abstract: A remote image monitor/control system for managing plural stable equipment is provided to optimize temperature and humidity in a stable and minimize a temperature variation between upper and lower temperatures in the stable, and measure harmful gas and water pollution in the stable, thereby managing the stable properly. Each stable control unit(160) measures the operation status of plural equipment in a stable, of which the monitoring is needed, through a sound, determines the abnormality of the equipment, photographs an image about the status of corresponding equipment if an abnormal state is detected, transmits the sound and the image to a central monitor/control unit(200), outputs a voice or music transmitted from the central monitor/control unit, recognizes response information and contact status information about the operation command of the plural equipment in the stable and on/off contact response information about the plural equipment, and transmits the code signal and data of a corresponding stable to the central monitor/control unit. The central monitor/control unit analyzes data transmitted from the each stable control unit, matches the analyzed image information and data to a corresponding code signal, displays the analyzed image information and data matched to the code signal, and transmits the operation command to the stable referring to the analyzed information. The each stable control unit includes a sound measuring device(110), a sound signal analyzing device(120), an image photographing device(130), a sound broadcasting device(140), a contact opening/closing device(150), an indoor-outdoor temperature/humidity measuring device(170), a harmful gas detecting device(180), a water measuring device(190), and each stable control device. The central monitor/control unit includes a monitoring device(230), a remote image control device(210), and a data analyzing device(240).

title: Livestock breeding and management system
abstract: A method and system for livestock breeding and management for use with a herd where each female animal carries a radio frequency identification (RFID) tag. The system comprises a herd management system and one or more breeding activity monitors to be carried by each male animal. Each breeding activity monitor is adapted to detect when the male animal is mounting a female animal based on the body position of the male animal, read identification data from the RFID tag carried by the mounted female animal, and generate breeding activity data including the identification data of the mounted female animal, mounting male animal and timing data for each mounting for output to the herd management system. The herd management system is adapted to process breeding activity data output from the breeding activity monitors to generate herd management data.

title: METHOD FOR MONITORING ESTRUS, OVULATION OF ANIMALS, FOR PLANNING A USEFUL FERTILIZATION TIME ZONE AND A PREFERRED FERTILIZATION TIME ZONE
abstract: Estrus and ovulation of animals and particularly sows is determined for planning of a preferred time zone of fertilization by a sensing system arranged to detect standing of the animal. Data from the sensing system is collected and analyzed using an algorithm and information that is displayed on an indicating system to provide an indication to a worker of the time zone of estrus and ovulation and of a useful fertilization time zone and a preferred fertilization time zone of the animal. The indicating system includes a countdown clock to the preferred time zone of fertilization. In the event that the fertilization fails, an indication is provided about whether the actual time of fertilization occurred at the preferred time of fertilization indicated to the worker. When estrus is completed, a confidence level is provided about the position of the actual time of fertilization relative to ovulation.

title: INGESTIBLE ANIMAL HEALTH SENSOR
abstract: An ingestible bolus configured to be maintained in a stomach of an animal may be formed from a substantially cylindrical enclosure shell. Ballast weight and a power source may be disposed therein. The ballast weight may be configured to cause the bolus to be maintained in contact with a stomach wall of the animal when disposed therein. The bolus may comprise sensors to measure one or more animal characteristics, a transmitter in wireless communication with an animal monitoring system, a memory unit to store measured characteristics and bolus configuration data, and processor to control the operation of the bolus components. The transmitter may be in communication with an antenna, which may be formed as a trace on an antenna circuit substrate, such as a printed circuit board (PCB). The antenna may be separated from the sensors, processors, and transmitter to prevent and/or reduce interference and/or coupling therebetween. The accelerometer sensor may be a three-axis accelerometer and may be configured to detect animal movement characteristics and animal stomach contractions.

title: Method and apparatus for data logging of physiological and environmental variables for domestic and feral animals
abstract: A GPS data acquisition collar incorporating an individualized rugged watertight collar that monitors factors including GPS location, gazing patterns, elevation, feeding patterns, temperature, movement speed, sleep patterns and signaling or beacon tracking options. Additionally the present invention provides options for visual representation or programming alerting of factors that may affect an animal or herd of animals in a monitored and recorded environment.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MONITORING A HEALTH CONDITION OF AN ANIMAL
abstract: An ingestible bolus may be disposed within the stomach of an animal. The bolus may comprise one or more sensors to monitor one or more internal and/or external animal characteristics. The bolus may comprise a data transmitter in wireless communication with a base station. The base station may receive messages from the bolus comprising one or more measured animal characteristics. The base station may comprise a process to monitor the animal and/or be in communication with a process to monitor the animal. The process may build an animal profile based upon the observed characteristics of the animal, the characteristics of other animals in a group associated with the animal, and/or characteristics associated with the breed and/or sex of the animal. Based on this profile, the process may detect a change in a health condition of the animal. Such heath conditions may include, but are not limited to, an estrus condition in the animal, off-feed condition, a nominal condition, the animal leaving an enclosure, or the like.

title: CATTLE INFECTION MANAGING SYSTEM THROUGH STATISTICAL ANALYSIS AND METHOD THEREOF
abstract: An infection management system of cattle and a method thereof through statistical analysis are provided to prevent the infectious disease of the cattle in case that the disease is generated. Sensor nodes(100) collect the health condition measurement information of entire cattle in a plurality of livestock sheds. A gateway controls the operation of sensor nodes. The health condition measurement information of the sensor node is received. A disease management server processes the health condition measurement information of the sensor node. A software platform(300) provides an application service determining whether to generate the disease of the corresponding cattle. The infection management system of the cattle prevents the infectious disease of the cattle.

title: METHOD OF AND DEVICE FOR MANAGING A GROUP OF DAIRY ANIMALS, AS WELL AS A COMPUTER PROGRAM PRODUCT THEREFOR
abstract: The invention provides a method of managing a group of dairy animals, wherein each animal can be recognized individually by means of an animal identification system, wherein the animals are milked and give an individually realized milk yield and wherein the animals are fed with an individual ration, wherein data regarding the group of dairy animals are collected, which data comprise at least the individually realized milk yields and the consumed rations, wherein subsequent individual milk yields are estimated by means of a model on the basis of said data, wherein, for one or more animals, at least one of the individual ration and the milking of individual dairy animals is adjusted in a regulatory step under application of a precondition. The invention also provides a device and a computer program product, arranged to perform such a method.

title: System for monitoring and tracking animals
abstract: A product is inserted subcutaneously, either manually or mechanically, into domesticated or wild animals to assist in tracking domesticated or wild animals. The product and methods of using include GPS transmitting or any other electronic device to locate and find a lost pet, livestock, migratory movements of birds, or the study of any and all aquatic life. A central data base or a location information receiving device allows an owner/caregiver to locate the animals.

title: IDENTIFICATION SYSTEM FOR MILKING PARLOUR
abstract: A method of correlating identification information received from a portable electronic identification module arranged to interrogate an electronic identification device with information obtained from a monitoring device, the method including the steps of: positioning the module in proximity to the monitoring device at a testing station, reading the identification information using the module, wirelessly transmitting the identification information from the module to a central electronic control device, and correlating data from the monitoring device that is entered into the central electronic control device with the identification information.
applicants: COATES, DAVID, KEN; OTLEY, TIMOTHY JAMES; TRU-TEST

title: AUTO LIVESTOCK RAISING DEVICE
abstract: An automatic livestock raising device is provided, which detects estrus and conception by using the feature that the behavioral trait changes. An automatic livestock raising device comprises: an acceleration sensor part(100) which measures the behavioral trait of the domestic animals and wirelessly transmits it; a receiving antenna part(200) delivering the information that is received by the acceleration sensor part to the main controller part; a main controller part(300) which understands the estrus or the conception information of the domestic animals and delivers it to the central processing unit; and a central processing unit(400) which outputs the information delivered to the main controller part and notifies the user terminal(500) of it.
applicants: KIM, SUNG DO; NARA T&S COMPANY

title: ANIMAL LAYOMETER DEVICE AND METHOD THEREOF
abstract: A device determining and recording at predefined time intervals various types of behavioral characteristics of an animal wearing the device which is useful in detection of a biological change in the animal and method thereof are disclosed. The laying down meter or 'layometer' device monitors when the animal is walking, standing still, or lying down throughout a given time period. Since the standing and laying pattern of animals such as individual dairy cows and other types of cattle throughout a twenty-four hour period is so specific, any deviation from that pattern may indicate the onset of lameness or another health-related problem.
applicants: TUROWSKI, ERIN, E.; EPPERSON, WILLIAM, B.; KIEL, LISA, MARIE; DARR, MATTHEW, J.; OHIO STATE UNIVERSITY

title: Livestock drafting apparatus and method
abstract: Apparatus for drafting livestock e.g. from a single race through a set of gates into a plurality of separate drafting groups in which a drafting controller (126) is arranged to receive e.g. wirelessly data from an electronic identification reader (122), to select automatically the drafting group for the animal, e.g. based on querying a database (132) or looking up information in a table. The drafting controller is communicable with a audio output device, e.g. voice chip (144) and speaker (146), that is arranged to output an audible signal which is indicative of the selected drafting group on the basis of instructions from the drafting controller. Automated identification of the drafting group for an animal means the attention of the operator of the set of gates is not distracted away from the animals.

title: METHOD OF IDENTIFYING ANIMALS WITH LIKELIHOOD OF PROVIDING HIGH QUALITY MEAT
abstract: A method of identifying prior to or after birth whether an animal, such as a Holstein calf, has an acceptable likelihood of producing high quality meat comprises the steps of: providing a unique identification indicia for the animal; providing, to a central organization, detailed information about the animal including at least some of the lineage of the animal, the provided information being keyed to the unique identification indicia of the animal; entering the detailed information for the animal into a central organization database keyed to the unique identification indicia for the animal; calculating a conditional probability percentage that the animal will provide high quality meat based on genetic information of at least one member of the lineage of the animal which is obtained from the central organization database; and selecting the animal for a particular raising program if the conditional probability percentage for the animal is greater than or equal to a predetermined limit.

title: SYSTEM FOR AND METHOD OF MANAGING A GROUP OF ANIMALS
abstract: System for managing a group of animals, comprising: - a control system (122), - a camera (100) connected thereto for forming a depth-image of an animal, and - performing means (124, 126), wherein the control system (122) is arranged to compare information regarding the depth-image observed by the camera (100) with reference information regarding the animal, to generate control information on the basis of this comparison, and to lead the control information to the performing means, and wherein the camera comprises: - a source of radiation (108) for electromagnetic radiation, - a matrix of receivers (110) for receiving electromagnetic radiation reflected from the dairy animal, - a lens (106) for displaying the reflected radiation on the receivers (110), and - sensor control means, characterized in that the sensor control means modulate the radiation, and in that the sensor control means are arranged to determine for each of the receivers (110) a phase difference between the emitted and the reflected radiation.
applicants: VOOGD, LUCIEN, ELIZA, NIELS; VAN DEN BERG, KAREL; MAASLAND

title: RECOGNITION AND LOCALISATION OF PATHOLOGIC ANIMAL AND HUMAN SOUNDS
abstract: A system and method are described for combining the respiratory status (e.g. amount and type of cough) with the localization of organisms having the respiratory status in real time. The organisms are able to suffer from a respiratory complaint, i.e. they have lungs such as mammals especially farm animals and humans. In particular the present invention is advantageous for animals and humans who are exposed to closed confinements such as pens, cages, aircraft, public places where humans are in close proximity to each other.
applicants: LEROY, TOON; FERRARI, SARA; AERTS, JEAN-MARIE; SILVA, MITCHELL; KATHOLIEKE UNIVERSITEIT LEUVEN; COSTA, ANNAMARIA; BERCKMANS, DANIEL; EXADAKTYLOS, VASILEIOS; BIORICS; BORGONOVO, FEDERICA; GUARINO, MARCELLA

title: Device for determining body temperature of farm animal, particularly cattle, comprises temperature sensor for measuring upper surface temperature of body of farm animal at location
abstract: The device (1) comprises a temperature sensor (2) for measuring the upper surface temperature of the body of a farm animal at a location. An evaluation unit (3) is provided, which is connected with the temperature sensor, and records the temperature signal from the temperature sensor. A transmission and display unit (4) is provided, which is connected with the evaluation unit. A mounting unit (5) is provided for the temperature sensor, the evaluation unit, and the transmission and display unit. An independent claim is included for a method for measuring body temperature of a farm animal, particularly cattle.

title: Antenna system
abstract: A method for energising and detecting RFID transponders in which a phase relationship between first and second power signals used to power first 34 and second 36 parts of an antenna 24 is repeatedly switched to produce two different field patterns. The regions which may allow transponders having a certain orientation to escape detection may be different for each phase relationship. By selecting the phase relationships appropriately and performing the phase switching at a rate to ensure that any transponder travelling through the antenna range is exposed to each field pattern, the probability of a transponder escaping detection can be reduced. The phase switching may occur during the transition between a transmitting period and a listening period. The method is particularly useful for detecting tags on livestock.

title: RADIO FREQUENCY ANIMAL TRACKING SYSTEM
abstract: An RFID system provides a transponder having a power store that can be recharged when located within an electromagnetic field generated by a transceiver unit. The power store can be a battery and/or a capacitor. In certain embodiments, the transponder can communicate over at least two different frequencies so that the real time performance of the transponder can be improved without losing backwards compatibility. The system provides an ear tag for use on livestock with superior durability and overall performance in the field.

title: Fuidi herd management schema
abstract: The invention is a herd management schema based upon the inventor's analysis of the natural history of bovine infection due to Mycobacterium avium subspecies paratuberculosis (Map) and related genomic variants and upon the ability of two distinct Map ELISA tests to sequentially or in parallel determine prior and current Map infection and evidence of active mycobacterium replication. Interpretation of the test results are integrated into sequential directives designed to enhance productive retention of infected animals as well as identify animal not previously infected. The sequential utilization of the data guidelines is developed to minimize the adverse economic impact.

title: Data acquiring method for use during e.g. animal husbandry i.e. intensive animal husbandry such as dairy farming, involves examining animal and detecting determined processable measured value in data-technical manner
abstract: The method involves examining an animal in such a manner that a further-processable measured value (20) i.e. diagnostic value, is determinable, where the animal has an unique identification code (21) i.e. radio frequency identification code, which is read by a machine. The determined processable measured value is detected in a data-technical manner such that the identification code is associated with the processable measured value and is led together to an electronic data processing unit (9) i.e. personal computer system, for subsequent treatment. An independent claim is also included for a data acquisition system comprising a measuring instrument.
applicants: H. HAUPTNER UND RICHARD HERBERHOLZ & COMPANY

title: LIVESTOCK TRACKING SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: A livestock tracking system includes the collection of animal data upon loading of the livestock for transport and the collection of similar data upon unloading, thereby monitoring and tracking same. Livestock is transported from a grouped plurality to individual animals capable of being weighed and then put into transport containers. Each transport container is readily identifiable throughout the process such that upon the unloading of the livestock the information pertaining to the livestock within each container can be compared to data collected upon loading and therefore traced. While the most important data is weight, other measurements may be utilized. A method incorporating this system is also disclosed.

title: Vitality meter for health monitoring of anonymous animals in livestock groups
abstract: Vitality sensing electronic system and method for monitoring the health of a livestock group, comprising: a vitality sensing unit attached to a sample of individual sentinels in a group of livestock, the unit configured to measure a plurality of physiological and behavioral parameters indicative of the sentinel's health condition, location means configured to locate each of the individual sentinels and a computing and storage unit communicating with the vitality sensing unit adapted to determine the group's health based on the sample of measured parameters.

title: System and methods for health monitoring of anonymous animals in livestock groups
abstract: A system and method for tracking the health of a group of livestock. In an exemplary embodiment of the invention, the vital signs of a small number of sentinel animals is tracked and used to assess the existence and/or progress of a disease in the group. In an exemplary embodiment of the invention, the vital signs are assessed using a vitality sensor, for example, an accelerometer which provides signals indicating the type and/or other properties of movements made by the sentinel animals.

title: Tracking method for the tracking in a hog production line, in particular for the production of raw/cooked ham, especially if denominated from a protected/controlled origin.
abstract: Tracking method for the tracking of a hog production line, in particular one for the production of raw/cooked ham, especially if denominated from a protected/controlled origin, and structure of an identifying code for carrying out such a method, which provides a sequence of operating phases wherein a phase of inserting emission devices into a hog at the milk piglet stage allows associating a particular identifying code to each hind leg of such a hog and a general identifying code for such a hog composed of a combination of these particular identifying codes. This system allows achieving a complete and real-time tracking of a hog production and processing line. The invention also concerns the structure of an identifying code for carrying out such a method ( Fig. 4 ).

title: Non-supervised livestock positioning and control system based on gnss technologies. (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract: Gnss positioning system and livestock control, based on the combined use of satellite navigation technologies (gps, waas, egnos, galileo) and action systems (acoustic buzzer-warning, actuation system by means of electric micro-discharges). Integrated by device that carries out the location of the carrier and a control system capable of ensuring that the positions of the carrier animal fall within a certain perimeter of action, causing a performance on the animal to achieve it in case its positions load outside of the same. The main innovation is the achievement of a system that does not require any type of intervention to achieve a 'virtual' grazing activity in a completely autonomous manner. The action system is adapted to each type of livestock in particular, based on the behavior/reactions of each type of hut (sheep, goat, bovine etc.) (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)

title: ANIMAL INTERACTION SYSTEM PROVIDED WITH AT LEAST ONE UV-LIGHT UNIT
abstract: An animal interaction.system (1) for milking, feeding and/or selecting animals. The system is provided with at least one UV-light unit (40. 1) for generating UV-light wherein the system is designed such that when the UV-light unit generates the UV-light, the UV-light irradiates a part of the system which, in use, comes into contact with an animal, for killing bacteria, spores and/or fungi present on the part of the system and/or that the UV-light can irradiate a part of an animal present in the proximity of the system for killing bacteria.
applicants: KARSIJNS, WOLTHERUS; NEDERLANDSCHE APPARATENFABRIEK NEDAP; VERSTEGE, ALBERTINO, BERNARDO, MARIA

title: Farming installation i.e. pigsty installation, for pigs, has detection and managing unit identifying animals that are opposite to feeders and controlling distribution units according to identity of identified animals
abstract: The installation has a passage system (120) i.e. chamber, allowing entry of animals (110) in a space (108). Exit systems (122-124) allow exit of the animals from the space. Food distribution units pour food in feeders (112, 142). A detection and managing unit identifies the animals and authorizes passing of the animals through the system according to identity and a number of animals present in the space, and number of feeders in the space, where the unit identifies the animals that are opposite to the feeders and controls distribution units according to the identity of the identified animals.

title: Method and system for monitoring and reducing ruminant methane production
abstract: A method, and systems implementing such method, for reducing methane emissions by ruminants. The method includes providing a feed dispenser for feeding ruminants one or more nutrient supplements, and the feed dispenser includes a gas analyzer proximate to where the ruminant places its head. The method includes determining a particular ruminant has accessed the feed dispenser such as by reading an identifier from an RFID ear tag and operating the feed dispenser to provide a ration of methane-controlling nutrient supplement. The method includes using the gas analyzer to determine levels of carbon dioxide and methane and operating a data analyzing station to determine a ratio of methane to carbon dioxide and modify the type or amount of nutrient supplement for the ruminant for a next feeding to control methane production or achieve an animal production goal, such as by selectively operating a hopper with two or more supplements compartments.

title: A RADIO FREQUENCY IDENTIFICATION TAG FOR LIVESTOCK TRACKING
abstract: A Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tag assembly (200) which is suitable for livestock tracking. The RFID tag assembly includes a male portion (110), a female portion (120) and a support member (130). The female portion is configured to receive the male portion, and the support member is coupled to the male and the female portions. The support member carries an RFID communication device (131) which includes a transponder (131a) and an RFID coil coupled to the transponder. In some embodiments, the RFID coil (131b) has a thickness of less than approximately 2 millimeters (mm). In one embodiment, the RFID coil has an inner diameter of approximately 9mm and an outer diameter of approximately 16mm.
applicants: PTS TECHNOLOGIES; LOH, KIM HUAT ALBERT; HUANG, TOON LIANG

title: Chewing activity detecting device for ruminant animal, has pressure sensor measuring and registering nose band movements with recording frequency of specific Hertz, where nose band movements are produced by jaw movements
abstract: The device has a pressure receiving device including a silicon tube, which is filled with vegetable oil. A head-collar includes a chuck for receiving a pressure sensor and a bag for receiving a data recorder for recording jaw movements. The pressure sensor measures and registers nose band movements with a recording frequency of 10 Hertz, where the nose band movements are produced by the jaw movements. The pressure sensor is connected with the data recorder via a cable. The chuck and the bag are fastened to a nose band of the head-collar.
applicants: FORSCHUNGSANSTALT AGROSCOPE RECKENHOLZ-TAENIKON ART; MSR ELECTRONICS

title: HIGH SPEED SYSTEM FOR ELECTRONIC IDENTIFICATION OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: The present invention concerns a high speed system for electronic identification of livestock comprising one or more low perceptive impact flexible antennas (11) for detection of transponders associated to each animal (12), arranged vertically in correspondence of a passage for animals (12) to identify, arranged side by side according to a transversal direction with respect to the path of the animals (12), characterised in that said antennas are constituted by a flexible wire (22) supporting at least one cylindrical antenna (23).

title: ROBOT MUSTERING OF ANIMALS
abstract: This invention concerns the mustering of animals. Mustering is currently conducted by people on motorbike, quadbike or horse, or in a helicopter. In particular the invention concerns a method for mustering animals. The method involves operating a robot mustering agent for mustering a herd of animals, comprising the steps of: Determining the location, direction and speed of the herd. Determining the location, direction and speed of the mustering agent. Storing information about the mustering location or path. Storing information about individual animal or herd behaviour. Storing a control function. Repeatedly using the determined and stored information and the control function to calculate adjustments to the speed and direction of the mustering agent. And, implementing the adjustments in the operation of the mustering agent. In another aspect the invention concerns a robot mustering agent and in a further aspect the invention is software to control the robot mustering agent.
applicants: CSIRO (COMMONWEALTH SCIENTIFIC AND INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH ORGANISATION); CORKE, PETER

title: Core-temperature based herd management system and method
abstract: A system and method for managing a herd of animals possibly requiring medical treatment, such as cows in a feedlot. The animals are herded individually into a chute, where identification data is collected from a tag, and core temperature data is collected using a special non-contacting core temperature sensor. The animal is tagged with a color coded tag representing a range of temperatures into which that animal's temperature falls. The animal is then delivered to a pen corresponding to that range of temperatures, where appropriate medicinal treatment is automatically dosed and applied to the animal.
applicants: LYMAN; JAMES C.; HICKS, RONALD, B.; LAURENCE, JACK C.; WILLIAMS, MICHAEL R.; LAURENCE, LAIRD W.; NANCE, ALLEN; HERDX; KING, JAMES DERWIN

title: DEVICE OF MANAGEMENTING A BREEDING FOR LIVESTOCK GROUP HOUSING
abstract: PURPOSE: A device of managing domestic animals of livestock housing is provided to feed a fixed amount of fodder to each domestic animal. CONSTITUTION: A device of managing domestic animals of livestock housing comprises: a frame part(10) in which an entrance and an exit are formed at a bent angle; a first sensor(20) sensing the information of domestic animals approaching the entrance; an entrance opening and closing part opening and closing the entrance of a path so that domestic animals can enter the path; an automatic feeding part(50) automatically providing a fixed amount of fodder to domestic animals; a second sensor sensing whether the domestic animals eat fodder or not; an exit closing part(70) closing the exit of the path; a compulsory withdrawal part(80) which forcibly withdraws the domestic animals to the exit of the path; and a controller(100).
applicants: REPUBLIC OF KOREA (RURAL DEVELOPMENT ADMINISTRATION); LEE, WAN SEOP

title: AUTO FEEDING SYSTEM FOR SOWS AND METHOD OF THEREOF
abstract: PURPOSE: An automatic feeding system for sows and a method thereof are provided to prevent loss of feed and to reduce labor manpower required for feeding. CONSTITUTION: An automatic feeding system for sows comprises: an RFID tag which transmits an electric wave having characteristic identifying information and is mounted on a fixed position of a sow; an RFID reader which receives an electric wave transmitted from the RFID tag and deciphers the received information; a memory unit in which feeding information is saved; a fixed amount feed supplying device; and a controller controlling the fixed amount feed supplying device.

title: THE ESTRUS AUTO-DETECTING SYSTEM FOR SOWS
abstract: PURPOSE: An automatic estrus detecting system for sows is provided to automatically detect estrus state of a sow by applying pressure to the buttock of the sow and sensing the pressure. CONSTITUTION: An automatic estrus detecting system for sows comprises: an RFID tag which is mounted on the fixed position of a sow; an RFID reader which receives an electric wave transmitted from the RFID tag and deciphers the received information; a memory unit in which sexual excitement time and information of each sow is saved; an installation trestle consisting of a plurality of vertical and transverse frames; a main pivot shaft which is installed in the installation trestle in the traverse direction; a drive motor; a pair of driving shafts; a limit photosensor detecting a lower limit an upper limit; a pressing unit pressing the upper portion of the buttock of the sow; and a controller controlling forward and inverse rotation of the drive motor.

title: Radio frequency recording of livestock method and chute
abstract: A radio frequency antenna and chute arrangement 1 comprises at least one radio frequency antenna 25 formed in the shape of an arch extending over at least an upper region of a passage 5 - 7 for recording the passage of livestock. The antenna 25 may be a saddle-shaped solenoid coil formed within a skeletal framework 17, 19 which has dimensions which only allows animals to pass through in single file. The antenna 25 may be linked to control electronics and a computer to read radio frequency identification (RFID) tags on animals and the computer may only record once the information provided by a tag irrespective of the number of times the information is received. Alternatively, a chute or a method for recording the passage of livestock may comprise an enclosed channel 3 where the entrance of the channel has a breadth sufficient to admit a plurality of animals abreast and the exit of the channel 3 has a plurality of exits passages 5 - 7 where each passage has a portion with a width to admit only a single file of animals and an RFID antenna 25 is located in each respective exit passage 5 - 7 and where the animals in adjacent exit passages 5 — 7 are visible to one another. The length of each exit passage 5 - 7 may be staggered.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR DETECTING BEHAVIOUR OF ANIMALS
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and a method for detecting the behaviour of a number of animals, such as cattle, where each animal carries at least a number of detectors, which detectors are communicating with at least a first processor carried by the animal, which first processor further communicates with a central processor. The object of the invention is to detect animal behaviour and transmit data concerning the animal behaviour to a computer system for further analysis of the data. This object can be achieved by a system and if the system and method are further modified by letting the animal carry an accelerometer and a gyroscope for detecting movement of the animal, which system comprises at least a short-range communication system for transmitting data from the first processor to the second central processor. By using an accelerometer and a gyroscop placed at an animal, this accelerometer and gyroscop can detect the behaviour of the animal.

title: LIVESTOCK TEMPERATURE MONITORING AND DETECTION SYSTEM
abstract: Disclosed herein is a livestock temperature measuring and detection system. The system includes a housing, typically made from engineering plastic. Within the housing is a probe defining a thermistor having a threshold temperature. The thermistor is inserted in the livestock's ear. The threshold temperature is pre-set for monitoring a particular livestock condition. The housing includes a visible display. The housing includes a microprocessor which monitors the thermistor and upon detecting the threshold signal activates the display for visible observation.
applicants: CRIDER, JR., RICHARD; MORELAND, TIM; FULTS, ALVIN

title: Control and monitoring system for a rotating dairy platform
abstract: Control and monitoring system for a rotating dairy platform which comprises multiple animal stalls arranged about its periphery (fig 1). The system comprises an interactive display screen which displays output information relating to the current status of operations on the platform and which displays input channels for use by an operator. The platform itself is represented by an annular shape 34, wherein each animal stall on the platform is graphically represented by a cell 8. The cells are displayed in a spatial arrangement corresponding to the arrangement of stalls on the platform. Real-time status information relating to operations on the platform is represented at each cell, and the rotating movement of the platform is represented by the progression of each cell about the displayed representation of the platform.

title: Optically supported livestock location device
abstract: The animal detection device has a characteristic collection device (30) for detecting an animal-individual characteristic, a picture version unit, which is formed to detect multiple animals in time intervals within an animal break area (20). A data processing unit is provided, which is signal-technically connected with a characteristic collection device and the picture version device.

title: HOG MIX FEEDER
abstract: PURPOSE: A feeding device for pigs is provided to reduce an effort for removing remaining feed and to facilitate feeding management. CONSTITUTION: A feeding device for pigs comprises a metric feed container(10), a fodder dosage distributor(20), a sensing switch(50), and a controller. The metric feed container is used in order to store fodder. The fodder dosage distributor is connected to the metric feed container and automatically controls feed supply amount. The sensing switch senses the contact of the body of a pig. The controller controls the drive of the fodder dosage distributor by a signal from the sensing switch.
applicants: CHOI, SUNG CHAN; CHOI, HO JEONG

title: RTLS TAG FOR REAL-TIME MANAGEMENT OF LIVESTOCK AND LIVESTOCK MANAGING SYSTEM USING THE SAME
abstract: PURPOSE: An RTLS tag for real-time management of livestock and a livestock managing system using the same are provided to biochemically test blood of livestock and communicate with an RTLS(Real Time Locating Systems) tag to transmit the test result in real time, thereby checking whether livestock which have diseases exist in real time. CONSTITUTION: A wireless transceiving unit(220) forms a communication channel by a reader and an antenna of an RTLS. A blood gathering unit(250) gathers blood of livestock. A bio sensor(260) measures components in the blood. The bio sensor senses a thermal change and a chemical change of the blood to output an electrical signal. A memory(230) stores identification information of a tag.

title: Signaling system for piggery installation to allow breeder to identify pig requiring medical treatment, has energy source to supply energy to receiving unit, light source and control unit controlling ignition and extinction of light source
abstract: The system (100) has a transmission unit (102) controlled by a CPU (106) and transmitting radio messages (108), and a signaling badge (104) fixed with an animal i.e. pig (50). A fixation unit i.e. orifice, fixes a base i.e. sealed case, on the animal. A receiving unit receives the transmitted messages. A control unit interprets the received messages, and controls ignition and extinction of a light source i.e. high quality LED, based on the interpretation. An energy source supplies electric energy to the receiving unit, the light source and the control unit.

title: ANIMAL MONITORING
abstract: The behavior of livestock animals (A1, A2, A3, A4) located within a predefined area (100) is monitored. To this aim each animal (A1, A2, A3, A4) has a respective identification means (T1, T2, T3, T4) uniquely identifying the animal. Image registering means (C1, C2, C3, C4) repeatedly record image data (d1, d2, d3, d4) representing the animals (A1, A2, A3, A4). A data processing means (120) receives the image data (d1, d2, d3, d4), and based thereon derives a movement pattern (MP) for each animal (A1, A2, A3, A4). Moreover, at least one identification station (110, 111) registers an animal identity (ID1) in response to the passing of one of said identification means (T1) within an operating zone of the identification station (110, 111). The identification station (110, 111) is distinct from the at least one image registering means (C1, C2, C3, C4).

title: METHOD FOR DETERMINING THE IDENTITY OF AN ANIMAL AT AT LEAST A FIRST LOCATION
abstract: Method for determining the identity and a position of an animal at at least a first location wherein for example at the at least one first location at least a part of a rotary milking parlour is present or at least a part of a separation station is present, characterised in that, the method comprises the following steps: a. determining the identity of an animal by means of reading an identification code from a identification label carried by the animal at a second location; b. following the animal which is identified in step a. by means of at least one camera when the animal travels from the second location towards the at least one first location while keeping the identity as determined in step a. associated with the animal followed in step b.; c. determining by means of the at least one camera when the animal which is followed in step b. is present and/or arrives on the at least one first location while determining by means of the camera the position of the animal at the at least one first location.

title: RFID/USN BASED LIVESTOCK FEEDER AND THEREFOR
abstract: PURPOSE: An RFID/USN-based livestock feeder and a method for operating the same are provided to obtain meat of uniform weights and sizes by supplying feed to livestock based on livestock individual and identifying information. CONSTITUTION: An RFID/USN-based livestock feeder includes a feeding unit(200) and a feed distributor(300). The feeding unit collects livestock information and support the feeding of livestock. The feeding unit is composed of a livestock weight measuring load cell(220), a feed reaming measuring load cell(230), a TAG information collecting part(210), a feed container, an opening and closing unit(250), a treating unit(260), a communicating part, and a controlling part. The opening and closing unit treats remaining feed. The treating unit cleans the remaining feed. The communicating part transmits collected information and receives controlling signals. The feed distributor automatically distributes feed to the livestock.
applicants: INDUSTRY-ACADEMY COOPERATION CORPS OF SUNCHON NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: A DEVICE FOR CONTROLLING THE MILK PRODUCED BY AN ANIMAL, A CONTAINER FOR THE DEVICE
abstract: This invention relates to a device for controlling milk produced by an animal to be milked (1), comprising a first means (4) for identifying the animal (1) and a means (3) for measuring the quantity of produced milk, said measuring means (3) comprising a container (3) supplied with milk through a pipe adapted so as to deliver a determined fraction of the milk produced by the animal (1). Said container (3) comprises a second means (5) for identifying the container (3) and the device comprises a portable apparatus (6) holding means (14) for detecting said first and second identification means (4, 5) and means for associating said first and second identification means (4, 5) for associating the container (3) with the animal (1). The invention is characterized in that said portable apparatus (6) is arranged so as to emit an alarm when the detection means (14) detect a tag of a second identification means (5) which is not associated with the first identification means (4). By means of this invention, controlling milk is simple and possible mistakes are minimized.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR ESTIMATING HERBAGE UPTAKE OF AN ANIMAL
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a system for estimating the feeding value or the amount of consumed herbage of grazing animals. The estimated herbage uptake is based on measured and possibly estimated data which is supplied as input data to a mathematical model. Measured input data may be acceleration data of the head of the animal, the length of herbage and the quality, i.e. feeding value, of herbage. Estimated input data may be the frequency of the reciprocate head motion of the animal and the in-active or active grazing status of the cow. Alternatively, the estimated data may be determined by the model and possibly provided as output data. Measurements may be obtained by a sensor module carried by the animal and the measurements may be wirelessly transmitted from the sensor module to a receiver, possibly via relay transceivers.
applicants: OUDSHOORN, FRANK WILLEM; SYDDANSK UNIVERSITET; NADIMI, ESMAEIL SHAHRAK; JOERGENSEN, RASMUS NYHOLM

title: DEVICE FOR THE MEASUREMENT OF INDIVIDUAL FARM ANIMAL DATA
abstract: The invention relates to a measuring device (3) for the measurement of at least one physiological parameter of a farm animal's organism, whereby the measuring device (3) is placeable in the gastro-intestinal tract of livestock and comprises the following components arranged in a casing (4): at least one sensor (8, 8') for the measurement of at least one physiological parameter of a farm animal, at least one transmitter (9) with antenna (10) for the wireless transmission of information, at least one control unit (7) for controlling the measuring device (3), and at least one power supply device (11) for the measuring device (3), whereby a hollow protective guard (12, 12') is provided inside the casing (4) which covers at least the power supply unit in order to protect it from mechanical impact.
applicants: ROSENKRANZ, STEFAN; SMAXTEC ANIMAL CARE SALES; FALLAST, MARIO

title: Control and monitoring system for an animal installation
abstract: Control and monitoring system for implementation as a computer supported graphical user interface for an installation comprising one or more arrangements of animal treatment stalls (1, fig 1). The control and monitoring system is configured to display, in an interactive display, output information relating to the current status of operations in a stall arrangement and input channels for use by an operator. The system is configured to display a representation of the stall arrangement in which each stall (12, fig 1) is represented by a cell 8 and in which the cells are displayed in a spatial layout corresponding to the layout of stalls in the actual stall arrangement. Furthermore, the system is configured to display live video picture images 4 from video cameras (21, fig 1) at or nearby animal stalls. The live video picture images are displayed in association with corresponding represented cells in said interactive display. The control and monitoring system is preferably used as part of a dairy platform, preferably a rotating platform (see fig 5).

title: Feeder Cam
abstract: A Game Or Livestock Or Other Farm/Wildlife Animal Feeder With DVR's/Cameras/Routers/Batteries/Solar Panels In Which Live And Recorded Video Can Be Transmitted By Aircard/Satellite/Or Other Wireless Connection To Be Viewed Via Internet Or Smart Phone. Cameras/Components Hidden And Or Exposed To Be Used With Or Without External Power. Able To View Live Or Recorded Video/Pictures/Audio From Other Location As Well As Locally Router To Allow WiFi Service To Devices Within Range. Multiple Users Simultaneously. Can Be For Entertainment, Hunting, Surveillance, Security, Weather, Spying, Anti-Terrorist , Activity, Nature Observing, Climate, Monitoring, Construction Activities, Poaching, ETC.

title: System and method for milking stall assignment using real-time location
abstract: In certain embodiments, a method for milking stall assignment includes storing first location information associated with a dairy livestock, the first location information comprising a coordinate location of the dairy livestock within a milking parlor at a first time. The method further includes comparing the stored first location information associated with the dairy livestock with an area associated with each of a plurality of milking stalls of the milking parlor to identify a milking stall in which the dairy cow is located at the first time and assigning the dairy livestock to the milking stall in which the dairy cow is located at the first time such that data associated with milking of the dairy livestock may be associated with the dairy cow.
applicants: TECHNOLOGIES HOLDINGS CORPORATION; ERDMAN, ROGER, K.; NELSON, WILLIAM, S.; THOMPSON; PAUL D.; JOHNSON, DAVID A.; STEINGRABER, GARY, C.; RAJKONDAWAR, PARIMAL, G.

title: A SYSTEM FOR ANALYZING THE MOVEMENT PATTERNS OF CATTLE
abstract: PURPOSE: A system for analyzing movement patterns of livestock is provided to apply all movements of livestock and also apply changes of movement patterns of the livestock, thereby calculating the actual momentum of the live stock. CONSTITUTION: An acceleration sensor is attached to livestock to obtain movement information of the livestock. A movement pattern analyzing unit(210) calculates a movement size by using the movement information. The movement pattern analyzing unit determines a movement pattern of the livestock by using a standard deviation of the movement size. The movement pattern analyzing unit generates movement pattern change information. A momentum calculating module calculates the momentum of the livestock by using the determined movement pattern and the movement pattern change information. [Reference numerals] (AA) Acceleration sensor; (BB) Signal amplification unit; (CC) Filtering unit; (DD) Vector size calculating unit; (EE) Standard deviation calculating module; (FF) Movement pattern determining module; (GG) Critical point generating module; (HH) Memory module; (II) Momentum calculating module; (JJ) Calorie consumption calculating module; (KK) Database
applicants: WONKWANG UNIVERSITY CENTER FOR INDUSTRY-ACADEMY COOPERATION

title: System and method for health monitoring using real-time location
abstract: In certain embodiments, a method includes storing location information associated with a dairy livestock. The stored location information includes a location of the dairy livestock within a free stall pen at each of a plurality of times during a time period. The method further includes determining, based on at least a portion of the stored location information, one or more movement parameters associated with the dairy livestock. The method further includes determining, based on the one or more movement parameters associated with the dairy livestock, whether the dairy livestock is likely unhealthy.
applicants: ERDMAN, ROGER, K.; JOHNSON, DAVID A.; RAJKONDAWAR, PARIMAL, G.; NELSON, WILLIAM, S.; THOMPSON; PAUL D.; TECHNOLOGIES HOLDINGS CORPORATION

title: Feed control device for pigsty feeder
abstract: PURPOSE: A feeding amount control instrument for piggery feeder is provided to accurately provide necessary amount of fodder according to the status of pigs which pass the feeding tool. CONSTITUTION: A feeding amount control instrument for piggery feeder comprises a feeding chamber(10), a fodder(30), and a feeding tool(40). The fodder drops the forage into a feed container. The feeding tool drops the forage at the lower end by using a transfer toothed gear and collects fixed amount on an opening and closing plate installed to a feeding pipe. The fodder comprises a pushing plate(35) for opening and closing the fodder plate and an actuator(38). The transfer toothed gear of the feeding tool has helical tooth shape in order to prevent blockage of forage while transferring the same.

title: System and method for estrus detection using real-time location
abstract: In certain embodiments, a method for estrus detection includes storing location information associated with a dairy livestock. The stored location information includes a coordinate location of the dairy livestock within a free stall pen at each of a plurality of times during a time period. The method further includes determining, based on at least a portion of the stored location information, one or more movement parameters associated with the dairy livestock. The method further includes determining, based on one or more movement parameters associated with the dairy livestock, whether the dairy livestock is likely to be in estrus.
applicants: JOHNSON, DAVID A.; RAJKONDAWAR, PARIMAL, G.; ERDMAN, ROGER, K.; THOMPSON; PAUL D.; TECHNOLOGIES HOLDINGS CORPORATION; NELSON, WILLIAM, S.

title: Method and system for monitoring and reducing ruminant methane production
abstract: A method and system for reducing methane emissions by ruminants. The method includes providing a feed dispenser for feeding ruminants nutrient supplements, and the feed dispenser includes a gas analyzer where a ruminant places its head. The method includes determining a particular ruminant has accessed the feed dispenser such as by reading an identifier from an RFID ear tag and operating the feed dispenser to provide a ration of methane-controlling nutrient supplement. The method includes using the gas analyzer to determine levels of carbon dioxide and methane and operating a data analyzing station to determine a ratio of methane to carbon dioxide and modify the type or amount of nutrient supplement for the ruminant for a next feeding to control methane production or achieve an animal production goal, such as by operating a hopper with supplement compartments. The unit can be monitored remotely and controlled through an Internet connection.
applicants: C-LOCK; ZIMMERMAN, ROBERT SCOTT; ZIMMERMAN, PATRICK, R.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR DETERMINING GREENHOUSE GAS, IN PARTICULAR METHANE, EMITTED BY A RUMINANT, IN PARTICULAR A DAIRY ANIMAL
abstract: Method and device for determining greenhouse gas, in particular methane, emitted by a ruminant, in particular a dairy animal The invention provides a method and a device for determining the emission of greenhouse gas, in particular methane, by ruminants, in particular dairy animals. Eructations ('belches') of the animal are counted for this purpose. This is done by measuring a signal linked to the eructations, for example sound with a microphone. Given that the methane content of an eructation of this type is more or less constant, the total methane emission can be derived therefrom by counting.

title: Apparatus and method for estimation of livestock weight
abstract: A digital image of a target object is received and the image includes a plurality of pixels. The target object is at least a portion of an animal, and the portion of the animal is disposed in the image according to a predetermined disposition. The weight of the animal is determined using the model and at least one characteristic. At least some of the pixels of the image of animal are analyzed to determine at least one characteristic of the image of the animal. The weight of the animal is determined using the at least one characteristic.
applicants: GOMAS, STEVE; SWEENEY, JOHN; THEIL, EDWARD

title: Milking box with robotic attacher
abstract: In certain embodiments, a system includes a front wall, a rear wall positioned substantially parallel to the front wall, and first and second side walls each extending between the front wall and the rear wall. The first side wall includes a gate, and the second side wall is spaced apart from the first side wall such that the front wall, the rear wall, the first side wall, and the second side wall define a milking box stall of a size sufficient to accommodate a dairy livestock. The system includes an equipment portion located adjacent to the rear wall. The equipment portion houses a robotic attacher configured to extend between the rear legs of a dairy livestock located within the milking box stall in order to attach milking equipment to the dairy livestock.
applicants: HOFMAN, HENK; VAN DER SLUIS, PETER, WILLEM; GROENSMA, YPE; TECHNOLOGIES HOLDINGS CORPORATION

title: System for real-time monitoring of physiological parameter of animal i.e. calf, has implant acquiring data relating to physiological parameter of animal at determined frequency, where implant is compact, autonomous and active
abstract: The system (2) has an implant (4) inserted under skin of an animal (1). A remote relay terminal (8) is in communication with the implant by a wireless connection unit. The implant acquires data relating to physiological parameter of an animal at a determined frequency, where the implant is a compact, autonomous and active. The implant comprises a circuit supplied by a lithium-thionyl battery and/or a biofuel cell. The circuit comprises a sensor for measurement the physiological parameter, a microprocessor, a storage unit, a clock and a radio communication module.

title: OPTICAL TRACKING SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR HERD MANAGEMENT THEREWITH
abstract: An optical tracking system includes at least one optical emitter adapted to emit an optical signal including a modulated pattern of pulsed light, at least one camera with a field of view directed toward a pre-defined area operable to capture radiation from the optical signal over a stream of captured image frames, and a processing unit adapted to receive input from the at least one camera and to identify an area on the image frames where input was received from the optical signal based on differences in intensities between contiguous frames in the stream that receive input from the optical signal.

title: Early alert system and method for livestock disease detection
abstract: An early alert system and a related method for livestock disease detection are disclosed. In one embodiment of the invention, an activity measurement zone (AMZ) is defined near an incentive device (e.g. food or water dispensing system) with an RFID tag reader, and an animal's entrance into or out of the AMZ is tracked and counted with an RFID tag attached to the animal. If the animals' activity relative to the AMZ drops to an alarmingly low level (e.g. dropping below an alert trigger point) over a period of time, then a user of the alert system is informed of a potential health problem with the animal and may also be encouraged to inspect the animal in person for further determination of its current health and potential medical issues.
applicants: HANA MICRON AMERICA; KWAK, SUNG BOK

title: THE LIVESTOCK BODY TEMPERATURE SENSING DEVICE AND THE REMOTE DIAGNOSIS SYSTEM OF THEIR DISEASE AND THE METHOD USING THEREOF
abstract: PURPOSE: A livestock body temperature sensing device, a remote livestock disease diagnosis system, and a method thereof are provided to precisely measure body temperature of livestock. CONSTITUTION: A remote livestock disease diagnosis system comprises: a temperature sensing body(100) which comprises a temperature sensor, a livestock body penetration part, and a temperature information sending unit; and a temperature sensing body fixing unit(130) for fixing the temperature sensing body to a livestock. The temperature sensing body fixing unit comprises a support plate, an elastic member, an elastic member supporting plate, a main post, and a joint.

title: Detection apparatus
abstract: (57) Abstract An apparatus for monitoring a milking animal during milking of the animal, including a plurality of productivity sensors, each configured to measure at least one indicator of productivity of the animal and output a signal indicative of same; a plurality of temperature sensors, each sensor configured to measure an indicator of heat output from different processing areas of the milking animal and output a signal indicative of same, wherein at least two of the temperature sensors are thermographic cameras; and a processor configured to receive the signals indicative of heat output; receive the signals indicative of the productivity indicators, and use a combination of the heat output and productivity indicators to determine at least one condition of the milking animal, and cause that condition to be indicated in real time at the monitoring apparatus.

title: Low power device and method for livestock detection
abstract: A system and method of tracking animal livestock using electronic frequency signal transmitters and receivers is herein presented. The system involves electronic tags attached to the bodies of livestock. The tags transmit a signal which conveys the location or other pertinent information regarding the status of the animal. The signals are picked up by a receiver attached to a stationary platform, or located in a vehicle, or in a portable hand held receiver device. The information transmitted can be used to locate a specific animal or can be used to monitor the status and condition of the animal. The device contains several modes which minimize power consumption and maximize power supply lifetime.
applicants: MENACHEM URI BEN; S.C.R. ENGINEERS; BRAYER EYAL; LEVY SHAY

title: Multi-sensor environmental and physiological monitor system and methods of use
abstract: A system and method for monitoring the condition of a human, companion animal, or livestock animal in an extreme environment is disclosed. In particular, a system and method to process at least one environmental measurement and at least one physiological measurement to assess at least one condition of a human, companion animal, or livestock animal in an extreme environment is disclosed.
applicants: ZACHER, JARROD; VACHA, BENJAMIN J.; CAMPBELL, VICKI L.; LEAR; KEVIN L.; COLORADO STATE UNIVERSITY; NOTAROS, OLIVERA K.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MONITORING REMOTE LIVESTOCK
abstract: PURPOSE: A system and method for remotely monitoring livestock are provided to early prevent a livestock disease by integrally analyzing the state of the livestock and broadcasting the analyzed result. CONSTITUTION: A livestock identifying unit(112,114) monitors the state of livestock and wirelessly transmits the state of the livestock. A management server(116) communicates with a plurality of service nodes, integrally manages information provided from each service node, collects, analyzes, and reads livestock identification information received from the livestock identifying unit. A movable terminal node(118,120,122) informs an administrator of the abnormal state of the livestock from the management server. The livestock identifying unit includes a sensor to measure a biometric signal, a temperature and moisture sensor which an external temperature and moisture, a history storing unit to store history information, an AD converter, a control unit to generate a monitor signal, and a wireless communication unit.
applicants: NAM, GOONG LIM; NAMGOONG, SUNG; LEE, SO HYUN

title: Early alert system and method for livestock disease detection powered by hybrid alternative energy sources
abstract: An early alert system and a method for livestock disease detection are disclosed. An activity measurement zone (AMZ) is defined near an incentive device (e.g. food or water dispensing system) with an RFID tag reader and/or an RFID antenna. An animal's access into the AMZ is tracked and counted with an RFID tag attached to the animal. If the animals' activity relative to the AMZ drops to an alarmingly low level (e.g. dropping below an alert trigger point) over time, then a user of the alert system is informed of a potential health problem of the animal and may also be encouraged to inspect the animal in person for further determination of its current health and potential medical issues. The early alert system may be powered by hybrid alternative energy sources for rural or remote areas, which may have inconvenient or expensive access to conventional electrical power lines.
applicants: HANA MICRON AMERICA; TRAN, TOAN; LEE, YONG HYUN; JIN, SUNG RYOL; KWAK, SUNG BOK; JIN, SONGTAO

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR AUTOMATICALLY DETERMINING ANIMAL POSITION AND ANIMAL ACTIVITY
abstract: A method for monitoring activity of an animal (2) in a system (1) for housing free walking animals comprising a plurality of animal ID stations, the method comprising the steps of a) recording a first visit of said animal at a first of said animal ID stations, b) recording a subsequent second visit of said animal at a second of said animal ID stations, and c) determining a distance covered by said animal as the distance between said first animal ID station at said first visit and said second animal ID station at said second visit. With such simple means, parts of which are already present in e.g. most robot dairy stables, important information about activity of animals can easily be gathered.
applicants: SONG, XIANGYU; VAN DER TOL, PATRICK PHILIP JACOB; LELY PATENT; KOOL, PIETER, NEELUS; VAN DER KAMP, ADOLF JAN

title: MANAGEMENT SYSTEM FOR WELFARE SOWS IN OUTDOOR GROUP BREEDING SYSTEM AND METHOD THEREOF
abstract: PURPOSE: An integrated sow management system and a method thereof are provided to facilitate the management of sow and to improve farm management efficiency. CONSTITUTION: An integrated sow management system comprises a feed stall(112), an automatic feeding unit(120), a sow induction unit(130), an estrus sensing unit, a door opening and closing unit(160), and a main controller. An RFID reader is installed in an entrance of the stall. The automatic feeding unit provides a fixed quantity of feed. The sow induction unit prevents from sows continuously entering the feeding stall. The estrus sensing unit senses sexual excitement time of a sow. The door opening and closing unit comprises a gate stall. The main controller controls the estrus sensing unit and opening and closing unit.

title: A method for breeding fine Korean beef cattle by increasing marbling degrees and yield in cows
abstract: PURPOSE: A method to increase the meat amount of livestock and the degree of fat in muscles is provided to increase conservativeness and breeding rate of livestock with an excellent pedigree and to grow livestock of good quality through specification information containing the types, the content ratio and the provided amount of forage to raise the livestock. CONSTITUTION: A method to increase the meat amount of livestock is monitoring the growth state of the subjected livestock according to the ultra-wave data of the subjective livestock and contains a step that grows the subjected livestock segmenting the livestock into A type, B type, and C type according to the following equations. <Equation> A type: Y=a_1X-b_1, but, a_1<1, 8<=b_1<=14. In this equation, X is more than 18 and Y is a positive number. B type: Y=a_2X-b_2, but, 1<=a_2<1.5, 18<=b_2<=23. In this equation, X is more than 18 and Y is positive. C type: Y=a_3X-b_3, a_3>=1.5, 27<=b_3<=31. In this equation, X is more than 18 and Y is a positive number X is the age of months and Y is the thickness of fat on the back. In a method to increase the meat amount of livestock, an equation is as shown below. a_1=0.7343, b_1=11.49, a_2=1.194, b_2=0.475, a_3=1.6643 and b_3=29.374. [Reference numerals] (AA) Type A; (BB) Type B; (CC) Type C

title: MIXING AND DOSING DEVICE FOR CATTLE FEED
abstract: The invention relates to a mixing and dosing device for cattle feed. The invention also relates to a feeding stall for feeding animals and a system and method for tracking positions of animals.
applicants: STICHTING ADMINISTRATIEKANTOOR WEELINK BERENDSEN; WEELINK, JOHANNES MARTINUS WILLIBRORDUS

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR TRACKING A STABLED ANIMAL
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus for monitoring livestock comprising a light source, a light sensitive pixel grid (1 10) sensor with a field-of-view of a monitored area (200), and a processing unit adapted and configured to interpret a reading from an individual pixel in the pixel grid (1 10) as indicating an equivalent location corresponding to the pixel's field-of-view. The apparatus (100) is adapted and configured to receive a reading in a pixel indicating an equivalent location in the monitored area (200); statistically deduct that the indicated location is associated with a precedently indicated location; convert a set of associated locations to a movement pattern associated with an animal; assess the movement pattern against a set of reference criteria; and send an alert control signal if at least one reference criterion of the reference criteria is met. The invention also relates to a method and a computer program product.

title: DEVICE FOR INSPECTING THE AMOUNT OF WATER CONSUMED AND INSPECTION SYSTEM AND METHOD INCLUDING THE SAME
abstract: PURPOSE: A water intake inspecting apparatus of livestock, a water intake inspecting system having the same, and a water intake inspecting method having the same are provided to minimize errors due to an obsessive behavior of the water intake of livestock or pumping out water by accurately distinguishing an individual head from testing livestock in an environment where the testing livestock share the water intake inspecting apparatus. CONSTITUTION: A water intake inspecting apparatus of livestock(1000) comprises a water supplying tank, a frame, a supplied water measuring unit, a water supplying device(140), and a cleansing unit. The supplied water measuring unit, which is placed in between the frame and the water supplying tank, measures the amount of supplied water in the water supplying tank in real time and transmits the measured data. The water supplying device supplies water to the water supplying tank. The cleansing unit removes contamination in the water supplying tank. A drain is formed on the bottom surface of the water supplying tank.

title: WIRELESS COMMUNICATION DEVICE ATTACHED TO LIVESTOCK TAIL
abstract: PURPOSE: A wireless communication device having a livestock tail is provided to automatically perform battery replacement and charge. CONSTITUTION: A plurality of power generation units is fixed to a band unit. A plurality of the power generation units generates power according to the movement of a domestic animal tail. A wireless module(120) is fixed to the band unit. The wireless module charges power of the power generation unit. The wireless module transmits domestic livestock related information through a predetermined communication method.

title: APPARATUS OF IDENTIFYING POSITION OF LIVESTOCK AND METHOD THEREOF
abstract: PURPOSE: A livestock location recognizing device and a method thereof are provided to confirm accurate locations of livestock through a measurement unit attached to the livestock based on the intensity of a signal generated from a reference node. CONSTITUTION: If a preset event is generated, a communication unit(310) receives location information of a first terminal and operation state information of a lighting unit included in the first terminal. If an operation state of the lighting unit is an on-state, a control unit(330) one or more of the received location information and location information transmitted by one or more terminals to a camera through the communication unit in order to set a route of the camera. [Reference numerals] (310) Second communication unit; (320) Storage unit; (330) Second control unit; (340) Display unit

title: SETTING METHOD, SETTING PROGRAM, AND SETTING APPARATUS
abstract: A setting apparatus (104) acquires a communications device ID that is for a communications device (101) attached to a livestock animal (A) and transmitted from a relay device (102). The setting apparatus (104) determines whether another communications device ID located in the same communication area (103a) as an object communications device (101) defined as an object of group setting is registered in a group. The setting apparatus (104) determines whether another relay device (102b) is present whose distance from the relay device (102) forming a communication area (103a) in which the object communications device (101) is located, is less than or equal to a predetermined value. If the other communications device ID located in the same communication area (103a) is not registered in a group and the other relay device (102b) is not present, the setting apparatus (104) adds a new group name to the communications device ID of the object communications device (101) and registers the communications device ID of the object communications device (101) into a corresponding group.

title: A SYSTEM FOR INDUCING ISOLATION OF DISEASE ANIMAL AND METHOD THEREOF
abstract: PURPOSE: A diseased animal separation guiding system and a method thereof are provided to guide the separation of an animal with suspicious diseases. CONSTITUTION: A diseased animal separation guiding system comprises a radio frequency sensor tag(100), radio frequency sensor tag readers(200), and a disease control center server(300). The radio frequency sensor tag comprises a battery supplying power, a transceiver for wirelessly transmitting and receiving various kinds of signals, and a microchip which operates a stimulus generator. A plurality of the radio frequency sensor tag readers is installed inside a cattle shed. The disease control center server receives the temperature information of an animal and determines a diseased animal using the received temperature information.

title: Milking box with robotic attacher and backplane for tracking movements of a dairy animal
abstract: A milking box comprises a stall portion and a backplane positioned in the stall portion. The backplane moves toward the rear of the stall portion in response to pressure applied to a contact surface of the backplane. The backplane moves toward the front of stall portion in response to pressure removed from the contact surface.
applicants: HOFMAN, HENK; DE RUIJTER, COR; KOEKOEK, MENNO; TECHNOLOGIES HOLDINGS CORPORATION; VAN DER SLUIS, PETER, WILLEM

title: System and method for filtering data captured by a 3D camera
abstract: In an exemplary embodiment, a system includes a three-dimensional camera and a processor. The processor is operable to access a first portion of visual data captured by the three-dimensional camera wherein the visual data comprises an image of a dairy livestock and access a second portion of the visual data, wherein the first portion and the second portion are aligned in a first dimension. The processor is further operable to determine a first coordinate, wherein the first coordinate comprises a location of the first portion in a second dimension, the second dimension orthogonal to the first dimension and determine a second coordinate, wherein the second coordinate comprises a location of the second portion in the second dimension. The processor is further operable to determine a first distance exceeds a distance threshold, wherein the first distance is the distance between the first coordinate and the second coordinate in the second dimension.
applicants: DE RUIJTER, COR; HOFMAN, HENK; KOEKOEK, MENNO; VAN DER SLUIS, PETER, WILLEM; TECHNOLOGIES HOLDINGS CORPORATION

title: CATTLE SHED SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR REMOTE CONTROL DEODORIZATION AND PHYSICAL CONDITION THEREFOR
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock shed monitoring system monitoring the deodorization and health condition of livestock, and a livestock shed monitoring method. The livestock shed monitoring system comprises the following: a deodorization gas generator generating deodorization gas mixed with oxygen; more than one deodorization gas inflow pipe inflowing the deodorization gas; a deodorization gas spraying pipe spraying the deodorization gas into a livestock shed; more than one camera for taking images of inside and outside of the livestock shed; multiple heat detection sensors photographing the health condition of livestock; multiple ammonia sensors detecting ammonia gas; multiple mercaptan sensors detecting mercaptan gas; a fire detection sensor; a temperature sensor; a power supply unit generating operation power by receiving AC commercial electricity; a livestock shed monitoring terminal wirelessly monitoring the health condition of the livestock, the temperature of the livestock shed, the concentration of the ammonia gas and the mercaptan gas, and a video signal of the livestock shed; and a controller generating a blowing pan control signal and an oxygen generation operation signal by the concentration of the ammonia gas and the mercaptan gas, and generating a heater operation signal when the temperature detected by the temperature sensor is lower than the preset temperature. [Reference numerals] (102) Camera;(104) Heat detection sensor;(106) Ammonia sensor;(108) Mercaptan sensor;(110) Fire detection sensor;(112) Temperature sensor;(212) Oxygen generator;(213) Ventilation fan;(214) Heater;(215) Compressor;(218) Moisture collecting unit;(301) Storage battery;(302) Power supply unit;(303) Controller;(304) LAN communication unit;(305) Livestock shed monitoring terminal;(306) Internet;(307) Mobile communication network;(308) Smartphone

title: Dry Feed and Liquid Feed Feeding System For Pregnant sow and Farrowing sow
abstract: Disclosed is a dry feed and a liquid feed supply system for pregnant sows and farrowing sows. The dry feed and liquid feed supply system includes a dry feed and a liquid feed supply device installed in a pigpen for raising pregnant sows or farrowing sows, a state measurement part for measuring the state of the pregnant sows or farrowing sows when feeding the pregnant sows or farrowing sows, a communication part which includes a first communication module for storing identification information on pregnant sows or farrowing sows and a second communication module for reading the identification information when the first communication module approaches, a memory part which stores state change information and standard state information on pregnant sows or farrowing sows, and a control part which supplies dry feed and liquid feed to the feed supply device by comparing the state change information with the standard state information stored in the memory part when the state change information and standard state information on pregnant sows or farrowing sows are received. The dry feed and liquid feed supply system can supply dry feed and liquid feed to pregnant sows and farrowing sows and reduces costs by supplying various feeds to a pigpen.

title: IMAGE ANALYSIS FOR DETERMINING CHARACTERISTICS OF ANIMAL AND HUMANS
abstract: Systems and methods are disclosed for predicting one or more characteristics of a animal by applying computational methods to image(s) of the animal to generate one or more metrics indicative of the characteristics. Embodiments determine predictors of characteristics by creating a sample library of animals of a particular type, determining facial descriptor measurements for each animal, determining relationships between facial descriptor measurements and additional library data, and selecting predictors from these relationships. Other embodiments predict characteristics of animals not in the library and, optionally, categorize animals for particular discipline, training, management, care, etc. based on the characteristics. Other embodiments predict characteristics and determine strategies for group(s) of animals using predicted characteristics of individual animals. Embodiments are broadly applicable to domesticated animals including dogs, cats, cattle, oxen, llamas, sheep, goats, camels, geese, horses, chickens, turkeys, and pigs. Other embodiments predict certain characteristics of humans, including certain cognitive or developmental disorders.
