title: LIVESTOCK SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MONITORING THEREOF
abstract: Disclosed is a method for monitoring a livestock system. The method for monitoring a livestock system in a livestock system including a user terminal and a managing server receiving in real time information of a user terminal through a network includes: a step for registering a user terminal in the managing server; a step for receiving position information and time information of the user terminal from a GPS; a step for transmitting identification, position, and time information of the user terminal to the managing server; a step for checking whether the user terminal is a registered terminal based on the identification information; and a step for storing position and time information of the user terminal when the user terminal is checked as a registered terminal. When the user terminal leaves a predetermined area based on the stored position information, a message notifying the breakaway of the predetermined area to the user terminal and to a control server connected to the managing server, and the user terminal is attached to a vehicle entering/leaving an area in which livestock disease broke out. [Reference numerals] (100) User terminal;(230) Managing server;(270) Control server;(AA,BB) Notify breakaway occurrence;(S310) Register a user terminal;(S320) Receive position information and time information;(S330) Transmit position information and time information;(S340) Authenticate a user terminal;(S350) User terminal breakaways predetermined area

title: SYSTEM FOR HISTORY PURSUITING OF PORK
abstract: Disclosed is a system for checking a record of pork. The system of the present invention comprises a farmer terminal which generates and transmits information of a pig farmer, breeding information of a pig, and indicator information indicating the pig is raised by the pig farmer; a slaughterhouse terminal which generates and transmits information of a slaughterhouse; a processing plant terminal which generates and transmits information of a processing plant; and a management server which collects and manages record information of a pig provided from a selling shop terminal generating and transmitting information of a selling shop, wherein the record information includes at least one among the breed, sex, grade, farmer information, slaughterhouse information, processing plant information, and selling shop information of the pig, and image information of the farmer, slaughterhouse, processing plant, and selling house. According to the present invention, when pigs raised in multiple pig farming houses are manufacture into pork, the system generates record information about a farming house, slaughterhouse, processing plant and selling shop as well as a series of distribution processes such as farming houses, butchery, processing and selling as a record number, and enables consumers to check quickly and correctly the record information of the pork based on the record information, thereby providing the customer with high reliability on pork products. [Reference numerals] (10) Management server;(12) Database;(20) Farmer terminal;(30) Slaughterhouse terminal;(40) Process plant terminal;(42) Barcode generating unit;(44) Printer;(50) Selling shop terminal;(60) Terminal for checking record information;(62) Scanner;(64) Printer;(66) Record check display unit;(AA) Internet

title: MONITORING OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: A collar (1) for use in a system for monitoring livestock. The collar comprises a strap and buckle (2) and at least two retaining components (10, 11), the components containing monitoring and transmitting equipment comprising a three axis accelerometer (3), processing electronics (4), power source (5) and transmitter. The collar is arranged such that, when it is placed on the animal being monitored, the weight of the buckle draws the buckle to the lower edge of the neck of the animal and the retaining components are positioned at the upper edge of either side of the top of the neck of the animal.

title: Computer-implemented method for monitoring dairy farm with herd of dairy animals, involves transferring and storing operating condition data of technical equipment of dairy farm and position of herd to central computer
abstract: The computer-implemented method involves detecting the position of each of the animals of a herd, where the current operating state of a technical equipment of a dairy farm (1) is detected with an interface for the transmission of operating status data. The operating condition data of the technical equipment of the dairy farm and the position of the herd are transferred and stored to a central computer. The operating condition data transmitted to the central computer is retrieved and displayed with one or more output devices connected to the central computer.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR DETERMINING GREENHOUSE GAS EMISSION FROM A RUMINANT
abstract: A method for estimating a greenhouse gas emission from a ruminant (6) in a loose housing environment (1), and in a predetermined time period from T0 to Tdesired, characterized in that the method comprises: - determining a model emission rate function EM(t) for the ruminant, - determining the moments of eating feed by the ruminant, at least during the predetermined time period, as a series of points in time {T1, T2, T3,..., Tn}, - constructing the estimated real emission rate function ER(t) on the basis of the model emission rate function and the moments of eating feed, and - integrating ER(t) from T0 to Tdesired. Also provided is a greenhouse gas emission estimation device (8), arranged to perform this method. In the invention, use is made of the insight that knowing the eating moments can fine-tune calculations for establishing greenhouse gas emissions from the animals.
applicants: KOOL, LEENDERT; VAN DER TOL, PATRICK PHILIP JACOB; LELY PATENT; VAN DER KAMP, ADOLF JAN

title: Systems and methods for detecting estrus
abstract: Methods, devices, and systems are provided for identifying estrus or onset of estrus in a female animal.
applicants: FRANK, LINDA C.; JOHNSON, BRUCE, E.; YANCEY, WILLIAM B.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR DETECTING LAMENESS IN LIVESTOCK
abstract: A device and method is proposed for detecting lameness in a standing animal that comprises at least one optical imaging device (20) and a processing arrangement (30) with the optical imaging device. The optical imaging device (20) is arranged in a position to capture at least one image showing the lower portions of at least one leg of an animal (100) and to forward the image to the processing arrangement (30), which, in turn, is configured to analyse the image to determine a condition of lameness when said at least one leg is held in a raised position on or above ground level. The system is particularly suited to detecting lameness in dairy animals and can be integrated in a milking or feeding stall or with an automatic or semi-automatic milking system.

title: INTEGRATED PRECISE NUTRITIVE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM FOR SUCKLING CALVES
abstract: Disclosed is an integrated precise nutritive status management system for individual suckling calves which is capable of monitoring an individual image and health condition of each suckling calf by observing an individual ingestion activity and the exact amount of intake of integrated nutritive material (milk, water, and feed) for suckling livestock, especially calves. The integrated precise nutritive status management system according to an aspect of the present invention comprises: at least one milk supplying device which recognizes a serial number of the suckling livestock which enter into a suckling period, supplies milk to the relevant suckling livestock, and transmits the serial number and the amount of milk intake of the relevant suckling livestock after the milk intake has finished; at least one water intake investigating device which measures, in real-time, the content of water inside a feed water container which is supported by a frame, recognizes the serial number of the suckling livestock which approaches the feed water container, and transmits the amount of water intake and the serial number of the relevant suckling livestock; at least one feed intake investigating device which measures, in real-time, the amount of feed inside a feed container which is supported by a frame, recognizes the serial number of the suckling livestock which approaches the feed container, and transmits the amount of feed intake and the serial number of the relevant suckling livestock; and an integrated management system which indicates the current condition of an individual intake of the suckling livestock based on the serial number and the amount of intake of milk, water, and feed of the suckling livestock which is transmitted from the milk supplying device, the water intake investigating device and the feed intake investigating device. [Reference numerals] (10) Milk supplying device; (20) Water intake investigating device; (30) Feed intake investigating device; (40) Integrated management system

title: Livestock Traceability System based on Implantable Sensor Tag
abstract: A batteryless sensor tag is implanted into the living body of livestock, and a magnetic field area network (MFAN)/RFID combined repeater for communications and power transmission is installed on the neck of the livestock to secure power to be supplied to the sensor tag. The MFAN/RFID combined repeater supplies wireless power to the sensor tag, collects sensing data from the sensor tag, and transmits the collected data to a magnetic field communications and wireless power transmission unit. That is, a livestock traceability system based on a batteryless implantable sensor tag of the present invention comprises a batteryless implantable sensor tag which is inserted into the living body of livestock to monitor a change in temperature of the livestock; a combined repeater which transmits wireless power to the batteryless implantable sensor tag by a wireless power transmission method using a magnetic field, wakes up the batteryless implantable sensor tag, and receives ID information and sensing data of the batteryless implantable sensor tag from the batteryless implantable sensor tag in the form of a signal according to an EPCglobal Class 1 Generation 2 Protocol; and a data collection and wireless power transmission unit which transmits the wireless power to the combined repeater by the wireless power transmission method using a magnetic field and receives the ID information and the sensing data of the batteryless implantable sensor tag from the combined repeater in the form of a signal according to an MFAN protocol.

title: MEASUREMENT DEVICE OF BODY PARAMETERS FOR DOMESTIC ANIMALS
abstract: The present invention relates to a temporary livestock measuring device which takes the whole image of livestock with a reference length capable of taking measurements of the livestock when taking measurement of the livestock by using the taken images. The present invention includes a base; an image taking unit having a lifting plate arranged on the base to be lifted; guides which are formed on one surface and the other surface of the lifting plate and horizontally extended to the outer sides of the surfaces of the lifting plate; a reference length marking unit including a guide holder which laser pointers which are guided by the guides respectively and which form two reference points on the livestock on the top; and a camera which takes the whole image of the livestock and the two reference points. The present invention measures a length of a desired portion of the livestock by using the distance between the reference points of the taken image as a reference length.

title: AUTOMATED MONITORING AND CONTROLLING OF UNDESIRED LIVESTOCK BEHAVIOUR
abstract: A fully automated method and system for monitoring, controlling or preventing undesired behaviour of an animal or group of animals, particularly livestock animals was developed, making use of the intelligence of the animals and their ability to learn. A trigger or stimulus is automatically generated when automated monitoring shows or predicts the onset of undesired behaviour of an animal. Said trigger or stimulus then prevents or stops the undesired behaviour, particularly by capturing or redirecting the attention of said animal. Preferably, said method and system is also capable of training the animals, particularly livestock, to associate said trigger with a reward, punishment or warning in a fully-automated way. The conditioned animal will then give its attention to the trigger at the moment that early signs of undesired behaviour have been observed or predicted.
applicants: STIFTUNG TIERAERZTLICHE HOCHSCHULE HANNOVER; FANCOM; UNIVERSITA' DEGLI STUDI DI MILANO; KATHOLIEKE UNIVERSITEIT LEUVEN

title: LIVESTOCK CERTIFICATION APPARATUS AND METHOD
abstract: A system for certification of animals, owners, attendants, venues, enterprises, and events relies on identification, traceability, and evaluation against selected criteria. Data maintained during agricultural production includes production, raising, selling, holding, treating, harvesting products like milk or wool, slaughter, transfer of ownership or venue, and veterinary and pharmacological interventions, whether medicaments, preventives, protocols, treatments, or inspections administered. Record keeping and selection, analysis, and notifications are according to criteria (particularly risks, exposures, or both) specified by any entity requesting or requiring a certification of a condition or lack thereof. Warnings may be triggered and distributed timely. Mobile units avoid traditional deficiencies in data, analysis, risk assessment, and timeliness.

title: FUIDI HERD MANAGEMENT AND RISK STRATIFICATION METHODS
abstract: The invention concerns the detection of pathogenic mycobacterium comprising Mycobacterium avium subsp. paratuberculosis (Map) and genomic variants in a bulk milk sample, and more particularly a method for herd management that stratifies the risk of bulk tank milk lots derived from diagnostic-tested subgroups potentially containing DNA from pathogenic mycobacterium including Map. The method involves creating defined risk groups (categories) of milk-producing animals, such as dairy cows, for the presence of Map or related genomic variants in their milk. Another aspect of the invention concerns a method to strengthen the ability of milk-producing animals to resist environmental challenges by Map based on identifying those animals that have and maintain a low antibody level to Map using their female progeny as replacement animals.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR GROOMING-RELATED FARM DECISION SUPPORT
abstract: Farm decision support is provided relating to a herd of animals (A1, A2, A3) in a farm environment (100). Each animal (A1, A2, A3) is associated with a respective identification device (T1, T2; T3). The farm environment (100) includes a brush station (B1 ) having a reader unit (224) configured to remotely register an identity of each animal (A1, A2, A3) visiting the brush station (B1 ) via the identification devices (T1, T2; T3). A detection means (242) detects a repositioning of the brush (210) from a neutral position resulting from an animal (A3) pushing a part of itself against the brush (210). The reader unit (244) has a detection range within which identity data (ID3) can be read out from an identification device (T3). In response to a detected repositioning of the brush (210), the reader unit (244) registers the identity data (ID3) from a first detected identification device (T3) within the detection range, and forwards the identity data (ID3) to a processing unit (120) via an output interface (246). The processing unit (120) stores data (d1 ) representing animal visits to the brush station (B1 ) as the decision support.

title: METHOD AND ARRANGEMENT FOR AUTOMATICALLY FEEDING MILK PRODUCING ANIMALS
abstract: A method for automatically feeding milk producing animals (12) in a milking parlor (10) comprising a row (14) of milking stalls (1, 2,..., N) accessible in serial order to a plurality of milk producing animals (12) from a front end thereof (14a) is provided. Feed is dispensed (72) into the feed manger of the milking stall (1) located in the far end (14b) of the row of milking stalls in connection with the first one of the plurality of milk producing animals entering the row of milking stalls to entice the plurality of milk producing animals to enter the row of milking stalls. The first milk producing animal is identified (71) when she enters the row of milking stall and/ or when she enters the milking stall in the far end. The feed dispensed into the feed manger of the milking stall located in the far end is subtracted (73) from the feed ration individually adapted for the first milk producing animal, thereby arriving in a corrected feed ration individually adapted for the first milk producing animal. The corrected feed ration is dispensed (74) into the feed manger of the milking stall located in the far end in connection with the milking of the first milk producing animal, thereby allowing her to consume her individually adapted feed ration.

title: ARRANGEMENT AND METHOD FOR A MILKING SYSTEM
abstract: A combined teat position and breeding rating determining arrangement is provided for a milking system comprising a milking stall (5) for housing the milking animal during milking, a movable robot arm (15) for automatically attaching teat cups to (11) the teats of the milking animal in the milking stall, and a control device (19) for controlling the movement of the robot arm based on determined positions of the teats of the milking animal. The arrangement comprises a three-dimensional camera (21) directed towards the udder of the milking animal in the milking stall and provided to repeatedly record three-dimensional images of the udder of the milking animal; and processing means (22) provided to repeatedly detect the teats of the milking animal and determine their positions based on the repeatedly recorded three-dimensional images. Further, the processing means is arranged to automatically determine the shapes of the teats of the milking animal based on the repeatedly recorded three-dimensional images and to calculate a breeding rating based on the determined shapes of the teats of the milking animal.

title: Early alert system for livestock disease detection with a feedlot fence crossbar-embedded RFID antenna
abstract: An early alert system and a method for livestock disease detection are disclosed. An activity measurement zone (AMZ) is defined near an incentive device (e.g. a livestock feeder) with an RFID tag reader and a uniquely-designed feedlot fence crossbar-embedded RFID antenna, which amplifies multiple signal wavelengths in a single dipole antenna. The early alert system is configured to detect and count an animal's access into the AMZ with an RFID tag attached to the animal. If the animals' activity relative to the AMZ drops to an alarmingly low level (e.g. dropping below an alert trigger point) over time, then a user of the early alert system is informed of a potential health problem of the animal and may also be encouraged to inspect the animal in person for further determination of its current health and potential medical issues.
applicants: HANA MICRON AMERICA; HANA MICRON COMPANY

title: Smart Terminal Liaison type Real Time Medical Examination Method
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart terminal connection type real time medical examination method. If a specific entity showing a symptom is checked from either physical state comprising body heat and a moving position or image data having moving pictures on behavior, photographs on each part of the entity and documents on activity with respect to each entity, where every entity is discriminated with an individual ID from a plurality of livestock, the present invention traces the specific entity and takes an image of the specific entity via regular monitoring or a smart terminal and then transmits the determination result to a farm owner, a veterinarian or an external specialized livestock management organization by generating an event using an automatic sensing and processing device (10) or the smart terminal (30). Particularly, a rapid precise examination for the entity (50-1) showing the symptom is performed, thereby rapidly coping with the legally designated infectious diseases with a latent period such as foot-and-mouth disease or fowl plague at an initial stage.

title: Necklace fasteners detects folders with livestock
abstract: The present invention relates to a necklace fastener for livestock having a detection folder. More specifically, the present invention is to enable a necklace for livestock having a detection folder which automatically detects the diet of the livestock such as a Korean native cattle, dairy cattle, etc.; and checks the nutrition condition and the growth process with a computer to be worn around the cow′s neck in a comfortable and convenient manner. The necklace fastener for livestock comprises: a band (10) having a detection folder (20) to detect the diet of the livestock, and check with a computer; band connection rings (30, 31) hung on one end (11) of the band (10) to be fixated having a square shape with different heights; and a fixation clip (40) fixating the other end (12) of the band (10) by connecting the band (10) to the band connection rings (30, 31), and adjusting the length.

title: VEGETATION DETERMINATION PROGRAM, VEGETATION DETERMINATION DEVICE AND VEGETATION DETERMINATION METHOD
abstract: A vegetation assessing apparatus (101) obtains step count measurement results obtained by a step measuring device (102) attached to a livestock animal (A) pastured in a pasture (H). The vegetation assessing apparatus (101) assesses whether a state of vegetation of the pasture (H) is a state suitable for pasturing, based on temporal change of the step count measurements obtained by the step measuring device (102). The vegetation assessing apparatus (101) transmits an obtained assessment result to a portable communications terminal (103) used by a livestock raiser.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MANAGEMENT FOR LIVESTOCK DELIVERY ROOM
abstract: The present invention relates to a system to manage a delivery room for livestock and a management method thereof. The system includes: a livestock delivery room which includes a plurality of delivery spaces, an image recording unit to record images of the delivery spaces, a ventilation unit to circulate air inside the delivery spaces, and a sensor unit to measure the temperature and humidity of the delivery spaces; a control device which receives detection results by the image recording unit, ventilation unit, and sensor unit of the delivery room and controls the operation of each unit; a management server which accesses the control device through a wired or wireless network and manages the device; and a user smart terminal which accesses the control device or management server through a wireless network and controls and manages the operation.

title: Cattle behavioral type estrus detection system
abstract: The present invention relates to a cattle behavioral-type estrus detecting system and, more specifically, to a cattle behavioral-type estrus detecting system by which estrus can be recognized by analyzing electric signals in which cattle mounting or work rate patterns by time are recorded. According to the present invention, the mounting or work rate patterns by time of subject cattle are accurately analyzed in a cattle farm, so that the discovery rate of estrus can be improved. Moreover, growing entity managing efficiency is also improved, so that the economical feasibility of the cattle farm can be improved.

title: Livestock Feeder-Embedded RFID Antenna Apparatus
abstract: Several embodiments of a novel RFID antenna apparatus that are uniquely structurally integrated with livestock feeder units are disclosed. In one embodiment, a circular antenna apparatus embeds a circular livestock feeder unit by structurally encapsulating or surrounding a perimeter of the circular livestock feeder unit. In another embodiment, a rectangular antenna similarly embeds a rectangular livestock feeder unit by structurally encapsulating or surrounding a perimeter of the rectangular livestock feeder unit. Preferably, the circular or the rectangular antenna apparatus also includes a protective pipe or an outer skin layer that incorporates an RF antenna feed point, an antenna core, an impedance matching circuit, and a coaxial RF connector inside the protective pipe or the outer skin layer. The novel livestock feeder-embedded RFID antenna apparatuses improve accuracy of animal RFID tag reading, while also minimizing tuning time and reinstallation efforts associated with an RFID-based livestock monitoring system.

title: APPARATUS FOR MONITORING THE AMOUNT OF FEED INGESTED BY ANIMALS, IN PARTICULAR POULTRY
abstract: The invention relates to an apparatus for monitoring, during feed intake, the amount of feed ingested by animals, such as poultry, specifically chickens, provided with an individual identification code, said apparatus including at least one individual feeding unit (10) having: a manger (11) comprising an access opening (113) for the animal; a feed silo (12) coupled to the manger (11) to move the feed into the manger (11); a weighing device (30) including a weighing gauge (31) for measuring the weight of the manger (11); a reading device (20) for reading the individual identification code borne by the animal; the apparatus including a plurality of individual manger units (10) mounted on a single frame (50) such that different access openings (113) of the mangers (20) are arranged along a circle, the access opening (113) of each manger (11) having an adjustable size that is provided for receiving the head of a single animal, and each reading device (20) being positioned at the access opening (113) of the corresponding manger (11).
applicants: INSTITUT NATIONAL DE LA RECHERCHE AGRONOMIQUE (INRA)

title: TRACKING AND MONITORING OF ANIMALS WITH COMBINED WIRELESS TECHNOLOGY AND GEOFENCING
abstract: A networked cattle tracking system may track cattle using a base station, smart tags for cattle, and a mobile device. Tags are placed on each animal within a group of cattle. The tags may communicate with each other and with a base station. The tags may communication animal location and other information, including temperature, movement, blood information, and so on. A user may track cattle location, behavior, health, and other information at a base station monitor or a remote wireless device in communication with the base station and plurality of tags.

title: Method and apparatus for monitoring poultry in barns
abstract: A method and apparatus for monitoring and acquiring data concerning the health of poultry and animals housed in one or more barns or enclosed environments predicated upon the frequencies and intensity of sounds generated by the poultry and animals to obtain baseline data of healthy and happy poultry and animals.

title: A DRY STICK DEVICE AND A METHOD FOR DETERMINING AN ANALYTE IN A SAMPLE
abstract: A novel and improved dry stick construction for the determination of an analyte in a sample is provided. The dry stick device comprises: (i) a solid support comprising a cavity, and (ii) at least one dry reagent capable of reacting with the analyte, a derivative of said analyte or an indicator compound for said analyte to provide a detectable signal when in a moistened state, wherein the cavity comprises the at least one dry reagent. The present invention also provides an automated or semi-automated system. Additionally the present invention provides an automated or semi-automated system for optimising the production performance of a milk producing animal herd.

title: METHODS FOR FEEDING DIETARY COMPOSITIONS TO RUMINANTS
abstract: Dietary compositions for ingestion by ruminants and methods for feeding the dietary compositions to ruminants are disclosed. The dietary compositions may include ruminant feed products having at least one saturated fatty acid component including at least about 90% of a palmitic acid compound. The ruminant feed product may be fed to the ruminant according to a feed program that is based on physical characteristics and/or a time period associated with the ruminant. For example, an amount of the ruminant feed product fed to the ruminant may be based on the calving cycle and/or lactation cycle of the ruminant and one of a body weight or a milk yield of the ruminant. Ingestion of the ruminant feed product by a ruminant according to the feed program may increase the milk yield and/or the milk fat content of milk produced by the ruminant.

title: COW RETRIEVAL SYSTEM
abstract: A cow retrieval system including one or more elevated rails and one or more trolleys translational along the rail and carrying at least one cow stimulating device operative to stimulate a cow to walk towards a desired location. The cow retrieval system could also include a cow tag localization system so to be operative to localize a tag attached to a cow, identify and retrieve the cow based on information input from the localization system.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MONITORING AND/OR CONTROLLING THE RESOURCE CONSUMPTION OF AN AGRICULTURAL PLANT
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a system for monitoring and/or controlling the resource consumption of an agricultural plant (1) for livestock husbandry or breeding, in particular of a livestock production business. The method according the invention comprises the following steps: determining agriculture-specific operation parameters of the agricultural plant in a current time interval, wherein the operating parameters comprise information on the livestock population, in particular the number of animals, and structure, in particular the number and size of the pens of the agricultural plant, and climate, in particular the temperature inside the agricultural plant, determining a resource consumption of at least one consumer (7a1, 7a2, 7a, b, c, d) of at least one resource type of the agricultural plant in the current time interval by means of at least one consumption detection unit (6, 6a1, 6a2, 6b, c, d), determining the resource consumption per one or more of the operating parameters, output of a signal comprising the resource consumption per one or more of the operating parameters.

title: System and method for determining viability of eggs
abstract: A system for simultaneously determining the viability (or fertility) of a plurality of eggs in an incubation tray comprises a tester unit located above the incubation tray in close proximity to, while avoiding contact with, the eggs in the tray. The tester unit is operable to determine the locations within the incubation tray of viable eggs or non-viable eggs. A conveyor may move the tray to a position under a removal mechanism so that the viable eggs, based on their location may be transferred to a hatching tray. The tester unit may include a plurality of housings comprising an electromagnetic source 34 and sensor 36 configured to emit radiation into the egg 6 and sense scattered radiation from the egg. A processor may receive real-time signals from the sensors to determine and store the locations of the viable or non-viable eggs in memory. The signals from the sensors may be multiplexed and synchronised with their sources using time slots in order to reduce crosstalk and noise.

title: Method and device for measuring core body temperature of livestock
abstract: The invention relates to the field of animal breeding and animal medicine, and provides a method and a device for measuring the core body temperature of livestock. According to the measuring method, in accordance with a physiological structure of the measured livestock, a temperature sensor is coupled with the body surface close to the core body temperature, a heat flux conduction formula is utilized, the temperature gradient of artificial materials can be calculated through heat resistance, the heat resistance of a measured position of body tissues is derived, and the core body temperature is deduced in an inversion way through the measured body surface temperature. Before the long-time use, the correction is carried out through measured values of the rectal temperature. The device comprises a heat transfer layer, an outside heat insulation layer and three temperature sensors, wherein the heat conductivity and the thickness of the heat transfer layer are known, the temperature measuring parameters of the three temperature sensors are very close through tests, and the temperature sensors are used for respectively measuring the surface temperature of the skin coupling position, the surface temperature outside the heat transfer layer and the surface temperature outside the heat insulation layer. When the method and the device provided by the invention are used, the long-period, continuous and dynamic core body temperature measurement on the livestock can be realized.

title: CENTRALLIZED CONROL TYPE PIGPEN
abstract: The present invention relates to a centralized controlled pigpen, and more specifically, to a centralized controlled pigpen, wherein various devices within a pigpen are connected to network communication lines and are controlled by a centralized management server. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the centralized management server (100) provides one or more among the weight of pigs, feeding activity of pigs, the amount of stored feed, the amount of feed supplied to pigs, and the moving status of pigs to a graphic display. [Reference numerals] (AA) Control signal; (AC) Air conditioning system; (BB) Monitoring result; (CC) Automatic feed order; (F) Sow military feeder; (FS) Feed suppliers; (FT) Feed bin; (MB) Maternity barn automatic feeder; (S) Growing pork automatic selector(weight selector)

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR GENERATING AN OESTRUS ATTENTION SIGNAL FOR A CATTLE ANIMAL
abstract: The invention relates to a method for monitoring oestrus of a cattle animal, in particular a cow. The method comprises: a) collecting activity data of the animal, b) computing a current activity level based on the activity data, c) deciding whether to generate an oestrus attention signal by comparing at least one current activity level to a corresponding baseline activity level. Action b) further comprises b1) detecting travelling movements of the animal and b2) correcting the baseline activity level for detected travelling movements.

title: A WEB-BASED PET RESCUE SYSTEM, METHOD AND APPARATUS
abstract: A rescue system comprising a website; software; and any plurality of tag or units physically attached to, digitally encoded or implanted into any pet, livestock or animal, that work together in order to allow the ability to tag, track, record, report and identify any type of pet, livestock or animal in the event of the animal, or pet becoming lost, stolen or in the case where the reporting of an animal, pet, or livestock is being monitored and tracked, allowing said reporting to occur either passively or actively.

title: A METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR DETERMINING MILK CHARACTERISTICS FOR INDIVIDUAL ANIMALS IN A HERD
abstract: The invention relations to a method of determining milk characteristics for individual animals within a cohort of milking animals, where the method is characterised by the steps of: a) recording individual identification of animals present at a milking shed for a milking event; b) recording the timing of the milking event for individual animals; c) measuring at least one milk characteristic of milk collected from the cohort of milking animals; d) correlating the identification of an individual animal with the timing of the milking event to develop a profile of one or more milk characteristics for the individual animal. A system for implementing the method is also claimed. The inventive method and system has particular application for determination of characteristics of milk from a selected animal from a group of animals, particularly, but not limited to, milk yield, based on measurement of an ensemble of milk production from a group of animals, such as a dairy herd or cohort of dairy cows.

title: Ear tag information reporting method and ear tag information reporting terminal
abstract: The invention relates to the field of animal epidemic diseases and food security, in particular to an ear tag information reporting method and an ear tag information reporting terminal. The ear tag information reporting method comprises the steps of reading an ear tag information table which is generated in advance, wherein the ear tag information table contains multiple sets of ear tag information, each set of ear tag information comprises an ear tag number of a domestic animal, information of an owner of the domestic animal, information of the breed of the domestic animal, information of a town to which the domestic animal belongs, information of a village to which the domestic animal belongs, application information and note information; sequentially carrying out packaging on the sets of ear tag information and account number data which are stored in advance to generate multiple sets of tag wearing information, wherein the sets of tag wearing information corresponds to the sets of ear tag information in a one-to-one mode, and the account number data which are stored in advance comprise town account numbers, passwords, server IPs, area numbers corresponding to the town account numbers, and epidemic prevention coordinator information; sending the sets of tag wearing information to a center database in sequence. According to the ear tag information reporting method and the ear tag information reporting terminal, when the large amount of the ear tag information needs to be reported, operation can be easy, efficiency is high, and mistakes cannot be easily made.

title: INDIVIDUAL ELECTRONIC IDENTIFICATION SYSTEM OF ANIMALS IN MILKING PARLOUR
abstract: The present invention relates to an Individual electronic identification system of animals (1) in milking parlor which includes a plurality of hanging flexible antennas (4) for the detection of transponders (2) associated with each animal (1), arranged vertically each in correspondence of a single milking post, and supported by a support structure (7).

title: INDIVIDUAL ELECTRONIC IDENTIFICATION SYSTEM OF ANIMALS ON BOARD LIVESTOCK TRANSPORTATION MEANS
abstract: The present invention relates to an individual electronic identification system of animals (1) on board livestock transportation means (2) which includes a plurality of hanging flexible antennas (3) for the detection of transponders associated with each animal (1), arranged vertically side by side and supported by a support structure (4).

title: BUTCHERY GRADE PREDICTION SYSTEM AND THE METHOD
abstract: A livestock carcass grade prediction system of the present invention includes: at least one sensor part which is installed at a fixed position in a livestock shed and measures body information of a livestock delivered into the livestock shed; a buffer part which receives the body information of the livestock measured in the sensor part and outputs the body information after arranging the body information; and a server which receives the body information of the livestock outputted from the buffer part, and predicts a carcass grade by linking the body information with a feeding program provided to the current livestock. According to the present invention, the system can predict the carcass grade by minimizing stress of a cow and measuring the condition of the livestock by measuring entity information and the body information of the cow in the livestock shed, and thus can use the carcass grade as data for a shipping date and breeding management.

title: RFID reader device including movable reader terminal selectively connected with gate antenna and cattle traceability system using the same
abstract: An RFID reader of the present invention includes a gate antenna installed in a gate and communicating data with an RFID tag passing through the gate; a portable RFID terminal communicating data with the RFID tag through an inner antenna; and a port switch selectively connecting and separating the gate antenna and the portable RFID terminal. According to the present invention, there is no need to perform extra network work on the gate.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR ESTIMATING FEED EFFICIENCY AND CARBON FOOTPRINT FOR MILK PRODUCING ANIMAL
abstract: Systems and methods for estimating milk producing animal feed conversion efficiency and carbon footprint, such as to allow adjustments to be made in the animals feed to improve milk production, reduce waste, and/or reduce the carbon footprint. In embodiments of the present application, a system is provided that integrates a digestion model of an animal feed with milk production efficiency and carbon footprint. Such systems and methods are useful to analyze and compare different animal feed compositions that differ from one another in one or more components and/or to analyze the effect of the addition of a feed supplement on milk production efficiency and/or carbon footprint. In some embodiments, the systems and methods described herein provide feed parameter-carbon footprint compromise. A feed parameter-carbon footprint compromise is useful to adjust animal feed composition by balancing milk production efficiency with effects on carbon footprint. Different feed supplements or amounts of feed supplements, and/or different feed compositions are selected based on the desired feed parameter-carbon footprint compromise.

title: A method of livestock rearing and a livestock shed
abstract: A method of rearing chickens comprises providing a chicken shed 10 having a floor area 12 over which the chickens can move freely. The shed is provided with a plurality of lights 18 arranged to illuminate respective different regions of the floor area so that, collectively, the lights are able to illuminate substantially all of the floor area. The shed is provided a plurality of cameras 20 arranged to view respective different regions of the floor area so that, collectively, the cameras are able to view substantially all of the floor area. A controller 22 is provided and is operatively connected to the lights and to the cameras. The controller receives and analyses signals, such as images, from the cameras. The controller controls the lights to adjust illumination provided to the floor area by the controlled lights in a manner dependent on the signals from the cameras. The controller is able to control each light independently of the other lights. In some situations, the control of the lights causes a predetermined desired response in the chickens. In some cases, the predetermined desired response overcomes or circumvents an undesirable situation recognised by the controller from analysis of the signals from the cameras.

title: Portable Radio Frequency Id charger-reader and charging with reading method using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a portable radio frequency identification wireless energy charger-reader. The present invention relates to a portable radio frequency identification wireless energy charger-reader and a charging and reading method using the same, which is capable of reading condition information of livestock through an active RFID tag reader as well as wirelessly charge a battery of the active REID tag reader. The portable radio frequency identification wireless energy charger-reader comprises: an antenna (10) for transmitting wireless power to an RFID tag (200) or reading RFID wireless data; a wireless power transmission unit (20) for transmitting the wireless power to the RFID tag (200) through the antenna (10); a RFID reader unit (30) for reading the RFID wireless data of the RFID tag (200) through an antenna (12); a display unit (50) for displaying at least one of identification information of the RFID tag (200), condition information of livestock, and battery remain information of a relevant RFID tag (200); a battery (80) for storing power so as to transmit the power to the wireless charging RFID tag (200) through the wireless power transmission unit (20); and a control unit (90) for storing reference information according to s species of livestock, receiving RFID information of the wireless charging RFID tag (200) and the battery remain information, comparing the battery remain information with the reference information to display the compared result on the display unit (50), and performing control so as to transmit the power of the battery (80) through the wireless power transmission unit (20).

title: METHODS FOR ESTIMATING BIRTHING DATA FOR AN ANIMAL
abstract: The present invention provides methods for the estimation of birthing data (such as birthing date and birthing weight) by consideration of a mother animal's weight over an expected birthing period. The method comprises the steps of: measuring or providing the weight of the mother animal at intervals over an expected birthing period to provide a series of dated weight records, estimating the underlying weight of the mother animal over the expected birthing period from the series of dated weight records, and identifying a significant weight drop of the mother animal by reference to the estimated underlying weight, wherein the estimated birthing date is on or before the date of the significant weight drop. The methods are particularly useful in animals associated with production, such as cattle.

title: DRY FEED AND LIQUID FEED FEEDING SYSTEM FOR PREGNANT SOW AND FARROWING SOW
abstract: A dried-feed and liquid-feed feeding system for pregnant pigs and breast-feeding pigs is disclosed. The present invention includes a feeding device which supplies dried feed or liquid feed to at least one pigpen where pregnant pigs or breast-feeding pigs are raised; a condition checking unit checking conditions of the pregnant pigs or the breast-feeding pigs when the pregnant pigs or the breast-feeding pigs are fed with dried feed or liquid feed; a communication unit including a first communication module which stores the identification information of the pregnant pigs or the breast-feeding pigs and a second communication module sensing an approach of the first communication module when the first communication module approaches and reading the identification information; a memory unit which the condition change information of each pregnant pig or each breast-feeding pig and the standard condition information which the pregnant pigs or the breast-feeding pigs have to maintain are stored; and a control unit which compares the condition information and the standard condition information of the pregnant pigs or the breast-feeding pigs stored in the memory unit when the condition information and the identification information of the pregnant pigs or the breast-feeding pigs are received and supplies dried feed or liquid feed to the feeding device and which controls the amount of the supplied feed. The present invention can supply dried feed or liquid feed to the pregnant pigs or the breast-feeding pigs and can supply different feeds to the pigpen where the pregnant pigs or the breast-feeding pigs are raised with a single feeding system.

title: EARLY WARNING SYSTEM AND/OR OPTICAL MONITORING OF LIVESTOCK INCLUDING POULTRY
abstract: A system and method for early prediction of and/or early detection of conditions affecting a livestock population and/or to monitor a state of livestock may include tracking behavior of previously identified sentinel individuals from a sample of the livestock in which some individuals cannot be directly distinguished. Optionally the tracking may be by means of an optical sensor. In some embodiments an unidentified sentinel may be tracked and/or an unidentified sentinel may be re-identified and/or sentinels may be marked. In some embodiments a behavior may be monitored in the population and a condition of the population may be detected based on a pattern of changes in the behavior. Optionally, the behavior may be monitored in individuals and/or a sample and/or a virtual flock. Optionally the method may be used for early detection of an outbreak of disease, for improved breeding and/or for development of treatments and/or vaccines.

title: A DESIGN AND METHOD FOR HOUSING OF SENSORS ATTACHED TO LIVESTOCK
abstract: The present invention relates to a housing design for a livestock-attachable type sensor, and a method thereof and, more specifically, to a method for attaching a housing including a sensor to livestock. To achieve this, the housing for a livestock-attachable type sensor according to the present invention comprises: a sensor attached to the inside of the housing; an elastic string for providing the convenience when attaching the sensor to the body of livestock; and a housing model for protecting the sensor from foreign substances present in a livestock shed by using a noncorrosive material.
applicants: INDUSTRY-ACADEMY COOPERATION CORPS OF SUNCHON NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: A DETECTION DEVICE FOR LIVESTOCK ESTRUS USING THE ACTIVITY OF TAIL AND SYSTEM MANAGEMENT METHOD
abstract: The present invention relates to a device for detecting estrus using livestock tail movement and a method for operating the device and, more specifically, to a method for using the device for measuring the activity frequency of a livestock tail.
applicants: INDUSTRY-ACADEMY COOPERATION CORPS OF SUNCHON NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: METHOD FOR DETERMINING THE SEX OF AN EMBRYO IN AN EGG
abstract: The invention relates to a method for determining the sex of at least one embryo in an egg (12), in which the sex of the embryo is determined by means of at least one detection method which is noninvasive at least with regard to the egg (12), wherein at least one oestradiol value which characterizes the concentration of oestradiol in the egg (12) is determined by means of the noninvasive detection method and the sex is determined as a function of the oestradiol value.

title: AUTOMATED MONITORING OF RUMINANT HEALTH AND BREEDING PARAMETERS
abstract: A system and a method for collecting and assessing temperature data is predictive of biological events. A combination of sensors identified with individual animals of a herd, a receiver, a base station and a processor that calculates variations or patterns of sensor data that reach thresholds and generate alerts. The assessment may include filters, such as water effect filters, and they may correlate diurnal cycles or circadian rhythms of the animal with the animal data records.

title: System for managing the health and respiratory condition of cattle
abstract: The system (1) has a microphone type device (2) for acquisition of data relating to ambient sound within a cattle breeding enclosure (E). A monitoring device (3) is arranged with a processing unit for processing of gathered ambient sound data so as to detect sound events corresponding to coughs emitted by a cattle or bovine. A comparison unit compares an acquired value of sound events with a threshold value of sound events. An alarm unit alarms an operator when the acquired value of sound events is higher than the threshold value of sound events. Independent claims are also included for the following: (1) a method for management of health and respiratory condition of cattle (2) a computer program comprising instructions for performing a method for management of health and respiratory condition of the cattle.

title: AUTOMATED MONITORING OF ANIMAL NUTRIMENT INGESTION
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and method for monitoring in real time the nutriment intake (feed and/or water) of farm animals, including but not limited to poultry, turkeys, pigs and cows, based on the measurement and identification of the nutriment uptake sounds and/or the working of the nutriment supply system, while the presence and eating position of the animals is monitored by using real-time image analysis.

title: IMPLANTABLE RADIO FREQUENCY ID DENTIFICATION WIRELESS POWER WITH DATA TRANSMISSION METHOD USING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a full-insertion type electronic tag and a method for transmitting wireless data and energy using the same which can charge a battery as embedding the battery and a sensor capable of sensing a state of a livestock in an active electronic tag (RFID). In the electronic tag which is fully inserted into the skin of the livestock, provided is the full-insertion type electronic tag including: a communication part (110) which transmits identification information of a livestock individual and status information of the livestock to the outside by transmitting and receiving electronic tag (RFID) information, and receives wireless power from the outside; memory parts (120, 130) which update and store the identification information of the livestock individual, the kind of the livestock, date of birth, livestock family information and at least one battery information, and at least one of the status information according to the identification information of the livestock individual and charging number information of the battery information; a wireless power receiving part (160) which receives the wireless power from the outside; a battery (170) which stores the wireless power received from the wireless power receiving part; a sensor (180) which senses the status information of the livestock as being embedded in the livestock; and a control part (190) which updates data required in the memory parts (120, 130) by controlling the memory parts (120, 130), the wireless power receiving part (160), the battery (170) and the sensor (180), and outputs abnormality of the data sensed by the sensor (180) to the outside through the electronic tag wireless communication if the abnormality in the data is sensed, and stores the wireless power received through the wireless power receiving part (160) in the battery (170).

title: BOVINE RUMINATION AND ESTRUS PREDICTION SYSTEM (BRES) AND METHOD
abstract: A bovine monitoring system may include a rumination sensor, a motion sensor, a posture sensor. The rumination sensor may detect chewing by sensing jaw motion. The motion sensor may detect motion. The posture sensor may detect orientation of the bovine asset through detection of gravitational acceleration, detection of gyroscopic rotation, or a combination of gravitational acceleration and gyroscopic rotation. Using the recorded rumination, motion, and posture sensors, the bovine asset monitoring system may identify aberrations in the estrous cycle or physical or mental health of the bovine assets. A bovine monitoring system may include a thermal scanning device to detect localized heating of the vulva area of the bovine asset, which may be used to identify aberrations in the estrous cycle or physical or mental health of the bovine assets.
applicants: ROISEN, ROGER; MCHUGH, MICHAEL; HORSE SENSE SHOES; WILSON, CRAIG, S.

title: Livestock identification system and method
abstract: A livestock identification system/method configured to identify individual animals from a pool of livestock is disclosed. The system/method utilizes images of individual animals and determines the identity of a specific animal based on markers extracted from the image of the animal. These markers may then be used to characterize the state of the animal as to weight, health, and other parameters. The system is configured to log these parameters in a temporal database that may be used to determine historical activity of the animal, including but not limited to activity relating to food and/or fluid intake. This historical record in conjunction with analysis of the animal state parameters is used to determine the animal health status and may also be used to determine whether the animal is ready for harvesting.

title: A feed apparatus and system
abstract: Disclosed is a liquid feeding systems, typically being milk or milk powder mixed on site and fed to calves, with a common supply line for individual stalls along its length.

title: A SENSOR GATHERING BIOMETICS OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock bio information collecting sensor. The sensor, capable of collecting livestock bio information in a low power environment, includes: an acceleration sensor identifying the movement of livestock; and a sensor control part controlling the operation of the acceleration sensor, based on a measurement value of the acceleration sensor.

title: FARM MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: The present invention relates to farm management or automation systems, for example for managing herd animals such as dairy cows and farm equipment. According to one aspect, there is provided a farm management system for a farm having a plurality of animals and farm equipment, the system comprising a wireless access point coupled to a database comprising data on the animals and/or the farm equipment, a user-mounted device arranged to receive at least some of the data wirelessly from the database, the user-mounted device in use mounted on a user and arranged to display the received data in a field of view of the user.

title: Oestrus detection system
abstract: Disclosed is an apparatus (100) for automatically detecting a status of an oestrus indicator (not shown) associated with an animal (A). The apparatus (100) comprises a structure, such as a cattle race, comprising two substantially parallel barrier means (1) and moveable barrier means (2) for selectively preventing an animal (A) from proceeding between the parallel barrier means (1); a camera (11); processing means (300); and animal position sensing means (6). The camera (11) is provided for capturing an electronic image of an area of interest of the animal (A). The area of interest includes an area of the animal (A) which the oestrus indicator is usually associated with or attached to. The processing means (300) is arranged to determine a status of the oestrus indicator based on the image. The closing of the moveable barrier means (2) is dependent on the animal position sensing means (6) detecting that a required portion of the animal (A) has moved past the moveable barrier means (2). This ensures that the animal (A) does not move back out of the structure and also that other animals don’t enter the structure at the same time.

title: COW BODY DIAGNOSTIC SYSTEM AND COW BODY DIAGNOSTIC METHOD
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system for estimating various characteristic values of a cow body simply.SOLUTION: A system for diagnosing a cow body comprises: three-dimensional scan devices (10, 22) for imaging a cow (200) which is a diagnosis object, and creating three-dimensional image data on a body surface of a hip of the cow; a geodesic length measurement part (23) for measuring geodesic length between optional two points on the body surface of the hip of the cow; and a cow body characteristic value estimation part (24) for, on the basis of a generalized linear regression model in which, weight is at least one objective variable, the geodesic length between left and right hip bones is at least one explanatory variable, and cow individual information is a stationary effect, estimating at least the weight of the cow which is the diagnosis object, as the cow body characteristic value, from at least the geodesic length between left and right hip bones, out of the geodesic lengths measured by the geodesic length measurement part.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: AUTOMATED MILKING STALL
abstract: A milking stall comprises a base structure (10) supporting a pen (12) within which an animal undergoing milking may be enclosed, the pen (12) comprising at least one entrance gate and first and second exit gates, each gate being movable between an open position in which an animal may pass though the gate and a closed position in which an animal is unable to do so.

title: EARLY DETERMINATION OF PREGNANCY STATUS IN RUMINANTS
abstract: The present invention provides compositions and methods for detection schemes for ascertaining pregnancy status of an animal. The compositions and methods employ interferon-tau (IFNT) and/or antibodies specific for IFNT. Methods of the present invention detect the presence of IFNT in samples obtained from animals as an early indicator of pregnancy. Methods are provided to identify non-pregnant animals so that management decisions regarding rebreeding can be made earlier compared to existing approaches.

title: Automatic feeding system of lactating sows and control method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to an automatic feeding system for lactating sows and a control method thereof. According to one aspect of the present invention, in an automatic feeding system for lactating sows comprising: an automatic feeding device supplying feed and drinking water to the lactating sows; and a control device accumulating and storing history and the feeding quantity of the lactating sows, and controlling each component of the automatic feeding device, the automatic feeding device comprises: a feed tank having a feed amount level sensor measuring a feed amount inside an external box to generate a feed amount sensing signal and storing the feed supplied to the lactating sows therein; a feeding device installed in the lower part of the feed tank to allow the lactating sows to take the feed and including a remaining feed sensor recognizing a remaining level of the feed provided on one side of the external box to transmit a remaining feed sensing signal to the control device; an entity identification device installed on one side of the feeding device and sensing the lactating sow to transmit an entity identification signal to the control device when the lactating sow approaches; a feed supplying pipe installed at a lower portion of the feed tank; a feed supply motor disposed between the feed supplying pipe and the feed tank and rotating a feed supplying device to supply the predetermined supply amount of feed according to a control signal of the control device; and a drinking water supply device installed on an upper part of the feeding device and including an automatic drinking water control valve to supply a predetermined amount of drinking water through a drinking water supply tube according to a control signal of the control device. The automatic feeding system can automatically manage feeding of each lactating sow in a customized way by dividing the lactating sows into each stage.

title: Traceable cow nose ring marker
abstract: The invention discloses a traceable cow nose ring marker, which comprises a ring marker rod, a fixed ring marker cover fixedly connected to the front end of the ring marker rod, and a moveable ring marker cover movably connected to the back end of the ring marker rod, wherein at least one of the fixed and moveable ring marker covers is provided with a built-in electronic chip, an external two-dimension code and a plain code consisting of texts and/or numbers. The traceable cow nose ring marker of the invention has the advantages of reliable recorded information, simple and difficult-to-damage structure, difficult disassembly and good anti-falsification, no damage to the cow nose, and good cow tying function.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE TO MONITOR GROWTH OF AN ANIMAL, IN PARTICULAR A CALF
abstract: The invention relates to a method to monitor growth of an animal, in particular a calf, comprising the steps: recording, by a three-dimensional camera system, at least one three- dimensional image of the animal, and processing, by a processing device, the at least one image of the animal, wherein processing of the image comprises the steps of: forming a three-dimensional surface representation of a surface part of the animal from the at least one image, determining a size parameter representative for the size of the animal on the basis of the surface representation, and determining a volume parameter representative for the volume of the animal, and monitoring the volume parameter and size parameter or a combination thereof to monitor growth of the animal.

title: Electronic growing-finishing pigs feeder device
abstract: According to an aspect of the present invention, there is provided an automatic feeding control device for grower-finisher pigs, the device comprising: an automatic feeding controller for setting a feed intake per day which should be taken for each individual grower-finisher pig and controlling the feed intake per day to be dividedly fed 1-3 times a day by selection of a manager; a bulk bin for storing feed; simple bins receiving feed from the bulk bin and installed for each room for grower-finisher pigs; three feed supply holes partitioned by partitioning walls around the simple bins; and feeding devices for each individual pig, the devices being installed at one side of the feed supply hole to which feed is discharged from the simple bins. The feeding device for each individual pig includes: a feed discharge hole for discharging feed from the simple bin depending on a control signal of the automatic feeding control device; a feeding barrel containing the feed discharged from the feed discharging hole, and an NEC reader.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MONITORING FOOD INTAKE OF LIVESTOCK ANIMALS
abstract: A method for monitoring food intake of livestock animals includes defining a relationship between time an animal spends at a feeding trough and the animals food intake during that time, monitoring the time an animal spends at the feeding trough and determining a quantity of food intake for the animal based on the time spent at the feeding trough and the defined relationship. Optionally, time an animal spends in a feeding position at the feeding trough is monitored and used to determine quantity of food intake.
applicants: THE STATE OF ISRAEL, MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE & RURAL DEVELOPMENT, AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH ORGANIZATION, (A.R.O.), VOLCANI CENTER

title: METHOD AND DEVICE TO CONTROL ANIMALS NUMBER AND LIVE WEIGHT IN HERD AND DETECTING WEAK AND SICK AMONG THEM
abstract: FIELD: agriculture.SUBSTANCE: for accounting of healthy animals first time interval corresponds to onset of first animal on passage to farm. Signals of first and second time delay meet period of debilitated and sick animals admission. Animals are labelled with first and second colours, respectively. Turnstile opens at animal appears in passage for passing on weight platform. Turnstile is blocked till completion of weighing. Animal is weighed during its passage over platform. Weighing completed at exit of animal from platform. Device contains passage with side barriers, turnstile and sensor of animal presence, first and second actuators, two aerosol cylinders with paints, control and signalling unit. Electro-magnetic card based on bracelet is fixed on animal's leg. Turnstile comprises actuator and control unit for passage of animals one by one. In passage there are weight platform, converter with strain sensors, analogue-to-digital converter, comparator, inverter, control and data processing unit and information display unit. Animals are taken into account of number of turnstile openings.EFFECT: higher production efficiency.2 cl, 3 dwg
applicants: FEDERALNOE GOSUDARSTVENNOE BYUDZHETNOE NAUCHNOE UCHREZHDENIE 'FEDERALNYJ NAUCHNYJ AGROINZHENERNYJ TSENTR VIM' (FGBNU FNATS VIM)

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR DETECTING ABNORMAL STATE OF PIG
abstract: Provided are a method for detecting an abnormal state of a pig and a device therefor, whereby an abnormal state of a pig can be surely detected. A vertical movement frequency of the neck of a subject pig 8 is measured for a preset period of time. When the deviation between the measured vertical movement frequency and the vertical movement frequency in a normal state is equal to or higher than a preset level, the subject pig 8 is determined as being in an abnormal state.

title: LIVESTOCK-FARMING SYSTEM
abstract: Livestock-farming system (1), comprising an animal space (4), such as an animal shed or a meadow, for keeping livestock animals (9), and a detector system (17, 24) for detecting an entity (20) within a predefined detection zone (18), wherein the detector system comprises - a detector (17), and - a control unit (24) which comprises a memory (28) and is connected to the former, wherein detecting comprises receiving a signal from the detection zone using the detector, which signal is suitable for recognising the entity, and wherein the control unit processes the received signal to yield detection data relating to the entity, and stores these in the memory. In this way, it is automatically recorded which entities visit the animal space or at least come sufficiently close to it to have an effect thereon. It is then possible to take respective action, if desired automatically.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR MONITORING NUTRITION, ESPECIALLY FERMENTATION IN A RUMEN OF A RUMINANT
abstract: Method for monitoring nutrition, especially fermentation in a rumen of a ruminant, wherein a characteristic value of carbon dioxide inside the rumen and/or reticulum is determined. A bolus system (1) is provided for measuring dissolved carbon dioxide in the rumen of the ruminant, such as a dairy cow, using a near dispersive infrared sensor (2). Dissolved C02 is correlated with pH and rumen acidosis can be detected. The bolus (1) is permanently implanted in the rumen and data are transmitted wirelessly. The system can be used in a milking parlor.

title: Cow oestrus monitoring system
abstract: The invention provides a cow oestrus monitoring system. The system comprises at least one data acquisition device, a data transmission device and an upper computer, wherein the data transmission device is connected with the data acquisition device; the upper computer is connected with the data transmission device; the data acquisition device acquires activity amount information and body temperature information of a cow and sends the activity amount information and the body temperature information of the cow to the data transmission device; the data transmission device the activity amount information and the body temperature information to the upper computer for analyzing the activity amount information and the body temperature information. By the cow oestrus monitoring system provided by the invention, signal acquisition coverage in different ranges can be implemented, the requirements of different pastures are met, accurate monitoring on the cow oestrus activity is implemented and cost is saved.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL SCIENCES, CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: APPARATUS FOR DETECTING DEAD ANIMALS IN A FARM AND METHOD OF DETECTION WITH SUCH APPARATUS
abstract: An apparatus (10) for detecting dead animals in a farm, particularly for farms of laying hens, comprising one or more scanning means (11) arranged, with a corresponding supporting structure (12), so as to map the space of a farm, the scanning means (11) being connected to an electronic control and management unit (13) that is adapted to process the scans, detecting any presence of motionless animals in the farm space. A method of detecting dead animals in a farm by way of such an apparatus (10) comprises the steps of performing periodically a mapping of the space of the farm intended to be occupied by animals raised there, comparing successive mappings in order to identify any animals that are in the same position in at least two successive mappings, and emitting a signal indicating the presence of a motionless animal.

title: METHOD AND MANAGING DAIRY ANIMALS, AND A MILKING SYSTEM FOR PERFORMING THE SAME
abstract: A method, and milking system, for managing a herd of dairy animals comprising N groups, wherein N ≥ 2, comprises A) determining a content of a substance in the milk for a group of dairy animals, and B) performing an animal-related operation for the group, based on the content of the determined substance, wherein A) comprises: A1) repeating the following steps at least N times: a) performing milkings for the group of dairy animals, wherein an amount of milk is measured, b) performing milkings for at least one other group of dairy animals from the herd, wherein an amount of milk is measured, c) collecting all the milk, the amount of which has been determined in steps a) and b), to form a bulk amount, d) determining a reference content of the substance in the bulk amount of milk using an external measuring device, and A2) determining the content of the substance in the milk of the one group of dairy animals from the amount values measured in steps a) and b), as well as from the reference value, and at a predetermined assumption. This makes it possible to measure specific contents of milk for each group at the dairy farm with only a milk meter and with external reference values, and to take managing measures on the basis thereof.

title: LIVESTOCK LOCATION SYSTEM
abstract: In a headlock system having a plurality of n headlock cells, each of the n cells being adapted to enclose at least one animal; n is an integer greater than 1; a system for locating the position of at least one animal, the system comprising: at least one identification means adapted to transmit at least one identification signal associated with said at least one animal; at least one locating means adapted to generate at least one location signal associated with said at least one animal; and, a data processing system in communication with said at least one identification means and said at least one locating means, adapted to analyze said signals, said analyzed signals comprising the position within a predetermined region in said headlock system of each of said at least one animals as a function of time.

title: APPARATUS FOR MONITORING
abstract: According to the present invention, a monitoring apparatus comprises: a case of which at least a part is inserted inside an ear of an animal; a measuring unit accommodated in the part of the case which is inserted inside an ear of the animal, and measuring the temperature of the animal; and a communicating unit accommodated in the case, and transmitting the temperature measured from the measuring unit. The monitoring apparatus can detect an abnormal condition of livestock.

title: Device and method of animal reward
abstract: The invention describes an automated method, device and system for both husbandry and study purposes of animals by providing a heat reward for specific behavior. Embodiments include maintaining the cage temperature at a normal, comfortable temperature for the animals, such as mice, using radiant heat rather than conducted heat to provide the reward, using home cages for the animals, detecting the behavior fully automated, operating in animal darkness, and using cages that are free of electrical penetrations. Some embodiments have one animal in a cage. Some embodiments have or support multiple animals in a cage and include methods to detect automatically identify animals, locate animals in the cage and associate a behavior and reward for a specific animal. Some embodiments place all sensors and radiant heat sources outside the cage, or use infrared sources for both heating and for IR camera lighting.

title: MILKING SYSTEM IDENTIFIER
abstract: An identification system including a milking bail identifier, and a remote reader configured to read the unique milking bail identifier, and a reader configured to read the identification of a milking animal associated with the milking bail.

title: Cattle monitoring for illness
abstract: Disclosed are a system, device and process for monitoring physical and physiological features of livestock through a unique monitoring system and device. Basic and Smart tags are placed on livestock to monitor, among other things, temperature, movement, location, posture, pulse rate, and other physical and physiological features. Information is relayed from Basic tags, in one embodiment, to Smart tags that requests the information and receives the information from the basic tags. Smart tags send information to a mobile unit controller and/or home base so that requested information is sent to an end user that monitors the livestock for signs of illness. Potentially ill animals are segregated from the herd for further evaluation and minimization of exposure risk to the rest of the herd. This early detection system saves livestock and ensures a healthier herd for livestock farmers.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MANAGING DAIRY ANIMALS
abstract: A living area, which comprises a lying and eating area (2) and a milking area (20), is connected to a separation area by means of a selection device (32). A subgroup of dairy animals to be separated is determined together with a desired end time at which the dairy animals to be separated should be present in the separation area. For each individual dairy animal from the subgroup to be separated, an individual separation period is determined separately which runs from the individually determined start time until the end time. A dairy animal which walks to the selection device is guided by the selection device to the separation area if the dairy animal belongs to the subgroup of dairy animals to be separated and if said dairy animal is present at the selection device during the individual separation period determined for said dairy animal. The activity of each dairy animal in the group of dairy animals is observed by means of an observation system while the dairy animal is in the lying and eating area. The individual separation period of each individual dairy animal from the subgroup to be separated depends on the activity of said dairy animal observed by the observation system.

title: METHOD FOR MONITORING, MEASURING AND ASSESSING GRAZING AND RUMINATION ACTIVITIES OF RUMINANTS AND DEVICE FOR PERFORMING
abstract: The invention relates to a method for monitoring, quantifying and evaluating grazing and rumination activities of ruminants on the basis of the detection and quantification of mastication periods, and to a device for implementing said method.
applicants: UNIVERSIDAD NACIONAL DE ROSARIO; CONSEJO NACIONAL DE INVESTIGACIONES CIENTIFICAS YTECNICAS (CONICET); UNIVERSIDAD NACIONAL DEL LITORAL; INIS BIOTECH

title: Live pig heartbeat monitoring method and system and live pig survival state monitoring system
abstract: The invention provides a live pig heartbeat monitoring method, a live pig heartbeat monitoring system and a live pig survival state monitoring system. The live pig heartbeat monitoring system comprises a heartbeat sensor, a motion sensor and a monitoring end, wherein the heartbeat sensor is used for acquiring the heartbeat data of a monitored object; the motion sensor is used for acquiring the motion data of the monitored object; the monitoring end is connected with the heartbeat sensor and the motion sensor in a wired or wireless manner, and is used for acquiring the heartbeat data transmitted by the heartbeat sensor and the motion data transmitted by the motion sensor, judging the motion amplitude of the monitored object according to the motion data, and calculating corrected heartbeat data by virtue of the heartbeat data and a correction parameter when the motion amplitude is low motion amplitude.
