The live pig survival state monitoring system comprises the live pig heartbeat monitoring system and a stimulator, wherein the stimulator is used for receiving a control signal from the monitoring end, and performing physical stimulation on the monitored object according to the control signal.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF AGRICULTURAL ECONOMICS AND INFORMATION, JIANGXI ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Dairy cow feeding method
abstract: The invention discloses a dairy cow feeding method. The dairy cow feeding method includes: monitoring temperature in a cowshed through a temperature sensor in real time, and a central processing unit controlling an air conditioning system to keep the cowshed in a constant-temperature condition according to received information from the temperature sensor; arranging pedometers on cow legs, setting a unique ID (identity) number on each pedometer, and the central processing unit acquiring data of the pedometers to make statistics on quantity of motion of each cow; performing partition feeding through the central processing unit according to the statistical quantity of motion of each cow and collected weight information of each cow and adopting an automatic conveying belt to convey feed to a feeding trough, wherein the feed is made of, by weight, 70-80 parts of corn powder, 15-20 parts of peanut cake, 2 parts of rock flour, 0.5 part of bone flour, 1 part of table salt, 6-10 parts of bran, 0.3 part of mint, 0.4 part of tangerine peels, 0.5 part of dandelion and 0.3 part of purple perilla. With the method, efficiency in feeding is improved.

title: Small-tailed Han sheep raising method
abstract: The invention discloses a small-tailed Han sheep raising method. The method includes: a plurality of isolated areas are set on a farm, wherein a rearing trough, a manipulator and an infrared thermal imaging type body temperature monitoring system for acquiring body temperatures of small-tailed Han sheep are arranged in each isolated area; a central server conveys feedstuffs to the rearing troughs for feeding the small-tailed Han sheep through automatic conveying belts according to preset time, the infrared thermal imaging type body temperature monitoring systems monitor the body temperatures of the small-tailed Han sheep in real time and updates information of the monitored body temperatures to the central server, and if data received by the central server from the infrared thermal imaging type body temperature monitoring systems are abnormal, the central server controls the manipulators to grab the small-tailed Han sheep abnormal in body temperature to a diagnosis room for further diagnosis. The feedstuffs are prepared from, by weight, 55 parts of cornstalk powder, 16 parts of sorghum, 4 parts of salt, 9 parts of shell powder, 15 parts of soybean meal and 15 parts of minced small shrimps. The small-tailed Han sheep raising method has the advantage that cross infection of the sheep can be avoided.
applicants: LIUZHOU CITY LIUNAN DISTRICT ANSHUN BREEDING ASSOCIATIONS

title: Hotan sheep farming method
abstract: The invention discloses a Hotan sheep farming method. The method includes that multiple isolated areas are arranged in a farm, and an infrared thermal imaging body temperature monitoring system used for acquiring body temperature of Hotan sheep, a manipulator and a rearing trough are arranged in each isolated area; a central server conveys feed to the rearing troughs for feeding the Hotan sheep through an automatic conveying belt according to preset time, the infrared thermal imaging body temperature monitoring systems monitor body temperature of the Hotan sheep in real time, and when data received by the central server from the infrared thermal imaging body temperature monitoring systems are abnormal, the central server grasps the Hotan sheep abnormal in body temperature into a diagnosis room for further diagnosis through the manipulators. The feed is proportionally made of, by weight, 70 parts of wheat bran, 4 parts of sweet potato powder, 4 parts of salt, 9 parts of shell powder, 13 parts of soybean meal and 15 parts of radish juice. The method has the advantage that cross infection of sheep flocks is avoided.

title: Method for raising Longlin goats
abstract: The invention discloses a method for raising Longlin goats. The method includes arranging a plurality of isolated zones in farms and arranging infrared thermal imaging body temperature monitoring systems, mechanical arms and rearing troughs in each isolated zone; conveying fodder to the rearing troughs by the aid of automatic conveyor belts according to preset time under the effects of central servers, feeding the Longlin goats with the fodder, enabling the infrared thermal imaging body temperature monitoring systems to monitor the body temperatures of the Longlin goats in real time, uploading monitored body temperature information to the central servers, catching the Longlin goats with abnormal body temperatures by the aid of the mechanical arms under the effects of the central servers when data which are transmitted from the infrared thermal imaging body temperature monitoring systems and are received by the central servers are abnormal, and placing the Longlin goats in diagnosis rooms by the aid of the mechanical arms under the effects of the central servers. The fodder comprises, by weight, 40 parts of corn stalk powder, 14 parts of sorghum, 4 parts of salt, 6 parts of shell powder, 20 parts of soybean meal and 16 parts of eucommia ulmoides powder. The method has the advantage that cross infection in flock of the goats can be prevented.
applicants: LIUZHOU CITY LIUNAN DISTRICT ANSHUN BREEDING ASSOCIATIONS

title: Milk cow body temperature and action state monitoring instrument
abstract: The invention discloses a milk cow body temperature and action state monitoring instrument which comprises a leg wearing part, a belt box, a milk cow field control device and a mobile control terminal for wireless communication with the leg wearing part, the belt box and the milk cow field control device. The belt box comprises a monitoring belt and a transmitter. A pulse sensor, a temperature sensor and a GPS locator are arranged in the monitoring belt. The leg wearing part comprises a lithium battery, an accelerometer, a gyroscope, a magnetometer, a second radio frequency antenna, an RSSI module and a passive RFID chip. The milk cow field control device is formed by a temperature sensor, a humidity sensor, a body weight sensor and a material weight sensor. The body and action conditions of milk cows can be monitored through the different sensors, temperature and humidity signals of the site and milk cow body weight and feed consumption amounts can be collected through the milk cow field control device, and data are transmitted to the mobile control terminal wirelessly to be stored and accessed.

title: Device for automatically feeding calves
abstract: Device for automatically feeding calves with a mixing container for mixing a liquid food product, a teat, a connection line, which connects the mixing container with the teat, a branch line, which branches off from the connection line at a branch point and connects the connection line with a pump and a controller for controlling the pump, where a sensor is arranged on the teat, which is connected with the controller and is designed to detect a movement and/or deformation of the teat, and the controller is designed to control the pump during detection of a movement and/or deformation of the teat such that liquid food product is delivered out of the branch line towards the branch point until liquid food product exits the teat.

title: DATA NETWORK FOR MONITORING ANIMALS
abstract: The invention relates to a data network for automatically monitoring voluntary behaviors of individual animals of an animal herd. The individual animals (1) of the animal herd each have a node (3) of the data network. A further node (8) is attached at a location which an animal (1) preferably approaches in the course of a behavior to be monitored. In the event that the animal (1) approaches the node (8), communication occurs between the nodes (3, 8), in which communication one node is identified by the other node and a central data-processing system is informed that the two nodes (3, 8) have come into contact. The communication between the two nodes (3, 8) occurs by means of the transfer of electrical signals in a closed electrical alternating-current circuit, which also passes, among other things, through the body of the animal (1) as an electrical conductor.

title: System and Method for Detection of Lameness in Sport Horses and other Quadrupeds
abstract: A method of diagnosing lameness in quadrupeds utilizing computer vision and a computerized depth perception system to scan quadrupeds, such as sport horses, over time. The method enables a detailed analysis of the quadruped's movement, and changes thereof over time without the need for attaching sensors to the body of the horse, or requiring force plates or expensive high speed cameras. A processing system receives the input of this movement data and utilizes it to make a determination of severity of lameness signals of the animal. The system is inexpensive enough that non-specialists, such as non-veterinary trained quadruped owners, may install the system at an appropriate location such as a horse barn enabling identification of lameness early, to aid in objectively analyzing rehabilitation from injury, and relating changes in gait to performance changes.

title: LIVESTOCK FARMING SYSTEM
abstract: A livestock farming system (1) for use in connection with feed (4) for livestock and comprising at least one livestock-related device (7) to carry out a livestock-related action on the feed and a controller (9) to control the livestock farming system and generate information messages, and with a communication system (10, 28), wherein the livestock farming system is configured to define a parameter value relating to the condition of the person, and wherein the controller is configured to send communication messages with the communication system and/or make cognizable said messages to the person depending on the defined parameter value. Since the livestock farming system can assess the condition of the receiving person, the system can make a choice in the sending and/or communicating of the information to the person, so that it can be better guaranteed that the information to be sent will be effectively processed, and is not disregarded or incorrectly processed because the person is, for example, suffering from a high level of stress.

title: Method and system for the management, monitoring and traceability of extensive livestock (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract: Method and system for management, monitoring and traceability of extensive livestock. The present invention relates to a method and system for the localization and monitoring of animals by means of devices (itm) (1) associated thereto. These devices transmit, wirelessly, the status information and location of the animal to communication nodes (nc) (2) arranged in the installation. These nc devices may have associated installation monitoring devices (3) that measure physical parameters of the installation. In turn, the nc devices communicate with a central server (4) where information is collected and analyzed. (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
applicants: CALLEJERO ANDRES, CARLOS; GOMEZ MAQUEDA, IGNACIO; BLANCO CARRERA, RUBEN

title: Mating Sensor Device for Livestock
abstract: A device and method detects the orientation of a copulating livestock to indicate when the copulating livestock is mounted over a recipient livestock. A mounting base attaches the device over the dorsal spine and in the middle line of the back of the copulating livestock. The copulating livestock orients its dorsal spinal cord at about 45° incline while copulating with the recipient livestock. A tilt sensor detects the angle of inclination in relation to gravity or a predetermined reference angle. The copulation angle is generally greater than 45°. A counting apparatus registers the count every time the copulation angle is detected. A transmitter sends the count data to a remote data storage for analysis of copulating patterns. A solar panel provides renewable energy to recharge a battery. A control portion controls the device with a power switch and a reset switch. A camera and light provide more efficient analysis.

title: Livestock Management Apparatus and Method
abstract: An apparatus and method directionally administers at least one medication directly onto livestock while also monitoring the effect of the medication and tracking the movement and orientation of the livestock. The apparatus periodically administers the medication at a predetermined dosage. The apparatus also tracks the position and orientation of the livestock as an indication of whether the medication is effective. A solar cell provides renewable energy for powering the apparatus. A dispenser directionally and topically sprays medication on the wither area of the livestock. The medication is stored in at least one reservoir. A tracking portion tracks the position of the livestock in a predetermined range. The orientation of the livestock is also determined. The apparatus can be controlled directly from a control portion, or remotely from a remote processor. The apparatus minimize time and costs for managing livestock, especially over large areas and large numbers of livestock.

title: Milk urea-N yield (MUNY) as a nutritional and environmental management tool for the dairy industry
abstract: The present disclosure provides methods and systems for optimizing a cost efficiency or a nitrogen-use efficiency (NUE) for a feeding regimen of a herd of interest of milk-producing animals, for monitoring a urinary urea-N excretion (UUNE) for a herd of interest of milk-producing animals, and for monitoring a NUE for a herd of interest of milk-producing animals. The methods include use of a milk urea-N yield (MUNY) value or a ratio of MUNY to a protein yield (PY) in milk produced by the herd of interest.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MANAGING DAIRY ANIMALS
abstract: A system for managing a group of dairy animals comprises a dwelling space (2, 3), such as an animal shed, in which the dairy animals (10) can roam. A dairy animal-related device (20, 38) for performing a dairy animal-related operation is arranged in the dwelling space. The dairy animals in the dwelling space can walk to the dairy animal-related device through the dwelling space. A luring system comprises luring devices (58), each of which is attached to in each case one of the dairy animals. The luring device of each dairy animal is activatable in order to give said dairy animal a luring signal so as to lure said dairy animal to the dairy animal-related device. A detection system (39, 40) is configured for detecting the position of each individual dairy animal in the dwelling space. The luring system is connected to the detection system for receiving the positions of the dairy animals in the dwelling space detected by the detection system. On the basis of the received detected positions of the dairy animals in the dwelling space, the number of dairy animals is determined which are situated in a predetermined area (50) of the dwelling space adjacent to the dairy animal-related device. The luring system activates the luring device of one of the other dairy animals depending on said number of dairy animals situated in said area.

title: DEVICE FOR MONITORING THE HEALTH, FERTILITY AND/OR WELL-BEING OF A PIG
abstract: A device for monitoring the health, fertility and/or well-being of a pig. The invention concerns a device for monitoring the health and/or condition of a pig intended to be rigidly connected to an ear of said pig. According to the invention, such a device comprises, in particular: - means for measuring acceleration components of said device along three orthogonal axes; - means for measuring, by infrared means, the temperature of a portion of said ear; - means for optical luminescence measurement forming an oximeter intended to measure the oxygen saturation of the blood flowing in said ear; - means for processing said measurement of the acceleration components, said temperature measurement and said measurement of the oxygen saturation of the blood flowing in said ear comprising: - means for determining the position and/or a movement and/or the standing still and/or an ingestion and/or the mounting and/or the respiration rate and/or the level of activity of said pig from said measurement of the acceleration components; - means for determining the heart rate of said pig from said measurement of the oxygen saturation of the blood flowing in said ear; - means for determining a body temperature of said pig from said temperature measurement and clock data in order to take into account the temperature circadian rhythm of said pig.

title: LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT
abstract: A livestock management system for a first livestock and a second livestock facility having a plurality of animals, the system comprising: a data processing block configured to process data associated with the first livestock facility; a plurality of animal identification components, wherein each identification component comprises a unique identifying information, and wherein each identification component is attached to a single animal from the first livestock facility; and at least one network element configured to interface between a user and said data processing block, wherein the plurality of network elements is further configured to obtain the unique identifying information of animals, and wherein the livestock management system of the first livestock facility is configured to exchange information with a livestock management system of a second livestock facility.

title: A method and system for monitoring pregnancy toxaemia
abstract: A system for automatically determining pregnancy toxaemia in at least one animal 10 in agroup of animals comprises a sensor 50 for obtaining at least one value representative of a liquid or water uptake of the at least one animal, said sensor being adapted to bepositioned in the vicinity of a liquid or water supply station 20 or on the at least one animal. A processing unit 70 is provided, which is configured for comparing the obtained at least one value representative of a liquid or water uptake of the at least one identified animal to a threshold value, the threshold value being representative of an average of the at least one value for the group of animals; and for generating a signal and/or alert when the obtained atleast one value exceeds the threshold value. A water supply station 20, and a water dispenser (300, fig 3) are also claimed. The animal may be a pregnant sheep or doe.

title: Intelligent detecting system for monitoring health of sow
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent detecting system for monitoring health of a sow, comprising a health information detecting module, an information processing module, a data transmission network and at least one mobile terminal, wherein the health information detecting module includes an RFID (radio frequency identification) ear tag and an RFID card reader for obtaining the RFID ear tag information, and the health information detecting module obtains physical temperature and movement frequency information of every sow, and similar condition as a boar, and transmitting to the information processing module; the information processing module compares the obtained body temperature and the movement frequency information of the sow with the preset standard value, and judging the healthy state and the heating state of the sow. Through the sensor and an antenna on the RFID ear tag, the physical temperature, blood pressure, movement frequency and heating period of the sow can be monitored in real time; through the RFID card reader, the information on the RFID ear tag is read, thus it is good for exactly mastering the heating and hybridization information and the health status of the sow.

title: System and method for filtering data captured by a 2D camera
abstract: A system comprises a memory operable to store first light intensity information for a first pixel of an image that includes a dairy livestock, and second light intensity information for a second pixel of the image, wherein the second pixel is adjacent to the first pixel. The system further comprises a processor communicatively coupled to the memory and operable to determine that a difference between the first light intensity information and the second light intensity information exceeds a threshold, and discard one of the first pixel or the second pixel from the image.

title: A monitoring system for use on a vehicle
abstract: A monitoring system for a cargo load area (12) of a vehicle (10) comprises a pressure sensing device (22) to indicate a state of the cargo, a determination module (42) to determine comparison states of the cargo (17), a comparator module (44) to compare the state of the cargo with the comparison states, and a notification module (46) to alert the driver that the cargo (17) is in an unacceptable state. If cargo moves during transit it can become unbalanced or damaged. The system monitors the pressure profile of the cargo and compares it to predetermined pressure profiles to ascertain if the cargo is in an acceptable or unacceptable condition. Cargo can be livestock (horses) and the system can learn a cargos movement across time periods. The determination module can be pre-programmed with comparison states or can learn them. The alert or alarm can trigger a video display of the cargo area or can delay warning until a safe mode period is identified to avoid distracting the driver. Cargo information can be manually entered. The pressure sensor is a two dimensional array of sensors in the form of a mat on the load floor of a truck load bed.

title: Automatic color-marking device for livestock
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic color-marking device for livestock. The device comprises one or more color spraying devices provided with nozzles, one or more nozzle actuating components, power supply circuits, infrared detection devices, radio-frequency signal receiving devices and control modules, wherein each power supply circuit, each infrared detection device, each radio-frequency signal receiving device and each control module correspond to the corresponding nozzle, the output end of each infrared detection device and the output end of each radio-frequency signal receiving device are connected with the corresponding control module, each control module controls the power supply circuit of the corresponding nozzle actuating component to be switched on and postponed to be disconnected according to output results of the corresponding infrared detection device and the corresponding radio-frequency signal receiving device, and each nozzle actuating component presses the nozzle of the corresponding color spraying device when being powered on. By the adoption of the technical scheme of the automatic color-marking device, computational logic is set in the control modules in advance according to management requirements, when the livestock enters the station, color-spraying marking is conducted on the livestock automatically according to the computational logic of the control modules, and it is convenient to remind management personnel that electronic ear tags of the livestock are lost or management operation is conducted on the livestock.

title: Real-time intelligent system for determining milkability of milking sow
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time intelligent system for determining milkability of a milking sow. The system comprises a sow bed and a mobile terminal, supporting columns are arranged at four corners of the sow bed respectively, a retaining plate is arranged at top ends of the supporting columns, a wireless transmitter and a position sensor are arranged on the top surface of the retaining plate, the position sensor is mounted on the right side of the wireless transmitter, and the wireless transmitter is in wireless connection with the mobile terminal. Supporting plates are arranged on left and right sides of the bottom surface of the sow bed, high-precision weight sensors are arranged on the bottom surface of the sow bed, a water trough and a feed trough are mounted on the outer wall of the sow bed, the feed trough is mounted on the right side of the water trough, a water amount measurer is arranged on the bottom surface of the water trough, and a weight sensor is arranged on the bottom surface of the feed trough. By the real-time intelligent system, reliable measured data are provided for assessment of sow milkability, description of weight lose laws of the sow in a lactation period, assessment of nutrient intake in a gestation period and assessment of breast milk nutrition conditions of piglets.

title: Real-time measurement system for commercial pig marketing indexes
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time measurement system for commercial pig marketing indexes. The real-time measurement system comprises a monitoring terminal, a cloud server, a data receiving terminal and a farming shed, the farming shed automatically adding feed, the monitoring terminal, the cloud server, the data receiving terminal and the farming shed interact and transmit data through a data transmission network, the monitoring terminal is arranged in the farming shed and can monitor various indexes of commercial livestock and poultry and information such as weight, temperature and movement frequency, the feed is automatically added according to livestock and poultry weight, so that the livestock and poultry weight is in a certain range, or the livestock and poultry weight is increased according to preset requirements in the preset weight increasing range, and the monitoring terminal modulates encoding data of encoding circuits and transmits the data to the cloud server according to the designated formats. According to the real-time measurement system for the commercial pig marketing indexes, the indexes at the marketing stage are controlled in real time, the indexes affecting economic value of commercial pigs are monitored and controlled, and index data meeting marketing standards of the commercial pigs are furthest improved.

title: Agricultural drone for use in livestock monitoring
abstract: A method and system utilizing one or more agricultural drones to improve the real-time monitoring, measuring and analysis of the health of livestock, in particular, the core body temperatures thereof.

title: Agricultural drone for use in livestock feeding
abstract: A method and system utilizing one or more agricultural drones for real-time monitoring, delivery and dispensing of feed in feed bunks associated with feed lots.

title: Intelligent raising station for growing and fattening pigs
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent raising station for growing and fattening pigs. The raising station comprises a measuring station used for obtaining identity information of the growing and fattening pigs and measuring the weight, a position sensor used for detecting the positions of the growing and fattening pigs, a limiting door used for communicating the measuring station with a resting area, a selecting door used for selecting an ingestion area, and ingestion outlet doors used for communicating the selecting door with the ingestion area. A waiting queuing area is arranged between the limiting door and the measuring station. Selecting channels are formed between the selecting door and the outlet doors. A first outlet is communicated with the first ingestion outlet door through the first selecting channel. The second outlet channel is communicated with the second ingestion outlet door through the second selecting channel. The measuring station and the position sensor are connected with a controller which is connected with the selecting door. The intelligent raising station for the growing and fattening pigs can collect data automatically in time, and can pay close attention to the growth condition of the growing and fattening pigs in real time.

title: RFID ear tag
abstract: The invention relates to an RFID ear tag, and belongs to the technical field of RFID recognition. The RFID ear tag comprises a male tag and a female tag, the male tag is composed of a male tag bottom, a male tag neck and a male tag head, and the external diameter of the male tag head is larger than that of the male tag neck; the female tag comprises a small inner core tablet, a big inner core tablet, an RFID electronic tag, and the RFID electronic tag is arranged between the small inner core tablet and the big inner core tablet; the big inner core tablet is provided with a six-pedal inverted tooth, and the male tag can be inserted into the six-pedal inverted tooth and can not return back; the small inner core tablet, the big inner core tablet and the RFID electronic tag are wrapped in an ear tag TPU plastic coated layer. The RFID ear tag is reasonable and simple in structure, easy to produce and manufacture and convenient to use; when the FRID ear tag is used, the male tag head is inserted into the female tag, the male tag head is clamped on the other side of a jack of the six-pedal inverted tooth, and therefore the male tag head can not return back after being inserted into the six-pedal inverted tooth. The RFID electronic tag is arranged on the female tag and particularly arranged between the small inner core tablet and the big inner core tablet.

title: FARM SYSTEM PROVIDED WITH COMMAND LABELS
abstract: A farm system (1) provided with at least one control unit (2) and at least one animal interaction device communicatively connected with the control unit, such as an automatic feed dispenser (6i), milking robot (8) or a controllable gaten (12, 14, 18, 20), - wherein the system is further provided with at least one tag (30) such as a barcode, SQR code or an RFID label (32), and at least one portable reader (24) for reading a code of the tag, wherein the reader is communicatively connected with the control unit, wherein the tag is a fixed tag which is set up in a fixed place and which is associated with the at least one animal interaction device, wherein the system is possibly furthermore provided with at least one mobile tag (40) which for instance can be carried by a user of the reader, wherein the system is configured such that upon scanning of the code of the fixed tag with the reader, the reader passes information about the scanned code to the control unit, wherein the control unit in response to the received information about the scanned code of the fixed tag selects the at least one animal interaction device to be controlled, and wherein the system is configured such that the manner in which the at least one animal interaction device is controlled by the control unit is associated with the scanned code of the fixed tag or is associated with a scanned code of the mobile tag.

title: Comprehensive System of Herd Management with Automated Data Management
abstract: The present invention is a comprehensive herd management system that provides automated data gathering, storing, synchronization, backup, and analysis as well as integration with wireless instrumentation, utilizes automated data input methods, and a mobile device application to provide herd management, breed registry, and herd performance data from birth to slaughter.

title: ELIMINATION OF PATHOGENIC INFECTION IN FARMED ANIMAL POPULATIONS
abstract: Animal husbandry has always been susceptible to the ravages of pathogenic infections. Poultry flus and cattle diseases are but two examples that have dire consequences for animals and adversely affect the economic fortunes of farmers. A testing and culling methodology is presented that can eliminate pathogens from an infected herd. The sensitivity of PCR to detect very low levels of nucleic acid of an infecting pathogen is utilized to identify infected animals. In addition, it has been discovered that PCR analysis of manure samples can accurately identify infected animals and offspring for those species that consume placental remains after birth. Mink Aleutian Disease Virus (mADV) is one of several deadly DNA parvoviruses that can quickly reach epidemic proportions in a mink herd. PCR primers have been developed that generate amplicons to detect and identify the mADV. In addition, a previously unidentified strain of mADV has been discovered, genomically sequenced, and substantially detailed.
applicants: STAHL, RICHARD; STAHL, MARK; STAHL, JOHN

title: Livestock health monitoring system having elongated temperature probe for the ear and method of use
abstract: An animal wellness notification system includes an attachment body configured to securely engage with an ear of the animal; an elongated temperature probe secured to the attachment body and configured to extend within the ear of the animal; a housing secured to the attachment body; a computer disposed within the housing and operably associated with the temperature probe; and a notification device in data communication with the computer, the notification device being configured to provide notice if a temperature of the animal goes beyond a determined threshold.
applicants: FULTS, ALVIN, CECIL; FEVERTAGS; CRIDER, JR., RICHARD ARELIN

title: UPDATING OF ANIMAL MANAGEMENT LABELS
abstract: A system comprising at least one animal management label, such as an ear tag or bolus provided with a transmitter and receiver device, a pedometer provided with a transmitter and receiver device, and a smart tag for detecting movements of the animal provided with a transmitter and receiver device, wherein the system comprises a plurality of readers for wirelessly reading out the label and a central computer which is or can be communicatively connected with the readers, wherein the system is configured for updating the label with new data such as setting parameters of the label and/or a software update of the label, wherein the central computer is configured to supply the data of the update to each of the readers, wherein: a. the system is configured such that a random reader of the plurality of readers starts transmitting data of the update to a label when the label is at such a distance from the respective reader that the label can be wirelessly read out by the respective reader and the label has not received any data of the update yet; b. the system comprises recording means, wherein the system is configured to keep record of information in the recording means about what part of the data of the update has been received by the respective label after the supply of data of an update to the label; and c. the system is configured such that a random reader of the plurality of readers starts further transmitting data of the update to the label when the label is at such a distance from the respective reader that the label can be wirelessly read out by the respective reader and according to the information which is stored in the recording means the label has not received all data of the update yet, wherein the data of the update that is then supplied to the label relates to data of the update that has not been received by the label before.

title: A livestock raising tracing information tracking method and system, and a tattooing device
abstract: The invention provides a livestock raising tracing information tracking method and system, and a tattooing device. The system comprising a computer terminal used for converting livestock raising tracing information into tattoo patterns, a server, a tattooing device and a recognizing and reading recorder. The tattoo patterns formed on the computer terminal are uploaded to the server for storage; simultaneously, the computer terminal outputs the tattoo patterns to the tattooing device and the tattooing device applies the tattoo patterns to the bodies of livestock; the recognizing and reading recorder reads the tattoo patterns and sends the read information to the server to activate the tattoo patterns. The tattooing device is used for applying the tracing mark tattoos to the bodies of livestock, so that the problem that tracing marks get lost during activities and fights of animals is solved and the tracing marks accompany the livestock forever without losing. Through the server and the recognizing and reading recorder, the tracing information corresponding to the tattoo patterns can be updated anytime.

title: Feeding detection system and feeding detection method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to the technical field of digitization cultivation and, in particular to a feeding detection system. The feeding detection system comprises a feeding channel, a feeding device, an information acquiring device and an industrial personal computer, wherein the feeding device is arranged at the outlet end of the feeding channel; the information acquiring device comprises an image acquiring machine for obtaining the shape, size and image of a pig, a weight sensor for obtaining weight information of the pig, and an ear tag card reader for reading ear tag information of the pig; the image acquiring machine and the weight sensor are respectively arranged at the inlet end of the feeding channel; the ear tag card reader is arranged on one side, close to the feeding device, of the feeding channel; the feeding device comprises a feeding controller for controlling material feeding of the feeding device; the ear tag card reader is connected with the feeding controller to activate the feeding controller to control the feeding device for material feeding; the image acquiring machine, the weight sensor and the feeding controller are respectively connected with the industrial personal computer.

title: A method of monitoring the physical condition and/or suitability of animal feed of ruminant animals.
abstract: A method of monitoring the physiological condition, and/or suitability of animal feed, of ruminant animals, comprising: a. sensing the occurrence of at least a first predetermined type of activity of the animal; b. determining a length of a time period of a first type during which in step a. a sensed first predetermined type of activity has taken place; c. transmitting information about the length of a time period of the first type determined in step b. wherein preferably the transmission starts on a moment in time which depends on the moment in time on which the time period of the first type has ended; d. repeating steps a.-c. for next sensed occurrences of activities of the first predetermined type.

title: Mating detection marker pen for cows
abstract: The invention relates to a mating detection marker pen for cows. The pen can be used for detecting whether the cows are in oestrus (mate) or not. The mating detection marker pen is composed of a body marker part, an externally-wrapped envelope part and an outer layer packaging part. The body market part is prepared from an appropriate amount of pigment, castor oil, petroleum jelly, palm oil, paraffin, beewax, Fischer-Tropsch wax, kaolin, calcium carbonate, linseed oil, propyl paraben and butyl paraben. The externally-wrapped envelope part is prepared from an appropriate amount of propyl benzene emulsion, polyvinyl acetate resin emulsion, pigment, glycerol and kaolin. The mating detection marker pen for the cows is prepared through an apt technology, the marker pen coats colors on the tail portions, capable of being mounted easily, of the cows, whether colored tapes are erased or not is observed every day, and accordingly whether the cows are in oestrus or not can be judged. The marker pen has the advantages of being short in time, durable, economical, effective, free of poison, easy to distinguish, resistant to environment temperature difference, and conducive to improving the economic benefits and social benefits of the cow rearing industry.
applicants: WUHAN HONGZHIXING AGRICULTURE AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY MACHINERY COMPANY

title: METHOD FOR OBTAINING INFORMATION ABOUT A FARM ANIMAL
abstract: The invention relates to a method for obtaining information about a farm animal, wherein a device (a) is attached to the head region of an animal, said device containing at least one acceleration sensor by means of which recurring acceleration data is measured, wherein the acceleration data is evaluated using automatic data processing means, and, as an outcome of the evaluation, is indicative of the activities and/or conditions of the animal. The acquired acceleration data is evaluated in order to detect the swallowing processes carried out by the animal.

title: Cage-free raising method, device and system for livestock and poultry
abstract: The invention discloses a cage-free raising method, device and system for livestock and poultry. The system is characterized in that collectors and driving devices are arranged in the cage-free raising area of the livestock and poultry, the collectors and the driving devices are arranged correspondingly and can be arranged at same spatial positions, and all the collectors of the cage-free raising area can seamlessly cover the whole cage-free raising area; each livestock and poultry fixedly wears one identification, the identification includes ID1, ID2, ID3...and IDn, the collectors can identify the identification and collect the identification signal of each livestock and poultry; a data processing unit detects the livestock and poultry density in an area or the livestock and poultry activity conditions in the area; if the density is higher than a threshold and/or the activity level of the livestock and poultry in unit time in the area is low, controlling the driving devices in the corresponding area to drive the livestock and poultry to allow the livestock and poultry to run to other areas so as to promote the movement of the livestock and poultry.

title: Animal environmental and physiological monitoring system
abstract: Generally, an animal monitoring system including a bolus administered to reside in an animal operable to sense changes in one or more physiological parameters of the animal and generate and transmit encoded bolus sensor data to a tag affixed on the outside of the animal which operates to sense changes in one or more environmental parameters surrounding the animal and to generate encoded tag sensor data and to receive encoded bolus sensor data each of which can be analyzed by the tag or a remote data processor to generate environmental parameter values and physiological parameter values to assess an environmental or physiological condition of or about the animal.

title: Cow physiological status early warning device
abstract: The invention provides a cow physiological status early warning device. A first monitoring unit is a pressure sensor, a second monitoring unit is a shading plate, and a third monitoring unit is a contact switch. The cow physiological status early warning device further comprises a stroboscope lamp in signal connection with an MCU processing unit and a buzzer in signal connection with the MCU processing unit. The cow physiological status early warning device can accurately monitor cow estrus information to provide technical support for optimizing hybridization time; cost for artificial observation of cow estrus is greatly saved, and labor intensity of veterinaries is reduced.

title: Positioner mounting device
abstract: The invention relates to the field of electronic information equipment, and discloses a positioner mounting device comprising clamping heads A, clamping heads B, round holes, a connection plate A, a rotation device, connection plates B, a storage box, a lid, and a positioner storage tank. The bottom of the storage box is fixedly connected with one end of the connection plate B through a screw. The rotation device is fixedly arranged between the connection plates B. The connection plates B on the two sides of the rotation device are hinged. The other end of the connection plate B is welded with the connection plate, forming a T shape. According to the invention, the positioner and battery combination is placed in the storage box, and are fixed on the clamping heads through the connection plate A and the connection plates B, such that the anti-lost device can be mounted on cattle or sheep horns. The positioner can operate for a long time without charging, such that cattle and sheep can be prevented from getting lost, and herdsman loss can be prevented. The device is suitable to be popularized.
applicants: TIANJIN YISHENG CENTURY TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT COMPANY

title: UNMANNED LIVESTOCK MONITORING SYSTEM AND METHODS OF USE
abstract: The present invention relates in general to the field of animal husbandry, and more specifically, to a livestock monitoring system utilizing an unmanned aerial vehicle (“UAV”) and methods of using such systems. The system and method of the present invention for monitoring the health and welfare of livestock comprises six primary components: (1) at least one UAV; (2) a plurality of cameras and sensors; (3) a transmitter; (4) a receiver; (5) a server connected to a computer system for receiving images, video, and data from the plurality of cameras and sensors; and (6) a display for viewing in real-time images, video and data obtained from the plurality of cameras and sensors for monitoring the condition of livestock on a farm or ranch. The purpose of the invention is to provide a convenient and cost-efficient system and method for monitoring the condition of livestock to obtain information in real-time about the behavioral and physiological states of individual animals.

title: INGESTIBLE BOLUS FOR ANIMALS
abstract: An ingestible bolus for automatically monitoring location and physiological parameters including core temperature of ruminant animals. The location parameters are determined using magnetic field information and/or GPS data sensed by the sensors in the bolus and communicated along with a unique ID number and time stamp to a centralized location. A data center at the centralized location comprises a computing environment for analyzing the data received from the bolus and transfer the analyzed results including animal temperature, location to a user interface display. The temperature information is analyzed at the data center to determine the health status of the animal.

title: Composite RFID animal ear tag and tracking system
abstract: The invention relates to a composite RFID animal ear tag and a tracking system. The composite RFID animal ear tag and the tracking system comprise a superhigh frequency RFID ear tag unit, a high frequency RFID ear tag unit, a superhigh frequency RFID extraction unit, a high frequency RFID write-in unit, an industrial control unit, a monitoring end communication unit, a management communication unit, a cloud data platform and a pasture management system. The composite RFID animal ear tag and the tracking system recognize the identities of animals remotely in motion, and the single-time-slot recognition efficiency is improved by about 7 times; short-range scanning and updating of feeding logs are further supported, the logs are protected against tampering, transparent reading is achieved, a pasture can be assisted in tracking the feeding process of the animals, important epidemic prevention processes of the animals are prevented from being missed by mistake in motion, and management of animal files is enhanced. NFC scanning of a circulation link can be supported through the composite ear tag, clients can transparently read the animal feeding logs through mobile phones, and traceability is achieved.

title: CLOUD-BASED AUTONOMOUS AQUACULTURE SYSTEM
abstract: A system and method for remote monitoring and command and control of one or many offshore aquafarms is provided. Operators are able to securely access web applications and services hosted in the cloud through which husbandry functions such as feeding fish, cleaning the cage and removing mortalities can be automatically scheduled and executed. Offshore aquafarms relay information, such as environmental sensor data and video feeds back to the cloud to be viewed by the operators.

title: SYSTEM, DEVICE AND METHOD FOR OBSERVING PIGLET BIRTH
abstract: A system and a method for observing piglet birth is provided. The method (15) comprises detecting (30), at a first detection zone (50), infrared electromagnetic radiation from a first radiation zone including at least a first area of a first delivery zone of a first farrowing sow or gilt, identifying (32) a first event indicative variation in the detected infrared electromagnetic radiation, the first event indicative variation being indicative of a piglet birth, and determining (34) a first piglet birth event by means of the identification of the first event indicative variation.

title: Animal behavior recorder for connecting bred animals into network
abstract: The invention discloses an animal behavior recorder for connecting bred animals into a network.The animal behavior recorder comprises a processor unit, a sensor, a co-processor, a ratio frequency communication module, an antenna, a camera, a microphone and a power supply; the sensor is connected with the co-processor, and the sensor and the co-processor are connected with the processor unit separately; the ratio frequency communication module is connected with the processor unit and the antenna; the power supply, the camera and the microphone are connected with the processor unit separately.The animal behavior recorder can be suitable for a breeding industry, is worn by the bred animals such as pigs, sheep, dogs and cows, records the environment, sound and feeding conditions and the like around the bred animals and can supply an important means to the breeding industry for walking to publicity, transparency and integrity and supply help to green breeding.

title: Device and method for monitoring of pig attitudes based on micro-inertial sensor
abstract: The invention provides a device and a method for monitoring of pig attitudes based on a micro-inertial sensor. The device comprises an information acquisition module used for acquiring information of pig individuals, an attitude calculation module used for fusion filtering of information acquired by the information acquisition module and output of attitude angles, and a PC upper computer used for recognition of the pig attitudes according to output results of the attitude calculation module. The invention has the following advantages: packaging space is saved; meanwhile, attitude information is updated by adopting a fourth order Runge-Kutta attitude algorithm; through a dynamic Kalman filtering model, gyroscopic drift is compensated by utilizing an accelerometer and a magnetometer, so superiority complementarity of attitudes of a gyroscope attitudes of the accelerometer and the magnetometer is realized, and accuracy and reliability of dynamic measurement of a system are improved; equipment cost is significantly reduced; meanwhile, the device has strong applicability, can meet the requirement of real-time monitoring, is capable of replacing breeders to observe the pig attitudes at each moment, so suspected cases of diseased pig individuals are early detected, and economic losses are reduced.

title: Technologies for managing the health of livestock
abstract: Technologies for managing the health of livestock include one or more livestock health sensor systems configured to determine livestock health data of livestock animals. The livestock health data includes livestock health characteristic data indicative of a health characteristic of the corresponding livestock animal associated livestock identification data that uniquely identifies each livestock animal. The livestock identification data is received by each livestock health sensor system from a livestock identification tag coupled to the corresponding livestock animal. Each livestock health sensor system transmits the determined livestock health data to a livestock health monitoring server, which aggregates the livestock health data for each livestock animal and analyzes the health data to determine whether any abnormalities are present. If so, the livestock health monitoring server may control a livestock treatment device to provide treatment to the corresponding livestock animal on a per-animal basis.

title: LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, SENSOR DEVICE, AND METHOD FOR ESTIMATING STATUS OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: [Problem] To provide a livestock management system, with which it is possible to simply and precisely estimate, a sensor device, and a method for estimating the status of livestock. [Solution] A livestock management system according to one embodiment of the present invention is equipped with a management device. The management device has a power generating unit, which generates power in response to the surrounding environment, and a transmission unit, which transmits power generation information from the power generation unit by means of the power obtained by the power generation unit. The management device further has a reception unit, which receives the power generation information from a sensor device configured so as to be mountable on the livestock, and a control unit that estimates the status of the livestock on the basis of the power generation information.

title: Cow oestrus detection necklace
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic detection devices, in particular to a cow oestrus detection necklace which comprises a band-shaped necklace body and an oestrus detection device.The oestrus detection device is arranged on the band-shaped necklace body and comprises an acquirer, a processor and an oestrus warning device, and the acquirer, the processor and the oestrus warning device are sequentially connected with one another; the acquirer is used for acquiring cow activity information and transmitting the cow activity information to the processor via a data wire; the processor is used for judging whether cows are in normal states or oestrus states and transmitting judgment results to the oestrus warning device via a data wire; the oestrus warning device is used for displaying current states of the cows.The cow oestrus detection necklace has the advantages that the cow oestrus detection necklace is simple in structure and is convenient and practical, and the labor intensity can be relieved for observation staffs; activity of the cows is monitored in real time, so that the cow oestrus period disclosure rate can be increased; the optimal mating time can be determined according to disclosed oestrus time, accordingly, the milk yield of the cows can be increased, and the cow oestrus detection necklace is favorable for the economical efficiency.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MONITORING LIVESTOCK
abstract: A system and method for monitoring livestock, the system including a remote server storing data, the remote server including a processing unit for processing stored data and a non-volatile memory; at least one simple data collection device for mounting on an animal to be monitored, the data collection device including a sensor sensing physical parameters of the animal on which it is mounted, a simple data collection device processor with a non-volatile memory, and a transmitter for transmitting data collected by the sensor; at least one central data collection device including a mobile hub for mounting on an animal to be monitored, the central data collection device including: a central data collection device processor with a non- volatile memory; a receiver for receiving data transmitted by the simple data collection devices; a transceiver for communication with the remote server over a communication system; an energy source; the remote server being configured to analyze collected physical parameters and determine therefrom physical condition or behavior of the animal; and a network for two-way communication between the remote server and a remote electronic communication device and configured to provide real time information and warning alarms to the remote electronic communication device.

title: Industrial intelligent livestock cultivation system
abstract: The invention discloses an industrial intelligent livestock cultivation system which comprises a breeding house, a man-machine operation interface, an automatic control system, a feeding cart, a cart track, a feeding trough, an excrement collecting and discharging unit, an image collecting unit and a temperature and humidity induction unit.Breeding units are arranged in the breeding house, the cart track is arranged in the breeding house and surround the outer portions of the breeding units by one round, the feeding trough and the excrement collecting and discharging unit are arranged on the two sides of the breeding units respectively, and the feeding trough is located between the cart track and the breeding units.The bottom of the feeding cart is slidably connected with the cart track, and the image collecting unit and the temperature and humidity induction unit are arranged in the breeding house and located above the breeding units.The automatic control system is connected with the feeding cart, the excrement collecting and discharging unit, the image collecting unit and the temperature and humidity induction unit simultaneously, and a corresponding feeding database can be established according to types and number of cultivated livestock.The automatic, informationized and intelligent operation of the cultivation system is performed well, and the requirements on refined cultivation are met.

title: CONDITION DETECTOR, METHOD FOR USING SAME, AND CONDITION DETECTION SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention is non-invasively attached to a farm animal so that a biosensor unit faces the body surface thereof. The biosensor unit detects the condition of the body of the animal by detecting biological data.

title: RFID (radio frequency identification device) transceiver and miniature livestock and poultry flocking alarming system and alarming method based on RFID transceiver
abstract: The invention provides an RFID (radio frequency identification device) transceiver and a miniature livestock and poultry flocking alarming system and an alarming method based on the RFID transceiver, aiming at solving the problem of flocking alarming in miniature free raising scene. The invention relates to the RFID transceiver, in particular to the RFID transceiver for the miniature livestock and poultry flocking alarming. The RFID transceiver is characterized in that a transmitting coil is arranged in a first metal cylinder, and one end of the first metal cylinder is sealed; a receiver is arranged in a second metal cylinder; a wave absorbing material is attached to the inner wall of the second metal cylinder. The RFID transceiver has the advantage that by adopting the improvement, the position detection on dense beacon carrying bodies by the RFID transceiver is improved, so that the flocking condition of the beacon carrying bodies can be effectively detected.

title: Bred sheep intelligent waistband with behavior and health identification
abstract: The invention discloses a bred sheep intelligent waistband with behavior and health identification. The intelligent waistband is formed by a single-chip microcomputer minimum system, a bluetooth module, a SD card module, a heart rate sensor, a three-axis acceleration sensor, a temperature sensor, a power supply, and a reset circuit. The bluetooth module, the SD card module, the heart rate sensor, the three-axis acceleration sensor, the temperature sensor, the power supply, and the reset circuit are connected with the single-chip microcomputer minimum system. Through using a wearing technology on a bred sheep, bred sheep behaviors and health conditions can be monitored everyday in real time, so as to track and analyze relations of feeding amount and health for long time. Combined with feeding contrastive analysis of different fodders, breeding investment conditions of all fertility stages of the bred sheep can be obtained, so as to provide basis for obtaining maximum economic benefits.

title: Detection instrument and method for cow oestrus degree and optimum insemination time
abstract: The invention discloses a detection instrument and method for the cow oestrus degree and the optimum insemination time, and relates to the technical field of cow reproduction. The detection instrument comprises a PWM wave generator, a direct-current constant-current source, a microcontroller, a two-way analog switch, a probe electrode and a display device. When measurement is conducted, the PWM wave generator generates PWM waves to control on-off of the two-way analog switch, direct-current constant-current currents generated by the direct-current constant-current source are converted into same-frequency measuring currents, the measuring currents act on the probe electrode to measure a bioelectrical impedance value of mucus around the probe electrode, the bioelectrical impedance value is input into the microcontroller, the microcontroller determines a cow oestrus degree and insemination time program according to fix quantities stored in the microcontroller, and then the current oestrus degree of a cow and whether the current time is the optimum insemination time of the cow or not are determined. Accordingly, labor force and labor intensity which are needed by traditional cow oestrus degree and insemination time detection are reduced, and the economic benefit of a livestock farm is increased.

title: MILKING ARRANGEMENT AND METHOD FOR GUIDING ANIMALS THROUGH A MILKING ARRANGEMENT
abstract: A milking arrangement (11) comprises at least a first (12) and a second (13) milking system for milking animals; a common entrance lane (14) configured to allow a plurality of animals to enter the milking arrangement; and a guiding structure (15) configured to guide each of the plurality of animals to either one of the first and second milking systems to be milked therein. The guiding structure comprises a smart gate arrangement (61) including an entrance through which animals can enter the smart gate arrangement, an animal identifier for identifying each animal having entered or is to enter the smart gate arrangement, and at least two separate exits, through which each animal, which has entered the smart gate arrangement, can be selectively guided to exit the smart gate arrangement after having been identified, to thereby be guided to a respective one of the first and second milking systems depending on the identity of the animal. The smart gate arrangement is configured, during selected periods of time, particularly during periods of low expected or measured utilization of the milking arrangement, to guide each animal, which has entered the smart gate arrangement, to exit the smart gate arrangement, to thereby be guided to a single one of the first and second milking systems irrespective of the identity of the animal.

title: Culture management system based on Internet of things
abstract: The invention discloses a culture management system based on Internet of things. The system comprises a wearing device, an application server, a browser, a user end and a total database. The wearing device comprises a ring sleeve, a fiber sleeve and a platform, and the wearing device is placed on an animal; information in the wearing device of the animal is acquired and stored in the database, and the database is connected with the application server through a GPRS module; and an information acquisition device on the wearing device comprises an accelerated speed sensor, a body surface electrode, a breathe sensor, a temperature detector, a blood pressure detector and a pedometer, and the application server is connected with the browser. According to the invention, through combining the technology of Internet of things with the livestock and poultry breeding industry, life information of cultured animals is obtained in real time, livestock and poultry farmers can rapidly know conditions of individual animals, and diseases can be found at an early stage; obtained information is gathered through a network, present conditions of culture products are analyzed, and the problems of excessive production power and product overstocking are solved.

title: PREVENTING SYSTEM FOR DOMESTIC ANIMAL DISEASES USING THERMAL CAMERA
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock disease prevention system for identifying and isolating abnormal livestock units. More specifically, livestock disease prevention system includes: a livestock barn including an isolated area; a thermal camera which records the thermal images of the livestock barn; an output unit for outputting an identification mark on livestock units; and a control unit which identifies the livestock units in the livestock barn from the thermal images, tracks the identified livestock units, monitors the body temperature of the livestock units, and controls the output unit to output the first identification mark on the sensed abnormal livestock units when sensing the abnormal livestock units among the monitored livestock units exceeding the normal temperature range.

title: Method and apparatus for providing indication of the oncoming parturition in livestock
abstract: This invention relates to a method of, and apparatus for providing an indication of the oncoming parturition in livestock. A tail mounted sensor 1 is mounted on the tail 31 of an animal 30 (e.g. a cow or horse) and monitors the tail movements (optionally using a low pass filter). Each time that the tail is raised by a predetermined angle θ, for a predetermined period of time T1 (typically between 1 and 30 seconds), the sensor records this as a contraction. The sensor then monitors the number of contractions (N) over a second predetermined period of time, T2. When the number of contractions in T2 equal or exceed a certain amount, a signal is created which generates an alarm to indicate the oncoming parturition of the animal. The system can transmit the alert signal to a remote server 40 and then to a mobile handset 50 (for example via SMS).

title: Livestock feeder with measured dispensing system
abstract: A livestock feeder is provided with a feed discharge assembly for dispensing a premeasured amount of feed into the trough of each feeding stall. The livestock feeder includes individual feeding stalls wherein the same amount of feed is dispensed for each animal such that the feeding of each animal may be monitored and controlled. Indicator lights may be provided to attract the livestock to the individual feeding stalls during feeding periods.

title: SYSTEM FOR CAPTURING AND TRANSMITTING LIVESTOCK DATA
abstract: The present disclosure relates to management of livestock, and more particularly to a secure and credible system, architecture, and method for uniquely and credibly identifying, capturing, updating and maintaining livestock herd data.

title: Automatic cleaning and disinfecting system and cleaning and disinfecting method for milk cows
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic cleaning and disinfecting system and cleaning and disinfecting method for milk cows. The automatic cleaning and disinfecting system comprises a cow herd transferring passage, a to-be-milk region, a disinfecting passage, a cleaning and disinfecting system, a sick cow treatment passage, a milking region, a return passage and a disinfecting system, wherein the cow herd transferring passage communicates with one end of the to-be-milk region, and the other end of the to-be-milk region communicates with one end of the disinfecting passage; the cleaning and disinfecting system is arranged on the disinfecting passage; one side of the cleaning and disinfecting system communicates with one end of the sick cow treatment passage, and the other end of the disinfecting passage communicates with the milking region; one end of the return passage communicates with the milking region, and the disinfecting system is arranged on the return passage; and the other end of the return passage communicates with cow herd transferring passage. The cleaning and disinfecting system consists of a front gate, a rear gate, a separation door, a door control module, a steel frame support structure, a wireless transferring module, a readcard module, a mechanical arm, a mechanical executing and control module, an image collecting and treating module and cleaning and disinfecting units. The automatic cleaning and disinfecting system disclosed by the invention is simple and convenient to operate, the labor cost for milking is effectively reduced, and the safety is improved.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based system for livestock parasite amelioration
abstract: Parasites are detected and ameliorative actions taken using unmanned aerial vehicles equipped with sensors and equipment for dispensing treatment materials. Physical characteristic data obtained by the sensors is supplemented using a risk management module that increases the confidence level that the diagnosis of a particular parasite on an animal is correct. The risk management module may further be used to assess additional factors, such as the potential harm in applying a selected treatment, in the decision of whether or not to take ameliorative action.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR IDENTIFICATION OF INDIVIDUAL ANIMALS BASED ON IMAGES OF THE BACK
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a system and a method for identification of individual animals based on images, such as 3D-images, of the animals, especially of cattle and cows. When animals live in areas or enclosures where they freely move around, it can be complicated to identify the individual animal. In a first aspect the present disclosure relates to a method for determining the identity of an individual animal in a population of animals with known identity, the method comprising the steps of acquiring at least one image of the back of a preselected animal, extracting data from said at least one image relating to the anatomy of the back and/or topology of the back of the preselected animal, and comparing and/or matching said extracted data against reference data corresponding to the anatomy of the back and/or topology of the back of the animals with known identity, thereby identifying the preselected animal. The method and system can be used to monitor feed intake, such as feed intake for dairy cows as well as health status.

title: Modular livestock feed system for measuring animal intake and monitoring animal health
abstract: A livestock feed system adapted to be modular and readily scalable from one bin assembly to multiple bin assemblies that can be communicatively networked together. The system includes a stainless steel feed bin with an opening on a first surface of the one or more sidewalls for receiving an animal head. The feed bin further includes an access door on a second surface of the one or more sidewalls that is pivotally, slidably, or removably coupled to adjacent portions of the one or more sidewalls to allow easy cleaning of the bin. The system includes a portable support frame supporting the feed bin, and a controller mounted on the support frame. The controller includes a self-contained computer with a processor executing code (programs or software) to provide an animal monitoring and management module that causes the controller to determine intake by an animal accessing the feed bin through the opening.

title: Momentum detection system and method of the bull or the cow in a domestic bull or cow farm
abstract: Disclosed are a system and a method to detect the momentum of a bull in a cattle farm. In a cattle farm in which 70-130 beef or diary cattle are raised, the system to detect the momentum of cattle transmits GPS position information, time information, and a device ID (identification tag information) of a beacon (sensor node), which is installed in a collar of cattle and includes a GPS receiver, from the beacon to a monitoring server, interlinked with the Internet, at regular intervals through a wireless sensor network (WSN) with a sink node and wired/wireless Internet (Wi-Fi, CDMA/LTE), and thus, the system identifies positions of the cattle in real time through a smartphone and a computer of the cattle farm and calculates a movement distance by unit time in accordance with the device ID of the beacon, including the identification tag information, to calculate speed (v) and detect the momentum (p=mv) of the cattle. As such, the present invention is capable of systemically managing the health of the cattle of the cattle farm by transmitting the speed and momentum to the monitoring server of the computer of the farm and monitoring the health of the cattle through the smartphone and the computer, thereby increasing sales of the cattle farm.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MILKING A GROUP OF DAIRY ANIMALS
abstract: A system (1) for milking a group of milking animals (8), in particular cows, comprises an accommodation space (2) in which the milking animals (8) can walk around, and a plurality of milking stations (10) which are each placed at a fixed position and next to each other, A milk storage tank (25) Is placed at a fixed position outside the accommodation space (2). An automatic milking system for automatic milking of a milking animal (8) comprises at least one autonomous self-propelled trolley (21) With milking cups (22). The milking system is configured for automatic connection of the milking cups (22) of the trolley (21) to the teats of a milking animal (8). The milking cups (22) of the trolley (21) are connected to the milk storage tank (25) by means of a milk discharge system. The milk discharge system comprises at least one flexible milk line (80a, 80b, 80c, 80d) which is connected to the trolley (21), An animal-free space (70) extends adjacent to the milking stations (10). The animal-free space (70) is connected to each milking station (10) by means of a connection (71) Through which the trolley (21) can travel. The flexible milk line (80a, 80b, 80c, 80d) is configured such that the trolley (21) can travel from the animal-free space (70) into each of the milking stations (10) while the milk line (80a, 80b, 80c, 80d) remains connected to the trolley (21).

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MILKING A GROUP OF MILKING ANIMALS
abstract: A system for milking a group of milking animals comprises an accommodation space in which the animals can walk around, multiple milking stations and a connection system for automatic connection of milking cups to the teats of an animal present in a milking station. Expulsion means are provided that can be activated by a control system in the milking stations to give an expulsion stimulus to a milking animal present in a milking station, to leave said milking station. The control system is configured to activate the expulsion means such that the expulsion stimulus is given to each milking animal present in one of the milking stations on condition that (i) said milking animal fulfils a predefined expulsion criterion, and (ii) all other milking stations are occupied by other milking animals.

title: SYSTEM FOR MILKING A GROUP OF DAIRY ANIMALS
abstract: A system for milking a group of milking animals (8), in particular cows, wherein the system comprises an accomodation space (2) for keeping milking animals (8). The accomodation space is configured such that the milking animals can walk around freely in the accommodation space. Several milking stations (10) are each placed at a fixed location and next to each other. The milking stations each comprise an entry opening (11) for entry of a milking animal from the accommodation space to the milking station. The entry openings of the milking stations are each open permanently. An automatic milking system (20) is provided for automatic milking of milking animals present in the milking station. The milking stations comprise a drinking system (16) which is configured to provide water for the milking animais. The drinking system of the milking stations is the only drinking facility for the milking milking animals can meet their daily water needs. The accommodation space is configured such that he aninals in the accomodation space can walk freely from the accommodation space to each entry.

title: LIVESTOCK REGISTRATION SYSTEM AND LIVESTOCK REGISTRATION METHOD
abstract: A livestock registration system according to one embodiment of the present technology is provided with an image data acquisition unit, a signal acquisition unit, and a registration unit. The image data acquisition unit acquires image data obtained by capturing an image of a livestock animal to be registered. The signal acquisition unit acquires an individual identification signal which contains an identifier that can be used to identify the livestock animal to be registered and is transmitted from a transmission device attached to the livestock animal to be registered. The registration unit registers, in association with each other, the image data and the identifier of the individual identification signal received at a reception timing corresponding to the timing of capturing the image of the livestock to be registered.

title: Cow occupation recognition method based on multiple radio frequency identification device (RFID) antennas
abstract: The invention provides a cow occupation recognition method based on multiple radio frequency identification device (RFID) antennas. The method comprises a rotating disc type milking device, a control system, a group of RFID antennas, a photoelectric sensor, a group of photoelectric switches, cow occupation sensors and cow labels; the cow occupation detection comprises following steps: 1) RFID fence recognition; 2) RFID fence inlet cow recognition; 3) RFID rotating disc cow recognition; 4) cow occupation detection; 5) photoelectric switch detection. According to the provided cow occupation recognition method based on multiple radio frequency identification device (RFID) antennas, information of the RFID antennas is effectively blended with information of the sensors, and the number of the cows can correspond to the cow gate number of the cows subjected to milking. The problem that the cow number needs to be recorded manually is solved, and the problems of single antenna, low power and poor recall ratio are solved, the final recall ratio and accuracy are high and can reach about 99%.
applicants: LIUZHOU LIUNAN DISTRICT ANSHUN BREEDING ASSOCIATION

title: CUBICLE SHED WITH A CUBICLE MONITORING SYSTEM
