abstract: A cubicle shed (1) with a plurality of cubicles (2) which are filled with litter material (3) comprises a cubicle monitoring system which is configured to monitor a plurality of cubicles for livestock animals in a livestock pen, and which is provided with an aircraft (4) which is autonomously movable along the cubicles, in particular a Zeppelin or drone, which is provided with ia sensor device (5) for observing the contents of the cubicles, a control unit (7) for moving the aircraft at least along a subset of the cubicles, and a processing device (8) which is operatively connected to the sensor device and the control unit for receiving the observation and for processing the observation in order to generate information about a cubicle content status comprising information about an amount and/or distribution and/or quality of the contents of the cubicles. Thus, an image of the cubicle can be obtained in an automated way, so that an individual can take action in a targeted way, instead of having to make a tour of the cubicles beforehand.

title: MULTIFUNCTION LIVESTOCK MEASUREMENT STATION
abstract: A multifunction livestock measurement system provides automatic hip location for animal height (hip height) assessment using a side-looking optical system. An automatic implementation identifies the hip through an analysis of the underside of the hindquarters of the animal. A manual version identifies the hip manually in a similar image. Automatic ear tag reading, weight measurement and animal temperature measurement can be integrated into the station.

title: Robot veterinarian for breeding industry
abstract: A robot veterinarian for the breeding industry comprises a walking mechanism, a hoisting guide rail, a multi-path data collector, a data forwarding device, a battery management unit and a monitor. A robot body is installed at the bottom of the walking mechanism which walks on the hoisting guide rail. The multi-path data collector, the data forwarding device, the battery management unit and the monitor are installed on the robot body. The battery management unit provides power for the walking mechanism, the multi-path data collector, the data forwarding device and the monitor. The battery management unit, a stepping motor driver and the multi-path data collector are in connection communication with a measure and control instrument. The measure and control instrument is connected with a robot veterinarian on-site intelligent monitoring system information platform through WiFi in the monitor. The intelligent comprehensive monitoring of site environment and animal growth and disease state of a livestock farm can be achieved, the management and disease prevention and treatment level of the breeding industry are remarkably improved through the timely service of an internet of things, a cloud storage and an expert system, and the comprehensive economic benefits are increased.
applicants: UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY LIAONING; CHEN HAO; WANG CHUNYAN; WANG JINGXIA

title: Cattle and other veterinary monitoring
abstract: Disclosed are a system, device and process for monitoring physical and physiological features of livestock through a unique monitoring system method and device. Basic and Smart tags are placed on livestock to monitor, among other things, temperature, movement, location, posture, pulse rate, and other physical and physiological features. Information is relayed from Basic tags, in one embodiment, to Smart tags that requests the information and receives the information from the basic tags. Smart tags send information to a mobile unit controller and/or home base so that requested information is sent to an end user that monitors the livestock for signs of illness. Potentially ill animals are segregated from the herd for further evaluation and minimization of exposure risk to the rest of the herd. This early detection system saves livestock and ensures a healthier herd for livestock farmers.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR EVALUATING AN ANIMAL
abstract: The application relates to a method and apparatus for automatically evaluating an animal based on its physical appearance, and in particular, but not exclusively, to a method and apparatus for determining a body condition score (BCS) or lameness, particularly for a dairy cow. The present application is also directed to methods for automatically evaluating a body condition score for cattle. The method preferably involves receiving three dimensional (3D) shape information corresponding to a space occupied by the animal; Creating a 3D point cloud from the 3D shape information; Creating a 3D model based on the shape information; Calculating one or more representative measurements from the 3D model; and Evaluating the animal based on the measurements.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR LIVESTOCK SUPPLY CHAIN COMPLIANCE MONITORING
abstract: This invention relates to the surveillance of livestock, in particular to condition of live animal exports destined for slaughter, and provides method for monitoring treatment meted out to animals in a supply chain on their way to and once at a remotely located abattoir. The apparatus comprises networked system of data capturing devices and controlling computer module to receive data electronically from remote monitoring stations on the supply chain, and process the data to detect and record the location and condition of each animal individually, according to identification tags, such as bearing a microchip on the body of the animal. Each animal may further be equipped with image capturing devices to add to the visual data being gathered and stored in relation to its condition and conditions to which it is subject in processing. The data is made available to bodies such as animal welfare watchdogs and regulators.

title: Intelligent cattle neck yoke device
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent cattle neck yoke device, and relates to the field of intelligent breeding. The intelligent cattle neck yoke device comprises a guardrail, an upper cross rod, a lower cross rod, cattle neck yoke bodies, food troughs and in-vitro radio frequency tags; the cattle neck yoke bodies are arranged between the upper cross rod and the lower cross rod, each cattle neck yoke body comprises a limiting rod, a fixed rod, a sensor, a microprocessor, a wireless signal receiver, a driving motor and a telescopic rod, a rotating shaft is arranged on each fixed rod, each limiting rod is connected with the corresponding fixed rod through the corresponding rotating shaft, the microprocessors are arranged inside the upper cross rod, the sensors are arranged on the lower surface of the upper cross rod, each driving motor drives the corresponding limiting rod through the corresponding telescopic rod, the driving motors and the telescopic rods are arranged on the upper surface of the upper cross rod, and the driving motors, the wireless signal receivers and the sensors are connected with the microprocessors through wires. According to the intelligent cattle neck yoke device, cattle in a farm can be automatically detected and matched, cattle neck yokes are automatically controlled through wireless signals, single locking and group locking can be achieved, intelligent operation is achieved, and the intelligent cattle neck yoke device is worthy of popularization.

title: Intelligent livestock protector
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent livestock protector. The intelligent livestock protector is an intelligent anti-theft protector worn on limbs and trunk of livestock and based on wireless communication, a mobile phone APP and a remote monitor, and is composed of a microcontroller and application equipment associated to the microcontroller, wherein a Beidou or GPS module with a positioning function is used for determining the location of the livestock and tracing stolen livestock; a motion perception sensor and a body temperature-pulse sensor which are associated to the microcontroller are used for confirming health and safety states of the livestock; a high-voltage electric shock unit capable of actively defensing thieves, a warning alarm unit and a self-protection unit which are jointly associated with the microcontroller are used for stimulating the livestock to resist and hindering the crime committing process of the thieves; and through the microcontroller, all the equipment is combined into a comprehensive application system which is associated to the mobile phone APP or the remote monitor through a wireless communication system, and collected information about monitored livestock is synchronously uploaded to the mobile phone APP of a breeder and the remote monitor in real time, so the safety of the livestock is guaranteed.

title: Method and device to detect lameness of a cow
abstract: The present invention relates to a method to automatically detect lameness of a cow, comprising the steps of: - providing position related data, acquired by a data acquisition system, of at least a part of a barrel of a cow kept for a time period within a detection area, - processing, by a processing device, the position related data of the barrel, wherein processing of the data comprises: - determining a position, or a derivative thereof, of one or more reference locations of the barrel on the basis of the position related data, - determining on the basis of the determined position, or the derivative thereof, of the one or more reference locations at least one lameness parameter indicative of the lameness of the cow.

title: Cow body detecting and swarming system
abstract: The invention discloses a cow body detecting and swarming system, and belongs to the technical field of livestock stock detection in the livestock husbandry. The system comprises a control module, a display, an infrared body temperature detector, four weighing sensors corresponding to four cow hoofs, a step counting sensor, an infrared sensor and an odor analyzer, wherein the control module is respectively in signal connection with the infrared body temperature detector, the four weighing sensors, the step counting sensor, the infrared sensor and the odor analyzer; and the control module is connected with the display. The cow body detecting and swarming system can be used for automatically detecting and identifying body and activity conditions of a dairy cow, and automatically swarming.

title: Calf health feeding system
abstract: The invention provides a calf health feeding system which includes a recognition system electrically connected with a controller, a feeding system and a health system. The feeding system is connectedwith a sanitation system, the controller is electrically connected with a communication module, and the communication module is connected with a database and an intelligent terminal. The feeding system includes a weighing sensor, a driving circuit and a temperature sensor. The recognition system includes an infrared ray sensor and an RFID device. The health system includes a weight sensor, a bodytemperature sensor and a cleaning device. The sanitation system includes a sterilization device and a cleaning device. According to the calf health feeding system, the health conditions of calves arechecked at any time in the calf feeding process, the feeding system is disinfected, feeding safety is ensured, healthy growth of the calves is promoted, and economic benefits are brought to farms as quickly as possible.

title: Customer self-operation type pig breeding and sales system
abstract: The invention discloses a customer self-operation type pig breeding and sales system. The system comprises a client, a sales center platform, a breeding management platform, a breeding optimization device and a monitoring terminal; a customer logs in the system through the client and can realize piglet selection through the system, so that the customer can select one or more piglets for his or her own, breeds the piglets according to breeding programs formulated by the customer so as to complete self-management of pig breeding, and completes online payment, and therefore, convenience and quickness can be realized; the system can achieve full-process video monitoring and monitor the information of the growth environment of the piglets, the customer can remotely manage the entire growth process of pigs, and therefore, the safety of the meat of the pigs can be ensured; and specially-assigned people for managing the piglets exist in a farm, pollution-free and green breeding of the piglets can be realized, after breeding is completed, the pigs are sent to a modernized slaughterhouse for slaughtering the pigs, and pork can be rapidly transferred to the house of the customer, so that the fresh taste of the pork product can be ensured.

title: Real-time monitor for sheep weight
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time monitor for a sheep weight. The monitor comprises a fence, a support, a sheep individual recognizer, an electronic monitor and a weighing sensor, etc. The support used to support the fence is disposed in the fence; a feces leakage floor is paved on the support; the weighing sensor is disposed on the feces leakage floor; the sheep individual recognizer is disposed on the outer side of the fence close to a food trough; and the suspended electronic monitor is disposed above a sheepcote. The weighing sensor, the sheep individual recognizer and the electronic monitor are connected to a wireless emitter by wires; and the wireless emitter is connected to a far-end computer host by a wireless network. The monitor disclosed by the invention is characterized in that the sheep weight can be monitored automatically in real time; manpower input can be reduced; and stress brought by weighing to a sheep can be reduced, etc. The support used to support the fence is disposed in the fence; the feces leakage floor is paved on the support; the weighing sensor is disposed on the feces leakage floor; the sheep individual recognizer is disposed on the outer side of the fence close to the food trough; and the suspended electronic monitor is disposed above the sheepcote.
applicants: JIANGSU POLYTECHNIC COLLEGE OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY

title: TEMPERATURE MEASURING APPARATUS AND TEMPERATURE MEASURING METHOD
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a temperature measuring apparatus and temperature measuring method capable of improving precision of measurement of a body temperature of an animal, while reducing stress and labor of a measurer and the animal as a measuring object.SOLUTION: The temperature measuring apparatus includes: a thermography 20 for contactlessly measuring a temperature distribution within a prescribed range; a calibration part 21 having a heat-generating body capable generating heat of a set temperature; and thermistors provided at a plurality of different-temperature positions of the calibration part 21 for measuring temperatures of the respective installation parts. A control part 22 calibrates a first temperature measurement result obtained, by the thermography 20, by measuring a temperature distribution within a range including an eye E of a calf C as an object, on the basis of a temperature difference of the corresponding parts, between a second temperature measurement result obtained, by the thermography 20, by measuring the temperature distribution within a range including the calibration part 21, and a third measurement result obtained, by the thermistor, by measuring the temperature distribution of the calibration part 21.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: WARNING SYSTEM FOR ANIMAL FARROWING OPERATIONS
abstract: A vibratory detector for detecting a vibratory signal from one or more feeders. A processor is in communication with the vibratory detector and configured for determining from at least one characteristic of the vibratory signal a possible action event, and for determining from a pattern of possible action events a likely action event. A warning device is in communication with the processor for providing an output in response to the likely action event. In an embodiment, the at least one characteristic of the vibratory signal can comprise the frequency or magnitude of the vibratory signal.

title: System and method for monitoring pre-natal behaviors of sow
abstract: The invention relates to a system and method for monitoring pre-natal behaviors of a sow. The system comprises a frame body, supersonic ranging nodes and a remote-control central processor, wherein the supersonic ranging nodes are mounted at the top of the frame body and are used for measuring distances from the head, back and tail of the sow to the top of the frame body, and signal output terminals of the supersonic ranging nodes are in wireless connection with the remote-control central processor and are used for sending monitoring data. According to the system and the method, through recognizing behaviors of the sow, including nesting, standing and lying, decisions can be made according to the behaviors of the sow, and warning signals are sent to mobile phones of feeders in case of abnormal conditions.

title: Dairy cattle nutrition supplementing system
abstract: The invention discloses a dairy cattle nutrition supplementing system which comprises a nutrient solution supplementing cabin and an RFID animal ear tag, wherein the RFID animal ear tag is arranged on a dairy cattle body; an RFID animal ear tag signal reader is connected with a controller; the nutrient solution supplementing cabin is connected with a solution supply tube through a solution sucking pump; a solution supply electronic valve is arranged at the outlet end of the solution supply tube; a pressure sensor is arranged on the solution supply electronic valve; the pressure sensor is connected with the solution supply electronic valve and an RFID animal ear tag activator through the controller; a plurality of micro-scale solution supply pumps are further connected with the solution supply tube; each micro-scale solution supply pump is connected with a micro-scale nutrition cabin; the plurality of the micro-scale solution supply pumps are respectively connected with the controller. The dairy cattle nutrition supplementing system has the advantages that when the nutrient solution is supplemented for dairy cattle, nutrition can be supplemented according to different milk production and growth and development periods of the dairy cattle.
applicants: HUBEI Q NEW YOUR ANIMAL HUSBANDRY COMPANY

title: Training-free liquid material feeding station with accurate measurement function and multiple ingestion positions for sow
abstract: The invention provides a training-free liquid material feeding station with an accurate measurement function and multiple ingestion positions for sow. The training-free liquid material feeding station comprises a positioning ingestion system, an intelligent discharge system, an inductive control system and an automatic expelling system. The positioning ingestion system comprises a first fence, a second fence, a third fence, a fourth fence, a fifth fence and a sixth fence; a first ingestion channel is formed by a space between the first fence and the second fence; a second ingestion channel is formed by a space between the second fence and the third fence; a third ingestion channel is formed by a space between the fourth fence and the fifth fence; a fourth ingestion channel is formed by a space between the fifth fence and the sixth fence; the intelligent discharge system is arranged among the first ingestion channel, the second ingestion channel, the third ingestion channel and the fourth ingestion channel; a first trough, a second trough, a third trough and a fourth trough are respectively correspondingly arranged in the various ingestion channels; the various troughs are provided with water outlets and material level detection sensors; the various troughs are connected with water sources by water inlet pipelines.

title: Multifunctional goat cultivating pen
abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional goat cultivating pen, comprising a pen body, an electric door, an electronic weighbridge, a first flexible hoop, a first hoop frame, a first action motor, a first camera, a controller, a server, a far infrared body temperature tester, a feeder slot, a second flexible hoop, a second hoop frame, and a second action motor; the electric door is arranged on the wall body of the pen body, the far infrared body temperature tester is arranged in the middle part of the feeder slot and faced to the electronic weighbridge body; the first camera is arranged on the right wall corner of the inner part of the pen body, the controller and the server are arranged at the inner part of the pen body; the electric door, the electronic weighbridge, the first action motor, the first camera, the server, the far infrared body temperature tester and the second action motor are connected with the controller through the cable. The multifunctional goat cultivating pen is combined with the characteristics of cultivating goat, related facilities are reasonably arranged; through a sensing device, the focus of the goat can be timely found, thus workers can be reminded of treating the goat; moreover, the worker can take the goat with required weight through monitoring, and conveniently catch the goat, and thus the working efficiency is improved.
applicants: ANSHUN PINGBA JIUJIU ECOLOGY AGRICULTURE DEVELOPMENT COMPANY

title: A method, system and apparatus for detecting when an animal is in heat
abstract: A method, system and apparatus for detecting when an animal is in heat and to a method of alerting a responsible individual that the animal is in heat. The method comprises the steps of, using a sensor 5 mounted on a bull, monitoring the activity of the bull in the proximity of the animal. Thereafter, the activity of the bull is analysed before finally it is determined, based on the analysed activity of the bull, whether or not the animal is in heat. The invention shifts the focus from the animal, such as a cow, to the bull and leans on the natural instincts of the bull to determine when the cow is in heat. The sensor preferably forms part of a collar 3. A proximity sensor target 13 is preferably mounted on the target animal 15.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR DETERMINING A PHYSIOLOGICAL CONDITION OF A RUMINANT
abstract: The invention provides a system and a method for determining a physiological condition of a ruminant. The system comprises a sensor unit and a calculating unit. The sensor unit generates a stream of measuring data that are indicative of a movement condition of the ruminant. The calculating unit uses a neural network for calculating a stream of condition data from the stream of measuring data. The condition data indicate a physiological condition of the ruminant.

title: Livestock breeding alarm system
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock barn birth and delivery notification system which can prevent birth and delivery accidents during the birth and delivery of cattle, check the delivery state of the cattle through complex monitoring, and provide accurate birth and delivery information. The livestock barn birth and delivery notification system includes: an attached sensor module which is attached to the tail of a cow; an insert sensor module inserted into the vagina of the cow; and a central processing module which receives pressure values, temperature values, and brightness values from the insert sensor module and the attached sensor module, compares the received values with that in a predetermined data table, and outputs the imminent delivery or an imminent delivery determination result in accordance with the comparison result. The attached sensor module includes: a pressure detection sensor measuring the degree of tail swelling of the cow; an attachment side communication unit which transmits the pressure value of the pressure determination sensor to the central processing module; and an attachment side housing which seals the pressure detection sensor and attachment side communication unit from the outside. The insert sensor module includes: a temperature measuring sensor for temperature measurement; a brightness sensor for measuring the light amount in the surroundings; an insertion side communication unit which transmits the brightness value of the brightness sensor and the temperature sensor of the temperature measuring sensor to the central processing module through the attachment side communication unit as well as transmitting the values to the central processing module directly; and an insertion side housing sealing the temperature measuring sensor, the brightness sensor, and the insertion side communication unit from the outside.

title: Cow electronic nose ring and cow health monitoring system comprising same
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of health monitoring, and discloses a cow electronic nose ring for health monitoring. The cow electronic nose ring comprises a nose ring shell of an open annular structure and at least one temperature sensor arranged at the open end of the nose ring shell and used for collecting the temperature inside the nose of a cow. The cow electronic nose ring further comprises a body temperature data collection unit which is arranged in the nose ring shell, connected with the temperature sensor and used for obtaining body temperature data from the temperature sensor to process and send the body temperature data to a remote server. According to the cow electronic nose ring, the temperature sensor is arranged on the cow electronic nose ring, so that the cow temperature can be accurately monitored, and monitoring precision and reliability are improved. In addition, the cow electronic nose ring is simple in structure and convenient to manufacture and install. The invention further provides a cow health monitoring system comprising the cow electronic nose ring.

title: Method and system for accurate feeding
abstract: The application provides a method and system for accurate feeding. The method comprises following steps: identifying the identification of livestock to be fed, wherein the identification comprises identification information of the livestock; according to the identification information, determining corresponding feeding schemes; detecting storage information of troughs; according to the feeding schemes and the storage information, feeding the livestock. By means of the method, customized feeding schemes can be designed according to specific condition of each livestock, intelligent feeding is realized, labor cost is saved and feeding efficiency is increased.

title: LIVESTOCK MONITORING SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock monitoring system which comprises: a collection device for obtaining image information of a barn, and collecting environmental information of the barn; and a server for analyzing a change in a barn environment, a biological change in a livestock, and a behavior pattern of the livestock based on the image information and the environmental information received from the collection device, and determining an abnormal state of the livestock based on an analysis result.

title: METHOD OF MANAGING DISEASE AND APPARATUSES OPERATING THE SAME
abstract: A method of managing a disease, and apparatuses for operating the same are disclosed. According to an embodiment, the method of managing a disease includes: a step of receiving the biometric information of a cow from a biosensor capsule seated on the stomach of the cow; a step of analyzing the biometric information and determining the health state of the cow based on an analysis result; and a step of transmitting information on the health state of the cow to a user managing the cow. The health state includes at least one of a breeding-related state, a disease state, a methane gas generation state, and the activity state of a rumen for estrus and labor of the cow. It is possible to manage the disease of the cow.

title: Beef cattle oestrus monitoring system
abstract: The invention provides a beef cattle oestrus monitoring system. The beef cattle oestrus monitoring system comprises a detection module, a data processing system, a display module and a communication module, beef cattle oestrus can be monitored in real time by detecting recent temperature and the moving step number of beef cattle, it is avoided that beef cattle cannot be fertilized during oestrus to cause loss, and data during beef cattle oestrus are sent to a mobile phone of a worker in real time so that the worker can judge the fertilization time of the beef cattle in time.

title: Pressure type beef cattle rut detecting system
abstract: The invention provides a pressure type beef cattle rut detecting system which comprises a data processing system, a pressure detecting module, a timer, a display module and a communication module. Information is sent to a worker in real time by detecting the pressure of climbing and striding a rutted cow of a bull and the climbing and striding time and detecting whether beef cattle ruts or not, so that the worker does not miss a rutting period of the beef cattle, and the working amount of the worker is decreased by monitoring the rutting time of the beef cattle and sending the information at different stages.

title: Cool water Sprinkle Apparatus and Method
abstract: A cool water dropping device of the present invention includes: a water dropping module which water drops cool water to the inside a stable; a dry bulb temperature sensor disposed inside the stable to measure dry bulb temperature; a wet bulb temperature sensor disposed inside the stable to measure the wet bulb temperature; and a main controller controlling the operation of the water dropping module by calculating a temperature and humidity index by being interlocked with the water dropping module, the dry bulb temperature sensor and the wet bulb temperature sensor and by using the temperature module and humidity index. According to the present invention, with the temperature and humidity index calculated using the dry bulb temperature and wet bulb temperature, it is possible to automatically drop the cool water on a pregnancy stole or a farrowing crate based on the sow, so that the sow heat stress can be efficiently controlled.

title: CATTLE RAISING MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND PROCESS
abstract: The present invention belongs in the cattle raising field and relates to a cattle raising management system which includes at least one terrain package (1 ) which includes a terrain intercommunication box (8), at least one propagation package (2) which includes a repeater intercommunication box (9) and at least one farm package (3) which includes a farm intercommunication box (10). The terrain intercommunication box (8), the repeater intercommunication box (9), and the farm intercommunication box (10) form a network where each of said boxes can be connected via radio waves to any of the other boxes. The present invention also relates to a cattle raising management process.

title: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: [Problem] To make livestock management more efficient. [Solution] Provided is an information processing device equipped with: a display control unit which controls the display of condition information indicating the condition of livestock; an acquisition unit which acquires work information that is entered on the basis of the condition information and that indicates work relating to the livestock; and an output unit which outputs instruction information for instructing that the work indicated by the work information be performed.

title: ENTRANCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM FOR ANIMAL FARM
abstract: The present invention provides a system for managing entrance of a livestock production facility which issues an electronic key in real time from an integrated management server every time when entrance is made and destroys the electronic key when authentication of the electronic key is completed, thereby being effective in security. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the system for managing entrance of a livestock production facility comprises: an entrance gate for entrance authentication in a livestock production facility; a user terminal performing visit application or reservation of the livestock production facility; and the integrated management server generating the electronic key in response to the visit application or reservation performed by the user terminal, and transmitting the electronic key to the user terminal. The electronic key transmitted to the user terminal is authenticated at the entrance gate, so that the entrance gate is opened. Also, when generating the electronic key, the electronic key and a unique identification code for the user terminal can be matched to the integrated management server.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR THE REAL-TIME DETECTION, CLASSIFICATION AND QUANTIFICATION OF THE FEEDING ACTIVITY OF RUMINANT ANIMALS
abstract: The invention relates to a method for monitoring, quantifying and evaluating grazing and rumination activities based on the detection and quantification of chewing events.
applicants: GIOVANINI, LEONARDO LUIS; UNIVERSIDAD NACIONAL DEL LITORAL; CONSEJO NACIONAL DE INVESTIGACIONES CIENTIFICAS YTECNICAS (CONICET)

title: DEVICE FOR MEASURING THE GASTRIC PRESSURE AND THE GASTRIC MOTILITY OF A LIVESTOCK ANIMAL
abstract: The invention relates to a device for permanently detecting the gastric pressure, the gastric temperature, the gastric motility and the movement of a livestock animal, in particular a ruminant, comprising a, for example, bolus-shaped body (14), said body (14) comprising the following components: a pressure sensor (9), a telemetric device (9) for transmitting measuring values, and a gas-tight interior space (12), wherein a wall of the gas-tight interior space (12) comprises in some regions an elastic material which is deformable by the gastric pressure of a livestock animal, and wherein the pressure sensor (9) is designed to detect the pressure in the gas-tight interior space (12). According to the invention, said device is designed such that it permanently remains in the stomach of the livestock animal when it is applied to the livestock animal.

title: METHOD AND LIGHT ASSEMBLY FOR TRACKING LIVESTOCK INSIDE A BUILDING
abstract: The present invention relates to a method performed by a light assembly (100) of tracking livestock inside of a building for keeping the livestock. The light assembly (100) is arranged above the livestock. The light assembly (100) comprises a light source (10), a camera (12), a controller (14) and a communication interface (16). The method controls (S100) the output of the light source (10) with the controller (14) such that a light condition inside the building is adapted to a diurnal rhythm of the livestock. The camera (12) retrieves (S110) a live view of the livestock in a field of view of the camera (12) and transmits (S120) with the communication interface (16) the retrieved live view of the livestock to a monitoring node (200).

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MONITORING LIVESTOCK INSIDE A BUILDING
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of monitoring livestock inside of a building for keeping the livestock, the method being performed by a monitoring system. The monitoring system comprises a camera (12), a monitoring node (200) and a livestock identity, ID, reader (300), wherein the camera (12) is arranged above the livestock and in communication with the monitoring node (200) and the livestock ID reader (300). The method tracks livestock within a field of view of the camera (12) and sends tracking data, including a first time stamp to the monitoring node (200). The livestock ID reader (300) obtains an identity of the individual of the livestock that is passing the livestock identity reader (300) and sends the obtained identity of the individual, including a second time stamp, to the monitoring node (200). The monitoring node (200) connects the identity of the individual received from the livestock ID reader (300) to tracking data for that individual by using the first and second time stamp.

title: INNER BODY STAY TYPE SENSING APPARATUS FOR LIVESTOCK AND FEEDING SYSTEM USING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention provides a feed supplying system using an in vivo stay type sensing apparatus for livestock, which can automatically mix feeds for livestock and control a feeding amount according to a measurement result of the sensing apparatus which is provided within a body of ruminant livestock, is able to perform wireless charging and data communications, and is able to measure pH, the temperature, heart rate and the number of steps. To this end, the in vivo stay type sensing apparatus comprises: a battery for wireless charging wirelessly charged by a wireless power supply device; a pH sensor measuring pH of stomach of the ruminant livestock; a temperature sensor measuring the temperature of the stomach of the ruminant livestock; a data transmission loop antenna converting the measured pH and temperature into digital values and transmitting the digital values to an external device through wireless communications; and a main body supporting the battery for wireless charging, the pH sensor, the temperature sensor and the data transmission loop antenna.

title: Selenium rich music chicken constant temperature feeding method and automatic control device for constant temperature feeding process
abstract: The invention provides a selenium rich music chicken feeding method and a control system. The feeding method comprises the steps that selenium element substances are casted respectively in a main food zone, a drinking water zone, and a snack zone, so that the music chicken can get the element, when the selenium rich music chicken is eaten by folk, the selenium element can be very well absorbed and digested, so that the health of a human body is promoted, the tissue functions can be improved and various diseases can be prevented. Furthermore, the control system comprises a main control device, an image processing module, a sound output module, a light control module and a constant temperature control module; and the picture screen monitoring, music playing and the on-and-off of lamplight are respectively achieved by the four modules.

title: Dairy cow individual recognition method based on deep convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention provides a dairy cow individual recognition method based on a deep convolutional neural network, and relates to an image recognition method in image data processing. According to the dairy cow individual recognition method, the dairy cow individual can be effectively recognized by extracting characteristics by virtue of a convolutional neural network in deep learning and combining the characteristics with textural features of dairy cows. The dairy cow individual recognition method comprises the following steps: collecting dairy cow data; preprocessing a training set and a test set; designing the convolutional neural network; training the convolutional neural network; generating a recognition model; and recognizing the dairy cow individual by virtue of the recognition model. By virtue of the dairy cow individual recognition method, the defects that an existing algorithm for processing dairy cow images by virtue of an image processing technique is single, the stripe characteristics of the dairy cows are not adequately and well combined with an image processing technique and a mode recognition technique, and therefore, the recognition rate of the daily cows is low are overcome.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING FEEDING OF RUMINATING LIVESTOCK ANIMALS
abstract: Disclosed is a method for controlling feeding of ruminating livestock animals, comprising equipping each animal with a rumination sensor (102), receiving rumination related information from the rumination sensor at a server (104), and using the rumination related information to calculate an optimal feeding time for at least one animal.

title: MULTIFUNCTIONAL INTELLIGENT BREEDING SYSTEM
abstract: A multifunctional intelligent breeding system, which uses functional modules, such as radio frequency ear tags and identification, a central controller (1), an isolation and dislodging device (2), a multifunctional manger (3), an automatic feeding device (4), a quantitative water supply device, automatic manger washing and remaining feed detection, to form a basic automatic feeding unit. The feeding unit can identify the identity and eating information about a pig; for a pig that does not eat during a feeding time period, feed and water are injected into a manger at the same time for precise feeding according to a feed amount and a mixing ratio pre-set by a system; a pig that has eaten up is dislodged in real time; and the manger is automatically washed at the end of feeding. The system realizes automatic and intelligent feeding of the livestock.

title: Milk cow estrus identification system and milk cow estrus identification method
abstract: The invention relates to a milk cow estrus identification system and a milk cow estrus identification method. The milk cow estrus identification system comprises a plurality of milk cow pedometers, a data collecting station and a user-side computer. Each milk cow pedometer, the data collecting station and the user-side computer are connected through wireless communication. Each milk cow pedometer is used for collecting the activity level of each milk cow in real time and sending the activity level to the data collecting station. The data collecting station is used for pre-processing the received data of the milk cow activity level, storing the pre-processed data and sending the pre-processed data to the user-side computer. A milk cow estrus identification module is installed in the user-side computer and is used for obtaining estrus identification results of the milk cows according to the received data of the milk cow activity level and milk cow basic information in a current cattle farm management system. The milk cow estrus identification system can be extensively applied to the estrus identification field of the milk cows, and is used for improving the pregnancy rate of the milk cows, prolonging the lactation period of the milk cows and increasing the milk production, thereby improving the production level and the economic benefit of a cattle farm.

title: System and Method for Dairy Farm Management
abstract: A system and method for animal feed management for a dairy farm, include a feed management server configured to monitor activities of a plurality of entities in a defined area of the dairy farm by a plurality of sensing devices. The monitored activities include at least a free-style grazing activity by a plurality of dairy animals included in the plurality of entities. An amount of milk yielded by each dairy animal of the plurality of dairy animals is estimated based on the monitored activities. A feed composition for each of the plurality of dairy animals is determined based on the determined amount of milk yielded by corresponding dairy animal and the monitored activities. A loading device, which loads a feed container with the determined feed composition for the first dairy animal, is controlled to manage consumption of the feed composition by the first dairy animal.

title: COW HEALTH CARE SYSTEM AND METHOD BASED ON BIG DATA ANALYSIS
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a cow health care system based on big data analysis comprises: an entity sensor inserted into a cow, and detecting sensing data including at least one among a body temperature, an activity, and a position of the cow; a plurality of access points (APs) installed in a space where the cow moves, collecting the sensing data from the entity sensor by performing data communication with the entity sensor through a wireless communication network, and processing the collected sensing data to distribute a load in processing information for the collected sensing data; and a server for analyzing a health state of the cow by receiving the processed sensing data from the plurality of APs, and providing health information of the cow based on an analysis result of the health state.

title: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: [Problem] To make predictions depending on on-site conditions of a livestock farm or the like, and to provide a user with prediction results at the optimum timing. [Solution] An information processing device according to the present embodiment includes an obtaining unit that obtains a plurality of pieces of livestock-farming related information that relate to livestock farming, a prediction unit that predicts a prospective value for an arbitrary parameter relating to livestock farming on the basis of a prediction model generated on the basis of the livestock-farming related information, and a prediction result providing unit that provides a prediction result by the prediction unit at a prescribed timing related to livestock farming. In this configuration, predictions are made depending on on-site conditions of a livestock farm or the like, and a user is provided with prediction results at the optimum timing.

title: HEALTH CONDITION ESTIMATION DEVICE
abstract: Provided is a health condition estimation device capable of accurately estimating the health condition of a cow, the device comprising: a three-dimensional coordinates acquisition unit which acquires a group of three-dimensional coordinates representing the three-dimensional shape of a cow extracted from a distance image of the cow; a feature amount extraction unit which extracts the feature amount of the cow, on the basis of the group of three-dimensional coordinates acquired by the three-dimensional coordinates acquisition unit; and a score calculation unit which calculates a score that indicates the health condition of the cow, on the basis of the feature amount extracted by the feature amount extraction unit. In the present invention, it is preferable: that the feature amount extraction unit extracts the feature amount that indicates the degree of sinking of the rumen on the basis of a group of three-dimensional coordinates in a rumen area, from among groups of three-dimensional coordinates acquired by the three-dimensional coordinates acquisition unit, the rumen area being an area on the body surface of the cow proximal to the rumen; and that the score calculation unit calculates the cow rumen fill score on the basis of the feature amount extracted by the feature amount extraction unit and representing the degree of sinking of the rumen.

title: System and Method for Managing Estrus for Domestic Animals
abstract: A system for managing estrus for a domestic animal includes: a sensor device mounted on a domestic animal and collecting the activity information and temperature and humidity information of the domestic animal; a server for receiving the collected activity information and temperature and humidity information and analyzing the estrous state of the domestic animal; and a user device for outputting the analyzed estrous state information. According to the system and method for managing estrus for a domestic animal, a user can check the estrous state of the domestic animal, and the user can check the accurate estrus timing by checking the estrous state. In addition, since accurate estrus timing is indicated to correct fertility timing so as to increase productivity. In addition, since the estrus timing is automatically determined and informed, a labor force can be saved.

title: Livestock health monitoring system and method of use
abstract: An animal wellness notification system includes an attachment body configured to securely engage with an ear of the animal; an elongated temperature probe secured to the attachment body and configured to extend within the ear of the animal; a housing secured to the attachment body; a computer disposed within the housing and operably associated with the temperature probe; and a notification device in data communication with the computer, the notification device being configured to provide notice if a temperature of the animal goes beyond a determined threshold.
applicants: FULTS, ALVIN, CECIL; FEVERTAGS; CRIDER, JR., RICHARD ARELIN

title: MILK ANALYSER SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: A milk analyser system is provided for detecting the presence of a biomarker, the system comprising: a colorimetric sensor which is arranged to change colour in the presence of a biomarker to be detected; and an optically transparent container which contains the sensor, the container being openable in use to allow milk received by the system to pass over the sensor in order to provide an indication of the biomarker in the milk, any change in colour in the sensor being detectable by viewing the sensor through the container.

title: Detecting system for mounting of cow
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for detecting a mounting action of a cow, the system which can detect a mounting action of a cow by only capturing an image of the inside of a cattle shed, does not require an additional device attached to the cow and an additional sensing device, can minimize detection error and error which may be caused during image processing, and is capable of autonomous learning at the same time. The system for detecting a mounting action of a cow comprises: a camera installed on an upper portion of the cattle shed; and a central processing unit which detects a mounting action of cow based on the image captured by the camera. The central processing unit obtains motion history images (MHIs) for each set frame of images input in real time, obtains a change amount of an area value, a change amount of a center point, and a change amount of inclination from the obtained MHIs, determines that the mounting action was performed when cases that the obtained change amounts of the area value, the center point, and the inclination satisfy a set range are identified at predetermined time intervals, records a date and time of the detection when the mounting action is detected, and transmits the date and the time to a user terminal.

title: INFORMATION PROCESSING SERVER, INFORMATION PROCESSING SYSTEM, AND INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD
abstract: [Problem] To provide an information processing server, an information processing system and an information processing method with which it is possible to manage livestock more appropriately. [Solution] In the present invention, a transmission signal is transmitted from a signal transmission device attached to each livestock and relayed to an information processing server via at least one signal relay devices disposed corresponding to a raising area of the livestock. The transmission signal includes a transmission device identifier which identifies the signal transmission device and a relay device identifier which identifies the signal relay device. This information processing server is provided with: a control unit for determining whether or not the livestock stays in a raising area corresponding to the growth stage thereof on the basis of the relay device identifier and individual information of the livestock corresponding to the transmission device identifier; and a notification information generation unit for generating notification information for controlling notification to an information terminal on the basis of the determination by the control unit.

title: Ecological livestock breeding method and apparatus
abstract: The invention discloses an ecological livestock breeding method and apparatus, and relates to a livestock breeding method and a matched mechanical apparatus. The invention provides an ecological breeding method and designs a related matched mechanical apparatus. Under the condition without enlarging an enterprise overall cultivation area, small fences are canceled, large fences are arranged, an ecological free-ranging mode is imitated, livestock with different ages is placed in the same large fence for mixed breeding, the free range of movement of the livestock is largely extended, the livestock is in a domestic polyculture atmosphere, activities of the livestock are increased, growth curves of the livestock are optimized, and the feed conversion rate index of the cultivation is increased. According to the ecological breeding method, the overall refined breeding level can be improved, and culture benefits are increased. The method and apparatus are suitable for heavy livestock such as pig, cattle, and sheep as main objects, and are suitable for large medium sized breeding enterprises having large breeding places.
applicants: HEBEI UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, INFORMATION PROCESSING SYSTEM, AND INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD
abstract: [Problem] To provide an information processing device, information processing system, and information processing method, which are capable, while viewing a progress of a state quantity which indicates a characteristic change in estrus in a domesticated animal, of assessing the estrus of each individual domesticated animal, and which, when estrus has occurred, are capable of executing a contact with a veterinarian and accumulation of estrus information by an operation which notifies the veterinarian of the onset of estrus. [Solution] Provided is an information processing device, comprising: a display information control unit which causes a display unit of a breeder-side information terminal to display a progress of a state quantity which indicates a characteristic change in estrus of a domesticated animal; and a notification control unit which, according to a notification request, for notifying a veterinarian-side information terminal of estrus of the domesticated animal, which is based on an operation upon the breeder-side information terminal, executes both a notification process upon the veterinarian-side information terminal, and a registration process which registers, in a database as an estrus history of the domesticated animal, time information which indicates the time at which the notification request occurred.

title: Vision system for teat detection
abstract: A system includes a robotic arm, a laser, and a processor. The processor is configured to determine that a teat cup is to be attached to a front teat of a dairy livestock, and in response, determine an amount of separation between the front teat and a rear teat. The processor is further configured to calculate, if the amount of separation between the front and rear teats is greater than or equal to a predetermined distance, an updated front teat position based on the amount of separation between the front and rear teats and command the robotic arm to move to the updated front teat position. The processor is further configure to determine whether the front teat is found in a scan of the dairy livestock by the laser, and if so, command the robotic arm to attach the teat cup to the front teat.

title: Breeding method based on Beidou satellite data transmission
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal breeding, and discloses a breeding method based on Beidou satellite data transmission. The breeding method comprises the following steps that (1) a breeding house is established; (2) environment monitoring data and livestock identity information are written in; (3) weighing: one time of weighing of the livestock wearing marking units is completed through a weighing channel; (4) data transmission and analysis are performed; and (5) information is fed back. According to the breeding method, the live pig growth state and the expected market mature situation in the area can be accurately mastered through big data analysis so that the optimal proportion can be obtained through comparison of the market supply and demand data, and supply and demand relation imbalance caused by blindly and excessively expanding the breeding scale can be avoided. Meanwhile, the growth state can be understood in a detailed way by monitoring the weight of individual animals and timely fed back to the breeding user to suggest that the mature animals can be sold so that the economic benefit of the breeding user can be effectively increased, and the optimal growth environment of the livestock can be analyzed and judged by a central processing module through information comparison.

title: Cultivation system based on Beidou Satellite data transmission
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal cultivation and discloses a cultivation system based on Beidou Satellite data transmission. The system comprises an environment monitoring module, a marking unit, an information collecting module, an information obtaining module and a central processing module. a weighing device is provided with an identification device which is used for identifying information in the marking unit; the environment monitoring module is used for monitoring the growth environment of cultured livestock and sending the detected data signals to the identification device; the weighing device matches and packs the weighing information, the information of the marking unit identified by the identification device, and the growth environment monitored data and then sends the packed data to the central processing module. According to the invention, the system is applied in cultivation farms for information comparison and collection to obtain relative conclusion; through the analysis of big data, the growth condition and expected market slaughter condition in the system can be accurately achieved; through the information comparison by the central processing module, the optimum growth environment of livestock can be obtained by analysis and determination.

title: Culturing system based on Beidou satellite data transmission
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal culturing and discloses a culturing system based on Beidou satellite data transmission. The culturing system based on Beidou satellite data transmission comprises a marking unit, an information collection module, an information acquiring module and a central processing module. A weighing device is equipped with an identification device; the identification device can identify information of the marking unit; the weighing device matches weighing information and information identified by the identifying device and then packs the same to send to the central processing module; and the central processing module compares the received information and then sends the same to a database for storage. Through big data analysis, pig growth states of an area of the system and expected marketing conditions can be precisely mastered, so the optimal proportion can be achieved by comparison of market supply-demand data; imbalanced supply-demand relationship due to blind excessive expansion of culturing scale can be avoided; growth conditions can be well learnt by monitoring of individual livestock weight and can be timely fed back to farmers; and sell fattened stocks are suggested and economic benefits of the farmers can be effectively increased.

title: Breeding method based on Beidou satellite data transmission
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of animal breeding technology and discloses a breeding method based on Beidou satellite data transmission, and the method comprises the following steps: (1) a breeding house is established; (2) livestock identity information is written in; (3) livestock wearing marking unit is weighed once through a weighing channel; (4) data is transmitted and analyzed; (5) the information is fed back. According to the invention, the method can precisely manage pig growing state in a region and prospective market slaughtering condition through big data analysis, so that market supply and demand data is prepared to obtain an optimal proportion, supply and demand relation unbalance caused by blindly and excessively expanding breeding scale is avoided, the growth condition of individual livestock can be clearly known through monitoring the weight of the livestock and can be fed back to a user who feeds the livestock, selling the fattened stock is suggested, and the economic benefit of the user who feeds the livestock can be effectively improved.

title: Cultivating method based on Beidou satellite data transmission
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal cultivating, and discloses a cultivating method based on Beidou satellite data transmission. The cultivating method based on Beidou satellite data transmission comprises the following steps: (1) establishment of a cultivating house; (2) writing of environment monitoring data and livestock identity information; (3) weighing: weighing livestock with mark units through a weighing channel; (4) transmission and analysis of data; and (5) feedback of the information. According to the cultivating method, through big data analysis, growth states of live pigs in the region and the expected market slaughtering condition can be controlled accurately, an optical ratio is obtained by comparison of market supply and demand data, the circumstance that a supply and demand relation is disordered due to blind overexpansion of the cultivation scale is avoided, meanwhile, the growth conditions of the individual livestock can be known in detail by monitoring of the individual livestock, and are fed back to feeding users in time, the livestock is suggested to be slaughtered and sold, the economic benefit of the feeding users can be increased effectively, and meanwhile, by information comparison of a central processing module, an optimum growth environment of the livestock can be obtained by analysis and judgment.

title: APPARATUS FOR CONTROLLING LIVESTOCK BREEDING ENVIRONMENT AND METHOD FOR THE SAME
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is an apparatus for controlling livestock breeding environments, which comprises: a monitoring unit analyzing sensor information and image information and collecting comprehensive housing information; a storage unit storing general housing information; a prediction model development unit analyzing the correlation between the breeding environments of the livestock and breeding results from the information accumulated in the storage unit to develop a breeding result prediction model; a breeding environment setting value determination unit determining a breeding environment setting value optimized for a predetermined breeding mode using the breeding result prediction model; and a breeding environment control unit controlling the breeding environment depending on the determined breeding environment setting value; and a control unit controlling the environment of the livestock. An object of the present invention is to provide the apparatus for controlling the livestock breeding environments, and a control method therefor, wherein the apparatus collects the environment information of a housing, biometric information of the livestock and shipment livestock information, and establishes the breeding result prediction model using an artificial neural network based on the collected information.

title: Pig feeding management system
abstract: The invention provides a pig feeding management system which is composed of an electronic label, a reader, a ZigBee wireless transmission module, an ARM9 development board, a driver, a stepping motor,a relay, a DC motor and a PC. When the electronic label passes, the reader transmits read information to the ZigBee module in an RS485 transmission manner, the ZigBee module communicates with the ARM9, and forwards the received information to a main node of the ZigBee network in the form of a data packet, and a system database receives information from the main node of the Zigbee, and reads information of a present pig; the amount of feeding forage is calculated automatically according to the body condition of the pig, and the ARM9 mainboard controls whether a motor rotates a door open; in aseparating door in the outlet, the system separates pigs which the system determine to be abnormal; and whether the pig eats for the first time is determiend, and whether to open the door to blankingand the blanking frequency, the blanking amount for each time and the total blanking amount are calculated automatically via a calculation method set by the system.

title: Breeding pig abnormal state detection method and device based on PSO-SVM
abstract: The invention discloses a breeding pig abnormal state detection method and device based on PSO-SVM, which can effectively detect suspected sick pigs and precisely recognize breeding pig oestrus behaviors in time, so that the manual observation cost is reduced, and the benefits of a farmer are improved. The method comprises the steps that (1) individual information of breeding pigs is collected, wherein the individual information consists of triaxial acceleration, body temperature and foraging information; (2) a feature matrix is built through the feature extraction of the individual information; (3) on the basis of a prebuilt breeding pig knowledge base, with the feature matrix, whether a breeding pig gets sick or not is judged by a method based on the rules; (4) breeding pig oestrus behaviors are recognized and classified through inputting the feature matrix to a prebuilt breeding pig oestrus behavior recognition model based on a support vector machine, and two outputs of whether oestrus happens or not and oestrus probability are obtained, wherein the parameters of the support vector machine are optimized through a particle swarm optimization when the breeding pig oestrus behavior recognition model is built.

title: Free-ranging-pig monitoring system
abstract: The invention provides a free-ranging-pig monitoring system. The free-ranging-pig monitoring system comprises a monitoring module, a control module, an indicating module, a voice module, a communication module and a remote monitoring center. The monitoring module comprises a positioning unit, a body temperature monitoring unit and a behavior monitoring unit; the monitoring module transfers collected information to the control module, the control module converts monitoring information to transfers the converted monitoring information to the remote monitoring center through the communication module, the remote monitoring center processes the information to send the information to the control module, and the control module controls the indicating module and the voice module. According to the free-ranging-pig monitoring system, real-time monitoring of free-ranging pigs is achieved, monitoring of tracking and the health condition of the free-ranging pigs and analysis of pig behaviors are convenient, and monitoring and management of the free-ranging pigs are convenient.

title: FEEDING DEVICE FOR LIQUID FOR ANIMALS
abstract: The present invention relates to a feeding device for a liquid feed for livestock, which comprises: a housing having a receiving unit for receiving the liquid feed and made of an insulation material blocking outside air; a food supply unit formed at one side of the housing and supplying the liquid feed to the livestock depending on inhalation of the livestock; a food discharge detecting unit for detecting the amount of the liquid feed flowing out through the food supply unit and generating food information; and a control unit for controlling the opening and closing of the food supply unit based on the food information. The present invention relates to the feeding device for the liquid feed for the livestock, which can automatically distribute uniform food to the livestock.

title: Method for monitoring free range pigs
abstract: The invention provides a method for monitoring free range pigs. A monitor camera is arranged on a pig free ranging site and arranged on the main activity area of the pig free ranging site; monitoring devices are arranged on the pigs needing to be monitored, and comprises a power source, a locating device, a body temperature monitoring device, a behavior monitoring device, an indicating lamp device, a central control unit and a remote communication device. According to the method for monitoring the free range pigs, the free range pigs are monitored through the monitoring camera of the free ranging site and the monitoring devices on the pigs, tracking on the free range pigs, monitoring of the health condition and analysis of pig behaviors are convenient, and monitoring management on the free range pigs is convenient.

title: Bionic ewe estrus detection/induction apparatus and estrus detection/induction method
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic ewe estrus detection/induction apparatus and an estrus detection/induction method; the apparatus comprises a ranging sensor, a central processing module, a wireless communication module, a recording device, a biological estrus induction device, an image acquisition device and a power source; the above parts are mounted on a base which is mounted on a wheeled travelling mechanism; in estrus detection/induction, the biological estrus induction device attracts an ewe in estrus, the ranging sensor measures a distance between the ewe and the apparatus, and the recording device records sound made by the ewe; the image acquisition device acquires the signals, such as ewe ear tag number, tail wag images, and pen number, and the central processing module judges whether the ewe is in estrus or not and transmits judging results and measurement information to a farm background management terminal. Estrus detection or induction is performed herein according to the principle of bionics, so that working quality and efficiency are improved; the apparatus and the method are convenient to operate and high in practicality, require reduced numbers of ewes and farm workers, and reduced feed cost, and may be used to induce estrus and comfort ewes during insemination, so that fertility rate and conception rate are increased.

title: Outline Partitioning Method and Apparatus for Segmentation of Touching Pigs
abstract: A method and an apparatus for partitioning an outline to separate adjacent pigs are provided. The method for partitioning an outline to separate adjacent pigs comprises the steps of: acquiring an image by capturing an object group through a camera; extracting a center point using a current frame of the acquired image and a previous frame dividing an outline of adjacent objects; generating time series data indicating a distance to an outline based on the extracted center point; mapping time series data of the current frame onto time series data of the previous frame using dynamic time warping (DTW); mapping color information labeled on the outline of the previous frame to correspond to an outline of the current frame; and determining a boundary line based on a point where a color is distinguished on the outline of the current frame.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MONITORING HEALTH OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a method for monitoring the health of livestock, which includes the steps of: transmitting first health data measured in an ear punch by performing short-range communication between the ear punch worn on a first part of the livestock and an activity meter worn on a second part of the livestock; and transmitting the first health data and second health data measured in the activity meter from the activity meter to a data management server through a gateway by performing long-range communication between the activity meter and the gateway. Accordingly, the present invention can efficiently monitor the health of the livestock without performing the long-range communication in a plurality of sensor nodes.

title: METHOD FOR MONITORING HEALTH OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: The present invention provides a method for monitoring health of livestock which controls a receiving frequency of health data to be changed for each section according to a temperature of livestock and controls the receiving frequency of the health data to increase as the temperature of the livestock increases. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for monitoring health of livestock comprises the following steps of: receiving the health data of the livestock measured for each section from a gateway; and controlling the receiving frequency of the health data to be changed for each section according to the temperature of the livestock calculated based on the health data.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR LOCATING AN OBJECT USING A RECEIVER DEVICE
abstract: The present application relates to a method for locating an animal using a livestock receiver device (104) attached to the animal, comprising steps of (a) associating the livestock receiver device to an animal to define an animal identification, comprising sending a request for the livestock receiver device to read a radio frequency identification tag attached to the animal and to memorise the animal identification contained therein, wherein the livestock receiver device comprises a radio receiver (202) and (b) activating the livestock receiver device by the livestock receiver device itself, to receive a signal for a period of time t r . In this step, if no signal comprising the animal identification is received during the period of time t r , passivating the livestock receiver device, by the livestock receiver device itself; and if a signal comprising the animal identification is received during the period of time t r , executing an action comprised in the signal, by the livestock receiver device. Furthermore, the method comprises a step (c): after a period of time t p , repeating the step (b), wherein the period of time t p is longer than the period of time t r .

title: Position information-based intelligent monitoring method and system for herding sheep
abstract: The invention discloses a position information-based intelligent monitoring method and system for herding sheep. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a current position of sheep and judging whether the current position of the sheep is in a safety place set range or not; when judging that the current position of the sheep is not in the safety place set range, moving a feeding device to the current position of the sheep, feeding the sheep and attracting the sheep to move into the safety set range; obtaining a secondary position of the sheep within preset time after feeding, judging whether the secondary position of the sheep is in the safety place set range or not; and when judging that the secondary position of the sheep is not in the safety place set range and moving the feeding device to send out warning information to a worker.

title: Rumination recognition method based on nosepiece pressure change of ruminant
abstract: The invention discloses a rumination recognition method based on nosepiece pressure change of a ruminant and belongs to the technical field of healthy culture of livestock and poultry. Rumination behaviors can be used for monitoring an estrous period and feeding condition of ruminants (mainly referring to domestic animals such as cattle and sheep) and reflecting physiological health status and the like of the animals. According to the method, a pressure sensor is adopted to acquire pressure signals of a nosepiece of the ruminant, rumination signals, food intake signals and water drinking signals can be preliminarily distinguished according to signal duration and whether the signals have stable frequencies or not, then, the rumination signals are further analyzed, boluses are measured according to peak value intervals of the rumination signals, and changes of the boluses can be used for reflecting health condition of the ruminant. According to the method, through measuring the pressure signals of the nosepiece of the ruminant to monitor rumination, environment noise interference can be effectively lowered, and thus, the accurate recognition and measurement of the rumination behaviors of animal individuals are achieved.

title: Farm livestock raising safety monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a farm livestock raising safety monitoring system. The system is characterized by comprising a terminal, a robot, walking lines and independent sheep cots; the terminal is connected with the robot in a communicated mode; the robot is provided with a vital sign detection device, a moving device, an assessing device and an alarm device, wherein the vital sign detection device is connected with the assessing device in a communicated mode, and the assessing device is connected with the alarm device in a communicated mode; the robot runs to the independent sheep cots through the moving device according to the guidance of the walking lines, and sheep vital sign parameters in the independent sheep cots are obtained through the vital sign detection device; the assessing device conducts a safety assessment on sheep based on the vital sign parameters and preset safe vital sign parameters and judges the safety condition of the sheep; the alarm device is used for sending alarm information when the sheep are in a dangerous condition.

title: Water intake monitoring method based on ruminant animal noseband pressure change
abstract: The invention discloses a water intake monitoring method based on ruminant animal noseband pressure change, and belongs to the technical field of the livestock healthful culture. Water is the necessary nutrient substance for survival of the ruminant animals (mainly comprising a cow, a sheep and so on), and the change of the water intake can indirectly reflect the water quality and the health condition of the ruminant animals. The method comprises the following steps: using a pressure sensor to collect a pressure signal at the noseband of the ruminant animals; according to the signal duration sum which has the stable frequency or not, initially distinguishing a water drinking signal, a foraging signal and a ruminant signal; further analyzing the water drinking signal, wherein each peak value represents one time of water drinking in the waveform of the water drinking activity; and counting the water drinking frequency, and estimating the water intake. The method is capable of, through measuring the pressure signal at the noseband of the ruminant animals, monitoring the water drinking, effectively reducing the environment noise interference, and realizing the accurate identification to the water drinking behavior of the individual animal and the estimation of the water intake.

title: Process and system for tracking and locating livestock using a GPS device.
abstract: The current invention is system and application that can be used to track and locate livestock. The system uses a GPS tracking device that will be placed in the ear tag of the livestock. These devices will show the location of the livestock as well as information about the livestock. This will allow the farmers to keep an eye on their livestock via phone, computer, or laptop screen. The system will use an easy to read screen from a website or phone application that will allow a user to see the movement of the GPS tracking device, whether this be on their phone or computer.

title: A system for application and measurement of poultry
abstract: The present invention relates to a measurement system for variation in water quantity for poultry.
