To this end, in a composition which comprises a water supply pipe (100) and a nipple (110), the measurement system comprises: a flow meter (S1) for measuring consumption of water consumed in the nipple (110); a measurement unit (S2) having a microprocessor; and a communication unit (S4) transmitting a counted data value to a terminal (S5) of a remote user via a wire/wireless communication module (S3).

title: Intelligent monitoring method and system for pig health
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent monitoring method for pig health. The intelligent monitoring method includes the following steps that different IDs are distributed to one or more pigs; the ingestion conditions and movement conditions of one or more pigs are recorded; the IDs of the pigs, the ingestion conditions of the corresponding pigs and the movement conditions of the corresponding pigs are input to a database; threshold values of changes of the ingestion conditions and threshold values of changes of the movement conditions of the pigs are set respectively; data in the database is analyzed, and if collected data changes of the pigs are larger than the threshold values, data of the pigs is subjected to alarm information displaying. The invention also provides a corresponding intelligent monitoring system for pig health. According to the intelligent monitoring method and system for pig health, whether the pigs are ill or not can be analyzed according to the movement conditions, the ingestion conditions, whether coughing is carried out or not of the pigs and the like, it can be achieved that pig disease analysis and monitoring can be incessantly and automatically carried out in a full-week and full-day mode, the production rate of workers is greatly increased, and the labor cost is saved.

title: Farm animal disease early warning system
abstract: The invention discloses a farm animal disease early warning system, and provides a disease early warning system of real-time observation and analysis of farm animals. The system comprises an information collecting part, an information processing part and an information receiving part. The information receiving part is arranged in a livestock captive enclosure, including electronic ear tags arranged on livestock, cameras arranged in the captive enclosure and a feeding recognition system, the information processing part comprises a cloud server which is wirelessly connected with the electronic ear tags, the cameras and the feeding recognition system, and the information receiving part comprises a cell phone and a computer receiving terminal. According to the farm animal disease early warning system, the human consumption is reduced, through a comparison of the data collection by components of the information collecting part and the default reference data, a specific judgment of feeding condition, mental condition and temperature condition of a domestic animal can be made to reflect the physical condition of the domestic animal and send a reminder to achieve the disease early warning, thereby effectively achieving a large scale of livestock disease management by a farmer.
applicants: ZHENGZHOU ZHONGDAO ZHILIAN CLOUD TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Dairy cattle oestrus monitoring method based on ruminating time and activity amount
abstract: The invention discloses a dairy cattle oestrus monitoring method based on ruminating time and activity amount, and belongs to the field of mentoring of signs of animal individuals. If the oestrus of dairy cattle is judged accurately, fertilization of the dairy cattle in time, calving and prolonging of a lactation period are facilitated, and the production efficiency is improved effectively. The oestrus of the dairy cattle is judged by combined monitoring of the ruminating time and the activity amount of the dairy cattle jointly, the oestrus of the dairy cattle is judged initially by the information of the ruminating time and the activity amount at first, namely, when the ruminating time is lower than a set threshold and the activity amount is higher than the threshold, the oestrus is early warned, the specific time of the oestrus of the dairy cattle is further judged by the information of the activity amount, and the oestrus time can be specifically accurate to hour. The oestrus time of the dairy cattle is judged by combination of the ruminating time and the activity amount, the detecting probability can be increased effectively, the oestrus detecting precision is improved, therefore, the dairy cattle is fertilized in time, and therefore, the dairy cattle oestrus monitoring method based on the ruminating time and the activity amount has important guidance significance on actual production.

title: Monitoring and management system for automatic drinking water of pigs
abstract: The invention discloses a monitoring and management system for automatic drinking water of pigs. The system includes a flow meter, a pressure gauge, an electric control valve, an electric pressure-reducing valve, an alarm, a controller, an ear tag, a code scanner, a power supply, a communication converter, a host computer, a displayer, a mouse and a keyboard; the system allows real-time monitoring and regulation of the flow and pressure of water flowing out of a pig-use water dispenser to be conducted on the computer in an office, and can achieve the functions of flow upper limit alarming, flow lower limit alarming, pressure upper limit alarming, pressure lower limit alarming, water shortage alarming, running water alarming, flow regulation, pressure regulation and recording the instantaneous water intake and cumulative water intake of each pig. The pig farm management efficiency is improved, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, the sewage discharge is reduced, the pollution to the environment is reduced, the sewage treatment cost is saved, and the intensive management of large-scale pig farms is achieved.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL SCIENCE AND VETERINARY MEDICINE, SHANDONG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Monitoring system of pig drinker
abstract: The invention discloses a monitoring system of a pig drinker. The monitoring system of the pig drinker comprises a flowmeter, a pressure gauge, an electric regulating valve, an electric pressure-reducing valve, an alarm, a controller, an ear tag, a code scanner and an electric power supply. The monitoring system of the pig drinker can realize a flow upper limit alarm function, a flow lower limit alarm function, a pressure upper limit alarm function, a pressure lower limit alarm function, a water shortage alarm function, a running water alarm function, a flow regulating function, a pressure regulating function, a function of recording the instantaneous water intake of each pig and a function of recording the accumulated water intake of each pig, thereby improving the management efficiency of a pig farm, reducing the labor intensity of staff, reducing the discharge quantity of sewage, reducing environmental pollution, reducing sewage treatment cost, realizing intensive management of a large-scale pig farm, and being convenient, practical, low in cost and favorable for popularization in a wide range.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL SCIENCE AND VETERINARY MEDICINE, SHANDONG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Vaccination system for injection of epidemics of livestock using drone and method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock disease prevention injection system using drones and a method thereof. More specifically, the livestock disease prevention injection system executes operations for injecting nutrients, antibiotics, vaccines, livestock disease prevention substances, and foot-and-mouth disease vaccines for vaccination and health management of cattle and pigs released and raised in the wild grass fields near a domesticated animals farmhouse by recognizing 900MHz radio frequency identification (RFID) tags of beacons arranged on the neck bands of the cattle and pigs, enabling the drones to hover the individual cattle and pigs as high as about 3-7 meters in the sky in a still state by controlling the altitude of the drones and to aim the buttocks of the cattle and pigs before remotely firing the vaccine syringes thereto. By rewinding the syringes by using a roller recovery unit of the drones within a short period of 1-8 seconds, the syringes connected to the drones with wires can be recovered and stored, thereby enabling safe vaccination of cattle and pigs on farms.

title: Device for rapidly detecting muscle development situations of goats or cattle and using method of device
abstract: The invention relates to a device for rapidly detecting muscle development situations of goats or cattle and a using method of the device. A fixed rack is a curved deformable rack and is fixed on a hip of a goat or cattle; one end of the fixed rack is fixed on a pressure sleeve; a cavity of the pressure sleeve is hollow; a non-detection end of the pressure probe extends into the pressure sleeve; the pressure probe is in sealing fit with the pressure sleeve; a detecting end of the pressure probe is positioned outside of the pressure sleeve and is opposite to a free end of the fixed rack; the pressure probe can move along the cavity under the pressure effect of the cavity; a pressure ball is connected with the cavity of the pressure sleeve through a ventilating pipe in a sealed manner; a pressure ball switch valve is arranged on the ventilating pipe; and a pressure gauge which detects pressure, which is fed into the pressure sleeve, of the pressure ball is arranged on the pressure sleeve. The device can be fixed on goats or cattle with different sizes, standard parameters are set according to a slaughtered detecting standard of goat bodies or cattle bodies, and comparison is implemented according to the standard parameters. In the measuring mode, the muscle development situations of the goats or cattle can be rapidly measured without slaughtering the goats or cattle, and the measuring result is standard relatively.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF AGRO-FOOD SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY, SHANDONG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Real-time monitoring system and method for female livestock foaling
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring system and method for female livestock foaling. The system comprises an alarm control unit and a cunnus opening sensing device which are arranged on the two sides of the cunnus of female livestock respectively, wherein the alarm control unit comprises a microcontroller and further comprises a telephone alarm module, a radio frequency module and a magnetic control switch which are connected with the microcontroller, the radio frequency module is in wireless communication with a mobile terminal through a network, and the cunnus opening sensing device comprises a magnetic sensor which is matched with the magnetic control switch and located on the other side, relative to the alarm control unit, of the cunnus of the female livestock. By using the magnetic control sensing device, the public wireless network and the handheld mobile terminal, a midwife can know position information of the expectant female livestock in time, the health of the female livestock is guaranteed, the survival rate of young animals is increased, and then considerable economic benefits are increased.
applicants: SHANDONG DONG'E BLACK HAIR DONKEY ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; DONGE EJIAO COMPANY

title: A cowhouse environment temperature detection system based on a wireless sensor network
abstract: The invention provides a cowhouse environment temperature detection system based on a wireless sensor network which consists of a cowhouse environment parameter collection platform based on a wireless sensor network and a cowhouse environment multi-point temperature fusion model. The cowhouse environment parameter collection platform based on a wireless sensor network is used for cowhouse environment temperature detection, regulation and monitoring. The cowhouse environment multi-point temperature fusion model achieves cowhouse environment multi-point temperature fusion based on a similarity fusion weight, a distance fusion weight and a game theory combination weight calculated from a similarity matrix and a distance matrix of temperature Vague values of temperature sensors of multiple detection points in a cowhouse environment, so that the accuracy, reliability and robustness of cowhouse environment temperature fusion are improved. The system effectively solves the problems that a conventional cowhouse monitoring system does not detect the temperature of a cowhouse environment according to the characteristics such as nonlinearity and large lag of temperature changes of cow environment, large area of cowhouses and complicated temperature changes, so that cowhouse environment temperature detection is greatly influenced.

title: Animal tag system
abstract: Apparatus for managing animals such as but not limited to livestock. In some embodiments, an ear tag assembly has a tag, a backing member and an elongated shaft assembly configured to pierce and extend through an outer ear (auricle) of the animal. A first temperature sensor is disposed within the shaft assembly to obtain an ear temperature measurement of the animal. A second temperature sensor obtains an ambient temperature measurement adjacent the animal. A control circuit accumulates temperature data from the first and second temperature sensors in a tag memory for subsequent transfer, via a wireless communication network, to a data collection unit. Additional sensors may be utilized. In some cases, the backing member may house a battery to power the control circuit. The backing member may be removably attachable to the shaft to allow replacement of the battery.

title: Breeding management method for breast-feeding female rabbit
abstract: The invention discloses a breeding management method for a breast-feeding female rabbit. The breeding management method comprises an investigation module and a breeding management system, wherein the investigation module is a basis of the breeding management system, and the breeding management system is continuously improved through the investigation result of the investigation module, so that growth and development of the breast-feeding female rabbit are ensured. The investigation module comprises a young rabbit manure investigation module, a female rabbit breast examination module and a female rabbit urine investigation module; the good and the bad of the bred breast-feeding female rabbit are intuitively reflected through the manure condition of a young rabbit; the female rabbit breast examination module is used for providing timing regular examination for breasts and nipples of the female rabbit and knowing the lactation condition of the female rabbit; and the breeding management system comprises a young rabbit and female rabbit separation module, and the young rabbit is sent back when needing to be nursed. According to the breeding management method, the lactation condition of the female rabbit can be known and the cold condition of the young rabbit during sucking is reduced; estrus of the female rabbit is mastered and timely mating is achieved; fighting of the female rabbit for food is avoided and the constitution of the female rabbit is strengthened; the infection opportunity of coccidiosis is reduced; and the independent living ability of the young rabbit is cultivated.

title: Livestock tracking anti-theft device
abstract: The invention provides a livestock tracking anti-theft device. The livestock tracking anti-theft device comprises a fixed strap, the fixed strap is provided with a power source component and a solar energy charging control component connected with the power source component, the two ends of the fixed strap are connected and locked through a locking mechanism, so that the fixed strap is in an annular shape, the size of the inner circle of the fixed strap is adjusted through the locking mechanism, the power source component and the solar energy charging control component are symmetrically arranged, and the distances of the two sides between the power source and the solar energy charging control component along the circumference on the fixed strap are the same all the way. In the livestock tracking anti-theft device, the power source component and the solar energy charging control component are arranged separately, and the size of the power source component is reduced; the size of the inner circle of the fixed strap can be adjusted, the fixed strap is applicable to livestock of all age groups of different sizes, and the applicability is improved; the distances of the two sides between the power source and the solar energy charging control component along the circumference on the fixed strap are the same all the way, when the livestock tracking anti-theft device is worn, the solar energy charging control component keeps upward all the time, the illumination time is prolonged, and the photovoltaic conversion efficiency is improved.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA ZHIMU SUYUAN TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT COMPANY

title: Animal intake observation device and animal intake observation method
abstract: The invention discloses an animal intake observation device and an animal intake observation method. The animal intake observation device comprises: an image acquisition unit, which is used for observing an animal intake situation; a mounting seat; a fixed assembly, which is connected with the mounting seat and worn on an animal body for fixing the position of the mounting seat; and an observationrod, which is connected with the mounting seat, wherein the tail end of the observation rod is connected with the image acquisition unit. The animal intake observation device and the animal intake observation method provided by the invention are applicable to grazing of livestock, such as yak, dairy cattle, horses and sheep; the animal intake observation device can move with movement of an animalin a grazing environment, and observes the intake condition of a grazing animal in real time; and the intake observation method can analyze parameters like the palatability of forage, the intake preferring index of an animal, the contribution degree of a plant to daily ration and the availability of the plant to comprehensively, truthfully and accurately reflect the intake habits of grazing livestock, so effective and reliable guidance is provided for subsequent grazing work.
applicants: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY INSTITUTE, TIBET ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY SCIENCES

title: Pig house capable of monitoring respiratory diseases
abstract: The invention discloses a pig house capable of monitoring respiratory diseases. The pig house comprises a roof, wall bodies, and enclosures for breeding live pigs, and also comprises a ventilation system, a disinfection system and a respiratory disease monitoring system, wherein the respiratory disease monitoring system comprises a reminding device, collecting devices worn on the live pigs and information processing devices arranged on the enclosures, wherein each collecting device comprises a voice collecting module and an electricity generating module, and each of the information processing devices comprises a voice preprocessing module, a feature extracting module and a cough recognition module. The technical scheme effectively reduces the data volume for processing and increases the recognition rate so as to effectively decrease the risk that the live pigs are infected with the respiratory diseases in the pig house.

title: Sensing system and method for animal individual feed intake and health condition monitoring
abstract: The invention discloses a sensing system for animal individual feed intake and health condition monitoring. The system comprises an RFID ear identifier identification module, a sensor system, an upper computer, a communication device, and a PC machine. The sensor system comprises an infrared sensor, an animal feed intake measuring module, a body temperature measuring module, and a heart rate measuring module. The animal feed intake measuring module comprises a micro vibration sensor. The body temperature measuring module comprises an infrared temperature sensor. The heart rate measuring module comprises a heart rate sensor. The upper computer is also provided with a micro-storage. A microcontroller is connected with the micro-storage. The micro-storage is connected with the PC machine through the communication device. The system and the method solve problems of real-time online detection of livestock animal feed intake and health conditions, and are suitable for long-term real-time monitoring of multi-class captive-bred animals, and greatly reduce manpower and material resources, and are beneficial for supervising growth processes and health conditions of animals.

title: System for controlling livestock husbandry
abstract: The present invention relates to a shed condition control system intended to improve productivity of livestock accommodated in a plurality of sheds. More specifically, the present invention relates to a shed condition control system for breeding livestock, which is capable of controlling amount of ventilation, humidity, and internal temperature of shed to regulate growth environment of the livestock, and acquires information on each raised livestock wirelessly, and makes comparison and an analysis on acquired data of feed insertion amounts, weight, and the number of days of breed, thereby providing optimized livestock breeding environment.

title: Breeding method of cattle through combination of ultrasonic testing
abstract: The invention discloses a breeding method of cattle through combination of cattle through combination of ultrasonic testing. The method comprises the steps of using an ultrasonic detector to detect a fat distribution situation of cattle in the first day of each breeding period during breeding; when the fat distribution situation in a current breeding period shows that the evenness of fat distribution is poorer than that of fat distribution in the last breeding period, conducting massage treatment on the cattle in the current breeding period, wherein the massage treatment comprises the procedures of adopting a massage hammer to conduct periodic work in a predetermined mode; in each breeding period, after feeding is conducted every day, making the cattle lie still for 30 minutes, and 1-1.5 hours after feeding is conducted, making the cattle move about for 25-45 minutes; binding a passometer on the cattle, wherein the passometer is in communication with one mobile terminal, when the passometer begins to count steps, the mobile terminal does not make a prompt tone, and when the passometer does not count the steps, the mobile terminal makes the prompt tone. According to the breeding method of the cattle through combination of ultrasonic testing, the fat distribution conditions can be improved, the fat is made to be uniformly distributed, and the meat quality is improved.

title: Intelligent pig farm monitoring system based on Internet of things
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent pig farm monitoring system based on the Internet of things, which includes a central processing unit, an intelligent monitoring terminal, a liquid crystal display device and a voice prompting device. The intelligent monitoring terminal, the liquid crystal display device and the voice prompting device are connected with the central processing unit. The intelligent monitoring terminal is connected with an intelligent detection device, an image acquisition device, and detection rings used for detecting the physical condition of pigs. Compared with the prior art, the intelligent detection device and the detection rings are used together, and the environment of the piggery is detected in real time to ensure that pigs live a healthy environment. In addition, each pig wears one detection ring on the neck, and the body temperature, pulse and step number of each pig are detected in real time through the detection ring and compared with the thresholds of a healthy pig to determine whether each pig is healthy. If any pig gets flu, the workers in the pig farm can be reminded in real time so healthy pigs will not be infected. Therefore, the disease prevention and treatment ability is improved, precision feeding is realized, and the benefit of pig feeding is improved.

title: Automated feeding house capable of monitoring body temperatures of pigs
abstract: The invention discloses an automated feeding house capable of monitoring body temperature of pigs. The automated feeding house capable of monitoring body temperature of pigs comprises a house body, wherein a water air conditioner box is mounted on the top of the house body; a water tube is mounted below the water air conditioner box; a supporting column is mounted in the house body; a baffle is mounted beside the supporting column; an infrared sensor is mounted on the inner wall of the house body; a water sprinkler is mounted below the infrared sensor; feeding troughs are mounted on two sides of the bottom surface of the inside of the house body; a control box is mounted on the upper part of the right side of the house body; a display screen is mounted on the surface of the control box; setting buttons are mounted below the display screen, and an alarming loudspeaker is mounted below the setting buttons. According to the automated feeding house capable of monitoring body temperature of pigs, owing to the infrared sensor, abnormal values of the body temperatures of the pigs in the house can be detected, farmers can isolate sick pigs from other pigs in time, infection is prevented, and loss is reduced.
applicants: GUANGXI GUIPING CHANGYUN PLANTATION AND BREEDING COMPANY

title: Sow farrowing stall monitoring and early-warning device, method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a sow farrowing stall monitoring and early-warning device, method and system. The device comprises a sow farrowing stall, a monitoring device, a data transmitting module, a central processing unit and an early-warning device. The sow farrowing stall comprises a sow stall and piglet moving stalls, wherein the piglet moving stalls are located at the two sides of the sow stall; the monitoring device comprises a video monitoring device and a voice recognition device, and is used for monitoring the state of the sow farrowing stall in real time; the data transmitting module is used for transmitting data collected by the monitoring device to the central processing unit in a data server; the central processing unit judges and recognizes the data, and recognizes abnormal images or abnormal audio frequencies; the early-warning device is used for sending early-warning information when the central processing unit recognizes the abnormal images or abnormal audio frequencies to remind a worker to manage in time. Through the sow farrowing stall monitoring and early-warning device, method and system, early-warning can be conducted in real time and in time when piglets are pressed, meanwhile a traditional farrowing stall is effectively utilized, and thus the sow farrowing stall is high in portability and low in cost.

title: A LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND METHOD OF OPERATION
abstract: A system is disclosed for use in a milking facility including a plurality of individual milking stations for milking animals. The system includes at least one performance sensor associated with at least one milking station, configured to output a signal indicative of a sensed performance measure. At least one processor is configured to receive the signal from the at least one performance sensor, determine whether the performance measure is to be associated with an identifier of an individual animal being milked at the milking station, and issue a notification alerting an operator as to which milking station the performance measure was obtained from. The processor is further configured to receive the identifier input into a user device by the operator, and associate the identifier with the performance measure in a database.

title: Intelligent sow feeding station
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of animal feeding, and particularly provides an intelligent sow feeding station. The intelligent sow feeding station comprises a controller, a feeding apparatus connected with the controller by virtue of a circuit, and an ingestion passage leading to the feeding apparatus, wherein a width of an internal space of the ingestion passage can allow a sow to walk but not to turn around, one end of the ingestion passage is provided with a door entry apparatus, and the other end close to the side of the feeding apparatus is provided with a door exit apparatus; and the door entry apparatus comprises a first ear tag identifier, a station entry door and a first electric control telescopic rod controlling the station entry door to be opened and closed, and the ear tag identifier and the first electric control telescopic rod are both connected with the controller by virtue of a circuit. By adopting the intelligent sow feeding station, the situation that the sow occupies the ingestion passage for a long time due to various reasons can be effectively prevented; and meanwhile, sows with high ingestion speed are treated differently, the sows are driven out of the station exit door in advance before a maximum time limit in the case of completing the ingestion, the advantage of the sows with rapid ingestion is sufficiently utilized, and the feeding efficiency is increased.

title: Intelligent pig raising system connected with mobile terminal
abstract: The invention relates to the field of animal feeding and particularly provides an intelligent pig raising system connected with a mobile terminal. The intelligent pig raising system comprises electronic marks on pig bodies, an identity recognition unit, a feeding trough, a control unit, a discharging unit, a trigger unit, a bio-sensor, a data server and the mobile control terminal. The discharging unit, the trigger unit, the bio-sensor, the data server and the mobile control terminal are connected with the control unit. The identity recognition unit reads information of the electronic marks and transmits the information to the control unit. The discharging unit conveys feed and water into the feeding trough. Generation of pig stress behaviors is effectively avoided, pigs can eat the fresh, delicious and proper feed, feed waste and deterioration are not caused, no human intervention is needed in the whole feed intake process, stress reactions of the pigs are reduced, the feeding cost is reduced, and maximization of economic benefits of animal breeding is achieved while the pigs grow healthily and rapidly.

title: Pig exercise amount monitoring system and method based on Bluetooth ear tag
abstract: The invention discloses a pig exercise amount monitoring system based on a Bluetooth ear tag. The system is characterized by comprising the Bluetooth ear tag, a camera, a Bluetooth host, a switch, a server, a client and a PC, wherein the Bluetooth ear tag is suspended on a pig ear and used for collecting pig exercise amount data, and uploading the data to the server by the Bluetooth host via the switch; the camera is used for collecting a pig exercise state, and uploading the state to the server via the switch; and the server is connected with the client and the PC for sending the exercise amount data. The system monitors the pig exercise state in real time all day, with no need for manual duty, the system analyzes the exercise state of a pig, can found abnormal situations and take corresponding measures in time, loss of a breeding plant caused by the abnormal situations is reduced, and work efficiency of poultry feeders is effectively improved.

title: KEEPING SYSTEM FOR SPREAD OF DISEASE FOR POULTRY FARM
abstract: The present invention relates to a disease spread prevention system for a stable, comprising: a body temperature sensing device (200) installed in a housing (40) for sensing a body temperature of the livestock and providing a temperature signal; and a communication unit (60) for transmitting the temperature signal provided from the body temperature sensing device (200) to a controller (30). The body temperature sensing device (200) includes a camera (250) that captures a thermal image and provides body temperature information so that the body temperature of the livestock can be sensed.

title: Intelligent ear tag suitable for free-ranging goats
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent ear tag suitable for free-ranging goats. The tag comprises an ear tag body, a controller, a hear rate monitoring device, a tri-axis accelerometer, a GPS positioning device, a wireless communication module, a storage battery, a temperature sensor, a photovoltaic battery piece, a warning device and a relaxation device for beasts, wherein the controller, the heat rate monitoring device, the tri-axis accelerometer, the GPS positioning device, the wireless communication module and the storage battery are arranged in the ear tag body, and the temperature sensor, the photovoltaic battery piece, the warning device and the relaxation device are arranged on the outer portion of the ear tag body; the temperature sensor is fixedly connected with the ear tag body through a piece of soft belt, the photovoltaic battery piece is a flexible battery piece and wraps the outer surface of the ear tag body, and the warning device and the relaxation device for beasts are fixedly connected with the outer surface of the ear tag body. According to the intelligent ear tag, the heart rate, moving condition and position of the free-ranging goats can be monitored in real time, the goats can be pacified and relaxed in excessive movement, and the situation that the excessive movement influences weight increment is avoided; meanwhile, the outer in-ear temperature sensor can precisely monitor the temperature.

title: ROBOT ASSISTED SURVEILLANCE OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: A system is described for monitoring the welfare of livestock in a shed, said system comprising a plurality of sensors for measuring ambient conditions in the shed; a robot, adapted to move through the shed; said robot comprising at least two cameras, one of which is a thermal camera; a processing engine and a memory operatively associated with the processing engine, the processing engine being operatively associated with the robot and the plurality of sensors for receiving data recorded by the robot and the plurality of sensors, said recorded data comprising measurements of ambient conditions in the shed; and images from said at least two cameras.

title: Toilet for cattle, in particular for cow
abstract: The invention provides a urine collection device for a cow, comprising a positioner, a urine container coupled to said positioner, a sensor for detecting a cow position, a stimulator for stimulating a stimulation region of a cow, which stimulation region is ventrally with respect to a vulva of said cow, and a controller, wherein said controller is functionally coupled to said sensor for in operation receiving a cow position of said cow, and said controller is functionally coupled to said positioner and said stimulator, said controller adapted for controlling said positioner for bringing said stimulator at said stimulation region and for stimulating said stimulation region of said cow in response to a cow position being within a predefined range, which stimulation starts a urination, and controlling said positioner for positioning said urine container from a storage position to a working position for receiving a subsequent flow of urine from said stimulated cow, wherein said urine container comprises a front end for providing at least part of said stimulator.

title: Sheep weight body size automatic measuring system and measuring method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a sheep weight body size automatic measuring system. The sheep weight body size automatic detection system comprises a box body, an inlet door and an outlet door are installed at the two ends of the box body respectively, locating preserving devices are arranged at the two sides of the bottom of the box body, a front neck locating device and a neck clamping door are installed at the side, close to the inlet door, in the box body, a rear rump locating device is installed at the side, close to the inlet door, of the box body, a body length measuring device, a body height measuring device and a chest width measuring device are further installed in the box body, and a weighing device is installed at the bottom of the box body; an integrated control device and an air cylinder control cabinet are installed at the upper end of the box body, the integrated control device comprises a PLC, an electronic ear tag reading device and an upper PC, and the PLC is in communication with the body length measuring device, the body height measuring device, the chest width measuring device, the electronic ear tag reading device the upper PC. The sheep weight body size automatic measuring system can improve the insufficiency of the prior art, achieve full-automatic measurement of the live sheep body size, and is precise in measurement data.
applicants: HEBEI INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY

title: Method for monitoring livestock breeding living body weight based on internet of things
abstract: The invention discloses a method for monitoring livestock breeding living body weight based on the internet of things. The method comprises: a camera and a sensor collecting data, when data collectionis completed, transmitting the data to a single board computer, the single board computer integrating the data, and transmitting the integrated data to a C/S terminal of a local terminal to perform next-step processing; on the local terminal C/S, firstly performing living body identification on acquired RGB images, combined with depth point cloud data of a depth camera, deducing a 3D point cloudimage, meanwhile uploading RGB and 3D point cloud images, and individual information of living bodies and environment variable collected by the sensor to a cloud server; the cloud server cleaning anddenoising the 3D point cloud images according to the uploaded individual information and environment variable, after the 3D point cloud images reach a standard, restoring volume to obtain living bodyvolume, and calculating mass; returning an obtained living body mass result to the C/S terminal, if objection for error of mass exists, correcting errors by hand, after error correction, recording anduploading to the cloud server.

title: Livestock management method based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock management method based on the Internet of Things. The method comprises the following steps: (1) mounting a detection device on the neck and/or ear and/or tail of the livestock; (2) obtaining livestock growth data information obtained by the detection device, wherein the growth data information comprises a body temperature, an activity time, a heart rate and a pH value; (3) performing variable screening on the growth data information, and performing make indexes being dimensionless; (4) performing clustering analysis by using a spectral clustering method to judge the growth stage type of the livestock; and (5) selecting and calling a solution corresponding to the step (4), and outputting a data information result and the solution to a user terminal for display and check. The growth stages of the livestock are counted and analyzed by using the big data Internet of Things means, thereby providing data support with scientific explanation for the farmers (i.e. users), which does not takes time and effort like the traditional farming methods, but also makes the analysis results be more scientific.

title: Milk cow wearable device and farming management system and method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a milk cow wearable device and a farming management system and method thereof. The milk cow wearable device comprises wearable device bodies capable of collecting physical sign information of milk cows, a milk cow farming management cloud server used for recording archives of the milk cows, receiving and storing movement, body temperature, chewing number and heart rate provided by the wearable device bodies equipped for the milk cows and calculating curves along with time, of movement steps, body temperature, average chewing number and heart rate, and a movable handheld unit used for receiving and displaying an operation instrument of the cloud server, receiving input field information and uploading the same to the milk cow farming management cloud server, and the milk cow related archives are updated through the milk cow farming management cloud server. Property superiorities of the wearable device bodies and the handhold movable unit are combined, automatic and scientific management of large farms is realized, and high reliability and operability are achieved.

title: Bovine estrus disclosure method based on activity monitoring
abstract: The invention discloses a bovine estrus disclosure method based on activity monitoring. The method comprises the following steps that 1, according to a period t, the bovine activity is obtained periodically; 2, according to the whole bovine estrus period, a long-term calculation period T1 is set, an activity expected value A1 and a mean square error D in the period t within the period T1 is calculated in a rolled mode; 3, according to the every bovine estrus duration time, a short-term calculation period Ts is set, and the activity expected value As in the period t within the period Ts is calculated in a rolling mode; 4, the deviation k between the long-term activity expected value and the short-term activity expected value As is calculated; 5, by comparing the deviation k with the estrus disclosure threshold value K, the bovine estrus is judged. The method is simple in algorithm and high in disclosure accuracy and can adjust the parameters according to experience.
applicants: YANG XUSHENG; WAN CHANGGENG; WANG JUN

title: Sheep-herding apparatus
abstract: The invention relates to a sheep-herding apparatus, comprising a helmet type body, a controller, a panoramic camera, a GPS positioning device, a driving device and a guiding device; the helmet type body is arranged to be worn by a sheep, and the helmet type body is provided with an elastic strap; the controller is disposed on the helmet body and is in communication connection with a remote host computer; the panoramic camera is disposed on the helmet type body and electrically connected to the controller; the GPS positioning device is disposed in the helmet type body and electrically connectedto the controller for positioning a geographical position of the sheep wearing the sheep-herding apparatus; the driving device is disposed at the helmet type body and electrically connected with thecontroller for driving the sheep wearing the sheep-herding apparatus; and the guiding device is disposed at the helmet type body and electrically connected to the controller for guiding the travel direction of the sheep wearing the sheep-herding apparatus.
applicants: MINQING JINSHA DALONGWAN ECO FARM COMPANY

title: Cattle illness data analysis method and device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a cattle illness data analysis method and device. The method concretely comprises the following steps: obtaining state index data representing cattle health states; selecting sample data, performing sample training of selected sample data according to an initialized cost matrix based on illness classification in advance and a multi-classification Bayesian process classifier based on cost sensibility, and obtaining the illness classification model of training samples; and according to the obtained state index data, the cost matrix and the training model, calculating the illness classification probability of the cattle to be detected and outputting the illness classification probability of the cattle to be detected. The method provided by the embodiment of the invention provides a cost-sensitive multi-classification Bayesian and Gaussian process to process the calculation of the illness classification probability of cattle, perform calculation of the state index states of the cattle and output a plurality of illness classification probabilities, and misjudgement cost factors are added to overcome the defects that a current discriminating method only can obtain general low misjudgement rate and only can output single classification results.

title: Specific wavelength light control device capable of improving synchronous estrus efficiency of rabbits, cats and martens and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a specific wavelength light control device capable of improving synchronous estrus efficiency of fur-bearing animals like rabbits, cats and martens and a control method thereof. The device comprises a specific wavelength light source and a light source controller, the light source controller comprises an intelligent dynamic time relay, a light intensity sensor and a PLC(programmable logic controller) processor, the specific wavelength light source is mounted above the middle of a shed for the fur-bearing animals like the rabbits, the cats and the martens, to-be-mated cages are arranged on two sides in the shed for the fur-bearing animals like the rabbits, the cats and the martens, and the light source controller is arranged on one side of a wall; the control device further comprises ear tag radio frequency recognizers, one ear tag radio frequency recognizer is mounted on one ear of each fur-bearing animal, and signals of the ear tag radio frequency recognizers are transmitted to the PLC processor. By the specific wavelength light control device and the control method, a specific wavelength light source can be emitted dynamically in a needed time period, light-sensitive characteristics of the fur-bearing animals like the rabbits, the cats and the martens can be utilized to induce synchronous estrus of the fur-bearing animals like the rabbits, the cats and the martens, tolerant effect on the fur-bearing animals like the rabbits, the cats and the martens by using exogenous hormones is eliminated, and labor input and production cost are lowered remarkably.

title: Live pig breeding system and breeding method based on interactive traceable system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock breeding, in particular to a live pig breeding system and a live pig breeding method based on an interactive traceable system. The live pig breeding system comprises a live pig information monitoring system, a live pig information acquisition terminal, a cloud server and a live pig information release terminal, the live pig information monitoring system is wirelessly connected with the live pig information acquisition terminal, the cloud server is mutually connected with the live pig information acquisition terminal, and the information release terminal is connected on the cloud server. The information monitoring system is provided with a communication module, and short-range control of the communication module in the information monitoring system and the information release terminal are achieved in a WIFI (wireless fidelity) or Bluetooth manner. According to the system, relevant information in live pig breeding can be effectively acquired by the aid of the information monitoring system, data are timely released, data sharing is achieved by the aid of the cloud server to form big data flow, real-time monitoring can be performed by breeding managers, and great decisions are timely made according to live pig breeding management.

title: An electronic temperature measuring ear tag and a livestock body temperature accurate measuring method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of animal body temperature detection and provides an electronic temperature measuring ear tag and a livestock body temperature accurate measuring method. The electronic temperature measuring ear tag comprises an ear tag body provided with a circuit board and a battery; the ear tag body comprises an ear tag head matching an ear tag fixer; the ear tag body is provided with at least two temperature probes on the same side as the ear tag fixer; the circuit board is provided with AD sampling units which are connected with the temperature probes separately; each AD sampling unit is electrically connected with a master control unit which controls the temperature probes to collect the body temperature of livestock synchronously and periodically; the master control unit is electrically connected with a storage unit used for storing collected body temperature data; the storage unit is electrically connected with a wireless communication unit which reads stored body temperature data and sends data periodically. With at least two temperature probes, the problem is solved that obtained temperature values are low because contact points are not attached to the surfaces of ears within a short time during movement of livestock in a temperature measuring period, and the accuracy of temperature measurement data is improved.

title: Breeding boar performance measurement station and system
abstract: The invention discloses a breeding boar performance measurement station and system. The station comprises a weight weighing device, an automatic discharge device, a feeding weighing device and a controller. The automatic discharge device comprises a material storage box, an auger discharger arranged below the material storage box, and a motor connected with the auger discharger. The motor is connected with the controller. The feeding weighing device comprises a trough arranged below the automatic discharge device, and a first weighing sensor arranged on the trough. The first weighing sensor is connected with the controller and used for collecting weight information of feed in the trough. The end, close to the outlet of the auger discharger, of the trough is provided with a feed port, and the other end is provided with a feeding opening. The weight weighing device is close to the feeding opening of the trough and used for collecting weight information of boars when the boars eat. The feed intake and weight data of the boars can be freely obtained when the boars eat and used for obtaining breeding boar performance measurement data through analysis, and thus the measurement boars with outstanding production performance can be screened out.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL SCIENCES, CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Novel method for monitoring ovulation time of fox
abstract: The present invention relates to a novel method for identifying the estrus condition of a fox and determining the ovulation time. The method uses a special endoscope to observe the changes of the cervix protrusion surface to determine the different estrus periods of the fox. Compared with the previous estrus identification method, the method is direct and accurate, does not require continuous observation to judge whether the estrus stage is the most productive estrus period and to determine the ovulation time, and provides a basis for determining the accurate insemination time. The method canalso make it relatively easy to determine whether the fox has passed the ovulation period and whether the fox has inflammation and abnormal morphological structure so as to provide reliable basis fordeciding whether to eliminate the female fox in time and saving one year's raising cost. When the fox is in the oestrum and ovulation stage, the uterine cervix protrudes and enlarges, there are many small round protrusions on the surface that differentiate and form like mulberry fruits, and the surface is covered with a thin keratinized epithelium layer, and when the white keratinized layer beginsto fall off till it is completely detached, the surface shows a pinkish white color, which indicates that the fox just finishes laying eggs, and this time can be used as the best artificial insemination time.

title: Livestock group raising automated weighing device
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock group raising automated weighing device. The device comprises multiple pig weighing platforms, a feed weighing feed tower and a master computer, the pig weighing platforms and the feed weighing feed tower are all connected to the master computer through connecting wires, the master computer is further externally connected to a speaker, a weighing instrument set, a control cabinet and an interchanger, the weighing instrument set and the control cabinet are both matched with the pig weighing platforms and the feed weighing feed tower, and each pig weighing platform comprises a platform, platform support legs, platform sheaths, platform pressure induction meters and a platform base. The livestock group raising automated weighing device can calculate the weight change and feeding amount of pigs, and monitor weight data of the pigs in real time in 24 hours, weighing equipment is waterproof, thus the platforms and the feed tower can be washed freely, the platforms and the feed tower are reasonable in structure design, weighing data is sent to a cloud server to be subjected to analysis and report form processing, and the formula proportion of feed can be guided according to a feed formula and change data of pig weights.

title: Automatic monitoring platform for feeding of dairy cows
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic monitoring platform for feeding of dairy cows. The automatic monitoring platform comprises a feeding trough used for containing fodder and a cow neck shelf locatedat one side of the feeding trough, a feeding port for the heads of the dairy cows to horizontally enter and exit from is formed in the cow neck shelf, and the monitoring platform comprises a controlsystem, a detection unit, a driving assembly and a baffle; the detection unit is used for recognizing whether or not the dairy cows entering the feeding port are dairy cows needing feeding; if yes, the detection unit feeds a signal back to the control system, the control systems feeds the signal back to the driving assembly and drives the baffle to moves downwards through the driving assembly, andthe dairy cows can lower their heads for feeding; if not, the detection unit does not feed back any signal. By means of the automatic monitoring platform, the workload of manual labor is reduced; meanwhile, the detection precision when there are many dairy cows is ensured, the physical conditions of the dairy cows are timely known according to data feedback of the monitoring platform, and the formula of the fodder is timely adjusted according to data feedback of the monitoring platform.
applicants: SHANGHAI CHEUNGHUNG AGRICULTURE-HUSBANDRY MECHANICAL EQUIPMENT COMPANY

title: Livestock specification management system based on livestock knowledge information
abstract: The present invention relates to a raising management system which generates various kinds of information for raising livestock based on biological and behavior characteristic information of the livestock, environment information inside a livestock shed, and standardized livestock knowledge information, and immediately detects an abnormal state of the livestock so that a user can efficiently raise the livestock. According to the present invention, a livestock raising management system based on livestock knowledge information comprises: one or more individual information collection units collecting current location and state information of livestock in real time or periodically to transmit the information to the outside; one or more livestock shed information collection units collecting environment information inside a livestock shed in real time or periodically to transmit the information to the outside; a raising management information generation unit generating raising management schedule information for raising the livestock based on livestock information about birth, pregnancy, and delivery of the livestock, and life period information in accordance with a period after the birth, the pregnancy, and the delivery; an information storage unit storing the current location and state information, the environment information, the livestock information, the life period information, the raising management schedule information, and abnormal state recognition information for recognizing the abnormal state of the livestock; an abnormal state information generation unit generating and transmitting the abnormal state information of the livestock to the outside based on the current location and state information, the environment information, and the abnormal state recognition information of the livestock; and one or more user terminals capable of inquiring the abnormal state information.
applicants: TURBO SOFT COMPANY; SEOWON UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF INDUSTRY-ACADEMY COLLABORATION

title: Differential diagnosis method for tuberculin intradermal allergy-positive cows
abstract: The invention relates to a differential diagnosis method for tuberculin intradermal allergy-positive cows, in particular to a differential diagnosis method for tuberculin intradermal allergy-positivecows that were last monitored for more than 6 months. It is characterized by the detection method of the Diagnostic Technology of Animal Tuberculosis (GB/T18645-2002). Detection (referred to as ''first monitoring'') is carried out to cows that were last monitored for more than 6 months, and the cows with positive tuberculosis are kept in isolation. A second monitoring is performed within one weekfrom the day of Observation of Skin Thickness Difference at 72 hours after the first monitoring and intradermal injection of tuberculin, and it was found that about 10% of the cows were negative for tuberculosis. A third monitoring is performed at another 45 days' interval and the cows are confirmed to be negative for tuberculosis. The invention reduces the misjudgment and mistake kill rate of tuberculin intradermal allergy test positive cows by about 10%, reduces the losses of dairy farming companies (fields and households) to a minimum and saves financial killing subsidies and working expenses. It is a supplement, improvement and promotion of the Diagnostic Technology of Animal Tuberculosis (GB/T 18645-2002).

title: Method and system for identifying estrus of sows
abstract: The invention discloses a method and system for identifying estrus of sows. The method comprises the following steps: collecting a body temperature and exercise amount data of a sow in real time by anintelligent ear tag, and uploading the data to a management terminal through an intelligent gateway; when the sow eats in a feeding trough, uploading the received body temperature and exercise amountdata sent by the intelligent ear tag to the management terminal by the intelligent gateway at the feeding trough, and meanwhile, recording a residence time of the intelligent ear tag in the feeding trough area and uploading the residence time to the management terminal by the intelligent gateway, and analyzing the eating amount of the sow according to the residence time by the management terminal; and analyzing the received data by the management terminal, and when the body temperature data, the exercise amount data and the eating amount data corresponding to a certain sow meet specific indexes, judging that the sow is in an estrus period and notifying a staff to check. According to the invention, whether a sow is in the estrus period can be judged by analyzing the body temperature, the exercise amount and the eating amount of the sow, and estrus sows can be found in time, so that the breeding rate is improved.
applicants: ZHEJIANG LIERDA INTERNET OF THINGS TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Sow estrus detection method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a sow estrus detection method and system. The method includes the following steps that an intelligent ear tag collects the body temperature and exercise data of a sow in real time and the data is uploaded to a management terminal through an intelligent gateway; when the sow takes foods from a food trough, the intelligent gateway at the food trough uploads the received datasent by the intelligent ear tag to the management terminal, and at the same time, the intelligent gateway records the residence time of the intelligent ear tag in the food trough area and uploads it to the management terminal and the management terminal analyzes the sow's food intake and eating frequency according to the residence time; the management terminal analyzes the received data, and whenthe corresponding body temperature, amount of exercise, food intake and feeding frequency of the sow meet specific indexes, the management terminal judges that the sow is in the estrus period and informs staff. The method can determine whether the sow is in the estrus period by analyzing the sow's body temperature, amount of exercise, food intake and feeding frequency so that the sow in the estrusperiod can be found in time and the breeding rate can be improved.
applicants: ZHEJIANG LIERDA INTERNET OF THINGS TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Livestock monitoring method, computer program, storage medium and electronic device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a livestock monitoring method, a computer program, a storage medium and an electronic device. The livestock monitoring method comprises the following steps: obtaining a video frame sequence of a scene of a livestock rearing area corresponding to a predetermined statistical time period; performing livestock tracking on target livestock occurring in the videoframe sequence by using a neural network model suitable for livestock tracking; obtaining the activity time length of the target livestock in a specified activity area in the livestock rearing area,and determining the activity amount of the activity corresponding to the specified activity area of the target livestock according to the activity time length. By adoption of the technical scheme of the invention, the activity amount of the specified activity of the target livestock can be accurately monitored so as to effectively monitor the of the target livestock, which is conducive to performing optimized rearing on the of the target livestock.

title: Early warning device, server and system for ewe parturition
abstract: The invention discloses an early warning device, server and system for ewe parturition. The early warning device for the ewe parturition includes an acceleration sensor used for collecting an acceleration value; a vibration sensor used for collecting a vibration quantity value; a processor used for sending the acceleration value collected by the acceleration sensor and the vibration quantity valuecollected by the vibration sensor to a wireless communication module; and the wireless communication module used for sending the received data to the server through a wireless manner. According to the technical scheme, the behavior information of ewes before parturition is obtained in real time through the early warning device for the ewe parturition and the information is uploaded to the early warning server for the ewe parturition, the early warning server for the ewe parturition sends the information of the ewes about to give birth to an intelligent terminal through intelligent analysis, thereby solving the problems of a low survival rate of lambs as well as time and energy consumption of nursing of sheep farmers caused by a traditional judgment method for the ewe parturition time, thetime of the sheep farmers for taking care of the pregnant ewes is saved, the labor costs of the sheep farmers are reduced, and the survival rate of the lambs is improved.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA MUYE XINGUANG INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR BIOMETIC IDENTIFICATION OF DAIRY OF ANIMALS USING VEIN PATTERN RECOGNITION
abstract: A method (200) for identifying a dairy animal, the method (200) comprising the steps of: providing an identification system (100) comprising an imaging device (20) and a database (42) of stored vein patterns; obtaining at least one image of at least a portion of an udder (12) of the dairy animal; extracting a vein pattern from the at least one image; comparing the extracted vein pattern to the database (42) of stored vein patterns; and identifying, based on said comparison, the dairy animal in the database (42) of stored vein patterns.

title: ANIMAL HEALTH CONDITION MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND MANAGEMENT METHOD
abstract: To provide an animal health condition management system and management method capable of managing an animal health condition while reducing stress and labor for a person who manages an animal health condition, and an animal to be measured.SOLUTION: In a management system 1, a temperature measuring unit 3 for measuring a temperature distribution in a predetermined range in a non-contact manner is provided to a feeding unit 2, and a processing device 4 includes an extraction part 30 for extracting a correlation temperature correlated to a body temperature of a calf C from a thermal image captured with a thermography camera 20 of the temperature measuring unit 3, and a management part 32 for managing a health condition of the calf C from the extracted correlation temperature. When the calf C suckles, the thermal image is captured with the thermography camera 20. The correlation temperature on the temperature of the calf C is extracted from the thermal image, and based on the correlation temperature, the health condition is managed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Control System, Method and Computer Program for a Milking Machine
abstract: An automatic milking machine is controlled (Ctrl) by a control unit in accordance with control commands and/or parameter settings produced via a local user interface fixedly arranged at the milking machine, or received via a communication interface from a remote user terminal (161, 162). In response to a control request (CR1) from a first remote user terminal (161), which control request (CR1 ) indicates an intention to initiate transmission of control commands and/or parameter settings (CMD1) from the first remote user terminal (161), the control unit checks if at least one control command and/or parameter setting (CMD2) from a second remote user terminal (162) has been received in the communication interface within a particular interval (P) preceding a point in time (t3) when the control request (CR1 ) was received. If so, the control unit returns status data (SD2) to the first remote user terminal (161), which status data (SD2) indicate an identity (ID) of the second remote user terminal (162). Based thereon, an operator of the first remote user terminal (161) may decide whether or not he/she should proceed to remote control the milking machine at the present point in time.

title: Monitoring method of livestock epidemic diseases
abstract: The invention discloses a monitoring method of livestock epidemic diseases. The monitoring system used by the method comprises a limiting feeding colony house, a detection system comprising an RFID reader-writer and an infrared sensor, a control system comprising a PLC controller and a PLC data display screen, and a moving system comprising a linear motor, a telescopic rod and a motor controller.The monitoring process comprises the following steps: (1) collecting body surface temperature data of healthy livestock; (2) selecting a temperature data of a time period A with the lowest average temperature value; (3) collecting the body surface temperature data of the livestock with the epidemic disease symptoms in the time period A; and (4) setting an abnormal-state parameter table according to the data of the process (2) and the process (3). According to the invention, the body temperature of a single individual can be accurately monitored in a large-scale livestock group, and the occurrence of large-scale epidemic situation can be effectively prevented.
applicants: LUSHAN KELONG FARMING AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title: HOLDER FOR A SMART MONITORING TAG FOR COWS
abstract: The present invention provides a quick release monitoring tag holder attached to cow's neck by a collar, comprising a first slot and a second slot configured for accommodating said collar therein; and a recess, provided in between said slots, configured for accommodating an identification tag having an upper portion and relatively smaller bottom portion, which is at least partially accommodated within said recess.

title: Pasture animal tracking and supervision system
abstract: The invention provides a pasture animal tracking and supervision system, and belongs to the field of animal supervision systems. The pasture animal tracking and supervision system comprises RFID radiofrequency electronic ear tags, an RFID reader-writer module, a video monitoring module, a data server module, a microcontroller module and a PC-side management module. The RFID radio frequency electronic ear tags are wirelessly connected with the RFID reader-writer module. The output end of the RFID reader-writer module is connected with the microcontroller module. The video monitoring module isconnected with the microcontroller module. The data server module is connected with the microcontroller module. The PC-side management module is connected with the microcontroller module. The RFID reader-writer module is equipped with at least one RFID reader-writer. The video monitoring module is equipped with at least one camera. The RFID radio frequency electronic ear tag is adopted in the system, so that users can monitor the activity condition and health condition of each animal in a pasture in real time. The problem that the existing pasture animal supervision system cannot monitor the growing condition of an individual animal in real time is solved.

title: Smart system for detecting the estrus of livestock
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for detecting estrus of livestock and, more particularly, to a smart system for detecting estrus of livestock to increase income of farm household. According to the present invention, by building a database using diverse information detected, it is possible to accurately detect whether a cow has entered estrus and a progress thereof.

title: Real-time online monitoring system based on LoRaWAN for biological features of livestock
abstract: The invention utilizes an LoRaWAN technique which is based on internet of things and suitable for the agricultural field, and combines biological sensors to collect basic biological parameters and other relative data of livestock. All the livestock wear neck rings designed specifically, each neck ring is internally provided with a biological sensor module capable of collecting the heart rate, temperature, acceleration speed, location, biological impedance and other features, and each sensor module sends data including the heartbeat, body temperature, step number, time ratio of sanding to lying and the like of the livestock to an internet cloud server through an LoRa gateway at certain time intervals. The server end conducts real-time analysis on big data and compares the big data with biological parameters of healthy livestock at the same age, and when the server end finds out an abnormal biological tendency, breeders are notified in time so that the server end can provide a real-time accurate state checking approach for the breeding process. The power consumption of the LoRaWAN sensors can be extremely low, and the real-time online monitoring system based on the LoRaWAN for the biological features of the livestock can promote standardized and large-scale development of agricultural culture, and meanwhile provide technical support for safety, traceability and value of meat products.
applicants: JIANGSU POLYTECHNIC COLLEGE OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY

title: METHOD FOR DETECTING THE RUMINAL MOTILITY OF FARM ANIMALS
abstract: Method for detecting the ruminal motility of farm animals, which comprises: a step for applying an accelerometer (1) at the fossa of one side of a ruminant animal; a step for detecting a time series of acceleration measurements (Xa, Ya, Za), carried out by means of the accelerometer (1); a step for discrimination in order to obtain, from the aforesaid acceleration measurements (Xa, Ya, Za), a selection group of such acceleration measurements (Xa, Ya, Za) detected in a first time interval (Tl) and indicative of a first behavior condition of the animal, such as a decubitus condition of the animal; a step for processing the acceleration measurements (Xa, Ya, Za) detected in the aforesaid first time interval (Tl), which calculates corresponding parameters of ruminal motility (PM) indicative of the detection of ruminal contractions of the animal.

title: System for performing diagnosis of domestic animal
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock group treatment prevention diagnosis system. The system includes: a biometric sensor part installed on livestock to collect biometric information of the livestock; an environment sensor part installed on a farming facility to collect environment information of the farming facility; a sensor unit including a communication module transmitting diagnosis information including environment information and biometric information through a communication network; a control server receiving the diagnosis information transmitted through the communication module; a receiving part receiving the diagnosis information through communication with the control server; and a manager terminal including an information output part outputting the diagnosis information received from the receiving part to enable a manager to determine whether the livestock and environment are normal. According to the present invention, the system is capable of increasing the accuracy of diagnosis by diagnosing environmental information about an environment around livestock as well as biometric information of the livestock through the sensor unit. Moreover, according to the present invention, the information obtained through the sensor unit is stored in a database part and the stored information is learned to determine whether an abnormal situation occurs around livestock, and then, the determination information is transmitted to a manager or livestock diagnosis institution, and thus, the diagnosis system is capable of easily managing a large number of livestock.

title: Whipping device of service boar running machine
abstract: The invention discloses a whipping device of a service boar running machine. The whipping device comprises annular conveying belts, an RFID chip and a pedometer, a pig house is arranged on the inner side of each annular conveying belt, fences are arranged on the two sides of each annular conveying belt, doors are arranged on the fences, infrared sensors are arranged at the tops of the doors and disposed on the fences, PLCs are arranged on one sides of the fences, sliding rails are arranged at the tops of the fences, and whipping carts are arranged at the tops of the sliding rails. According tothe whipping device, by the arrangement of the annular conveying belts, pigs can run by multiple circles, and the occupied area can be reduced; when the pigs run, pig feed containing essence is placed in feed storage tanks, and the pigs can be attracted by the pig feed to run ahead; besides, by the arrangement of a sound device, pig driving voice can be conveniently played to drive the pigs; moreover, when an RFID reader-writer reads that some pigs leave behind, information is sent to the PLCs, and the PLCs control whipping device bodies to whip the pigs to make the pigs run. The whole deviceis simple in structure, small in occupied area and capable of saving cost.

title: MECHANIZED INSTALLATION FOR CONTACTLESS THERMAL IMAGING VIDEO-DIGITAL DIAGNOSTICS OF ANIMAL DISEASES
abstract: FIELD: agriculture.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to agriculture, in particular livestock, and is intended for identification and diagnosis of diseases of cows and horses. Mechanized installation for contactless thermal imaging video-digital diagnostics of animal diseases contains a machine for fixing animals and a contactless thermal imaging device connected to the control unit. Thermal imaging device is made in the form of two thermal imagers. First thermal imager is fixed by means of a slide on a movable vertical guide, the upper end of which is rigidly fixed to the slide, moving along the horizontal guide, located outside and along the lathe for fixing animals, with the possibility of vertical and horizontal displacement. Second imager is installed on the opposite side of the machine to fix the animal and is located on a movable mobile rod with hinges, fixed by means of a slider on a horizontal guide located outside and along the lathe for fixing, with the possibility of performing thermal imaging both on the side of the animal, and under the belly or udder of the animal. In this case, the second thermal imager moves freely sideways and down under the belly or udder of the animal, and the first thermal imager performs thermal imaging of fragments of the trunk and head from the opposite side of the animal. According to these thermal imaging images in the control unit in the software package of the information system, a comparative analysis of the animal's state is made based on the laid-in basic program of measurements and statistical processing in the interface to identify and diagnose the physiological state of the animal. Then, the unlocking signal is sent to the gate of the machine, directing the animal into the box or into the veterinary unit.EFFECT: invention makes it possible to quickly and accurately carry out thermal images of the whole body of the cow and its parts, which significantly improves and speeds up the identification and diagnosis of signs of pathology in cows.1 cl, 2 dwg
applicants: FEDERALNOE GOSUDARSTVENNOE BYUDZHETNOE NAUCHNOE UCHREZHDENIE 'FEDERALNYJ NAUCHNYJ AGROINZHENERNYJ TSENTR VIM' (FGBNU FNATS VIM)

title: Anti-theft safe feeding pen for domesticated pigs
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of livestock breeding, and discloses an anti-theft safe feeding pen for domesticated pigs. The pen comprises a wall, a ceiling and an excrement storage device, wherein the upper end of the ceiling is electrically connected with solar cell panels.
