According to the pen, a heat dissipation fan is arranged at the upper end in the ceiling; through detectionof a temperature sensor, once the external temperature reaches a set value, a microcontroller controls the heat dissipation fan to work; an anti-collision sensor is arranged on the inner wall of the ceiling, and once the ceiling suffers from violent impact and the collision force exceeds a set value of the anti-collision sensor, the microcontroller controls an alarm device to give an alarm; a decibel meter is arranged on the inner wall of the ceiling, and if a thief steals the pigs, the pigs make a sound, and once the sound reaches the set value, the microcontroller controls the alarm device to give an alarm; an inclined plate is arranged at the bottom of the wall, and excrement can be discharged into the excrement storage device through an inlet by means of a water pipe; meanwhile, the excrement can be used for fertilizing.

title: Abnormal signs monitoring system and method based on food intake of livestock
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and method for monitoring abnormal signs based on feed intake of livestock to manage abnormal signs of each livestock. The system comprises: a plurality of frames (100) for individual feeding guidance; a plurality of feedboxes (200); an individual feed supply member (300); an AP (400); and a livestock management server (500).

title: FEED INSPECTION EQUIPMENT OF HERBIVORES
abstract: The present invention relates to a feed intake inspection apparatus for big livestock, and more specifically, to a feed intake inspection apparatus for big livestock, having a sensor for sensing big livestock, whose position is connected to an opening of an opening/closing plate, not only to easily recognize an object and but also to easily control intake. The feed intake inspection apparatus for big livestock comprises: a gate body having an inlet/outlet through which a head of big livestock can enter; an opening/closing plate for opening/closing the inlet/outlet; an opening/closing plate opening means including a cylinder for opening the opening/closing plate; a cylinder position adjustment means for adjusting a position to which the cylinder is fixed; an RFID reader fixed to the opening/closing plate to recognize information of a tag attached to a body of big livestock and storing unique information; sensor modules installed at left and right sides of the inlet/outlet of the gate body to sense entrance and exit of big livestock; a feed tank located on a rear surface of the gate body and including a support frame for supporting a feeding container capable of storing feed therein from both sides; and a load cell installed between the support frame and the feeding container and measuring the weight of the feeding container, wherein the opening/closing plate opening means includes a cylinder which has a rod moving forward and backward and is vertically installed on one side of the gate body, a link bar which has one end fixed to the rod of the cylinder and horizontally extends from the rod to fix the opening/closing plate, and sensor module cases which are fixed to both surfaces of the opening/closing plate, respectively, and in which a transmission unit and a reception unit of the sensor modules are embedded, respectively.

title: Radio frequency ear tag for pigs in large-scale farm
abstract: The invention discloses a radio frequency ear tag for pigs in a large-scale farm. The radio frequency ear tag comprises an ear tag base body, a processor and a power supply. The processor and the power supply are connected and both arranged in the ear tag base body. The ear tag base body comprises a main tag and an auxiliary tag. Two ear tag necks are arranged on the main tag. Buffering mechanismsare arranged at the joints of the ear tag necks and the main tag. A metal needle is arranged in each ear tag needle and connected with a magnetic lock catch device in the auxiliary tag. The magneticlock catch device is connected with the power supply. The processor is arranged in the main tag and connected with an acceleration sensor, a temperature sensor, an ammonia gas sensor and a carbon dioxide sensor. The processor is connected with an RFID tag and a breathing light. By detecting the activity conditions and feeding conditions of the pigs and the temperature and growth environment, the storage of the daily routine and living environment is realized, the ear tag has a fault breathe alarm function, the pigs can be comprehensively observed and detected by people conveniently, operationis simple, and the automatic detection, storage and sending of data are realized.

title: Livestock health management system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock health management system comprising a monitoring device, a local terminal, a server and a backstage management terminal; the monitoring device is used for sending monitoring information to the server; the server is used for storing the received monitoring information and calculating the information, obtaining the livestock health condition management information, and returning the livestock health condition management information to the local terminal; the local terminal is used for storing and the displaying the livestock health condition management information; the monitoring device communicates with the local terminal; the local terminal communicates with the server; the server communicates with the backstage management terminal; a livestock health management method comprises the following steps: S1, using the monitoring device to gather the livestock health monitoring information, and sending the monitoring information to the server; S2, using the server to receive and store the monitoring information, and calculating the information so as to obtain the livestock health condition management information; S3, using the server to send the livestock health condition management information to the local terminal.

title: Apparatus for monitoring ruminant stomach of cattle and method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a device and a method for analyzing the activity of livestock by collecting motion data from a sensor device inserted into ruminant stomachs of the livestock and monitoring livestock health and disease management information by using the activity information. According to the present invention, the device for monitoring the activity of livestock by using a sensor device inserted into ruminant stomachs of the livestock by means of oral administration comprises: a data sensing unit for receiving sensing data including the motion data of ruminant stomachs from the sensor device; an activity analysis unit for analyzing the intake activity, the rumination activity, and the rest activity by using the received sensing data; and a monitoring unit for storing analyzed activity information and providing information on the health and disease of the livestock for which activity information is not analyzed so as to monitor the same.

title: Apparatus for monitoring location and behavior of cattle and method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a device and a method for determining the activity of livestock by collecting a neck motion and a position of the livestock, and monitoring health and disease management information on the livestock using activity information. According to the present invention, the device for analyzing and monitoring sensing data collected by a sensor device for sensing a neck motion of livestock comprises: a livestock data sensing unit for receiving neck motion data and position data sensed by a sensing device; a behavior analyzing unit for analyzing a feeding behavior and a resting behavior using the received neck motion data; a pen position mapping unit for mapping the received position data with pre-stored pen position information; an activity determination unit for determining the mapped position information on livestock, that the feeding behavior is analyzed, as a feeding activity if the position information is a feed zone in the pen, determining the same as a water drinking activity if the position information is a water drinking zone in the pen, and determining the resting behavior as a resting activity; and a monitoring unit for storing the determined activity information on feeding, water drinking, and resting, and providing livestock health and disease information corresponding to the stored information to monitor the same.

title: Method and system for monitoring livestock
abstract: A system for monitoring livestock in a ranching environment. The system includes tag sensors attached to animals, and configured to collect monitoring data from the animals, a first access point, configured to receive the collected monitoring data from the tag sensors and to process the collected monitoring data, an Internet of Things (IoT) link established between each of the tag sensors and the access point, and an IoT communication protocol overlay that enables synchronized uplinks from the tag sensors to the first access point via the IoT links. The IoT communication protocol overlay governs transmissions of monitoring data by the tag sensors to the access point. The system further includes a hub/cloud platform configured to receive the processed monitoring data from the first access point, perform data analytics on the processed monitoring data, and provide a user interface that enables a user to monitor the livestock.

title: Internet of things-based intelligent system and method for intensive healthy breeding of pigs
abstract: The invention discloses an internet of things-based intelligent system and method for intensive healthy breeding of pigs. The system includes a pig fine feeding subsystem and a multi-parameter measuring controlling subsystem for an pig house environment, wherein on the one hand, the pig fine feeding subsystem detects the pigs through ear tags, begins to weigh the pigs, and sends the information and weight information of the pigs to a remote host computer, the host computer is used for controlling opening and closing of a front door and a rear door of a weighing module according to the information so as to ensure that only one pig is weighted at a time, and meanwhile the host computer is used for controlling an automatic feeder to perform feeding according to the weight information and thelast feeding amount; the multi-parameter monitoring controlling subsystem for the pig house environment utilizes a sensor set to detect environmental parameters, realizes local display of the data through a liquid crystal display screen on the one hand, and sends the environmental parameters to the remote host computer on the other hand; the host computer displays the data in real time and storesthe data, and simultaneously controls an on-site fan and a wet curtain to work so as to adjust on-site environmental conditions. According to the internet of things-based intelligent system and methodfor intensive healthy breeding of the pigs, the remote host computer is utilized to perform monitoring in real time, and a GPRS network is adopted to realize long-distance transmission of the data, so that interference from other external equipment is reduced.

title: Pig raising box capable of preventing diseases
abstract: The invention discloses a pig raising box capable of preventing diseases. The pig raising box comprises a box body, a mobile door is rotatably connected with the left side of the box body, a temperature sensor is fixedly connected to the right side of the movable door, a humidity sensor is fixedly connected to the top of the inner wall of the box body, and an electronic drying box is connected tothe bottom of the right side of the box body through a bolt; a first high-definition camera is connected to the left side of the top of the inner wall of the box body through a bolt, a second high-definition camera is connected to the right side of the top of the inner wall of the box body through a bolt, a data collector is connected to the right side of the inner wall of the box body through a bolt, and a processor is fixedly connected to the top of the box body. According to the pig raising box capable of preventing the diseases, through cooperation of the first high-definition camera, thesecond high-definition camera, the processor, a voice reminder, a loudspeaker, thermometers and heart rate sensors, the problems are solved that through existing methods, the physical health situations of piglets cannot be detected, and prevention or treatment measures cannot be taken for the diseased piglets in time, so that the survival rate of the piglets is low.

title: Ear tag having informatization and body temperature monitoring functions
abstract: The invention discloses an ear tag having informatization and body temperature monitoring functions. The ear tag includes a primary tag body and a secondary tag body; an ear tag neck is fixedly arranged on one side of the ear tag; an infrared temperature measurement device and a GPS positioning module are arranged on an upper part and a lower part of one end of the ear tag neck respectively, can conveniently perform temperature measurement and positioning on a pig, can timely detect a temperature value and a position of the pig, and can prevent the pig from being lost; an ear tag head is fixedly arranged on one end of the ear tag neck; the secondary tag body is arranged on one side of the primary tag body; a volatile insect-expelling bag is arranged an inner top of the secondary tag body,can prevent mosquitoes from biting the pig, and can prevent diseases; through holes are evenly distributed in the top of the secondary tag body; an ear locking fastener is fixedly arranged on one sideof the secondary tag body; an indicating lamp and a lighting lamp are arranged on one side of the bottom of the secondary tag body; a medical gauze layer is arranged in the ear tag neck; and an anti-inflammation layer is arranged in an inner side of the medical gauze layer, and can disinfect the pig so as to prevent diseases. The ear tag is simple in structure, can timely monitor pig information,can ensure growth of the pig, and can improve the safety for consumers.
applicants: HUIZHOU INTERNET OF THINGS MICROELECTRONIC COMPANY

title: A METHOD FOR CUSTOMIZED MONITORING OF SOUNDS CAUSED BY RESPIRATORY DISTRESS
abstract: The invention relates to a method for customized monitoring of sounds caused by respiratory distress in a group of farm animals in a specific farm, stable, or section of a stable, a non-transitory processor readable medium having stored thereon processor executable instructions configured to cause a processor to perform the method according to the invention, a computing device to carry out the method according to the invention, and a kit of parts for carrying out each of the inventive method comprising such a computing device and at least one microphone.

title: METHOD FOR PREDICTING A SPECIFIC RESPIRATORY PATHOGEN
abstract: The invention relates to a method carried out by a processor for predicting a specific respiratory pathogen in a group of farm animals, which method comprises monitoring the sounds generated by said farm animals.

title: Method for conducting early warning of cow rutting by detecting temperature of vagina of cow
abstract: The invention relates to a method for conducting early warning of cow rutting by detecting the temperature of the vagina of a cow. The method comprises the steps of continuously detecting the temperature of the vagina of the cow, recording the temperature change, and conducting early warning of cow rutting when the temperature of the random time point is raised to be 0.3 DEG C higher than the temperature average value of the same time point of the first 7 days. Through multiple times of exploration and verification, the temperature change rule of the vagina when the cow ruts is revealed, on this basis, a temperature change threshold value of cow rutting is judged, a cow rutting identification technology is originally developed, and automated monitoring of cow rutting is achieved. Despite partial false positive situations, no false negative situations occur, which shows that through the threshold value, all rutting cows can be identified, and the economic loss of a cattle farm cannot becaused. It is shown that the temperature threshold value has an ideal detecting result in detecting cow rutting, and has high application value.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL SCIENCES, CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Internet-of-things milk production livestock monitoring system for saline-alkali land animal husbandry
abstract: The invention discloses an internet-of-things milk production livestock monitoring system for saline-alkali land animal husbandry. The system comprises a livestock main monitor, leg rings, electroniccodes and electronic scanning codes, livestock secondary monitors and pedometers are correspondingly packaged in the leg rings, and the livestock secondary monitors are in signal connection with the livestock main monitor through a communication device. The system further comprises temperature sensors, heart rate sensors, milk production metering devices and metering input devices, and the metering input devices are connected to the milk production metering devices and the livestock secondary monitors respectively. The milk production metering devices and the metering input devices can meter milk produced by each livestock so that breeding personnel can know the milk production condition of each livestock conveniently; once the milk yield of a certain livestock is greatly changed, it indicates that the livestock has a healthy problem, and the breeding personnel can quickly take corresponding measures for barrier nursing to prevent bacterial infection; the pedometers, the temperature sensors and the heart rate sensors can comprehensively monitor the livestock so as to facilitate nursing.

title: Device for preventing piglets from being squeezed and working method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a device for preventing piglets from being squeezed and a working method thereof. The device comprises a pig-chasing rod, a pig-chasing rod drive device, a mounting plate and atotal control box; the mounting plate is fixed to the upper end of a pigsty, the pig-chasing rod drive device and the total control box are fixed on the surface of the mounting plate, a pickup is arranged in the overall control box, and the pig-chasing rod drive device is connected with the pig-chasing rod. The device for preventing the piglets from being squeezed and the working method thereof collect audio in the pigsty and identify the audio by means of the total control box when the piglets scream out after being squeezed, and the total control box controls the pig-chasing rod to swing andknock and uses a low-voltage slight electric shock to chase away sows when the audio in the pigsty containing the screaming audio of the piglets is detected, thereby reducing the death rate of the piglets squeezed by the sows in a farrowing house, avoiding economic losses of breeders and improving benefits of pig farm breeding.

title: Intelligent grazing system and monitoring method thereof
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent grazing system, which comprises a background management system, a grazing terminal and a client terminal. The grazing terminal is worn on a livestock body, and the client terminal is in signal connection with the background management system. A grazing terminal network is formed by the grazing terminal in a networking mode. The grazing terminal network is connected with the background management system through network communication. The grazing terminal network comprises a data processing unit, a data transceiving unit and a positioning unit, wherein the data transceiving unit and the positioning unit are connected with the data processing unit. The data transceiving unit comprises a ground base station communication unit used for carrying out data transmission in the GPRS (general packet radio service) communication mode and a satellite communication unit used for carrying out data transmission in the satellite communication mode. The invention further provides a monitoring method for the intelligent grazing. According to the method, the herds can be monitored remotely in real time. The system and the method are particularly suitable for monitoring the herds in the unmanned area, so that the grazing of the herds can be effectively managed. As a result, the real-time remote monitoring and the management of the herds can be effectively and reliably realized. The herdsmen can control the herds at a distal end and the property loss of herdsmen is avoided.
applicants: GUANGZHOU QIZHI COMMUNICATION SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Sensor module for collecting biometric information of livestock and method for calibrating temperature using the sensor module
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a sensor module for collecting biometric information of livestock, comprising a contact type first temperature sensor for measuring skin temperature by making contact with the skin of livestock; a non-contact type second temperature sensor for measuring the skin temperature of livestock in a non-contact manner; a third temperature sensor for measuring the ambient temperature of the livestock; and a data processing unit. The data processing unit calculates an estimated body temperature of the livestock, based on a first skin temperature measured by the first temperature sensor, a second skin temperature measured by the second temperature sensor, and an outdoor temperature measured by the third temperature sensor.

title: Dairy cattle breeding method
abstract: The invention relates to a dairy cattle breeding method which comprises: carrying out division feeding according to the statistic value of each of the cattle and the weight information of each cattleacquired. Conveying the feed to a feeding groove by using an automatic conveying belt; the feeding is conveyed by using an automatic conveyor belt, which is driven by a motor, to a feeding groove. Forthe motor, the higher position of the bottom barrier device is provided with a bottom and a rotary support. In addition, the external hoop of the motor is provided with an iron core of the cable andthe high-power rotary shell is arranged in the iron core with the cable. The lower part of the high-power rotary shell is connected with the rotary support at the bottom part, the top part is providedwith a fixedly connected supporting plate at the higher position of the rotary support and the higher position of the fixedly connected supporting plate is provided with a connecting part. The problem that the damage caused by traction in a lower direction is caused and that the motor device cannot be fixed and cannot adapt to the operation requirement of the manufacturing industry in the prior art is avoided.

title: POULTRY FARM MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention relates to a poultry farm management system installed in a poultry farm having any one of a humidifier, a cold air blower, and an external window. According to the present invention, the poultry farm management system comprises: an LED lighting unit comprising a plurality of LEDs for outputting light supplied to the poultry farm; a temperature sensor for measuring a temperature in the poultry farm; a humidity sensor for measuring a humidity in the poultry farm; a control unit for receiving temperature information and humidity information transmitted from the humidity sensor, and controlling a lighting time of the LED lighting unit; and a server connected to the control unit to provide temperature or humidity information of the poultry farm to a user, and storing temperature and humidity information and lighting time information of the LED lighting unit.

title: Intelligent device and Internet traceability system for modern animal husbandry
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent animal husbandry, and specifically relates to an intelligent device and Internet traceability system for modern animal husbandry. The systemincludes a monitoring center, locating collars, a building, and a pasture located on the periphery of the building; a control host and a wireless transceiver module connected with the control host are arranged in a control room; communication columns are arranged on the pasture around the building, and a boundary line with a feedback function is established through all the communication columns.When there is a sheep crossing the boundary line, feedback can be sent to the monitoring center in real time; the locating collars can locate sheep in real time, and at the same time facilitate observing the daily activities of each sheep; monitoring components, temperature control components and humidity control components are arranged in sheep pens, straw sheds, drinking houses and feeding roomsto monitor the active status of the sheep in real time and at the same time ensure that the flock of sheep has a good living environment.

title: FARROWING SYSTEM WITH PIGLET BIRTH DETECTION AND METHOD FOR OPERATING THE SAME
abstract: A farrowing system comprising: a farrowing pen adapted to receive a sow; a feed dispenser adapted to dispense feed to the sow received in the farrowing pen according to a first feeding pattern; at least one heating element providing heat to a portion of the farrowing pen; a birth detection sensor for detecting a birth of a piglet from the sow; and a controller operatively connected to the birth sensor, to the feed dispenser and to the at least one heating element for switching from the first feeding pattern to a second feeding pattern and for activating the at least one heating element upon detection of the birth. There is also provided a method for operating a farrowing system and a method for dispensing feed to a farrowing sow.

title: Livestock pregnancy monitoring system and monitoring method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock pregnancy monitoring system and a monitoring method thereof. The system comprises a first cultivation region, a second cultivation region, an RFID label, a step counting sensor, a first heart rate sensor, a data monitoring center, a controller, an HCG sensor, a weight sensor and a wireless communication module. The step counting sensor and the first heart ratesensor are fixedly arranged at legs of livestock, and the step counting sensor and the first heart rate sensor collect step number and heart rate information of the livestock and transmit the information to the data monitoring center through the RFID label. The HCG sensor and a second heart rate sensor arranged inside the second cultivation region collect livestock urine and fetus heartbeat information respectively, and transmit the information to the data monitoring center through the controller and the wireless communication module to monitor whether or not the livestock is pregnant or not.The system does not dependent on human experience, is high in reliability and automatic degree, can find that the livestock is pregnant as soon as possible, ensures the safety of a mother and a fetusand improves the farm yield.

title: System and method of measuring livestock weight
abstract: A system and a method of weighing livestock are disclosed. A system of weighing livestock according to the present invention comprises a measuring plate; a load cell for measuring the weight applied to the measuring plate as the two forefeet of livestock are placed on the measuring plate; an angle sensor for measuring the tilt angle of the measuring plate; and an information processing apparatus. At the time, the information processing apparatus acquires the instantaneous weight measured by the load cell when the tilted angle of the measuring plate reaches the threshold, and the instantaneous weight is multiplied by a predetermined correction factor to approximate the actual weight of the livestock.

title: A LIVESTOCK ANIMAL MONITORING DEVICE
abstract: A livestock animal monitoring device (1) has a temperature probe stem (3) for insertion in an ear canal (EC), and including a thermistor temperature sensor (54). At its other end the device (1) has a stud (40, 48) fastener for attachment to an animal's ear lobe tissue. A housing (2) is connected between the fastener and the probe stem (3) so that the device is retained by the fastener on ear lobe tissue and insertion of the probe stem in an animal ear canal in use. The housing contains a signal processing circuit (57) connected to the temperature sensor (54) and a wireless communication circuit (57) linked to the signal processing circuit for wireless upload of temperature data to a host. The fastener (40, 48) is connected to the housing (2) by an adjustable longitudinal support (5) which sets distance between the fastener and the probe stem, to suit the animal.

title: Smart pig farm monitoring system
abstract: The invention provides a smart pig farm monitoring system. The monitoring system includes a water supply device, a food supply device and a processing module; the water supply device includes a plurality of water supply units, wherein the water supply units are respectively arranged in pigsties in a pig farm and are used for collecting the drinking water data of pigs to be tested, the identity information of the pigs to be tested, and pigsty identifiers; the food supply device includes a plurality of food supply units, wherein the food supply units are respectively arranged in the pigsties inthe pig farm and are used for collecting the dietary data of the pigs to be tested, the identity information of the pigs to be tested, and the pig identifiers; and the processing module is connected with the water supply device and the food supply device and is used for obtaining pre-stored bred pig reference data according to the pigsty identifiers, comparing the drinking water data of the pigs to be tested and the dietary data of the pigs to be tested with the drinking water reference value of the corresponding pigs to be tested and the dietary reference value of the corresponding pigs to betested in the bred pig reference data respectively, and outputting the health statuses of the pigs to be tested according to comparison results.

title: Biological information checking system
abstract: The invention provides a biological information checking system. The checking system comprises a processing device, a plurality of identity collection devices and a plurality of feeding devices, wherein the feeding devices are distributed in all pigsties in a pig farm and used for providing feed and water for to-be-tested pigs; the identity collection devices are arranged on the feeding devices and used for collecting identity information of the to-be-tested pigs when the to-be-tested pigs eat the feed or drink the water; and the processing device is connected with the identity collection devices and used for acquiring the identity information and obtaining the quantity of the to-be-tested pigs in the pig farm according to the identity information. Through the biological information checking system, a breeder can obtain the quantity of bred pigs quickly and conveniently, it is convenient for the breeder to effectively manage the farm, the workload of the breeder is reduced, and a relevant breeding work plan can be made timely according to the quantity change of the bred pigs.

title: Intellectualized pig fitness platform and method
abstract: The invention discloses an intellectualized pig fitness platform and method. The intellectualized pig fitness platform comprises a pig house, a swimming pool, a pit, a channel, a control terminal anda cloud storage side, the pig house is internally provided with a front door and a rear door of a roller shutter door and a pig house control system, the pig house control system controls the front door and the rear door of the roller shutter door to be opened and closed; the pit is connected with the pig house and the swimming pool; the channel is connected with the swimming pool and the pig house; the control terminal provides an APP and completes control over the pig house control system and a pit control system; the cloud storage side is used for storing information sent by the pig house control system and the pit control system. Compared with the prior art, by means of the intellectualized pig fitness platform and method, pig driving motion is intelligently achieved, through running,diving and swimming, the disease resistance of pigs is improved, infectious diseases are prevented, vaccine untoward effects are reduced, the food intake is increased, the growth speed is increased, the reproductive capacity is improved, the practicability is high, the applicable range is wide, and popularization is easily conducted.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF S&T INFORMATION, SHANDONG ACADEMY OFAGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: NON-INVASIVE METHOD FOR SELECTIVE DETECTION OF MIOELECTRIC SIGNALS ORIGINATING FROM THE GASTRO-INTESTINAL TRACT
abstract: The invention relates to a method and apparatus for non-invasive determination of motility, motility change and/or degree of motility change of the gastrointestinal tract or a specific part thereof of conscious animals, by selectively detecting and analyzing myoelectric signals. The method and apparatus of the invention are suitable, for the first time, for simultaneous and specific non-invasive detection of changes in the motility of various parts of the gastrointestinal tract - such as stomach, small intestine and colon - of the monitored animal. The method and apparatus of the present invention can be used, inter alia, to detect and monitor a stress condition, to investigate the rate of feed utilization, and to investigate the effect of active substances, feed ingredients and stress on the feed utilization rate. The process and apparatus of the present invention are suitable for controlling and improving the husbandry and breeding conditions of farmed animals.

title: METHOD, CONTROL UNIT AND SYSTEM FOR INSEMINATION TIME DETERMINATION
abstract: Method (400), control unit (120) and system (500) for assisting a user in determining an insemination time interval (230) of an animal (100). The control unit (120) is configured to: obtain progesterone level of a milk sample of the animal (100); detect that the progesterone level is lower than a first threshold limit at a first moment (210); obtain activity level of the animal (100); detect that the activity level exceeds a second threshold limit at a second moment (220), within a first time period (240) from the first moment (210); determine the insemination time interval (230) of the animal (100) to be a second time period (250) from the moment (220) of detecting the activity level exceeding the second threshold limit; and generate a command signal to a user equipment (150) to output information to the user, comprising the insemination time interval (230),

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR INDIVIDUALLY MONITORING A GROUP OF ANIMALS, IN PARTICULAR FATTENING PIGS IN A GROUP
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a device for individually monitoring a group of animals, in particular fattening pigs in a group. The method is characterised in that: the animals pass via a detection cell (1) before feeding, in which they are weighed and each animal is supplied with feed according to the requirements of each individual animal, based on the weight of said animal; the weight of an animal is considered in relation to the weights of the other animals or a data curve, and on this basis, a specific feed composition is determined for the animal; according to the determined feed composition, the animal is directed to a feeding region (4A) in which the feed composition is provided; and a passage width of the detection cell (1) is adjusted based on the weights of all animals in the group, wherein same is adapted to a size of the animals.

title: METHOD, CONTROL UNIT AND SYSTEM TO GROUP FEED ANIMALS
abstract: Method (300), control unit (120) and system (400) to group feed animals (100) in a herd comprising different feeding groups (101, 102) based on an estimated energy need, and where each respective feeding group (101, 102) has feed having different energy content. The control unit (120) is configured to: identify an animal (100) in a first feeding group (101); determine BCS (230) of the animal (100); define position (210) in lactation cycle (200) of the animal (100); compare the BCS (230) with reference value (220) corresponding to the position (210); and confirm that the animal (100) is able to assimilate the feed and is kept in the correct feeding group (101) when the determined BCS (230) of the animal (100) is within an interval, defined by the reference value (220) minus a first margin (240) and the reference value (220) in addition to a second margin (250).

title: Livestock management
abstract: Livestock may be managed by a variety of systems, processes, and techniques. In particular implementations, the properties of water may be monitored by automated techniques and treated water may be provided to animals. In certain implementations, sick, or potentially sick, livestock may be provided with treated water to improve their health. The automated techniques may include monitoring the movements and/or water consumption of the livestock and predicting which ones may be sick based on their movements and/or water consumption. In some implementations, a water trough may contain multiple segments. The water properties in the segments may be maintained at different states.

title: METHOD FOR MONITORING THE BEHAVIOUR AND CONDITION OF ANIMALS IN REAL TIME BASED ON INERTIAL TAG MEASUREMENT
abstract: The invention relates to a method and system of smart monitoring rings for characterising and interpreting the behaviour and health condition of an animal by identifying predetermined wavelets that are characteristic of each type of movement of the livestock, via the use of two six-axis inertial sensors, a gyroscope and an accelerometer, and algorithms for processing data simultaneously in the space-time domains and the space-time frequency.

title: IoT IoT-based pig estrus detection system
abstract: The present invention relates to a pig estrus detection system and, more specifically, to a method for collecting information of pigs using iBeacon of IoT technology and detecting estrus. To this end, the pig estrus detection system comprises an iBeacon sensing device receiving information when sensing estrus and a basic device sensing estrus of pigs according to the measured values.
applicants: INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF SUNCHON NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR DETECTING ABNORMAL STATE USING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
abstract: Disclosed are a livestock disease detecting apparatus and a method thereof, for detecting whether a disease has occurred in livestock. The apparatus for detecting whether a disease has occurred in livestock is configured to monitor biometric information such as body temperature, momentum, voice and sound of the livestock, water supply and the like and to classify the livestock into a plurality of groups using the monitored biometric information. The apparatus for detecting whether a disease has occurred in livestock determines whether or not a disease has occurred in the livestock depending on how the size of each group changes with time.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD OF MEASURED DRUG EFFICACY USING NON-INVASIVE TESTING
abstract: Systems and methods of measuring drug efficacy and side effects using non-invasive or husbandry-only testing are described. Steps include testing a cohort with a proposed husbandry-only protocol against an existing gold-standard treatment, and then validating the use of a created surrogate, non-invasive metric in place of an invasive metric. Then, the validated non-invasive surrogate metric and the husbandry-only protocols are used with an animal treatment cohort to study a new proposed treatment. A control cohort is also used, subject to the same husbandry-only testing and the surrogate metric. A statistical difference in outcomes, using one or more surrogate metrics, between the treatment cohort and the control cohort is the drug efficacy, for a drug used to treat the treatment cohort.

title: Animal tag system
abstract: Apparatus and method for managing animals such as but not limited to livestock. In some embodiments, an ear tag assembly has a main body, a backing member and a shaft that extends through an aperture through an outer ear of an animal to interconnect the main body and the backing member. A primary temperature sensor obtains an outer ear temperature of the outer ear. An ambient temperature sensor obtains an ambient temperature of a surrounding environment external to the animal. A control circuit receives the outer ear and ambient temperatures and determines a state of the animal responsive to a comparison of the outer ear temperature and the ambient temperature over a selected time interval.

title: Herd monitoring method
abstract: The invention discloses a herd monitoring method. The method comprises the steps of detecting the belching of a cow, setting a threshold value according to the feeding time of the cow, and comparing the threshold value with a detected value to determine whether the feeding and growth of the cow need to be interfered. The invention provides a herd monitoring method, a comprehensive, objective and detailed management and control method is arranged by detecting various behaviors of the cow, and the method can achieve monitoring of herds in real time, improve milk production and survival rate of the cow, and improve economic benefits.
applicants: CHANGSHA TUOPU LUCHUAN NEW MATERIAL TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Cattle herd monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a cattle herd monitoring system. The system comprises a first vibration detector, a first timer, a first controller, a first clock, a first communicator, a second vibration detector, a second timer, a counter, a second clock, a second controller, a second communicator, an alarm device, a third controller and a third communicator, wherein the first vibration detector, the first timer, the first controller, the first clock and the first communicator are located at a cattle lower jaw; the second vibration detector, the second timer, the counter, the second clock, the second controller and the second communicator are located at a cattle left neck venous groove; the alarm device, the third controller and the third communicator are arranged on a cowshed. According to thecattle herd monitoring system, the vibration detectors, the timers and the like are arranged on the cattle lower jaw and the cattle left neck venous groove so that the body conditions of cattle can beobjectively and accurately monitored, a cattle herd is monitored in real time, the yield of milk and the survival rate of the cattle are increased, and economic benefits are improved.
applicants: CHANGSHA TOPOLOGY LUCHUAN NEW MATERIAL TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Multi-source information fusion dairy cow behavior monitoring system and method
abstract: The invention provides a multi-source information fusion dairy cow behavior monitoring system and method. The method comprises the steps of performing data fusion on collected body temperature parameters, pulse parameters and exercise amount parameters to obtain body temperature data, pulse data and exercise amount data; collecting video frames in dairy cow monitoring videos, and performing normalization conversion on the collected video frames to obtain image data; on the basis of the body temperature data, the pulse data, the exercise amount data and the image data, constructing a sample data matrix; on the basis of the sample matrix, adopting a density clustering algorithm for determining whether an outlier exists or not; if the outlier exists, indicating that dairy cow is in the heat state at an outlier corresponding moment. By means of complementarity among multi-dimensional data, the problem that single data is poor in anti-jamming capability is avoided, accurate judgment of thedairy cow behavior state is achieved, and the effects of high reliability and good fault tolerance are achieved.
applicants: BEIJING RESEARCH CENTER FOR INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY IN AGRICULTURE

title: Free-range livestock food delivery system
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of livestock breeding, and provides a free-range livestock food delivery system. According to the system, S1, the first controller of each livestock periodically transmits the current position of the livestock recorded by a GPS positioner and the identity information recorded by an electronic identity card to an aircraft, wherein the identity information includes the born age and the state of health of each livestock, and the state of health is classified as healthy state and the unhealthy state; and S2, the aircraft determines the food delivery amount of the food delivery points in each designated area according to the current position and the identity information of the livestock to perform periodical food delivery. The beneficial effectsare that no manual intervention is required in the whole process so that the manpower and the material resources can be saved; and the food delivery amount of the food delivery points in each area isdetermined based on the number of the livestock in the area and the born age of the livestock so that waste of the food can be effectively avoided and the cost can be saved.
applicants: WUHU WANJIANG INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY OPERATION CENTER COMPANY

title: Wild boar lean meat rate increasing device
abstract: The invention is applicable to the technical field of wild boar rearing and provides a wild boar lean meat rate increasing device. The wild boar lean meat rate increasing device comprises an aircraft,pedometers, GPS positioners, electronic identification cards and second controllers. The aircraft is provided with a first controller and a laser transmitter, and the first controller is in communication connection with the laser transmitter. Each wild boar is provided with one pedometer, one GPS positioner, one electronic identification card and one second controller, wherein the pedometer, theGPS positioned and the electronic identification card are all in communication connection with the second controller which is in communication connection with the first controller. Each second controller comprises a reading unit and a sending unit, the first controller comprises a judgment unit and a driving unit, the judgment unit is used for judging whether wild boars need to increase exercise amount or not currently on the basis of received wild boar ages and current step numbers of the wild boars, and the driving unit controls the aircraft to fly to a position above a current position of the wild boars and drives the laser transmitters to beat the wild boars. The wild boar lean meat rate increasing device has advantages that the wild boar lean meat rate can be increased by control of the wild boar exercise amount, healthiness and freeness of contamination of meat are realized, and the wild boar exercise amount can be controlled more accurately.
applicants: WUHU WANJIANG INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY OPERATION CENTER COMPANY

title: SYSTEM FOR DETECTING MOVEMENT OF ANIMAL
abstract: The present invention relates to an activity sensing system of livestock. The livestock activity sensing system of the present invention includes: an energy harvesting device which can be attached to and detached from one of the leg and neck of livestock, converts vibration energy or thermal energy according to the movement of the livestock into electric energy, stores the converted electric energy in a capacitor, and transmits a preset signal by using the electric energy when the stored electric energy exceeds a preset reference value; and a livestock managing device which receives the preset signal transmitted from the energy harvesting device, calculates the activity of the livestock by using the reception period and reception pattern of the preset signal, and diagnoses the state of the livestock by comparing the calculated livestock activity and reference activity. The present invention can be used permanently and is able to transmit the activity signal of livestock continuously since the activity signal of livestock can be transmitted by using self-produced energy.

title: An air-conditioning and heating system of the pigsty for livestock growth of pigs
abstract: A radiant heating and cooling system of a pigsty for managing the growth of sows and piglets of the present invention distinguishes a heating temperature and a cooling temperature supplied to the pigsty in which the sows and piglets bred in pigsty live, reduces the pig mortality rate by the supply, and reduces the pig mortality rate by applying the cooling and heating system supplied to the pigsty as a radiation cooling and heating system, which is an indirect transmission system instead of a convective air-conditioning system. According to the present invention, by installing a variety of sensing devices including a thermal sensing camera in the pigsty, changes in the state of the pigs responding to the cooling and heating temperatures is confirmed and a growth database of pigs is constructed.

title: Livestock product monitoring device
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock product monitoring device. The livestock product monitoring device specifically comprises a monitoring chamber, a monitoring chamber cover plate, a triggering switch and a plurality of sensors, wherein the monitoring chamber is movably connected with the monitoring chamber cover plate; the triggering switch is arranged on the monitoring chamber cover plate, electrically connected with the monitoring chamber cover plate and used for controlling the opening and closing of the monitoring chamber cover plate; the sensors with different monitoring functions are mounted in the monitoring chamber and used for monitoring the biological features, which include body temperature, body weight and body height, of free-ranging livestock products. By the livestock product monitoring device, the free-ranging livestock products can be monitored automatically, the waste of manpower resources is avoided greatly, and the monitoring efficiency of the livestock products is increased.

title: A big data making system for optimizing livestock growth of pigs
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for generating and constructing big data related to growth condition information of a pig, which is capable of precisely collecting growth state changed information of a pig in response to change of temperature, humidity, and air by installing a camera and various kinds of sensors in a plurality of pigsties installed in a cattle shed; setting various and detailed growth condition information for each of the pigsties in a basic growth information range of the pig; finding optimal pig growth condition data by comparing and analyzing growth state change of the pig for each of the pigsties in response to a set growth condition; and controlling cooling and heating the temperature of the pigsties, where a mother pig and a piglet live, with a radiant heating and cooling system.

title: Livestock and poultry intelligent illumination system
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock and poultry intelligent illumination system. The livestock and poultry intelligent illumination system comprises a power supply module, a central control system, adetection module, a wireless transmission module and an LED lamp set module, wherein the power supply module supplies electric energy for the central control system, the detection module, the wireless transmission module and the LED lamp set module; and the central control system is connected with the detection module, the wireless transmission module and the LED lamp set module. By means of theabove structure, the livestock and poultry intelligent illumination system enables illumination in production in the breeding industry to meet the requirement for low energy consumption and long service life and have very strong controllability. And at the same time, the livestock and poultry intelligent illumination system can improve the technical index system of physiological rhythm, feeding behaviors, growth and development and breeding performance of livestock and poultry, can promote growth and potential productivity of livestock and poultry, and can improve immunity of livestock and poultry.
applicants: FOSHAN CITY NANHAI DISTRICT GUANGDONG NEW LIGHT SOURCE INDUSTRY INNOVATION CENTER

title: Pig farm breeding disease management system
abstract: The invention discloses a pig farm breeding disease management system. The system comprises a pig driving module and a detection module. The system is characterized in that the pig driving module comprises a driving fence and a driving device, the driving device comprises an artificial remote controller and an acoustic wave driving device, the output end of the artificial remote controller is connected to the input end of the acoustic wave driving device through signal control, the detection module includes a body temperature detection module, a body weight detection module and a mental statedetection module, and the body temperature detection module includes an infrared imaging probe and a red-hot imaging instrument. The system is reasonable in structure and convenient to operate, pigs are driven to a ring fence by the driving module, the body temperature detection module, the body weight detection module and the mental state detection module are arranged, the body temperature, the body fat and the stress state are detected to make an initial judgment, the pigs are isolated in time, the pigs are quickly checked one by one through a variety of equipment, the whole state of the pigs can be judged through data changes, and timely management isolation can be conducted.
applicants: ZHENGZHOU JHT SOFT TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; HENAN AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY

title: Systems, computer media, and methods for using electromagnetic frequency (EMF) identification (ID) devices for monitoring, collection, analysis, use and tracking of personal data, biometric data, medical data, transaction data, electronic payment data, and location data for one or more end user, pet, livestock, dairy cows, cattle or other animals, including use of unmanned surveillance vehicles, satellites or hand-held devices
abstract: Methods, apparatuses, non-transitory computer readable storage media, computer systems, networks, and/or systems for monitoring, collection, analysis, use and tracking of personal data, biometric data, medical data, transaction data, electronic payment data, location data and other data to develop a profile for one or more end user, pet, livestock, dairy cows, cattle or other animal using radio and other frequency tags and relaying data from EMFID tag interactions to a database that can be accessed by members of a network, and further including the use of unmanned surveillance vehicles, satellites or hand-held devices for monitoring, collection, and/or analysis of EMFID data.

title: Intelligent monitoring device of animal ear tag, monitoring system and monitoring method
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring device of an animal ear tag. The intelligent monitoring device of the animal ear tag comprises an electronic monitoring device arranged at the front end of one of handles and a calipers folding induction device arranged on the handle and positioned near a rotating shaft. The invention further discloses an intelligent monitoring system of the animalear tag. The intelligent monitoring system of the animal ear tag comprises the intelligent monitoring device, as well as mobile communication equipment and a cloud server which communicate with eachother. The invention further discloses a monitoring method adopting the intelligent monitoring device of the animal ear tag. Judgment on whether to complete tag wearing is conducted through synchronization of an action signal catcher of the electronic monitoring device and the calipers folding induction device. The electronic monitor of the action signal catcher and the calipers folding inductiondevice are integrated on the calipers and are mutually connected, so that the functions of automatically determining that the ear tag is truly worn on earlaps of the animal and obtaining accurate tagwearing time are achieved, the false tag wearing phenomenon is avoided and the identity of the animal can be deeply traced.
applicants: SMART ANIMAL HUSBANDRY CARE; CHENGDU RUIHU ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Dairy cattle information monitoring method and system
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a dairy cattle information monitoring method and system, and belongs to the field of animal monitoring. The method comprises the steps that a first data collecting device obtains environment status parameter information of the environment where dairy cattle is located, a second data collecting device obtains biological sign information corresponding to theenvironment status parameter information of the environment where the dairy cattle is located, a data transmission device transmits the biological sign information corresponding to the environment status parameter information to a server, the server compares the biological sign information of the dairy cattle with biological sign information corresponding to target dairy cattle under the target environment in a prestored target database and obtains the comparison result, the dairy cattle is recognized according to the comparison result, and therefore the dairy cattle can be subjected to identity authentication, and the phenomenon that the dairy cattle is illegally replaced in the breeding process can be effectively avoided.

title: Pig farm message management system
abstract: The invention discloses a pig farm message management system. The pig farm message management system comprises a shell, the inside of the shell is fixedly connected with a first partition; the right side of the top of the first partition is fixedly connected with a detecting box; the top of the detecting box is fixedly connected with an exhaust fan; an air inlet of the exhaust fan communicates with an air inlet tube; the right end of the air inlet tube communicates with the right wall of the shell; an air outlet of the exhaust fan communicates with an air outlet tube; the bottom of the air outlet tube communicates with a flow distributing box; and the bottom of the flow distributing box successively communicates with a first detecting tube and a second detecting tube from left to right. The invention relates to the field of technical farm management equipment. By the pig farm message management system, air extracted by the exhaust fan can be divided into two portions by the flow distributing box, the two portions of air are separately arranged on the left side and the right side of the second partition, the humidity in air and the concentration of carbon dioxide can be detected separately by a humidity detector and a carbon dioxide concentration detector, and farmers can adjust the humidity and the concentration of carbon dioxide conveniently in time to ensure the most suitablebreeding environment.

title: Counting and monitoring system for animal husbandry
abstract: The invention discloses a counting and monitoring system for animal husbandry. The counting and monitoring system comprises a base plate, wherein the top part of the base plate is fixedly connected with a breeding shed body; a U-shaped passage frame is fixedly connected with and arranged at the top part of the base plate and located at one side of the breeding shed body; a rotating shaft is rotatably connected with and arranged between two sides of the inner wall of the U-shaped passage frame; the outer surfaces of two ends of the rotating shaft are respectively sleeved by a worm sleeve drum;and the outer surface of the rotating shaft located between two worm sleeve drums is sleeved by a first bevel gear. The invention relates to the technical field of counting and monitoring of the animal husbandry. The counting and monitoring system for the animal husbandry provided by the invention greatly facilitates counting of the number of cattle and sheep back to a shed for a breeder, well avoids the situation of incorrect counting from occurring, does not require the breeder to spend a great amount of time to count the cattle and the sheep back to the shed, lightens the workload of the breeder, improves the working efficiency of the breeder, and realizes rapid, accurate and automatic counting of the cattle and sheep back to the breeding shed.

title: Electromagnetic device for promoting estrus of cows
abstract: The invention discloses an electromagnet device for promoting oestrus of cows. The device comprises a pulse acquisition module, an oestrum detection module, a controller, an electromagnetic device, acommunication module and a power supply module. The pulse acquisition module collects pulse beat information around cow genitals and sends the information collected to the controller. After the controller receives pulse information, pulse currents synchronized with pulse beat time are output and sent to the electromagnetic device. The electromagnetic device converts the pulse currents into a corresponding pulse magnetic field. The pulse magnetic field acts around the cow genitals, regulates the speed of blood flow in the cows, changes microcirculation, enhances metabolism, and accelerates tissue repair and recovery of physiological functions, thereby inducing the estrus of the cows. The estrus detection module detects the behavior that the cows are bestridden by bulls, and when a bestriding behavior occurs, the communication module is started to send cow estrus information to staffs. The device integrates the functions of promoting the estrus and detecting the estrus, and maximizes theprobability of cow conception.

title: Animal behavior monitoring, analysis and pre-warning system based on action and sound and working method of system
abstract: The invention discloses an animal behavior monitoring, analysis and pre-warning system based on action and sound and a working method of the system, and belongs to the technical field of non-invasiveanimal behavior monitoring, mathematical modeling, data fuzzy processing and intelligent hardware. The system comprises an intelligent wearable device and a client device, wherein the intelligent wearable device is used for acquiring animal behavior data, analyzing and matching the acquired behavior data by a pre-stored training model to obtain animal behavior characteristics and/or regularities (such as estrus and/or health status data) and transmitting the data to the client device, and the client device is used for receiving and displaying the animal behavior characteristic and/or regularity data transmitted by the intelligent wearable device. By the aid of the system, managers can timely know the behavior characteristics, the estrus status and the health status of animals, and proper management measures such as timely in-place mating opportunity selection and increase of natural mating success rate of are taken according to animal behavior change regularities.
applicants: LIANQI TECHNOLOGY (BEIJING) COMPANY; CHINA CONSERVATION AND RESEARCH CENTER FOR GIANT PANDA; BEIJING NORMAL UNIVERSITY

title: Pasture water drinking equipment and system having monitoring function
abstract: The invention provides pasture water drinking equipment and system having a monitoring function and relates to the technical field of animal husbandry environment engineering. The pasture water drinking equipment comprises a first groove, a second groove, a gas collecting tube, a gas detector, an exhaust fan and an automatic watering device, the second groove is arranged inside the first groove, anotch is formed in one side of the first groove, one end of the gas collecting tube is communicated with the gas detector while the other end of the same is fixedly connected with the edge of the notch, the exhaust fan is arranged at one end, close to the gas detector, of the gas collecting tube, and the gas detector is used for detecting concentration of gas expired by dairy cows. The pasture water drinking equipment can realize functions of providing a water drinking platform, automatically watering and monitoring gas; compared with conventional water drinking troughs, the pasture drinkingequipment is multifunctional, can collect more information of dairy cows and brings convenience to working personnel to master dynamic information of the dairy cows in the process of water drinking soas to formulate better feeding schemes.
applicants: AGRO-ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION INSTITUTE, MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE

title: APPARATUS AND SYSTEM FOR MANAGING LIVESTOCK HEALTH
abstract: A livestock health management device is disclosed. The livestock health management device comprises: a first automatic door which is placed at a livestock entrance area in a stable; a second automatic door which is separated from the first automatic door at a fixed distance; a livestock recognizing unit which recognizes a specific livestock animal when the specific livestock animal approaches the first automatic door within a fixed distance; a first photographing unit which is placed in the upper part of the first automatic door in order to photograph the specific livestock animal; a livestock size measuring unit which measures the size of the specific livestock animal based on an image photographed by the first photographing unit; a second photographing unit which is placed in the upper part of the second automatic door and has a thermal image taking function; a storage unit which stores information on livestock animals included in the stable; and a control module. Therefore, the livestock health management device can provide improved efficiency thereof.
applicants: KOREA NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF TRANSPORTATION INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title: Real-time monitoring system for pig farm environment
abstract: The invention provides a real-time monitoring system for a pig farm environment. The system comprises a data processing center, an environment monitoring device and a user terminal, wherein the environment monitoring device, the user terminal are in communication connection with the data processing center; the environment monitoring device comprises aggregation nodes and sensor nodes, multiple sensor nodes and aggregation nodes form a wireless sensor network through a mode of self-organizing, the sensor nodes are used for collecting and transmitting the pig farm environment information, the aggregation nodes are used for aggregating the pig farm environment information collected by each sensor node and sending the pig farm environment information to the data processing center, and the dataprocessing center is used for saving and displaying the pig farm environment information transmitted by the aggregation nodes, and sending an alarm signal to the user terminal when the pig farm environment information is abnormal. The real-time monitoring system for the pig farm environment realizes real-time monitoring of the pig farm environment.
applicants: SHENZHEN HUICHUANG UNITED AUTOMATION CONTROL COMPANY

title: Simulated cattle pasturing mechanical bird
abstract: The invention discloses a simulated cattle pasturing mechanical bird. The simulated cattle pasturing mechanical bird comprises a simulated bird shell, a CPU, a GPS device, a visual sensor, a heat sensor, a vermifuge sprayer, a temperature testing probe, an alarm, a signal receiver and a solar panel, wherein the CPU, the GPS device, the vermifuge sprayer, the alarm and the signal receiver are positioned in the shell; and after being in parallel connection, the GPS device, the visual sensor positioned in an eye of the mechanical bird, the heat sensor positioned in the head of the mechanical bird, the temperature testing probe positioned in the beak of the mechanical bird, the vermifuge sprayer, the alarm and the signal receiver are serially connected with the CPU and the solar panel positioned on the shell to form a power loop. The simulated cattle pasturing mechanical bird is simple in structure and complete in function, and can adapt to most of complex terrains, and unmanned managementof buffalo pasturing is realized effectively.

title: Animal behavior monitor
abstract: A system for monitoring ruminant animal foraging that utilizes a piezoelectric film sensor in communication with a computer processor to record and characterize jaw movement data for the foraging ruminant animal. The processor applies pattern algorithms to categorize the jaw movement data so that the jaw movements are categorized as at least chewing, biting, ruminating, and/or idling.
applicants: THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, AS REPRESENTED BY THE SECRETARY OF AGRICULTURE

title: Animal husbandry management system based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention discloses an animal husbandry management system based on the Internet of Things. The system comprises terminal equipment, a cloud service platform, comprehensive application equipment and a third-party application platform, the terminal equipment with unique identification is fixed on each animal, various information such as positioning information, temperature information, displacement information and the like are sensed and recognized, the situation of daily breeding of each animal is monitored by a user in real time through a PC end and an APP, the functions of positioning, tracking, trajectory viewing, monitoring and the like of animals are achieved, and unique archival information of each animal is established, so that the management of livestock breeding is more scientific and refined, and the statistics and analysis are conducted on data to further improve management.

title: Fence based livestock data acquisition system
abstract: The invention discloses a fence based livestock data acquisition system. The fence based livestock data acquisition system comprises a fence, a data acquisition device and a feed device, and the fenceis formed by at least one passage; the feed device is used for attracting livestock into the passages; the data acquisition system comprises a camera, a body temperature sensor or a sound collector,the camera is used for acquiring head images and/or images of body parts of the livestock entering the passages, the body temperature sensor is used for acquiring body data of the livestock entering the passages, and the sound collector is used for acquiring sound data of the livestock entering the passages. The feed device is adopted to attract the livestock to the fence, and movement areas of the livestock are limited through the passages, so that livestock data can be acquired, the purpose of acquiring the data meeting the standard is achieved, and finally the technical problem about improving precise identification of the livestock in the later period is finally solved.

title: Cowhouse monitoring system and method thereof
abstract: A cowhouse monitoring system and method thereof are provided. The cowhouse monitoring system can automatically calculate cattle drinking water frequency by using image sensor and control the cooling system in different operation model to cool down the cowhouse so that for relieving the heat stress.

title: LIVESTOCK TRADING PLATFORM
abstract: The Livestock Trading Platform invention is a novel confluence of software and hardware to improve how livestock are managed and marketed. The collection of animal biometric data inclusive of facial recognition and weight estimates along with a distributed ledger payment gateway and a geo-fencing system to control animal grazing locations and movements will allow livestock producers to supply livestock consumers, individual, animal-level traceability data which, taken in aggregate, will allow a livestock producers to supply a livestock consumers with whole herd data.

title: Market pig feeding and tracking system based on ARM and RFID
abstract: The invention relates to a market pig feeding and tracking system based on ARM and RFID and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication and the internet of things. The system structurallycomprises a breeding monitoring device and a communication device. The breeding monitoring device is composed of a main control module (1), a weight detection sensor module (2), a conditioning and A/D conversion module (3), a market pig foraging identification module (7), a breeding environment monitoring module (6) connected with the conditioning and A/D conversion module (3) and a display module (5) connected with main control module (1), wherein the weight detection sensor module (2), the conditioning and A/D conversion module (3) and the market pig foraging identification module (7) are connected with the main control module (1); the communication device is composed of a WIFI communication module (4). According to the market pig feeding and tracking system based on ARM and RFID, information such as pig weight, foraging conditions and breeding environment can be detected in real time, and the system helps market pig breeding to become an environment-friendly and resource-saving industry with scientific management and obvious benefits.

title: Artificial intelligence livestock supervision terminal
abstract: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence livestock supervision terminal which is mainly composed of an integrated structure comprising an artificial intelligence center processing unit, a camera and an infrared directional remote sensing thermometer. The supervision terminal is mainly used for automatically recognizing serial numbers of livestock faces and conducting animal motion morphological analysis.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MONITORING THE DEVELOPMENT OF ANIMALS
abstract: Method and systems for monitoring the growth of animals, the method comprising: a. bringing together a multiplicity of animals in at least one collective space, such as a pen or barn space, in which the animals can move freely; b. obtaining a 3D image of an area within the at least one pen with the aid of at least one 3D camera and/or a multiplicity of cameras, while the animals can be inside the area; c. supplying information about the 3D image of the area to a signal processing unit; d. with the signal processing unit, according to a first predetermined algorithm, recognizing an animal in the 3D image; e. determining the identity of the animal which has been or is recognized in step d.; f. with the signal processing unit, on the basis of a 3D image obtained and supplied in step c, of the animal recognized in step d., within the 3D image of the area, according to a second predetermined algorithm, at least estimating a growth parameter such as a weight, a volume and/or a length parameter of the animal recognized in step d.; g. repeating steps d.-f. when the animal appears in the image again; h. with the aid of a first computer, collecting the information obtained in steps d.-g. to obtain insight into the growth of the animal in time.

title: Multi-fuction robot for livestock house
abstract: According to the present invention, provided is a multi-functional robot device for a livestock shed comprising: a driving body; a feeder part disposed on the driving body; an arm part disposed on the driving body to be rotatable; a mast disposed on the rear surface of the driving body; a fork part disposed on the mast to be lifted; and a sensor part disposed at the end of the fork part. The sensor part comprises: a sensor body coupled to the end of the fork part; a non-contact sensor disposed inside the sensor body and sensing a distance to an object approaching the driving body; and a contact type sensor disposed inside the sensor body and touching the object approaching the driving body. Therefore, an objective of the present invention is to provide the multi-functional robot device for a livestock shed which moves and automatically supplies feed to a livestock.

title: BEHAVIOR SPECIFYING DEVICE, BEHAVIOR SPECIFYING METHOD AND PROGRAM
abstract: According the present invention, a behavior specifying device, which specifies the behavior of livestock, includes: a storage means which stores acceleration data measured by an acceleration sensor mounted on the livestock; an acquisition means which acquires, from among the acceleration data stored in the storage means, one or more pieces of acceleration data between prescribed times; an index value calculation means which calculates, from the one or more pieces of acceleration data acquired by the acquisition means, a prescribed index value; and a specifying means which specifies a behavior of the livestock on the basis of the index value calculated by the index value calculation means, and a pre-created specifying model for specifying a behavior of the livestock.

title: LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, BEACON USED IN SAID LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, AND METHOD FOR PROVIDING LOCATION OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: This livestock management system (100) is provided with: a plurality of beacons (50), which are respectively attached to and used on a plurality of livestock (1), and each of which includes a communication device (51) and tactile devices (57a, 57b) connected to the communication device; a positioning system (38) that detects electromagnetic wave signals transmitted from the communication devices of the plurality of beacons, and estimates the respective locations of the livestock to which the beacons are attached; and a control device (40) that is connected to the positioning system. The control device selects, according to the locations of the livestock, at least one from among the plurality of beacons, generates a command for operating the tactile devices included in the selected beacon, transmits the command to the communication device included in the selected beacon, and operates the tactile devices connected to the communication device to generate a stimulus.

title: Device for improving sow reproduction
abstract: The invention discloses a device for improving sow reproduction. The device comprises a pulse sensor, a body temperature sensor, a MCU processing unit, an electromagnetic device, a communication module and a power module. The pulse sensor collects the sow's pulse beat information and passes it to the MCU processing unit; the MCU processing unit outputs a pulse current synchronized with the pulse beat time to the electromagnetic device; the electromagnetic device converts the pulse current into a corresponding pulsed magnetic field and acts it around the genitals of the sow; the pulsed magneticfield regulates the blood flow rate of the sow, enhances metabolism, accelerates tissue repair and physiological function recovery, and induces sow estrus; the body temperature sensor detects the sow's body temperature and transmits it to the MCU processing unit; the MCU processing unit analyzes and compares the received body temperature data; when the body temperature data exceeds a preset value, the communication module is started to send the sow estrus information to the staff.
