The invention combines the functions of promoting estrus and detecting estrus, and can maximize the conception ofthe sow.

title: Photoelectric detection method for poultry gender
abstract: The invention discloses a photoelectric detection method for poultry gender. The photoelectric detection method comprises the following steps: horizontally fixing a to-be-detected egg collected by mating of a female duck with W chromosome containing GFP or a female duck with Z chromosome containing GFP and a male duck without GFP, carrying out standing for a few seconds until the interior of a blastoderm is completely static, and allowing the blastoderm to be able to freely rotate at the top part; and selecting 20 to 50 sites on an eggshell in a longitudinal axis plane perpendicular to the egg, and carrying out fluorescence measurement, wherein a correlation between a fluorescence measurement position and fluorescence intensity comprises two unique forms. The photoelectric detection methodprovided by the invention has the following beneficial effects: identification of a female embryo egg can be carried out under the condition of no damage to a breeding egg, is fast and effective andhas an accuracy rate reaching 100%.

title: Production pit device and production pit system
abstract: The invention discloses a production pit device and a production pit system. The production pit device comprises a production shell cabin in the shape of a concave cambered surface and further comprises a draining pipeline, a self-flushing supporting component, a supporting frame, an air exchange pipeline component, a waterproof cover and a swing disinfection lamp component, the draining pipeline,the self-flushing supporting component and the supporting frame are arranged at the bottom of the production shell cabin, and the production shell cabin comprises an inner production shell and an outer production shell. The production pit device and the production pit system simulate technical features of soil pits; after black pigs are helped to enter the production pit device naturally withoutresistance, modernized control equipment and devices in the production pit device can be utilized to realize treatment like ventilation, cleaning and water spraying, heat preservation, omnibearing disinfection matched with shell shape, sewage drainage and dung removal of mother black pigs and small black pigs, so that breeding personnel can be helped to scientifically and reasonably assist the black pigs in realizing specialized and large-scale production of small black pigs outside a breeding house.

title: Livestock quality tracking system
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock quality tracking system. The livestock quality tracking system comprises a livestock breeding controller, a server and a client, wherein the livestock breeding controller and the server are connected through the Internet, the server and the client are connected through the Internet, a livestock breeding plant environment data acquisition module, a manual operation module, a data processing module and a quality inspection module which are arranged in a livestock breeding plant and are connected with the livestock breeding controller are further comprised, aninput device for livestock cub information input and an output device for livestock breeding information output are further comprised, the input device and the output device are connected with the server, and the output device is an RFID radio frequency label generation printing device. The system is advantaged in that livestock production, logistics and transportation traceability is realized, full transparency of the livestock from production to transportation to use is realized, during use, marking of the identity information is realized through inputting all the data, and thereby traceability of all the data is realized.

title: METHOD OF DETECTING ESTROUS PERIOD OF COWS BY A DRONE
abstract: The invention is about a system that provides detection of estrous in cows with a drone and gains time to cattle breeders by saving labor, making the operations easy and minimize the errors due to human.

title: Herding livestock positioning system and method
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a herding livestock positioning system and a herding livestock positioning method. The herding livestock positioning system comprises a plurality of relay modules and a control module; each piece of livestock corresponds to one relay module; for any one of the relay modules, any one of the relay modules is used for acquiring position information of the livestock corresponding to any one of the relay modules; and the control module is used for acquiring the position information of each piece of livestock through narrow band internet of things and positioning each piece of livestock. According to the herding livestock positioning system and the herding livestock positioning method, which are provided by the embodiment of the invention, and through a narrow band internet of things technology, signal transmission stability and accuracy are guaranteed, the problem that the livestock cannot be positioned when the distance among the livestock is too far is solved and the operation time of a terminal is prolonged; moreover, through collection of herding livestock position information, temperature and step number, the use condition of a grassland canbe analyzed through livestock motion trails, the grassland resources can be distributed reasonably, the body condition of the animals can be monitored through temperature data, a monitor can be reminded at once when the temperature exceeds a certain numerical value, and the aim of warning in advance is achieved.
applicants: BEIJING RESEARCH CENTER FOR INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY IN AGRICULTURE

title: Animal husbandry monitoring method based on ear tags, device and ear tag monitoring system
abstract: The invention provides an animal husbandry monitoring method based on ear tags, a device and an ear tag monitoring system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent detection for breeding animals. Firstly, the body temperature information acquired by a temperature sensor and the motion information acquired by an attitude sensor are obtained; the temperature sensor and the attitude sensor are arranged in an electronic ear tag; a health analysis result corresponding to an animal individual is obtained according to the body temperature information and the motion information, wherein the individual health information comprises body temperature information, attitude information, motion quantity, and motion amplitude and frequency. The state of the animal individual is detected from twoaspects of physiology and movement of the animal individual through the temperature sensor and the attitude sensor in the electronic ear tag, the input cost is low, the monitoring result is objective,quantitative and accurate, the applicable scene is not limited by the activity environment of the husbandry individuals, and real-time and accurate monitoring is realized.

title: Intelligent livestock breeding system based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent livestock breeding system based on the Internet of Things. The intelligent livestock breeding system comprises a breeding fence, livestock bred in the fence, intelligent terminals arranged for livestock in a one-to-one mode and a server which communicates with the intelligent terminals through the Internet of Things, wherein each intelligent terminal comprises a power supply unit, a physiological sensor, an ultrasonic sensor, a three-dimensional acceleration sensor, a zigbee communication unit, a controller and a vibration unit, and the zigbee communication unit communicates with the server. Through the system, real-time grasping of growth and activity data of the livestock by a farm can be facilitated, proper movement of the livestock is promoted, the yield and quality of the livestock are improved, and ecological farming and maximum reduction of drugs are achieved.

title: Livestock chew detection system based on wireless technology
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock chew detection system based on a wireless technology. The system comprises a main controller, a zigbee communication network and a chew signal collection terminal,the chew signal collection terminal is used for collecting chew information of livestock, the chew information is sent into the main controller through the zigbee communication network, the main controller displays the abnormal chew information through display equipment at the same time, herding people conducts judgment, and after judgment is completed, abnormal livestock can be located quickly and very conveniently through the system. The livestock chew detection system is beneficial to implementation of livestock breeding intellectualization, and the efficiency of livestock breeding is improved. The system can be applied to livestock breeding operation.

title: A system of a stable pig breeding using video analysis of pig
abstract: A system of piglet raising using video analysis according to the present invention collects, accumulates, and analyzes data on group behaviors and individual behaviors of piglets detected through a sensor unit to observe abnormal signs of the pigs; and thus, can minimize the group stress of the piglets and allows users to predict the amount of weight gain. Also, the death of piglets can be minimized without much labor, so that the increased animal welfare and increased marketed pig per sow per year (MSY) and reduced incidence of epidemics can be expected.

title: environment management system of a constant temperature stable for pig breeding
abstract: According to the present invention, an integrated system for regulating a homothermal environment of a pigsty for breeding pigs measures the temperature in the pigsty and the temperature of a pig individual through a sensor part including a thermal imaging camera capable of rotation in right and left and top and bottom directions, observes abnormalities of pigs by observing and solving abnormalities such as the cause of changes in room temperature, and minimizes group stress of the pigs to predict weight gain. In addition, it is possible to anticipate improvement of animal welfare by minimizing the death of the pigs without much labor force, increase of marketed per sow per year (MSY) and a lower incidence of epidemics.

title: A system of a stable for pig breeding using near field communication
abstract: A pig breeding system using near field wireless communications according to the present invention collects, accumulates, and analyzes data on group behaviors and individual behaviors of pigs detected through a sensor unit to observe abnormal signs of the pigs; and thus, can minimize the group stress of the pigs and allows users to predict the amount of weight gain. Also, the death of pigs can be minimized without much labor, so that the increased animal welfare and increased marketed pig per sow per year (MSY) and reduced incidence of epidemics can be expected.

title: Fine feeding system for pig farm
abstract: The invention discloses a fine feeding system for a pig farm. The fine feeding system comprises feed inlet devices, a weighing device, a mixing tank and a distributing device. Input ends of the inletdevices are connected with an input end of the weighing device, an output end of the weighing device is connected with an input end of the mixing tank, an output end of the mixing tank is connected with an input end of the distributing device, and feed can be distributed into feeding troughs in pig raising pigsties by the distributing device via distributing openings of the distributing device. The fine feeding system has the advantages that feed formula proportions can be finely regulated by the aid of the fine feeding system, and feed components can be finely uniformly mixed with one anotherby the fine feeding system; one-time food intake can be set by the aid of RFID (radiofrequency identification) scanning technologies according to individual live pig conditions of live pigs, the one-time feed demand of each single live pig individual can be adjusted in real time, accordingly, refined live pig individual feeding requirements can be met, conditions such as the weights of the live pigs, eating states and epidemic situations can be monitored in real time, and reliable bases can be provided to refined feed feeding; residual feed can be effectively recycled, accordingly, the cost can be saved, and feed contamination can be prevented.

title: Sow estrus behavior detection method based on machine vision
abstract: The invention discloses a sow estrus behavior detection method based on machine vision. Firstly, a mounting behavior judgment model is trained through sow life videos; displacement moving amount information of multiple estrus sows and proximity degrees to boars in cases of boar seduction are obtained through the sow life videos, and mounting behaviors of a certain number of estrus sows and frequency of the mounting behaviors are judged by the mounting behavior judgment model; the above obtained information of all the estrus sows are used as all training samples to train a neural network modelto obtain a sow estrus early-warning model; and when sow estrus behaviors need to be detected, displacement moving amount information of a sow, frequency of sow mounting behaviors and a proximity degree to a boar in a case of boar seduction are obtained through a sow video, and the above information is input into the sow estrus early-warning model to judge whether the sow is in estrus. According to the method, the estrus behaviors of the sow can be detected quickly and accurately, and pig farm incomes can be increased while labor intensity is alleviated.

title: Internet-based system and method of use thereof
abstract: An Internet of Things (IoT) based system for providing individualised support to livestock in a farming environment. The system includes a data processor that receives sensor signals from a temporally logged sensor arrangement distributed within the environment, with the processor including a multi-dimensional array model against which sensor signals are compared. The sensor arrangement senses environmental conditions experienced by each animal including a food intake. The array is populated with at least one of drug characteristics, food supplement characteristics, husbandry strategies, disease characteristics of each breed of animal, animal genotype or single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) data. The data processor further executes a software product which performs a multi-dimensional solution search in the array model, the search being based on logged sensor signals and genotype determination by DNA sequencing of each animal. The software product then computes a welfare trajectory to be used in providing an individualised husbandry for each animal, and output signals are generated by the processor.

title: Livestock chewing detection device and intelligent farmland management system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent farmlands, and particularly provides a livestock chewing detection device and an intelligent farmland management system. The device comprises a housing, a belt pulley, magnetic encoding device, a processor and a mouth connecting rope, the mouth connecting rope is arranged at the mouth of livestock and connected with the belt pulley, the magnetic encoding device is electrically connected with the processor, the magnetic encoding device is used for detecting the rotating angle of the belt pulley driven by the mouth connecting rope to transmitting detected angle data to the processor, posture data and chewing behavior data of the livestock are obtained through detection, the chewing behavior of the livestock is determined according to the posture data and the chewing behavior data to help farmland workers in tracking and detecting the states of feeding, ruminating and the like of the livestock, the device is suitable for popularization and use of large-scale farmlands, and the device has higher economic value.

title: Livestock raising fence having monitoring function
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock raising fence having a monitoring function. The livestock raising fence comprises a cross beam, wherein a first support is fixedly connected to the bottom of the cross beam, a second supporting column is arranged at the bottom of the cross beam and located on the right side of the first supporting column, a third supporting column is arranged at the bottom of the cross beam and located on the right side of the second supporting column, a fourth supporting column is arranged at the bottom of the cross beam and fixedly connected to the right side of the thirdsupporting column, a first handrail is welded between the cross beam and the first supporting column, and a second handrail is welded between the third supporting column and the fourth supporting column. Based on matching of first electric telescopic rods, first push plates, second electric telescopic rods, second push plates, first laser transmitters, second laser transmitters, first laser receivers, second laser receivers, a memorizer, a counter, a single chip microcomputer and a camera, the problem is solved that an existing livestock raising fence cannot monitor and count the livestock raising situation and quantity and cannot effectively reduce the working burden of raising farmers.

title: Cow estrus monitoring system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a cow estrus monitoring system and method. The system is characterized in that a heart rate sensor, a temperature sensor and an acceleration sensor are installed on each cow, and the signal output ends of the heart rate sensor, the temperature sensor and the acceleration sensor are respectively connected with the signal input end of a processor. The processor transmits sensor information to the remote control end, and the remote control end judges whether the cow is in estrus, and displays a judgment result of the estrus and/or the sensor information through a display.According to the system and method, the estrus of the cow is judged by detecting the body temperature, the heart rate and the behavioral activity of the cow and by combining three kinds of informationinstead of a single feature. The system is more accurate and reliable, and has low cost and low power consumption. The modern Internet of Things technology is applied to the dairy industry, so that the the economic effects of enterprises are greatly improved.
applicants: HUBEI UNIVERSITY FOR NATIONALITIES; HUBEI COLAND SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Meat quality tracing system
abstract: The invention discloses a meat quality tracing system. The meat quality tracing system comprises a monitoring terminal, a processor and a generating terminal; the monitoring terminal comprises a dietmodule, a health sate module and a movement module; the diet module is used for recording the eating variety and the eating quantity of livestock every meal; the health sate module is used for recording ill reasons, ill duration and medicine used in the ill process of the livestock every time; the movement module is used for recording movement time and movement duration of the livestock every day;the processor is used for collecting data monitored by the monitoring terminal and processing the data; the generating terminal is used for allowing the data processed by the processor to form two-dimensional codes. The aims that the value of meat products is fully incarnated, value-for-money consumption of consumers is also conveniently achieved, and relative balance between the consumers and the meat quality is guaranteed are achieved.

title: Separating system used for goat breeding
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of goat breeding, in particular to a separating system used for goat breeding. The separating system comprises a goat house and a goat shooing device, thegoat house is sequentially divided into an isolating region and a normal region, and the isolating region is provided with a wireless signal emitter; the goat shooing device comprises a control module, a wireless receiving module, an electric shock device and a temperature sensor, the control module can detect the body temperature of goats through the temperature sensor, and is further used for switching operation modes of the goat shooing device according to body temperature of the goats, the operation modes include the isolating mode and the normal mode, the operation mode of the goat shooing device is the normal mode when the body temperature of the goats is smaller than a preset value, the operation mode of the goat shooing device is the isolating mode when the body temperature of thegoats is larger than the preset value, the control module can obtain signal intensity of the wireless signal emitter through the wireless receiving module, and the electric shock device is used for performing electric shock on the goats. The separating system used for goat breeding can shoo diseased goats into the isolating region to avoid disease spreading in goat groups and reduce the loss of farmers.
applicants: WUCHUAN AUTONOMOUS COUNTY HONGMU SHEEP INDUSTRY COMPANY

title: Pig house with function of monitoring growth conditions
abstract: The invention discloses a pig house with a function of monitoring growth conditions in the field of livestock breeding. The pig house comprises a display, a processor and a plurality of breeding houses, the breeding houses comprise rear walls, front guard railings and side walls, the bottom ends of the guard railings are fixedly connected with food troughs, and the food troughs are close to one ofthe side walls of the breeding houses; the side walls of the breeding houses are connected in sequence, weighbridges are arranged beside the food troughs, the weighbridges are located in the breedinghouses and rotatably connected with the side walls of the breeding houses, fixed pulleys are fixedly connected to the side walls which are connected with the weighbridges, motors are arranged below the fixed pulleys, the motors are fixedly connected with the side walls, the output shafts of the motors are fixedly connected with rollers, traction ropes are wound around the rollers, the ends, awayfrom the rollers, of traction ropes bypass the fixed pulleys and are fixedly connected to the ends, away from the side walls, of the weighbridges, the traction ropes are in sliding contact with the fixed pulleys, the weighbridges are electrically connected with the processor, and the processor is electrically connected with the display. The pig house solves the problem of time and effort consumingin the weighing of bred pigs.

title: Goat growth detection system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of animal husbandry animal detection, in particular to a goat growth detection system. The detection system comprises a conveyor belt. Baffles are arrangedat two side ends of the conveyor belt. A plurality of grooves are formed in the upper surface of the conveyor belt, an opening is formed between two adjacent grooves, and a bottom plate is arranged on the opening. A connecting member is disposed on each baffle, and a weight measuring unit is disposed under the bottom plate. The system further comprises a storage box, a controller, a detection assembly in signal connection with the controller and a cylinder. A limit stop is installed in the storage box, the limit stop is provided with a temperature detecting unit capable of detecting the bodytemperature of a goat, and the temperature detecting unit is further used for sending a detection signal to the controller after detecting the abnormal body temperature of the goat. The limit stop isfurther provided with a marking assembly for marking the goat after receiving the signal sent by the controller. The system solves the problem that the body weight and body temperature of the goat cannot be detected automatically and in batch.
applicants: WUCHUAN AUTONOMOUS COUNTY HONGMU SHEEP INDUSTRY COMPANY

title: Multifunctional animal ear tag for quick threading, grading and positioning
abstract: The invention relates to a multifunctional animal ear tag for quick threading, grading and positioning. The multifunctional animal ear tag comprises a main tag body, a sub tag body, an ultrahigh-frequency RFID chip, an environment temperature sensor and an animal body temperature sensor, main tag needle holes are formed in the main tag body, and sub tag needle holes are formed in the sub tag body;the ear tag further comprises quick threading, grading and positioning needles and bearing clamps; quick threading needle protection columns extend to the outer side surfaces of the sub tag needle holes, the quick threading, grading and positioning needles penetrate through the main tag needle holes and the sub tag needle holes, are aligned at the bearing clamps, penetrate through the quick threading needle protection columns and are fixedly clamped, and accordingly the grading and positioning function is achieved; the number of the quick threading, grading and positioning needles is three, and the three main tag needle holes are formed corresponding to the three sub tag needle holes in position. In addition, the ear tag further has the functions of testing of the ear temperature of animals and the temperature of the environment where the animals are located, ultrahigh-frequency RFID electronic tags and the like.

title: Monitoring method and device for optimizing sow breeding
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of livestock cultivation, and discloses a monitoring method and device for optimizing sow breeding. The method comprises the following steps of: monitoringthe barking, body temperature data, and exercise amount of a sow, judging whether the sow is in estrus according to the breeding sound, body temperature data and exercise amount data of the sow; whenthe sow is monitored to be in estrus, an administrator is informed to check. By using the intelligent technology, accurate judgment is carried out on the estrus of the sow, staff are informed to carry out breeding timely, the litter size of the sow is improved, the litter size of each time is increased, the survival rate of the piglets is improved, the labor cost is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.
applicants: WANG YUEZHANG; XIE YONGHONG; WANG XUNZHI; GUIZHOU DUYUN QIANCHANG ANIMAL HUSBANDRY DEVELOPMENT COMPANY

title: Automatic separation and breeding house for sick sheep
abstract: The invention relates to goat breeding equipment, in particular to an automatic separation and breeding house for sick sheep. The automatic separation and breeding house for sick sheep comprises a house and an ear tag mounted on the sheep body, and the ear tag is provided with a detecting device, and the detecting device comprises an inflatable member arranged in the ear tag and a soundproof airbag in the ear canal of the sheep, a temperature sensor for detecting the temperature in the ear canal of the sheep, and a controller fixed in the ear tag, the temperature sensor sends the detected temperature signal to the controller, and the controller receives the temperature value sent by the temperature sensor. When the set value is exceeded, an inflation signal is sent to the inflatable member, and the inflatable member receives the inflation signal and then fills the soundproof airbag with gas. The invention provides an automatic separation and breeding house for sick sheep.
applicants: WUCHUAN AUTONOMOUS COUNTY HONGMU SHEEP INDUSTRY COMPANY

title: Sheep data automatic determination vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a sheep data automatic determination vehicle. The vehicle comprises a displayer, a weighing platform and a channel support wall, and the weighing platform is connected with a vehicle bottom plate through sensors; the frame is connected with the vehicle bottom plate through connecting columns; the weighting platform does not make contact with a frame; the channel support wall is provided with an infrared scanner, an ear tag identifier and a photo collector; the frame is provided with the displayer, and connected with the sensors on the weighting platform through weighting connecting lines; the displayer is connected with the infrared scanner, the ear tag identifier and the photo collector , and the displayer can be in remote connection or wired connection with a computer. According to device, in any place in a farm area, sheep are subjected to weighing, body size measurement, contour scanning, ear tag identification and photo collection, information is stored inthe displayer, and science researchers or farming enterprises can carry out sheep breeding and other work conveniently. The sheep can be fenced, immunized, protected and transported.
applicants: YULIN UNIVERSITY; JIAXIAN ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY POPULARIZATION STATION

title: Intelligent sow breeding system
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent sow breeding system. The system comprises an intelligent ear tag, a feeding system, a staying timing module, a database system and an operation system; the intelligent ear tag is arranged on a pig body; the feeding system is used for automatically carrying out feeding and monitoring a feeding condition; the staying timing module is used for monitoring the staying time of a sow in a boar region; the database system is used for analyzing and processing data of the intelligent ear tag, the feeding system and the staying timing module; and the operation system is used for monitoring and setting data of the database system. According to the intelligent sow breeding system provided by the invention, automatic analysis system of feeding and monitoring is used, so that manual investment is greatly reduced, and breeding cost is reduced.

title: AN ACCELERATION SENSOR AND A CAPSULE INCLUDING THE SAME
abstract: Disclosed are an acceleration sensor and a capsule including the same. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the acceleration sensor sets the highest value of a certain range as a threshold value if an acceleration value collected at a specific period moves within the certain range and counts if an acceleration value currently measured is larger than the threshold value. Embodiments of the present invention may provide the technology for collecting motion data of livestock using the acceleration sensor.

title: Pig health state remote monitoring system based on Internet of things
abstract: The invention provides a pig health state remote monitoring system based on Internet of things, which comprises an intelligent ear tag, an environment acquisition device and a control device, whereinthe intelligent ear tag and the environment acquisition device are connected with the control device through a ZigBee module; the control device is connected with a wireless gateway through a router;the wireless gateway is connected with the Internet through a GPRS network; data are transmitted to a remote server; and the server is connected with a government supervision department monitoring center through a database. According to the technical scheme provided in the invention, the Internet of things and the sensing technology are integrated to build an information platform for pig safety production and intelligent management and control, intelligent monitoring is provided for pork breeding, and an information supervision platform is provided for an enterprise, the government supervisiondepartment and a customer.

title: Mosquitoes and flies killing device for livestock
abstract: The invention discloses a mosquitoes and flies killing device for livestock, which comprises a box body, a top cover and a wide angle camera. The bottom of the box body is in threaded connection withthe edge of the bottom cover, and the middle part of the bottom of the bottom cover is fixedly connected with the bottom of the wide angle camera through the camera fixing column. The top of the bottom cover is in threaded connection with the bottom of a storage room, and the top of the storage room is provided with a first power grid; an illumination lamp is arranged at the bottom of one end of afixed pole, a deckle frame is arranged on the inner wall of the top of the box body, and the top of the deckle frame is contacted with the bottom end of a second power grid.The mosquitoes and flies killing device for livestock has the advantages of adopting a closed form to attract mosquitoes and flies to the interior of the device and kill the mosquitoes and flies by the power grid, being clean,sanitary and convenient to use, and capable of greatly protecting the health of livestock and people.At the same time, the bottom of the device is provided with a camera, so that when the livestock is in crisis, people can handle in time to avoid unnecessary economic losses. The device is mostly threaded in connection, and easy to disassemble and clean.

title: APPARATUS FOR FLY MANAGEMENT
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus (10) for fly management. It is described to provide (310) a processing unit with at least one image of an agricultural environment, wherein the agricultural environment contains a plurality of bovine animals. The at least one image comprises image data of at least a part of at least one bovine animal of the plurality of bovine animals. The processing unit determines (320) a number of flies in the image data of the at least a part of at least one bovine animal. The processing unit determines (330) information relating to fly infestation of the plurality of bovine animals. The determination comprises utilisation of the determined number of flies. An output unit outputs (340) an indication relating to a treatment for fly infestation of the plurality of bovine animals based on the determined information relating to fly infestation of the plurality of bovine animals.

title: ADAPTIVE LIVESTOCK GROWTH MODELING USING MACHINE LEARNING APPROACHES TO PREDICT GROWTH AND RECOMMEND LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT OPERATIONS AND ACTIVITIES
abstract: A method and system is provided in an adaptive framework for modeling livestock growth. The adaptive framework processes input data relative to livestock growth in an ensemble of one or more models and an artificial intelligence layer configured to select the most appropriate or primary model to optimize, predict, and recommend livestock feed operations based upon environmental, physiological, location and time variables within such input data. The adaptive framework also optimizes workflow by pen and by producer, based upon historical performance, gender and breed and the management practices of the producer.

title: Two-dimensional code laser marking machine used for marking pig information
abstract: The invention provides a two-dimensional code laser marking machine used for marking pig information. The machine comprises a base, a multifunctional supporting platform is welded to the surface of the base, and one end of the multifunctional supporting platform is in a right trapezoid shape; the other end of the multifunctional supporting platform is in an acute triangle shape, and two live pig corridor side plates are welded to the surface of the multifunctional supporting platform and symmetrically distributed by taking the central line of the surface of the multifunctional supporting platform as the symmetric line. The two-dimensional code laser marking machine relates to the field of lasers. According to the two-dimensional code laser marking machine used for marking pig information,by arranging a protective rubber cushion and a flexible trapezoid leakage-proof rubber sleeve, the phenomenon that pigs are injured in the transporting process is avoided, the flexible trapezoid leakage-proof rubber sleeve avoids that excrement leaks in the machine, so the normal running of the machine is influenced, and the problems that live pigs easily move and cannot be controlled easily, thetwo-dimensional code marking can go wrong, which causes information marking failures are effectively solved.

title: DEVICE TO MEASURE AN EMBRYO'S HEART IN AN EGG
abstract: The invention relates to a device for measuring an embryo's heart rate in an egg using infrared light and one or more light sensors, whereby a light tube is provided which is dimensioned and positioned such that light reflected from the surface of the egg cannot directly reach the light sensors, whereby the light tube is provided between the light source and the egg and is internally dimensioned and positioned such that a focused light spot is directed on the egg. The invention also relates to a method for measuring an embryo's heart rate in an egg.

title: Animal status monitoring and analysis system
abstract: The present invention relates to an animal status monitoring and analyzing system. In particular, the system is configured such that an integrated remote control server receives, from an animal status information acquisition device attached to and disposed on a body of each animal, not only the skin temperature and moisture level of the animal, but also the status information of the animal′s movement and power status information and/or GPS information and analyzes the received information. Therefore, a health status of the animal, the degree of stress of the animal, pregnancy or estrus of the animal, a battery condition, and a movement path of the animal are determined remotely and collectively, thereby allowing a proper response to be performed quickly and accurately. According to the present invention, the animal status monitoring and analyzing system comprises: the animal status information acquisition device which is attached to and disposed on the body of each animal, acquires animal status information including the skin temperature of the animal, the skin moisture level of the animal and the number of movements of the animal at every set period, at every set time or on request, and transmits extended transmission information including at least one of power status information and GPS information and the animal status information through a communication network at every set period or every time or on request; and an integrated control server which receives, stores, analyzes and manages the extended transmission information corresponding to the animal status information acquisition device, determines the animal′s condition by analyzing its status information, determines the battery status when the power status information is transmitted, and determines a position status of the animal when the GPS information is transmitted.

title: Farm disease control management system and management device and inspection robot applied to farm disease control management system
abstract: The invention provides a farm disease control management system and a management device and inspection robot applied to the farm disease control management system. According to the technical scheme, thermal images and colored images of all livestock in a farm are received, the species and body temperature information of all the livestock are recognized from the thermal images and colored images, then various pieces of the body temperature information are compared with the prestored information of livestock of the same species and whether or not the livestock suffer from a certain disease or not are in a latent period of the certain disease is judged according to the comparison result. In the whole process, workers do not need to appear in the site in person, the efficiency of supervising the farm is greatly improved, timely finding of the diseased livestock is facilitated, and the economic loss of the farm is lowered.

title: Animal breeding management system and method
abstract: The invention relates to an animal breeding management system and method. The system comprises an intelligent production cloud server, an RFID reader-writer and an RFID ultrahigh-frequency electronicearcon performing communication with the RFID reader-writer through a radio frequency signal, wherein the RFID reader-writer comprises an antenna, a coupling element, an electronic chip and a capacitance display screen. The animal breeding management system also comprises a mobile terminal Android APP (application) and an intelligent production task management subsystem. Through the animal breeding management system and method, the timeliness and accuracy of production task operation can be effectively improved, and the working efficiency of animal breeding management is improved; and moreover, by urging production staff to perform mating at proper time, pregnancy check and fetal determination, prenatal and perinatal operation and other operation, the breeding rate of bred animals can be increased, the non-pregnant cycle can be shortened, the calving risk can be lowered, and therefore cost is lowered.
applicants: XINING ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY STATION

title: FARM ANIMAL ACTIVITY DETECTION
abstract: The invention relates to an activity detection device for detecting the activity of a farm animal, comprising: an accelerometer (30) with an attachment unit (31) for the locally fixed attachment of the accelerometer (30) to a section (200) of a ground contact area (10) of a farm animal holding bay, a data processing unit that has a signal connection to the accelerometer (30) and is designed to detect an acceleration of the section (200) of the ground contact area (10) of the farm animal holding bay and from this acceleration to calculate a calculated farm animal activity, and an electronic interface (40) that is designed to signal the calculated farm animal activity.

title: RFID TAG
abstract: An RFID tag (10) to be used, for example, for tagging livestock is disclosed. The RFID tag (10) has a high resistance to mechanical and thermal stress due to a physical separation of a main antenna (18) and an integrated circuit (22) forming an RFID circuit (26). Namely, the RFID tag (10) comprises an inlay (14) with the main antenna (18), and a chip module (20) with the integrated circuit (22) and a loop antenna (24) inductively coupled to the main antenna (18). The inlay (14) and the chip module (20) are safely embedded in a tag housing (12). In particular, the compact chip module (20) with the electrical connections between the loop antenna (24) and the integrated circuit (22) can be reliably protected.

title: Method for monitoring health of domestic animals and system
abstract: The invention relates to the field of monitoring of health of livestock and discloses a method for monitoring health of domestic animals and a system. The method comprises the steps: adorning each domestic animal with an electronic tag, arranging a corresponding electronic tag reader in an exercise area of the domestic animals, and arranging an image pick-up device, which is used for acquiring video images of exercise of the domestic animals, in the exercise area of the domestic animals; acquiring an electronic tag identity and individual moving track information corresponding to the corresponding electronic tag identity of each domestic animal by using the video images acquired by the electronic tag reader and the image pick-up device; acquiring a total amount of displacements of each domestic animal once in each interval time T1 by using the individual moving track information; acquiring feed intake condition of each domestic animal; and acquiring water intake condition of each domestic animal. According to the method and the system, moving tracks of domestic animal individuals can be tracked in real time based on electronic tag identities of the domestic animals, locations, amount of exercise, feed intake condition and water intake condition can be monitored, the accurate monitoring on health statuses of the domestic animal individuals is facilitated, and the medication andcase-fatality rate of the domestic animals is reduced.

title: Automatic pen separating and group raising system of nursing and fattening house
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic pen separating and group raising system of a nursing and fattening house. The automatic pen separating and group raising system comprises a pen separating systemfor collecting weights of pigs and conducting pen separating, a monitoring system for monitoring and tracking individual behaviors of the pigs and predicting the marketing time, an environment controlsystem for monitoring, adjusting and controlling the temperature, humidity, carbon dioxide concentration and ammonia gas concentration in the pig fattening house, a supply system for supplying materials and water to pig pens, and an illumination system. By means of the automatic pen separating and group raising system, the weights of the pigs are more uniform, the function of predicting the pig marketing time is realized, the form and uniformity of the pigs can be reasonably controlled, the labor intensity can be lowered, and the system can be widely applied to the technical field of livestock breeding.
applicants: ANHUI XINSHIRUN ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Organic circulation breeding method
abstract: The invention relates to an organic circulation breeding method. The method includes selecting a region to build a bridge frame and planting grasses, dividing a chicken habitat area and a feeding area, and regularly driving chickens into the feeding area for feeding; collecting culture environment information of the habitat area and the feeding area, and sending the collected culture environment information to a culture management system for recording; and wearing an electronic tag for individual identification of the chickens on one of chicken feet of each chicken, wherein an RFID reader reads information on the electronic tag at any time, and sends the electronic tag information to the culture management system through a wireless network. The organic circulation breeding method not onlycan reduce the chicken breeding cost and improve economic benefits of farmers, but also achieves green and organic sustainable development.

title: LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract: A tag device for placement on a livestock animal can generally include a first communications interface, a second communications interface, one or more batteries, and a local controller. A base station can be configured for bidirectional communications with a plurality of mobile communication units, which may be mobile tag devices (e.g., being made mobile by being carried by a corresponding livestock animal). A low-frequency emitting system for identifying a feed lot feature can generally include at least one wire loop and a wire driver coupled to the wire loop. The wire loop can be physically associated with or positioned adjacent to the feed lot feature. A data silo may generally include a transceiver, a memory, and a processor. The transceiver is configured to receive a plurality of historical data sets pertaining to respective livestock animals from a base station.
applicants: BUCHANAN, EVAN; MEYER, TRAVIS; NIEVEEN, LYNN; BLAYLOCK, PAUL; CIHOLAS, MIKE

title: Intelligent monitoring method for growth data of cattle breeding
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method for growth data of cattle breeding. The method is characterized in that a breeding room is involved, a fodder trough is formed in the breedingroom, a sensor is installed in the fodder trough, a recorder is installed in the breeding room, a plurality of fodder boxes are connected to the fodder trough, a main control computer is arranged outside the breeding room and connected with the recorder through a wireless network, and the fodder boxes are located at the outer side of the breeding room. By means of the method, the physiological states of cattle within a time range are monitored according to biological characteristics in the current state, and the physiological states include an estrus period, a sick period, a healthy period anda lactation period of the cattle.
applicants: HEFEI HENGYI ECOLOGICAL AGRICULTURE TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: SYSTEM TERMINAL AND METHOD FOR MANAGING FARM ENVIRONMENT
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a terminal comprises: an image analysis part detecting at least one of a position and movement of livestock in a farm from image data including information on the livestock to generate behavioral propensity data for the livestock; and an environment parameter estimation part applying the behavioral propensity data and environment data of the farm to an optimal environment estimation algorithm based on machine learning to estimate an optimal environmental parameter optimized for the growth of the livestock, and calculating a final environmental parameter based on at least one of a recommended environmental parameter based on the environmental data and the optimal environmental parameter.

title: Quality-monitoring solar temperature difference power supply waistband-shaped fastening chest circle for livestock breeding
abstract: The invention discloses a quality-monitoring solar temperature difference power supply waistband-shaped fastening chest circle for livestock breeding. The quality-monitoring solar temperature difference power supply waistband-shaped fastening chest circle comprises a chest circle body, a data acquisition device, a data receiving unit, a display terminal and a cloud processor, wherein the output end of the data acquisition device is connected with the input end of the data receiving unit, the output end of the data acquisition device and the output end of the data receiving unit are also connected with the chest circle body, and the chest circle body and the data receiving unit are in bidirectional communicated connection with the cloud processor, the cloud processor is in communicated connection with the display terminal. The data acquisition device is used for acquiring somatic function data of cattle, the data receiving unit is used for receiving the data acquired by the data acquisition device and feeding the data back to the cloud processor, and the display is displayed on the display terminal through the cloud processor. Various parameters such as ultrahigh body temperature ofcattle herds and instant positions can be monitored at any time, data is displayed clearly, and information prompting is clear and reliable.

title: SYSTEM TERMINAL AND METHOD FOR MANAGING FARM ENVIRONMENT
abstract: The present invention relates to a farm environment management system and terminal, and a method thereof. The farm environment management terminal according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an image analysis part detecting at least one of a position or movement of livestock in a farm from image data including information on the livestock to generate behavioral propensity data for the livestock; and an environment parameter estimation part estimating an optimal environment parameter optimized for growth of the livestock by applying the behavioral propensity data and environment data of the farm to an optimal environment estimation algorithm based on machine learning.

title: Intelligent broiler chicken breeding system based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent broiler chicken breeding system based on Internet of Things. The intelligent broiler chicken breeding system is characterized in that the intelligent broiler chicken breeding system comprises a plurality of breeding farms; breeding environment information acquisition modules comprise a plurality of sensors and cameras, and are connected to a first communication module, the sensors are spread in the breeding farms, and the cameras are arranged in feed troughs, water troughs and dung containers respectively; pedometers are fixed to legs of broiler chicken,and comprise second communication modules, connection devices and pedometer bodies with label identity information; identity numbers of the broiler chicken and RFID chips with breeding farm information are embedded and recorded in the pedometer bodies; the second communication modules receive environment data and organize internal programs or receive external control programs to generate control commands. The intelligent broiler chicken breeding system has the advantages that the breeding environment information acquisition modules and breeding environment information control modules are arranged in the breeding farms respectively and are in wireless communication with computers, so that workers can know the conditions of each breeding farm through the computers.

title: Robotic injection system for domestic herd animals
abstract: A robotic injection system is herein described for delivering vaccines, reproductive hormones, and liquid materials to domestic herd animals. The robotic injection system includes a cooling-unit for storage of the liquid materials to be injected, a series of automatic gates to control the movement of herd animals, an RFID and camera ID reading system utilized for tracking identification numbers and medical history, a robotic arm to position and apply force in the injection process, and an injection mechanism for delivering injections to the patient. A streamlined system is described in delivering necessary injections to a mass number of domestic herd animals. A robotic injection system for injecting an accurate dosage of more than one fluid is described. For this description, bovines will be used as the primary example but this described invention also applies to other domestic herd animals such as sus, equus caballus, ovis aries, and capra aegagrus hircus.

title: IoTs-based intelligent collar monitoring system for pasture
abstract: The invention discloses an IoTs-based intelligent collar monitoring system for a pasture. The intelligent collar monitoring system for the pasture comprises a data acquisition node and an upper computer, wherein the data acquisition node is used for acquiring various information data of the livestock in real time, and sends the data to the aggregation node through the wireless network; the aggregation node sends the data to the upper computer; the upper computer is used for receiving the sensor data transmitted by the data acquisition node and storing the original data in a database, and displays the data on a terminal device in real time, so that the positioning function of the data acquisition node is realized. By designing the livestock behavior recognition algorithm, various data of the livestock can be classified, and the health condition of the livestock can be monitored. According to the invention, the system can acquire and process a lot of life data from livestock in real time, supports the networking in the pasture, is extremely high in anti-interference performance, and has the advantages of being low in power consumption, long in working time, and long in communicationdistance, and can recognize the behavior of the livestock through the received data.

title: Method and device for recognizing pig diseases and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a method and device for recognizing pig diseases and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of recognition of animal diseases. It is unnecessary to check pigsone by one and judge the types of the pig diseases one by one for a veterinarian. The process that the pig diseases are recognized is simplified, and the speed of recognizing the pig diseases is increased. The method includes the steps that multiple pieces of pig cough sample data are obtained, wherein the pig cough sample data carries corresponding pig disease type labels respectively; the pig cough sample data is input into a circulation neural network model to be trained, a pig disease recognition model is constructed, and a mapping relation of the pig cough data and the pig disease typesis recorded in the pig disease recognition model; the pig cough data to be recognized is input into the pig disease recognition model to recognize the pig disease types corresponding to the pig coughdata.

title: AN EAR TAG AND ANIMAL MONITORING SYSTEM
abstract: An ear tag (1) suitable for monitoring an animal comprises an ear plug (10). The ear plug (10) comprises a base (11) and a shaft (12) extending upwards from the base (11). A piercing pin (31) is mounted at the end of the shaft (12) and dimensioned to pierce the ear of the animal such that the shaft (12) becomes surrounded by ear tissue (460). The ear plug (10) further comprises a first light pipe (17; 413) designed to guide light from a light source (421) near a first base opening (13) towards ear tissue (460) of the animal near a first shaft opening (15). The ear plug (10) also comprises a second light pipe (18; 414) designed to guide reflected light from ear tissue (460) of the animal near a second shaft opening (16) to a light detector (422) near a second base opening (14).

title: Intelligent grazing vehicle with herd water feeding function
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent grazing vehicle with a herd water feeding function. The intelligent grazing vehicle comprises an intelligent grazing vehicle body, an electric control box, a controller, a voice recognition module, imaging radars, an alarm, a voice broadcast device, a voice input module, a water box, a water tank and a rain shielding plate, the electric control box is arranged above the intelligent grazing vehicle body; the electric control box is of a rectangular hollow structure, and the four imaging radars are respectively and fixedly connected with the four outer sidewalls of the electric control box; the alarm and the voice broadcast device are arranged at the two corners of the top end of the electric control box; the voice recognition module, the controller and the voice input module are respectively arranged in the electric cabinet; the controller is connected with the intelligent grazing vehicle body, the voice recognition module, the imaging radars, thealarm, the voice broadcast device and the voice input module through electric wires. The vehicle achieves the functions of automatic grazing, automatic positioning and tracking of livestock, weatherreceiving and intelligent control, energy saving and environmental protection, and automatic water feeding to the herd and rain blocking.

title: DAIRY ANIMAL-MONITORING SYSTEM COMPRISING HEAT STRESS-REDUCING MEANS
abstract: A dairy animal-monitoring system (1) for a herd of dairy animals (3-1) comprises a dwelling space for the herd of dairy animals, one or more controllable heat stress-reducing means (14) for reducing or preventing heat stress in the dairy animals, and a control system (10, 11) for the dairy animal-monitoring system which comprises a subset-determining device for determining or inputting a subset of the herd, an identification system (4, 5) for identifying the dairy animals from at least the subset, and a heat stress-detecting system for detecting a value of a heat stress indicator with a dairy animal of the subset. The control system is configured to controlling the one or more heat stress-reducing means in several of the dairy animals, in particular in substantially the entire herd in the dwelling space (2), on the basis of the at least one detected value. The subset of the animals are the indicator animals which will show heat stress sooner, as a result of which the control unit will cool down all cows in order to prevent the other animals from developing heat stress before it becomes noticeable. Due to the fact that monitoring now only has to be performed for some of the animals, this is easier, more accurate and more reliable.

title: LIVESTOCK SENSOR DEVICE, LIVESTOCK ASTASIA INFERENCE METHOD, LIVESTOCK ASTASIA INFERENCE PROGRAM, AND LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract: Provided are a livestock sensor device, livestock state inference method, livestock state inference program, and livestock management system with which it is possible to prevent losses to stockbreeders. The livestock sensor device of an embodiment of the present technology comprises a postural state-determining part, a state-inferring part, a transmitting part, and a case. The postural state-determining part determines the fallover state and non-fallover state of livestock on the basis of values output from an acceleration sensor. The state-inferring part infers an astasic state in the livestock on the basis of the time that a fallover state continues. When the livestock is inferred to be in the astasic state, the transmitting part transmits astasia notification data, which indicates that the astasic state has been inferred, to a server. The case houses the acceleration sensor, the postural state-determining part, the state-inferring part, and the transmitting part, and is configured so that the case can be worn on the head of livestock.

title: Swine plague detecting method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a pig plague detecting method and system, and belongs to the field of livestock breeding application. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the body temperature,movement, the sulfide concentration and the hemoglobin concentration change of a pig in the T time period by using a smart ear tag, and transmitting the data to a management terminal; allowing the management terminal to analyze the data to form the actual body temperature, the actual movement mount, the actual sulfide concentration, the actual hemoglobin concentration change curve of the pig, analyzing each curve to determine if the pig is in the pig plague state; and allowing the management terminal to inform the staff to check the pig if so. The system includes the management terminal capable of performing data analysis and outputting results, and the smart ear tag capable of detecting the body temperature, the movement amount, the sulfide concentration, and the hemoglobin concentrationand communicating with the management terminal. The pig plague detecting method and system are conducive to the early detection of swine plague, preventing a large number of infections, effectively reducing losses, and also reducing the risk of workers infected with swine erysipelas.

title: A control system of animal husbandry plant based on internet of things control
abstract: The invention discloses an animal husbandry plant control system based on internet of things control, comprises a factory building body and a ground body, wherein the bottom of the factory building body is fixedly connected with the top of the ground body, a partition plate is fixedly connected with the top between two sides of the inner wall of the factory building body, the top of the partitionplate is fixedly connected with a top box, and the top of the inner wall of the factory building body is rotatably connected with a threaded rod through the top plate, and relates to the technical field of animal husbandry and breeding. The animal husbandry plant control system based on the internet of things control, A fix rod is fixedly connected with one end of that output shaft of the first motor, monitoring is performed on the aquaculture factory at any time to know the growth condition of the livestock and improve the cultivation efficiency, the output end of the temperature sensor is connected with the input end of the first data comparator, and the temperature and humidity of the breeding plant can be monitored by an intelligent way, and the growth condition of the livestock can bemonitored at the same time, so that the breeding is more intelligent.
applicants: ZIBO ZHENGBANG INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY PLANNING COMPANY

title: HEALTH MONITORING AND TRACKING SYSTEM FOR ANIMALS
abstract: The present invention relates to a monitoring and tracking system for animals and especially for livestock. The inventive system comprises a wireless ear unit (6) which comprises an RFID antenna (4) comprising a temperature-heat sensor (1), an ear probe (2) and a flexible cable section (3); and a pulse oximeter sensor (5); a wireless nose unit (11) comprising a relative humidity/temperature (RHT) sensor (7), a microphone and vibration sensor (8), a triaxial accelerometer (9) and a fisheye IP (internet protocol) camera (10), to determine the number of breaths; at least one RFID signal transmitter (12) receiving RFID signals from sensors located in said units; an RFID reader (13) receiving and reading RFID signals from sensors located in said units or from at least one RFID signal transmitter (12); at least one microprocessor to which the sensors in the respective units are connected and which reads the values sensed by the sensors; a computer (14) to which the data received from the RFID reader (13) is transferred and which enables to notify the user with e-mail and/or SMS by determining this data by means of the software it includes. The present invention provides a health tracking and monitoring system for the measurement and transmission of multiple parameters related to animal health; and it can both send a warning signal to the user if a value other than the predetermined limit values is determined and can instantly measure the sensor parameter values when requested.

title: Device for detecting cow activity and body temperature
abstract: The invention discloses a device for detecting cow activity and body temperature, which belongs to the technical field of detection, and mainly consists of a temperature sensor, a wireless communication module, a microcontroller, a pedometer chip and a storage module. The device is characterized in that the temperature sensor and the wireless communication module are connected with the microcontroller, and the microcontroller is connected with the pedometer chip and the storage module. The device can accurately and effectively monitor the change of cow body temperature and activity, is helpfulfor timely determining reproductive states and health conditions of cows such as estrus, pregnancy and the like, and prevents diseases, shortens calving intervals, improves milk yield and improves economic benefits of dairy farms through a scientific and timely management technology.

title: Novel sow welfare intelligent delivery room, colony house and application method
abstract: The invention provides a novel sow welfare intelligent delivery room, a colony house and an application method. The delivery room comprises a delivery room body. The delivery room body comprises a lactation region, a plurality of thermal imaging collecting devices, a sound collecting device, an image collecting device and a computer; the lactation region is formed by surrounding a plurality of anti-pressing mechanisms; the multiple thermal imaging collecting devices are arranged around the lactation region; the sound collecting device and the image collecting device are both arranged over thelactation region; the output ends of the thermal imaging collecting devices, the output end of the sound collecting device and the output end of the image collecting device are all connected with thecomputer. Intelligence of inspection work of the delivery room is achieved, human input is reduced, the inspection efficiency is improved, and the abnormal condition of the delivery room can be foundin time and solved; the problems that a traditional delivery room is poor in sow motion welfare, high in dystocia and stillbirth rate, large in room building consumable amount, high in cost, capable of affecting swinery observation and conventional delivery room working operation and the like.

title: Intelligent ecological system for pig raising
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent ecological system for pig raising, relates to the technical field of ecological cultivation, and mainly solves the technical problems that cultivated pigs are poor in meat quality, and pig cultivation environments are poor in the prior art. The intelligent ecological system comprises a pig house, forest bushes, a mire pond, dry sand land and a shallow pond and is characterized in that a pig house environment intelligent management system is used in the pig house and comprises an information collecting module, an information processing module and a workingmodule; the forest bushes include a first forest bush and a second forest bush, the pig house is connected with the first forest bush through a walkway, the first forest bush is connected with the mire pond through a runway, the mire pond is connected with the dry sand land through a runway, the dry sand land is connected with the second forest bush through a walkway, the second forest bush is connected with the shallow pond through a runway, and the shallow pond is connected with the pig house through a walkway. The intelligent ecological system is capable of allowing the cultivated pigs tobe delicious in meat, capable of achieving intelligent cultivation and high in cultivation benefits.

title: Disease Prediction and Notification System for Livestock
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for disease prediction and notification for livestock which analyzes a variety of information (body temperature, pulse, activity amount, sound, and image information) collected by a data collection device of a necklace form worn on the neck of livestock to predict diseases (swine fever, mad cow disease, foot and mouth disease, etc.) of livestock, and transmits disease prediction information to a livestock disease control center and users (livestock owners) to recognize livestock disease states in real time and quickly take follow-up measures to minimize damage by contagious diseases. The system for disease prediction and notification for livestock comprises: a livestock state information collection means to store entity identification numbers of livestock, and collect direct state information, activity information, and sound and motion image information of livestock as livestock state information to transmit the information; a data collection and disease prediction server to comprehensively analyze activity information, body temperature information, heart rate information, sound information, and motion image information in the livestock state information collected by the livestock state information collection means to predict disease states of livestock, and transmit predicted disease information to a remote user and a disease control center server when an abnormal sign is discovered; and a user terminal to display disease prediction information of livestock on a screen based on livestock disease prediction information transmitted by the data collection and disease prediction server to provide the user with the disease prediction information of livestock.

title: Breeding farm capable of intelligently driving livestock and poultries to do sports
abstract: The invention discloses a breeding farm capable of intelligently driving livestock and poultries to do sports. The breeding farm is capable of intelligently setting the sports quantity of livestock and poultries and automatically driving the livestock and the poultries in a livestock and poultry living room into a driving sports car according to different livestock and poultry varieties as well asages and body weights so that the livestock and the poultries scientifically and regularly move. A system is mainly composed of an intelligent software system, an electronic control system, the livestock and poultry living room, the driving sports car and a sports track. The breeding farm has the beneficial effects that the sports time and rest time of the livestock and the poultries are intelligently controlled, the healthy growth of the livestock and the poultries can be improved, and the quality and taste of meat of the livestock and the poultries can be promoted; the living environments of the livestock and the poultries are recorded in real time, it is convenient to scientifically master the growth states of the livestock and the poultries, the breeding costs of the livestock and thepoultries can be reduced, and the breeding benefits of the livestock and the poultries can be increased; and the growth weights of the livestock and the poultries are recorded every day, which is beneficial to the calculation of the growth speed and the regulation of the feeding amount of a feed according to the growth state, so that the waste of the feed is reduced, the feeding efficiency of thefeed is increased, the production cost is reduced, and the scientific development of livestock and poultry breeding can be effectively promoted.

title: A system that recognizes objects and recognizes motion by diverging ultrasonic waves
abstract: The present invention relates to an object identification and behavior recognition system of livestock using an ultrasonic cowbell device. The ultrasonic cowbell device comprises: a sender for transmitting an ultrasonic signal; a receiver for receiving the ultrasonic signal; a battery for supplying power to the ultrasonic cowbell device; and a transmitter for transmitting the ultrasonic signal to a communication network. The system comprises: a management server connected to the ultrasonic cowbell device through the communication network; a manager terminal connected to the management server, receiving information transmitted from the management server, and allowing a manager to check the status of livestock in real time; and a database storing the riding state information of the livestock derived through the management server. According to the present invention, by providing an ultrasound system for emitting an ultrasonic signal to the livestock and determining the behavior radius of cattle through ultrasound analysis, the present invention can quickly and accurately identify estrus signs of livestock, thereby improving the economic feasibility of breeding farmhouses.

title: Intelligent system for driving livestock and poultry to move
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent system for driving livestock and poultry to move. The system can be used for intelligently setting the movement amount of the livestock and poultry and automatically driving the livestock and poultry in a livestock and poultry living room into a driving and running vehicle according to different livestock and poultry varieties, ages and weights, so that the livestock and poultry can do scientific and regular exercise; the system is mainly composed of an intelligent software system, an electronic control system, the livestock and poultry living room, the driving and running vehicle and an exercise runway. The system provided by the invention has the beneficial effects that exercise and rest time of the livestock and poultry is intelligently controlled,healthy growth of the livestock and poultry can be improved and the meat quality and taste of the livestock and poultry are promoted; a living environment of the livestock and poultry is recorded in real time, so that the growth state of the livestock and poultry is conveniently and scientifically grasped, the breeding cost of the livestock and poultry can be reduced and the breeding benefits of the livestock and poultry are improved; the growth weight of the livestock and poultry is recorded every day, so that the growth speed is easy to calculate according to a growth state, the feeding amount of feed is adjusted; the wastes of the feed are reduced, the feeding efficiency of the feed is improved and the production cost is reduced, so that scientific development of livestock and poultry breeding can be effectively promoted.

title: Equipment for intelligently driving livestock and poultry to move
abstract: The invention relates to equipment for intelligently driving livestock and poultry to move. The equipment can intelligently set the movement quantity of the livestock and poultry, according to different livestock and poultry breeds, ages and weights, the livestock and poultry in a livestock and poultry living room are automatically driven into a driving sports car, the livestock and poultry can move scientifically and regularly, and the system is mainly composed of an intelligent software system, an electronic control system, the livestock and poultry living room, the driving sports car and asports track. The equipment has the advantages that the livestock and poultry movement and break time are intelligently controlled, healthy growth of the livestock and poultry can be improved, and thequality and taste of livestock and poultry meat are promoted; the livestock and poultry living environment is recorded in real time, the growth situation of the livestock and poultry is mastered scientifically conveniently, the livestock and poultry breeding cost can be reduced, and the livestock and poultry breeding benefit can be increased; the growth weights of the livestock and poultry are recorded every day, according to the growth situation, the growth speed is calculated conveniently, the feed feeding amount is adjusted conveniently, waste of feed is reduced, the feed feeding efficiency is improved, the production cost is lowered, and scientific development of livestock and poultry breeding can be effectively promoted.

title: System for intelligently driving livestock and poultry to move
abstract: The invention relates to a system for intelligently driving livestock and poultry to move. The system can intelligently set the movement quantity of the livestock and poultry, according to different livestock and poultry breeds, ages and weights, the livestock and poultry in a livestock and poultry living room are automatically driven into a driving sports car, the livestock and poultry can move scientifically and regularly, and the system is mainly composed of an intelligent software system, an electronic control system, the livestock and poultry living room, the driving sports car and a sports track. The system has the advantages that the livestock and poultry movement and break time are intelligently controlled, healthy growth of the livestock and poultry can be improved, and the quality and taste of livestock and poultry meat are promoted; the livestock and poultry living environment is recorded in real time, the growth situation of the livestock and poultry is mastered scientifically conveniently, the livestock and poultry breeding cost can be reduced, and the livestock and poultry breeding benefit can be increased; the growth weights of the livestock and poultry are recordedevery day, according to the growth situation, the growth speed is calculated conveniently, the feed feeding amount is adjusted conveniently, waste of feed is reduced, the feed feeding efficiency is improved, the production cost is lowered, and scientific development of livestock and poultry breeding can be effectively promoted.

title: Intelligent livestock motion driving device
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent livestock motion driving device. The device can intelligently set the livestock motion quantity; according to different livestock varieties, ages and weights, livestocks inside a livestock living room are driven to a driving sports car, livestocks can scientifically and regularly move, and a system is mainly composed of an intelligent software system, an electronic control system, the livestock living room, the driving sports car and a motion track.
