The device has the advantages that the livestock motion and rest time can be controlled intelligently, healthy growth of the livestock can be improved, and the livestock meat quality and taste are improved; the livestock living environment is recorded in real time, the livestock growth state is scientifically mastered, the livestock cultivation cost can be saved, and livestock cultivation benefits are improved; the livestock growth weight is recorded every day, so that the growth speed is calculated according to the growth state, the feeding amount of feed is regulated, the feed waste is lowered, the feed feeding efficiency is improved, the production cost is lowered, and scientific development oflivestock cultivation cane effectively promoted.

title: Black bone sheep transportation feeding cage
abstract: The invention discloses a black bone sheep transportation feeding cage which comprises a closed cage body and a controller. An opening and closing door and a feed releasing door are arranged on the cage body, an oxygen content sensor and a pressure sensor are arranged in the cage body, the cage body is connected with an air inlet pipe and an air outlet pipe, an air inlet valve is arranged on the air inlet pipe, an exhaust fan and an air outlet valve are arranged on the air outlet pipe, the oxygen content sensor, the pressure sensor, the air inlet valve, the exhaust fan and the air outlet valveare electrically connected with the controller, the controller is in communication connection with a wireless data transmission device, and the wireless data transmission device is in wireless communication connection with a mobile phone of a user. The black bone sheep transportation feeding cage can effectively solve the problem of de-adaptation to high altitude of black bone sheep.

title: Black bone sheep feeding sheepfold
abstract: The invention discloses a black bone sheep feeding sheepfold which comprises a bounding wall, a sheepfold roof and a controller. A first motor is arranged in the bounding wall and positioned below thesheepfold roof, an output shaft of the first motor is vertically arranged downwards and fixedly connected with a horizontal hanging rod, feed baskets are hung at two ends of the hanging rod through pulling ropes, a cage is arranged in the bounding wall, a conveying belt is driven by a second motor and arranged on the lower portion of the cage, the first motor and the second motor are electricallyconnected, the controller is in communication connection with a wireless data transmission device, and the wireless data transmission device is in wireless communication connection with a mobile phone of a feeder. According to the black bone sheep feeding sheepfold, the labor amount of the feeder can be greatly reduced when the meat quality of black bone sheep is ensured.

title: LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, LIVESTOCK BARN, LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM, AND LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT METHOD
abstract: A livestock information management system (100) is provided with: an imaging unit (10) for acquiring image data for a prescribed area (A) wherein livestock (501, 502, 503 … 525) to which identification information (T1, T2, T3, ...T25) is attached can move; an identification information acquisition unit 22 for acquiring the identification information (T1, T2, T3, ... T25) for each of the livestock (501, 502, 503, … 525) on the basis of the image data for the prescribed area (A); a position information acquisition unit (23) for acquiring position information for each of the livestock (501, 502, 503 … 525) on the basis of the image data for the prescribed area A; and an information storage unit (25) for storing the identification information (T1, T2, T3, ...T25) and the position information in associated fashion for each of the livestock (501, 502, 503, … 525).

title: NBIOT/5G signal channel collar instrument for livestock in pasturing area and management and application method
abstract: The invention provides an NBIOT/5G signal channel collar instrument for livestock in a pasturing area. The collar instrument comprises a collar instrument unit, a weight monitoring unit, a grassland information unit, NB-IOT communication modules, a 5G communication module, a server, a control mainframe and a management and control platform. The collar instrument is characterized in that the collarinstrument unit and the weight monitoring unit are provided with the NB-IOT communication modules, the grassland information unit is provided with the 5G communication module, and the collar instrument unit, the weight monitoring unit and the grassland information unit communicate with the management and control platform. A collar instrument body is embedded into the inner side of an elastic collar, a collar controller is installed in the collar instrument body, and the collar controller communicates with the serer through the NB-IOT communication modules. A pedometer, an information input module and a GPS or Beidou positioning module in the collar controller are connected to the input end of the collar controller, the NB-IOT communication modules are connected to the output end of the collar controller, a lithium battery is in circuit connection with the collar controller, and an LED lamp is in circuit connection with the collar controller.

title: Livestock monitoring system
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock monitoring system comprising: a plurality of sensor units each mounted on a plurality of pieces of livestock grazing in a pasture to measure a biometric signal or the movement of the livestock and transmit the measured data together with identification information of the livestock; a repeater receiving the identification information of the livestock and the measured data from the sensor units and transmitting the same to a management server; a mobile unit installed in the repeater to move the repeater; and a control unit controlling the mobile unit so that the repeater can receive the identification information of the livestock and the measured data from the sensor units distributed in the pasture and the repeater can be moved within the pasture. According to the present invention, the livestock monitoring system can easily collect data from the sensor units attached to the livestock distributed in the pasture as the repeater is moved within the pasture by the mobile unit.

title: Data processing method of acceleration sensor for livestock monitoring
abstract: The present invention relates to a data processing method for an acceleration sensor for monitoring livestock, which comprises: a data reception step of receiving measurement information from an acceleration sensor disposed on a body of livestock to measure body movement of livestock to be measured; a data arrangement step of arranging measurement information received from the acceleration sensor in the order of time; and an analysis step of analyzing the number of times in which the movement direction of the body of livestock is changed based on the information arranged in the data arrangement step. According to the present invention, direction changes in movement are calculated from the data provided from the acceleration sensor disposed on the body of livestock, and analyzed, thereby providing an advantage of correctly checking a state of livestock which does not largely move.

title: IMPROVING DETECTION, PREVENTION, AND REACTION IN A WARNING SYSTEM FOR ANIMAL FARROWING OPERATIONS
abstract: A detector (110) for detecting a signal from one or more feeders (104). A processor (118, 119, 300) is in communication with the can be configured with an artificial intelligence module and a library of prerecorded action events and for comparing the signal with the library of pre-recorded action events and determining a likely action event. A warning device (130) can be in communication with the processor (118, 119, 300) for providing an output in response to the likely action event. At least one false positive sensor in communication with either the processor (118, 119, 300) or the warning device (130) or both of the processor (118, 119, 300) and the warning device (130) can be used for stopping the output from the warning device (130) upon a predetermined condition.

title: METHOD OF DETECTING AND DETERMINING STRESS IN POULTRY BASED ON EXPRESSION OF HSP70 IN GROWING FEATHERS
abstract: This invention relates generally to a method of detecting and determining stress in poultry based on expression of HSP70 in growing feathers. More particularly, the invention relates to a non-invasive and accurate process to evaluate stress levels, such as from environmental heat or cold, transport, and/or feed restriction, in poultry species, such as broiler chickens, layers, turkeys, breeders, and/or quail. The method uses feather HSP70 expression as a non-invasive marker for stress in poultry species, and also provides for a method to rapidly evaluate and continuously monitor dynamic change and time-course stress induced by stress load in the same individual poultry.

title: Beef cattle breeding method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of beef cattle breeding, and specifically relates to a beef cattle breeding method. According to the invention, step recording chips are embedded into thelegs of cattle, each step recording chip is equipped with a unique ID number, and a central processing unit collects data of the step recording chips so as to be used for calculating the exercise amount of each head of cattle; a weighbridge is installed at the access of a cattle housing to weigh the weight of the cattle when going out of and returning back to the cattle housing every day, the difference of the weight of the cattle when going out of and returning back to the cattle housing is calculated, whether the cattle are full or sick is detected according to the weight difference; different standards of exercise steps are set for the cattle, whether the exercise of the cattle exceeds or does not reach the standard is monitored in real time so as to detect whether the exercise amount of the cattle is appropriate and matched with the weight of the cattle or not, thereby preventing the occurrence of excessively fast consumption of nutrients in the body of the beef cattle or poor physical condition of the cattle to result in slow growing rate of the beef cattle, prolongation of putting the beef cattle to the slaughter market and reduction of economic benefits of farmers.
applicants: GUIZHOU FENGGANG HONGFENG ECOLOGICAL AGRICULTURE COMPREHENSIVE DEVELOPMENT COMPANY

title: Internet-based drinking water system
abstract: The invention discloses an Internet-based drinking water system. Via the system, a mobile phone can be used to observe situation of pigs in real time through a camera. A water quantity in a drinking water basin can be monitored in real time through the mobile phone, and the drinking water basin can be heated to ensure temperature of drinking water. When the water quantity in the drinking basin islow, heating is automatically stopped, and the drinking water basin can be protected from being burnt.
applicants: ZHAOQING TIANMU NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: DRONE FOR MANAGEMENT OF SMART FARM
abstract: The present invention relates to a drone for managing a smart farm, which acquires biological information of livestock and provides a proper nutritional supplement or attracts the livestock infected with an infectious disease with bait to move the livestock to an isolation place in accordance with a health state. Moreover, a coating material containing an antibacterial material is coated on a feed storage unit to remove the possibility of propagating harmful bacteria, thereby increasing feed storage stability. Moreover, an anti-slip pad is applied to a feed supply unit, thereby increasing supply efficiency. According to the present invention, the drone comprises: a drone body; a drone wing; an RFID recognition unit installed on the rear part of the drone wing; a sensor box installed on the rear end of the drone body and including a skin temperature sensor, a skin electric conductivity sensor, and a pulse wave sensor; a camera installed on the front surface part of the drone body and photographing an eyeball, a tongue, and a nose of livestock; a memory card storing data collected through the RFID recognition unit, the sensor box, and the camera; a communication unit transmitting the data stored in the memory card and receiving a calculated health index; the feed storage unit installed in the drone body and including a storage section and an outlet; the feed supply unit installed on the lower part of the drone body and supplying feed discharged from the outlet of the feed storage unit; and a control unit recognizing a body portion of livestock to control photographing of the camera and operating the feed storage unit and the feed supply unit in accordance with the health index received by the communication unit.

title: Livestock drinking water information collecting device, system and method
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock drinking water information collecting device, system and method. The livestock drinking water information collecting device comprises a water tank and a reader installed to the water tank. Drinking water mouths having a preset flow rate are arranged on the side wall of the water tank. The livestock are provided with trigger members adapted to the reader. The reader is capable of recognizing the respective trigger members of the livestock when the livestock are drinking water at the drinking water mouths. The livestock drinking water information collecting device can collect drinking water information of the livestock to find abnormal livestock, facilitate timely detection of mass epidemics and take timely measures, and can also perform data traceabilityin the whole process through the drinking water information collection of the livestock.

title: Web-based live pig feeding remote monitoring system and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a web-based live pig feeding remote monitoring system and a control method thereof. The web-based live pig feeding remote monitoring system comprises a data acquisition module,an equipment server, a database server and a browser terminal module; the data acquisition module comprises a LoRa concentrator and a GPRS for being responsible for data transmission, a plurality ofterminal data are collected, the networking is simple, the transmission distance is long, and the power consumption is low; the equipment server is used for transmitting field parameters, pig individual information and alarm information, and the database server is used for storing and modifying parameters, and drawing the collected historical information into a curve graph, so that the growth condition of the pigs can be observed conveniently; the browser terminal module is used for realizing the feeding and adjusting and checking of the abnormal situation of the pigs by the working staff, sothat a farmer can check the individual information of the pigs in real time, and intelligent feeding of healthy breeding is realized. According to the system, live pigs are monitored in real time, andthe eating state of each pig is recorded; and whether abnormal conditions exist or not can be observed, the abnormal conditions can be timely treated to ensure that the live pigs are in a good growthstate, so that the system can be well adapted to meet pig farm breeding requirements.

title: Meishan pig estrus monitoring method based on acoustic information
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal estrus monitoring, and particularly relates to a meishan pig estrus monitoring method based on acoustic information. The method comprises the steps that a meishan pig estrus acoustic signal and the sound made by the sniffling, eating, screaming, mumbling and ear moving of other pigs in a pig farm environment are firstly collected, pre-processing is conducted on the pig acoustic signal through multi-window spectrum Wiener speech enhancement based on wavelet thresholding and double-threshold end-point detection based on short-time energy, and the denoising and effective signal detection of pig acoustic signal are achieved; the time-and-frequency domain features of the pig acoustic signal are analyzed by using a time-and-frequency analyzing method and a short-time analyzing technology, 1352-dimension of meishan pig acoustic features in total of 300-dimension short-time energy, 300-dimension short-time zero crossing rate, 32-dimensionsub band frequency range energy ratio based on six-layer wavelet decomposing and 720-dimension Vermeer cepstral coefficients which are standardized by a time wrapping algorithm are extracted; the recognition of meishan pig estrus sound performed by a depth belief network (DBN) is constructed. The method has the advantages that the estrus period of the meishan pig is accurately judged to help the timely conception of sows, achieve the propagation potential of the sows and improve economical benefits.
applicants: WUHAN RED STAR INTELLIGENT AGRI-TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; HUAZHONG AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY

title: Intelligent control system for pasture
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent control system for a pasture. The system includes a stirring mechanism, a feeding pipe and a fodder loading mechanism. The stirring mechanism is fixedly installed on the ground through a lifting bracket, the bottom of the stirring mechanism is fixedly connected with the feeding pipe, the fodder loading mechanism is fixedly connected to the side, away from thestirring mechanism, of the feeding pipe, and a fodder partition chamber is internally and movably provided with a discharge impeller; a motor is fixedly mounted at the bottom of the fodder partitionchamber, pressing rods are fixedly mounted on each pressing plate, the pressing plates are movably mounted on troughs, and extrusion springs are fixedly mounted between the pressing plates and the troughs. Fodder for different kinds of livestock can be stirred and uniformly mixed and can be added into each trough without moving the fodder loading mechanism, the dining process of milk cows is not influenced during addition of the fodder, the dining condition of the livestock can be monitored, and therefore sick livestock can be found out in time. The system is simple in structure, convenient tomaintain in the later period and suitable for popularization.

title: Real-time embedded equipment for animal step counting and positioning in animal husbandry
abstract: The invention relates to real-time embedded equipment for animal step counting and positioning in animal husbandry, and belongs to the field of animal physical sign monitoring in animal husbandry. Theequipment is bound on a waist and back part of an animal. When the animal walks, information of acceleration can be acquired through a six-axis gyroscope module, and step counting information is obtained after denoising is carried out by a single-chip microcomputer. On one hand, the step counting information is displayed through an organic light emitting diode (OLED) screen, on the other hand, the step counting information is uploaded to a LoRa base station in real time through a LoRa communication module, and the LORA base station transmits the step counting information to a cloud server through a general packet radio service (GPRS) communication mode. The step counting information can be used as a basic measurement standard for health conditions livestock breeding animals, physiologicalexcitation states of animals can be monitored dynamically in real time, and the step counting information can be used as basic data of aspects such as epidemic situation prediction, feeding method feedback and the like. The step counting information can also serve as a basic data source of source tracing information of meat of the livestock breeding animals, and meat health conditions are provided to consumers. The equipment has the advantages that cost is low, real-time performance is good, the device can be used repeatedly, energy and power can be saved, and the like.
applicants: YUNNAN YUNSHANGYUN BIG DATA INDUSTRY DEVELOPMENT COMPANY; YUNNAN XIAORUN TECHNOLOGY SERVICE COMPANY; KMUST (KUNMING UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY)

title: METHOD FOR REDUCING THE INDIVIDUAL-SPECIFIC MILK PRODUCTION OF MILK-PRODUCING ANIMALS
abstract: The invention relates to a method for milking a milk-producing animal, in particular a cow. According to this method, a target milk quantity which is lower than a possible expected milk quantity is determined. The milking process is carried out. During milking, the milked quantity is determined. The milked quantity is compared with the target milk quantity. Milking is terminated when the milked quantity corresponds substantially to the target milk quantity.

title: Local pig breeding monitoring method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a local pig breeding monitoring method and system. The method comprises the following steps: the breeding information of local pigs purchased by consumers is recorded to obtainthe breeding monitoring information; the breeding monitoring information is transmitted to a cloud server, and the cloud server generates a live broadcast link; the live broadcast link is received from the cloud server; and the live broadcast link is transmitted to a terminal used by the consumer to enable the consumer to watch the breeding monitoring information through the live broadcast link.The scheme disclosed in the invention is a breeding technology covering the whole production chain of local pig breeding, the consumers can directly see the growth situation, the feeding condition andthe epidemic prevention situation of the local pigs purchased by them, thus ensuring the quality of the local pork purchased by the consumers, and making the consumers feel at ease.

title: SYSTEMS, METHODS, AND APPARATUSES FOR ANIMAL WEIGHT MONITORING AND MANAGEMENT
abstract: Systems, methods, or apparatuses for animal weight monitoring/managing may comprise at least an identification tag detector, weight sensors, a platform, a localized computing device/remote server, an animal profile database, an analysis module, and/or a graphical user interface. In some examples, the systems, methods, and/or apparatuses may determine an identifier from an identification tag and associate, based on analysis from the analysis module, the identifier with a weight value determined from a weight signal received from the one or more weight sensors. The systems, methods, or apparatuses may improve weight monitoring and management of animals (e.g., bovine cattle) by providing interactive elements for monitoring the weight(s) of one or more animals associated with one or more identifiers, filtering the one more animals into groups for supplier, competitor, and animal health analysis, and presents the results in a manner that improves comprehension of the data and enables scheduling follow-up processes.

title: A method and a system for collecting and grouping animal body conditions based on RFID
abstract: The invention provides a method and a system for collecting and grouping animal body condition based on RFID. The method for collecting and grouping animal body condition comprises the following steps: detecting whether an animal enters a weight collecting area; if the animal enters the weight collecting area, opening an inlet door; if the animal enters the weight collecting area, opening the inlet door; scanning the electronic ear tag of the animal entering the weight collection area to identify the identification information of the animal; collection of animal weight data located in the weight collection area; opening an exit door and a corresponding grouping door according to the weight data of the animals for grouping the animals; after detecting an animal exiting through the herding door, control the herding door to close and control the inlet door to open, allowing the next animal to enter the weight collection area. The invention improves the efficiency of animal grouping by collecting animal weight data and automatically grouping animals according to the weight data.

title: SYSTEM FOR MEASURING, MONITORING AND MANAGING FEED INTAKE TO DETERMINE FEED EFFICIENCY OF INDIVIDUAL ANIMALS OF A DAIRY HERD
abstract: A feeding system for measuring, monitoring and managing feed intake to determine feed efficiency of individual animals of a dairy herd. The feeding system includes at least one feed trough that contains feed to be consumed by the individual animals of the dairy herd. At least one load cell is coupled to the at least one feed trough for detecting a weight of the feed contained within the at least one feed trough. Lifting assemblies support the at least one load cell. The lifting assemblies can be actuated to move the at least one load cell and the at least one feed trough between a set feeding position, in which the individual animals consume the amount of feed contained within the feed trough, and a pivoted discharge position in which the amount of feed is discharged from the feed trough.

title: PASTURE SATELLITE MEASUREMENTS
abstract: In one embodiment, a method implemented on a computing device for visualizing an amount of pasture available for grazing by livestock in a farm including one or more paddocks is provided. The method includes: receiving data relevant to the particular farm, the data comprising at least satellite data of the farm and a georeferenced map identifying the one or more paddocks of the farm; processing the satellite data using at least the georeferenced map; and generating a graphical user interface using the processed data, the graphical user interface comprising at least one biomass value representation of the farm, the biomass value representation being indicative of an amount of pasture available for grazing by livestock for each or some of the one or more paddocks of the farm.

title: Pig house with monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a pig house with a monitoring system. The pig house with the monitoring system comprises monitoring camera components, shock-proof components, slide rods, slide shells, fixingcomponents, motor shells, slide grooves, fixing blocks, connecting rods, conveying belts, gears and motors. Each monitoring camera component comprises a light shield, a monitoring camera body, a rotary clamping sleeve, a rotary disk, a monitoring camera base, a rotary groove and a rotary rod, the rotating disk is fixed to one side of the monitoring camera base through a screw, the rotary clampingsleeve is fixed to one side of the rotary disk through a screw, and the rotary rod is fixed to the center of one end of the rotary clamping sleeve through a screw. The pig house with the monitoring system has the advantages that the pig house is simple in structure and convenient to operate, and monitoring camera bodies can rotate by 180 degrees through adjustment of the rotary disks and the rotary rods; the motors drive the conveying belts to enable the monitoring camera bodies to move horizontally, monitoring blind angles caused by sundry blockage in the pig house are avoided, and accordingly the pig house is wider in monitoring range and can be monitored conveniently.
applicants: JIAHE GUANGFA AGRICULTURE AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY COMPANY

title: Heat dissipation index of livestock and poultry bodies and prevention scheme of livestock and poultry climate stress risk
abstract: The invention discloses a heat dissipation index of livestock and poultry bodies and a prevention scheme of livestock and poultry climate stress risk. The disclosed index CTI=C0-(0.026+0.564 W+0.0181delta t*W)*delta t*V. According to the physical characteristics of the influence of three main physical factors of temperature, humidity and wind power on the heat dissipation, the heat dissipation index and algorithm of the livestock and poultry bodies for evaluating the influence of the environment on the heat dissipation of the bodies are constructed. According to the invention, based on the magnitude of the heat dissipation index CTI of the livestock and poultry, the environmental climate is classified into three types of cold stress, suitable stress and heat stress, and in each type, thegrading design is carried out according to the climate heat dissipation index based on to the potential risk of causing the stress, according to the classification system, the corresponding measures are established, in the aspects of physiology, nutrition, environmental sanitation reform, drug prevention, and the like, the health of livestock and poultry and the quality of livestock and poultry products are ensured.

title: Intelligent breeding pig weighing and automatic grouping and screening machine
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent breeding pig weighing and automatic grouping and screening machine. The machine comprises outer fences, wherein an inner fence is arranged between the two outerfence, a feed trough is arranged in the inner fence, the front sides of the two outer fences are respectively provided with fence doors, the rear side of the left outer fence is provided with a left fence drinking water area, the rear side of the right side outer fence is provided with a right fence drinking water area, a left side of the inner fence is provided with a left fence one-way inlet door, the right side of the inner fence is provided with a right fence one-way inlet door, a control box is arranged on the rear side of the inner fence, a passage is arranged in the middle of the rear side of the inner fence, a passage scale is arranged on the floor of the passage, an electronic ear tag card reader is arranged on the side part of the passage, and a one-way rotating door is arrangedat the connecting position of the rear side of the inner fence and the passage. The intelligent breeding pig weighing and automatic grouping and screening machine has the advantages that the activityspace of breeding pigs is large, the breeding pigs freely eat feed and grow fast, measurement cost of a breeding farm is greatly reduced, breeding pigs with fast growth are screened out, and the breeding level of the breeding pigs are increased.

title: System for collecting pig food-intake of pig house
abstract: The invention discloses a system for collecting pig food-intake of a pig house. The system comprises a feeding channel, a controller, a gravity sensor, a RFID reader, and a RFID label. Only a single pig can pass through the feeding channel according to a size of the feeding channel. The tail end of the feeding channel is provided with a feeding port. Only the head of the single pig can enter the feeding port according to a size of the feeding port. The upper side of the feeding port is provided with the RFID reader, and the lower side of the feeding port is provided with a feeding trough. Thegravity sensor is used for detecting a weight of a feed in the feeding trough. The controller is connected with the RFID reader and the gravity sensor. The RFID label is used for storing individual information of the live pig and installed on the head of the corresponding live pig. The system is capable of, through combining a RFID technology and the gravity sensor, detecting the pig food-intake,avoiding an administrator from frequently entering and exiting the pig house so as to cause stress response of a pig group, and reducing a propagation probability of infectious diseases. In addition,the RFID reader is installed on the feeding port through which the live pig passes necessarily during feeding, short in distance away from the RFID label, and beneficial to identify more accurately.

title: Intelligent feeding trough device and pig house management method based on same
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent feeding trough device and a pig house management method based on the same. The intelligent feeding trough device comprises a PLC control device, a push rod motor, a material pushing baffle, and a feed tray. A machine frame is placed on the ground. The push rod motor is connected with the material pushing baffle and installed on a sliding rail at two sides ofthe feed tray. The feed tray is provided with a first weight sensor. One side, along a material pushing direction, of the feed tray is provided with a sliding rail and connected with a feeding troughthrough the sliding rail. The feeding trough is provided with a second weight sensor. The PLC control device is installed on the machine frame and connected with the push rod motor, the first weight sensor and the second weight sensor through a signal line. Daily food-intake of a pig is accurately known, and a physiological cycle of the pig or disease warning is accurately controlled through a practical food-intake and food-intake arithmetic mean value dual fitted line in combination with experiences of related managers, so pig feeding is more scientific.

title: Intelligent water drinking device and pig house management method based on same
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent water drinking device and a pig house management method based on the same. The intelligent water drinking device comprises a PLC control device, a push rod motor, a piston, and a first guide pipe. A machine frame is placed on the ground. The push rod motor is connected with the piston and installed on a second guide pipe at two sides of the first guide pipe.The first guide pipe is provided with a first weight sensor. One side, along a material pushing direction, of the first guide pipe is provided with the second guide pipe and connected with a water tank through the second guide pipe. The water tank is provided with a second weight sensor. The PLC control device is installed on the machine frame and connected with the push rod motor, the first weight sensor and the second weight sensor through a signal line. Daily water-intake of a pig is accurately known, and a physiological cycle of the pig or disease warning is accurately controlled through apractical water-intake and water-intake root mean square average dual fitted line in combination with experiences of related managers, so pig feeding is more scientific.

title: DEVICE FOR LOCATING OBJECT IN ANIMAL ACCOMMODATION FACILITY
abstract: To detect an object quickly and reliably in an animal housing system in a practically useful and economical manner.SOLUTION: The present invention is related to an animal surveillance device for detecting a stationary object in a poultry house. The device comprises a noncontact scanner adapted to emit electromagnetic radiation in a scanner and to receive a reflection of the electromagnetic radiation and an electronic evaluation unit which is in signal communication with the scanner and adapted to evaluate the signals received from the scanner. The scanner includes at least one scanner unit comprising a transmitter for transmitting an electromagnetic scanning beam in a predetermined direction and a receiver for receiving a reflection of the scanning beam from the predetermined direction. The evaluation unit is configured to calculate a transit time signal from the reception of a reflected signal emitted from the scanner unit and from the transit time of the signal and to produce a transit time profile for the scanner unit from the transit time signal received over a period.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Wearing device of cow rumination behavior monitor
abstract: The invention discloses a wearing device of a cow rumination behavior monitor, and belongs to livestock breeding monitoring devices. An installation hole is formed in the middle of the bottom of an adjustable opening type flexible necklace, a wireless monitor installation protection shell is arranged at the bottom of the adjustable opening type flexible necklace through the installation hole, an adjustable buckle is arranged on an opening of the upper portion of the adjustable opening type flexible necklace so that the two ends of the opening of the adjustable opening type flexible necklace can be connected, and adjustable flexible ear rings are arranged at the portions, located on the left side and the right side of the adjustable buckle, of the outer portion of the upper side of the adjustable opening type flexible necklace respectively. By means of the wearing device, the wireless monitor can be accurately, stably and reliably arranged at the position, close to a rumination behaviorsound signal source, of a cow neck without being affected by cow physical actions, and the wearing device has the advantages of being simple in structure, easy and convenient to wear and install, stable and accurate in wearing position, high in comfort, high in applicability and precise and timely in detection information.

title: UWB (Ultra-wide Bandwidth) based alarming method and equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a UWB (Ultra-wide Bandwidth) based alarming method and equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time position data of different positioning tags within a preset time period on the basis of a UWB channel, wherein the positioning tags are arranged on livestock, and the real-time position data are used for indicating movement rangesand movement frequencies of the positioning tags; according to the real-time position data, confirming types of living evaluation data for evaluating living situations of the livestock, wherein the types of the living evaluation data comprise question data, suspected question data and normal data; and when the types of the living evaluation data are abnormal data, acquiring and outputting targettag IDs (Identities) of target positioning tags corresponding to the real-time position data. By adopting the method, the positioning tags are arranged on the livestock by using a UWB positioning system, position data of the livestock are acquired and analyzed on the basis of the UWB channel, then the living situations of the livestock can be confirmed, and furthermore intelligent breeding requirements of medium/small-size breeding farmers can be met.
applicants: ARMY ENGINEERING UNIVERSITY OF CHINA PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR DETERMINING A CONDITION OF AT LEAST ONE PIG IN A PEN
abstract: Method (100,200) and system (1) for determining a condition of at least one pig (3) in a pen (5) provided with a feed unit (7). The pen (5) is provided with a sensor system (11). For carrying out the method (100,200), a step (101,102,103,104,105) a., step (101,102,103,104,105) b. or a combination of steps a. and b. is possible. In a step (101,102,103,104,105) a., with the aid of the sensor system (11) a reaction of the at least one pig (3) is measured. This is done when with the feed unit (7) feed is made available in the pen (5) to the at least one pig (3) to determine on the basis of the measured reaction a condition of the at least one pig (3). In a step (101,102,103,104,105) b., with the aid of the sensor system (11) it is measured that the at least one pig (3) 'demands' feed to determine a condition of the at least one pig (3).

title: ANIMAL MANAGEMENT TAG CONFIGURED TO BE WORN BY AN ANIMAL
abstract: Animal management tag and system of carrier and tag, where the tag is configured to be worn by an animal, such as an ear stud, bolus, leg tag, neck tag and a tail tag. The tag is provided with at least one first sensor for performing a measurement on the animal. The tag is further provided with a processor connected with the at least one first sensor, at least for processing measuring results which have been obtained with the aid of the at least one first sensor. The tag is further also provided with a transmitting device connected with the processor, for transmitting information generated by the processor. The processor is configured to process the measuring results, whereby the manner of processing depends on the manner in which the tag, in use, is applied.

title: Smell monitoring system for mutton sheep mating
abstract: The invention discloses a smell monitoring system for mutton sheep mating, and solves the problem that a best mating time can be missed through observation by people. The smell monitoring system comprises a sheep house, and a plurality of compartments are arranged in the sheep house. The compartments are characterized in that four sides of each compartment are provided with smell detectors, and asmell detector is also worn on the body of each mutton sheep, wherein the compartments, the smell detectors and the mutton sheep are all provided with corresponding serial numbers. Each smell detectorcomprises a power circuit, a heating circuit, a sensor signal acquisition circuit, a voltage conversion circuit, a data processing unit and an upper computer. The smell monitoring system has the advantages that the monitoring precision is high, male sheep can be screened out specifically, and the like.
applicants: YIBIN CHENGLE SHEEP BREEDING PROFESSIONAL COOPERATIVE

title: Smell monitoring system for mutton sheep mating
abstract: The invention discloses a smell monitoring system for mutton sheep mating, and solves the problem that a best mating time can be missed through observation by people. The smell monitoring system comprises a sheep house, and a plurality of compartments are arranged in the sheep house. The compartments are characterized in that four sides of each compartment are provided with smell detectors, and asmell detector is also worn on the body of each mutton sheep, wherein the compartments, the smell detectors and the mutton sheep are all provided with corresponding serial numbers. Each smell detectorcomprises a power circuit, a heating circuit, a sensor signal acquisition circuit, a voltage conversion circuit, a data processing unit and an upper computer. The smell monitoring system has the advantages that the monitoring precision is high, male sheep can be screened out specifically, and the like.
applicants: YIBIN CHENGLE SHEEP BREEDING PROFESSIONAL COOPERATIVE

title: Intelligent acquisition system for welfare production information of parturition sow
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent acquisition system for welfare production information of a parturition sow. The intelligent acquisition system comprises a feeding pen and a collection system used for connecting the feeding pen and for acquiring the production information of the parturition sow, wherein the feeding pen comprises a sow water-drinking bowl, a sow trough, piglet water-drinking bowls, piglet troughs, a pen body support, a fence and a manure leakage floor; an anti-press device is arranged on the manure leakage floor; a gap is remained between the edge of the manure leakage floor and the pen body support; a weighing sensor is arranged below the manure leakage floor; the fence comprises a sow fence and piglet fences; the piglet fences are respectively located at two sides ofthe sow fence; the sow fence and the manure leakage floor constitute a sow feeding space; and the piglet fences, the sow fence and the manure leakage floor constitute a piglet feeding space. The intelligent acquisition system provided by the invention can acquire the weight data of the parturition sow in the process of feeding, does not need to drive the parturition sow in the weight acquisitionprocess of the parturition sow, does not cause physical damage and psychological fear to the parturition sow, and does not need to move the fence and the manure leakage floor .

title: Adjustable neck frame suitable for sheep of different ages
abstract: The invention discloses an adjustable neck frame suitable for sheep of different ages. The adjustable neck frame comprises vertical fixing rods, wherein the first vertical fixing rod is internally provided with limiting holes, an upper neck frame and a lower neck frame are respectively inserted and connected at the central positions, corresponding to the limiting holes, of the inside of the firstvertical fixing rod, the upper neck frame is located above the lower neck frame, the other end of the upper neck frame and the other end of the lower neck frame are respectively inserted and connectedin the second vertical fixing rod, a control box is fixedly installed at the top of the second vertical fixing rod, a control panel is arranged in the control box, a timer is fixedly installed at theposition, close to the lower portion, of the control panel, in the control box, a charging port is formed in the position, close to the lower portion of the timer, in the control box, and a camera isfixedly installed at the top of the control box. By regulating the length of the upper neck frame, the upper neck frame is conveniently inserted into different limiting holes, accordingly the separation distance between the upper neck frame and the lower neck frame is adjusted to make the adjustable neck frame to be suitable for sheep of different ages.

title: Automatic monitoring system for livestock safety production
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic monitoring system for livestock safety production. The system comprises a livestock fixator, an animal marking device, an animal conveying cage, automatic livestock coding registration software and a livestock quarantining device with the function of body temperature abnormality automatic alarming. According to the technical scheme, the system is characterizedby further comprising a production process automatic monitoring device for links in the production process, and the monitoring device, the automatic livestock coding registration software and the livestock quarantining device are all supported by the internet. The system is applied to monitoring the livestock growth process, the management measures, the livestock immunity condition, the medicine consumption condition, epidemic disease records and convenient use and management of each link of the livestock production process can be checked in real time, and the good popularization value is obtained.
applicants: BAZHONG REPUTATION ABUNDANT AGRICULTURAL SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Cattle herd monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a cattle herd monitoring system. The system includes first vibration detecting devices, first timers, first controllers, first clocks, first communicators, second vibration detecting devices, second timers, counters, second clocks, second controllers, second communicators, an alarm, a third controller and a third communicator, wherein the first vibration detecting devices,the first timers, the first controllers, the first clocks and the first communicators are located at the lower jaws of cattle, the second vibration detecting devices, the second timers, the counters,the second clocks, the second controllers and the second communicators are located at the left jugular grooves of the cattle, and the alarm, the third controller and the third communicator are locatedon a cowshed. Through the arrangement of the vibration detecting devices and timers at the lower jaw and left jugular groove of the cattle, the body conditions of the cattle can be accurately monitored, real-time monitoring on a cattle herd can be realized, the yield of milk and the survival rates of the cattle can be enhanced, and economic benefits can be increased.

title: Cattle herd monitoring method
abstract: The invention discloses a cattle herd monitoring method, which comprises the following steps of: detecting belching of cattle, setting a threshold value according to the feeding time of the cattle, comparing the threshold value with a detected numerical value, and further judging whether the feeding and growth of the cattle need to be intervened or not. According to the cattle herd monitoring method provided by the invention, various behaviors of cattle are detected, and a comprehensive, objective and detailed management and control method is set, so that cattle herds can be monitored in realtime, the yield of milk and the survival rate of the cattle are increased, and the economic benefit is increased.

title: Large-scale-commercial-pig-farm digital monitoring information application method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a large-scale-commercial-pig-farm digital monitoring information application method. The large-scale-commercial-pig-farm digital monitoring information application method includes the steps that live-pig data indexes are collected, and a database is established; value ranges of the data indexes are determined, and an associated database of the data indexes and values is established; abnormal indexes or states are extracted, causes of abnormal conditions and risk are analyzed, historical data and reports are compared and analyzed, and the space-time rule when the abnormal conditions of live-pig breeding occur is explored; according to analysis results, analysis reports are written, and a warning is given. According to the large-scale-commercial-pig-farm digital monitoring information application method in the technical scheme, by establishing the database, the live-pig breeding states and the risk are analyzed and evaluated, the abnormal states in live-pig breeding are discovered in time, the warning is given, and practical application and production guidance of live-pig-breeding monitoring information are achieved. The invention also discloses a large-scale-commercial-pig-farm digital monitoring information application system.
applicants: GUANGDONG GUANGKEN ANIMAL HUSBANDRY ENGINEERING RESEARCH INSTITUTE COMPANY

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD OF ESTIMATING LIVESTOCK WEIGHT
abstract: A system and method for estimating livestock weight is described. Embodiments of the system can include a computing device and a three-dimensional tag configured to be secured to an animal. One or more images of an animal, including the three-dimensional tag, can be processed to take various measurements of the animal. A scaling factor for the measurements can be based on the three-dimensional tag. After the measurement are calibrated, a weight of the animal can be estimated based on the calibrated measurements.

title: Airtight poultry brooder house, intelligent monitoring and automatic control system thereof, and poultry house for collecting big data related to growth factor correlation and conforming to biological control safety capable of enabling the poultry farmers a to obtain instant and accurate information for making correct and efficient judgment and to perform immediate and effective treatment and solve the problems for improving the quality of poultry farming
abstract: The present invention relates to an airtight poultry brooder house, and an intelligent monitoring and automatic control system thereof that collects big data related to growth factor correlation. The intelligent monitoring and automatic control system includes: at least one detection module disposed in a processing unit for generating a farming area data according to the airtight state of at least one poultry farming area; at least one control module disposed in the processing unit, wherein each of the at least one control module is provided with a processing unit automatic control rule and used to automatically control the desired airtight state for the farming environment of the at least one poultry farming area according to the processing unit automatic control rule and the farming area data to make the at least one poultry farming area present a negative pressure state; and a database configured to store the farming area data via the processing unit, and automatically generate a plurality of analytical data according to the farming area data and the airtight state of the at least one poultry farming area, so as to compute the best farming mode. The spray planning of interior and exterior of each poultry house are automatically controlled to isolate epidemic situation, so as to reduce the possibility of infection through air or human body. As a result, this invention can reduce the dependence on the manpower of on-site workers and enable the poultry farmers or relevant management personnel of the farming area to obtain instant and accurate information for making correct and efficient judgment and to perform immediate and effective treatment and solve the problems, thereby improving the quality of poultry farming.

title: Camera shooting system adopting mobile phone APP remote control
abstract: The invention discloses a camera shooting system adopting mobile phone APP remote control. The camera shooting system comprises a farm, wherein a supporting column is arranged at the edge of the top of the farm, a solar photovoltaic power generation plate is arranged at the top end of the supporting column, a telescopic ceiling capable of covering the farm is arranged at the middle part of the supporting column, and a bottom plate is arranged at the bottom of the farm. According to the camera shooting system, the telescopic ceiling designed can reasonably adjust the illumination intensity of the farm, a pest trapping and killing device arranged at the bottom plate can trap and kill pests (such as snakes, flies, mosquitoes and the like) trying to enter the farm, fully ensuring the normal life of the mutton sheep, and a non-contact infrared thermometer is arranged to detect the body temperature of the mutton sheep in real time and the physical condition of the mutton sheep in time; a heating device and a heat preservation device are also arranged in a food trough, the food temperature in cold days is basically low, so food can be eaten more easily by means of heating and heat preservation. Moreover, the excrement can be quickly and thoroughly cleaned away through the matching use of an excrement cleaning push plate and a sheep noise expelling device.

title: Mobile smart internet of things electric measuring vehicle
abstract: The invention provides a mobile smart internet of things electric measuring vehicle. The vehicle comprises an electric chassis, a livestock scale, a detection cage, a measuring grating, a depth of field stereo camera and an industrial computer; the livestock scale is used for weighing the weight of tested livestock in the detection cage; the measuring grating feeds the distance between a beam farthest from the livestock of beams which are not received by a light receiver and the upper surface of the livestock scale as the height of the measured livestock to the industrial computer; the depth of field camera is placed at the top of the detection cage, the tested livestock in the detection cage is shot from the above to form and send a three-dimensional image to the industrial computer, andthe industrial computer receives the three-dimensional image sent by the depth of field camera and introduces the image into a deep learning module to calculate the body length and body width of the tested livestock. The vehicle constructs the special detection cage, detects an overhead profile based on a depth image, uses a deep learning OPEN CV computer vision algorithm to accurately measure height key points through an infrared beam, comprehensively analyzes, and quickly and accurately detects the physiological and physical information of breeding pigs.
applicants: NANJING ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND POULTRY SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE (NANJING LIVESTOCK VARIETY IMPROVEMENT STATION); JIANGSU THIRTY-THREE INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Ecosystem for large-scale breeding of mutton sheep
abstract: The invention provides an ecosystem for large-scale breeding of mutton sheep. The ecosystem comprises a sheep house, wherein a supporting column is arranged at the edge of the top part of the sheep house, the top end of the supporting column is provided with a solar photovoltaic power generation panel, a telescopic ceiling capable of shielding the sheep house is arranged at the middle part of thesupporting column, and the bottom part of the sheep house is provided with a bottom plate. The telescopic ceiling designed by the invention can reasonably adjust the illumination intensity of the sheep house, a pest trapping and killing device arranged on the bottom plate can trap and kill pests (such as snakes, flies, mosquitoes and the like) trying to enter the sheep house, thus the normal lifeof the mutton sheep is fully guaranteed, the ecosystem is further provided with a non-contact infrared thermometer which can detect body temperature of the mutton sheep in real time and timely discover the physical conditions of the mutton sheep, a heating device and a heat preservation device are further arranged in a food trough, so as to make food easier to eat through heating and heat preservation since the food temperature is low in the cold weather, and the manure can be cleaned quickly and thoroughly by using a manure cleaning push plate and a sheep repellent noise device in cooperation.
applicants: YIBIN CHENGLE SHEEP BREEDING PROFESSIONAL COOPERATIVE

title: Goat individual information collection and control device
abstract: The invention discloses a goat individual information collection and control device. On a two-dimensional plane composed of goat timeliness-event vertical-horizontal coordinates, a three-dimensional house position of each goat label is fixed according to the information of a certain type of goat, different types of goat labels are filled according to the goat label orientation house regional plans, and a goat farm bottom plate containing virtual goat houses is formed. Above the horizontal surface of a virtual goat farm, a fourth-dimensional transparent indicating top plate with the same size as the bottom plate and accurate alignment of longitude line scales and latitude line scales is arranged. The goat individual information collection and control device is created based on a four-dimensional structure. A micro camera is installed above the device to take pictures of entire contents of a four-dimensional management device, WeChat transmits images to a computer or mobile phone terminal, and a fifth-dimensional remote spatial interactive transmission method of full-farm goat individual information is established. Through the establishment of a technical service platform under the guidance of ''five-dimensional integration'', a technical management system in which science and technology special commissioners serve the sheep breeding industry in remote mountain villages in a refined manner is formed.

title: Live pig abnormal sound intelligent monitoring system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a live pig abnormal sound intelligent monitoring system and method. The system comprises a data acquisition layer, a data transmission layer and an intelligent monitoring layer. The data acquisition layer includes a pickup and an audio acquisition and encoding processor for collecting sounds in a pig house in real time and encoding collected signals; the data transmission layer transmits the collected sound signals to the intelligent monitoring layer through a wireless transceiver device; the intelligent monitoring layer includes a monitoring computer and an alarm device for processing, identifying and alarming the collected sound. The system has reasonable design, friendly human-computer interaction and high stability, improves the intelligent level of abnormal live pig monitoring, and reduces the degree of artificial dependence.

title: Sheep house breeding sheep feeding technology optimizing device based on internet of things data collection and method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a sheep house breeding sheep feeding technology optimizing device based on internet of things data collection. The device comprises colony house feeding sheep drinking water, ingestion feed, a lick brick, an internet of things data collection device for weighing, a colony house temperature sensor, a converter, and an internet of things data collection integration computer; diet behavior data collection supervisors, a weighing data collection supervisor, the colony house temperature sensor and the converter are in communication connection with the internet of things datacollection integration computer. A sheep house breeding sheep feeding technology optimizing method based on the device comprises the following steps of S1, collecting and recording sheep diet behaviordata and weighing data; S2, importing the sheet diet behavior data and weighing data; S3, importing or typing in sheep basic condition data; S4, importing or typing in feed putting data; S5, calculating the total sheep consumption cost and the sheep body weight unit weight gaining cost; S6, obtaining the best sheep feed putting data. The best sheep feeding method can be obtained, and the colony house sheet production benefits are improved.
applicants: CHABUCHAR COUNTY MERINO BREEDING AND BREEDING COMPANY; ZHEJIANG UNIVERSITY; XINJIANG FRUIT INDUSTRY GROUP COMPANY

title: Cow's Signs Detection System based on the Internet of Things
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for detecting an important bovine sign based on the Internet of things. According to the present invention, bovine behavior information and body temperature information are detected for each cow raised in a cattle shed. Whether the cow is in a mating period or a delivery period is distinguished and determined based on the detection and a cattle shed manager is provided with the information. The present invention includes: a body part-specific important signal detection member (200) attached to a body part of each cow (103) raised in a cattle shed (101), storing a cow-specific identification code identifying the cow, generating important sign determination information by detecting the body or behavior pattern of the cow, and wirelessly transmitting an important sign determination signal including the cow-specific identification code and the important sign determination information; a low-power wide area network (300) wirelessly receiving the important sign determination signal and relay-transmitting the signal; a cattle shed manager terminal (500) of a cattle shed manager managing the cattle (103) raised in the cattle shed (101); and an important sign management server (400) relay-receiving the important sign determination signal, analyzing the relay-received signal, and performing control such that the history of the important sign is transmitted to the cattle shed manager terminal (500) when the analyzed value corresponds to an important sign.

title: Automatic living pig measuring device and method
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic pigsty dividing device and method for living pigs. The device comprises a turntable and a controller, wherein the turntable is provided with a first channel, a plurality of pigsties are arranged around the turntable, one side of each pigsty is communicated with a second channel, and the turntable drives the first channel to be communicated with the second channels; gates are mounted on both the first channel and the second channels. A measuring device is mounted on the turntable and transmits a detected signal to the controller, and the controller controlsthe turntable and each gate. In order to solve problems, the device can automatically measure the length, height, width and body weight of the living pigs and allocates the living pigs into designated pigsties according to the data, and the automation and refinement of feeding management of the living pigs are achieved.

title: A method for monitoring abnormal diet of sheep raised in a barn based on Internet of Things data acquisition
abstract: The invention provides a method for monitoring abnormal diet of barn sheep based on Internet of Things data collection. The method comprises the following steps of S1) collecting diet behavior data; S2) importing or inputting basic condition data of the sheep; S3) establishing a diet behavior discrimination model; S4) judging whether the diet behavior of the sheep is normal or not; S5) updating the diet behavior discrimination model. The method has the advantages that through data collection and calculation judgment on water drinking, feed intake and licking brick diet behaviors of the sheep raised in the breeding house, the abnormal diet conditions are found out in time, measures are taken in time, the healthy growth of the sheep is guaranteed, and the requirement for refined production in large-scale breeding house raising is met.
applicants: QAPQAL AUTONOMOUS COUNTY MEILINU PEDIGREE BREEDING COMPANY; ZHEJIANG UNIVERSITY; XINJIANG FRUIT INDUSTRY GROUP COMPANY

title: Method for realizing meat batch information traceability based on QRcode
abstract: The invention relates to a method for realizing meat batch information traceability based on QRcode technology, and belongs to the technical field of commodity traceability. Based on the QRcode technology, the traceability requirement of meat information can be realized by adding the related subject information through the structured network address carried by QRcode two-dimensional code carried by meat. The main implementation steps are as follows: 1, the basic information registration is carried out in the process of breeding and pig harvesting; 2, that initial tracing two-dimensional code of the white stripe meat is printed in the slaughter step; 3, that subject information is added to the traceability two-dimensional code in the sales phase and upload the traceability information to the traceability system through the network; Fourthly, traceability two-dimensional code access traceability system data is scanned in food and beverage links to achieve meat information transparency. The invention has the advantages of realizing the product tracking and tracing of the whole process of meat and meat products from production and processing to sales, having the important characteristics of traceability of source, traceability of flow direction, traceability of information and traceability of responsibility, realizing one thing one code, tracing the whole process, and solving the safety problem of meat and meat products from the root.

title: A Injecting Apparatus for Living Stock and A System for Living Stock Using
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus for injecting an in vivo drug into livestock, a livestock management system using the same, and a management method using the same. The apparatus for injecting an in vivo drug into livestock comprises: a body portion which forms a body; a drug storage portion provided at the body portion and having a predetermined space therein to store a drug; a cooling portion provided at the drug storage portion to adjust a temperature of the drug; a drug injection portion connected with the drug storage portion and having a needle inserted into a skin of livestock; a first temperature sensor provided at the body portion to measure a temperature of a surface of the livestock; a second temperature sensor for measuring a temperature of the drug in the drug storage portion; a battery portion for supplying power; a communication portion for transmitting a signal of the first temperature sensor and the second temperature sensor to a server outside and receiving a signal of the server; and a control portion for controlling the cooling portion, the drug injection portion, the first temperature sensor, the second temperature sensor, and the communication portion.

title: Intelligent feeding device for large-scale livestock farm
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent feeding device of a large-scale livestock farm. The intelligent feeding device comprises a mobile platform, a feed stirring cavity and a wireless radio frequencyidentification system; the mobile platform is driven by walking wheels to move to the positions of separation fences of a livestock farm to be fed, the wireless radio frequency identification systemis installed on the mobile platform, a RFID positioning code reader reads information in a RFID radio frequency tag, and transmits theinformation to a wireless communication module; the wireless communication module is connected to a central processing unit, an analysis processing module is used for sending a result to a control module after data analysis; the control module controls an electromagnetic switch valve to open a material leakage outlet, according to command information, a weighing sensor weighs a predetermined amount of feed into the feed stirring cavity; after the mixed feed is uniformly mixed in the feed stirring cavity, the mixed feed enters an inclined material cavity through a discharge port, the front end of the inclined material cavity is connected with an elastic telescopic material cavity, a turnover motor drives a turnover shaft to turn over, and the turnover shaft drives a feeding outlet to be overturned to the positions of feed troughs of the separation fencesof the livestock farm, and the feed falls into the feed troughs from the elastic telescopic material cavity.

title: FEEDING CONTROL SYSTEM AND FEEDING CONTROL METHOD
abstract: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a feeding control system and a feeding control method that enable providing a dairy cow (pre-parturition cow) having a high risk of developing post-parturition disorders (e.g., ketosis) with a feed suitable for prevention of said disorders without having to put the cow in isolation. A free-stall feeding system of an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a central management device; a portable communication terminal to be carried by a person in charge of a cowshed; a network; a transmitter; a reader; and a trespassing control system. The central management device is capable of communicating with the reader and the trespassing control system via the network. A control unit of the central management device is primarily provided with an assessment unit, a selection unit, a feeding information acquisition unit, a device information acquisition unit, and a control information transmission unit. The assessment unit assesses the risk of a dairy cow developing post-parturition disorders by using, for example, the blood amino acid level and/or test values of biochemical parameters of the pre-parturition cow.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR MONITORING FOOD INTAKE OF LIVESTOCK ANIMALS
abstract: A system for monitoring individual food intake of a livestock animal includes a calibration system configured to measure weight or volume of food intake of an animal over a pre-defined period of time and to calibrate a mathematical model for the animal based on the measure, a tracking system configured track animal eating behavior at times other than the pre-defined period of time and a computing system. The pre-defined period of time is less than three weeks. The mathematical model relates eating behavior of the animal and defined physiological parameters of the animal with food intake. The computing system determines food intake of the animal over a lactation period based on the mathematical model for the animal as calibrated and the eating behavior at the times other than the pre-defined period of time.
applicants: THE STATE OF ISRAEL, MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE & RURAL DEVELOPMENT, AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH ORGANIZATION, (A.R.O.), VOLCANI CENTER

title: Ultrasonic measuring stick for pigs, cattle, sheep and donkeys
abstract: The invention discloses an ultrasonic measuring stick for pigs, cattle, sheep and donkeys and relates to the technical field of size data measurement of animal bodies. The ultrasonic measuring stick comprises a main rod and an electronic displayer, an auxiliary rod is connected directly below the main rod, the electronic displayer is arranged directly in front of the main rod, and the main rod isin threaded connection with the auxiliary rod; one end of the main rod and one end of the auxiliary rod are connected with detecting plates respectively, and the detecting plates are separately connected with the main rod and the auxiliary rod through overturning shafts. The ultrasonic measuring stick for the pigs, the cattle, the sheep and the donkeys has the advantages that through arrangement of a first button and a second button, a worker can freely select a body position to be measured; when the first button is selected, data of the lift body height and rump height can be obtained throughmeasurement; when the second button is selected, a group of detection boards can be used for measuring the chest width, the chest depth and the rump width and obtaining other data by using a mobile phone. According to the ultrasonic measuring stick, a mechanical measurement mode is replaced with an intelligent measurement mode so that the entire measurement data can be more precise.
applicants: DONGE EJIAO COMPANY; SHANDONG DONG'E BLACK HAIR DONKEY ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Livestock Breeding Apparatus
abstract: A livestock breeding apparatus is provided. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a livestock breeding apparatus comprises: a storage which stores a compound feed which is food for livestock bred in a pen; a first mass measuring device which measures the mass of the compound feed stored in the storage; a transferring device which transfers the compound feed stored in the storage to a feeder which is installed in every feeding area in the pen; and a terminal which displays mass information measured by the first mass measuring device. Through this configuration, it is possible to accurately measure the mass of the compound feed eaten by the livestock in a pen unit or a feeding area unit in the pen and to rapidly confirm a correlation of a feeding condition and feed efficiency, thereby increasing productivity by increasing the feed efficiency.

title: Device for non-intervention livestock recognition and weight determination
abstract: The invention relates to the intelligent technical field of livestock breeding, in particular to a device for non-intervention livestock recognition and weight determination. The device comprises a positioning device arranged according to animal behaviors, and further comprises an identity recognition photographing device adopting face recognition and a weight determination photographing device adopting back characteristic recognition. Livestocks can be automatically recognized, the detected weight is recorded, target images are collected after one-time installation, no manual intervention isneeded, the livestock individual recognition cost is lowered, no ear tag needs to be implanted to each livestock, the continuous input cost is lowered, and meanwhile damage caused by ear tag implantation to the livestock is lowered; in addition, in the whole process of livestock weight determination, no any intervention needs to be performed on normal living of the livestock, the livestock weightdata can be updated in real time every day, and the labor cost of a livestock farm is effectively lowered.

title: Device for livestock non-interference recognition
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock breeding intelligence, and discloses a device for livestock non-interference recognition. The device comprises a positioning device arranged according to animal behaviors, and further comprises an identity recognizing camera device with facial recognition. By means of the device, recognizing and weight recording and detecting of livestock are automatically conducted, a target image is collected without manual interference after one-time installation is completed, the livestock individual recognizing cost is reduced, there is no need toimplant an ear tag in each livestock animal, the continuous input cost is reduced, and meanwhile the injuries of implanted ear tags in livestock are reduced.

title: Culture high bed IoT (Internet of Things) weighing system with superposition weight measurement and using method of system
abstract: The invention relates to a culture high bed IoT weighing system with superposition weight measurement, and belongs to the technical field of weight measuring devices. The system comprises a culture high bed and a weighing feeding trough, the culture high bed comprises fences, a leak base plate, weighing legs and connecting pieces, the weighing legs are fixedly connected to the leak base plate andfences via the connecting pieces, the weighing feeding trough is installed in the culture high bed, the culture high bed can weight livestock in the high bed and uploads weighing data to the cloud end, and the weighing feeding trough measures the total weight of the feeding trough and contents therein. The system can monitor the feeding weight of the cultured livestock in real time, a culturing manner can be adjusted, and culturing can be standardized in high efficiency.

title: Cattle Stress Management Using IoT Systems
abstract: Cattle collar which contains biosensors, motors and Long Range (LoRa) communications ability, the LoRa sensors placed on the circumference of the feedlot to pick up data from collars, a computer that analyses behavioural and biological data and moves cattle around for lower stress levels ; and a data collection tool and analysis of various external factors affecting hormone presence in cattle.

title: Ecological pig raising circulation system
abstract: The invention discloses an ecological pig raising circulation system which comprises pig raising, monitoring, excrement treatment and waste utilization, wherein pig raising comprises hog house confined breeding and free breeding; excrement treatment comprises collecting excrement, generating biogases, filtering biogas residues, and carrying out dry-wet separation; waste utilization comprises utilization of biogases and biogas residues; the biogases are adopted to provide electric energy and heat energy for a pig farm and equipment around; a liquid obtained after dry-wet separation of the biogases is directly adopted to plant vegetates around the pig farm; the obtained solid waste dregs are used as base materials for cultivating edible mushrooms. By adopting the system, living pig excrementis subjected to harmless treatment, and the solid waste dregs are used as base materials for cultivating edible mushrooms after dry-wet separation of the biogases, so that while harmlessness of the edible mushrooms is ensured, growth of the edible mushrooms is effectively promoted, and the economic benefits can be increased.

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR SENSING ESTRUS OF DOMESTIC ANIMALS USING ENERGY HARVESTING SENSOR
abstract: A device for detecting estrus of livestock according to one embodiment of the present invention may comprise: an activity receiving unit for receiving activity information of livestock from an energy harvesting sensor; an activity analysis unit for analyzing the received activity information to output an estrus detection algorithm; and an estrus detection unit for detecting livestock in an estrus state through the estrus detection algorithm. According to the present invention, a conception rate can be increased by sensing estrus and performing artificial insemination.

title: Method and device of intelligent pig group housing and weighing, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a method and device of intelligent pig group housing and weighing, electronic equipment and a storage medium.
