The method comprises the following steps that S1, image informationof a group housing fence of a pig farm to be subjected to intelligent group housing measurement is acquired; S2, image information of each pig in the group housing fence is acquired according to theimage information of the group housing fence; and S3, according to the image information of each pig in the group housing fence, a preset weight measurement model is adopted, the weight information ofeach pig in the group housing fence is obtained, wherein the preset weight measurement model is obtained based on image sample inputting data and weight sample result data of the pig in the group housing fence. The method of intelligent pig group housing and weighing can effectively solve the stress reaction problem caused by the fact that the pig are driven to be weighed on a common weighbridgein an existing pig housing process.

title: Intelligent pig raising method and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent pig raising method and a system, an electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps of S1 acquiring image information of pigsin a pig farm; S2 obtaining the weight information and/or backfat information of the pigs by adopting a preset weight measurement model and/or a preset backfat measurement model according to the imageinformation of the pigs, wherein the preset weight measurement model is obtained by training the image sample input data and the weight sample result data of the pigs in the pig farm; and the presetbackfat measurement model is obtained by training the image sample input data and the backfat sample result data of the pigs in the pig farm. According to the intelligent pig raising method, only theimage information of the pig needs to be collected, and the weight information and the backfat information of the pig can be obtained, and therefore the problem that an existing measuring mode is prone to generating stress response of the pigs is solved, so that the pain points in the traditional pig raising process are solved, the non-stress measurement of the pig growth indexes is realized.

title: Method, device and detection system for voice detection on pigs
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device and a detection system for carrying out sound detection on pigs, and the abnormal activity in the pig swarm can be timely found by monitoring the sound of the pig swarm. According to the method, a voice recognition model is trained through deep learning, and the voice recognition model can recognize the voice category to which the inputvoice data belongs. Sound in the group culture column is collected by sound collecting equipment arranged around the group culture column to obtain target sound data only emitted by pigs in the groupculture column, a trained sound recognition model is used for recognizing the sound category to which the target sound data belongs, and the recognized sound category is output. The workers can judgewhether the pigs in the group culture column have abnormal conditions or not according to the identified sound categories so as to take measures in time and reduce the loss.

title: Method and system for real-time livestock management
abstract: A method and system for managing livestock health in real-time is provided. The method and system analyze and detect anomalies in various livestock health-related parameters and provide a health management plan that includes nutritional recommendations for curing the anomalies. A method for manufacturing a livestock feed is also provided.

title: System and method for monitoring physiological behaviors of sheep
abstract: An embodiment of the invention provides a system and a method for monitoring physiological behaviors of sheep. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a microprocessor, a wireless transmissionmodule, a power module and a host computer; acceleration data, pressure data, tail swing frequency data and weight data of monitored sheep are acquired by the data acquisition module and preprocessedby the microprocessor, the preprocessed data is uploaded to the host computer, and the host computer judges whether the monitored sheep is in heat according to the data. The system can run automatically, requires no artificial experience, has accurate monitoring result and low energy consumption and is suitable for large-area practice and promotion.

title: Calf feeding management system
abstract: A calf feeding management system comprises an information collecting module, an information processing module, an execution module and an RFID (radio frequency identification) read-write module, wherein the signal output end of the information collecting module is electrically connected with the signal input end of the information processing module; the signal output end of the information processing module is electrically connected with the signal input ends of the execution module and a display module; the information processing module is also in bidirectional signal transmission with the RFID read-write module; the information collecting module comprises a temperature sensor, a milk quantity detection device and a weight detection device, and the temperature sensor and the milk quantitydetection device are arranged in a milk tank so as to detect the temperature and quantity of milk in the milk tank; the weight detection device is positioned at a calf milk feeding port of a calf hutch so as to detect the weight of a calf; and the execution module comprises a heating device and an electromagnetic valve, and the heating device, the electromagnetic valve and the information processing module are electrically connected with the RFID read-write module to store the identification information and growth information of the calf, so as to facilitate working personnel to check and read.
applicants: NINGXIA CHUANGYAOXIN TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; NINGXIA NONGKEN HELANSHAN DAIRY COMPANY

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR IDENTIFYING, FEEDING AND HANDLING ANIMALS, IN PARTICULAR DAIRY CATTLE
abstract: In pasture-based milk-production systems, it is a complex task to balance the individual diets of the animals through feeding in the milking room, especially in hormone-free herds to synchronise oestrus, or in organic herds where it is necessary to supply a broad range of food and nutritional supplements. The proposed invention inexpensively solves the secure supply of said broad range of food and supplements, by optimising ISO 11784-85 RFID identification, measuring the food not consumed by each specific animal and adequate handling of the animals.

title: Accurate fattening pig feeding system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of livestock and poultry feeding equipment, and particularly relates to an accurate fattening pig feeding system. The device comprises a rack, a feeding device, card readers, an electronic ear tag and a controller, the feeding device comprises a feed bin, feeding troughs, a double-side discharging device and a feed guide pipe; a blanking opening is formed in the bottom of the feed bin; the double-side discharging device comprises a discharging pipe and a discharging motor, a stirring wheel is arranged in the discharging pipe, the discharging motor is in transmission connection with a rotating shaft of the stirring wheel through a coupler, a feeding port is formed in the upper end of the discharging pipe, two discharging ports are formed in the lower end of the discharging pipe, a discharging distributing piece is fixed between the two discharging ports, and a material level sensor is fixed in the feed bin. Touch switches are fixed above thefeeding troughs, and the electronic ear tags are worn on pig ears. According to the invention, the fattening pigs are accurately fed, the feed is saved, the ingestion rule of the pigs is accurately reflected, and the healthy development of the pigs is further promoted on the premise of not increasing the equipment cost due to the unique double-side discharging structure.
applicants: HENAN NANSHANG AGRICULTURE AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Monitoring system and method for key parameters of pig growth based on NB-IoT
abstract: The invention discloses a monitoring system and method for key parameters of pig growth based on NB-IoT. The monitoring system includes a field device side, a remote server and a mobile client. The field device side comprises an information identification module, a PLC, a parameter acquisition module, a feeding drive module and a feeding device, which can realize automatic feeding and automatic acquisition of pig weight, body temperature, feed intake, feeding frequency and field temperature and humidity information. The collected data are uploaded to the NB-IoT connection management platform through NB-IoT, and the data are parsed and pushed to the remote server by the platform. The remote server processes the data collected in the field and determines whether an exception has occurred. The mobile client comprises a login module, a monitoring node management module, an early warning module, an information monitoring module, and a historical curve analysis module. The monitoring systemand method for key parameters of pig growth based on NB-IoT can effectively obtain the growth parameters of the pigs, and monitor the body temperature and the feeding information which have a great relationship with the health of the pigs throughout the day, and the breeders can timely find the pigs with abnormal health and obtain the early warning information through the mobile phone.

title: RFID pig identification device
abstract: The invention discloses an RFID pig identification device; the pig identification device comprises a body, an RFID tag and an RFID reader, wherein the RFID tag is arranged on a pig ear in a form of anearring, a pig serial number of a pig is stored in the RFID tag, and the RFID reader is arranged on the body; a main processor, a storage module, the RFID reader, a feeding device, a capture device,a weight acquisition device and a power source module are integrated in the body. The RFID electronic tag is arranged on a pig body; the RFID reader identifies the RFID electronic tag on the pig body,provides an effective pig serial number, and determines whether a pig is captured according to the weight information measured by a weighing platform; if a pig needs to be captured, the pig can be captured by a pig capture net; if a pig does not need to be captured, according to the weight of the pig and the time interval of two times of foraging, the ratio and the amount of food for the pig at the time are set, the pig is fed with the food, the scientific breeding of all the pigs is realized and the informatization and automation of pig breeding are further realized.
applicants: HENAN UNIVERSITY OF ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND ECONOMY

title: An intelligent livestock breeding management system and method based on a big data technology
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent livestock breeding management system and method based on a big data technology, and relates to the technical field of intelligent livestock breeding. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data transmission module, a farm computing center and a cloud computing center, The data acquisition module acquires six element data for determining the height of the livestock breeding level and transmits the six element data to the livestock farm computing center; The farm computing center transmits the six element data to the cloud computing center throughthe data transmission module; And the cloud computing center establishes a 5 + 1 animal value model for processing the six element data and feeds back a processing result to the farm computing center, and the farm computing center sends out a control instruction to control terminal equipment of a farm. According to the livestock intelligent breeding management system and method based on the big data technology, the optimal breeding management scheme is fed back to the intelligent breeding terminal equipment through the cloud computing center, and intelligent breeding management of livestock is achieved.

title: Inspection device used by livestock veterinarians
abstract: The invention provides an inspection device used by livestock veterinarians. The device comprises a base, a light-tight inspection room is arranged on the base, the inspection room comprises a strip-shaped walking inspection channel, and an inlet and an outlet of the walking inspection channel are both provided with shading vertical curtains; and an illuminating mechanism is arranged in the walking inspection channel, and at least one camera is arranged in the walking inspection channel. According to the inspection device used by livestock veterinarians provided by the embodiment of the invention, the livestock are photographed or detected when passing through the walking inspection channel, and photographs are analyzed by the veterinarians or an automatic detection technology to realize the inspection of corresponding items. On the one hand, the normal walking cannot cause the stress state of the livestock, and on the other hand, the walking inspection channel can realize the continuous walking and inspection of the livestock so as to realize the continuous inspection and to improve the inspection efficiency.
applicants: SUN CHUANYI; GUO YAN; FENG YUNXIA; XU YANG; HUI YONGHUA; SHEN XIAOLI; ZHANG SHUANGYAN

title: A livestock traceability system and a traceability method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a A livestock traceability system and a traceability method thereof. The system comprises a feeding module, a receiving and purchasing module, a weighing module, a server, a first communication module and a second communication module. The feeding module is used for providing feeding information of livestock and transmitting to the server through the first communication module. The weighing module is used for providing weight information of livestock and transmitting to the server through the second communication module. The receiving and purchasing module is used for providing vaccine information of livestock and transmitting the vaccine information to the server; The server is used for storing the feeding information, the weight information and the vaccine information, and obtaining the corresponding traceability information according to the traceability search instruction. The traceability system and the traceability method of the invention avoid manual recording, and the related data are automatically formed and recorded in the daily feeding process of the livestock, thus saving manpower and improving the real reliability of the data. The traceability system and the traceability method of the invention avoid manual recording, and the related data are automatically formed and recorded in the daily feeding process of the livestock.

title: Pig farm epidemic disease monitoring method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a pig farm epidemic disease monitoring method and system. The monitoring method includes the steps: acquiring historical feed intake, historical environment parameters, historical health statuses and historical epidemic disease statues of live pigs; taking the historical feed intake and the historical environment parameters as input, taking the historical health statuses and the historical epidemic disease as output, building a pig farm monitoring model; determining first current statues of the live pigs according to the pig farm monitoring model; monitoring pig farms to be monitored according to the first current statues. The historical environment parameters comprise temperature, humidity and gas concentration in air, and the first current statues include health statues and epidemic disease statues. By the aid of the monitoring method and system, pig farm epidemic disease monitoring efficiency can be improved.

title: Live pig number counting device and method
abstract: The invention discloses a live pig number counting device and method. The method includes: acquiring first electronic ear tag serial number of electronic ear tags within a time interval threshold range; judging whether live pigs in a detected pig farm have feeding activities or not, and if yes, determining the number of the live pigs according to the first electronic ear tag serial number; if not,determining the live pigs without feeding activities according to the first electronic ear tag serial number. By adopting the live pig number counting device and method, live pig number counting efficiency can be improved.

title: POULTRY RAISING SYSTEM, POULTRY RAISING METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: A poultry raising system (10) comprises: an imaging unit (21) that captures an image of the interior of a poultry house (100); and a monitoring unit (32) that establishes the variation in density of poultry present in a specified region, which is a region of at least a part of the image captured by the imaging unit (21), and monitors the established variation.

title: LIVESTOCK FEED INTAKE AMOUNT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock feed intake amount management system including: a cage having livestock therein, and having at least one opening portion and an opening-closing member for selective opening and closing of the opening portion; a feed supply portion disposed outside the cage such that livestock feed is provided thereon; a stimulus detection unit detecting the stimulus that is applied to the feed supply portion whenever each livestock takes feed in the feed supply portion; and a control unit controlling the opening and closing of the opening portion by operating the opening-closing member based on the stimulus information detected by the stimulus detection unit.
applicants: LEE, HO CHAN; KIM, JIN HYUNG; KIM, WON KYEONG; KANG, DAE-SHIK; JEONG, HOE SUK

title: SMART CATTLE SHED MANAGEMENT SYSTEM USING LONG RANGE NETWORKS
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart cattle shed management system using a long-range (LoRa) network. According to the present invention, the smart cattle shed management system includes a plurality of sensor nodes to sense a cattle shed environment and a cattle state. The sensor nodes use a LoRa network to provide sensed information. The smart cattle shed management system integrates and manages cattle shed environment monitoring, cattle health state monitoring, cattle remote treatment, and feeding management. To this end, the smart cattle shed management system provides standardized data and a system platform. In other words, the smart cattle shed management system collects a variety of cattle raising-related information to build big data, thereby processing and generating analysis data in accordance with the cattle shed environment and the cattle health state. The smart cattle shed management system receives bioinformation of cattle and cattle shed environment information sensed in real time from the sensor nodes via the LoRa network, and uses and applies analysis data and big data in accordance with the information to cattle shed environment control, cattle health state determination, abnormal signal initial prediction, and feeding management. According to the present invention, wide data accumulation of a big data concept is used to provide the effect of cattle quality and productivity improvement and prevention in accordance with a disease or the like.

title: Method and apparatus for detection of estrus and optimal time for embryo transfer or artificial insemination in animals
abstract: An apparatus and methods for detection of estrus and optimal time for embryo transfer or artificial insemination in animals. An arched polycarbonate housing is attached to an animal. A circuit board is disposed within the housing. A rechargeable battery mounted on the circuit board provides power to the apparatus. A switch mounted on the circuit board is actuated when a breeding behavior occurs. A controller mounted on the circuit board detects actuations of the switch to generate data indicative of breeding behavior. A transmitter transmits data indicative of breeding behavior to a remote receiver.

title: Fast-wearing grade-positioning wound-exposed multifunctional animal ear tag
abstract: Described herein is a fast-wearing grade-positioning wound-exposed multifunctional animal ear tag that includes a primary tag, a secondary tag, an UHF RFID chip, a half-duplex ULF RFID chip, an ambient temperature sensor, an animal body temperature sensor, a fast-wearing grade-positioning pin, and a bearing clamp. The ear tag measures animal ear root temperature and ambient temperature of a place where the animal resides. An ointment may be placed onto the UHF RFID chip, the half-duplex ULF RFID chip, and the ear tag in order to facilitate rapid wound healing.

title: Sow oestrus monitoring device and system based on analyzing of cloud end
abstract: The invention discloses a sow oestrus monitoring device and system based on analyzing of a cloud end, and belongs to the field of livestock breeding. The monitoring device comprises a sensing probe, akey, a display screen, a single chip microcomputer, an ear tag module, a Bluetooth communication module and a lithium battery module. The sensing probe detects changes of the conductivity when a sowis in the oestrus period, data is fed back to the single chip microcomputer, the single chip microcomputer judges detected data according to preset conductivity data to judge whether or not the sow isin the oestrus period, and the judging data is sent to the display screen for displaying. The key is used for controlling starting and stopping of the monitoring device. The ear tag module is used for reading ear tag data of the sow. Energy is supplied to the ear tag module, the display screen, the single chip microcomputer and a sensing probe through the lithium battery module. The single chip microcomputer comprises an AD sampling module, and data is sampled through the AD sampling module. The Bluetooth communication module is used for uploading the data.

title: Bovine motion sensor tag
abstract: A system and method for determining when a pregnant cow 10 is about to calve comprising monitoring movement of the cow using a motion sensor 12 attached to the cow to determine a movement pattern of the cow over a period of time comparing the determined movement pattern with a stored movement pattern that is representative of such a cow calving. There may be a plurality of stored movement patterns which may be selected depending on the cow, an electronic ID of the cow, the cow breed, calving history of the cow, or expected due date of the cow. An alert may be generated when the cow is about to calve. There may be a long-range communication module 14 to transmit a notification to a mobile device 15. A sensor tag may be used in the system. There is a self-powered motion sensor tag attachable to the tail 16 of a cow with a bovine adhesive configured to emit a wireless signal indicative of a cow calving.

title: Intelligent egg laying monitoring system, device and method for livestock
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent egg laying monitoring device for livestock, and the device is used for monitoring egg laying of the livestock. A first bottom plate comprises a flat plate area and is arranged on a frame seat, and the flat plate area comprises a bearing surface and an installing surface. A second bottom plate is latticed, is arranged on the frame seat and is detachably connected with the first bottom plate. A cage body is arranged on the frame seat and forms an egg laying space with the first bottom plate, and the bearing surface faces the cage body. A wireless radio frequency tag is arranged on the livestock. A reading unit reads the wireless radio frequency tag located in an egg laying space through a reading antenna to generate livestock identity information. A sensor senses eggs located on the second bottom plate to generate livestock egg body information. A processor receives and calculates the livestock identity information and the livestock egg body information to obtain the egg laying condition of the corresponding livestock. Therefore, whether the livestock is high-yield livestock or low-yield livestock can be effectively judged.

title: BIO-PATCH AND RELATED METHODS FOR DETECTING FERTILITY CONDITION IN COWS
abstract: Bio-patch and related methods for detecting fertility condition in cows. In some embodiments, a patch can include a patch substrate configured to support a plurality of components, and to allow the patch to be attached to a cow. The patch can further include a detector implemented on or at least partially within the patch structure, and configured to detect one or more conditions associated with a fertility cycle of the cow. The patch can further include an interface component implemented on or at least partially within the patch structure, and in communication with the detector. The interface component can be configured to transmit information related to the one or more conditions, such that the information allows estimation of occurrence of a standing estrus window for the cow.

title: Automatic system and apparatus for mastitis detection by means of electrical properties measurements of milk.
abstract: A Health Management System for automatic monitoring of dairy animal's health. The system including a method for mastitis detection through, at least, electrical conductivity measurement of milk powered by artificial intelligence analysis. In addition, an apparatus for automatically measuring electrical conductivity and temperature of milk, and milking time length, all from each teat of the animal separately. All information is transmitted for registering and statistics development remotely.
applicants: CAAMANO FERNANDEZ, SANTIAGO ENRIQUE; CAAMANO FERNANDEZ, GABRIEL NELSON; CAAMANO FERNANDEZ, ALEJANDRO GONZALO

title: RUMINAL BOLUS FOR TRACKING BOVINES
abstract: A bolus is inserted into the rumen of a bovine and includes sensors for collecting the temperature, activity level, and location of the animal over time and circuitry for communicating the collected data to a server that monitors the health, kinetic activity, and location of that animal and perhaps other animals in a herd. The battery of the bolus is continuously recharged in response to the peristaltic contractions of the rumen. The bolus communicates via a local network transmission technology such as Bluetooth to a radio transmitter mounted on the tail of the animal using a tail-mounted bracelet. This transmitter may then communicate the collected data and additional sensor data to the server. Thermal cameras mounted near water troughs, in corridors to milking rooms, or on drones may be used to supplement the data collected by the bolus to provide data indicative of the health condition of the animal.

title: SYSTEM FOR DETECTING ESTRUS OF HANWOO COWS
abstract: To achieve the objects, the system for detecting an estrus of Hanwoo cattle (Korean beef) according to the present invention comprises: an EV activity sensor which is worn on the neck or foot of Hanwoo cattle and senses data for measuring the activity frequency and size of the corresponding Hanwoo cattle; a data collector which is wirelessly connected to the plurality of EV activity sensors to collect the sensed data; a cloud server configured to determine whether there is an estrus or not by calculating the activity frequency and size of Hanwoo cattle with data sensed by the EV activity sensor from the data collector; and a notification terminal connected to the cloud server to deliver various data including an activity frequency, an activity size, and an estrus status to a manager, so that only activities showing a frequency of 3Hz or more can be measured as an activity and a signal can be sent, thereby providing an effect of clearly distinguishing the frequency of activities, reducing an energy consumption of sensors, and increasing the life span of the sensors.
applicants: KIM, JIN HONG; GYEONGSANG NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: Livestock physiological index intelligent monitoring system and monitoring method based on internet of things
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock physiological index intelligent monitoring system and monitoring method based on the Internet of Things. The livestock physiological index intelligent monitoring system comprises a wireless base station antenna, a wireless base station, a plurality of physiological index acquisition equipment and an operator signal tower, the plurality of physiological index acquisition equipment and the wireless base station are in wireless communication, the wireless base station communicates wirelessly with the operator signal tower. The invention monitors the movement physiological data of the livestock through the livestock physiological index intelligent monitoring system consisting of the plurality of physiological index acquisition equipment, the wireless base station, a server and the like so as to reflect the health condition of the livestock. A standard physiological index model and a livestock health index are established according to the movement physiological data, and a livestock health index-diagnosis result related database is established according to the diagnosis results of workers, a correlation database of heath index-diagnosis and treatmentor nutrition supplement is finally established, a correlation database of the diagnosis and treatment or treatment scheme and the movement data is finally established, thereby providing an efficient and quick solution for the disease condition management of the livestock.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA WISDOM ANIMAL HUSBANDRY INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: A Computer Vision for the Prediction System of Livestock Diseases and Their Methods
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and a method for predicting a livestock disease. Specifically, disclosed in the present invention are a system and a method for predicting a livestock disease using a computer vision, wherein the system includes: an input device including a photographing device mounted on one side of a breeding farm to photograph livestock; and an analysis device extracting and analyzing determination information (D) of the livestock from an image photographed by the photographing device, and determining whether the livestock is diseased by using the determination information. Thus, according to the present invention, the image photographed by the photographing device is analyzed using the computer vision, so that it is determined whether the livestock is diseased in advance, diseases of various types of livestock are predicted, and the spread of the diseases is prevented.

title: COW BODY INFORMATION COLLECTION SYSTEM USING LPWANLoRa and BLE
abstract: The present invention relates to a cow body information collection system using a low-power wide-area network (LPWAN, LoRa) and Bluetooth low energy (BLE) to provide correct health information. According to the present invention, the cow body information collection system comprises: an ear tag attached to an ear of a cow entity to identify the cow entity of livestock farms and including an entity sensor module detecting sensing data including at least one from the body heat and activity amount of the cow entity and a BLE communication module transmitting the sensing data through BLE communications; an ear tag access point (AP) collecting the sensing data transmitted from the ear tag through the BLE communications and transmitting the received sensing data through the LPWAN; a server analyzing the collected sensing data to estimate a health state of the cow entity; and an AP gateway connecting communications with the ear tag AP through the LPWAN, connecting communications with the server through Internet, and relaying the collected sensing data between the ear tag AP and the server.

title: DEVICE, METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MONITORING OF ANIMAL BODY TEMPERATURE
abstract: A device for monitoring animal body temperature (1a, 1b, 1c) provided with a thermal module (21) including a central unit (10) with a communication module (11) and a contactless temperature sensor matrix (13) connected thereto according to the invention, characterised in that it is provided with a selecting device (15) connected to the central unit (10) and with a device (20, 30, 40) positioning the head (S) of the animal below the contactless temperature sensor matrix (133) placed above the lower part of the positioning device (20, 30, 40), wherein the contactless temperature sensor matrix (13) includes at least two rows and offers a resolution of at least 10 pixels in each of the rows. The method of animal monitoring using the device according to the invention is characterised in that it is performed using the device according to the invention, wherein temperature is read from the matrix of contactless temperature sensors within a period of time shorter than 3.5 s, and a pre-defined pattern is detected in a summary of temperature values read from the matrix of contactless temperature sensors (12), followed by verification of a pre-defined criterion, meeting of which is subsequently used to send a control signal to the selecting device (15). The herd animal condition monitoring system including a server and monitoring units communicating with the server according to the invention is characterised in that the monitoring units are provided as monitoring devices according to the invention.
applicants: SMART SOFT SOLUTIONS SPOLKA Z OGRANICZONA ODPOWIEDZIALNOSCIA

title: Breeding management system
abstract: The invention discloses a breeding management system. The breeding management system comprises a breeding device, a processing engine and a server. The breeding device is used for obtaining initial breeding information. And the processing engine is used for receiving and processing the initial breeding information to obtain final breeding information. And the server is used for receiving the finalbreeding information and generating breeding tasks according to the final breeding information. According to the breeding management system provided by the embodiment of the invention, initial breeding information is obtained through the breeding device and the initial breeding information is received and processed through a processing engine to obtain final breeding information; the server receives and processes the final breeding information to generate breeding tasks, the electronic informatization level of the breeding farm is improved, a user can grasp detailed final breeding information, the user can execute the breeding tasks conveniently, breeding and management of pigs can be promoted, and the production efficiency of the breeding farm is improved.

title: AUTOMATED LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract: [Problem] To provide an automated livestock management system with which it is possible to optimize a livestock environment and achieve efficient livestock raising by automatically managing and controlling the livestock environment on the basis of various numerical values obtained from a variety of measuring instruments and also by utilizing past rearing records and actual values. [Solution] This automated livestock management system comprises a management server, an operating means, a measuring device group, and a livestock barn equipment group, wherein the management server comprises a livestock management database, an analysis unit which extracts external information and rearing environment information from the livestock management database and then performs arithmetic processing to generate rearing environment parameters, and a control processing unit which generates control parameters on the basis of the rearing environment parameters and the rearing environment information that is acquired consecutively. This automated livestock management system is configured such that the control processing unit consecutively and automatically determines the control parameters on the basis of the rearing environment parameters and the rearing environment information and performs control on the equipment group by generating and transmitting control signals.

title: SYSTEM FOR PREDICTING DOMESTIC ANIMAL DISEASE
abstract: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a system for predicting domestic animal disease comprises: a radio tag attached to domestic animal, detecting biometric information of the domestic animal, and registered with identification information of the domestic animal; a recognition device installed around a feeder and water tank in barn, recognizing that the domestic animal takes feed and water if the radio tag is within a certain distance from the feeder and water tank, and transmitting information about taking the feed and water and the biometric information; an analysis unit receiving the information about taking the feed and water of the domestic animal from the recognition device to determine behavioral information about taking the feed and water of the domestic animal and comparing the behavioral information with data stored in database to analyze whether the domestic animal is abnormal based on machine learning and predict disease of the domestic animal; and a monitoring unit taking statistics on the analysis result and transmitting the analysis result to a previously registered administrator.

title: Pasture cooling system and control method of pasture cooling devices
abstract: The present invention discloses a pasture cooling system. The system comprises a plurality of sensors, a plurality of cooling devices and a controller, wherein each sensor is capable of detecting a cattle behavior in a neck strap; each cooling device is associated with the corresponding position of the neck strap and can be started and stopped alone; the controller can receive signals from the sensors and detects the cattle behaviors accordingly; and the controller starts or stops the cooling device corresponding to the position of cattle according to the detected cattle behavior. The invention further discloses a control method of the pasture cooling devices. According to the system, based on a control strategy of a sprayer, a fan and/or a fog making device for the cattle feeding behaviors, the cattle feeding behaviors are sensed by judging the position of a swing arm of the neck strap and in other ways, and the control strategy of the sprayer/fan/fog making device is triggered, so that real accurate control is realized and the water and energy saving effect is achieved while heat stress is reduced.

title: METHOD, CONTROL UNIT AND SYSTEM TO IDENTIFY ANIMALS
abstract: Method (400), control unit (120) and system (500) for animal identification, based on an individual milk flow characteristic. The method (400) comprises obtaining (402) information related to a milk flow when milking an animal (100a, 100b, 100c, 100d); determining (403) a first characteristic of the milk flow based on the obtained (402) information; and identifying (405) the animal (100a, 100b, 100c, 100d), based on said determined (403) first characteristic of the milk flow.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MONITORING THE BEHAVIOUR AND REPRODUCTIVE ACTIVITY OF ANIMALS IN HERDS
abstract: The present invention describes a system and method for monitoring the behaviour and reproductive activity of animals in herds, capable of collecting information regarding animal behaviour by means of sensors, identifying and analyzing said information to find out about the routine behaviour of the animals, in terms of reproduction and motor activity. Above all, the present invention analyses the reproductive behaviour of the animals for the purpose of recognizing, for example, when a female animal is in the mating season and when successful copulation has occurred. The present invention is also capable of identifying a disease in animals which compromises motor activity. Specifically, the present invention comprises a wearable electronic device, an intravaginal device (2), a data collector (4) and a data processor (5), wherein the intravaginal device (2) is the device capable of identifying whether or not successful copulation has occurred, and the wearable electronic device is responsible for providing information on motor activity, localization, inter alia. The present invention pertains to the fields of electrical engineering, computing, veterinary medicine and telecommunications.
applicants: FEDERAL UNIVERSITY OF RIO GRANDE DO SUL

title: System and method for managing livestock using radio frequency device
abstract: A system can comprise a radio frequency (RF) monitoring device configured to collect information relating to livestock and transmit the collected information to a management device, and a management device configured to process the collected information and generate corresponding livestock management information.

title: Overhead camera system to gauge livestock development
abstract: A livestock development gauging system is provided. The livestock development gauging system includes a pen, an imaging device and a processing system. The pen defines a livestock containment area. The imaging device is suspended proximate to the livestock containment area and configured to generate images of livestock in the livestock containment area. The processing system is configured to determine a livestock health measurement of the livestock based on an analysis of the images of the livestock.

title: BREEDING FARM MONITORING SYSTEM USING VISOIN AND THERMAL IMAGE CAMERA
abstract: According to the present invention, a breeding farm monitoring system using vision and a thermal imaging camera comprises: a thermal imaging camera to photograph a monitoring target of caged birds to acquire movement or body temperature information of the monitoring target; a driving device to move the thermal imaging camera; and a breeding farm monitoring device to determine whether the monitoring target is dead and avian influenza disease status based on information acquired by the thermal imaging camera. Accordingly, diseases caused by the death of chickens are prevented, and the health condition of caged birds and the environmental condition of a breeding farm can be uniformly maintained.
applicants: KHO, MYUNG CHAN; MOON, IN-HO; TECHNICA

title: small management system and management method
abstract: The present invention relates to a cattle management system and a management method thereof and, more particularly, to a cattle management system which monitors, in real time, the body temperature and pulse of cattle such as Korean cattle, beef cattle, and dairy cattle, wirelessly transmits the measured values, and allows a management server to receive and store the wirelessly transmitted values, analyze the received information, and transmit the analyzed data to a mobile terminal of a user, so that the user can know, in real time, the current status of the cattle such as the current disease, pregnancy, hunger, and thirst of the cattle to identify, in real time, the state of the cattle such as an urgent disease, for example, foot-and-mouth disease or such as a pregnancy situation and take necessary measures thereon, thereby solving the desires of the cattle such as treatment of disease or feed intake, and increasing the quality of meat or milk, and to a management method thereof.
applicants: REBO; LEE, BONG KYU; KIM, JIN SOO

title: Electronic Sow Management Apparatus
abstract: An electronic sow management apparatus is provided. The electronic sow management apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an input part receiving sow biometric information; a communication part receiving sow movement information; a processor which detects activity and respiration rate of a sow from movement information of the sow received through the communication part, and detects estrus of the sow based on biometric information, activity, and respiration rate of the sow; and a display part for displaying estrus information detected by the processor. By the same, it is possible to automatically detect estrus of the sow to predict right time for fertilization, and to improve health management of the sow by providing information on the menstrual cycle, the presence of diseases, and vitality.

title: Analysis system and method for feeding milk-production livestock
abstract: An analysis system for feeding milk-production livestocks includes an image analysis device and a central server signal connected to the image analysis device. The image analysis device is configured to capture a plurality of images from a feeding field, sharpening the images and identifying a plurality of face images having feeding motion of the milk-production livestock from the sharpened images, and then the capture the face images and a feeding time of each feeding motion to generate captured signals, and finally transfer the captured signals to the central server. The central server includes a milk-production livestock database having a plurality of original face images. The central server is configured to identify the milk-production livestock identity of the face images of each captured signal in accordance with the original face images, and then generate a feeding record by integrating the feeding time of each captured signal and the identified milk-production livestock identity. The present application further discloses an analysis method for feeding milk-production livestock.

title: DAIRY CATTLE BREEDING STATUS INDICATOR TECHNOLOGY
abstract: A bovine estrus detection device includes a generally rectangular base having sides and ends, the base having a predetermined length and a predetermined width, and the width being less than the length, the base having a first side and. a second side. The first side of the base has a central region having a first color and end regions having a second color. The second color is different from the first color. An adhesive is disposed on the second side of the base for coupling the base to a female cow or heifer. A removable coating is disposed over the first side of the base. The removable coating is exposed for contact by male or female cows mounting the female cow or heifer to which the device is attached. The coating is adapted to being removed by mounting male or female cows, whereby the first and second colors become visible. Exposure of the first color in the central region is an. accurate predictor of activation and estrus.

title: SYSTEM FOR MONITORING AVIAN INFLUENZA
abstract: Provided is a system for monitoring avian influenza in real time. The system comprises: a data collection unit collecting data related to movement routes of migratory birds and vehicles and livestock environment of livestock farms; an early diagnosis unit determining whether the avian influenza has occurred based on the data; and a central countermeasure unit determining a quarantine method and quarantine range based on the data and based on whether the avian influenza has occurred.

title: 3 A livestock weighing system using 3D image and a livestock weighing method using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock weighing system and a livestock weighing method using the same. According to the present invention, the livestock weighing system includes: a three-dimensional scanner part obtaining a three-dimensional image by scanning livestock; and a livestock weighing terminal connected with the three-dimensional scanner part to derive the weight of the livestock by using the three-dimensional image. Also, the livestock weighing method using the livestock weighing system includes: a step (a) of obtaining a three-dimensional image by scanning livestock through the three-dimensional scanner part; and a step (b) of allowing the livestock weighing terminal to derive the weight of the livestock by using the three-dimensional image. Therefore, the present invention is capable of reducing costs for breeding and increasing profits of farms.

title: Oestrus detection method, device and system
abstract: The invention provides an oestrus detection method, device and system. The oestrus detection method comprises the following steps of: acquiring information of a sow to be detected to determine predicted oestrus time of the sow; generating a predicted index according to the current time and the predicted oestrus time; acquiring motion information of the sow to generate a static index and a restlessness index of the sow; generating an oestrus probability according to the static index, the restlessness index and the predicted index; and determining the oestrus of the sow when the oestrus probability is greater than or equal to a preset threshold value. By the adoption of the oestrus detection method, device and system, the predicted index, the static index and the restlessness index are comprehensively considered to generate the oestrus probability, the oestrus of the sow is determined when the oestrus probability is larger than the preset threshold value, and manual oestrus checking by experienced workers is not needed, so that labor cost is saved, automatic oestrus checking is achieved, and oestrus checking efficiency is improved; and real-time oestrus checking can be achieved, whether the sow is in an oestrus period or not can be found in time, and the oestrus period of the sow can be prevented from being missed, so that production efficiency is improved.

title: Smart environment disinfection and healthy water drinking integrated system for pig farm
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of smart environment treatment, in particular to a smart environment disinfection and healthy water drinking integrated system for a pig farm. The smart environment disinfection and healthy water drinking integrated system comprises a PLC control chip, a detection module, a disinfection module and a water purification module. The PLC control chip is used for analyzing data and issuing work instructions according to the analyzed data; the detection module connected with the PLC control chip is used for centrally detecting entrances and exits of the pig farm and a pig house, and travelling conditions of personnel, workshops and pigs in personnel travelling passages, production region pig transfer passages and the like among subregions, and transmitting detected information to the PLC control chip; the disinfection module connected with the PLC control chip is used for executing disinfection instructions sent by the PLC control chip; the waterpurification module is connected with the PLC control chip. Ozone is adopted, the air atomization and spray disinfection module in the pig house is constructed, air in the pig house is purified, the concentrations of pathogenic microorganisms, harmful gases and dust in the air of the pig house are effectively recued, and the disinfection effect, the ozone monitoring feedback control effect, and influences on production are studied.

title: LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: A herd management system for monitoring and managing the movements of animals within a herd comprises a user interface for defining one or more virtual fences for each to comprise a paddock, a plurality of wireless tags affixed to the monitored animals, and a network server for managing communications between the user interface and wireless communication with the tags. The tags include devices for stimulating the animal to move as desired by the herd management system, including staying within a paddock or moving from one paddock to another as guided by the system.
applicants: HUGHES, MATT; PARKER, TODD; KOMSUOGLU, HALDUN; SINGLER, PATRICK; FITZGERALD, SCOTT; VENCE CORPORATION; YARUSINSKY, MICHAEL, ANTHONY; WOOTEN, FRANK

title: Full livestock system
abstract: A livestock management system is disclosed. The system includes a gantry assembly and a controller. The gantry assembly includes a support assembly including one or more work tool rails and one or more support structures. The gantry assembly further includes one or more propulsion units disposed on one or more support rails within a livestock facility and configured to provide movement of the support assembly along the one or more support rails. The gantry assembly further includes one or more work tool assemblies actuatable along the one or more work tool rails so to provide one or more work tool attachments selective access within the livestock facility. The controller may be configured to actuate the support assembly to along the one or more support rails and further configured to actuate the one or more work tool assemblies to along the one or more work tool rails.

title: Intelligent system for limited feeding and backfat detection of pig
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of breeding pig backfat detection equipment and discloses an intelligent system for limited feeding and backfat detection of a pig. The intelligent systemcomprises a limiting pen, a backfat detection subsystem and an automatic limited feeding subsystem. The limiting pen comprise a feed trough, limiting pen protective plates, limiting pen supporting frames and the like, and the limiting pen only allows one pig to access and eat and is isolated to prevent pigs from competing for food. The backfat detection subsystem comprises backfat detection vertical columns, linear slide rails, linear sliders and the like, a veterinary A or B mode ultrasound scanner moves along the height direction, along a direction perpendicular to the body length of the pigand along the direction of the body length of the pig, and coverage of different pig backfat P2 test points is guaranteed. The automatic limited feeding subsystem comprises a feed drum, a center shaft, a screw, a feeding wheel and the like. By introduction of data of backfat, an ear tag, weight and the like of the pig, the rotating speed of a feeding motor is controlled, and an appropriate amountof feed is supplied through the feed drum and the feeding wheel and then guided into the feed trough through a retaining plate.

title: Piglet rescuing device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of animal breeding, and provides a piglet rescuing device. The device comprises a sensing piece, a movable piece and a driving piece. The sensing piece andthe movable piece are both arranged at the upper side of a hogcote, the driving piece is arranged on the movable piece, and the sensing piece is connected with the driving piece and the movable piece. Piglet sound signals are collected in real time through the sensing piece, sows are driven through the movable piece and the driving piece, the sow lying posture is changed, the piglets are rescued,and the piglet survival rate is increased; the device is simple in structure, convenient to operate and high in automatic degree, labor intensity of workers is lowered, and the cultivation efficiencyand benefits of a farm are improved.

title: Monitoring methods of ruminant stomach of cattle
abstract: The present invention relates to a device and method capable of analyzing activity of livestock by collecting movement data from a sensor inserted into rumina of the livestock and monitoring health of the livestock and disease managing information by using activity information. The device for monitoring activity of livestock by using the sensor inserted into the rumina of the livestock by oral administration comprises: a data sensing unit which receives sensing data including the movement data of the rumina from the sensor; an activity analyzing unit which analyzes the received sensing data as ingestion activity, rumination activity, and rest activity; and a monitoring unit which stores the analyzed activity information, and provides and monitors livestock health and disease information of which the activity information is not analyzed.

title: Livestock finding system
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock finding system which comprises positioning collars, a control system, a client-side, an unmanned aerial vehicle system and a monitoring system, wherein the positioning collars are worn on the livestock necks and used for positioning herds, feeding back position information, communicating with the control system and feeding back related information, the controlsystem serves as the core of an intelligent livestock system, receives and sends data and carries out operation processing on the data, and the client-side is used for inquiring current livestock information; the control system is simultaneously in radio communication connection with the positioning collars, the client-side, the unmanned aerial vehicle system and the monitoring system, and the control system presets longitude and latitude activity intervals of livestock.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA WUTONGTIANXIA NETWORK TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: METHOD FOR PREDICTING MILK YIELDS, TMR NUTRIENT COMPOSITION TO ACHIEVE TARGET MILK YIELDS, AND TMR NUTRIENT COMPOSITION TO ACHIEVE TARGET COST, ON BASIS OF DEEP LEARNING-BASED PREDICTION MODELS
abstract: Provided is a method for predicting milk yields performed by a livestock farm management server that communicates with the outside through a communication network. The method for predicting milk yields of the present disclosure comprises the steps of: receiving, through the communication network, n data sets (n is an integer of 2 or more) retroactively from a reference date, accumulated from a past p-month prior date (p is an integer of 2 or more) to the reference date, wherein each data set of the n data sets includes state information data of a target cow to be managed, nutrient intake data of the target cow to be managed, and ambient state data on the basis of each specific date between the past p-month prior date and the reference date; and applying the received data sets and predicting milk yields that may be expected for the target cow to be managed for q months (q is an integer of 1 or more) from the reference date on the basis of a first prediction model. The state information data of the target cow to be managed includes the date of birth or the age in months of the target cow to be managed and the number of postpartum weeks on the specific date, the nutrient intake data of the target cow to be managed includes daily dry matter intake, water intake, metabolic energy intake, metabolic protein intake, MET intake, LYS intake, calcium intake, and phosphorus intake on the specific date, and the ambient state data includes average temperature and average humidity information of the specific date.

title: Ruminant animal monitoring system
abstract: There is provided a system and method for automatically monitoring a ruminant animal. The system comprises a 3D camera system that obtains images from a region of interest. An image processor determines the surface curvature in the region of interest, as a function of time. Based on the frequency with which this function attains local maxima, a health indication for the animal is generated.

title: Pig verification method, pig verification device and pig verification system
abstract: The invention provides a pig verification method, a pig verification device and a pig verification system. The pig verification method comprises the steps of obtaining the pre-stored pig face depth images of all pigs associated with a traceability code; obtaining a check pig face depth image and a check body temperature parameter of the current pig; and when the check pig face depth image is not matched with any one of the pre-stored pig face depth images and/or the check body temperature parameter is beyond the preset body temperature range, not allowing the current pig to enter the slaughterhouse. According to the pig verification method, the pig verification device and the pig verification system, due to the fact that the pig face depth image cannot be modified basically, the detectionaccuracy is higher when the pig identity verification is conducted through the pig face depth image, a user can determine whether a current pig is replaced or not according to the prompt information,the pig can be prevented from being replaced, and the detection vulnerabilities are made up. In addition, the user can assist in judging whether the pigs are infected or not according to the abnormalbody temperature prompt information of the pigs, and the infected pigs are prevented from entering a slaughterhouse.

title: Cow's feed dispensing and feeding system based on methane monitoring
abstract: The invention relates to a cow's feed dispensing and feeding system based on methane monitoring, comprising a processor, a methane monitoring device, a microbial monitoring device, a dispensing systemand a feeding system. The processor is connected with the methane monitoring device, the microbial monitoring device, the dispensing system and the feeding system; the methane monitoring device comprises a front monitor and a rear monitor; the processor is used for acquiring daily methane emission of a cow; the microbial monitoring device is disposed in a feeding unit and is used for monitoring products of microbes in the emission of the single cow; the microbial monitoring device acquires the content of the products of the microbes and outputs the content to the processor; the processor calculates estimated methane yield; the processor proportions the cow's feed according to the daily methane emission and the estimated methane yield; the dispensing system comprises a plurality of storagetanks, a dispensing tank and a release device. Therefore, the cow's feed dispensing and feeding system based on methane monitoring allows a feed formulation to be corrected so that the methane emission of a single cow is reduced.

title: HOLDING AREA AND METHOD EXECUTED IN A HOLDING AREA
abstract: Holding area (110) and method (500) executed in a holding area (110) arranged at a milking parlour (120) of a farm. A Location System (200) is arranged at the holding area (110), and is configured to monitor animal movements in at least two directions. The Location System (200) comprises a control unit (210), a tag (220), and transceivers (230a, 230b, 230c), configured to detect signals emitted by the tag (220), and communicate information with the control unit (210). The method (500) comprises determining (501) arrival time of the animal (100) and/ or animal movement;identifying (502) the animal (100); monitoring (503) a waiting time of the animal (100) in the holding area (110) and/ or animal movements of the animal (100); comparing (509) the waiting time and/ or animal movements with a respective reference threshold; and triggering (510) an action, when the reference threshold is exceeded.

title: Livestock raising pet monitoring device and system
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock raising pet monitoring device and system. Timely handling of various abnormities in the pet breeding process is ensured by real-time reporting and early warning ofvarious types of information, and data security and access convenience are improved by the aid of permission and associated operation.

title: Livestock health monitoring system and method of use
abstract: An animal wellness notification system includes an attachment body configured to securely engage with an ear of the animal; an elongated temperature probe secured to the attachment body and configured to extend within the ear of the animal; a housing secured to the attachment body; a computer disposed within the housing and operably associated with the temperature probe; and a notification device in data communication with the computer, the notification device being configured to provide notice if a temperature of the animal goes beyond a determined threshold.

title: METHOD AND CONTROL UNIT FOR CONTROLLING A MOVEABLE CROWD GATE
abstract: Method (500) and control unit (110) for controlling a moveable crowd gate (120) of a holding area (130) at an entrance (140) of a milking parlour (150) at a farm (100). The control unit (110) is configured to obtain information from at least one sensor (210, 220, 310a, 310b, 330a, 330b, 330c, 340) regarding animals (101) present in the holding area (130); determine a stress level (410) among the animals (101) in the holding area (130), based on the obtained information; and control movement of the crowd gate (120), via an actuator (160) configured to adjust position of the moveable crowd gate (120), based on the determined stress level (410).

title: Monitoring method and device of cow ingestion behaviors and ingestion amount
abstract: The invention provides a monitoring method and device of cow ingestion behaviors and ingestion amount. The method includes: based on a first preset neural network and according to acceleration information of the cow ingestion behaviors, determining categories of corresponding ingestion behaviors to be a food rolling state or chewing state of ingestion or a non-ingestion state; in a preset time period, acquiring time of duration for ingestion respectively according to time of duration of the food rolling state and the chewing state; based on a second preset neural network and according to the acceleration information acquired after classifying on the basis of the first preset neutral network, acquiring an ingestion rate estimated value; according to the time of duration for ingestion and the ingestion rate estimated value in a preset time period, acquiring individual ingestion amount of cows. By the method, automatic monitoring of the cow ingestion behaviors and the individual ingestionamount in the process of cow breeding is realized, building of an Internet of Things data platform based on the cow ingestion behaviors and the ingestion amount is facilitated, remote transmission, analysis and management of data are realized, and digitalization and intelligentization levels of precise feeding of the cows are elevated.
applicants: BEIJING RESEARCH CENTER FOR INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY IN AGRICULTURE

title: Wearable monitoring device and monitoring system of cow ingestion behaviors and ingestion amount
abstract: An embodiment of the invention provides a wearable monitoring device and a monitoring system of cow ingestion behaviors and ingestion amount. Each wearable monitoring device sleeves the head of a cow,and acceleration information of the cow ingestion behaviors is collected through a sensor, contacting with the cheek or the nose of the cow; the sensor of the device is sequentially connected with arelay, a data storing module and a data processing module electrically, the acceleration information collected by the sensor is transmitted to the data storing module through the relay for data processing and storing, and the data processing module monitors and analyzes the ingestion behaviors and the ingestion amount of the cows by calling the acceleration information in the data storing module.By the wearable monitoring device and the monitoring system, automatic monitoring of the ingestion behaviors and the individual ingestion amount of each cow in the process of cow breeding is realized,building of an Internet of Things data platform based on the cow ingestion behaviors and the ingestion amount is facilitated, remote transmission, analysis and management of data are realized, and digitalization and intelligentization levels of precise feeding of the cows are elevated.
applicants: BEIJING RESEARCH CENTER FOR INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY IN AGRICULTURE

title: MONITORING LIVESTOCK IN AN AGRICULTURAL PEN
abstract: A method comprising: receiving an image of a scene comprising one or more animals; defining region boundaries for each of said one or more animals; evaluating a suitability of each of said region boundaries for further processing, based, at least in part, on a predetermined set of parameters; and determining at least one of: (i) a physical state of at least some of said one or more animals, based, at least in part, on said further processing, and (ii) an identity of at least some of said one or more animals.

title: System for sharing chicken information using application
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system of sharing chicken information in real time using an application comprises: a camera installed inside or outside a chicken coop or installed in a pasturing breeding environment, and photographing chickens bred in the chicken coop to transmit photographed chicken images to a chicken information sharing server; the chicken information sharing server for generating breeding information including chicken information and breeding information for each chicken information list and providing the generated information to a consumer terminal, wherein the chicken information includes images, breed and characteristics, population, and egg-laying number of chickens bred in a chicken coop or a pasturing breeding environment, and the breeding information includes design of a chicken coop, breeding site pictures, the number of pasturing, and an authentication status of chicken farm; and the consumer terminal having a chicken information sharing application installed therein to receive a chicken information list from the chicken information sharing server and receive a selection for any one of chicken coops or pasturing breeding environments from a consumer, and to display chicken information and breeding information for chickens bred in the chicken coop or the pasturing breeding environment selected by the consumer.

title: WEIGHT DETERMINATION OF AN ANIMAL BASED ON 3D IMAGING
abstract: The present disclosure relates to determination of the weight of an animal, especially cattle, in a shed environment based on vision technology, in particular 3D imaging. A first embodiment relates to a method for determining the weight of an animal with known breed, the method comprising the steps of acquiring at least one 3D image of the back of the animal, extracting data from said at least one 3D image relating to the topology of the back of the animal, and calculating the weight of said animal by correlating the extracted data against a reference model comprising information of the topology of the back versus the weight for the breed of said animal.

title: SPECIFICATION MANAGEMENT SYSTEM OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: A specification management system of livestock capable of improving the productivity and profitability comprises: a tag unit attached to ears of livestock, sensing activity and body information of the livestock, and displaying specification information of the livestock; a livestock server analyzing the specification information of the livestock using data sensed by the tag unit; a communication relay unit relaying the network connection between the tag unit and the livestock server; a user terminal controlling the livestock server and displaying the specification information of the livestock analyzed by the livestock server; and a main server storing the data analyzed by the livestock server and analyzing the specification information of the livestock by converting the analyzed data into big data.

title: Method and system for monitoring abnormal sound of pigs
abstract: The invention discloses a method and system for monitoring abnormal sound of pigs. The method for monitoring the abnormal sound of the pigs comprises the following steps that S101, standard signals ofthe abnormal sounds of the pigs are collected; S102, characteristic parameters of the standard signals of the abnormal sound of the pigs are extracted, and a sound recognition model is established according to the characteristic parameters; S103, field sound signals of the pigs in a pig house are collected through sound collection equipment; S104, the field sound signals of the pigs are input into the sound recognition model for identification; and S105, a recognition result is output. The method and system can monitor the sound of the pigs in real time, and judge whether the sound emitted bythe pigs is abnormal sound (such as pig coughing sound and pig biting sound) or not through the sound recognition model, so that people can know that whether the pigs have abnormal behavior or not intime, and corresponding measures are taken timely to ensure the normal growth of a pig herd.
applicants: BEIJING PAIKE SHENGHONG ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Sound-based pig behavior recognition method and system
abstract: The invention particularly relates to a sound-based pig behavior recognition method and system. The system comprises a pig bed body module, an audio collection module, an audio processing and recognition module and an audio play module, wherein the pig bed body module is a place used for allowing pigs to lie at rest and monitoring the pigs; the audio collection module is used for collecting data of sound made by the pigs in a pig bed body; the audio processing and recognition module is used for collecting and saving audio data and recognizing and classifying behaviors of the pigs in audio information; the audio play module plays collected audio files; the audio processing and recognition module is composed of a signal receiving module, a storage hard disk, a loudspeaker, a time warping functional module, a window filtering functional module, a frequency domain transform functional module and a behavior prediction function module. The sound-based pig behavior recognition method and system have the advantages that a pig bed can sense the sound of the pigs and recognize the pigs' behavior types represented by the pig sound, and timely find abnormal behaviors of the pigs such as fightsand illnesses to remind management personnel to take targeted intervention measures in time, thereby improving the automatic and intelligent levels of pig raising.
applicants: HENAN UNIVERSITY OF ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND ECONOMY

title: Method and system for collecting and analyzing vocal behavior of pigs
abstract: The invention particularly relates to a method and system for collecting and analyzing vocal behavior of pigs. The system for collecting and analyzing the vocal behavior of the pigs comprises a pig bed body module, an audio collection module, an audio processing and analysis module, an audio playing module, a signal receiving module, an audio storage module, a behavior labeling module, a frequency domain transform module and a model training and evaluation module, wherein the pigs lie on the pig bed body module during rest; the audio collection module is used for collecting sound data of the pigs in a pig bed body; the audio processing and analysis module is used for collecting and storing audio data, and processing and analyzing the audio data; and the audio playing module plays a collected audio file; the signal receiving module receives the audio file; the audio storage module stores the audio file in a storage hard disk; the behavior labeling module marks the pig sounding behavior; and the frequency domain transform module establishes a frequency domain database of the pig sounding behavior, and a classification model is obtained through the model training and evaluation module. The sound behavior characteristics of the pigs in the pig bed body are collected and stored in a labeling mode, and data support is provided for the sound-based intelligent identification of the pig behavior.
applicants: HENAN UNIVERSITY OF ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND ECONOMY

title: Dairy cow farming system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of dairy cow framing, and discloses a dairy cow farming system, comprising a feeding sub-system, a milk production sub-system and a data center, wherein the feeding sub-system comprises a first electronic label identifier, a data collector, a timer, an infrared sensor and a camera arranged in a cow barn; the milk production sub-system comprises milkingequipment, and a second electronic label identifier, a flow valve and a mastitis detector arranged on the milking equipment. According to the dairy cow farming system, each dairy cow is provided withan electronic label, and feeding and milking information of each dairy cow are collected via the electronic label and related equipment, so that the lifecycle of each dairy cow from feeding to milkingin online monitored in real time, and the dairy cow heath and milk quality can be controlled in time.

title: Statistical method for amount of movement of live pigs
abstract: The invention discloses a statistical method for the amount of movement of live pigs. A camera is arranged above a pig pen, and the influence of the overlap of the pigs in a video can be avoided. The video is obtained through the camera, the video is decomposed into continuous single-frame pictures, the pictures are processed to obtain pictures including only black and white color blocks, the white color blocks represent the positions of the pigs, particles are determined to represent the white color blocks, namely, the positions of the pigs, and the amounts of movement of the pigs are determined based on the amount of movement of the particles in successive two frames of pictures; because the interval between two consecutive frames is short, the amounts of movement of the white color blocks in two frames are small, and the white color blocks are easily distinguished and not easily confused. Finally, all the movements in the video are added to get the total amount of movement of each white color block during the video time, that is, the total amount of movement of each pig. Even if the number of the live pigs in the pig pen in large-scale breeding is large, the amount of movement of each pig can be counted. The statistical method for the amount of movement of the live pigs is very convenient and practical.
applicants: BEIJING PAIKE SHENGHONG ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Intelligent livestock system based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent livestock system based on the Internet of Things, relates to the field of application sensors, LoRa networks, and artificial intelligence livestock, realizes theautomatic collection of livestock and pasture statuses, stores and analyzes data, and gives an intelligent solution for integrating the Internet of Things technology into the livestock industry. The intelligent livestock system comprises an intelligent livestock software system, a special soil moisture information collection climatological station for a pasture, a livestock wearable device, a visual individual identification module and a livestock wireless network based on an LoRa broadband technology. The livestock personnel, scientific research institutions and regulatory agencies can masterthe conditions of the pasture and livestock in real time for daily management; the linkage between ranchers, experts and supervision departments is realized to provide solutions and rapid support foremergency events; complete livestock bookbuilding is achieved, and a foundation is built for further integrating pastures, slaughter houses and retailer information and realizing whole-course qualitytracing; and a large-range epidemic disease outbreak is predicted and effectively controlled by combining a think tank and a big data analysis technology.

title: Livestock breeding management method, device and system and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock breeding management method and system and a storage medium.
