The management method comprises the steps of judging whether or not livestock farrow; when it is confirmed that the livestock farrow, obtaining the number of cubs produced by the livestock; correcting a pre-stored feeding curve according to the number of the cubs; feeding the cubs with fodder accordingto the pre-stored feeding curve. According to the livestock breeding management method and system and the storage medium, after the livestock farrow, the number of the cubs produced by the livestockis timely obtained, the pre-stored feeding curve is corrected according to the number of the produced cubs, feeding is conducted according to the corrected feeding curve, and by confirming whether ornot the livestock farrow and timely adjusting the feeding cubs according to the number of the cubs, it is ensured that the state information of the livestock is timely obtained, then it is guaranteedthat the livestock and cubs are fed with the fodder, and then a sufficient amount of fodder can be fed to the livestock and cubs; meanwhile, the waste of the fodder is avoided, and refined control over the livestock breeding process is achieved.

title: Pig Estrus Test Apparatus
abstract: A conventional pig estrus measuring device can only measure the weight of a pig by measuring the weight of the pig using one or two load cells, and the estrus of a pig cannot be known thereby. To solve such a problem, an automatic breeding device according to the present invention comprises an entrance door, a weight measuring part, a feeding part, and an exit door part. The weight measuring part comprises: a top plate composed of a rectangular top plate frame and a top plate wire mesh; and load cells placed in the middle of the long side of the top plate and at the four corners of the top plate, at the lower part of the top plate. The estrus of a pig is determined from a change pattern of the weight of the pig measured by the six load cells and generated when the pig enters the automatic breeding device. When it is determined that the pig is in estrus from the change in the weight of the pig, pheromone is generated by driving a pheromone scent generator provided at the lower part of the front part of the weight measuring unit where the pig′s head is located, so that it is possible to accurately inspect the estrus of the pig. Also, the movement of a pig after the generation of the pheromone is measured by the six load cells to determine whether there is a change in the movement of the pig. According to the structure of the present invention, a means for determining whether a pig is in estrus is provided, and by using the pheromone scent of a male pig for more accurate confirmation of estrus, the estrus can be more reliably detected earlier.

title: Ear Tag with Acceleration Sensor
abstract: When many pigs are closely bred, it is difficult to recognize each individual by a conventional method using a camera and an image processing system to check the movement of pigs in a conventional pig farm. Thus, the present invention is to resolve such a problem by a method in which a camera is not used. To this end, a pig ear tag provided according to the present invention comprises an RFID, a microprocessor, a real-time clock, a 6-axis accelerometer, a rechargeable battery, a wireless charging unit, and a program synchronization terminal. According to the structure of the present invention, a means capable of measuring the real-time movement of pigs is provided. According to the means, by using such data, it is possible to continuously acquire pig growth environment data, and it is possible to find out how a pig moves if there is something wrong with the pig.

title: A Pig Farm with Mounting Test Apparatus
abstract: Provided is a pig breeding device having a mounting tester. According to the present invention, existing pig estrum measurement can be only performed by coupling a separate device to a pig or observing a behavior change of the pig with a camera device and the like, and thus, is inaccurate and causes the pig to be unpleasant. To this end, an automatic breeding device has an entrance door, a weight measurement unit, a feeding unit and an exit door unit, wherein the weight measurement unit includes an upper plate including a rectangular upper plate frame and an upper wire net, and six load cells disposed in the middle of four corners and long sides of the upper plate at a lower portion of the upper plate. A pig estrum is determined by a change pattern of the weight in accordance with a pig gait, which is generated when the pig enters the automatic breeding device, and is measured by the load cells. The mounting device tests whether the pig allows mounting by pressing a back part of the pig by descending a vertical movement unit of the mounting device provided at an upper portion of a pig weight measurement unit in order to accurately test the pig estrum when it is determined that the pig is in an estrum state from the determination of the pig estrum. Therefore, the sow estrum can be accurately checked.

title: Automated Pig Farm
abstract: The present invention relates to an automatic pig breeding device. When two or more pigs are to enter a pig weight measurement unit and such a situation is not prevented, the two or more pigs enter the pig weight measurement unit or all the pigs fight with each other without entering the pig weight measurement unit. Thus, an automatic pig breeding device cannot function properly. The present invention is to resolve such a problem. To solve the problem, a pig breeding device provided according to the present invention comprises an entrance door, a weight measurement unit, a feeding unit, and an exit door unit. The weight measurement unit comprises: a top plate composed of a rectangular top plate frame and a top plate wire mesh; and load cells placed in the middle of the long side of the top plate, at the four corners of the top plate, and at the lower part of the top plate. When the sum of the weight values of the two innermost load cells opposite to the entrance door among the six load cells is 1/6 or more of the total weight of a pig, the entrance door of the pig breeding device is closed. According to the structure of the present invention, a pig′s health status is predicted by judging the symmetry of the pig′s left and right gait, and the movement of the pig′s weight is detected to close the entrance door. Accordingly, a means enabling the automatic pig breeding device to function properly is provided.

title: Pig Estrus Test Apparatus
abstract: Conventional estrus measurement in pigs is inaccurate and inconvenient to the pigs because the estrus can be measured only by attaching a separate device to the pigs or observing the behavior change of the pigs with a camera device or the like. To solve such a problem, an automatic breeding device according to the present invention comprises an entrance door, a weight measuring part, a feeding part, and an exit door part. The weight measuring part comprises: a top plate composed of a rectangular top plate frame and a top plate wire mesh; and load cells placed in the middle of the long side of the top plate, at the four corners of the top plate, and at the lower part of the top plate. The estrus of a pig is determined from a change pattern of the weight of the pig measured by the six load cells and generated when the pig enters the automatic breeding device. According to the structure of the present invention, the gait of a pig can be analyzed, and thus a means for determining whether a pig is in estrus and whether the pig′s gait is normal or not is provided. Accordingly, pig breeding can be more scientifically performed.

title: Live pig breeding monitoring node, system and method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock scientific breeding, and provides a live pig breeding monitoring node, system and method. The monitoring node comprises a radio frequency recognition unit, a water intake collecting unit, an image collecting unit and a data transmission module and is used for obtaining the identity ID, the body temperature, the water intake and drinking picture information of each pig, information collected by the monitoring node is sent to the far end through the data transmission module so that related people can perform remote monitoring; the relatedbody temperature, the water intake and the drinking picture information of each live pig can be quite conveniently monitored automatically, continuously and cooperatively, and the problem that data errors are caused by manual independent monitoring of various indexes of live pigs is avoided, so that the monitoring efficiency is greatly improved, and effective data support is supplied to early warning and diagnosis of live pig fever diseases.

title: Pig Estrus Test Apparatus
abstract: Conventional estrus measurement in pigs is inaccurate and inconvenient to the pigs because the estrus can be measured only by attaching a separate device to the pigs or observing the behavior change of the pigs with a camera device or the like. To solve such a problem, an automatic breeding device according to the present invention comprises an entrance door, a weight measuring part, a feeding part, and an exit door part. The weight measuring part comprises: a top plate composed of a rectangular top plate frame and a top plate wire mesh; and load cells placed in the middle of the long side of the top plate, at the four corners of the top plate, and at the lower part of the top plate. The estrus of a pig is determined by using a change pattern of the weight of the pig measured by the six load cells and generated when the pig enters the automatic breeding device, and an acceleration sensor provided at the center of the top plate wire mesh. According to the structure of the present invention, a means for confirming whether a pig is in estrus by detecting anxiety indicated by a pig′s gait is provided, and thus pig breeding can be more scientifically performed.

title: Gate Control System for Gathering Biometric Information For Fed Pigs
abstract: The present invention relates to an automatic pig breeding apparatus. The purpose of the present invention is to solve a problem that it is unable to manage an object since pigs do not enter the automatic pig breeding apparatus one by one due to nature of pigs, but enter while struggling, when recognizing a pig by an RFID, measuring the weight, feeding, and storing and managing the weight and feeding amount. To this end, an entrance control system for measuring biometric information for fed pigs comprises: an automatic pig breeding apparatus passage (610); an automatic pig breeding apparatus entrance door (620) for opening and closing the automatic pig breeding apparatus passage (610) in a vertical direction; a distance measurement sensor (630) provided in the automatic pig breeding apparatus entrance door (620) and measuring a distance between a pig and the automatic pig breeding apparatus entrance door to control opening and closing of the automatic pig breeding apparatus entrance door; a door rotation hinge (640) for supporting the automatic pig breeding apparatus entrance door to be able to rotate; and a hydraulic or pneumatic cylinder (not shown) for rotating the automatic pig breeding apparatus entrance door. Therefore, the present invention provides a means for performing effective automatic pig breeding management by controlling sequential entrance of a pig object, which becomes the greatest problem in an automatic pig breeding apparatus.

title: Pig Ear Tag with Led
abstract: The present invention relates to a method in which a camera and an image processing system are used to confirm a motion of a pig in a conventional pig farm, wherein the method is configured to resolve difficulties of recognizing an individual pig when several pigs are densely bred. In the present invention, the following configuration is provided to solve the problem above. Provided is a pig tag which comprises an RFID, a microprocessor, a real-time clock, a charging battery, a wireless charging unit, a synchronization terminal and an LED. Accordingly, as compared with a conventional method of identifying an individual pig depending only on image processing to measure a motion of the pig with the identified result, it is possible to conveniently identify the individual pig and calculate the motion of the pig, thereby easily confirming the motion of the pig in the pig farm in which a lot of pigs are densely bred.

title: Intelligent breeding management method and system for livestock
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent breeding management method and system for livestock. The method comprises the following steps that S1, a preset breeding management value is acquired; S2, a breeding management value is monitored in real time, it is judged whether or not the breeding management value reaches the preset breeding management value, if yes, S3 is executed; and if not, S4 is executed; S3, a breeding manager is reminded to execute a preset breeding management operation step; S4, the breeding management value continues to be monitored. The system comprises a setting unit, a monitoring unit, a judging unit, a prompt unit and a central processing unit. Through the intelligent breeding management method and system for the livestock, the large-scale livestock breeding management can be more intelligent, the breeding cost is reduced, and the breeding efficiency and quality are improved.

title: Cross-cage breeding hen Individual behavior identification system and identification method
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-cage breeding hen individual behavior identification system, which comprises: a nine-axis attitude acceleration sensor worn below the neck of a breeding hen and used for monitoring the behavior of the breeding hen; a camera which is mounted above the local cross cage and is used for shooting breeding hen behavior data; and an upper computer which is in communication connection with the nine-axis attitude acceleration sensor and the camera and is used for analyzing and identifying breeding hen behavior data. The defects in the prior art can be overcome, the identification process is convenient, fast and accurate, and the input of labor cost is reduced.

title: Method and system for detecting abnormality of livestock monitoring equipment
abstract: The invention provides a system for detecting an abnormality of livestock monitoring equipment. The system comprises an acquisition module, a determining module and an execution module, wherein the acquisition module is used for acquiring monitoring data of the livestock monitoring equipment; the determining module is configured to determine whether the livestock monitoring equipment encounters anabnormality according to the monitoring data of the livestock monitoring equipment; the execution module is configured to perform a corresponding abnormal reminding action when the determining moduledetermines that the livestock monitoring equipment encounters the abnormality. The livestock monitoring equipment is one or more selected from the following: a heart rate detecting sensor, a body temperature detecting sensor, a positioning module, and an ambient temperature and humidity sensor. The invention further provides a method for detecting an abnormality of the livestock monitoring equipment. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can monitor whether the livestock monitoring equipment encounters the abnormality, and generate a corresponding reminding action when monitoring that the livestock monitoring equipment encounters the abnormality, thereby ensuring normal operation of the livestock monitoring equipment.

title: Method and system for smart livestock rearing
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart breeding management method. The present invention is composed of: a farm gateway apparatus installed in a livestock house of the farm and linked with a breeding management apparatus and managing breeding management information of the farm; a breeding management service web server; and a central data analysis server that collects breeding management information of each farm and provides a real-time notification service by learning through machine learning along with public data information, disease, feed, and weather. The present invention enables more effective breeding management.

title: METHOD FOR RADIO-FREQUENCY IDENTIFICATION OF LARGE AND SMALL CATTLE AND DEVICE FOR IMPLEMENTATION THEREOF
abstract: FIELD: cattle breeding.SUBSTANCE: group of inventions relates to livestock sector, in particular to livestock, hunting, forest and subsidiary farms, and can be used for identification and compliance with animal health rules. Method for radio-frequency identification of large and small cattle is characterized by using a capsule placed under animal skin, in which a temperature sensor is placed. Piezocrystal is placed in capsule with applied on its surface aluminium interdigital transducer of surface acoustic waves, internal structure of which corresponds to identification code of animal, sensitive element, which is used as temperature sensor, and set of reflectors. Operators are equipped with a reader, in which harmonic oscillation of high frequency is formed, amplified by power, directed to irradiate animal in location of capsule, in which harmonic oscillation of high frequency is picked up, converted to acoustic wave, its propagation along piezoelectric crystal surface and back reflection. Reflected acoustic wave is converted into a phase-shift keyed signal, emitted in the air, trapped by the transceiver antenna of the reader, amplified by power, multiplied and phase-separated by two. Harmonic voltage is then selected and used as a reference voltage for synchronous detection of a complex signal with phase manipulation and for phase comparison with harmonic oscillation of the master oscillator. Low-frequency voltage proportional to the identification code of the animal and a phase difference proportional to temperature of the animal are picked up and recorded. Reader 1 comprises master oscillator 2, power amplifier 3, duplexer 4, directional transceiving antenna 5, high-frequency amplifier 6, phase doubler 7, phase divider 8, narrow-band filter 9, phase detector 10, phase meter 11 and registration unit 12. Capsule contains piezocrystal 13, microstrip transceiving antenna 14, electrodes 15, buses 16 and 17, sensitive element - temperature sensor 18 and set of reflectors 19.EFFECT: invention provides high reliability of radio-frequency identification of large and small cattle.2 cl, 3 dwg

title: A HERD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND A TRACKING SENSOR
abstract: The present invention is related to a herd management system used for gathering data by means of various sensors in any kind of animal breeding activities, for decreasing losses in the herd by means of early detection and intervention, for increasing profitability. The present invention is particularly related to a herd management system which is put on the any limb of the animals within the herd, in which there is a geographical location finder that provides the location continuously, which comprises an electronic label on animals (10) those are registered with herds and farms.
applicants: LAKTO HAYVANCILIK TEKNOLOJİLERİ SANAYİ VE TİCARET LİMİTED ŞİRKETİ

title: Intelligent detection method and system for sow parturition based on nesting behavior
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent detection method and system for sow parturition based on a nesting behavior. The method comprises the steps that from the time before sow parturition to the timewhen parturition is completed, a distance measuring module is adopted for acquiring distance data; the distance data is classified through a subtractive clustering algorithm; the cluster where the nesting behavior is located is obtained by collecting video information, nesting behavior data and non-nesting behavior data are saved in a database; the sow behavior is monitored in real time, and the cluster where the behavior is located is determined, when the sow behavior is located in the cluster of the nesting behavior and the lasting time exceeds a set threshold, an alarm is given. After the method is applied, the nesting behavior before sow parturition can be monitored in real time for 24 hours, no manual guarding is needed, abnormal situations can be found in time, and corresponding measures can be taken, so that the loss caused by the abnormal situations of a breeding factory is reduced, and the work efficiency of breeding personnel is effectively improved.
applicants: NANJING RESEARCH INSTITUTE FOR AGRICULTURAL MECHANIZATION MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE

title: Live pig monitoring terminal and system based on image recognition
abstract: The invention provides a live pig monitoring terminal and system based on image recognition and belongs to the field of live pig breeding. The live pig monitoring terminal based on image recognition comprises a first CPU, a storage module, a first communication module, a live pig video acquisition module, a sensor module and an image characteristic code production unit, wherein the first communication module, the live pig video acquisition module, the sensor module and the image characteristic code production unit are separately connected with the first CPU and the storage module. The providedlive pig monitoring system comprises the live pig monitoring terminal. The terminal and the system have the advantages that an optimal growth environment is created for live pigs, and disease prevention is realized, so that the yield of the live pigs is increased.

title: Health monitoring device for raising and lying of fattening cattle
abstract: The invention provides a health monitoring device for raising and lying of fattening cattle. The health monitoring device comprises a fattening cattle collar and an information acquisition device fixed on the fattening cattle collar; the fattening cattle collar is composed of a nylon belt, a movable lock catch and a balance block, and the information acquisition device comprises a GPS module, a nine-axis sensor, a communication module and a storage module which are respectively connected with a processor. The monitoring device provided by the invention can monitor the raising and lying state and the activity state of the fattening cattle in real time on the premise of not influencing the normal activity of the fattening cattle, analyzes the detection data, intelligently monitors the raising and lying health of the fattening cattle, remotely monitors the raising and lying state of the fattening cattle, and controls the raising and lying health state of the fattening cattle in real time,problems are discovered and treated as soon as possible, and a technical support is provided for the benefit and quality improvement of the fattening cattle.

title: Systems and methods for avian flock flight path modification using UAVs
abstract: Systems and methods for autonomously herding birds in accordance with embodiments of the invention are illustrated. One embodiment includes an autonomous flock herding system, including a bird location sensor, a drone; and a control system, including a processor, and a memory, the memory containing a flock herding application, where the application directs the processor to obtain bird position data from the at least one bird location sensor, where the bird position data describes the location of birds in a flock of birds, determine if the flock of birds will enter a protected zone, generate a set of waypoints using a flock dynamics model, instruct the unmanned aerial vehicle to navigate to at least one waypoint in the set of waypoints such that the flock of birds will, in response to the presence of the unmanned aerial vehicle at the at least one waypoint, change trajectory away from the protected zone.
applicants: IMPERIAL INNOVATIONS; CALTECH (CALIFORNIA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY)

title: RAIL ROBOT SYSTEM FOR MANAGING LIVESTOCK HOUSING
abstract: The present invention relates to a multi-functional rail robot system for livestock housing management. The multi-functional rail robot system for livestock housing management according to the present invention comprises: a transfer path unit installed in a livestock housing divided into a plurality of management areas; a robot unit moving on the transfer path unit; and a control unit controlling the robot unit, wherein the robot unit comprises: a main body; and a filming unit filming livestock housing. According to the present invention, the multi-functional rail robot system for livestock housing management can efficiently monitor and manage a large-area livestock housing while minimizing manpower input.

title: Intelligent pig feeding equipment
abstract: The invention provides intelligent pig feeding equipment. Intelligent weight measuring equipment comprises a measuring equipment outer frame, a weighing support is arranged above the measuring equipment outer frame, a suspension cage is arranged inside the measuring equipment outer frame, and the weighing support is provided with a first weighing device; intelligent feeding equipment comprises a feeding equipment outer frame, the top end of the feeding equipment outer frame is connected with a feed box, the bottom end of the feeding equipment outer frame is provided with a trough, and the front surface of the feeding equipment outer frame is provided with a feeding port; intelligent drinking equipment comprises a drinking equipment outer frame, a drinking basin is arranged in the drinkingequipment outer frame, a sewer pipe is arranged above the drinking basin, and the top end of the sewer pipe is provided with a water level controller and a flowmeter; the feed intake, body weight anddaily water consumption of each pig can be monitored, the growth condition of pigs can be monitored, dozens of pigs can be bred at the same time, the growth balance and meat quality of the same batchof pigs are ensured to be consistent, fighting for eating is reduced, and the labor is saved; and the traceability of pork is realized, and the food safety is improved.

title: Live pig detection system and counting and detection methods
abstract: The invention discloses a live pig detection system. The live pig detection system comprises a live pig detection device, a display electrically connected with an output end of the live pig detectiondevice, a control terminal connected with the live pig detection device through a network model as well as an image acquisition module connected with the live pig detection device through a switch. The user experience is improved, a user can count pigs conveniently, the labor cost is reduced, errors possibly caused by manual counting are reduced, meanwhile, the user can check related statistical data conveniently and check pictures and specific numbers of pigs, and the user can perform check and analysis conveniently, for example, the pig detection system can be used for judging the environment of a pigsty, the pig detection device is convenient to mount and can adapt to more complicated environments (such as high and low temperatures), besides, the user can operate the device through a mobile phone and a computer, and data cloud storage and centralized management can be realized.
applicants: HANGZHOU ANLIAN INTERNET OF THINGS COMPANY

title: Intelligent pasture remote monitoring device, system and method based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent pasture remote monitoring device, system and method based on the Internet of Things, and belongs to the technical field of the Internet of Things. The system comprises the intelligent pasture remote monitoring device based on the Internet of Things, a monitoring center unit, a mobile terminal, a fixed information collection unit and a wireless communication network. The system can remotely monitor the activity status of a pasture herd and information such as temperature, humidity, images and illumination intensity of the environment of the pasture where the herd is located in real time through the Internet of Things, the adopted intelligent pasture remote monitoring device is convenient to wear, and the fixed information collection unit is used for enlarging the monitoring range; monitoring in the pasture adopts a three-moving-point monitoring mode, which reduces the complexity of data by independent individual multi-point remote monitoring and processing, and avoids the problem of one-sidedness of single-point remote monitoring of the livestock.

title: SYSTEM FOR DETECTING COW ESTRUS USING RECOGNITION OF BEHAVIOR PATTERN
abstract: The present invention relates to a cow/bull estrus/rut detecting system using behavior pattern recognition. The system comprises: a behavior detection sensor (100) attached to a cow/bull and detecting the movement and behavior of the cow/bull; a DB server (200) for receiving and storing data detected by the behavior detection sensor (100), and constructing a database together with pre-stored cattle-related breeding information; an analysis server (300) for analyzing data stored in the DB server (200) to recognize a cow/bull′s behavior pattern and detect estrus/rut; an observation camera unit (400); and a smart device (500). According to the present invention, estrus/rut of a cow/bull can be more accurately and easily determined, and thus breeding efficiency of cattle can be enhanced.

title: Detection and management of disease outbreaks in livestock using health graph networks
abstract: Sensor data captured over time and associated with a plurality of livestock animals can be analyzed to determine health conditions associated with a plurality of livestock animals and to determine interactions of the livestock animals. The interactions specify at least distances between the livestock animals, duration of the distances, and frequency of the interactions. A health graph network is constructed, which includes nodes and edges, a node in the nodes representing a livestock animal and specifying at least a health condition of the represented livestock animal, an edge connecting at least two of the nodes and representing an interaction between at least two animals represented by said at least two of the nodes. Based on the health graph network, a potential outbreak among a subgroup of the livestock animals can be predicted.

title: A METHOD, APPARATUS AND SYSTEM FOR DETECTING URINATION EVENTS FOR LIVESTOCK
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus, system and methods for the non-invasive detection and measuring of urination events for livestock animals, which in one example, may be dairy cows. The invention involves detecting audio signals associated with the sound of fluid striking the substrate. If certain properties of the audio signal, and its duration, meet predetermined criteria, then it may be determined that a urination event has occurred for the livestock animal. This data may be assessed and used for managing and/or minimising the potential environmental impact of nitrogen derived from urine of cows on the landscape.

title: METHOD, APPARATUS AND SYSTEM FOR MEASURING URINATION EVENTS FOR COWS
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus, system and non-invasive methods of detecting and measuring urination events for cows. The invention involves the use of apparatus and a system in a method of detecting changes in the tilt angle of the spine of a cow and measuring the duration of those changes. If the changes and duration meet predetermined criteria, then it may be determined that a urination event has occurred for the cow. This data may be assessed and used for managing and/or minimising the potential environmental impact of nitrogen derived from urine of cows on the environment.

title: Intelligent locating method and labels suitable for agricultural livestock management in raising place
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent locating method and labels suitable for agricultural livestock management in a raising place, and belongs to the field of intelligent management equipment and application methods. A plurality of read-write devices and antennas are arranged in a farm, reference labels are separately arranged on each body part of livestock and can independently send information to the read-write devices and the antennas, the read-write devices read the information of the reference labels and determine the positions of the reference labels through a locating algorithm, andthe calculated positions of the reference labels are transmitted to a central information system through the antennas for data management. According to the intelligent locating method and labels suitable for agricultural livestock management in the breeding place, by adopting the intelligent agricultural livestock locating labels, the management efficiency of the farm can be greatly improved, andthe management cost of the farm can be reduced. Meanwhile, the working efficiency of workers in the farm can be improved, and the daily workload is reduced. Since the intelligent agricultural livestock locating labels are driven by paper batteries, the environmental protection performance of materials can be enhanced, and the labels are environmentally friendly and sanitary.

title: Livestock health monitoring system and method of use
abstract: An animal wellness notification system includes an attachment body configured to securely engage with an ear of the animal; an elongated temperature probe secured to the attachment body and configured to extend within the ear of the animal; a housing secured to the attachment body; a power module electrically connect to and configured to provide power to (or recharge) at least one other element of the animal wellness notification system; a computer disposed within the housing and operably associated with the temperature probe; and a notification device in data communication with the computer, the notification device being configured to provide notice if a temperature of the animal goes beyond a determined threshold.

title: Sow health monitoring method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock health monitoring, in particular to a sow health monitoring method and system. The system can record the complete activity state of each sow from slaughter entrance to slaughter exit, and can trace back in the whole process when discovering abnormality, reminds delivery, early warns farrowing, and reduces the risk that piglets are pressed to death; automatically gives an alarm to remind workers of the delivery process of the sows, and makes original work more timely and efficient while reducing manual checking all the time; and can effectively reduce the contact between personnel and foreign objects and the sows, reduces the risk of epidemic situation infection, and avoids the stress reaction brought to the sows by personnel contactgreatly. The method comprises the following steps that the sows are shoot, and shooting signals of the sows are sent; the shooting signals are received, and the shooting signals are saved; data is displayed; and the shooting signals are read, and the sow raising and lying frequency is counted according to the shooting signals.

title: Dairy cattle behavior classifying and judging method and device based on multi-tag-chain type ecological environment
abstract: The invention relates to the field of animal husbandry, in particular to a dairy cattle behavior classifying and judging method and device based on the multi-tag-chain type ecological environment. Themethod includes the steps of obtaining dairy cattle behavior original data, marking a tag Y1 and a tag Y2 for the original data, deriving 57-dimensional feature vectors for the original data, selecting 9-dimensional features from 57-dimensional features according to the tag Y2 by means of a support vector machine-recursive feature elimination method, randomly selecting one half of a selected 9-dimensional dataset to be recorded as a first dataset for training a GBDT model and the other half of the selected 9-dimensional dataset to be recorded as a second dataset for establishing a logistic regression model, and inputting real-time data into a first boosting tree model, a second boosting tree model, a first regression model and a second logistic regression model to obtain the classification result of nine postures of dairy cattle. By dividing the behaviors of the dairy cattle of different types into nine types of postures and precisely classifying and monitoring the behaviors of the dairy cattle, the estrus and health state of the dairy cattle can be judged.
applicants: CHONGQING UNIVERSITY OF POSTS AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title: Smart Calf Cloths Applied ICT
abstract: The present invention relates to ICT-applied smart clothes for calves. More particularly, the present invention relates to ICT-applied smart clothes for calves, which keep the calf′s belly warm by heating the calf′s belly with a heating element while monitoring the calf′s body temperature in real time, thereby preventing or treating diarrhea in calves to prevent calf deaths.

title: Livestock Monitoring Device
abstract: The present invention relates to a monitoring device for livestock, which monitors the activities of livestock more smoothly using a non-contact sensor and an atmospheric pressure sensor.

title: Lame cattle identification and automatic grouping method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic breeding, in particular to a lame cattle identification and automatic grouping method and system. The method comprises the steps that leg andhoof movement images of cattle during walking are collected; according to the leg and hoof movement images, a detection offset between a front hoof foothold of each cow at a certain moment and a rearhoof foothold at the same side at the next moment is obtained; according to the detection offset, the state of each cow is judged, and opening and closing of a corresponding grouping door are controlled to drive the cattle to enter a corresponding grouping passage. The system comprises an image acquisition device, an image recognition device, a main passage, the grouping passages and the groupingdoors. According to the lame cattle identification and automatic grouping method and system, through the offset between the front hoof foothold and the rear hoof foothold, whether the cattle is a lamecow or a normal cattle is judged, and the opening and closing states of the grouping doors of the grouping passages are controlled to separate the lame cattle and the normal cattle into different groups, so that a veterinarian can diagnose the separated lame cattle in time to facilitate the subsequent diagnosis of cattle hoof diseases.

title: Intelligent animal ear tag
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent animal ear tag. The intelligent animal ear tag comprises a male mark and a female mark; the male mark comprises a nail head mechanism and a sign monitoring mechanism, and the bottom of the nail head mechanism is fixed to the sign monitoring mechanism; the female mark comprises a cylinder body, a base and an elastic mechanism, and the elastic mechanism is arranged between the cylinder body and the base; a nail head clamping structure is arranged in a passage formed in the cylinder body in the axial direction, a via hole corresponding to the nail head mechanism in size is formed in the portion, corresponding to the passage of the cylinder body, of the base, and the nail head mechanism of the male mark passes the via hole and then is clamped into the passage of the cylinder body through the nail head clamping mechanism; the elastic mechanism can be compressed so as to generate acting force to the base and the sign monitoring mechanism, and thus the base and the sign monitoring mechanism both cling to the two sides of the ear of an animal all the time. According to the ear tag, the sign monitoring mechanism can cling to the ear of the animal all the time to perform continuous and accurate monitoring on animal sign data. Meanwhile, the contact area of the ear tag and the ear of the animal is large, the pressure to the animal is small, and the ear of the animal is not likely to be hurt.

title: Monitoring livestock
abstract: An apparatus for raising livestock includes one or more confinement pens together with alleyways for transfer of the animals from one location to another. The apparatus includes one or more cameras for obtaining images of all animals in the containment area. A processor is provided for analyzing the images, the processor being arranged to allocate an arbitrary identification to each animal and to track all animals continually to maintain the allocation. From this tracking various data related to individual animals or the animals as a group can be obtained to assess their characteristics and to provide an indication to the worker of the animal to be extracted. The processor can be arranged to detect by image analysis of the image a quantity of feed and/or water in a feeder and to obtain images of the farrowing pen including the sow confinement area and at least one piglet confinement area.

title: System and Method for Monitoring Activity and Forecasting Healthcare of Livestock
abstract: Provided are a system and a method for livestock activity amount monitoring and health surveillance, wherein it is possible to quickly perform responding in advance by improving a breeding environment and observing disease signs through the identification of the body temperature and activity amount of livestock in real time. A livestock management system according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a reference heating element which is installed in a livestock house and generating heat at a set temperature; a thermal imaging camera which generates a thermal image by photographing livestock raised in a livestock house and a reference heating element; and a processor which identifies the temperature of the reference heating element and the body temperature of the livestock from the thermal image generated by the thermal imaging camera, and predicts the health of the livestock by using the identified temperature of the reference heating element and the body temperature of the livestock. Accordingly, through the real-time identification of the body temperature and activity of livestock, it is possible to quickly perform responding in advance by improving a breeding environment and observing disease signs.

title: Live pig breeding monitoring method and system
abstract: The invention provides a live pig breeding monitoring method and system. The method includes the steps: acquiring oink data of live pigs and building an oink sample library; taking oink samples in thesample library as input parameters, taking health conditions of the live pigs as output parameters and performing deep learning by the aid of a voiceprint recognition system; acquiring oink of the live pigs in a live pig farm in real time and judging the health conditions of the live pigs by the aid of the voiceprint recognition system. The oink of the live pigs is analyzed by the voiceprint recognition system after deep learning, the health conditions and abnormal behaviors of the live pigs can be timely and accurately monitored, early warning is performed at the first time, cost is reducedas compared with manual routing inspection, and efficiency is improved.

title: Artificial intelligence based non-contact breeding pig body temperature abnormity monitoring system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of cultivation and discloses an artificial intelligence based non-contact breeding pig body temperature abnormity monitoring system, which comprises an automatic buttock detection module, a QR-code pig identification module, a non-invasive non-contact infrared temperature measuring module, a body temperature fluctuation recording module and an abnormalbody temperature warning push module. An output end of the automatic buttock detection module is connected with an input end of the QR-code pig identification module, an output end of the QR-code pigidentification module is connected with an input end of the non-invasive non-contact infrared temperature measuring module, and an output end of the non-invasive non-contact infrared temperature measuring module is connected with an input end of the body temperature fluctuation recording module. Since software and hardware are designed in linkage to form a whole system by means of mature techniques such as the artificial intelligence, the deep learning and the computer vision, the system realizes real-time monitoring to body temperature of each breeding pig and then pushes the abnormity data to breeders in time, so that the breeders can isolate the pigs with abnormal body temperature to prevent epidemic spreading, and high real-time performance and high efficiency are both achieved.

title: Livestock and feedlot data collection and processing using UHF-band interrogation of radio frequency identification tags
abstract: An agricultural data collection framework is provided in a system and method for tracking and managing livestock, and for analyzing animal conditions such as health, growth, nutrition, and behavior. The framework uses ultra-high frequency interrogation of RFID tags to collect individual animal data across multiple geographical locations, and incorporates artificial intelligence techniques to develop machine learning base models for statistical process controls around each animal for evaluating the animal condition. The framework provides a determination of normality at an individual animal basis or for a specific location, and generates alerts, predictions, and a targeted processing or application schedule for prioritizing and delivering resources when intervention is needed.

title: Livestock Management System with Audio Support
abstract: A voice controlled virtual assistant usable by livestock management or workers is disclosed. Information received via a cloud connected device can include veterinary related questions, curated answers, or access to individual animal health records. The animal support system can actively provide information derived from information received through the cloud connected device, including warnings derived from audio monitoring of animal condition. In some embodiments, the cloud connected device can interact with additional sensors that monitor animal condition, capture animal images, or provide electronically available animal tag identification or sensor information.

title: A Pig Farm with Mounting Test Apparatus
abstract: Conventional measurement of estrus in a pig is enabled only through the monitoring of behavioral changes of a pig by coupling a separate device to the pig or by using a camera device, and thus is inaccurate, and causes inconvenience to the pig. In order to solve the above problems, the present invention provides a pig breeding apparatus including a mounting examination device. The automatic breeding apparatus comprises: an entrance door; a weight measurement unit; a feeding unit; and an exit door unit. The weight measurement unit of the automatic breeding apparatus includes: an upper plate having an upper plate frame and an upper plate iron net formed in a rectangular shape; and six load cells formed in the middle of four corners and four long sides of the upper plate on a lower portion of the upper plate. The weight measurement unit is configured to determine whether a pig is in estrus from patterns of weight change thereof according to the pig′s gait, which are generated when the pig enters the automatic breeding apparatus and measured by the six load cells. When the pig is confirmed to be in estrus while the determination of whether the pig is in estrus is performed, an upper/lower moving unit of the mounting examination device provided on an upper portion of the pig weight measurement unit is lowered to press the back of the pig so as to examine whether the pig allows mounting such that estrus in the pig can be accurately examined. Accordingly, the present invention is able to accurately check whether a female pig is in estrus.

title: IDENTIFICATION INFORMATION READING DEVICE, METHOD, PROGRAM, RECORD MEDIUM AND MEASUREMENT SYSTEM
abstract: To easily associate measurement results of milk with dairy cows.SOLUTION: An identification information reading device 1 comprises: an ID reader 1a that reads a dairy cow ID from a recording medium 2a that records an ID of a dairy cow 2; a milk container 1b; a somatic cell concentration measurement unit 1c that measures the concentration of somatic cells in milk obtained from the dairy cow 2; a measurement result recording unit 1d that records the concentration of somatic cells in association with dairy cow identification information; and a measurement result output unit 1e that outputs the recorded content of the measurement result recording unit 1d. The recording medium 2a is attached to the dairy cow 2.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: A Pig Farm with Mounting Test Apparatus
abstract: Conventional measurement of estrus in a pig is enabled only through the monitoring of behavioral changes of a pig by coupling a separate device to the pig or by using a camera device, and thus is inaccurate, and causes inconvenience to the pig. In order to solve the above problems, the present invention provides a pig breeding apparatus including a mounting examination device. The automatic breeding apparatus comprises: an entrance door; a weight measurement unit; a feeding unit; and an exit door unit. The weight measurement unit of the automatic breeding apparatus includes: an upper plate having an upper plate frame and an upper plate iron net formed in a rectangular shape; and six load cells formed in the middle of four corners and four long sides of the upper plate on a lower portion of the upper plate. The weight measurement unit is configured to determine whether a pig is in estrus from patterns of weight change thereof according to the pig′s gait, which are generated when the pig enters the automatic breeding apparatus and measured by the six load cells. When the pig is confirmed to be in estrus while the determination of whether the pig is in estrus is performed, an upper/lower moving unit of the mounting examination device provided on an upper portion of the pig weight measurement unit is lowered to press the back of the pig so as to examine whether the pig allows mounting such that estrus in the pig can be accurately examined. Accordingly, the present invention is able to accurately check whether a female pig is in estrus.

title: Dairy herd improvement determination standard substance, and preparation method and applications thereof
abstract: The invention provides a dairy herd improvement (DHI) determination standard substance, and a preparation method and applications thereof. The standard substance is obtained through orthogonal designaccording to components with the following mass percentage ranges and corresponding horizontal gradients: the mass percentage range of fat is 0.20-6.00%, and 12 horizontal gradients are designed; themass percentage range of protein is 2.00-4.50%, and 6 horizontal gradients are designed; and the mass percentage range of lactose is 4.00-5.00%, and 4 horizontal gradients are designed. The standard substance is uniform, stable, wide in component concentration range and low in leverage value, so that requirements of DHI measurement can be achieved, and the influences of the correlation between fatand protein content in natural milk samples on the calibration accuracy of the DHI standard substance can be reduced; and after a DHI standard substance calibration instrument is used, the accuracy of the instrument can be enhanced, measurement levels can be improved and maintain stable, and inter-laboratory consistency can be increased.

title: Animal house environment control method and system
abstract: The invention discloses an animal house environment control method. The method comprises the steps that a respiratory rate of cattle is monitored; a rough wheeze sign of the cattle is detected based on the detected respiratory rate of the cattle, and animal house environment is controlled based on the detected rough wheeze sign of the cattle. The invention also discloses an animal house environment control system, and the system comprises a plurality of intelligent necklaces and a cloud processor, wherein the multiple intelligent necklaces can be worn on the cattle so as to monitor the respiratory rate of the cattle; the cloud processor is capable of receiving the detected respiratory rate of the cattle from the multiple intelligent necklaces, the rough wheeze sign of the cattle is detected based on the detected respiratory rate of the cattle, and the animal house environment is controlled based on the detected rough wheeze sign of the cattle.
applicants: ALLFLEX (CHINA) INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; EAST ROCK

title: Positioning column sow monitoring system and method
abstract: An embodiment of the invention provides a positioning column sow monitoring system and method. A color image, a depth image and a heat distribution image of a sow are acquired by a data acquisition device, the size, the condition, the weight and the temperature of the sow are acquired according to the color image, the depth image and the heat distribution image of the sow, and a growth health condition grade of the sow is acquired according to the size, the condition, the weight and the temperature of the sow. According to the system, machine vision, a depth sensor, a heat imaging sensor, an internet of things, signal processing, three-dimensional scanning, intelligent information processing and the like are integrated. The method includes the steps: sow physical sign monitoring; size parameter monitoring; health condition monitoring; breeding environment assessment and the like. According to the device and the method, condition information and environment information of the positioning column sow can be timely, accurately, rapidly, automatically and intelligently acquired and monitored.
applicants: BEIJING RESEARCH CENTER FOR INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY IN AGRICULTURE; AGCORE TECHNOLOGY (GUANGZHOU) COMPANY

title: Smart farm livestock management system and method
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart farm livestock management system implemented in a way that a recognition body is implanted on the skin of livestock to identify an individual thereof and manage growth status of the livestock according to a change in the size of the recognition body caused by the growth of the livestock, and to a method thereof. The smart farm livestock management system comprises: a recognition body implanted on or attached to the skin of livestock; an identification device which identifies the recognition body, transmits individual identification information, confirms the size of the recognition body changed according to the growth of the livestock, and transmits recognition body size information; a management server which confirms individual weight information corresponding to the recognition body size information transmitted from the identification device, and registers the individual weight information or the recognition body size information transmitted from the identification device for each piece of individual identification information transmitted from the identification device so as to individually manage growth status of the livestock; and a database which converts and sets corresponding individual weight information into a database according to the recognition body size information, classifies and stores the individual weight information or the recognition body size information registered by the management server, for each piece of individual identification information. Accordingly, it is possible to efficiently manage the livestock.

title: Intelligent live pig transferring system and transferring method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent live pig transferring system which comprises: a live pig electronic identification module; a transferring center upper computer that comprises a transferring center server and a transferring control terminal, wherein the transferring center server is used for synchronizing the information increment of the live pigs needing transfer into a pre-transfer queue according to the production pre-transfer queue and a transferring scheduling table which is not updated and is manually set; a plurality of transferring physical devices that comprises a feeder, a lower computer, an entrance channel provided with an entrance guard and a pig transferring channel, wherein the pig transferring center upper computer synchronizes an updated pig pre-transfer queue to thelower computer through a heartbeat packet mechanism, and the lower computer is used for judging the identity of a live pig eating currently and judging whether to transfer the live pig or not according to the synchronized pig pre-transfer queue; a database. The invention further discloses a pig transferring method of the intelligent pig transferring system for the live pigs. The problem that reasonable and controllable pig transferring scheduling cannot be more conveniently, rapidly and accurately carried out on pigsty transferring services of an existing intelligent feeding station is solved.

title: Smart farm livestock management system using code and management method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart farm livestock management system and management method using a code, capable of creating an optimal growth environment by accurately recognizing cattle or pigs by using a QR code or a barcode, etc. as an individual information recognition code and managing the growth status of each population. The system comprises: a code application means for applying an individual information recognition code to livestock; a photographing means for photographing the individual information recognition code; an analysis means for analyzing the individual information recognition code photographed by the photographing means; and a management means for managing the livestock according to the individual information recognition code analyzed by the analysis means. The code application means implants a plurality of QR codes or barcodes on the back, flanks, etc. of piglets during the first vaccination after piglets are born. The photographing means provides a configuration that is a camera installed on the ceiling of a pig pen to photograph the QR code or barcode, which is the individual information recognition code. Therefore, it is possible to create an optimal growth environment for livestock.

title: Pig quantity monitoring device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to a pig quantity monitoring device. The pig quantity monitoring device includes an image acquisition device for obtaining an image at the trough of each pig pen, namely, the image at the trough, a pig quantity identification device for determining the quantity of pigs eating in each pig pen according to the image at the trough of each pig pen, and an alarmdevice for issuing an alarm when the change in the quantity of pigs in a pig pen exceeds the predetermined quantity or the change in the total quantity of pigs in each pig pen exceeds the predetermined quantity according to the quantity of pigs eating in each pig pen obtained by the pig quantity identification device.
applicants: CHONGQING XIAOFU NONGKANG AGRICULTURE TECHNOLOGY SERVICE COMPANY

title: IoT Real time monitoring system and method for agriculture and farming by using IoT sensors
abstract: The present invention relates to: a real-time monitoring system for agriculture and farming using IoT sensors, which detects a tag attached to a moving entity and a Wi-Fi signal by using the IoT sensors and uses a livestock monitoring system (LMS) to monitor an approach to a virtual fence and an abnormal action of the moving entity; and a real-time monitoring method. According to the present invention, a tag/Wi-Fi signal generator is installed on the moving entity to generate a tag/Wi-Fi signal, the IoT sensors detect the tag/Wi-Fi signal generated by the tag/Wi-Fi signal generator, and an LMS unit receives the tag/Wi-Fi signal detected by the IoT sensors to monitor an approach to a virtual fence and an abnormal action of the moving entity.

title: 3 Cattle plague alarm system using 3 kinds of data from sensors
abstract: The present invention relates to a system that displays a notification about a disease on a manager's wireless communication device and transmits it along with a countermeasure when a disease data value stored in the control device is matched by receiving the measured data value of livestock from a control device through an attachment device in the form of a silicone ring that can measure a body temperature, a heart rate, and an exercise volume of the livestock, and is characterized in that the accuracy can be increased and the collected data be monitored and managed by one server in one region or the entire country in order to accurately identify diseases and types of diseases, the heart rate, the body temperature, and the momentum amount measured and compared with the stored data.

title: METHOD FOR MONITORING STATE OF LIVESTOCK WITH MONITORING TERMINAL AND APPARATUS THEREOF
abstract: Disclosed according to an embodiment of the present invention is a method for monitoring the state of livestock, performed by a device for monitoring the state of livestock. The method for monitoring the state of the livestock includes the following steps: receiving state information of a first livestock from a first terminal in contact with the first livestock; identifying the first livestock based on the state information of the first livestock, and displaying matched graphic information; changing at least one of a shape and a color of the displayed graphic information based on temperature and motion information in the state information of the first livestock; and displaying health state information of livestock corresponding to the changed graphic information.

title: Ruminant movement behavior identification method and system and computer readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a ruminant movement behavior identification method and system and a computer readable storage medium. The ruminant movement behavior identification method comprises the steps that the X-axis acceleration, Y-axis acceleration and Z-axis acceleration of an animal are acquired by an acceleration sensor in real time; the X-axis acceleration, Y-axis acceleration and Z-axis acceleration which are acquired in real time are calculated to obtain real-time resultant acceleration A, wherein the computational formula is shown in the description, Ax is the X-axis acceleration, Ay isthe Y-axis acceleration and Az is the Z-axis acceleration; the real-time resultant acceleration A is subjected to noise reduction treatment; the point value of the resultant acceleration A is obtained at the interval b; obtained movement behaviors of the animal are judged, wherein movement states of the animal include the static behavior, the walking behavior and the running behavior. According to the method, the ruminant movement behaviors can be monitored in real time, so that management and analysis of ruminants are facilitated.

title: Dairy cow behavior recognition algorithm based oestrus and health monitoring method
abstract: The invention discloses a dairy cow behavior recognition algorithm based oestrus and health monitoring method and particularly relates to the field of NB-IOT animal wearable devices. The method includes that dairy cow behavior data are mined on the basis of artificial intelligence by a dairy cow behavior recognition algorithm and an NB-IOT data transmission and receiving and cloud algorithm layer.A device required for the monitoring method comprises an application layer, the cloud algorithm layer, a data transmission layer and a behavior algorithm layer. By behavior recognition algorithms ofdairy cow activities, walking, eating, ruminating, resting and the like and an NB-IOT low-power-consumption wide area network for real-time data transmission, multi-dimensional integrated monitoring of dairy cow oestrus can be realized through data mining and machine learning technologies, and accordingly the dairy cow oestrus and disease discovery rate is substantially increased. Therefore, economic benefits of farms are increased, and the popularizing rate of smart collars for dairy cows is increased.

title: Sow oestrus monitoring method, device and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a sow oestrus monitoring method, device and system, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The technical scheme includes that by continuous collection of to-be-detected images including target objects, image based multi-dimension acquisition of sow state information and comprehensive analysis on the basis of the information to determine whether sows are in oestrus or not, sow oestrus can be monitored by means of computer vision, behaviors including manual routing inspection or boar driving and the like are avoided, sow oestrus can be discovered timely and accurately, and accordingly timely mating of the sows can be realized, the reproductive rate of the sows is increased, and labor cost is sharply reduced while monitoring efficiency is greatly improved. In addition, the monitoring device is low in hardware cost and avoids contacting with the sows, so that disease infection risks are reduced, and influences on health of the sows due to stress reaction of thesows are avoided.
applicants: BEIJING HAIYI TONGZHAN INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Method, device and system for monitoring state of object, and method, device and system for monitoring estrus of sow
abstract: The invention relates to a method, a device and a system for monitoring the state of an object, and a method, a device and a system for monitoring the estrus of a sow. The method for monitoring the state of the object includes acquiring a to-be-detected image, recognizing posture information of a target object from the to-be-detected image according to a pre-trained posture detection model, and analyzing the state of the target object according to the posture information. Through computer vision, the state of the object is recognized based on the image, so that long-term manual observation anddetermination are not needed, and labor cost and time cost are greatly reduced; recognition for monitoring the state of the object can be achieved without a camera and a computing device, and the cost of the monitoring system is low; monitoring results are accurate, the real-time performance is high, and the monitoring efficiency is improved.
applicants: BEIJING HAIYI TONGZHAN INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Livestock face recognition equipment and fence with same
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock breeding, in particular to livestock face recognition equipment and a fence with the same. The livestock face recognition equipment comprisesa mounting pipe, a camera, a lifting mechanism and a connecting mechanism; an opening is formed in the mounting pipe; the camera comprises a body and a lens, the body is embedded in the mounting pipethrough the opening, and the lens is located outside the mounting pipe; the lifting mechanism is connected with the mounting pipe and used for driving the mounting pipe to lift; and the connecting mechanism is used for connecting the fence, and the lifting mechanism is installed on the connecting mechanism. The whole equipment is mounted on the livestock fence through any connecting mechanism, thecamera is directly embedded into the mounting pipe, a camera support does not need to be independently designed, the mounting stability of the camera is guaranteed, the camera body structure is protected, the camera is prevented from being damaged, and the subsequent camera maintenance burden is reduced; and the height of the camera is adjusted through the lifting mechanism so as to meet the shooting requirement.
applicants: BEIJING HAIYI TONGZHAN INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Intelligent non-inductive temperature measurement system and temperature measurement method for pig farm
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent non-inductive temperature measurement system and temperature measurement method for a pig farm, and belongs to the technical field of pig temperature measurement.The temperature measurement system comprises: a temperature measuring robot, used for measuring the temperature of pigs in pigsties; a guide rail, arranged along the pigsty and used for allowing thetemperature measuring robot to move so as to measure the temperature of the pigs in each pigsty; and an RFID (radio frequency identification) module, arranged in the temperature measuring robot, wherein a corresponding RFID tag is arranged at a rail of each pigsty so as to stop the temperature measuring robot at the position. According to the invention, the temperature measuring robot moves alongthe guide rail to measure the temperature of pigs in each pigsty, no special channel needs to be established, and therefore, the cost is low; driving the pigs to move is not required, the temperaturemeasuring robot moves along the guide rail rapidly, the body temperature measurement for one pig can be completed in about 30 seconds, the temperature measuring time is short, and the temperature measuring efficiency is high.

title: LIVESTOCK STILLBIRTHING ALERTING SYSTEM
abstract: An image capture device with processors can execute a set of instructions stored in the system memory to: receive a plurality of time-sequenced images of the animal from the digital image sensor; determine, using an artificial intelligence module, a first birth in process from a first subset of images of the plurality of time-sequenced images of the animal; and determine an interval of time lapse between the first birth in process from the first subset of images of the plurality of time-sequenced images of the animal and a next birth in process from the next subset of images of the plurality of time-sequenced images of the animal, as determined using the artificial intelligence module, and when the interval of time lapse between the first birth in process and the next birth in process exceeds a predetermined amount trigger an action from an alert trigger.

title: Breeding management method, system and device, and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a breeding management method, system and device, and a storage medium. The management method includes as follows: obtaining remaining material amount in a material plate; obtaining current bred amount and historical feeding amount when the remaining material amount is less than preset material amount, and obtaining current to-be-needed feeding amount according to the current bred amount and the historical feeding amount; and performing feeding according to the current to-be-needed feeding amount. Under the condition that livestock is guaranteed to eat enough, the wasteof feed can be reduced and scientific breeding can be realized by determining the remaining material amount in the material plate, determining the current to-be-needed feeding amount according to thecurrent bred amount and the historical feeding amount when the remaining material amount is less than the preset material amount and performing feeding according to the current to-be-needed feeding amount.

title: SYSTEM FOR MANAGING BREED OF CATTLE TO FORCE THE MANAGEMENT OF CATTLE WITH REGISTRATION
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for managing breeding cycles of Korean native cattle, capable of compelling management of Korean native cattle through a registration procedure. According to the present invention, the system for managing breeding cycles of Korean native cattle comprises: an estrus detection unit; a server for managing and storing information on a breeding cycle and a breeding state; and a breeder terminal, wherein the server includes a schedule calculation unit, a registration unit, and a comparison unit. According to the present invention, an estrus can be more accurately determined.

title: SYSTEM FOR MANAGING BREEDING OF COW WITH ACTIVITY GRAPH AND BREEDING INFORMATION
abstract: The present invention relates to a Korean native cattle breeding management system for providing an activity graph and breeding state information. The Korean native cattle breeding management system for providing an activity graph and breeding state information comprises a breeding cow management module (100) configured to compare and provide collected activity state information for each object; a breeding expectation date management module (200) for storing and providing expectation breeding state information per date and object state information; a semen/fertilized egg management module (300); and a livestock management module (400) that stores and provides cattle shed state information including manager information and real-time video of a cattle shed. Therefore, the Korean native cattle breeding management system for providing an activity graph and breeding state information can accurately and easily determine a breeding state of breeding cattle.

title: Method for providing management guidline based on feeding standard
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for providing a guide in accordance with a feeding management standard related to domestic livestock, which is executed on a computer system. The method includes: a feeding management standard storage step; a step of receiving at least one first sensing data (temperature and humidity) from at least one livestock house sensor; a step of receiving at least one second sensing data (current sensing data for body composition measurement, feed box weight sensor data), livestock image data (including lateral and posterior livestock images, vertebral process image of the livestock, images of humeral processes in the vertebral processes of the livestock, images of the livestock humeral processes, stepped images of the flanks of the livestock, hip and sciatic processes images of the livestock, image between the ischial and hip joint of the livestock, image between the hip joint of the livestock, and image of the ischial process at the tail of the livestock), livestock-related biometric characteristic data (age, breed, pregnancy status, and sex information on the livestock), and a plurality of genetic information on the livestock from at least one livestock sensor; a step of receiving real life video data on the livestock (including feeding video, gait video, sleeping video, moving video, and livestock house cleaning status); and a step of calculating the body condition score of the livestock based on the livestock image data.

title: Livestock's weight measuring device and weight measuring method using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock body weight measuring apparatus and a body weight measuring method using the same. According to the present invention, the livestock body weight measuring apparatus comprises: a front surface fence, a left-side surface fence, a right-side surface fence, a rear surface fence, and a gauge for measuring the weight of livestock. There is a space unit formed on an upper side of the front surface fence through which the head of livestock can pass from the inside toward the outside. According to the present invention, the body weight measuring method using the livestock body weight measuring apparatus comprises: a step of measuring the individual information of the livestock placed in the livestock body weight measuring apparatus including the livestock′s head height, shoulder width, and length in a sensor unit; a step of controlling the height of the front surface fence of the livestock measuring apparatus by a control unit in accordance with the head height of the livestock among the measured individual information; a step of controlling the distance between the left-side surface fence and the right-side surface fence of the livestock measuring apparatus by the control unit in accordance with the shoulder width of the livestock among the measured individual information; a step of controlling the distance between the front surface fence and the rear surface fence of the livestock measuring apparatus by the control unit in accordance with the length of the livestock among the measured individual information; and a step of measuring the weight of the livestock on the gauge of the livestock measuring apparatus. The present invention has effects to, when measuring the body weight of the livestock on the body weight measuring apparatus, control the height of the front surface fence, the distance between the left-side surface fence and the right-side surface fence, and the distance between the front surface fence and the rear surface fence, to minimize the movement of the livestock while the body weight of the livestock is being measured by fixing the livestock, and to increase the accuracy of the body weight measurement.

title: Long range low power livestock monitoring
abstract: Systems for long range low power cattle monitoring include a tail patch for sensing mounting activity and communicating the sensed activity via low power communications techniques. Low power, LoRaWAN, communications with long range capabilities can provide extended range for monitoring breeding activity while conserving energy use.

title: .Method and system of determine cow mounting behavior
abstract: The present invention relates to a method and system of determine a cow mounting behavior, and more specifically, to a method and system of determine a cow mounting behavior, which can detect a cow suspected of mounting behavior from an image, and accurately determine whether or not the mounting behavior of the cow is performed based on a detected motion of the cow and detection duration.

title: Held-down piglet detection method, device and system
abstract: The invention provides a held-down piglet detection method, device and system. The method includes: acquiring images in a monitoring area, performing pig detection in the images, and determining at least one piglet area with piglets and at least one adult pig area with adult pigs in the images; performing adult pig lying-down detection in each adult pig area, and determining lying-down adult pig areas with lying-down adult pigs; judging whether piglets are held down by the lying-down adult pigs or not according to an overlapping relation between the lying-down adult pig areas and the at leastone piglet area; if piglets are held down by the lying-down adult pigs, generating alarm signals. Therefore, whether the piglets are held down by the lying-down adult pigs or not can be judged in themonitoring area in real time through image recognition, and the alarm signals are generated timely when the piglets are held down by the lying-down adult pigs, so that the held-down piglets can be timely rescued by workers, and operating efficiency is improved.

title: Positive pig farm pseudorabies purification method for PRV (pseudorabies virus) infection
