abstract: The invention discloses a positive pig farm pseudorabies purification method for PRV (pseudorabies virus) infection, and particularly relates to the technical field of pseudorabies purification. The purification method particularly includes the steps: S1 pig farm background investigation; S2 vaccine selection and immunity and effect assessment; S3 negative conversion of growing and fattening pig groups; S4 negative standby breeding pig group building; S5 negative boar group building; S6 sampled vaccine immunization detection of all pig groups, and complete elimination of pig groups with gE positive wild virus antibodies. According to the method, background investigation of the positive pseudorabies pig farm, vaccine selection and immunity and effect assessment, negative conversion of the growing and fattening pig groups, negative standby breeding pig group building, negative boar group building and detection, elimination and supplement are implemented, and positive pseudorabies pig farms are effectively controlled and purified step by step.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL HEALTH, GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Fast and Simple Length Compare Method for Pig's Pose Detection
abstract: Disclosed is a fast and simple length comparison method for determining posture of a pig to efficiently manage pigs in a pig room. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the fast and simple length comparison method for determining posture of a pig comprises the following steps: acquiring an image of a pig in a pig room through a camera installed in a pigsty; acquiring a pig image separated from a background in which gray values remain by performing a background separation operation to separate a pig room floor and the pig from the pig image; acquiring the central point and occupation area of the pig by using a connected component labeling technique in the pig image; connecting a line segment connecting an outline of the pig from the acquired central point by using OpenCV; and comparing the lengths of the connected line segments to acquire a difference in the lengths and determining that the posture of the pig is incorrect when the length difference between the line segments is greater than or equal to a predetermined level.

title: MONITORING OF THE WELL-BEING AND/OR COMFORT OF A LIVESTOCK ANIMAL
abstract: The present invention concerns an electronic system (100) for monitoring the well-being of a livestock animal (A) such as a bovine, the system (100) comprising: a) a portable measurement module (10) positioned on the animal (A) and comprising: - a temperature probe (11) for measuring the temperature of the ambient air on the animal (A), denoted Tvac_m, and - a humidity sensor (12) for measuring a humidity of the ambient air on the animal (A), denoted HRvac_m; and b) a central processing unit (20) remote from the animal (A) and comprising: - a generation circuit (22) configured for collecting information relating to the temperature and humidity measured on the animal (A) and for generating, according to the collected information, at least one temperature datum (DT) containing a piece of information relating to the measured temperature Tvac_m and at least one humidity datum (DH) containing a piece of information relating to the measured humidity HRvac_m; - a processing circuit (23) for processing the temperature (DT) and humidity (DH) data in order to calculate an actual relative humidity HR felt by the animal; and - a processor (24) configured for determining a comfort parameter associated with the well-being of the animal (A) according to the calculated actual relative humidity HR felt.

title: SWINE ACTIVATED FEEDER WITH ACTUATION SENSOR
abstract: A sensor assembly on a swine-activated self-feeder allows monitoring or tracking of individual animal feeding activity, thereby allowing corrective action to be taken in instances of under-feeding or over-feeding by an animal. The sensor assembly includes a sensor on the feed dispenser and, with a printed circuit board to generate a signal corresponding to activation of the dispenser by an animal. The signal can be sent to a computer or website which generates reports on the individual animal's feeding activity.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR DETERMINING HEALTH STATUS OF FARM LIVESTOCK
abstract: Disclosed are a method and a system for evaluating a state of farm livestock which can accurately evaluate the health state of farm livestock by an individual. Such the system for evaluating a state of farm livestock includes at least one camera which is installed at an arbitrary farm and takes a video; and a farm livestock state evaluation device which is in connection with the camera. The farm livestock state evaluation device extracts an outline by analyzing a video taken at an arbitrary reference time in the camera; sorting a livestock individual by using the extracted outline; determining a reference line by the sorted livestock individual; determining an evaluation reference for evaluating a health state of the livestock individual by each livestock individual by using the determined reference line; extracting an outline by analyzing a video taken at at least one time after the reference time in the camera; sorting the livestock individual by using the extracted outline; setting a target line by the sorted livestock individual; and comparing the set target line with the evaluation reference for the same livestock individual; and evaluating a health state by the livestock individual. Accordingly, the health state of farm livestock by an individual can be accurately evaluated.

title: Method for quickly finding cows in pasture
abstract: The invention discloses a method for quickly finding cows in a pasture. The method includes that step 1, each cow wears an RFID tag that stores a corresponding cow number of the cow; step 2, a user carrying an RFID reader enters a cow house and inputs the cow number of a target cow into the RFID reader, and the RFID reader sends a reminding signal if detecting the target cow. The method has the advantages that the RFID reader on a handheld terminal reads the cow numbers in the RFID tags, the target cow can be determined to be within the identification range of the RFID reader when the RFID reader reads the cow number of the target cow, the scope for finding the target cow is narrowed, and accordingly, the target cow is found rapidly.
applicants: SICHUAN JIXINGHAI SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; SICHUAN AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY

title: BRDC SIGN DETECTION SYSTEM
abstract: To provide a BRDC sign detection system for detecting a BRDC sign.SOLUTION: A BRDC sign detection system 100 includes: an acquisition unit for acquiring data indicating a state in a predetermined period in which BRDC is not developed on a cow that develops BRDC in a period required for raising, and data indicating a state in a predetermined period on a cow that does not develop BRDC after an elapse of a period required for raising; a machine learning unit for machine-learning the correspondence between the acquired data indicating a state in the predetermined period and information indicating whether or not BRDC is developed; and an inference unit for inferring information indicating whether or not a new cow develops BRDC by inputting data indicating a state in the predetermined period of the new cow into a learned model generated by machine-learning the correspondence, and outputting a result of the inference.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: METHOD, DEVICE, AND SYSTEM FOR ASCERTAINING AT LEAST ONE STATE VARIABLE OF A LIVESTOCK ORGANISM
abstract: The invention relates to a method for ascertaining at least one state variable of at least one livestock (2) organism, wherein at least one probe device (1) for measuring at least one physical parameter is arranged in the gastrointestinal tract (3) of the livestock (2), and at least one analysis unit (12) is arranged outside of the gastrointestinal tract (3) of the livestock (2). The invention is characterized by the following steps: a) ascertaining at least one first physical parameter by means of the probe device (1); b) converting the first physical parameter into a first state variable of the livestock (2) organism in a control unit (6) of the probe device (1); c) transmitting the first state variable from the probe device (1) to the analysis unit (12); and d) converting the first state variable into a second state variable in the analysis unit (12). The invention additionally relates to a probe device (1) for measuring at least one state variable of the livestock (2) organism and to a system (100) comprising at least one such probe device (1) and an analysis unit (12).

title: Breeding system for online long-range livestock using the Internet
abstract: The present invention relates to an online remote livestock breeding system using Internet. The online remote livestock breeding system using Internet comprises: an individual determination step; an individual information confirmation step; an individual superiority and inferiority determination step; and an individual respective feed supply step. According to the present invention, it is possible to solve the problem in which efficient management according to the developmental state of each individual is difficult.

title: Method and device for measuring heart rate breathing using bovine carotid artery
abstract: Pressure is recorded through a piezo sensor or a piezoelectric sensor to measure pressure of a movement occurring in a body, only movements of a heart and breathing in all pressures including movements of all organs and muscles occurring in the body and a movement of a cardiovascular system are extracted through wavelet transformation, and a heart rate and a breathing rate are counted when a signal of the heart and the breathing exceeds a designated value.

title: Livestock Uniformity Management System Using Cattle Weighing Machine
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock uniformity management system using a weight measuring device, which includes: a weight measuring device installed in a barn to measure the weight of livestock; an environmental sensor unit for sensing the breeding environment of the livestock; and a server that interworks with the weight measuring device and the environmental sensor unit, collects measured livestock weight data, estimates standard weight, and controls the breeding environment in the barn according to the standard weight and the sensed breeding environment.

title: Poultry behavior analysis method and device
abstract: The invention provides a poultry behavior analysis method and device, and relates to the technical field of intelligent breeding, and the method comprises the steps: receiving positioning informationtransmitted by a positioning device disposed on a poultry body; determining a movement track of the poultry according to the positioning information; performing clustering analysis on the motion trails and obtaining a clustering result; and analyzing the behaviors of the poultry according to the clustering result. The motion trail determined according to the positioning information can reflect themotion area of the poultry, then the behavior of the poultry is analyzed according to the clustering result obtained through motion trail clustering analysis, the behavior state of the poultry can beeffectively analyzed, and then management personnel can manage the poultry conveniently.
applicants: CHINA INFORMATION DEVELOPMENT INC., LTD. SHANGHAI

title: Computer-assisted automatic sheep recognition and sheep body measurement device
abstract: The invention discloses a computer-assisted automatic sheep recognition and sheep body measurement device, which comprises a frame, a top plate, an entrance door, entrance door motors, an exit door, exit door motors, steps, infrared sensors A, infrared sensors B, an ear tag recognizer, an adjustable background plate, a binocular camera, a weighing device and a computer. The top plate is arranged on the frame, the adjustable background plate is arranged in the frame, a group of the infrared sensors A are mounted on inner lower sides of outer guard bars of an entrance door fence, and a group ofthe infrared sensors B are mounted on the inner lower sides of inner guard bars of the entrance door fence. The ear tag recognizer is mounted on the inner upper side of the entrance door fence, the binocular camera is mounted at the lower end of a mounting frame and faces the background plate, the weighing device is mounted below the frame, and the devices are in electrical connection. The computer-assisted automatic sheep recognition and sheep body measurement device has advantages of freeness of contact, full automatic, convenience in operation and efficiency improvement.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ACTIVITY VALIDATION
abstract: A system for animal population activity verification may include a user device configured to receive one or more chore completion inputs, a barn node configured to identify an interaction between the barn node and the user device, and a barn hub communicatively coupled to the barn node. In embodiments, the barn hub is configured to: identify a spatial relationship between the barn hub and the user device; receive identified interaction data; and receive the one or more chore completion inputs, in embodiments, the system further includes a server configured to: receive the one or more chore completion inputs, the identified interaction data, and identified spatial relationship data; store a transaction log in memory; and identify one or more incomplete chores of the list of chores based on at least one of the one or more chore completion inputs, the identified interaction data, and the identified spatial relationship data.

title: BRDC SIGN DETECTION SYSTEM
abstract: Provided is a BRDC sign detection system which detects a sign of BRDC. This BRDC sign detection system includes: an acquisition unit which acquires data, which indicates a state in a prescribed period in which BRDC has not developed, on a cow that develops the BRDC in a period necessary for fattening, and data, which indicates a state in the prescribed period, on a cow that has not developed BRDC after the period necessary for fattening; a machine learning unit which machine-learns the correspondence relationship between the acquired data, which indicates the state in the prescribed period, and information that indicates whether the BRDC has been developed; and an inference unit which infers information that indicates whether a new cow develops BRDC by inputting data, which indicates a state of the new cow in the prescribed period, to a learning-completed model generated by machine-learning the correspondence relationship, and outputs the inference result.

title: Livestock and poultry breeding intelligent information management system and method based on cloud service
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock and poultry breeding intelligent information management system based on cloud service. The livestock and poultry breeding intelligent information management systembased on cloud service comprises a hardware perception layer in a livestock and poultry shed, a cloud service layer and a management system application layer, wherein a local area network is constructed in the livestock and poultry shed, a terminal node comprises information collecting equipment and executing nodes, data information collected by the information collecting equipment is transmittedto the cloud service layer through an information transmitting module, and a terminal server is used for receiving control instructions transmitted by the cloud service layer and controlling the corresponding executing nodes; the cloud service layer comprises a cloud database and a cloud server which are arranged at the cloud terminal and are respectively used for storing and analyzing data; and the management system application layer is used for assisting in livestock and poultry breeding enterprises to perform examination, management and operations. According to the livestock and poultry breeding intelligent information management system based on cloud service disclosed by the invention, various data information generated in the productive activity of the livestock and poultry breeding enterprises can be subjected to favorable storage and management, besides, a management system can provide service in four respects of production management, office management, traceability managementand expert systems, and all the requirements in the productive activity of the livestock and poultry breeding enterprises can be covered.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR PREDICTING MARBLING DEGREE OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: Disclosed are a method and device for predicting intramuscular fat level of livestock. The device for predicting the intramuscular fat level of the livestock according to one embodiment of the present disclosure comprises: a bioelectrical resistance measurement module that generates a bioelectrical resistance measurement signal by measuring the bioelectrical resistance measurement module for each area of the livestock; and a machine learning module that receives the bioelectrical resistance measurement signal and the measurement area information, and outputs the intramuscular fat level for the relevant area of the livestock.

title: Non-contact measuring device and method for cow body size
abstract: The application discloses a non-contact measuring device and method for cow body size, and relates to the technical field of cow breeding. The device includes a device frame, the device frame is provided with an acquisition channel, the acquisition channel can only accommodate a cow to pass through at a time, a first camera and a second camera are respectively fixed on one side and the upper partof a middle position of the acquisition channel, the first camera and the second camera are electrically connected with an acquisition and processing device. Since the acquisition channel can only hold one cow at a time, when the cow enters the acquisition channel, the acquisition and processing device controls the first camera and the second camera to take photos of the cow from the top and sideof the cow respectively. Cow images obtained by photographing are transmitted to the acquisition and processing device, which determines the body size data of the cow according to the acquired cow images. Because the images of only one cow are processed at a time, the accuracy of body size data acquisition is improved.

title: Method for Image Information Analysis Based Prevention System and Method thereof
abstract: The present invention provides an image information analysis-based livestock disease control management method which is performed on a computer system and can check a livestock disease situation without relying on the knowledge or experience of a producer. The method comprises: a step of determining the position of livestock by analyzing image information received from a CCTV installed in a farm, wherein the position of the livestock includes a sitting position, a lying position, and a standing position; a step of determining whether the livestock vomit by analyzing the image information received from the CCTV installed in the farm; a step of generating first time-series data recording the position of the livestock, whether the livestock vomit, and whether the position of the livestock is maintained; a step of determining an abnormal sign if the livestock are in a prescribed position or vomit; a step of generating abnormal signal discovery time and abnormal sign continuation time in second time-series data if the abnormal signal is determined; a step of generating the number of abnormal signs over time and abnormal signal continuation time over time in two-dimensional data based on the second time-series data; and a step of determining whether a disease breaks out by analyzing the pattern of the two-dimensional data.

title: Livestock and poultry water intake real-time monitoring method
abstract: A livestock and poultry water intake real-time monitoring method provided by the present invention comprises the following steps of monitoring the water flow, calibrating and accessing a sensing device and setting a barrier, constructing a background monitoring terminal, monitoring repeatedly and circularly to obtain a broken line statistical graph, and judging the livestock and poultry health. According to the method, the background monitoring terminal is constructed, the water outlet flow is monitored in real time through a water flow pressure detection device, and by calibrating the water pressure, the data is more accurate; the variation of a drinking trough is monitored in real time through a water level sensor and a pressure sensor, and by combining with the data, such as the water supply time, etc., the water supply volume, the water level change value in the drinking trough and the pressure change value of the drinking trough are obtained conveniently, so that the livestock andpoultry water intake is obtained, the water intake broken line statistical graph of the livestock and poultry in each period is monitored and comprehensively obtained by taking the water intake of the livestock and poultry as a period, and the data is more visual and comprehensive. By matching the design of a food net, a barrier and a blocking rod, the livestock and poultry excrement is preventedfrom being mixed, and the interference of the external factors is avoided.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL SCIENCES, CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Method and device for managing female livestock to be bred
abstract: In the embodiment, the invention discloses a method for managing female livestock to be bred. The method for managing the female livestock to be bred comprises the following steps: screening out female livestock with estrus characteristics and female livestock without estrus characteristics on basis of sign monitoring data of female livestock when a request for allocating female livestock to be bred is received; classifying the screened female livestock without the estrus characteristics according to prerecorded inspection data of the female livestock; and then, outputting identity informationof the female livestock with the estrus characteristics and classification information of the female livestock without the estrus characteristics. The invention further discloses a corresponding device for managing the female livestock to be bred. Through the schemes, breeding of the female livestock can be conveniently managed by an animal breeder, thereby improving breeding quantity and efficiency so as to have overall breeding rate of female livestock in a farm increased.

title: Livestock feeding sound signal acquisition device and acquisition method using same
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock feeding sound signal acquisition device and an acquisition method using the same. The device comprises a substrate, wind shielding and sound insulation cotton, a silica gel sleeve, a microphone, rebound foam and an interference noise elimination module. The substrate is attached to the surface of a livestock shearing forehead, and the wind shielding and sound insulation cotton is in a sucker shape, wraps the substrate and is fixed to the forehead. The silica gel sleeve comprises an inner layer, a sound insulation layer and an outer layer, the outer layer isattached and fixed to the wind-shielding sound-insulation cotton, and the sound-insulation layer is located between the outer layer and the inner layer. The inner layer, the substrate and a shearing surface form a closed space, and the microphone is arranged in the closed space and collects the sound signals of livestock. The rebound foam covers the microphone and extends to the inner layer afterexpansion, and the goat sound interference noise elimination module is used for eliminating interference noise. The device has the effects of weakening environmental noise and eliminating interferencenoise, minimizes the interference of environmental wind noise, the interference noise of sheep and other noise, and is easy to disassemble and replace, is small and exquisite, and is convenient to install.

title: METHOD OF CONTROLLING A LIVESTOCK FARM
abstract: A computer-implemented method of controlling a livestock farm housing a population of animals, the method comprising the steps of obtaining, by means of one or more, preferably a plurality of, sensors, farm sensor data indicative of the condition of the livestock farm; optionally combining said farm sensor data with further data, indicative of the condition of the livestock farm, but not obtained via sensors, to obtain farm condition data; obtaining, by means of one or more, preferably a plurality, of measurement devices, animal status data of thelivestock farm population; and selecting and continuously adjusting, dependent on the obtained farm sensor data or farm condition data and the animal status data, a set of animal supply values using a feedback loop such that a value of at least a selectedone of the animal status data is optimized.

title: Sheep behavior monitoring system and method based on action recognition
abstract: The invention discloses a sheep behavior monitoring system based on action recognition. The sheep behavior monitoring system comprises a behavior monitoring end and a control end, the behavior monitoring end is connected with the control end through a wireless network and comprises a processor, a power supply module, a communication module and a sensor module, and the control end comprises a PC and a control software arranged on the PC and is used for analyzing the data of the behavior monitoring ends and backing up the obtained data. According to the invention, the information of a pluralityof animals can be collected at one time, so that the problem that errors are easy to occur in mass animal collection and in traditional image collection is avoided; the acquisition frequency can be remotely modified, the acquired data can be compared with an animal behavior analysis database, and the animal behaviors can be judged; the collected actions can be compared with a high-risk action database, and an alarm can be given for the high-risk actions of animals.

title: Method and device for identifying sow pregnancy
abstract: The invention provides a method and device for identifying sow pregnancy. The method comprises the following steps of: for a sow to be detected, collecting the characteristic information of the sow, and inputting the characteristic information into a trained pregnancy identification model to obtain an identification result for showing whether the sow is pregnant or not, wherein the characteristicinformation comprises one or multiple pieces of the following information, including the image information of a scheduled position of the sow, the movement time data of the sow, the food-intake data of the sow and the movement trajectory information of the sow. By use of the above technical scheme, accuracy for identifying the sow pregnancy can be improved, and the cost of manpower, material resources and time can be reduced.

title: METHOD AND SERVICE SERVER FOR MANAGING LIVESTOCK BREEDING VIA SMART FARM
abstract: According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is a method for managing the breeding of livestock in a service server. A livestock breeding management method through a smart farm comprises the steps of: receiving livestock health information and egg production information measured for each zone; determining whether there is an abnormality in livestock for each zone based on the health information and the production information; and transmitting livestock abnormality notification information to a manager terminal of the zone where the abnormal livestock is located, when determined that there is an abnormality in the livestock.

title: SYSTEM FOR SENSING SOUNDS OF DOMESTIC ANIMALS AND METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock vocal sound sensing system and method. The livestock vocal sound sensing system according to the present invention comprises: a plurality of sound sensors disposed in a livestock barn to detect the voices of livestock; a voiced sound identification unit for identifying a type of the spoken sound based on the feature data extracted from the voiced sound; an entity location detector configured to detect a location of a livestock entity that has generated the spoken sound based on time information at which the spoken sound is detected by the plurality of sound sensors. An information providing unit for providing information on the identified type of voiced sound and the location of the livestock individual.
applicants: KIST (KOREA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY)

title: Method for Establishing Prevention Boundary of Epidemics of Livestock Based On Image Information Analysis
abstract: According to one feature of the present disclosure, provided is a method for analyzing image information to set a livestock quarantine boundary line, performed on a computer system. The method comprises: a step of generating a disease spread probability prediction model using a time-series prediction machine learning technique based on infection rate data to neighboring livestock houses by reflecting GIS information when a disease occurs in a reference livestock house; a step of analyzing image information to determine whether a disease occurs in livestock of a specific livestock house; a step of generating input data by storing information on a corresponding livestock house, information on livestock having a disease, and disease information over time when a disease occurs, wherein the disease information includes the name of the disease, infectiousness, non-infectiousness, and the degree of infectiousness; and a step of predicting disease spread probability according to the disease spread probability prediction model based on the input data. According to the present disclosure, it is possible to provide a system for recognizing the disease state of livestock based on artificial intelligence technology by using visual information such as CCTV images, etc. and setting a quarantine boundary line accordingly.

title: Pig individual checking system and method
abstract: The invention provides a pig individual checking system and method. The system comprises RFID capsules, an automatic suspension device, a data server, a display terminal and a power circuit. The RFIDcapsules are implanted into the epidermis of pigs; the automatic suspension device is connected with the RFID capsules and positioned in the upper portion of a pig house; the data server is connectedwith the automatic suspension device through an eMTC network module; the display terminal is connected with the data server; the power circuit is connected with the automatic suspension device and theeMTC network module. By combination of eMTC and RFID technologies, the RFID capsules are implanted into the epidermis of the pigs and recognized by a RFID reader-writer in the suspension device during patrolling in the pig house, identity information of the pigs can be recognized accurately while individual amount and body temperature information of the pigs in the pig house can be obtained automatically, and accordingly automatic statistics of body temperatures and individual amount of the pigs can be realized.

title: Chicken Poop Treatment System and Method
abstract: The present invention relates to a poultry waste treatment system and to a method thereof, which can reduce the amount of waste by rapidly moving poultry waste generated in a poultry farm to a treatment tank and extinguishing the poultry waste as much as possible by decomposition using microorganisms in the treatment tank, improve the surrounding environment using a puer tea extract by minimizing odors occurs during the generation and extinction of the poultry waste, and quickly and efficiently process when the poultry waste occurs by installing a camera which moves vertically and horizontally at the poultry farm to check the activity of chickens and the amount of poultry waste produced for 24 hours. The poultry waste treatment system of the present invention comprises: a poultry farm for breeding chickens; a hopper for collecting the poultry waste generated at the poultry farm to one side and discharging the same by being installed on a lower portion of the poultry farm; a treatment tank equipped with a stirrer for stirring the poultry waste; a conveyor which moves the poultry waste discharged from the hopper to the treatment tank; and a surveillance camera installed to move vertically and horizontally with respect to the poultry farm and the hopper to check the condition of chickens raised in the poultry farm and the poultry waste discharged to the hopper. In addition, a microbial preparation or the puer tea extract for decomposing the poultry waste is added into the treatment tank.
applicants: LEE, KYUNG WON; WHANG, HYUN SUNG; JO, NAM JUNG

title: ICT LED ICT LED Sterilization and disease Control System for Disinfection and Sterilization of peggery
abstract: The present invention relates to an information communication technology (ICT) LED sterilization and disease control system for disinfecting and sterilizing a piggery and, more specifically, to an ICT LED sterilization and disease control system for disinfecting and sterilizing a piggery, which performs disinfection and sterilization for a breeding space by using ICT to sterilize a piggery, and performs and manages sterilization with an LED sterilization lamp by using a mobile phone and a computer on the basis of location information of piglets and LED operation information. According to the present invention, the ICT LED sterilization and disease control system comprises: a sensor sensing the inside of a breeding space to generate a detection signal indicating whether livestock exists in the breeding space; a first LED module emitting electromagnetic waves of a first band; a second LED module emitting electromagnetic waves of a second band; and a control unit acquiring the detection signal from the sensor, determining whether the livestock exists in the breeding space on the basis of the detection signal, and performing on/off control of the first LED module and the second LED according to whether the livestock exists in the breeding space.

title: Farm movement tracking and monitoring device
abstract: The invention discloses a farm movement tracking and monitoring device, and belongs to the technical field of livestock breeding monitoring. The farm movement tracking and monitoring device comprisesa monitoring component, a U-shaped base and a sliding block, the sliding block is movably arranged on a sliding rail, the sliding rail is fixedly installed above a farm, the monitoring component comprises an infrared thermometer, a camera and a gas sensor, and the infrared thermometer, the camera and the gas sensor are fixedly installed at one end of a first installation base. According to the invention, the camera is arranged to shoot real-time videos of the farm, the monitoring component is fed back and controlled according to the shot video, a gun point is shot to the surface of the specified monitored livestock for temperature measurement by the infrared thermometer, the behavior state of the livestock is monitored, diet behaviors, activity frequencies, the number of livestock in eachbreeding fence, whether the livestock is ill or not and the like of the livestock are analyzed, gas components near a current breeding fence are detected by an arranged gas sensor, it is analyzed whether abnormal conditions exist in current gas or not, and it is comprehensively determined whether air in a breeding factory is polluted or not and whether unhealthy livestock exist or not.

title: Feeding groove for animal husbandry
abstract: The invention discloses a feeding groove for animal husbandry, which comprises a supporting plate, wherein an antenna is arranged at the upper part of the middle of the outer surface of the supportingplate; the antenna is embedded and fixed on the surface of the supporting plate; a controller is arranged on the left side below the antenna; the controller is embedded and fixed in front of the supporting plate; a touch screen is arranged at the upper part of the front of the controller; the touch screen is embedded and fixed in the controller; a control switch is arranged below the touch screen; the control switch is fixed on the controller through screws; an RFID card reader is arranged on the right side of the controller; the RFID card read is embedded and fix in front of the supporting plate; a wireless transmitter is arranged on the right side of the RFID card read; the wireless transmitter is embedded and fixed in front of the supporting plate; a feeding groove is formed in the bottom of the front of the supporting plate; a base seat is arranged at the bottom of the supporting plate; a pressure sensor is arranged in the middle of the top of the inner side of the base seat; anda storage battery is arranged below the pressure sensor. The feeding groove for animal husbandry has the advantages of reasonable design, simple structure, automatic labeling, diet monitoring and firmness and durability.
applicants: HUNAN ZHIGAO AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Robot for healthy raising of live pigs
abstract: The invention provides a robot for healthy raising of live pigs. The robot for healthy raising of the live pigs is used for solving the problems that manual inspection of abnormal behavior characteristics of live pigs, and detection and regulation of raising environment parameters are poor in accuracy, low in efficiency and high in labor strength. The robot for healthy raising of the live pigs comprises a mobile terminal monitoring platform, an execution mechanism platform and a behavior monitoring platform, wherein the mobile terminal monitoring platform, the execution mechanism platform andthe behavior monitoring platform are all provided with wireless transmission modules, and the mobile terminal monitoring platform and the execution mechanism platform are connected with the behavior monitoring platform through the corresponding wireless transmission modules respectively. The robot for healthy raising of the live pigs can automatically and fast conduct global or local monitoring and automatic collecting on information of growth situations, behavior characteristics, raising environments and the like of pig herds and pig individuals of selected pigpens in sequence, functions of timely regulation of abnormal environments of the live pigs, fast judgement and diagnosis of abnormal behavior and diseases, early warnings against epidemic situations, and the like are achieved, and the intelligent management level of a live pig raising process is raised.

title: LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract: A livestock management system for managing livestock in an extensive farming environment, the system comprising: a plurality of tags, wherein each tag is configured to be affixed to a respective animal; at least one base station located within said extensive farming environment; and a remote information system; wherein each tag includes at least one sensor for generating sensor data representative of a predetermined characteristic of the respective animal and a wireless communications component configured to transmit data representative of the sensor data to one or more base stations; wherein the at least one base station comprises a wireless access point and includes a wired or wireless broadband communications module for transmitting data representative of the sensor data to the remote information system via the internet.

title: Animal temperature measuring ear tag, temperature measuring method and system
abstract: The invention provides an animal temperature measuring ear tag, temperature measuring method and system. The animal temperature measuring ear tag comprises an ear tag body, a first temperature sensor,a second temperature sensor and an integrated circuit module with a wireless communication function. The integrated circuit module is arranged in the ear tag body, and the first temperature sensor and the second temperature sensor are arranged in the ear tag body and connected with the integrated circuit module. By arrangement of the integrated circuit module with the wireless communication function and the multiple temperature sensors (namely the first temperature sensor and the second temperature sensor), animal body temperature measuring data can be acquired respectively by the temperaturesensors, and accordingly convenience in correction, error reporting and the like of the temperature measuring data is achieved, and acquisition of accurate and stable temperature measuring data of animals is benefited; owing to the wireless communication function of the integrated circuit module, real-time animal body temperature monitoring can be realized through the animal temperature measuringear tag.

title: Electronic ear tag, monitoring method and statistic method based thereon
abstract: The invention provides an electronic ear tag, a monitoring method and a statistic method based thereon. The electronic ear tag comprises an ear tag neck of a hollow structure, and a temperature sensoris arranged in the hollow structure. The ear tag neck is directly connected with an ear of livestock, and the temperature sensor is positioned in the ear tag neck of the hollow structure, thereby being capable of collecting body temperature information of the livestock more accurately. In addition, body temperature of the livestock can reflect health condition thereof, and the number of the livestock in a certain area can be acquired by monitoring and summarizing the health condition of the livestock in the area.

title: Physiological characteristic detection system and detection method for livestock breeding
abstract: The invention discloses a physiological characteristic detection system and detection method for livestock breeding. The physiological characteristic detection system for livestock breeding comprisesan identity recognition module, a physiological characteristic acquisition module and an analyzing and early warning module, wherein the identity recognition module comprises a radio frequency electronic label for storing livestock identity information and an electronic label reader for reading information stored in the radio frequency electronic label on livestock bodies; the physiological characteristic acquisition module comprises information acquisition equipment for acquiring physiological characteristic information of the livestock; and the analyzing and early warning module is used formerging the acquired physiological characteristic information of the livestock with the livestock identity information recognized by the identity recognition module, contrasting the merged informationwith livestock health physiological characteristic information stored in a database, and performing early warning based on the contrasting result. Through the adoption of the physiological characteristic detection system for livestock breeding disclosed by the invention, the physiological characteristic information of the livestock can be timely and accurately detected, the growth state of the livestock is judged, the livestock which are possibly attacked by diseases can be accurately recognized, and found out to be given with an early warning, so that the pathogenic livestock can be treatedtimely in early stage, and cross-infection of the livestock is reduced.
applicants: NORTH CHINA UNIVERSITY OF WATER RESOURCES AND ELECTRIC POWER

title: Energy-saving integrated double bed for healthy breeding of mutton sheep
abstract: The invention relates to an energy-saving integrated double bed for healthy breeding of mutton sheep. The energy-saving integrated double bed comprises a main body, a rainwater collecting box is fixedly installed on the side face of the main body, a shed roof is arranged at the top of the main body, a supporting frame is connected to the bottom of the shed roof, a ceiling beam is connected to one side of the supporting frame, a storage battery is arranged above the ceiling beam, a photovoltaic inverter is arranged above the storage battery, and a solar panel is connected to the upper part of the ceiling top. According to the novel energy-saving integrated double bed for healthy breeding of mutton sheep, breeding and excrement treatment and fermentation can be conducted synchronously through the arrangement of the double bed, odor of excrement in a house is isolated through the facility of movable baffles, diffusion of the odor is avoided, the double bed is divided into a plurality of units through arrangement of partitions, and reasonable breeding management is facilitated; in addition, due to the arrangement of solar energy, energy consumption of the double bed is changed into clean energy consumption, and the cost is reduced; and due to the arrangement of a monitoring device, a farmer can monitor the breeding condition in a house in real time, and convenience is provided for humanized management of double bed breeding.
applicants: MACHENG HUANGBAICHONG ECOLOGICAL AGRICULTURE SPECIALIZED COOPERATIVES

title: Ethological device for detecting mating intentions of rodents
abstract: The invention discloses an ethological device for detecting mating intentions of rodents. The ethological device comprises a box with an opening at the top end and a partition plate, wherein a clamping groove is formed in the box, the partition plate is detachably connected with the box through the clamping groove, a female rodent channel is formed in the partition plate, and the partition plate is provided with transparent strip hole. The ethological device can more accurately reflect the mating intentions of rodents. The ethological device has the specific advantages as follows: 1) the animal activity space simulates the size of the feeding environment to ensure the stability of animal behavior. 2) The partition plate is transparent and air-permeable to ensure that animals can obtain sufficient visual and olfactory information, and the output and observation of behaviors are facilitated. 3) The partition plate can be replaced, and partition plates with different channel sizes can beselected to adapt to animals of different sizes to ensure stable output of animal behavior. 4) The device design is simple and easy to clean. 5) The ethological device can determine the mating willingness of female rodents and eliminate the possibility of forced mating, thereby laying a foundation for accurate behavior analysis.

title: Sustainable and intelligent pig raising method
abstract: The invention provides a sustainable and intelligent pig raising method. According to the sustainable and intelligent pig raising method, by acquiring respective detection information about pig raising external environments, the pig growth status and external discharge of pig raising fields, the environmental status of the pig raising fields, the pig raising feeding status and the external discharge status of the pig raising fields are adaptively adjusted, so that intelligent operation in the pig raising process and reduction of wastes in the pig raisin process are realized, and the environmental sustainability of pig raising and intelligent degree of raising are improved.

title: MILKING INFORMATION RECORDING SYSTEM BY OBJECT
abstract: The present invention relates to an individual-specific milking information recording system including: an identification device installed at a gate of a milking facility and identifying tags on milk cows entering through the gate to confirm the ID of each milk cow and the milk cow individual count; detection devices respectively installed in milking sections in the milking facility, each given a unique identification number, and using a sensor in order to detect the state of occupation of the milking sections by the milk cows; milking devices respectively installed in the milking sections and measuring the milking amount of extracted raw milk; a control device; and a monitoring terminal communicating with the control device to receive milking information. The control device compares the individual count received from the identification device to the number of the detection devices, determines the current milking section of each of the milk cows based on the milk cow ID received from the identification device and the occupation state received from the detection device, and receives result values related to the milking amount from the milking devices to generate the milking information on each of the milk cows. According to the present invention, it is possible to perform livestock milking performance analysis and efficiently operate the milking facility.
applicants: REALFARM COMPANY; REPUBLIC OF KOREA (RURAL DEVELOPMENT ADMINISTRATION)

title: a breeding ground for automatic disinfection systems using solar power
abstract: The present invention relates to a farm with an automatic disinfection system using solar power generation, comprising: a barn (10) in the form of closing an inner space; a detection unit installed inside the barn (10) to directly or indirectly detect whether or not a virus is generated inside or outside the barn (10); a control unit (14) capable of receiving a detection signal from the detection unit and transmitting a control signal based on the received signal; a plurality of piezoelectric ceramics (110) installed therein so as to make a chemical liquid in a liquid tank installed at the lower end of the barn (10) into a mist form; a disinfection device (40) capable of injecting the mist chemical liquid into and out of the barn (10); and a power unit connected to the detection unit, the control unit (14), the plurality of piezoelectric ceramics (110), and the disinfection device (40) to supply electric power.

title: Estrus state detection method, device, system and equipment and medium
abstract: The embodiments of the invention provide an estrus state detection method, device and system, equipment and a medium. The estrus state detection method comprises the following steps that a detection signal aiming at a target organism is sent, so that detection equipment of the target organism detects a motion state parameter and a physiological characteristic parameter of the target organism to obtain a detection result; a detection result fed back by the detection equipment is received; and the estrus state of the target organism is predicted based on the received detection result and an estrus state information database. According to the estrus state detection method, device, system and equipment and the medium, the detection efficiency of the biological estrus state can be improved, and the accuracy of the detection result is improved.
applicants: CHINA MOBILE (CHENGDU) INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; CMC (CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS COMPANY)

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR DIRECTING LIVESTOCK ANIMAL
abstract: A method and a system configured to differentially direct the passage of livestock animal; to signal the livestock animal; to identify an individual livestock animal and to monitor livestock activity are provided.

title: METHOD FOR INTELLIGENT MONITORING OF ONE OR MORE COMMERCIAL SITES FOR LIVESTOCK ANIMALS
abstract: The invention concerns a method for monitoring of one or more commercial sites for livestock animals, each comprising multiple buildings having one or more airspaces that comprise one or more monitoring devices equipped with one or more sensors to receive data. Data obtained by the monitoring devices is uploaded to the web server. User can access web server data related to one or more commercial sites for livestock animals using mobile terminal wherein this comprises display to indicate the broader level summary associate with one or more commercial sites and detailed status of one or more commercial sites wherein detailed status comprises outside environmental conditions, temperature, relative humidity, status of each airspace of the building and livestock animal's health and/or welfare status. Further, it provides personalized notifications to users associated with one or more sites indicating site status and early warning of alarm conditions.

title: DEVICE FOR MONITORING THE STATUS OF A LIVESTOCK FACILITY
abstract: A device for monitoring the status of a livestock facility is disclosed, wherein the status of the livestock facility includes health and/or welfare of livestock animals inside the livestock facility, and management status of various devices installed in the facility. The device includes a housing unit, one or more temperature sensors configured to measure the air temperature in the livestock facility, one or more relative humidity sensors configured to monitor the relative humidity of the air in the livestock facility, one or more light sensors configured to measure the color and/or the light intensity inside the livestock facility to distinguish the real or artificially imposed day and night regimes in the livestock facility, one or more light emitting means configured to indicate the status of the device and/or abnormalities related to livestock animals inside the livestock facility, one or more microphones, one or more loudspeakers, a communication module comprising one or more wireless communication means to interact with other devices.

title: METHOD FOR MONITORING A LIVESTOCK FACILITY AND/OR LIVESTOCK ANIMALS IN A LIVESTOCK FACILITY USING IMPROVED SOUND PROCESSING TECHNIQUES
abstract: The invention concerns a method for monitoring a livestock facility and/or livestock animals in a livestock facility. It includes receiving audio signals comprising sounds generated in a livestock facility from two or more microphones. Sounds of interest in the audio signals are localized, the sounds of interest being both sounds generated by livestock animals and sounds generated by noise sources. The localization further comprises the steps of utilizing models of noise sources in an airspace based on localization in noise reduction algorithms to filter off noise sources from the audio signal, resulting in a filtered audio signal, and the step of analysing the filtered audio signal.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING ANIMALS
abstract: Disclosed are a method, system and apparatus for controlling the movement of animals, and in some aspects, the virtual herding or steering of animals over large areas of land. In some aspects, the animal is steered towards a desired region when the animal is out of the desired region. In some aspects, the animals is steered away from a steering region when the animal is within the steering region. In some aspects, the animal is steered towards a reference, which can be made to move along a path, thus leading the animal along the path from a starting point to a finish point. The method, system and apparatus disclosed reduce the need for fences or the use of personnel to manage the animals.

title: Mobile and modular device with movable walls for dynamic weighing of a bovine animal
abstract: A mobile and modular device with movable walls for the dynamic weighing of a bovine animal includes an identification module having a support structure, a processing module, a solar panel, an antenna and an identifier; and a weighing module including a base, a pair of side walls, a weighing platform, a pair of load cells and an amplifier and transmission box. The processing module, the identifier, the solar panel and the antenna are associated on the support structure. The weighing platform, the pair of load cells and the amplifier and transmission box are associated on the base in a fixed way. Each one of the pair of side walls contains a fixed portion and a mobile portion; and each one of the lower ends of the fixed portion contains a mechanism, which is associated to the base in a mobile way, through a first distal end and a second distal end.

title: Dairy cow physiological parameter external behavior intelligent monitoring system and method
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a dairy cow physiological parameter external behavior intelligent monitoring system and method. The intelligent monitoring system is characterized by comprising a sensing layer, a network layer, a cloud platform, an operation layer and a service layer, wherein the sensing layer is used for monitoring behavior parameters of a dairy cow in real time; the network layer transmits data monitored by the sensing layer to the cloud platform; the cloud platform shares data to the operation layer through middleware; and the service layer acquires data by accessing the operation layer. According to the invention, electronic devices such as an intelligent sensing chip, an indicator lamp and the like are adopted to monitor the physiological parameter external behavior of the dairy cow (the activity amount of the dairy cow and the climbing and collapsing behavior of the dairy cow), the intelligent monitoring device is worn on the dairy cow to collect the activity amount and the climbing data of the dairy cow and upload the activity amount and the climbing and collapsing data of the dairy cow to the platform, the condition of the activity amount and the climbing and collapsing data of the dairy cow (oestrus detection accuracy reaches 90% or above) is obtained through large data analysis, and workers are informed to know oestrus and health conditions of the dairy cow in time through an APP to carry out accurate positioning.
applicants: HUNAN GOLD BEACON INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Breeding management system and method based on RFID
abstract: The invention discloses a breeding management system and method based on RFID, relates to the field of livestock breeding, and is used for achieving the following: collecting basic information, growthdata and activity data of livestock through an RFID collector; establishing a livestock file in the database, performing data consulting and growth track tracing on designated livestock, and the customization module generating a corresponding breeding plan according to customization requirements. The beneficial effects of the method are as follows: customized breeding is carried out according tothe needs of customers, the commodity needs of different customers are met, the self-adjusting ability of the farm is enhanced, and the farm can be tracing to diseased livestock at the first time whenepidemic occurs, so that timely prevention and control, root tracing and source tracing are achieved, and the loss of livestock is reduced to the minimum.

title: Layered dairy cow feeding system and feeding method
abstract: The invention provides a layered dairy cow feeding system and a feeding method. The system comprises a feeding layer and a feed supply layer, the feeding layer and the feed supply layer are separatedby a separation layer to form an upper space layer and a lower space layer which are independent; an opening is formed in the middle of the partition layer, and a partition plate is arranged at the opening and connected with a driving motor; the feed supply layer comprises a dosing machine, a trough, a feed recovery box and a trough conveyor belt cleaning device; the trough is located below the partition plate. The dosing machine conveys feed to the trough through the inclined conveying belt; and the feeding layer comprises a plurality of groups of cameras and cowsheds. The method comprises the following steps: 1, determining a feed formula by a dosing machine; 2, a trough conveying belt and an inclined conveying belt starting to operate; 3, after the trough is lifted to the feeding layer,the dairy cow starting to eat; according to the method, feed mixing, catering, conveying, recycling, trough cleaning and disinfection operations are completed on a feed supply layer, and dairy cow feeding, feeding monitoring and feedback operations are completed on a feeding layer.

title: OPTICAL BREEDING MODEL DECISION METHOD AND OPTICAL BREEDING MODEL DECISION SYSTEM USING THE METHOD
abstract: Disclosed are an optimal breeding model determination method capable of determining an optimal breeding model to be provided to a maternity barn system placed in a random maternity barn, and an optimal breeding model determination system using the same. The optimal breeding model determination method, which is a model determination method performed by a computer system, includes the following steps of: receiving at least one piece of maternity barn monitoring data from at least one monitoring maternity barn system individually placed in at least one maternity barn which is a monitoring target; and determining an optimal breeding model to be provided to at least one target maternity barn system individually placed in at least one target maternity barn by collectively analyzing the maternity barn monitoring data. Therefore, the target maternity barn system can manage the target maternity barn in an optimal condition in accordance with the optimal breeding model.
applicants: EZFARM; REPUBLIC OF KOREA (RURAL DEVELOPMENT ADMINISTRATION)

title: Gas monitoring device
abstract: An animal emission monitoring device to be worn by cattle comprises a snout member 30 with a sensor unit for detecting the quantity of methane emissions and positioning means 60 for positioning the device on the head of an animal to locate the sensor unit over the animal’s nostril, e.g. with respective sensors 80, 85 over each nostril 90. The telemetry device may also detect carbon dioxide, may provide storage and real-time wireless transmission of intermittently or continuously captured data, and may comprise a battery and/or solar power module 40.

title: Wearable device-based electronic fence for livestock breeding and husbandry method of wearable device-based electronic fence
abstract: The invention discloses a wearable device-based electronic fence for livestock breeding. The wearable device-based electronic fence includes a wearable device, a main control room, an electronic fencehost, a wiring rod, a plurality of bearing rods and a terminal rod, wherein a serial closed loop is formed among the wiring rod, the bearing rods and the terminal rod through four alloy wires. The invention also discloses a husbandry method of the wearable device-based electronic fence for livestock breeding. The husbandry method includes the following steps: S1, inputting information; S2, performing real-time positioning, S3, adopting electric shock for warning; and S4, performing statistical analysis. The wearable device-based electronic fence has a reasonable structure, and though arrangement of a warning mechanism, livestock is expelled by shape whistles which are produced by the warning mechanism when the livestock approaches the electronic fence, so that the number of the electric shocks applied to the livestock is reduced; and if the livestock ignores the whistles and continues to go near the electronic fence, the electric shocks are applied to the livestock, and therefore thelivestock produces a conditioned reflex through the action of the whistles and electric shocks, and then goes away from the position of the electronic fence actively.

title: AN ACCELERATION SENSOR AND A CAPSULE INCLUDING THE SAME
abstract: An acceleration sensor and a capsule including the same are disclosed. An acceleration sensor according to an embodiment sets the maximum value of a specific range as a threshold value when an acceleration value collected at a specific period moves within the specific range, and counts when a currently measured acceleration value is greater than the threshold value. It is possible to provide a technology for collecting movement data of livestock by using an acceleration sensor.

title: Body Insertion Type Bio Capsule
abstract: The proposed technology relates to a body insertion type bio capsule, and more particularly, to a bio capsule inserted into the living body of livestock to store and analyze bio information of the livestock. The body insertion type bio capsule includes a temperature sensor; a pressure sensor; a signal processing module; a wireless communication module; and a power module. The purpose of the present invention is to analyze the ruminant phenomenon of cattle using the body insertion type bio capsule.

title: Method and apparatus for detecting cow artificial insemination time through activity monitoring
abstract: According to the present invention, disclosed are a method and a device for detecting the timing of artificial insemination of cattle through activity monitoring. According to the present invention, provided is a device for detecting the timing of artificial insemination of cattle, including: a processor; and a memory coupled to the processor, wherein the memory collects cattle activity data through an activity measurement sensor for a preset time, converts the collected cattle activity data into a wavelet spectrum to extract one or more indexes, and stores program instructions executable by the processor to determine whether or not to perform artificial insemination of cattle by inputting the extracted index into a classifier.

title: System for detecting sick chickens of indoor chicken farm based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a system for detecting sick chickens of an indoor chicken farm based on deep learning, belongs to the technical field of chicken farm sick chicken intelligent detection, and aims to improve the intelligent degree of indoor chicken farm sick chicken detection, rapidly and accurately detect chicken breeding epidemic situations such as bird flu, strive for time for avoiding large-scale infection and reduce losses for farmers. The technical main points are that a method comprises the steps: collecting coop video image data through a camera of a cruise robot; performing dataenhancement and amplification on the acquired video image data; enabling a deep network training module to adopt DenseNet for chicken breeding data in a chicken coop acquired by the robot camera to improve the network feature extraction capability by expanding the receptive field, thereby improving the target detection precision, and achieving higher real-time detection performance; enabling a real-time monitoring module to monitor whether sick chickens exist in the chicken farm or not according to the trained network model and displays the sick chickens through a mobile terminal or a PC terminal. The method is suitable for sick chicken detection and early warning in large indoor chicken farms.

title: Method and device for predicting estrus of sows
abstract: The invention provides a method for predicting estrus of sows, and belongs to a technology applied to the field of sow production. The method comprises the step of predicting the estrus probability ofthe sows according to the content change trend of estradiol (E2), progesterone (P4), adrenocortical hormone (ACTH) and gonadotropin releasing hormone (GnRH) in urine of multiparous sows. According tothe method, a non-contact, non-stress and welfare estrus identification mode is carried out on the sows after weaning, so that manpower is saved, the production cost is reduced, and an estrus probability model is established by analyzing data. According to the method, the estrus probability of the sows is predicted by monitoring the hormone index of the urine of the sows, so that the technical guarantee of estrus identification can be provided for large-scale production of the sows in the future.

title: Beef cattle natural breeding process monitoring method based on 4G network
abstract: The invention discloses a beef cattle natural breeding process monitoring method based on 4G network, and relates to the field of animal husbandry. The purpose of the invention is to solve the problemof unable intelligent monitoring of the natural breeding process of the cattle at present. According to the beef cattle natural breeding process monitoring method based on the 4G network, the 4G network and sensors worn on the cattle are utilized to realize the monitoring on the natural breeding process of the cattle; and moreover, the monitoring is time-saving, labor-saving, good in real-time performance, and capable of realizing unattended monitoring.

title: Identifying device and method for chickens in cages
abstract: The present invention relates to an identifying device and method for chickens in cages. The identifying device comprises an infrared imager, a fixing device, a rotary steering engine, a steering engine platform, a lifting platform, a control device box and a moving device; a single chip microcomputer receives infrared thermal images acquired by the infrared imager, controls rotation of the rotarysteering engine, controls lifting of the lifting platform and controls movement of the moving device; and the moving device is used for moving in cages, the lifting platform is used for lifting according to height of the chickens in the cages, besides, life states of each layer of the chickens in the cages are monitored through the infrared imager, meanwhile, the rotary steering engine can be used for completely replacing manual monitoring of the life states of the chickens in the cages, and identification efficiency and monitoring precision can be improved by adopting the provided identifying device and method.

title: Livestock breeding equipment capable of monitoring livestock
abstract: The invention discloses livestock breeding equipment capable of monitoring livestock. The livestock breeding equipment comprises a supporting plate, wherein a first weighing module is fixedly arrangedon the upper end surface of the supporting plate; a standing box is arranged at the upper side of the supporting plate and located at the upper side of the first weighing module; a standing cavity with an upward opening is formed in the standing box; the standing cavity has a rightward opening; a detachable door plate is arranged at the position of the rightward opening of the standing cavity; after the door plate is detached, a dairy cow enters the standing cavity; and the first weighing module can weigh the dairy cow. According to the invention, through detection of the feeding amount of the dairy cow and collection of the weight information of the dairy cow, whether the dairy cow is fed abnormally or not is determined according to the normal feeding amount range of the dairy cow with the weight, so the abnormal condition of the dairy cow is found in the early stage of disease occurrence of the dairy cow; treatment is conducted on the dairy cow; and economic losses caused by the fact that diseases are not found in time are avoided.
applicants: NINGBO ZHENHAI YOUXIANG AGRICULTURAL TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Wearing device, detection system and detection method for detecting oestrus
abstract: The invention discloses a wearing device, a detection system and a detection method for detecting oestrus. The wearing device comprises a wearing belt and a collector. The collector comprises a shell,a circuit board, a power supply element, a communication element and at least one sensor, the circuit board, the power supply element, the communication element and the sensors are arranged in the shell, the power supply element, the communication element and the sensors are connected to the circuit board, the shell is installed on the wearing belt, when the wearing belt is arranged to surround the neck of a cow, the collector can be tightly attached to one side of the neck of the cow so as to collect data of the exercise amount and the temperature variation amount of the cow, and whether thecow is in the estrus period or not can be evaluated subsequently based on the data.

title: LIVESTOCK HOUSE MONITORING METHOD AND LIVESTOCK HOUSE MONITORING SYSTEM
abstract: A livestock house monitoring method comprises: an image capture step (S11) of capturing moving images in a henhouse; a conversion step (S12) of converting a plurality of images included in the captured moving images to respective monochrome images; and a generation step (S13) of statistically processing the plurality of images as converted to the monochrome images, thereby generating a monitoring image showing the distribution of hens in the henhouse. The henhouse is an example of the livestock house, and the hens are an example of livestock.

title: Livestock estrus detection method, device and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock estrus detection method, device and equipment. The method comprises the steps of: acquiring a video image and a sound audio of a livestock in a colony house; determining an action behavior of the livestock on the basis of the video image; identifying a sound production type of the sound audio; and according to the action behavior and the sound production type, eliminating an interference case and determining an estrus state of the livestock. According to the livestock estrus detection method, device and equipment, judgment on the estrus state is more accurate and reliable; problems of high human input and high experience requirement of artificial routing inspection are solved; cost of the detection equipment also can be effectively controlled; and estrusdetection efficiency and economic benefits are promoted.

title: VETERINARY DRUG INJECTION DEVICE DRUG INJECTION SYSTEMS METHOD AND COMPUTING DEVICE FOR EXECUTING THE SYSTEM
abstract: Disclosed are a veterinary drug injection device, a drug injection system using the same, a method thereof, and a computing device for executing the same. A veterinary drug injection device according to one embodiment of the present invention, a drug injection system using the same, a method thereof, and a computing device for executing the same comprise: a drug injection device, which includes a drug injection unit attached to an animal for injecting a drug, and a sensor unit for measuring information on the animal; and a management server for receiving the animal sensing information from the drug injection device, generating a drug injection signal for controlling drug injection based on the animal sensing information, and transmitting the drug injection signal to the drug injection device According to embodiments of the present invention, a drug can be administered to a plurality of livestock at once by attaching the drug injection device to an animal such as a cow, a pig or the like to remotely control the drug injection. In addition, according to the embodiments of the present invention, it is possible to prevent an operator in advance from encountering a safety accident caused by an injection close to the animal by accurately and quickly the drug injection. Furthermore, according to embodiments of the present invention, it is possible to prevent the spread of infectious diseases by administering a drug according to the animal's condition.
applicants: MEMSWINE; INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF KYUNGNAM UNIVERSITY

title: Pig growth prediction system using temperature and humidity sensing information in pig farm
abstract: Disclosed is pig growth prediction system using sensing information about the temperature and humidity of the inside of a pigpen. The pig growth prediction system using sensing information about the temperature and humidity of the inside of a pigpen comprises: a temperature measuring unit which measures temperature information inside a pigpen; a humidity measuring unit which measures humidity information inside the pigpen; a daily weight gain measuring unit which measures a daily weight gain of a pig for each growth stage based on measurement values of the temperature measuring unit and the humidity measuring unit; an expected breeding day calculation unit which calculates expected breeding days for each breeding period based on a calculated value of the daily weight grain measuring unit and a set weight for each growth stage of a pig; and a shipment day predicting unit which calculates a target shipment date based on the calculated value of the breeding day calculation unit and a preset suckling period of a pig. According to the present invention, a growth ability of a pig is predicted by using ICT information (sensing information about the temperature and humidity inside a pigpen), such that an expected target shipment date, an estimated total feed intake up to the expected target shipment data, an average feed conversion rate and the like can be predicted, and pig farms can manage pigs efficiently and economically with precise specification management.
applicants: INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF SUNCHON NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: CONTROL UNIT, SYSTEM AND METHOD RELATED TO AN ANIMAL'S ENERGY BALANCE
abstract: Herein a control unit (120), a system and a method are disclosed. Early lactation of an animal includes at least the first 3 days in milk of the current lactation period. The control unit is configured to:obtain measurements of milk flow during a milking session of the animal (101); analyse a sequence of said obtained measurements. Based on said analysis, the control unit estimates a total milk yield of the animal (101), and determines a predetermined partial amount of milk of the estimated total milk yield; and during early lactation, interrupts the milking of the animal on all teats when the predetermined partial amount of milk of the estimated total milk yield has been drawn from the animal. Alternatively, the control unit, based on said analysis, detects that the milk flow has reached a plateau phase; and during early lactation, interrupts the milking during the plateau phase (220).

title: Pasture automatic drinking water control system and control method
abstract: The invention provides a pasture automatic drinking water control system and a control method. The control system comprises at least one electronic tag, a wireless card reader, a temperature sensor, awater depth sensor, a concentrator, a water tank, a water discharge switch and a big data platform. The wireless card reader reads electronic tag data worn by cattle and sheep and uploads the electronic tag data to the concentrator; the temperature sensor monitors the environment temperature of the pasture in real time and uploads temperature data to the concentrator; the water depth sensor monitors the water depth of the water tank and uploads water depth data to the concentrator; and the concentrator reports the received electronic tag data, water depth data and temperature data to the bigdata platform. According to the invention, remote manual control and system automatic control can be realized; remote water injection and drainage can be realized, the water quality is ensured, and residual water can be prevented from freezing; water drinking conditions of cattle and sheep can be counted automatically, and pasture field temperature can be collected automatically. The workload of herdsmen can be reduced, and meanwhile the working efficiency can be improved.

title: EAR TAG AND TRACKING SYSTEM USING THE SAME
