abstract: To protect the ear of livestock by making an ear tag to be separated and removed from the ear of the livestock when a predetermined level or more of external force is applied to the ear tag, the present invention provides an ear tag comprising: a male ear tag member having a front surface on which information is displayed; a through-pin extending at one side of the male ear tag member, and having a sharp front end which penetrate the ear of livestock; a hanging protrusion formed at the front end of the through-pin; a female ear tag member having a front surface on which information is displayed; a holder unit installed at one side of the female ear tag member, and allowing the through-pin to be inserted thereinto; and a hook member provided in the holder unit, and allowing the hanging protrusion of the through-pin to be hung thereon and fastened thereto.

title: Cow individual behavior monitoring device and method based on vibration signals
abstract: The application discloses a cow individual behavior monitoring device and method based on vibration signals. A circuit board is arranged in a device shell, a piezoelectric sensor, a magnetic sensor and a processor are fixedly arranged on the circuit board, the piezoelectric sensor and the magnetic sensor are electrically connected with the processor, the piezoelectric sensor is used for collectingvibration information in cow individual behaviors, and the magnetic sensor is used for collecting standing and lying state information in the cow individual behaviors; and a hanging rope arranged onthe device shell is movably connected with the device shell, and is used for fixing the monitoring device on the neck of a cow. The monitoring device is fixed on the neck position of the cow, the vibration information in the cow individual behaviors can be detected through the piezoelectric sensor, the standing and lying action information of the cow can be detected through the magnetic sensor, after the detection information from the sensors is received by the processor, the detection information is transmitted to a monitoring computer, and real-time monitoring of cow individual behavior datacan be realized.

title: LIVESTOCK DATA ANALYSIS-BASED FARM HEALTH STATE DIAGNOSIS SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock data analysis-based livestock farm state diagnosis system and, more specifically, to a farm state diagnosis system for diagnosing a state of a livestock farm producing livestock products including livestock and poultry. According to the present invention, the farm state diagnosis system comprises: a multi-data collection unit collecting and converting livestock data including biodata and farm data of a livestock farm to store converted data; a model forming unit learning the data of the livestock farm collected by the multi-data collection unit based on artificial intelligence to form a state diagnosis model; and a state diagnosis unit using the livestock data of a livestock farm to be diagnosed, which are collected and converted by the multi-data collection unit, and the state diagnosis model formed by the model forming unit to diagnose a health management state of the livestock farm to be diagnosed. Accordingly, the livestock data including the biodata and the farm data of the livestock farm is learned, such that a health management state of the livestock farm to be diagnosed, and thus a current state of the livestock farm to be diagnosed through integration of various livestock data. Moreover, the state diagnosis model is formed based on artificial intelligence, and thus diagnosis correctness can be increased as livestock data is accumulated and, based on a correct diagnosis, livestock productivity is increased and management for producing healthy livestock products can be efficiently operated.

title: Method and system for monitoring egg laying performance of laying hen zone of cage-rearing laying hens
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring egg laying performance of a laying hen zone of cage-rearing laying hens. Wherein coops are arranged side by side, a conveying belt is arranged below the coops, and a machine vision detection device with a CCD camera and a lighting device is arranged at the conveying outlet end of the conveyor belt; chicken lay eggs and the eggs leak fromthe bottom of the hencoop and fall onto the conveying belt, after all eggs are laid, the conveying belt is started, the eggs pass through the machine vision detection device in the conveying processalong with the conveying belt, the CCD camera is triggered to shoot and obtain conveying belt surface images with the eggs, and egg contours in the images are obtained through image processing. And counting is performed to obtain the number of eggs, and processing is performed to obtain the coop area position, the egg color, the egg size and the egg weight of each egg, thereby realizing real-timemonitoring. According to the system, the change conditions of the egg laying number, the egg weight and the egg color of each egg laying area every day can be monitored, the egg laying performance andthe health condition of the laying hen area are monitored, the system is simple, and the cost of breeding equipment is saved.

title: LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT SERVER, LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT METHOD AND LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM
abstract: To manage implementation of an event (work) for huge number of livestock and check implementation results of the event without any omission.SOLUTION: A livestock information management system 1 for managing information of livestock includes: an information storage unit 121 for storing event information representing an event to be implemented for raising the livestock, event schedule master information regulating timing to implement the event, identifiers for identifying and individual or a group of the livestock or livestock groups, status information representing a status, the raising state where the livestock or the livestock groups identified by the identifiers transition by the implementation of the event, and history information relating to timing when the status transitions; and a livestock extraction unit 111 comparing the history information with the event schedule master information to determine whether or not the event has been implemented for the livestock or the livestock groups, and extracting livestock or livestock groups determined not to have been implemented as object livestock to which the event is not implemented yet.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Apparatus for cleaning and disinfecting of cattle hoof
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus for cleaning and disinfecting hooves of livestock and, more specifically, to an apparatus for cleaning and disinfecting hooves of livestock, capable of cleaning and disinfecting the hooves while moving the livestock, such as a cow, having hooves and processing sewage/wastewater or excreta generated while cleaning the hooves. According to the present invention, the apparatus comprises: a main body having an entrance and an exit opened to allow the livestock to enter and exit and having a support plate (110), which has a plurality of embosses protruding therefrom, embedded in an upper part; a detection unit (200) installed in the main body (100) to detect the livestock moving through the support plate (110); a cleaning water supply unit (300) installed in the main body (100) to spray cleaning water to the hooves of the livestock in accordance with a signal detected from the detection unit (200); a disinfection liquid supply unit (400) installed in the main body (100) to spray a disinfection liquid to the hooves of the livestock cleaned by the cleaning water supply unit (300); an impurity discharge unit (500) formed on one side of the main body to discharge the sewage/wastewater and the excreta; and a control unit (700) controlling the cleaning water supply unit (300) and the disinfection liquid supply unit (400) in accordance with a detection signal received from the detection unit (200).
applicants: PARK, JAE HEE; SHIN, SANG UN

title: COMPUTER VISION-BASED FEEDING MONITORING AND METHOD THEREFOR
abstract: Aspects of this disclosure are directed to methods and apparatuses involving the characterization of livestock feeding functions. As may be implemented as or with one or more embodiments herein, networked cameras are configured to capture images of a livestock feed area and machine-vision logic circuitry characterizes, based on the captured images, an amount of available feed and the presence of livestock in the livestock feed area depicted in the captured image over time. Feed-control logic circuitry may assign time- based condition values each respective feed area characterized by the cameras based on the characterized amount of available feed and the characterized presence of livestock provided via the machine-vision logic circuitry. An instruction characterizing the presentation of feed in the feed area may be output based on the assigned time-based condition values and a current time. Such an output may be used to control the presentation amount, timing and/or other feeding characteristics.

title: CAMERA WINCH CONTROL FOR DYNAMIC MONITORING
abstract: A method for controlling a sensor subsystem, the method including receiving one or more metrics representing one or more characteristics of livestock, including one or more livestock objects, contained in an enclosure and monitored by one or more sensors coupled to a winch subsystem. The method further includes determining a position to move the one or more sensors based on the metrics and determining an instruction that includes information related to a movement of the one or more sensors. The method further includes sending the instruction to the winch subsystem to change the position of the one or more sensors.

title: LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT SERVER, LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT METHOD, LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM AND DATA STRUCTURE FOR LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT
abstract: To perform precise numerical management of mother pigs as a group and reflect it in feeding work in the swine industry by constantly acquiring the feeding state of all the mother pigs as a whole farm.SOLUTION: A livestock information management system 1 for managing the breeding of a plurality of mother pigs, includes: information storage section 121 for storing mother pig identifiers D11 identifying individual mother pigs, and mother pig status information D12 in association with each other, the mother pig status information including a mother pig status representing a breeding state of a mother pig that transitions by a breeding event to be performed to the mother pig identified by the mother pig identifier, and a history relating to timing when the mother pig status transitions; a mother pig extraction section 111 for using the mother pig status information to extract a plurality of mother pigs in a same mother pig status; and a production group registration section 113 for assigning a production group identifier D21 for identifying them as a production group to which the same breeding event should be performed at a same period, in association with the mother pig identifier extracted by the mother pig extraction section.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Pig behavior recognition method and system based on information fusion
abstract: The invention relates to a pig behavior recognition method and system based on information fusion. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical pig behavior data in a previous pig activity process; determining a historical acceleration-time curve according to the historical pig behavior data; determining a historical adjacent wave crest interval set and a historical adjacent wave crest and wave trough difference set according to the historical curve; training a convolutional neural network to obtain a trained convolutional neural network; acquiring current pig behavior data; determining a current pig behavior standard deviation according to the current pig behavior data; judging whether the standard deviation is smaller than a preset standard deviation threshold value or not; ifyes, judging that the current pig behavior is in a static state; if not, determining a current acceleration-time curve according to the current pig behavior data; determining a current adjacent wave crest interval set and a current adjacent wave crest and wave trough difference set according to the current curve; and inputting the set into a trained convolutional neural network to obtain a currentdetection result, so that the abnormal behaviors of the pigs can be identified through the method.

title: Biological Information Capsule and Method for Measuring Methane Gas in the Rumen of Livestock
abstract: The present invention relates to a bio-information capsule of livestock and a measurement method and, more specifically, to a bio-information capsule that a bio-information capsule inserted into rumen of a cow is not fixed in rumen but a bio-information capsule is configured to measure a methane gas while a bio-information capsule flows. The bio-information capsule comprises: a methane sensor module; a capsule housing; and a buoyancy pocket.

title: METHODS AND APPARATUS FOR LIVESTOCK REARING
abstract: Apparatus for rearing livestock comprising a livestock enclosure, a plurality of sensors, and a plurality of output devices, and methods of operating the same. Methods of determining measurements of animal welfare by processing vocalisations by chicks, especially by detecting the spectral entropy of animal vocalisations. The relationship between chick distress calling in early life and outcome.

title: Dairy cow limp detection method and system based on support time phase
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a dairy cow limp detection method and system based on a support time phase. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a cow walking video, and extracting a cow hoof moving image from the cow walking video; calculating a support time phase set based on the cow hoof moving image; detecting and classifying cow limp by adopting a cow limp classification algorithm based on the support time phase set to obtain a cow limp classification result; and based on the cow limp classification result, detecting a single bracket of the existing limp cow to obtain a limp leg detection result. According to the embodiment of the invention, an autonomously designed limp detection algorithm based on a support time phase is adopted to internally compare the differences of four brackets of a dairy cow in the walking process, and the method is used for dairy cow limp detection, effectively reduces the influence of individual specificity in a conventional limpdetection method, improves the computer vision dairy cow limp detection and classification precision, and achieves the detection of limp legs.

title: Intelligent pig behavior abnormity monitoring method and system
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent pig behavior abnormity monitoring method and system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an instantaneous acceleration of a live pig; calculating an instantaneous acceleration variation according to the instantaneous acceleration; calculating a sampling characteristic value according to the instantaneous acceleration and the instantaneous acceleration variation; calculating a threshold value according to the historical data; drawing a box chart according to the sampling characteristic value and the threshold value; judging whether the sampling characteristic value exceeds the threshold value or not according to the box diagram; if not, obtaining the instantaneous acceleration of the live pig again, and returning to calculate the variation of the instantaneous acceleration according to the instantaneous acceleration; if yes, sending an alarm signal to a feeder. By comparing the sampling characteristic value with the threshold value, whether the behavior of the live pig belongs to the normal behavior or the abnormal behavior is determined, and the alarm signal is sent out after the abnormal behavior is detected, so that a feeder can find the abnormal behavior of the live pig in time, and the feeding safety is improved.

title: Novel intelligent modernized sheep house
abstract: The invention provides a novel intelligent modernized sheep house which comprises a house body, an arc ceiling arranged at the upper end of the house body and a slatted floor arranged at the lower endof the house body, wherein the house body is provided with a functional structure composed of an excrement cleaning device, an access control device, an adjusting device and a rain and sewage separation device; the arc ceiling is of an arch structure, and a heat-insulating plastic foam layer is arranged in the arc ceiling; and the slatted floor is laid at the upper end of a supporting frame, andthe supporting frame is fixedly connected with the arc ceiling. Under the condition that the basic requirements of a traditional sheep house are met, automatic management of the sheep flock living environment of the sheep house, real-time monitoring of various body indexes of a sheep flock and real-time observation of daily life of the sheep flock can be achieved. The sheep house is good in ventilation performance and capable of automatically cleaning excrement, and the rainwater is recycled by the rain and sewage separation device and thus the cost is reduced. A technical support is providedfor intelligent, automatic and reasonable management of the sheep flock.

title: MEASUREMENT METHOD OF BODY COMPOSITION IN RUMINANT CLASS ANIMALS
abstract: The related invention relates to the measurement device in the breeding of ruminant class animals, the monitoring of the development of which tissue type caused by dairy cattle rations in the body and determination of the percentage of tissue types such as protein, fat, water, and bone that make of body composition.

title: AI METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR INSPECTING BARN ENVIRONMENT BASED ON AI
abstract: Provided is a method and an apparatus for inspecting a livestock shed environment based on AI, wherein the apparatus inspecting a livestock shed environment based on AI may comprise: a camera photographing a livestock room, which is a partitioned place for raising livestock in a livestock shed; and a control device identifying the position of livestock in the livestock room based on a visible-light image of the livestock room photographed through the camera, and measuring a body temperature of the livestock based on a thermal image obtained by thermal imaging for the livestock whose location has been identified.

title: Cattle and sheep breeding system
abstract: The present invention discloses a cattle and sheep breeding system and belongs to the technical field of livestock breeding. The system comprises an intelligent processing module, the intelligent processing module is electrically connected to an indoor sensor module, an indoor processing module, an image acquisition module and a roller shutters control module, a mobile terminal and a power supplymodule, and the intelligent processing module is also electrically connected to a remote terminal through a wireless transceiver module. The system can automatically sense and adjust the environment of breeding farms, enables cattle and sheep in a good growth environment, reduces the number of times of breeding workers entering breeding rooms and reduces infection of cattle and sheep caused by bacteria brought back from the outside, which results in loss of the breeding farms. Besides, a structure of the image acquisition module is added, so that the breeding workers can always observe conditions within the breeding farms without patrolling. The cattle and sheep breeding system can also facilitate the farms to grasp growth and activity data of livestock in real time, promotes a proper movement of the livestock, and improves yield and quality of the livestock.
applicants: ZHANGYE CITY GANZHOU DISTRICT SHANHU BREEDING FARM

title: Detection device based on pig individual identification comprehensive information
abstract: The invention discloses a detection device based on pig individual identification comprehensive information. The detection device comprises a pig water nozzle, an infrared thermometer, a first identifier, a second identifier, a third identifier, a controller, a first sliding rod; a first lead screw, a back plate, a first side plate, a second side plate and a top plate; when the controller detectsthat a pig bites a start button on the pig water nozzle, the controller controls the first identifier, the second identifier or the third identifier to identify the ID number of the pig biting the pigwater nozzle currently, controls the infrared thermometer to detect the body temperature value of the pig biting the pig water nozzle currently, and uploads the ID number and the body temperature value to a server. By means of the mode, the detection device disclosed by the invention can identify pig individuals and detect comprehensive information such as the water intake and the body temperature of the pigs, meanwhile, the size of the detection device can be changed, a user can change the distance between the first side plate and the back plate and the distance between the second side plateand the back plate as needed so as to change the size of the detection device, and the user experience is greatly improved.

title: Robot for cleaning manure in piggery and health quarantine
abstract: The invention provides a robot for cleaning manure in a piggery and health quarantine, and belongs to the field of electromechanical integration. The problems of low cleaning efficiency of existing large pig farms and piggeries and relatively simple disease prevention and control method are solved. The robot includes a robot body, a sensor navigation mechanism, a health quarantine mechanism, fourgroups of drive assemblies, a brush frame and an electrical control mechanism. The sensor navigation mechanism is arranged on the robot body so that the robot body can walk along a set route. The fourgroups of drive assemblies are arranged on the bottom surface of the robot body in an in-toeing shape to drive the robot body to walk. The electrical control mechanism is in communication connectionwith the sensor navigation mechanism, the health quarantine mechanism, the drive assemblies and the brush frame correspondingly. The robot is mainly used for piggery manure removal and health quarantine.

title: System and Method for managing barn
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and a method for managing a pen of a livestock farm, which monitors a pen condition and a health condition of a livestock in a deep learning way. The system of the present invention comprises: a data obtaining unit for obtaining pen photographing data from at least one CCTV camera installed in a pen; a livestock image analysis unit for receiving the pen photographing data for each time zone from the data obtaining unit to generate an appearance condition of a livestock in a 3D model of the livestock included in the pen photographing data; and a health condition recognizing unit for recognizing a health condition of the livestock on the basis of a deep learning technology based on the appearance condition of the livestock generated from the livestock image analysis unit. Therefore, a customized environment for each stage of livestock growth can be provided and managed by easily recognizing and adjusting temperature/humidity of the pen to maintain a proper body temperature for each stage of the livestock growth including a pig.

title: Permanent-available grazing animals health-disease management system using solar panel
abstract: An animal management apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an ear tag part for measuring the animal′s biometric information; a collar part wrapping the animals′ neck; and a neck tag part installed on the collar part to measure movement information and location information of animals, wherein the collar part comprises a photovoltaic part for receiving light and generating and supplying power, and the neck tag part comprises a motion information measuring part for measuring motion information of animals, a location measuring part for measuring the location of animals, and a communication part for receiving biometric information from the ear tag part, and transmitting at least one of biometric information, motion information, and position to the outside.

title: LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT SERVER, LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT METHOD AND LIVESTOCK INFORMATION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM
abstract: To provide a livestock information management system, livestock information management server, livestock information management method and livestock information management program, even in a few-people large-scale breeding farmer, capable of managing the weight and feeding of livestock, while suppressing increase in the cost.SOLUTION: A livestock information management system 1 includes a livestock image information acquisition section 112 for acquiring livestock image information including a plurality of livestock animals belonging to a management group, a feeding information acquisition section 114 for acquiring feeding information relating to the feeding to the livestock of the management group, a group weight estimation section 116 for estimating group weight distribution of a plurality of livestock animals from the livestock image information, and a livestock information management section 118 generating livestock management information, while associating the group weight distribution estimated by the group weight estimation section and the feeding information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Pig ear profiling skeleton and non-invasive pig ear temperature measuring device
abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent farming, and discloses a pig ear profiling skeleton and a non-invasive pig ear temperature measuring device. The pig ear profiling skeleton comprisesthe profiling skeleton that can be worn on the auricle of a pig ear and the non-invasive pig ear temperature measuring device made based on the profiling skeleton. According to the pig ear profiling skeleton provided by the invention, the live pig body temperature is monitored through the profiling skeleton worn on the auricle of the pig ear and a temperature measuring component installed on the profiling skeleton, the whole device is stable and reliable in installation and wearing, has high temperature measurement accuracy, and also avoids the problem that a traditional ear tag type temperature measuring device can damage pig ears.

title: Micro kinetic energy collection device and method
abstract: The invention discloses a micro kinetic energy collection device and method which is used for converting kinetic energy into electric energy, and belongs to the technical field of energy collection and conversion. The kinetic energy collection device adopts an annular plastic pipe, a magnetic induction coil winds around the plastic pipe, a magnetic ball or two magnetic balls are placed in the annular plastic pipe, and when two magnetic balls are placed, the two magnetic balls are separated by a small plastic plate. When an ear of a live pig flaps, the magnetic ball rolls in the annular plasticpipe to cut the coil, and then electric energy is generated. The generated voltage is unstable or weak due to the influence of factors such as flapping amplitude and frequency of the ear of the livepig, thus the electromagnetic coil is connected with an external electric appliance element through a wire, alternating current is converted into direct current through a rectifier bridge firstly, then the energy is recycled and output to a battery through a micro energy collecting chip, the effect of recycling energy is achieved, and finally, the endurance of the battery capacity of an intelligent ear tag is achieved.

title: Method and system for monitoring health status of live pigs
abstract: The invention discloses a method and system for monitoring health status of live pigs. Through data acquisition, system transmission and monitoring management, a closed loop including performing analyzing treatment, and judging the health status of the live pigs is formed. The data acquisition comprises acquisition of blood oxygen, cardiac rate, body temperature and movement data; the system transmission and monitoring management are used for uploading data acquired by sensors to a server through an LORA gateway to allow a health monitoring terminal to perform further analyzing treatment, so that the health status of the live pigs is judged. The system disclosed by the invention adopts multi-functional Internet of Things sensing and detecting equipment with ultralow power consumption, so that the pain spot of product monitoring in the high-density live pig breeding process is solved; through data, the physiclal status of the pigs is inspected, and the situation whether the live pigs are healthy or not is judged; and the liquid supplying device disclosed by the invention is comprehensive in acquired data, simple to operate, easy to amend and high in universality.

title: ESTIMATION SYSTEM FOR ESTIMATING HEALTH CONDITION OF ANIMAL, ESTIMATION METHOD, AND LEARNING MODEL GENERATION METHOD
abstract: To solve problems in which it is important to take care of livestock for each individual in the livestock industry, but it is a burden to perform the work by manpower every day for all individuals, and from such a point, a health condition estimation device for calculating scores to represent healthy conditions such as depression conditions of the rumen of a cow by acquiring a three-dimensional shape of the cow from a distance image is proposed as conventional technology, however, many other viewpoints to be examined for verification of the health conditions of the cow are present, but some items such as the change of appetite and the presence or absence of fever are difficult to be determined just by looking at them.SOLUTION: According to the present invention, a learning model is generated by using measurement data acquired from a sensor worn by each individual of the cow in addition to video data photographing the cow, and the presence or absence of abnormality of health conditions of each individual is estimated by using the generated learning model. As a result, a system capable of early detecting the abnormality of the health conditions of the cow and preventing its oversight can be provided.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: Anti-pressing device for piglets
abstract: The invention discloses an anti-pressing device for piglets. The anti-pressing device comprises a power supply, a pickup MIC, a unidirectional microphone, an audio processing module, a master controlsingle-chip microcomputer, a transmitting chip and an LDO circuit. The pickup MIC is connected with the unidirectional microphone. The unidirectional microphone is also connected with the audio processing module and the master control single-chip microcomputer. The master control single-chip microcomputer is further connected with the transmitting chip. The power supply is respectively connected with the audio processing module, the transmitting chip and the LDO circuit; and the output end of the LDO circuit is further connected with the audio processing module and the master control single-chip microcomputer. According to the anti-pressing device for the piglets, the sound of the piglets can be detected, the special squeal sound caused by extrusion suffocation of sows is accurately separated from the mixed sound of numerous piglets, a breeder is informed in time for rescue, the death rate of the piglets is reduced, and the breeding efficiency is improved. Therefore, the anti-pressingdevice for the piglets has the huge market application value.

title: Smart farm pig-raising system and method
abstract: Disclosed are a smart farm pig raising system and a method. The smart farm pig raising system includes: a user response unit for receiving changes in a pig's livestock house according to user's manipulation from a user terminal; and a data update unit for updating breeding data so that the information on changes in the livestock house is added to the breeding data of a corresponding pig. Therefore, it is possible to continuously manage the breeding data of each individual to reflect real-time information regardless of movement of the barn for each growth cycle during an entire growing period of the pig.

title: Intelligent pig raising monitoring method and management terminal
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent pig raising monitoring method and a management terminal. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a live pig monitoring video of live pigs in a farm in a raising process; identifying a walking track and an expression behavior of each live pig in the live pig monitoring video; and obtaining the health state of each live pig according to the walkingtrack and the expression behavior of each live pig. Video real-time monitoring is carried out on live pigs in the breeding process, so that a farmer can observe the growth condition of the live pigs in real time to judge the health state of the live pigs; and meanwhile, the walking track and the expression behavior of each live pig are automatically analyzed according to the monitored video system, so that the health state of each live pig is obtained, and intelligent real-time health monitoring is automatically provided for farmers.

title: Livestock networking environment monitoring and data identification type automatic feeding system
abstract: A livestock networking environment monitoring and data identification type automatic feeding system comprises a total breeding area, a breeding device, a cleaning device, a feeding device, a housing controller and a total control server, wherein the total breeding area comprises a breeding area, a feeding area, a delivery area, an isolation area and a storage area, the breeding device comprises apartition telescopic mechanism, a partition guardrail, a partition module, a food trough, a food isolation mechanism, a food shield, a rail crane, an electric hook, and a housing camera, the cleaningdevice comprises a cleaning net layer, a slope sliding layer, a drainage storage layer, a cleaning rail, a rail shell, a hydraulic mechanism, an interference platform, a vibration motor unit, a drainage sealing mechanism and a drainage sealing plate, and the feeding device comprises a feed supply mechanism, a ventilation port, an air exhaust device, an air supply filtering device, a feed collection port, an annular switch mechanism, a stirring mechanism, a feed purification channel, an ultraviolet disinfection device and a drying device. The system provides intelligent housing breeding.

title: System for abnornal signs dection of individual animals and method thereof
abstract: Provided is a method for detecting anomalies for each individual of livestock based on sensor data and image data performed on a computer system. The method can comprise the following steps of: receiving sensor data and an identifier of the livestock, analyzing the sensor data to identify the livestock, and classifying the identified behavior of the livestock; and receiving image data, analyzing the image data, and classifying the behavior of at least one livestock individual included in the image.

title: Automatic breeding pig feeding machine material amount detection system and method based on machine vision
abstract: The invention provides an automatic breeding pig feeding machine material amount detection system and method based on machine vision. The system comprises a camera module, a water valve module, a flowmeter module, a display module, a main control circuit, a motor module and a power supply module, wherein the main control circuit is connected with all other modules. On one hand, the water valve module is controlled according to a water discharge amount obtained by the flowmeter module to implement automatic water discharge, on the other hand, according to image information acquired by the camera module, material amount situations in material basins are confirmed by using a target area partitioning method based on OpenCV and an area growth algorithm, and furthermore, the motor module is controlled to implement automatic material discharge. With the combination of machine vision and a breeding pig feeding machine, the robustness of automatic water and material discharge of the breeding pig feeding machine can be well improved, the probability of excessive or sufficient water and material discharge can be reduced, and precise casting of pig feeds can be achieved.

title: Intelligent culture management system for fattening pigs
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of culture, in particular to an intelligent culture management system for fattening pigs. Compared with the prior art, the intelligent culture management system has differences that the feed intake of each fattening pig is monitored, the weight information of each fattening pig is obtained, and the future feeding quantity of the pig can be dynamically regulated according to the monitored feed intake and the obtained weight information. Compared with the prior art, the intelligent culture management system can realize the later-stage accurate limitedfeeding of the fattening pigs, can save feed consumption and can improve a pig body situation.

title: Feeding device for fattening pigs
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of breeding, and in particular to a feeding device for fattening pigs. The feeding device is different from the prior art in that feeding amount of each fattening pig is monitored, weight information of each fattening pig is obtained, and future feeding amount of each fattening pig is dynamically adjusted according to the monitored feeding amount and the obtained weight information. Compared with the prior art, the feeding device can realize accurate limited feeding in the later period of fattening pigs, save feed consumption and improve body condition of pigs.

title: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for implementing real time beef cattle monitoring utilizing radio-frequency identification (RFID) based technologies
abstract: In accordance with embodiments disclosed herein, there are provided methods and systems for real-time beef cattle monitoring utilizing Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID) based technologies. For example, there is disclosed a system having at least a memory to store instructions; a processor to execute the instructions; a database to store data for heads of livestock, wherein each head of livestock is individually identified via a Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID) tag, the RFID tag uniquely identifying each of the heads of livestock to the system; a plurality of antennas to read information transmitted from the RFID tags; a transactional and analytical server to receive the information transmitted from the RFID tags and to store the information in the database; wherein the transactional and analytical server to further analyze the information stored in the database to identify when each head of livestock is present within a defined feeding zone; and monitoring the heads of livestock for anomalous feeding behavior based on the analysis. Other related embodiments are disclosed.

title: Temperature measurement ear tag and temperature measurement method and system based on temperature measurement ear tag
abstract: The invention discloses a temperature measurement ear tag and a temperature measurement method and system based on the temperature measurement ear tag. The temperature measurement ear tag comprises anear tag main body, an ear tag column and an ear tag buckle, wherein the ear tag main body is internally provided with an integrated circuit board; the integrated circuit board comprises a main control chip and a power supply chip; the first end of the ear tag column is connected with the ear tag main body; the ear tag column is of a hollow structure; the ear tag column is internally provided witha temperature sensor; the temperature sensor is used for acquiring the temperature of a target; and the second end of the ear tag column is connected with the ear tag buckle. By adopting the temperature measurement ear tag, the technical problem that a temperature measurement method provided by related technologies is tedious in temperature measurement operation on livestock targets can be solved.

title: METHOD AND APPARTUS FOR CHECKING SYMPTOM OF PIG AND MANAGING CLOUD SERVICE
abstract: The present invention provides a method of checking abnormal symptoms of sows based on image data performed on a computer program. According to the present invention, the method may comprise the steps of: receiving image data of sows; analyzing the image data to analyze the behavior of at least one sow included in the image; and calculating the severity of abnormal symptoms of sows based on the analyzed result.

title: AUDIT AND TRACING SYSTEM AND RELATED APPARATUS OF OR FOR ORGANISMS
abstract: - 30 To improve the audit and tracing trail of or for animals, electronic tags that may come included in halters or collars or bolus or eartags may be used with and/or applied to animals. Electronic tags may be subcutaneous or may be eartags that are 5 commonly applied to the ears of livestock. Despite the increased security resulting from the use of identification tags, there still remains the risk of error, lost tags, fraud or installation or handling error. This may occur during the tagging process if there are insufficient measures to prevent tampering of the tags. The present invention relates to an audit and tracing system, related apparatus and methods of or for organisms 10 such as animals or plants.
