title: Veterinary affected animal observation control system, control method and storage medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic monitoring and discloses a veterinary affected animal observation control system and method and a storage medium. The veterinary affected animal observation control system is provided with an image acquisition module, an image conversion module, a parameter setting module, a central control module, a temperature acquisition module, an electrocardiogram monitoring module, a motion recording module, a feeding recording module, an excrement monitoring module and the like. The veterinary affected animal observation control method comprisesthe steps of collecting affected animal images and converting the images into videos; performing data input; acquiring the information of affected livestocks; comparing the acquired affected animal data with set data, and displaying the data through a display. The veterinary affected animal observation control system provided by the invention can perform monitoring according to different affectedanimal types, and adapts to the requirement of livestock isolation observation; automatic and accurate observation and monitoring of the body information of the affected livestock are achieved, the judgment result is more accurate, and effective data are provided for veterinary treatment.

title: Cow state monitoring system and cow state monitoring method
abstract: The invention discloses a cattle state monitoring system and a cattle state monitoring method. The cattle state monitoring system comprises an acquisition unit and a monitoring unit. The acquisition unit comprises a sign acquisition module used for acquiring exercise amount and body temperature change amount of a cow. The monitoring unit comprises a modeling module and a judgment module, and the judgment module is in communication connection with the modeling module and the sign acquisition module. The judging module is used for judging the current health state of the cattle after acquiring amonitoring model uniquely corresponding to the cattle from the modeling module and acquiring the exercise amount and the body temperature change amount of the cattle from the physical sign acquiring module.

title: Live pig cultivation device and method based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention discloses a live pig cultivation device and method based on Internet of Things. The live pig cultivation device comprises a pig house and an unmanned aerial vehicle for monitoring arranged in the pig house. The live pig cultivation device can detect temperature, humidity and harmful gas concentration in the pig house, and according to the detection data, temperature, humidity and ventilation situation in the pig house can be adjusted intelligently. The unmanned aerial vehicle is used for monitoring and cruise shooting of the situation of each pig bed, so that an animal keeper cantimely understand the health situation of each living pig and the hygienic situation in each pig bed, and cleaning can be reasonably arranged for timely assisting and isolation of ill pigs. Epidemicsituation proliferation can be avoided, increment of the rate of live pigs delivered to the slaughterhouse is facilitated, the breeding efficiency is improved, and the live pig cultivation device andmethod can save human resources and substance resources.
applicants: TANGSHAN HACHUAN TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; TANGSHAN SHENGYIN MARINE TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Configuration method and device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract: The invention provides a configuration method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining condition information corresponding to a target objectthrough an electronic identifier carried by the target object; determining the amount of water required by the target object and the information of ingredients added into the water according to the condition information; and sending a notification message, wherein the notification message is used for notifying a user of the amount of water required by drinking equipment of the target object and the ingredient information in the water. According to the method, the problem existing in the prior art that the drinking equipment of a pig farm shares the same drinking nozzle for a group of pigs is solved.

title: Livestock and poultry breeding method for individual control
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock and poultry breeding method. The method is characterized in that a rest area (2), a weighing area, (3), a charging area (6) and the like are constructed. A breeding colony house provided with an individual control device (12) and the like is equipped; adaptive training is carried out, wherein conditioned reflex is formed between the driving modes of the specific activities of each livestock and poultry individual (14) and the livestock and poultry individual control device (12), and the breeding data of each livestock and poultry individual (14) is analyzedand a growth and development model is established; according to the meat product order requirements and the growth and development model of each livestock and poultry individual (14), an individual breeding scheme is determined separately; and through conditioned reflex, each livestock and poultry individual (14) is driven to complete the breeding activities determined by the individual breedingscheme until breeding is completed. According to the difference of different livestock and poultry individuals (14), targeted and individual breeding is carried out, thereby helping to reduce the feedcost, improving the immunity and the meat quality and the stability of the product quality, and reducing the difference.

title: SOLAR-POWERED REMOTE MONITORING TAG SYSTEM FOR ANIMALS
abstract: A solar-powered remote monitoring tag (110, 295) for beef cattle and other animals typically inhabiting outdoor environments combines animal health and activity monitoring with geolocation information. The tags communicate with a base station (120) using radio communications, which in turn uses satellite internet services to communicate with a remote computing server (140). The remote computing server provides a user interface (150), such as a mobile app, that provides geospatially enabled information involving the health, activity, and location of monitored animals, thus providing timely and evidence-based decision support to the end user. The remote monitoring tags may also provide for close range communication using a near field communication transponder.

title: Disease precontrol detection device for livestock breeding
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock and discloses a disease precontrol detection device for livestock breeding. The device comprises a main body box; the inner walls of the mainbody box are fixedly connected by a partition plate; an iron wire net is fixedly mounted in the partition plate; the inner bottom wall of the main body box is fixedly provided with a collection box; supporting plates are fixedly connected to the left and right sides of the collection box at the bottom of the partition plate; one opposite sides of the two supporting plates are provided with slidinggrooves; the interiors of the two sliding grooves are movably connected with movable blocks; one opposite sides of the two movable blocks are fixedly connected with the collection box; a baffle is fixedly mounted in the iron wire net; the inner bottom wall of the collection box is fixedly connected with clamping plates; clamping grooves are formed in the positions corresponding to the clamping plates at the bottom of the baffle; and the clamping plates are located in the clamping grooves. The disease precontrol detection device for livestock breeding facilitates disease detection and saves time and labor.

title: Live pig quantity statistics method and system
abstract: The invention provides a live pig quantity statistics method and system. The method comprises the following steps: enabling an electronic tag reader-writer disposed on a pig drinking device or a feeding device to scan an electronic tag worn by a live pig entering a preset range in a preset time interval, and uploading the scanned electronic tag to a server; the server compares the scanned electronic tag with a pre-stored electronic tag to determine the number of live pigs scanned within the time interval; and when the number of the scanned live pigs is inconsistent with the number of the livepigs recorded on the server, the server sends prompt information to a specified terminal. According to the invention, each live pig is provided with a unique electronic tag, and the unique electronictag is read by the electronic tag reader-writer arranged on the pig drinking device or the feeding device, so that the live pigs can be accurately identified, and the number of the live pigs can be accurately counted.

title: Method and system for determining motion state, storage medium and electronic device
abstract: The invention provides a method and system for determining a motion state, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring motion data of a target objectin a target area through a target device, wherein the target area is determined by the target device used for limiting the motion range of the target object, at least an infrared sensor and a pressure sensor are arranged on the target device, and the motion data at least comprises one of first data acquired through the infrared sensor and second data acquired through the pressure sensor; and determining the motion state of the target object according to the motion data meeting the preset condition under the condition that the motion data meets the preset condition. Therefore, the method and system further solve the problems that the motion state of the current target object (for example, animals such as pigs and the like) at a certain time cannot be known in the related technology, and can continuously monitor the motion state of the target object and generate the motion data of the target object.

title: Intelligent feeding device for cats
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent feeding device for cats and belongs to the technical field of pet feeding equipment. The intelligent feeding device comprises a feeder body, a food discharge mechanism arranged on the feeder body, a multi-cat recognition device and a food scattering device, wherein the food discharge mechanism comprises a food bowl and a weighing tray; the food bowl is fixedon the weighing tray; a tray fixing member is fixed at the bottom of the weighing tray; a weighing sensor is arranged in the tray fixing member; and the food scattering device is arranged in a barn ofthe feeder body and comprises silica gel blades, food discharge blades and a food discharge impeller box which are sequentially arranged from top to bottom. Cat food in the food bowl is weighed through the weighing sensor, and the weight of the cat food fed to the cats each time can be known; meanwhile, the multi-cat recognition device can recognize the fed cats and feeding frequency, and the daily eating situation of each cat is recorded through matching the fed cats, the feeding frequency and the weight of the cat food fed to the cats each time, so as to know the health condition of the cats. The silica gel blades and food discharge blades are used for guiding the food.

title: Breeding equipment and method capable of monitoring health states of livestock and automatically dispensing medicines
abstract: The invention discloses breeding equipment capable of monitoring the health states of livestock and automatically dispensing medicines. The equipment comprises a breeding bed, a trough and a feeding vehicle, wherein the trough is positioned at the front end of the breeding bed, an infrared transmitter is arranged at the front end of the trough, an infrared sensor is arranged at the front end of the feeding vehicle, a storage barrel is arranged on the feeding vehicle, a weighing cylinder is arranged below the storage cylinder, the weighing cylinder is installed on an electronic scale, the storage cylinder supplies materials to the weighing cylinder for weighing, a first automatic switch gate is arranged at a discharge port of the storage barrel, a second automatic switch gate is arranged ata discharge port of the weighing cylinder, and an infrared thermometer is arranged at a discharge port of the weighing cylinder, a medicine powder preparation rotating disc is arranged beside the weighing cylinder, a plurality of medicine powder cavities are arranged in the periphery of the medicine powder preparation rotating disc, a powder discharge port is formed in the bottom of each medicinepowder cavity, an automatic medicine powder opening and closing gate is arranged at each powder discharge port, and a medicine powder weighing device is arranged below each powder discharge port andused for weighing medicine powder and conveying the medicine powder into the weighing cylinder.

title: Special device and breeding method for captive type automatic livestock breeding
abstract: The invention discloses a special device for captive type automatic livestock breeding. The special device comprises a breeding bed body, a first electronic scale, a manure scraping mechanism and an automatic weighing skip car, wherein the breeding bed body is laid on the first electronic scale; a manure discharging pit is dug along the periphery of the breeding bed body; the manure scraping mechanism scrapes away manure on the breeding bed body; an infrared sensor is arranged on the automatic weighing skip car; an infrared emitter is arranged at a livestock feeding position; the automatic weighing skip car and the manure scraping mechanism are in signal connection with a computer system; the manure scraping mechanism comprises a moving frame, a scraping plate, sliding rails, a lead screwmechanism and a driving motor; the sliding rails are arranged at two sides of the breeding bed body respectively; the moving frame is connected with and arranged above the breeding bed body in a bridged mode; two ends of the moving frame are in sliding fit with the sliding rails at two side positions respectively; a lead screw is arranged beside the sliding rails and connected with the driving motor; and lead screw nuts are connected with the moving frame. According to the invention, the warm and full states of livestock are judged by monitoring of the weight of the livestock on the same day,the daily weight increment and the defecation weight of the livestock every day, so the livestock is fed with the most economical feed consumption.

title: Cow estrus monitoring sticker and using method
abstract: The invention discloses a cow estrus monitoring sticker. The cow estrus monitoring sticker comprises an estrus sticker body and a protection mechanism, wherein the estrus sticker body comprises an erasable surface layer, a first bright color signal layer, a back glue sticking layer and a white bright color signal layer, and the estrus sticker body is sequentially provided with the erasable surfacelayer, the first bright color signal layer, the white bright color signal layer and the back glue sticking layer from top to bottom. The invention further discloses a using method of the cow estrus monitoring sticker. The cow estrus monitoring sticker and the using method have the advantages that the estrus sticker is an economical, simple and efficient estrus detection tool, and a more accurateestrus detection result is provided by using a simple 'scratch' technology; protection paper is stuck to the bottom of the back glue sticking layer to protect the back glue sticking layer, and the circumstance that the viscous force of the back glue sticking layer is reduced due to the fact that the back glue sticking layer is exposed outside, and the viscous force of the back glue sticking layerstuck to the back of a cow is affected is avoided; and the protection paper is used for protecting the erasable surface layer of the estrus sticker body, and scratch of the erasable surface layer exposed outside is reduced.
applicants: WUHAN ANSCITECH ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Object index detection method and livestock weight detection method and device
abstract: The invention relates to an object index detection method and a livestock weight detection method and device. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a to-be-detected image which comprisesat least one target object; inputting the to-be-detected image into a pre-trained segmentation model, and segmenting the to-be-detected image by the segmentation model according to the position information of the specified part of the target object in the to-be-detected image to obtain a part image; extracting a feature vector of a specified part of the target object based on the part image; anddetermining index information of the target object according to the feature vector. According to the technical scheme adopted by the invention, depth feature information is extracted based on the partimage of the specified part of the target object obtained through segmentation, and the index of the target object is estimated in a machine learning mode. The method has the advantages of high efficiency, low cost, no damage to the target object, and small error of the detection result compared with the prior art.
applicants: BEIJING HAIYI TONGZHAN INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: INTERGRATED STREAMING SERVICE PROVIFING SYSTEM AND METHOD THEREOF
abstract: Provided are a smart livestock management system and a method thereof. The method comprises the steps of: allowing a livestock management server to acquire livestock image data acquired by photographing livestock located in cages; allowing the livestock management server to separate the livestock included in the livestock image data into individual objects; allowing the livestock management server to extract object information including object body temperature information and object behavior information of the individual object from the livestock image data; allowing the livestock management server to generate determination result data for determining whether the livestock has abnormal symptoms by analyzing the object information based on standard livestock management data; and allowing the livestock management server to transmit the determination result data to a manager terminal, wherein the livestock management server determines whether the livestock has the abnormal symptoms by using a deep learning technique based on the standard livestock management data, and can divide the abnormal symptoms into disease symptoms, childbirth symptoms and synagogue symptoms.

title: Apparatus and method for obtaining saliva
abstract: The present invention provides an apparatus for quantitatively and efficiently collecting saliva from a subject, which is easy to maintain, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, a plurality of micro-holes are formed at one end part of a tube having elastic properties and the other end part is connected to a vacuum pump to suck animal saliva from the end part in which the micro-holes are formed. The tube having the micro-holes has a coaxial structure or a structure including a filler to filter out substances except for the subject's saliva. In addition, since motion and position sensors and electronically controllable valves such as solenoid valves are used so that the apparatus is operated only when being used by a user, and thus automatic and quantitative control is possible. In addition, the apparatus is connected to drinking water and air lines inside a livestock shed so that a saliva collection tube is washed and dried, thereby simplifying maintenance and efficiently collecting saliva.

title: DETERMINATION DEVICE AND DETERMINATION PROGRAM
abstract: To accurately determine specific behavior classification of a ruminant.SOLUTION: A determination device 130 includes: a generation unit for executing frequency analysis for one-dimensional time-series data indicating an acceleration output by an acceleration sensor 110 attached to a ruminant 10 and generating two-dimensional arrangement data indicating intensity of each frequency in each time; and a determination unit for determining behavior classification by predetermined time range of the ruminant with the two-dimensional arrangement data by predetermined time range as an input.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: RUMINANT ANIMAL MONITORING SYSTEM
abstract: There is provided a system and method for automatically monitoring a ruminant animal. The system comprises a 3D camera system that obtains images from a region of interest, in particular the paralumbar fossa. An image processor determines the surface curvature in the region of interest, as a function of time. Based on the frequency with which this function attains local maxima, a health indication for the animal is generated.

title: Method for predicting abortion or premature birth based on changes in body temperature and activity in rumen after vaccination of bovine foot-and-mouth disease
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for predicting miscarriage or premature birth according to changes in body temperature and activity in the rumen after vaccination of bovine foot-and-mouth disease. And more specifically, the present invention collects information on the body temperature and activity of pregnant cattle after vaccination of foot-and-mouth disease through a temperature and activity sensor inserted into the rumen of a Korean native cow to predict miscarriage or premature birth.

title: Intelligent sheep reproductive capacity detection system and method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent sheep reproductive capacity detection, and discloses an intelligent sheep reproductive capacity detection system and method. The system comprises a sheep image collection module, a sign information collection module, a gene information collection module, a main control module, a health monitoring module, a reproductive number calculationmodule, a reproductive evaluation module, a cloud service module, and a display module. The method for collecting data through the health monitoring module is simple, the data content is rich, individual data with relatively high reliability can be generated after data mining, manpower simplification and cost reduction of a farm are facilitated, behavior monitoring and source tracing of the individual sheep growth process are accurate, and real-time monitoring of the sheep health state is achieved; meanwhile, gray processing, splicing processing, filtering, threshold processing and the like are carried out on the shot image through a reproduction number calculation module, the shot image is converted into a binary image, and contour retrieval is carried out in the binary image to obtain the number of sheep reproduction groups.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL SCIENCES, CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Beef cattle mating process monitoring system and monitoring method based on wearable monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a beef cattle mating process monitoring system and monitoring method based on a wearable monitoring system, relates to the field of livestock raising, and aims at solving the problems caused by lack of process monitoring in a natural mating mode in the existing beef cattle raising process. The monitoring on cattle data in the mating process is realized by using a pluralityof kinds of sensors worn on a cattle body, and the monitoring effect is good. Particularly, data support and monitoring guarantee are provided for manual intervention after natural breeding failure.

title: Method for monitoring abnormity of cows in oestrous period
abstract: The invention discloses a method for monitoring abnormity of cows in an oestrous period, relates to the field of livestock and aims to solve the problems that the reliability is poor and great time and labor are needed when abnormity of cows are monitored at present. According to the method, physiological data of cows in an oestrous period can be acquired in real time by using sensors distributedin different positions of cow bodies, the physiological data are compared with standard data, and then abnormity of the cows in the oestrous period can be monitored. The method is good in monitoring instantaneity, and the time and labor can be saved.

title: Livestock motion remote monitoring method, livestock motion remote monitoring device, storage medium and electronic device
abstract: The invention provides a livestock motion remote monitoring method, a livestock motion remote monitoring device, a storage medium and an electronic device, wherein the method comprises the following steps that a first motion parameter of the livestock is collected, wherein the first motion parameter refers to a motion gait parameter of the livestock motion detected by one or a plurality of sensorsarranged on a living livestock body; a motion state division result on the livestock sent by an upper computer according to the first motion parameter is received, wherein the motion state division result at least comprises one of the followings: a livestock rest state and a livestock activity state; and the remote monitoring early warning reminding is performed in response to the motion state division result. The problems that the data obtained through remote monitoring is inaccurate, and the continuous and real-time monitoring on the individual motion behavior of the livestock cannot be realized are solved. The effects of continuously recording the motion state of the livestock in real time and accurately determining the livestock individual with the poor health state are achieved.

title: Sheep rumination behavior monitoring method based on acoustic analysis
abstract: The invention discloses a sheep rumination behavior monitoring method based on acoustic analysis, which is beneficial to health early warning of sheep and establishment of an intelligent breeding mode. The method comprises the following steps of: (1) enabling a lower computer to read a sound signal in real time; (2) taking [delta] as a time interval, preprocessing and identifying the original sound signal by the lower computer, and counting the rumination times and the rumination behavior duration of the sheep in the time period; and (3) enabling the lower computer to upload the statistical information to an upper computer server every 24 hours, enabling the upper computer server to store the data into a database and judges whether the sheep are in a healthy state or not according to the sheep information of the day, and if the sheep are judged to be in an unhealthy state, enabling the upper computer server to send the sheep number to a mobile phone of a sheep farm administrator in a short message mode.

title: Growth monitoring device for broiler weight management reaching slaughter weight
abstract: Provided is a breeding environment monitoring device to display a schedule to reach a target weight of individuals. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the breeding environment monitoring device comprises: a display screen; and a processor configured to display, through the display screen, a first input box for receiving a target weight of an object, the average weight of the individual by day on a first graph, and the average weight by day of the individual and the expected shipment date when the average weight by day of the individual is expected to reach the target weight. The processor performs control of displaying the date on the first axis of the first graph and displaying the average weight on the second axis. The processor performs control of displaying the average weight by day of at least one individual on the first graph as a selectable mark and displaying distribution data for the selected average weight by each day as a second graph when the mark is selected.

The present invention provides a means for solving problems that may occur when an abnormality occurs in a system for controlling a growth environment of animals and plants through remote control or automatic control in an existing livestock shed or a smart farm facility. According to the present invention, a livestock shed safety apparatus comprises: a livestock shed environment control device including a central controller which receives environmental information from an indoor environment sensor and outdoor environment sensor for controlling an environment of the livestock shed to control an air purifier, a ventilation fan, a heater, and a sprinkler to control the environment inside the livestock shed; a power monitoring unit monitoring power consumption of the livestock environment control device; a switchgear control unit shutting off any one or more of the ventilation fan, the heater, and the sprinkler of the livestock environment control device when the power consumption in the power monitoring unit increases rapidly or a power consumption pattern is unstable; and a life support device operated when the power of at least one of the ventilation fan, the heater, and the sprinkler is cut off by the switchgear control unit. The life support device controls operation of any one or more of a low-temperature planar heating element, a heating bulb, and a cooling water supply device. Accordingly, the solves a problem that the existing safety device through power monitoring has only a function of simply shutting off power to be not suitable for agricultural facilities, thereby providing an effect of providing a means for enabling plants and animals to sustain life in any case.

title: Lamb nest weighing equipment
abstract: The invention discloses lamb nest weighing equipment. The equipment comprises an equipment main body structure metal framework, a birth lamb movable barrel, a weight sensor, a first RFID radio frequency card reader antenna, a second RFID radio frequency card reader antenna, an openable and closable birth lamb barrel outlet door, an equipment meter head and a resistance type touch display screen, an STM32 core control board, a battery pack, an RFID radio frequency card reader core control board and a GRPS/WLAN/LAN communication module are configured in the equipment meter head, and a resistivetouch display screen is configured on a front panel of the equipment meter head. The nest weighing device is convenient to use, errors can be reduced to the maximum extent, it is guaranteed that sheepweighing data are accurate, the tablet device is connected with the nest weighing device, nest weighing data are collected, an intelligent RFID hardware device is combined, a whole set of informationdata collection mechanism is established, operation is easy and convenient, and higher use requirements of modern agricultural breeding are met.
applicants: ANHUI RAYBACA INTERNET OF THINGS TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Method and device for detecting the state of livestock
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and device for detecting the state of livestock. One specific embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring sound data obtained by acquiring sound of target livestock; detecting the acquired sound data by using a pre-trained sound detection model to obtain a first detection result, the first detection result being used for indicating whether the sound data includes oestrus sound data; and generating a target result used for indicating whether the target livestock is oestrus or not based on the first detection result. According to the embodiment, the real-time performance and accuracy of oestrus state discovery can be improved, the labor cost can be reduced, and the efficiency of livestock oestrus state detection can beimproved.
applicants: BEIJING HAIYI TONGZHAN INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Intelligent pasture management system
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent pasture management system. The system comprises positioning devices which are worn by livestock in a pasture and used for indicating real-time positions of the worn livestock through wireless connection; and a display terminal used for carrying out centralized display on a pasture map according to the real-time position transmitted by each positioning device.According to the intelligent pasture management system provided by the invention, the positions of the livestock can be known in real time, and the management efficiency is improved. The intelligent pasture management system provided by the invention further integrates a herdsman management module, a veterinarian management module, a feeding knowledge management module, a disease knowledge management module and/or a diagnosis and treatment management module, and thus relevant information of the pasture is comprehensively managed.
applicants: XILINGOL LEAGUE TANSHI AGRICULTURE AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Multifunctional solar-powered monitoring physiotherapy equipment for disease control of livestock during livestock breeding
abstract: The invention discloses multifunctional solar-powered monitoring physiotherapy equipment for disease control of livestock during livestock breeding, and specifically relates to the technical field oflivestock medical equipment. The equipment includes a front bottom plate, wherein a rear bottom plate is fixedly arranged on the rear side of the front bottom plate, a monitoring cage is fixedly arranged on the top of the front bottom plate, and a sorting cage is fixedly arranged on the top of the rear bottom plate; and the monitoring cage communicates with the interior of the sorting cage, nursing windows are fixedly formed in both sides of the monitoring cage, and infrared body-temperature measuring instruments are fixedly arranged on the tops of the nursing windows. Rotation of a rotating shaft is realized through a swing rod which is driven through expansion and retraction of an electric-hydraulic push rod, rotation of a sorting rotary plate is achieved through cooperation with a fixing rack, two ends of the sorting cage communicate with the monitoring cage selectively, and livestock leave from the end part of the sorting cage along a pre-set path, so that healthy livestock and sick livestock are distinguished conveniently with adoption of the monitoring cage and the sorting cage, the efficiency of livestock disease control is improved, and treatment of livestock is facilitated.
applicants: SHANXI CENTER FOR ANIMAL EPIDEMIC DISEASE CONTROL AND PREVENTION

title: Intelligent pasture management system
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent pasture management system which comprises a first RFID reader-writer, a first electric switch, a controller, wireless terminal equipment and a server. The controller controls the working state of the first RFID reader-writer by controlling the conduction state of the first electric switch, and communicates with a server through wireless terminal equipment; the first RFID reader-writer is used for identifying RFID electronic ear tags carried by livestock and sending first identification data to the server through the controller, and the server checks thetypes and the number of the livestock according to the first identification data. An epidemic prevention monitoring module is arranged in the server and used for storing epidemic prevention data, editing the epidemic prevention data and feeding back the epidemic prevention data to the preset terminal. According to the system, the epidemic prevention enthusiasm of epidemic prevention personnel canbe improved, the supervision department can conveniently and effectively supervise the pasture epidemic prevention situation, concealment, false report and false report of epidemic prevention data areeffectively avoided, and a processing factory can easily judge whether the epidemic prevention situation of livestock meets the epidemic prevention standard.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA HEMUER NETWORK TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Ear tag module
abstract: An ear tag module includes a rod member, a spike, a circuit component, and a temperature sensor. The spike is disposed on one side of the rod member, and the circuit component is disposed on another side of the rod member. The temperature sensor is electrically connected to the circuit component. When the spike penetrates an ear, the ear is in contact with a sensing area of the rod member, and the temperature sensor is located in the rod member to detect a temperature of the ear and transmit at least one temperature sensing information to the circuit component.

title: Automatic feeder, system and method based on pig face recognition technology
abstract: The invention provides an automatic feeder, system and method based on a pig face recognition technology. The automatic feeder comprises a food storage barrel, wherein a guide pipe is arranged at thebottom end of the food storage barrel; a valve and a recognition device for recognizing pig faces are arranged on the guide pipe, and a trough is arranged at the bottom end of the guide pipe; the recognition device is used for recognizing a pig face image, determining the feeding quantity and the feeding frequency of the current pig and judging whether the current pig needs to feed or not; the automatic feeding system is formed by connecting the multiple automatic feeders in parallel; and each automatic feeder corresponds to one feeding channel, and automatic feeding can be achieved accordingto the pig face recognition result. An intelligent breeding service platform based on pig face recognition is built, a set of full-process, full-chain and full-ecological pig face recognition automatic feeding system is created, the problems of high waste, high pollution and high energy consumption in the pig breeding process are solved, and the breeding cost is reduced for small and medium-scalebreeding enterprises.
applicants: BEIJING YIKEXIAOSHU AGRICULTURAL TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT COMPANY; UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title: Ear tag
abstract: The invention discloses an ear tag. The ear tag comprises a temperature sensing assembly, a main ear tag body and an auxiliary ear tag body, wherein the main ear tag body comprises a shell with a mounting cavity and a main needle connected with the shell; the main needle is inserted into the auxiliary ear tag body; a through hole communicated with the mounting cavity is formed in the side, opposite to the auxiliary ear tag body, of the shell; the temperature sensing assembly penetrates through the through hole; and the detection end of the temperature sensing assembly is located outside the shell, and the temperature sensing assembly can move in a direction of being close to or far from the auxiliary ear tag body relative to the shell. According to the technical scheme, the temperature sensing assembly makes contact with the tragus of an animal to be detected to detect sign data of the animal, the main needle penetrates through the tragus to enable the tragus to be clamped between theauxiliary ear tag and the shell; the detection end of the temperature sensing assembly abuts against the inner side of the tragus to detect sign data of an animal, and when the animal is in a moving state or a movable ear state, the temperature sensing assembly can move in the direction of being close to or away from the auxiliary ear tag relative to the shell, that is, the temperature sensing assembly keeps abutting against the inner side of the tragus to guarantee the accuracy of the detection data and achieve continuous monitoring.

title: Fastening device for monitoring livestock
abstract: The present invention relates to a fastening device for monitoring livestock, and more specifically, to a fastening device which is attached to the body of livestock to monitor a health state of the livestock. The present invention is stably fixed and attached to the body of livestock and is configured to: collect biological signals related to a health state of livestock through a sensor unit and generates sensing information; and transmit the corresponding sensing information to an external device that manages livestock so as to support the external device to identify the livestock based on an identifier included in the corresponding sensing information and to check a health state of the livestock through sensing signals of the corresponding sensing information. Accordingly, the fastening device for monitoring livestock can support a user to easily identify a health state of livestock that is grazing according to each livestock, thereby increasing efficiency in management of livestock and providing more accurate information about the health state of livestock through sensors attached to various parts of the body of the livestock.

title: Air cushion device, system and method for determining lameness and weight monitoring
abstract: The present invention relates to a farming/veterinary device, system, and method for sensing force to analyze the stance of an animal or human to determine lameness and total weight monitoring. The invention is directed to an air cushion device for determining lameness and total weight management for animals with an air cushion for each animal leg which will enable the system to determine the force exerted on each air cushion. Optimally, the air cushion device is waterproof. The system is directed to incorporating the air cushion device with an air supply system and sensor system to automatically determine lameness and total weight in animals. The method is directed to a procedure for using the air cushion system to determine lameness and total weight in animals. Because implementations of the device are waterproof, it is suitable for use in any type of wet or dirty environment. Further, due to making the determinations while the animal is standing still, the device is capable of on-site installation in areas of the farm such as milking stalls, cattle chutes, and other small areas in which the animal is used to being.

title: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY CONTROL SYSTEM, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY CONTROL SERVER, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY CONTROL METHOD, AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY CONTROL PROGRAM
abstract: To provide an animal husbandry control system, an animal husbandry control server, an animal husbandry control method, and an animal husbandry control program that control an appropriate feeding environment in accordance with facility capabilities and the like of a barn.SOLUTION: In an animal husbandry control system 1, an animal husbandry control server 101 comprises: a barn measurement device 511 for obtaining feeding environment information of a barn 501; a barn device 512 for adjusting feeding environments of the barn; and an analysis unit 111 for generating a feeding environment parameter serving as information of a target environment of the barn 501 using the feeding environment information obtained by the barn measurement device. When the obtained feeding environment information is determined not to satisfy a predetermined condition after the lapse of a predetermined time from the start of control of the barn device 512 in accordance with a first feeding environment parameter, the analysis unit 111 can generate a second feeding environment parameter.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Methods and systems for using sound data to analyze health condition and welfare states in collections of farm animals
abstract: Systems and methods are described for selecting a sound type of interest from a first (e.g., master/global) machine learning library comprising information derived from reference audio stream data acquired from a plurality of farm animal operation reference sound monitoring events, including from a first farm animal operation monitoring event of a first farm animal operation, wherein the sound type of interest is associated with a condition state of interest of a first collection of farm animals. Further, information associated with the selected sound type of interest can be included a second machine learning library, wherein the second machine learning library is operational on an edge computing device located in proximity to a second farm animal operation. Audio stream data can be acquired from the second farm animal operation in a second farm animal operation monitoring event, and processed using the second machine learning library information to determine whether the sound type of interest is present in the acquired audio stream data, thereby generating information associated with the presence or absence of the condition during the second farm animal operation monitoring event.
applicants: Aglogica Holdings Inc; AgLogica Holdings, Inc.

title: Sheep feed measuring system
abstract: The invention discloses a sheep feed measuring system. The systemcomprises a PLC host, a feed trough and a bearing flat plate, wherein a control panel and a wireless receiver are arranged in the PLC host; a temperature and humidity sensor is fixed in the center of the bottom of the feed trough; a first weighing sensor is mounted at the bottom end of the feed trough; sliding grooves are fixed in the left side and the right side of the bottom end of the first weighing sensor; an RFID reader-writer is mounted on the outer wall of the right side of the feed trough; and thebearing flat plate is horizontally arranged on the right side of the feed trough, wireless transmitters are fixed to the centers of the bottom ends of the first weighing sensor and the bearing flat plate correspondingly, second weighing sensors are fixed to the corners of the bottom end of the bearing flat plate correspondingly, and brackets are arranged on the left sides and the right sides of the second weighing sensorscorrespondingly. According to the sheep feed measuring system, the quality and the conversion rate of the sheep feed can be displayed in a classified mode, the measuring effect of the sheep feed is enhanced, and the assembling and maintaining efficiency of related assemblies is improved.
applicants: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY BRANCH, HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: ANIMAL INFORMATION MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND ANIMAL INFORMATION MANAGEMENT METHOD
abstract: An animal information management system (100) includes a storage (24) and an information processor (22). The information processor (22) causes an imaging device (10) to perform tracking imaging of a pig (80), and accumulates still pictures including the pig (80) in the storage (24), the still pictures being obtained during the tracking imaging. The information processor (22) brings the imaging device (10) into a zoom-in state having a zooming magnification higher than that during the tracking imaging when a predetermined requirement for the accumulated still pictures is satisfied, obtains the identification information of the pig (80) by causing the imaging device (10) in the zoom-in state to capture an image of the pig (80), and stores the identification information in the storage (24), in association with the accumulated still pictures.

title: Method for Detecting Livestock Abnormal Signs in a Farm by Monitoring Activity Energy based on the Sound of Livestock Behavior
abstract: Provided is a method for detecting abnormal symptoms of livestock in a farm by activity energy monitoring based on physiological sound of livestock behavior. The livestock monitoring method according to an embodiment of the present invention collects the physiological sound of livestock behavior, calculates the activity energy from the collected physiological sound of livestock behavior, and predicts a health status of the livestock based on the calculated active energy. Accordingly, it is possible to detect and monitor the activity energy of small animals (chickens, ducks, and the like) which are difficult to directly mount a device such as an activity detection terminal.

title: Cow health monitoring system and method based on gait recognition
abstract: The invention relates to a cow health monitoring system and method based on gait recognition. The system comprises image collection equipment which is used for collecting a walking image of a cow, a storage device which is used for storing the ID of each dairy cow and the morphological characteristics and standard gait characteristics of each dairy cow, a controller which is used for extracting monitored morphological characteristics and actually measured gait characteristics of the dairy cow from the walking images of the dairy cow acquired by the image collection equipment, comparing the monitored actual measurement gait characteristics of the dairy cow with the corresponding standard gait characteristics, and inputting a comparison result into a trained health state prediction model toacquire a health state prediction result, output by the health state prediction model, of the dairy cow, and alarm equipment which is used for sending an alarm signal when the health state predictionresult reaches a preset alarm condition. According to the invention, the health state of the dairy cow is accurately predicted based on the health prediction model, the accuracy and efficiency of dairy cow health monitoring are improved, and the burden of manual observation is greatly reduced.

title: Sheep farm data intelligent acquisition and management integrated system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a sheep farm data intelligent acquisition and management integrated system and method. The system comprises a ewe multi-fetus monitoring module, a staged intelligent weighing module and a grouping fine management module, wherein the staged intelligent weighing module comprises an animal house, an intelligent weighing unit and a transition channel communicated between the animal house and the intelligent weighing unit, and the grouping fine management module comprises a grouping data processing unit, a grouping execution unit and a fine management unit which are in communication connection with the intelligent monitoring unit and the weighing indication device. The system and method can be used for application scenarios such as breeding ewe multiparous monitoring andprecise management, backup sheep and fattening sheep staged intelligent weighing and data management, core breeding field production performance measurement and genetic evaluation, intelligent weighing and grouping management and the like.

title: Method for identifying estrus behaviors of ruminant based on artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention discloses a method for identifying estrus behaviors of a ruminant based on artificial intelligence and relates to the technical field of estrus monitoring of ruminants. The method comprises the following steps: A. photographing a picture of the ruminant from a top view angle, and marking the ruminant in the picture; B. processing the picture by using a few-sample learning method, soas to establish an evaluation prediction model; C. acquiring video data on the ruminant by using a picture pickup device, marking the ruminant in the video data, and then, analyzing behaviors of the ruminant in the video data by using the evaluation prediction model; and D. determining whether the ruminant is in estrus or not according to the analysis result. According to the method for identifying the estrus behaviors of the ruminant based on the artificial intelligence, provided by the invention, a large number of ruminants can be monitored simultaneously; and compared with the existing methods, the accuracy of identification can be improved substantially, and the use cost is reduced.

title: Multi-angle monitoring and dirt cleaning device for animal husbandry
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of animal husbandry, and discloses a multi-angle monitoring and dirt cleaning device for animal husbandry. The device comprises a shell I and a shell II, wherein a photovoltaic panel is movably connected to the outer part of the shell I, a connecting rod I is movably connected to the inner part of the shell I, a spring I is movably connected to the exterior of the connecting rod I, a rotating wheel I is movably connected to the exterior of the spring I, a rotating wheel II is movably connected to the exterior of the rotating wheel I, and a buckle ismovably connected to the exterior of the rotating wheel II; under the interaction of the shell I, photovoltaic panel, connecting rod I, spring I, rotating wheel I, rotating wheel II, buckle, shell III and monitor, the photovoltaic panel in the device can provide electric power for electric equipment such as the monitor, so that the use stability of the device is greatly guaranteed; and furthermore, due to transmission between the structures, the monitor can rotate around the outside of the shell I, so that multi-angle monitoring of the monitor can be realized.

title: Smart cattle reproduction management and digital farm to market transparency metrics
abstract: A method of smart cattle reproduction management and digital farm to market transparency metrics tracks, monitors, and predicts reproductive efficiency, providing actionable information that allows the cattle rancher to optimize operations to ensure a high calf crop percentage. Using conventional ear tags to track and monitor the location, temperature, and movement of each animal in the herd, a highly accurate and data-driven reproductive performance score may be calculated for open heifers, cows, and bulls, thereby allowing actions to be taken to enhance reproductive efficiency. In addition, given the high risk of losing a heifer during calving, a method provides a means to detect, in advance and remotely, when a pregnant heifer is about to start calving to allow the cattle rancher to go on site, locate the animal, and provide any veterinary assistance that may be required should the delivery be difficult.

title: Pig movement monitoring method and feeding fence
abstract: The invention discloses a pig movement monitoring method and a feeding fence. The method comprises the steps that first signals sent by at least two sensors of a plurality of sensors installed in a feeding fence are obtained, and the sensors are used for monitoring the motion state of pigs in the feeding fence; under the condition that first signals sent by two adjacent sensors in the multiple sensors are obtained, the numerical value of the counter corresponding to the feeding fence is increased by 1, and a first numerical value is obtained; under the condition that the first numerical valueof the counter is smaller than a first threshold value or the first numerical value is larger than a second threshold value within a preset time period, warning information is sent, the warning information is used for prompting that the motion state of the pigs in the feeding fence is abnormal, and the first threshold value is smaller than the second threshold value. The technical problem that theefficiency of obtaining or supervising the motion state of the pig is low is solved.

title: Monitoring system for health condition of suckling pig
abstract: The invention provides a monitoring system for the health condition of a suckling pig. The system comprises data acquisition equipment, an information processing system, a transmission layer, a cloudserver and monitoring equipment. The data such as the diet, drinking condition, activity condition, mental state and body temperature condition of the suckling pig are monitored, comparison processingis carried out on the information processing system, the processed information is uploaded to the cloud server, and then the health condition is checked on the monitoring equipment.

title: Yak estrus information determination method and system, storage medium, program and terminal
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of information detection, and discloses a yak estrus information determination method and system, a storage medium, a program and a terminal. The method comprises the steps: learning the number of steps and an activity track of a yak under a normal condition from the start of operation of a pedometer system to the start of hybridization of a first yak;judging the oestrus yak in the estrus period, and starting to judge when the step number and the track are abnormal after the pedometer system results are systematically learned. The yak estrus information determination system comprises an information learning module used for learning the number of steps and the activity track of the yak under a normal condition from the beginning of operation ofthe pedometer system to the beginning of hybridization of the first yak, and an information judgment module which is used for judging the oestrus cattle in the estrus period and starting judgment whenthe step number and the track are abnormal after the pedometer system results are systematically learned. According to the method, the yak oestrus identification accuracy is improved, and basic cow herds are well managed; and occurrence of wolf damage can be determined. Meanwhile, the oestrus cows at night can be accurately judged.

title: Large-area epidemic situation detection system for indoor pig farm
abstract: The invention discloses a large-area epidemic situation detection system for an indoor pig farm, and the system comprises: ear tags which are disposed on the ears of each pig, and record the identityinformation of each pig in a mode of a two-dimensional code; a rail-mounted robot which is erected on the upper portion in the pig farm through a rail and used for collecting state video data of eachpig; a manipulator group which is erected at the upper part in the pig farm through a track and is used for driving and directionally catching pigs; and an intelligent terminal which is internally provided with a data post-processing system, adopts an ssd _ Inception _ V3 _ model to analyze the pig state based on the historical pig ill-conditioned image set, and outputs the current state information of each pig. Large-area automatic quarantine of pigs in a pig farm is achieved, time and labor are saved, and meanwhile compared with manual quarantine, the precision is higher.

title: Healthy breeding fence for replacement gilts
abstract: The invention discloses a healthy breeding fence for replacement gilts. The healthy breeding fence comprises a breeding fence module, an estrus monitoring module, an automatic feeding module, a periodic cleaning module, a data processing system and a control module, wherein the breeding fence module comprises two rows of breeding fences which are oppositely arranged and a transfer channel which islocated between the two rows of breeding fences; each row of breeding fences comprises a plurality of breeding units; a feeding area, a defecation area and a leisure and entertainment area are arranged in each breeding unit; the estrus monitoring module comprises a temperature detection module and an activity amount detection module; the temperature detection module and the activity amount detection module are arranged in each corresponding breeding unit; the automatic feeding module and the periodic cleaning module are arranged in the corresponding breeding units; the data processing systemcomprises a data storage module and a data analysis module which are in signal connection; the data storage module is in signal connection with the temperature detection module, the activity amount detection module and the automatic feeding device; and the control module is in signal connection with a control valve, the automatic feeding device, a cleaning unit, the data storage module and the data analysis module.
applicants: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY BRANCH OF HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Low-power-consumption livestock motion monitoring and positioning device, implementation method and client thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a low-power-consumption livestock motion monitoring and positioning device, an implementation method and a client thereof. The device comprises a shell, wherein a processing module, a positioning module, an acceleration module, a communication module and a power module are arranged in the shell; the processing module is used for enabling the livestock motion monitoring andpositioning device to operate in a corresponding operation mode according to an instruction of the client; and the operation mode comprises a standby mode and a tracing mode. The device has the characteristics of low energy consumption, capability of opening/closing the positioning module as required and long standby time, ensures accuracy and stability in a working process, and can truly achievean extremely low power consumption and ultra-long working mode. All links of the low-power-consumption implementation method can be tightly connected with the client, accurate positioning informationand motion amount information are fed back in time, and control is convenient and simple. The received data is integrated through a client cloud platform, so that data visualization is realized in anomnibearing manner.
applicants: TIANJIN CALINO IOT TECHNOLOGY INDUSTRY DEVELOPMENT COMPANY

title: LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, LEARNING DEVICE, AND INFERENCE DEVICE
abstract: A livestock management system (10) in which a livestock management device (50) and an infrared sensor (31) are connected over a network (40). The livestock management device uses the behavior of livestock in a barn that has a rearing area in which the livestock are reared to manage the state of the livestock, and the infrared sensor is provided in the barn, detects the temperature of the rearing area, and transmits detection results to the livestock management device. The livestock management device comprises a livestock state calculation unit (53), an abnormal individual determination unit (55), and a reporting unit (56). On the basis of information that indicates a temperature distribution for the rearing area generated using detection results from the infrared sensor, the livestock state calculation unit generates livestock state information that includes location information or body temperature information for the livestock in the rearing area and the time at which detection results were acquired from the infrared sensor. On the basis of the livestock state information, the abnormal individual determination unit determines abnormal individuals among the livestock whose behavior is different from normal individuals whose behavior is normal. When there is an abnormal individual, the reporting unit reports abnormal individual information to a user, the abnormal individual information indicating that there is an abnormal individual in the barn.

title: Intelligent livestock electronic feeding system based on Internet of Things and working method of intelligent livestock electronic feeding system
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent livestock electronic feeding system based on an Internet of Things and a working method of the intelligent livestock electronic feeding system. The intelligent livestock electronic feeding system comprises a cloud server platform, wherein the cloud server platform is connected with a third party database, an operation end and an Internet of Things intelligentgateway; an Internet of Things electronic ear tag recognizing end is connected with a cloud server, the Internet of Things intelligent gateway is connected with main machines of electronic feeders, the main machine of each electronic feeder is connected with a sub machine of the corresponding electronic feeder, and the Internet of Things electronic ear tag recognizing end is connected with an electronic ear tag. The individual identity information of livestock is bound with the ID of the main machine of each electronic feeder and the ID of the sub machine of the corresponding electronic feederin a breeding farm, the cloud server platform, the Internet of Things intelligent gateway, the main machine of each electronic feeder and the corresponding sub machine of the corresponding electronicfeeder are used, so that a feeding plan is stored in the cloud server platform, the feeding plan is issued to the main machine of each electronic feeder, intelligent feeding control is realized, later stage collected feeding parameters are combined with an artificial intelligence algorithm, and the feeding plan can be updated timely.

title: A SYSTEM AND A METHOD FOR LIVESTOCK MONITORING
abstract: The present invention provides a method and a system for monitoring the mobility levels of individual farm animals and accordingly determining their corresponding mobility score. The mobility score may be indicative of the health and/or welfare status of the animals. The present invention processes a 2D video recording obtained from an imaging device to detect the movement of individual animals through a space. The video recording is segmented over a set of individual frames and in each frame the individual instances of the animal appearing in the vide frame are detected. The detected instances of each animal over a number of frames are grouped together. From each detected instance of an individual animal a set of reference points are extracted. The reference points are associated with location on the animal body. The present invention determines the mobility score of each animal by monitoring the relative position between reference points in each frame and the relative position of each reference point across the set of individual frames associated with an animal

title: Hog house gas detection alarm system and method
abstract: The invention relates to a hog house gas detection alarm system and a method thereof. The system comprises a wall body, a top cover, lighting and ventilating windows, a colony house and supporting beams. Monitors are fixed at four corners of the wall body; the monitors are connected with a master control system module; the master control system module comprises a monitoring module used for monitoring behaviors and sounds of pigs, a behavior analysis module and a sound processing module which acquire the pig cough condition in the pig house, an image processing module which analyzes abnormal behaviors of the pigs, a gas detection module which detects the gas concentration of the colony house, an alarm module which controls a NH3 alarm lamp and a CO2 alarm lamp, an atomization module which sprays atomized water vapor to absorb toxic gas and cool the pig house at the same time, a telescopic module which controls a first electric telescopic rod to ascend and descend the pig house for ventilation and controls a second electric telescopic rod to ascend and descend the gas monitor so that the gas generation position can be accurately determined, and a fan module which controls an exhaustfan to be turned on and the power of the exhaust fan to realize effective ventilation and energy conservation.

title: Cow behavior detection necklace and detection method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a cow behavior detection necklace. The cow behavior detection necklace is worn on the neck of a cow and used for detecting the lying, standing and climbing behaviors of the cow, and the cow behavior detection necklace comprises a necklace body, a distance measuring sensor, a controller and a wireless communication module. The distance measuring sensor is arranged in the necklace body and used for detecting the height from the cow behavior detection necklace worn on the neck of the cow to a detection reference surface when the cow lies, stands or climbs in real time; the controller is used for receiving the height value detected by the distance measuring sensor in real time, comparing the height value with a reference value and judging the lying, standing or climbing state of the cow; and the wireless communication module is used for sending the judgment result to a user system.

title: Cow behavior detection necklace and detection method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a cow behavior detection necklace and a detection method thereof. Basic data acquisition is realized through the necklace worn on a cow. According to the cow behavior detection necklace and the detection method thereof, the necklace can realize basic data acquisition only by one barometer, the size of the necklace is reduced, the load of the cow is reduced, and calculation is carried out through data acquired by the barometer. The behavior of the cow is judged by utilizing the relative air pressure difference, errors caused by environmental factors are avoided, the behavior of the cow is accurately identified, and therefore accurate guidance is provided for improving the yield of a cattle farm.

title: WEIGHT ESTIMATION SYSTEM, WEIGHT ESTIMATION METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: A weight estimation system (10) comprises: an imaging unit (21) that captures an image of the inside of a poultry house; a calculation unit (32a) that calculates, through image processing of the image captured by the imaging unit (21), a group behavior feature amount of poultry inside the poultry house; and an estimation unit (32b) that estimates the weight of the poultry inside the poultry house on the basis of the calculated group behavior feature amount.

title: A Method for Measuring Abdominal Fat Content in Poultry by Ultrasonic Technology
abstract: Abstract of Description The present invention relates to a method for measuring abdominal fat content in poultry by ultrasonic technology: select individuals to weigh and disinfect, remove feathers from an abdominal area to be measured, measure the abdominal area by ultrasonic instrument and collect image data, analyze image data, and establish regression equation and calculate abdominal fat weight of chicken. The present invention uses ultrasonic penetrating imaging technology to accurately and effectively collect image data of abdominal fat in poultry, which can effectively solve the problem of live measurement of abdominal fat content in poultry. The present invention can also dynamically observe the variation law of abdominal fat deposition in poultry individual. The present invention meets the requirements of scientific research and breeding practice, and greatly reduces the cost of measuring abdominal fat content. title: Breeding house image big data acquisition and analysis method based on livestock image semantic perception
abstract: The invention discloses a breeding house image big data acquisition and analysis method based on livestock image semantic perception. The method comprises the steps of constructing a breeding house building information model; training a livestock key point extraction network; and superposing livestock key point thermodynamic diagrams of continuous frames, performing thresholding processing and proportion analysis on an added thermodynamic diagram result, outputting a camera real-time refresh rate grade, adjusting a camera refresh rate in real time according to the grade, performing image acquisition, performing image splicing, and performing visual display on a building information model on a Web page. By means of the animal husbandry image acquisition system and method, intelligent animalhusbandry image acquisition is achieved, the livestock animal detection and analysis precision is improved, the camera power consumption is reduced, and model visualization results are richer.

title: Limiting fence pig posture recognition method and system based on laser positioning
abstract: The invention discloses a limiting fence pig posture recognition method based on laser positioning. According to the method, two line-shaped laser emitters are adopted, a certain height difference orangle difference exists between the laser emitters, horizontal lasers are emitted at the same time, laser line segments are imaged on the back of a pig and the floor, and the pigs in the limiting fences are positioned through the imaging line segments on the pig backs and the floors. Pig image data are collected through a camera over the limiting fence and transmitted to an image processing module, the image processing module mainly completes preprocessing of the image data, laser line segment positioning and pig posture judgment, finally, the pig posture data obtained through processing are transmitted to a server, and finally client side display is carried out. By means of the pig posture recognition method, rapid and effective pig posture recognition can be achieved, and data support isprovided for accurate pig management.

title: Smart barn system and control method for detecting abnormal signs of livestock
abstract: Provided are a smart barn system capable of detecting an abnormal sign of a domestic animal. The present invention comprises: a plurality of tags attached to ears of domestic animals bred in a pigsty and configured to measure temperatures of the domestic animals and transmit the measured temperature information of the domestic animals; a plurality of antennas configured to transmit and receive wireless signals to and from the tags; a reader configured to collect tag information of the domestic animals, which approach an apparatus for providing feed and water, through any one of the plurality of antennas and measure an access frequency of the tag, which is collected through each of the antennas, through the collected tag information of the domestic animals; and a plurality of wireless power switching modules provided between the antennas and the reader and connected in a cascade.

title: Intelligent collar for judging estrus of deer and judgment method
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent collar for judging an estrus of a deer and a judgment method. The intelligent collar comprises the deer, an intelligent collar body, a wireless communication module and a use terminal, wherein the intelligent collar body, the wireless communication module and the use terminal are worn on the neck of the deer. The intelligent collar is characterized in that anintelligent monitoring module, a power supply module and a positioning device are integrated in the intelligent collar body, the power supply module is connected with the intelligent monitoring module, one end of the wireless communication module is connected with the monitoring module, the other end of the wireless communication module is connected with the use terminal, a snapping buckle is arranged outside the intelligent collar body, and the intelligent collar body is worn to the neck of the deer through the snapping buckle. The intelligent collar has the beneficial effects that a physiological state or pregnant state of the deer is evaluated comprehensively, thus, the determining of the estrus of the deer is facilitated, and a state of health of the deer can also be reflected; and the workload is reduced, meanwhile, the success rate of propagation is increased, the cost of culture is reduced, and the benefit of culture is improved.
applicants: HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF LAND RECLAMATION SCIENCES

title: Animal feeding motor home
abstract: The invention relates to an animal feeding motor home. The animal feeding motor home comprises a box body, a movable device, a controller, a plurality of sensing monitoring devices, a hydraulic fixingdevice, an automatic feeding device, a spraying device, a milking health-care breeding operation window, an excrement discharging device and the like, wherein the box body is provided with a plurality of rooms; the hydraulic fixing device is arranged in each room; animals to be fed are placed in the rooms; the movable device is arranged at the bottom of the box body; the sensing monitoring devices, the automatic feeding device, the spraying device, the milking health-care breeding operation window and the excrement discharging device are arranged in the rooms; the controller is connected withthe sensing monitoring devices, the automatic feeding device and the spraying device respectively; and the excrement discharging device is used for discharging excrement of the animals to be fed in acentralized manner; and the milking health-care breeding operation window is used for carrying out milking, health-care and breeding operation on the animals to be fed. By the feeding motor home, automatic intelligent integrated breeding of the animals to be fed is realized, the breeding and management efficiency is improved, and effects of saving resources and protecting the environment can be achieved.

title: Big data-based pig breeding and growth health intelligent detection and management system
abstract: The invention discloses a big data-based pig breeding and growth health intelligent detection and management system. The system comprises an identity label recognition module, an intelligent weight detection module and a health management analysis module, wherein the identity label recognition module is used to wear label boards for all pigs in a pig breeding area, the intelligent detection moduleis used to weigh the pigs wearing the label boards in a weighing area, and the health management analysis module is used to analyze the growth health of each obtained pig. The present invention provides the big data-based pig breeding and growth health intelligent detection and management system, by arrangement of the weighing area in the breeding area, when the pigs enter the weighing area, thesystem collects and displays the weight parameters of the pigs entering the weighing area, the weight of each pig is solved according to a weight equation, rapid and effective weighing of the pigs isrealized, the weighing accuracy is improved, and a lot of labor costs are reduced.

title: Sow health monitoring system
abstract: The invention provides a sow oestrus and health monitoring system. The sow oestrus and health monitoring system comprises an automatic feeding station, an RFID tag, an intelligent leg ring, a LoRa gateway, a cloud computing platform and an information terminal, is characterized in that the automatic feeding station and the intelligent leg ring collect sow activity data, upload the sow activity data to a behavior record relay, then upload the sow activity data to the LoRa gateway, and finally transmit the sow activity data to the cloud computing platform. A database of the cloud computing platform records data and manages user permission. The information terminal may obtain data from the cloud computing platform and may alter data located in the database or the behavior record relay according to user rights. By adopting the monitoring method, a better feeding condition can be provided for each sow, the number of non-production days of the sow is reduced, the production efficiency of sow breeding is improved, the experience accumulation demand of workers is reduced, and the human resource cost is saved.

title: Automatic pig farm inspection system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of pig farm inspection, in particular to an automatic pig farm inspection system.
