The automatic pig farm inspection system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle device, a UWB positioning system, an information acquisition device, an application terminal and a background server, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle device comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, and a processor and a memory card which are respectively arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle body; the UWB positioning system comprises a UWB positioning label arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle body and a plurality of base stations arranged in a pig farm; the information acquisition device comprises a camera and an infrared thermal imager, and the camera and the infrared thermalimager are respectively arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle device; the application terminal is connected with the memory card, and the background server is connected with the application terminal. The system can automatically inspect the pig farm, thereby recording the number and body temperature of live pigs, effectively monitoring the health condition of the live pigs, saving manpower andmaterial resources, improving the working efficiency, and facilitating the daily management of the large-scale pig farm.

title: Automatic control system for cattle house
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic control system for a cattle house. A containing box is arranged in the cattle house, a data acquisition unit, a PLC data control unit and an internet data analysis platform are arranged in the containing box, the data acquisition unit acquires data in the cattle house and transmits the acquired information to the PLC data control unit, the PLC data control unit transmits collected environment parameters of the cattle house to the internet data analysis platform, and the internet data analysis platform transmits collected signals to an air supply mechanism, a lighting mechanism, a spraying mechanism and a roller shutter mechanism respectively. According to the automatic control system for the cattle house, the Internet of Things technology is combined with breeding industry, a farmer can perceive the breeding environment problem in the first time, so that remedy is made in time, the growth environment of cattle is always kept in the optimal state, the body health and rapid growth of the cattle are ensured, and the labor cost is greatly reduced through remote data monitoring and automatic control of the cattle house.

title: Animal food intake monitoring method, animal food intake monitoring system and intelligent ear tag
abstract: The invention relates to an animal food intake monitoring method, an animal food intake monitoring system and an intelligent ear tag. The animal food intake monitoring method comprises the following steps that (1) when an animal approaches a wireless charging transmitter positioned in a feeding area, a wireless charging coil fixed in the ear tag of the animal receives an electromagnetic signal ofthe wireless charging transmitter, and converts the electromagnetic signal into a voltage signal; and after the voltage signal is processed, electric power is supplied to the ear tag; and (2) a computer system acquires the voltage signal; when the voltage value of the voltage signal exceeds a voltage value set by the computer system, the computer system acquires movement information of the head ofthe animal, and the computer control system obtains the food intake of the animal according to the movement information of the ears of the animal. The organic combination of magnetic resonance wireless charging and food intake detection is realized; acquisition of animal food intake key data is realized; and automatic charging and energy storage of the intelligent ear tag are realized.

title: Livestock monitoring device with anesthesia function
abstract: A livestock monitoring device with an anesthesia function comprises a base and a movable shell arranged on the upper side of the base, wherein a movable cavity is formed in the movable shell, an electric sliding rail is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the movable cavity, a spring is arranged on the upper side of the electric sliding rail in a sliding mode, the spring is fixedly connected with a sliding block in the electric sliding rail, a power motor is fixedly arranged on the upper side of the spring, and a supporting rod is fixedly arranged on a power shaft of the power motor. According to the device provided by the invention, improvement is implemented on the basis of an original monitoring camera, and livestock can be prevented when in escaping; when the device finds out the escaping livestock, a certain amount of anesthetic can be automatically injected into an anesthesia needle tube according to the weight of the livestock, the specific position of the livestock is positioned through the camera, then the needle tube is emitted by an emitting device to anesthetize the livestock so as to prevent escaping, and the needle tube used for anesthesia can be recycled.

title: Dairy cow breeding supervision system based on big data
abstract: The invention discloses a dairy cow breeding supervision system based on big data. The dairy cow breeding supervision system comprises a milking module, a footstep recording module, an alarm module, ahuman-computer interaction module, a weight detection module, an information storage module and a dairy cow state tracing module, wherein the dairy cow state tracing module is used for monitoring themilk yield of a dairy cow for a long time, and when the milk yield of the dairy cow is abnormally reduced, the situation is timely discovered, so that the influence of a result of the influence of the time change on the change of the milk yield of the dairy cows on a data analysis result can be reduced; in addition, the dairy cow state tracing module monitors the movement conditions of two frontfeet or two rear feet of the dairy cow to find crippling of the dairy cow in time, so that the waist condition of the corresponding dairy cow is further detected in a targeted mode, and specifically,judgment is carried out according to the bending degree of the back of the dairy cow; and the detection range is automatically and gradually narrowed, so that the dairy cow hoof disease analysis accuracy of the dairy cow tracing module is improved, a large number of misjudgments are avoided, and the workload of workers is reduced.

title: method for detecting estrus of cattle based on object detection algorithm
abstract: The present invention provides a method for detecting estrus of cattle based on an object detection algorithm comprising: a photographing step of capturing a behavioral image of cattle by a camera installed in a cattle ranch; a search step of searching for the action image of cattle on a frame-by-frame basis; and a determination step of detecting an estrus expression of cattle by detecting mounting activity based on the object recognition algorithm through deep learning.

title: FERTILITY PREDICTION IN ANIMALS
abstract: The present invention is directed to methods for fertility prediction in animals, and in particular dairy cows. The methods allow detection of the likelihood of conception upon insemination of a cow based on the analysis of properties of milk of the cow, and in particular the mid-infrared (MIR) spectrum of the milk. Such methods also enable selection of cows for insemination and fertility classification of cows. Software and systems for carrying out the methods of the invention are also provided. The present invention also provides methods for deriving reference MIR spectra representative cows with good or poor likelihoods of conception upon insemination. These reference MIR spectra can be used for fertility prediction in cows to be tested.
applicants: DAIRY AUSTRALIA; Geoffrey Gardiner Dairy Foundation Limited; Agriculture Victoria Services Pty Ltd

title: Control equipment applied to multi-directional video monitoring of cattle farm
abstract: The invention relates to control equipment applied to multidirectional video monitoring of a cattle farm. The control equipment comprises a mounting seat, a first motor and a bearing seat, wherein thefirst motor and the bearing seat are fixedly mounted on the mounting seat; a basic shaft connected with the first motor is rotationally installed on the bearing seat, a linkage rod is welded to the basic shaft, a reference frame is welded to the linkage rod, the reference frame is connected with a cross rod through a bearing, and an arc-shaped main control frame is welded to the cross rod; and the main control frame is connected with a plurality of monitoring surrounding assemblies. The control equipment is convenient to use, on the basis that the monitoring probe is controlled to slide alongthe arc track through gear tooth transmission to conduct multi-angle change monitoring, the monitoring probe can be controlled to deflect up and down and deflect obliquely, and therefore all-around comprehensive monitoring on the whole cattle and livestock farm is achieved.

title: Livestock behavior detection method and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock behavior detection method and related equipment. The method comprises the following steps of acquiring livestock behavior characteristic information of at least onelivestock, wherein the livestock behavior characteristic information corresponding to each livestock consists of X barometer values and X exercise amount collector values corresponding to different time periods, for each livestock, the X barometer values and the X exercise amount collector values corresponding to each time period in the livestock behavior characteristic information are processedinto characteristic groups corresponding to the time period, each characteristic group comprises M characteristics, and then the behaviors of the corresponding livestock in the corresponding time period are judged according to the M characteristics included in each characteristic group, identifiers of livestock behavior information collectors are in one-to-one correspondence with identifiers of the livestock, and the X and the M are both preset positive integers. Based on the scheme, the daily behavior state of the livestock can be detected, then the health state of the livestock is judged, and a data basis is provided for scientifically feeding the livestock.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA WANG XUN INFORMATION ENGINEERING COMPANY

title: Timed feeding system for feeding machine of lactating sows
abstract: The invention discloses a timed feeding system for a feeding machine of lactating sows, and belongs to the technical field of sow breeding. According to the invention, a user uploads basic informationto a database to provide basic information for a central controller; the feeding time and the feeding amount of a feed are controlled according to sow hunger information collected by an image collection module during feeding; meanwhile, feeding and growth conditions of sows in all stages can be monitored and recorded in real time; basic data can be provided for research of sow breeding; online dynamic adjustment of timed feeding of the feed is achieved; scientization and standardization of sow breeding are facilitated; thus, the automation degree of the feeding machine is increased; manpowerand material resources can be effectively saved; and scientific feeding is realized. Through a mobile terminal, under the action of a communication module, a working instruction can be remotely sent to the system, and the feeding amount and the feeding time of the feed can be observed in real time, so remote control management is realized, and human resources are greatly saved.

title: MONITORING SYSTEM FOR DETECTING BREEDING CATTLE'S ESTRUS AND DISEASE
abstract: The present invention relates to a monitoring system constructed in a livestock house in which an inner area is partitioned into at least one breeding space in which a plurality of breeding cattle are positioned. The monitoring system includes: an intelligent imaging device that is individually installed on the upper side for each breeding space and generates image information by photographing the breeding space from the top down; an information collecting device that receives the image information for each breeding space generated through the intelligent imaging device through a communication network and stores and records the same in an internal database; and a monitoring device that receives the stored and recorded image information for each breeding space from the information collecting device and analyzes the behavioral patterns of the plurality of breeding cattle positioned inside the breeding space based on the received image information.

title: Intelligent pig raising growth health dynamic monitoring management system based on big data
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent pig raising growth health dynamic monitoring management system based on big data. The system comprises a pig house division module, a weight detection module, abody condition analysis module, a feeding amount adjustment module, a backfat detection module, a fat condition analysis module, a fat condition adjustment module, an early warning display module, ananalysis server and a storage database. According to the system, pig houses are divided according to pregnancy stages of pregnant sows, the weight of each pregnant sow in each pig house is detected, the average difference value of the weight of the pregnant sows in each pig house is calculated, the body condition of the pregnant sows in each pig house is analyzed, the feeding amount is adjusted, the backfat of each pregnant sow in each pig house is detected, the fat condition of each pregnant sow is analyzed and adjusted, the embryo life health safety coefficient of each pregnant sow in each pig house is comprehensively calculated, the pregnant sows with the embryo life in danger are treated, the health of the pregnant sows is guaranteed, and the growth and development of embryos are promoted.

title: Sheep parasitic disease monitoring device based on 5G network and working method of device
abstract: The invention discloses a sheep parasitic disease monitoring device based on a 5G network and a working method of the device, relates to the field of veterinarians, and aims to realize real-time automatic monitoring of a lying phenomenon after sheep suffers from parasitic diseases, and realize effective monitoring of a dehydration phenomenon after sheep suffers from parasitic diseases. According to the invention, the real-time lying condition of a single sheep body is monitored through the 5G network, the time and labor are saved during lying monitoring of the single sheep body, and the real-time performance is high.
applicants: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY BRANCH OF HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: METHOD FOR MANAGING BREEDING OF LIVESTOCK AND USER TERMINAL THEREOF
abstract: Disclosed is a method for managing a domestic animal. The method for managing the domestic animal may comprise: a process of receiving selection for at least one farm, which is an examination target of a domestic animal examination day; a process of receiving selection for at least one domestic animal, which is the examination target of the domestic animal examination day, among domestic animals bred in the at least one farm; and a process of displaying information on the at least one domestic animal. The information on the at least one domestic animal may comprise identification information on the domestic animal and identification information on an artificial fertilization program applied to the domestic animal.

title: Sheep parasitic disease monitoring device based on wireless network and working method of device
abstract: The invention discloses a sheep parasitic disease monitoring device based on a wireless network and a working method of the device, relates to the field of veterinarians, and aims to realize real-timeautomatic monitoring of a dehydration phenomenon after sheep suffer from parasitic diseases and the like. The device comprises a humidity sensor (4), a liquid level sensor (5), a weighing sensor (7),a controller (8) and a wireless signal transmitting device (9). The real-time dehydration condition of the sheep is collected by utilizing various sensors, and then field monitoring or remote monitoring is carried out by utilizing the wireless network.
applicants: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY BRANCH, HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Multifunctional sow estrus detection device
abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional sow estrus detection device. The multifunctional sow estrus detection device comprises a detection station, wherein a feeding mechanism, a detection mechanism, a driving mechanism, an estrus promoting mechanism and an ink jetting mechanism are arranged in the detection station. The detection station comprises a bottom plate, fences fixed to the left end and the right end of the bottom plate, and a front door arranged at the front ends of the fences. The feeding mechanism comprises a feeding box, a feeding roller and a feeding roller driving motor. Thedetection mechanism comprises back pressing rods, a connecting rod, a connecting rod driving air cylinder and a generation mechanism. The driving mechanism comprises blocking rods, a second sliding block sliding front and back, a second ball screw arranged in the front-back direction and second sliding rods, and the left end and the right end of the second sliding block are each fixedly provided with a cross rod; the estrus promoting mechanism comprises an estrus promoting disc. The ink jet mechanism comprises an ink box, a water pipe and a nozzle. The multifunctional sow estrus detection device has the advantages of being capable of automatically detecting estrus sows, completing estrus promoting actions of the sows and scientifically feeding the sows.

title: Male tag needle, needle temperature measuring male tag and ear tag
abstract: The invention discloses a male tag needle, a needle temperature measuring male tag and an ear tag. The ear tag comprises the needle temperature measuring male tag and a female tag; the male tag comprises a male tag base and a middle shaft; and the male tag needle also comprises a middle shaft. A cavity is designed in the middle shaft, and a temperature sensor is installed in the cavity. The end ofthe middle shaft is connected with a needle, and the part of the middle shaft connected with the needle is concave. The middle shaft is made of beryllium bronze. According to the design, under the condition that an elastic structure is not designed, it can be guaranteed that a temperature measuring sensor can make tight contact with the ear of an animal all the time, marking is more convenient and faster through the small-size needle head, caused wounds are smaller, and the problem that ear cartilages are hard and difficult to penetrate can be solved.

title: Cattle water trough self-water-storage multi-view processing method based on artificial intelligence and BIM
abstract: The invention provides a cattle water trough self-water-storage multi-view processing method based on artificial intelligence and BIM. The method comprises the following steps: performing operation onthe image of each sub-region based on a deep neural network to obtain a key point heat map; defining a region of interest ROI in a pre-constructed BIM, bonding ROI, obtaining position information ofcattle, matching the key points in the key point heat map, performing judgment operation to obtain orientation information of the cattle, performing superposition operation on the key point heat map of the channel corresponding to the central point of the hip bone of the cattle to obtain a moving track of the cattle, obtaining moving information of the cattle according to the moving track, and placing a water level sensor in the drinking trough to obtain water level information; realizing self-water-storage of the drinking trough by combining the information. According to the method, the information can be obtained only by further processing the obtained key points, the operation is simple, the calculation speed is high, and the problem of inaccurate water adding when animals shield the drinking trough in the prior art is solved.

title: Method operating acceleration sensor employing measurement of health state of livestock
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of operating an acceleration sensor for measuring the health state of livestock. The method of operating an acceleration sensor for measuring the health state of livestock comprises: a first step of presetting a sampling period and an interrupt value; a second step of confirming a fixed state by setting a threshold value with an absolute position of an acceleration sensor in an initial state and changing an interrupt type to occur with a relative position value after the fixed state; a third step of setting, when the interrupt value is detected from the acceleration sensor, a value of a preset time interval before and after a state in which the interrupt value is measured as a valid value; a fourth step of performing an operation of comparing a converted vector value with a previously measured vector value until the interrupt value is not continuously generated for a preset time; and a fifth step of detecting object motility. Therefore, the method of operating an acceleration sensor for measuring the health state of livestock effectively acquires the biometric information of livestock.

title: Physical condition monitoring equipment based on 5G intelligent cattle and sheep raising Internet of Things
abstract: The invention discloses physical condition monitoring equipment based on 5G intelligent cattle and sheep raising Internet of Things, belonging to the technical field of livestock breeding. The equipment comprises a first driving mechanism, wherein a weight detection mechanism is placed at one end of the first driving mechanism, an infrared temperature measurement mechanism is placed on one side ofthe weight detection mechanism, and a second driving mechanism is placed at the end, away from the first driving mechanism, of the weight detection mechanism. By arranging the first driving mechanismand the second driving mechanism, cattle and sheep can be driven, so detection difficulty is effectively reduced, cattle and sheep can be detected more conveniently, and labor intensity in detectionof the physical conditions of cattle and sheep is effectively reduced; and universal wheels can make contact with the ground by rotating internal-thread rotary knobs, and therefore, the angle of a separation fence can be more easily adjusted to meet the requirements of users, the application range of the equipment is greatly widened, and great convenience is provided for users.

title: Target object monitoring method and target device
abstract: The invention provides a target object monitoring method and a target device. The method comprises the steps: enabling the target device to obtain the motion data information of a target object, and enabling the target device to be carried on a target part of the target object, wherein the target device determines whether the current state of the target object is abnormal or not according to the size relation between the motion step number indicated by the motion data information and the preset threshold range. By adoption of the technical scheme, the problem that in the related art, the motion behavior of the target object cannot be monitored in real time, and the target object with the abnormal condition cannot be determined in time is solved; instead, the motion behavior state of the target object is monitored in real time through the target device, when a pig is abnormal, display prompting is carried out in time, and the monitoring efficiency of remote monitoring of the pig is improved.

title: Precise cattle breeding system
abstract: The invention discloses a precise cattle breeding system. The precise cattle breeding system comprises a cattle pen, a plurality of feed troughs arranged on the outer side edge of the cattle pen, a plurality of cameras and a controller connected with the cameras, wherein an opening allowing the head of a cattle to extend out to facilitate the cattle to eat feed in the feed troughs is formed in theposition, corresponding to each feed trough, of the cattle pen, an openable door is arranged at each opening, and each camera is arranged above the corresponding opening; and the precise cattle breeding system further comprises a control device for controlling the door to be opened and closed, and the control device is connected with the controller. According to the precise cattle breeding system, the problem that when small cattle, adult cattle and even sick cattle are bred together in the same cattle pen, the cattle eat wrong feed is solved, and the technical problem that the occupied cattle breeding site is large due to the fact that the small cattle, the adult cattle and the sick cattle need to be bred in different pens in the past is solved.
applicants: CHONGQING KAIZHOU CIXING ECOLOGICAL AGRICULTURE COMPANY

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MONITORING LIVESTOCK USING EGDE INFORMATION
abstract: A method for monitoring livestock in a barn using edge information of livestock is provided. The method includes a step of generating first to fourth frame synchronization signals synchronized via a frame synchronization signal generator; a step of transmitting the first frame synchronization signal to a plurality of edge lights installed in a predetermined space and emitted toward livestock raised in a barn; a step of controlling the plurality of edge lights based on the first frame synchronization signal; a step of transmitting the second frame synchronization signal to a camera installed in a specific area of the predetermined space; a step of acquiring image information photographed by the camera based on the synchronized timing with the plurality of edge lights according to the second frame synchronization signal; a step of synchronizing and storing the photographed image information to the third frame synchronization signal; a step of extracting a plurality of pieces of edge information on at least one livestock corresponding to the edge lights from the image information based on the third frame synchronization signal; and a step of generating monitoring information of the livestock by synthesizing the plurality of pieces of extracted edge information on the livestock based on the fourth frame synchronization signal.

title: Full-auto environment-friendly hog raising equipment system
abstract: The invention discloses a full-auto environment-friendly hog raising equipment system which comprises a hog house. According to the system, a circulation running chain drags a transmission plate device to realize automatic timed running, faces generated in hog raising can be cleaned out for many times every day without manual operations, environmental health of the whole hog house can be maintained, effective separation of urine and the feces is thoroughly realized, the urine and feces can be timely collected and discharged from a hog farm, influences of harmful gases such as ammonia gas on hogs are reduced, the environmental temperature of the hog house can be regulated in time, diseases of the hogs caused by super-cold and super-hot conditions are reduced, temperature changes of hogs ina hog lot can be monitored at any time, monitoring and alarming are carried out in time, long-standing environmental pollution problems in the breeding industry are reduced, a brand-new automatic breeding mode is brought to breeding enterprises and breeding farmers, and the ecological environment is protected and economic benefits of the breeding farmers realize leap-type improvement based on reduction of sewage discharge, reduction of sewage disposal cost and reduction of manual cost.
applicants: ZHAO MINGSHAN; WANG SHENG; YU JIFU

title: Pig exercise amount monitoring device and exercise amount detection scoring method
abstract: The invention discloses a pig exercise amount monitoring device. The pig exercise amount monitoring device comprises a shell, a printed circuit board and a power supply. A micro-control unit, a ZigBeemodule and an acceleration module are integrated on the printed circuit board. The acceleration module is a three-axis accelerometer, and the ZigBee module is used for transmitting received exerciseamount information and scoring information to a base station. The micro-control unit is used for acquiring acceleration information by using serial port communication, calculating the acceleration information to obtain exercise amount information of the pig and sending the exercise amount information to the ZigBee module. The ZigBee module and the acceleration module are awakened/dormant as required. The device has three operation modes, namely a charging mode, an active measurement mode and a passive awakening mode. The three operation modes are realized by controlling awakening/dormancy states of the micro-control unit, the acceleration module and the ZigBee module. Meanwhile, the invention discloses an exercise amount detection scoring method based on the pig exercise amount monitoringdevice. The exercise amount detection scoring method is used for monitoring daily exercise amount of pigs and preliminarily judging whether the pigs enter estrus or not.
applicants: TIANJIN CALINO IOT TECHNOLOGY INDUSTRY DEVELOPMENT COMPANY

title: Calf main sign information acquisition system
abstract: The invention provides a calf main sign information acquisition system. The system comprises a sign information acquisition module, a control module, a transmission module and an upper computer module, wherein the sign information acquisition module is connected with the input end of the control module; the output end of the control module is connected with the input end of the transmission module; the output end of the transmission module is connected with the upper computer module; the physical sign information acquisition module comprises a position detection module, an identity recognitionmodule, a weight acquisition module and a body temperature acquisition module, and is used for carrying out identity recognition and weight and body temperature information acquisition on a calf on the basis of position detection; the control module is a single-chip microcomputer which automatically executes instructions according to acquired information; the transmission module takes RS232 as abus and carries out communication according to a Modbus protocol; and the upper computer module is a human-computer interaction interface built on a PC by utilizing kingview software. According to thesystem, the problem of single sign detection can be solved, the position, the identity, the weight and the body temperature of the calf are automatically acquired, and the acquired information is displayed and stored through the upper computer, so that a foundation is laid for fine and automatic breeding and scientific management of the calf.

title: LIVESTOCK HEALTH MONITORING SYSTEM AND METHOD OF USE
abstract: Systems and methods of using an animal wellness notification system to determine the wellness of an animal, the systems and methods comprising: attaching an animal wellness notification system component to an animal, monitoring the temperature of the animal to determine if the animal's temperature remains outside a selected temperature range for a selected time duration, and providing notice if the animal's temperature remained outside the selected temperature range for the selected time duration.

title: Device for measuring the movement amount of livestock in a barn using video and method the same
abstract: The present invention discloses a device and a method for measuring the amount of movement of livestock in a livestock house using image information. The device for measuring the amount of movement of the present invention includes: an image photographing unit including at least one image sensor, and collecting image information by photographing at least one livestock in a livestock house through the image sensor; and a control unit correcting the size of the livestock included in the image information based on the installed position and angle of the image sensor photographing the collected image information, and using the standardized area of the livestock and the preset area of the livestock based on the corrected image information to calculate the amount of movement of the livestock.

title: LIVESTOCK HEALTH MONITORING SYSTEM AND METHOD OF USE
abstract: Systems and methods of using an animal wellness notification system to determine the wellness of an animal, the systems and methods comprising: attaching an animal wellness notification system component to an animal, monitoring the temperature of the animal to determine if the animal's temperature remains outside a selected temperature range for a selected time duration, and providing notice if the animal's temperature remained outside the selected temperature range for the selected time duration.

title: GRAZING ANIMAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract: Provided is a grazing animal management system that includes the following steps: a herd determination step in which a server 20 having an animal information database 22 in which management information for animals is registered determines a herd from the positions in which a plurality of animals are present at a specific time t1; a management candidate animal extraction step in which animals not in the herd determined in the herd determination step are extracted as management candidate animals; and a managed animal specification step in which animals extracted as management candidate animals at least a predetermined number of times when the herd determination step and the management candidate animal extraction step are performed repeatedly at different times are specified as managed animals. As a result, it is possible to focus on the animal behavior of forming a herd, determine that animals straying from the herd are behaving abnormally, and thereby reduce the burden involved in managing a large number of animals.
applicants: ZUKOSHA; NATIONAL UNIVERSITY CORPORATION, IWATE UNIVERSITY

title: A METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR DETERMINING THE IDENTITY OF AN ANIMAL OF A HERD OF ANIMALS
abstract: A rotary milking platform (3) comprises a plurality of stalls (5) and an RFID animal identifying system (9) for identifying animals entering the stalls (5) of the platform (3). A microprocessor (14) reads signals from an image capturing device (15) and computes a feature vector from the captured image of each animal. A plurality of reference feature vectors comprising respective matrices of metrics already derived from images of the respective animals captured by the image capturing device (15) are stored and cross-referenced with the identity of the respective animals. The microprocessor (14) compares computed feature vectors of each animal with the stored reference feature vectors until a best match has been determined with one of the reference feature vectors. The identity of the animal of that matching reference feature vector is then determined as the identity of the animal of that computed feature vector. The determined identity of the animal in the relevant stall (5) is compared with the identity of the animal determined for that stall (5) by the RFID system (9). On a favourable comparison the identity of the animal determined from the captured image of that animal is confirmed as the identity of the animal. In the event of a conflict between the two identities being determined, a conflict alert signal is produced.

title: Electronic measuring stick for cattle
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic measuring stick for cattle, and relates to the technical field of windows. The electronic measuring stick comprises a fixing sleeve, a display screen and a scalemechanism, wherein a storage battery is arranged in a lower part of interior of the fixing sleeve, a push switch and a charging interface are arranged in a lower part of exterior of the fixing sleeve,the display screen is installed on an outer side of an upper part of the fixing sleeve, the scale mechanism is installed on an upper part of the interior of the fixing sleeve, a first limiting rod isarranged on one side of a bottom of the fixing sleeve, a second limiting rod is arranged on one side of an upper portion of the fixing sleeve, and a third limiting rod is arranged on one side of an upper portion of the scale mechanism. The electronic measuring stick has beneficial effects that the electronic measuring stick can measure a telescoping length of a telescoping scale through arrangement of capacitive grating displacement sensors at top ends of the first, second and third limiting rods, and transmits the information to a data processing module, the data processing module can transmit the data to a data display module, and through arrangement of a display screen, measurement data can be displayed conveniently, and digital measurement is achieved.
applicants: BEIJING LIANYU BEEF BREEDING TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; ZHENGZHOU QIFEITE ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL SCIENCES, CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Livestock breeding management system based on block chain
abstract: The present invention discloses a livestock breeding management system based on a block chain. The livestock breeding management system based on the block chain comprises a control center, a block chain center intelligent control platform and a plurality of block chain node platforms, the block chain node platforms are plural and all connected to the block chain center intelligent control platform, the block chain center intelligent control platform is also connected to the control center, the block chain node platforms are connected with a positioning management system, a monitoring management system, an environment management system, a livestock health supervision system, a veterinarian distribution system and an electronic breeding planning system. Under monitoring of big data, the breeding system realizes simultaneous supervision of multiple breeding areas, can trace back the breeding environment of livestock breeding, provides environment information reference for subsequent breeding, reduces spreading of diseases of livestock, improves monitoring safety of livestock breeding, meanwhile, autonomously plans livestock breeding information of each block chain, including breedingquantity and variety, provides an optimal breeding scheme for livestock breeding, optimizes breeding and increases breeding capacity.

title: Intelligent water drinking and temperature measurement integrated monitoring device, system and method for pigs
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent water drinking and temperature measurement integrated monitoring device, system and method for pigs. The system comprises a liquid flow meter, a temperature measurement module, an electronic ear tag reading module, a controller and a wireless transmission module, wherein the electronic ear tag reading module is used for reading the electronic ear tag information of the pig close to a water dispenser and transmitting the electronic ear tag information to the controller, the temperature measuring module is used for measuring the temperature of the pigs close to the water dispenser, the liquid flow meter is installed on a water conveying pipeline between a water source and the water dispenser and used for monitoring the water drinking starting time, thewater drinking ending time and the water drinking amount, and the controller is used for reading the temperature measurement data of the temperature measurement module and starting to obtain the output data of the liquid flow meter after the pig electronic ear tag information is obtained, and sending out the pig electronic ear tag information, the temperature measurement data, the water drinkingstarting time, the water drinking ending time and the water drinking amount through the wireless transmission module. According to the system, the problems of pig drinking water monitoring and pig body temperature monitoring can be solved as a whole.

title: A DAIRY FARM WITH A SINGLE OR MULTIPLE FRONTAL ELEVATED ROADS
abstract: The present invention discloses, inter alia, a free dome range system (FDR) comprising at least one front elevated rail (FER); at least one rear elevated rail (RER); a plurality of mobile units, each of the plurality of mobile units movable along a member of a group consisting of: the at least one FER, the least one RER and any combination thereof. The invention also discloses a method of positioning at least one of a plurality of mobile units in an FDR comprising steps of providing a free dome range system (FDR) comprising at least one front elevated rail (FER); at least one rear elevated rail (RER); and the plurality of mobile units, each of the plurality of mobile units movable along a member of a group consisting of: the at least one FER, the least one RER and any combination thereof. The present invention further discloses a dairy farm characterized by (a) an array of n stalls side-by-side along an X axis on the dairy animal's level. Each of the stalls is configured by means of size and shape to accommodate a dairy animal, having a main axis Y that is substantially perpendicular to axis X, a front side and an opposite rear side; and (b) a common elevated road surface provided on a higher level, above the stalls. This upper road surface extends along the X axis and is constructed to allow free passage of mobile units, including mobile longitudinal milking units, in a direction along the X axis, along the Y axis, a rotation about the X axis, a rotation about the Y axis, a rotation about the Z axis, and any combination thereof. The present invention further discloses means and method that in a stall, a gate located between the animal and the feeding line is thereby configured to at least temporarily prevent or otherwise limit free access of said animal to its feed.

title: Electronic ear tag, method and equipment for remotely monitoring disassembly of electronic ear tag, and remote underwriting method
abstract: The invention provides a method and equipment for remotely monitoring disassembly of an electronic ear tag, the electronic ear tag with a disassembly alarm function, an electronic ear tag disassembly monitoring system and a bred animal remote underwriting method based on the electronic ear tag. The method for remotely monitoring disassembly of the electronic ear tag comprises the following steps: receiving temperature data of a wearing object acquired by the electronic ear tag in real time or at regular time; determining the body temperature change of the wearing object according to the received temperature data; if the decrease of the body temperature of the wearing object in the preset time period exceeds a preset threshold value, it is determined that the electronic ear tag is detached. According to the method for remotely monitoring the disassembly of the electronic ear tag, the risk that the replacement of the identity of the bred animal cannot be perceived due to the fact that the bred animal cannot go to the site in person can be avoided.
applicants: KARUDII ZHENNONG SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (BEIJING) CO., LTD

title: Automatic gateframe for livestock selection
abstract: The present invention relates to an automatic gate frame for selecting livestock, which comprises: an entry unit forming an RFID transmission unit and having a blocking door coupled to one side of the front surface; a selection unit having a one-way gate formed on the front side of entry unit and having first and second diagonal gates formed on both sides of the rear end; a scale unit formed on the bottom surface of the entry unit; and a controller connected to the blocking door, the first and second diagonal gates, and the scale unit. According to the present invention, the RFID transmission unit and the scale unit transmit a biorhythm and weight signal of livestock to the controller and the controller receiving the signal allows livestock to move straight to one side or the other side of the selection unit or in the direction of the one-way gate while selectively operating the first diagonal gate or the second diagonal gate or limiting the operation, and the livestock is automatically selected. Accordingly, a tag of the livestock entering the entry unit is recognized by the RFID transmission unit so that biorhythm status of the livestock can be easily checked. In addition, the weight of livestock measured on the scale unit installed on the bottom surface IC calculated so that health of livestock can be managed. Signals from the RFID transmission unit and the scale unit are transmitted to the controller so that the first and second diagonal gates are selectively opened or controlled on the basis of a livestock selection criteria input to the controller, and thus the moving direction of livestock is automatically guided. The movement direction of livestock with similar health conditions is guided to the first and second diagonal gates, and thus livestock that need treatment, livestock that can be milked, and livestock that can't be milked can be easily selected.

title: Stock semen management and artificial insemination control system
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock semen management and breeding control system to maximize breeding success probability. According to the present invention, the livestock semen management and breeding control system comprises: a livestock semen storage device string livestock semen while maintaining conditions for a preset storage environment and reading and providing state information and identification information of the stored livestock semen; a livestock semen management edge computing device monitoring and managing a semen storage list for the livestock semen storage device and management state information of the livestock semen; a breeding control edge device transmitting a query request for breeding control management information together with livestock entity identification information and livestock semen identification information scheduled for artificial insemination and displaying breeding control management information provided according to the request; and a livestock breeding management server generating and transmitting the breeding control management information for a livestock entity and livestock semen in response to an inquiry request of the breeding control edge device, wherein the breeding control management information includes management status information about the livestock semen scheduled for artificial insemination, pedigree information, inbreeding coefficient, and breeding recommendation probability information.

title: Smart barn management system with LED sterilization and management method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart LED sterilizing livestock barn management system which predicts the occurrence of a disease through a pre-learned deep learning algorithm and, as a follow-up measure, automatically prevents the occurrence of a disease through LED sterilization when a disease occurrence probability derived from deep learning exceeds a specific threshold, and to a management method thereof. The smart LED sterilizing livestock barn management system according to the present invention comprises: a sensor unit including an indicator virus detection sensor, an indicator bacteria detection sensor, a temperature sensor, and a humidity sensor; a pre-learning unit including a database for storing biological indicator data and environmental indicator data of a livestock burn, and a disease learning unit for outputting a completed learning model after training a deep neural network through the data input from the database; an integrated disease management system including a data collection unit which receives and normalizes the biological indicator data and the environmental indicator data detected by the sensor unit, a disease prediction unit which receives the deep neural network from the disease learning unit, receives the data of the data collection unit, calculates a predicted value for each disease, and converts the predicted value into a reliability score, and a lighting control unit which receives the reliability score; and a lighting device including an LED lighting unit which outputs the LED light of a specific wavelength capable of performing sterilization, and configured to emit the LED light of the specific wavelength according to a signal transmitted from the integrated disease management system.
applicants: CHUNG, KWANG CHUL; KATACOM; HUR, CHUNG

title: ESTRUS DETERMINATION DEVICE FOR SOWS, METHOD FOR DETERMINING ESTRUS OF SOWS, AND PROGRAM FOR DETERMINING ESTRUS OF SOWS
abstract: Provided is a feature for accurately determining estrus of sows without relying on experience or intuition of an observer. This estrus determination device for sows comprises a measuring unit that measures the frequency of waking up and going to sleeping per unit time of a sow kept in a stall, and a determination unit that determines estrus of the sow on the basis of a plurality of said frequencies repeatedly measured by the measuring unit over a set period of time.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR REMOTELY DETECTING AND ALERTING ACTUAL OR IMPENDING STRESS IN ANIMALS IN CORRALS AND DURING TRANSPORTATION
abstract: A system for detecting and alerting actual or impending heat stress in livestock, and especially in cows, comprising an array of thermal sensors placed sufficiently high above ground of a cowshed, which consists of at least Infra-Red thermal camera; an external temperature sensor hanging in the air, placed at a predetermined distance away from the thermal camera lens inside the camera's field of view; humidity sensor that measures the environmental humidity; a dedicated software module configured to preform image processing algorithms in order to calculate the temperature representing the thermal energy level for all pixels in the image, and consequently performing calibration for all the pixels in the image; a dedicated software module configured to perform measurements of temperature, ambient heat load and physiological measurements from the cows, continuously and at a constant rate, which enable to monitor the energy that the cow produces, and at the same time monitor the herd's ability to cool itself by releasing heat energy to the environment, by calculating an LSI.

title: Object motion behavior detection device, system and method and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses an object motion behavior detection device, system and method and a storage medium. The device comprises an excrement leakage plate body, a supporting structure, a plurality ofmicroswitches and a central processing unit, and a first surface of the excrement leakage plate body is used for bearing a to-be-detected target object; the supporting structure is located in the center of the second face of the excrement leakage plate body, and the supporting structure enters an unbalanced state when the target object moves; the microswitches are located in the peripheral area of the supporting structure on the second face of the excrement leakage plate body, and under the condition that the supporting structure is about to enter an unbalanced state, the microswitches are triggered; and the central processing unit is connected with the plurality of microswitches and is used for counting the triggering times of the plurality of microswitches, and the times are used for indicating whether the motion behavior of the target object is abnormal or not. According to the device, the technical problem that the change of the health state of a pig cannot be accurately monitoredin real time in the pig breeding process in the prior art is solved.

title: METHOD OF ANALYZE GASTRIC MOVEMENT OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: The present invention provides a stomach-insertion type sensor for analyzing gastric movement of livestock and a method for analyzing movement information of livestock using the same. Therefore, livestock farms increase management efficiency and contribute to an income increase by precisely analyzing health conditions of livestock.

title: RADIO TERMINAL, LIVESTOCK MONITORING SYSTEM AND LIVESTOCK MONITORING METHOD
abstract: To provide a radio terminal capable of finding the bloat of livestock at an initial stage or a predictive stage.SOLUTION: A radio terminal 20 including a pressure sensor 30 is indwelled in a stomach 10S of a cow 10, and wirelessly transmits pressure data in the stomach 10S so as to enable finding the bloat of the cow 10 at an initial stage or a predictive stage based on the pressure data. A pressure-receiving face 34 for measurement of the pressure sensor 30 in the radio terminal 20 is arranged inside a measurement hole 46 formed in a case 40 for housing a main circuit board 21 and a sub circuit board 31 so as to suppress contact of coarse feed to the pressure-receiving face 34 for measurement, and improve durability, and when pressure of liquid in the stomach 10S is measured, an influence of dynamic pressure of the liquid is hardly received so as to improve measuring accuracy.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: System and method for diarrhea signs dection of animals and diarrhea risk prediction
abstract: Provided is a method for livestock diarrhea detection and diarrhea risk prediction based on sensor data and image data performed on a computer system. The method may comprise the following steps of: receiving sensor data and an identifier of the livestock; analyzing the sensor data to identify the livestock, classifying the activity of the identified livestock, and calculating the location of the livestock; and receiving image data, and analyzing the image data to classify the activity of at least one livestock species included in the image.

title: Pig raising robot for quantitatively feeding pigs by measuring weight of pigs
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of feeding robots, in particular to a pig raising robot capable of quantitatively feeding pigs by measuring the weight of the pigs. The pig raising robot comprises an enclosing wall, a first weighing mechanism, a feeding trough, a mixing mechanism, a second weighing mechanism, a turnover mechanism and a load box; an opening for allowing the fattening pigs to enter is formed in the side, close to the first weighing mechanism, of the enclosing wall, and a pit slot for burying the first weighing mechanism is formed in the bottom; the first weighing mechanism is buried in the pit slot at the bottom of the enclosing wall, and the front end faces the opening in one side of the enclosing wall; the feeding trough is arranged in the enclosing wall and isarranged at the rear end of the first weighing mechanism; the material mixing mechanism is erected on the enclosing wall and is positioned over the load box; the second weighing mechanism is arrangedin the enclosing wall; the turnover mechanism can be movably mounted at the working end of the second weighing mechanism in the vertical direction; and the load box is rotatably mounted on the turnover mechanism and is positioned under the discharge end of the mixing mechanism. According to the scheme, the effect of dynamically and quantitatively feeding the pigs according to the weight of the fattening pigs is achieved, the structure is stable, and the effect is remarkable.

title: SYSTEM FOR DETECTING DIARRHEA AND PREDICTING DIARRHEA RISK LEVEL IN LIVESTOCK, AND METHOD FOR USING SAME
abstract: Provided is a method for detecting diarrhea and predicting diarrhea risk level, wherein the method is based on sensor data and image data and performed on a computer system. The method may comprise the steps of: receiving sensor data and identifiers of livestock, and analyzing the sensor data to identify the livestock, classify activities of the identified livestock, and calculate the locations of the livestock; and receiving image data and analyzing the image data to classify the activity of at least one livestock animal included in an image.

title: Livestock breeding Internet of Things data acquisition system
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock breeding Internet of Things data acquisition system, which comprises: a server, which is used for remotely managing livestock breeding data; a data acquisition terminal, which is used for acquiring original data in the livestock breeding process; a bearing plate, a first weighing sensor, a second weighing sensor, a third weighing sensor and a fourth weighing sensor; wherein the server comprises a fifth coordinate solving module, a distance solving module and a weight solving module; the data acquisition terminal comprises a data acquisition module, a coordinate establishment module and a coordinate acquisition module. And the server is in communication connection with the data acquisition terminal. According to the invention, the weighting coefficients are added to a first numerical value F1, a second numerical value F2, a third numerical value F3 and a fourth numerical value F4 respectively, errors caused by different positions of livestock to be weighed can be effectively reduced when the livestock to be weighed is weighed, the livestock weighing mode is simplified, and livestock weighing automation is achieved.

title: Internet-of-things livestock breeding data acquisition method
abstract: The invention discloses an Internet-of-things livestock breeding data acquisition method. The method comprises the steps of acqiring a first numerical value F1, a second numerical value F2, a third numerical value F3 and a fourth numerical value F4; acquiring a first coordinate (x1, 0), a second coordinate (x2, 0), a third coordinate (0, y3) and a fourth coordinate (0, y4); calculating a fifth coordinate (x, y) of a first position of a livestock to be weighed; respectively calculating a first distance r1, a second distance r2, a third distance r3 and a fourth distance r4; and calculating the weight G of the livestock to be weighed. According to the method, weighting coefficients are added to the first numerical value F1, the second numerical value F2, the third numerical value F3 and the fourth numerical value F4 respectively, errors caused by different positions of livestock to be weighed can be effectively reduced when the livestock to be weighed is weighed, the livestock weighing mode is simplified, and livestock weighing automation is achieved.

title: Pig farm epidemic prevention system and method
abstract: The invention provides a pig farm epidemic prevention system and an epidemic prevention method. The pig farm epidemic prevention system comprises a disinfection area, a breeding pig feeding area, a fattening area, an isolation area, signal conversion equipment and a server, and disinfection equipment and drying equipment are arranged in the disinfection area; and a plurality of temperature sensorsare laid on the ground of the breeding pig feeding area and the ground of the fattening area separately, the temperature sensors are connected with the signal conversion equipment, and the signal conversion equipment is connected with the server. According to the pig farm epidemic prevention system, the multiple areas are arranged, pigs in different conditions can be conveniently managed and controlled, and cross infection is prevented; fever pigs are recognized through the temperature sensors and the like, the fever pigs are isolated in time, and early discovery and early control of swine fever are achieved; and through arranging a special channel and the disinfection area, effective prevention and control management is carried out, and major epidemic outbreak is prevented.
applicants: JIANGXI ZHENGBANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES; JIANGXI ZHENGBANG TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Livestock breeding management system based on Internet of things
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock breeding, in particular to a livestock breeding management system based on the Internet of things. The system comprises identity labels whichare configured on the livestock ears of livestock and carry the identity information of the livestock; an inspection robot which is erected at the upper part in a livestock farm through a track and isused for realizing acquisition of video data of the livestock; and an intelligent terminal which is internally provided with a data post-processing system and is used for processing the video data ofeach livestock, evaluating the growth state and the health state of each livestock and outputting a corresponding breeding scheme and an epidemic prevention scheme according to an evaluation result.According to the invention, comprehensive detection and automatic evaluation of the growth state and the health state of the livestock and the environment in the livestock farm are realized, so that risk factors existing in the livestock breeding process can be found in time.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF AGRICULTURAL ECONOMICS AND INFORMATION, JIANGXI ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Milking guidance system for livestock
abstract: The present invention relates to a milking guidance system for livestock, wherein an electronic tag device attached to the livestock to include an electronic tag outputs a training signal that allows the livestock to learn a behavioral pattern of moving to a milking place at a milking time, thereby guiding the corresponding livestock to move to the milking place at the milking time. When the electronic tag is recognized wirelessly by an electronic tag recognizer installed on the milking place for a predetermined waiting time for movement before the milking time for the corresponding livestock after the training signal is outputted and a signal for checking the electronic tag is not received by the electronic tag device, electric shock is applied to the skin of the corresponding livestock to guide the corresponding livestock to forcibly be moved to the milking place at the milking time. According to the present invention, the training signal such as vibration and an alarming sound is outputted around at the milking time of the corresponding livestock to be milked or the electric shock is additionally applied to the skin of the livestock to enable the livestock to learn the behavioral pattern of moving to the milking place at the milking time, thereby alleviating inconvenience of a milking manager that the manager has to drive the livestock to the milking place by himself. Because periodical milking is performed at the milking time for the livestock, problems of health deterioration of the livestock and quality degradation of the produced milk, which are caused by the delay of the milking can be solved to ensure the convenience of management of livestock milking and both the health of the livestock and the quality of the produced milk. In particular, in a milking place having a robot milking machine for unmanned milking, guidance for milking the livestock can become unmanned to enable the implementation of a complete unmanned milking system.

title: ANIMAL HEALTH, BEHAVIOR, AND INVENTORY MONITORING
abstract: Systems and methods are discussed to monitor animal health and behavior. In some embodiments, a method may include reading an animal ID using a reader that reads the animal ID from a passive ear tag on the animal when the animal is within a monitoring area; storing a time stamp associated with the animal ID when the animal ID was read by the reader; determining a number of times the animal was within the monitoring area in a given period of time based on the time stamp and the animal ID; determining that the animal has likely has an illness based on the number of times the animal was within the monitoring area; and communicating the animal ID and an indication that the animal likely has an illness to a user device.

title: SMART PIGSTY SYSTEM AND PIGSTY MONITORING METHOD USING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart barn system for providing intelligent monitoring as to livestock raised in a barn. The system includes: imaging devices provided in the barn and generating a captured image; and a monitoring server performing image recognition as to the captured image to detect whether a predetermined event has occurred with respect to livestock in the barn, generating event data as to an event that has occurred, and generating statistical information with respect to the event data. According to the present invention, an abnormal animal behavior event is detected and a change in body weight is detected based on learning-based image analysis. Accordingly, an abnormal animal behavior in a barn can be monitored more accurately and intelligently.

title: METHOD FOR DETERMINING THE STATE OF ESTRUS OF AN AGRICULTURAL ANIMAL
abstract: FIELD: animal husbandry.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of animal husbandry, namely to systems for automatically tracking the behavior of individual animals in a herd to identify the most favorable time for their fertilization, mainly artificial. The method for determining the state of estrus of an agricultural animal is characterized by the fact that the animal carries a motor activity sensor containing a transceiver for communication with the information processing center. The method includes stages at which the motor activity of each individual of an agricultural animal in the herd is recorded over time, animals with increased motor activity are isolated compared to the recorded activity for previous periods, the radar method determines the mutual proximity of the selected animals for a certain period by analyzing the attenuation or delay of signals propagating between transceivers installed on animals. Based on the results of the assessment of the mutual proximity and motor activity of animals, a decision is made on the state of estrus of these animals.EFFECT: invention provides high reliability of determining the state of estrus of an animal under various conditions of its maintenance, both indoors and in conditions of free grazing.1 cl, 3 dwg

title: Industrial livestock management leveraging digital twin computing
abstract: An approach for maintaining industrial livestock infrastructure is disclosed. The approach utilizes digital twin computing to create a digital copy of biological and non-biological assets of a livestock production unit/facility (e.g., aquaculture, sericulture, dairy industry, meat industry, etc.) to improve the efficiency and reduce cost associated with the production of livestock. The usage of digital twins removes fundamental constraints concerning place, time, and human observation. Instead of control based on direct observation of physical objects, which requires physical proximity, digital twins enable remote control of livestock operations coupled with IoT sensors. This allows for the decoupling of physical flows from information aspects of farm operations.

title: Lifting platform for breeding pig measurement
abstract: The invention discloses a lifting platform for breeding pig measurement. The lifting platform comprises a bottom plate, a first side plate, a movable plate, a column and a second side plate, wherein afixed plate is fixed to the top end of the bottom plate, a second sliding rail is arranged at the top end of the fixed plate, a second rolling wheel is slidably arranged in the second sliding rail, second fixed blocks are arranged at the end, away from the second rolling wheel, of the second sliding rail and are fixedly connected with the fixed plate, a first adjusting rod is hinged to the top end of the second fixed block, a second adjusting rod is hinged to the top end of the second rolling wheel, the first adjusting rod and the second adjusting rod are distributed in a crossed mode and areconnected through a pin shaft at the crossed position, a first rolling wheel is hinged to the top end of the first adjusting rod, first fixed blocks are hinged to the top end of the second adjustingrod, a first slide rail is arranged at the bottom end of a lifting platform board, a hydraulic rod is fixed to the bottom end of the outer side of the first adjusting rod, and the top end of the hydraulic rod is fixedly connected with the top end of the outer side of the second adjusting rod. Parameters such as backfat thickness and eye muscle depth of breeding pigs can be measured more effectively, the number of nipples of the breeding pigs is counted, and the workload of a measurer is reduced.

title: Hog house for preventing African swine fever from spreading
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of hog houses, and particularly relates to a hog house for preventing African swine fever from spreading. The hog house comprises a hog house entrance/exitand a ventilation opening, a first monitoring device is arranged at the hog house entrance/exit, a second monitoring device is arranged at the ventilation opening of the hog house, a spray type disinfection device covering the interior of the hog house is installed in the hog house, and the first monitoring device and the second monitoring device are electrically connected with a controller of the spray type disinfection device; and when the first monitoring device and/or the second monitoring device are/is triggered, the controller can control the spray type disinfection device to spray. According to the scheme, the problem that in the prior art, a hog house is poor in resistance to African swine fever spreading is solved.

title: Dairy cow disease management system using thermal camera
abstract: A milk cow disease management system according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a milk cow identification device that is positioned in a movement path of a milk cow and receives biometric information from a biometric device mounted on the milk cow; a plurality of thermal imaging cameras positioned in the movement path; a guide device that opens and closes a gate that guides the milk cow to either a milking center or a disease treatment center depending on milk cow's diseases and health conditions; and a control unit that receives biometric information of the milk cow and thermal images taken from the plurality of thermal imaging cameras from the milk cow identification device to determine whether the milk cow has mastitis and ankle diseases and transmits a control signal for controlling the guide device according to whether mastitis and ankle diseases have occurred.

title: Automatic non-contact treatment system for brucellosis infected livestock
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic treatment, and discloses an automatic non-contact treatment system for brucellosis infected livestock. The automatic non-contact treatment system comprises a base, a left support plate, a right support plate and a transportation device, the transportation device is installed above the base, one end of the transportation device sequentiallypenetrates through the left side of the left support plate and the left side of the right support plate and extends to the right side of the right support plate, a transportation controller and monitoring equipment are installed at the left side of the left support plate, and the top of the left support plate is fixedly connected with the bottom of a top plate. According to the automatic non-contact treatment system for the brucellosis infected livestock, a winding roller can be rotated by starting a driving motor, a steel wire rope can be wound and unwound, and a movable rod can deflect up and down by winding and unwinding the steel wire rope, so that a second liquid conveying pipe can move up and down, a nozzle can spray up and down finally, and liquid medicines can be sprayed to the livestock with different physiques.

title: Whole-stage precise feeding control method for farrowing sow
abstract: The invention discloses a whole-stage precise feeding control method for a farrowing sow. The method includes the steps that farrowing sow information is bound with feeding controller information corresponding to farrowing sow fences in advance, and the bound information is fed back to cloud; the state of the farrowing sows is monitored from a to-be-mated stage to a whole farrowing stage in real time and feeding the state back to the cloud, and a corresponding feeding curve is searched by the cloud according to the current state of the farrowing sows; and the cloud calls a feeding program corresponding to the found feeding curve, and based on the feeding program, a feeder is controlled to feed the farrowing sows in the corresponding fences. According to the whole-stage precise feeding control method for the farrowing sow, the state of the farrowing sows from the to-be-mated stage to the delivery stage is monitored and tracked in real time, and the corresponding feeding program is started for feeding according to the current state of the farrowing sows, so that the real-time control of the feeding amount of the farrowing sows from the to-be-mated stage to the delivery stage is realized; and automatic control over the total feed intake of the farrowing sows in the whole stage is achieved by controlling the feed intake of the farrowing sows in different stages.

title: Livestock excrement treatment method
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock excrement treatment method, and belongs to the technical field of livestock breeding excrement treatment. The method comprises the following steps that firstly, anexcrement detection chip for detecting animal excrement/urine signals is implanted between two intestinal canals of livestock excrement and urine, and the excrement detection chip is placed at the middle position of the two intestinal canals of the livestock excrement and urine; each excrement detection chip is numbered, exclusive identity information is set, and a number corresponding to the corresponding excrement detection chip is set on an animal body; and an intelligent terminal device in wireless communication connection with the excrement detection chip is configured, the intelligent terminal device is used for receiving signals sent by the excrement detection chip and analyzing and processing the received signals, the excrement/urine and excrement/urine time of the corresponding livestock are finally judged, an operator can know the excrement/urine condition of the corresponding livestock in time conveniently, the target livestock is accurately found out, and a defecation device is held to walk to the position where the target animal is located to receive the excrement/urine. By means of the method, the problems that livestock defecates and urinates anywhere, and excrementexists everywhere are solved.

title: Whole-stage precise feeding device for production sows
abstract: The invention discloses a whole-stage precise feeding device for production sows. The whole-stage precise feeding device comprises a feeder, wherein the feeder is correspondingly provided with a feedinlet and a feed outlet; and the feeder comprises a feed bin used for achieving feed distribution, an impeller arranged in the feed bin and used for achieving precise control over the feed amount, a position monitoring device arranged corresponding to the impeller and used for monitoring the rotating position of the impeller, a driving device connected with the impeller and used for driving the impeller to rotate and a controller, the feed bin is located between the feed inlet and the feed outlet, and the controller is in control connection with the driving device and the position monitoring device correspondingly. The whole-stage precise feeding device for the production sows is suitable for feeding pregnant sows and parturient sows, precise feeding of the whole stage of the production sows are achieved, and timed and quantitative feed falling is achieved, so that the body condition of the production sows is kept, feed waste is reduced, the feeding cost is reduced, automatic adjustment of the feeding amount is achieved, and the labor force of workers is reduced; and meanwhile, the body condition of the production sows is monitored in real time, so that the feeding process is precisely controlled.

title: Puberty information acquisition system and method
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and method for acquiring and displaying entity information, and specifically, to a system and method for acquiring and displaying entity information, which can be effectively utilized for the management of livestock by effectively acquiring each individual biometric information and location information from livestock grazing on vast grasslands through sensor-communication network construction and by displaying the information on a display unit attached to the livestock. In addition, the present invention provides a device that can effectively acquire information about the estrous period, fertilization, and parturition of the livestock and display the information on the display unit for visual identification.

title: Livestock temperature measurement ear tag
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock temperature measurement ear tag. The livestock temperature measurement ear tag comprises an ear tag body and an integrated circuit board. The integrated circuit board comprises a main control chip and a power supply module, and the main control chip is electrically connected with a temperature measurement module, an RFID module and a communication module. According to the livestock temperature measurement ear tag, the technical problem of inaccurate livestock temperature measurement is solved. According to the livestock temperature measurement ear tag, livestock infection is prevented while the temperature is accurately measured, and the livestock temperature can be monitored.

title: CUSTOMIZED BREEDING METHOD OF CATTLE USING BIG DATA ANALYSIS AND BREEDING SYSTEM USING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a customized breeding method of cattle using big data analysis and a breading system using the same.
