According to an embodiment of the present invention, the customized breeding method of cattle using big data analysis can comprise: a step of acquiring gene-type information of cattle which have not passed seven days after birth; a step of acquiring the cattle's status information and status prediction information from the gene-type information of the cattle by using an artificial intelligence learning model; a step of determining the usage of the cattle as one of meat production, breeding, and dairy products production by using the acquired status information and status prediction information of the cattle; a step of determining the time for butchering the cattle and breeding method in accordance with the determined usage of the cattle; a step of determining the substance ratio of the customized feed based on the determined breeding method; a step of, after one year has passed after the cattle have eaten the customized feed, acquiring gene-type information of the cattle which have passed one year after birth; a step of re-determining the usage and time for butchering the cattle based on the gene-type information of the cattle which have passed one year after birth, and re-configuring the substance ratio of the customized feed in accordance with the re-determined usage of cattle and the time for butchering; and a step of generating an electronic tag on the time and place for butchering the cattle. The present invention aims to provide a customized breeding method of cattle using big data analysis and a breeding system using the same, which are capable of effectively breeding cattle.

title: Accurate feeding control method for parturient sows
abstract: The invention discloses an accurate feeding control method for parturient sows. The method comprises the following steps that to-be-parturient sow information is bound with feeding controller information corresponding to a to-be-parturient sow fence in advance, and binding information is fed back to a cloud end; the states of the to-be-parturient sows from the parturient stage to the delivery stage are monitored in real time and fed back to the cloud end, and the cloud end searches for a corresponding feeding curve according to the current states of the sows; and the cloud end calls a feedingprogram corresponding to the searched feeding curve, and based on the feeding program, a feeder is controlled to feed the sows in the corresponding fences. According to the accurate feeding control method for the parturient sows, the states of the to-be-parturient sows from the parturient stage to the parturient stage are monitored and tracked in real time, corresponding feeding programs are started for feeding according to the current states, and real-time control over the feeding amount of the to-be-parturient sows from the parturient stage to the parturient stage is achieved; and the totalfeed intake of the parturient sows is automatically controlled according to the feed intake control of the parturient sows at different stages.

title: SLAVE MACHINE TERMINAL, MONITORING SYSTEM, AND RADIO TRANSMISSION METHOD
abstract: To provide a technology capable of avoiding interference with less required labor and time and less power consumption than before.SOLUTION: Use of a plurality of slave machine terminals 20 makes state data D1 on a plurality of cows 10 be transmitted at fixed intervals, which makes it possible to monitor variations in states of the plurality of cows 10 in a lump. When interference is caused by overlap of transmission timing of the plurality of slave machine terminals 20 and an ACK signal is not returned from a transmission destination, a slave machine terminal 20 receiving no ACK signal shifts timing of subsequently transmitting transmission data D2 by an adjustment period Rt having a random length. Thereby, even if transmission timing deviation is not set previously to the plurality of slave machine terminals 20, repetition of transmission by all of the slave machine terminals 20 gradually establishes scheduling so that mutual overlap of transmission timing is eliminated.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: System and method of counting livestock
abstract: A system configured to receive video and/or images from an image capture device over a livestock path, generate feature maps from an image of the video by applying at least a first convolutional neural network, slide a window across the feature maps to obtain a plurality of anchor shapes, determine if each anchor shape contains an object to generate a plurality of regions of interest, each of the plurality of regions of interest being a non-rectangular, polygonal shape, extract feature maps from each region of interest, classify objects in each region of interest, in parallel with classification, predict segmentation masks on at least a subset of the regions of interest in a pixel-to-pixel manner, identify individual animals within the objects based on classifications and the segmentation masks, and count individual animals based on identification, and provide the count to a digital device for display, processing, and/or reporting.

title: Livestock health monitoring systems and methods of use
abstract: Systems and methods of using an animal wellness notification system to determine the wellness of an animal, the systems and methods comprising: attaching an animal wellness notification system component to an animal, monitoring the temperature of the animal to determine if the animal's temperature remains outside a selected temperature range for a selected time duration, and providing notice if the animal's temperature remained outside the selected temperature range for the selected time duration.

title: Piglet heating healthy breeding intelligent monitoring system based on Wi-Fi socket
abstract: The invention provides a piglet heating healthy breeding intelligent monitoring system based on a WiFi socket. The system is used for solving the technical problems that the existing device cannot inform a farmer of information in advance, so that piglets are burnt, burnt to death, heated to death and frozen to death. The system comprises an intelligent detection terminal platform, an execution mechanism platform and a monitoring terminal platform, wherein the intelligent detection terminal platform comprises a detection module, and the detection module comprises an environment monitoring sensor group, an electricity consumption detection module and an overload protection circuit module; the execution mechanism platform comprises execution equipment and a regulation and control circuit, and the execution equipment is connected with the regulation and control circuit; and the environment monitoring sensor group, the electricity consumption detection module, the overload protection circuit module and the regulation and control circuit are connected with a control panel, and the control panel is connected with the monitoring terminal platform through a wireless communication module. The system has the functions of overload protection, quick power supply cutoff, disaster early warning and the like, dynamic monitoring of piglets and remote detection and regulation of environmental parameters are realized, and the probability of burning or freezing death of the piglets is reduced.

title: Dairy cow image information collecting and processing method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a dairy cow image information collecting and processing method and system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring dairy cow image information, analyzing the dairycow image information to obtain a verification section comprising identity verification information and body condition information, obtaining the identity of dairy cows by identifying the identity verification information of the verification section, and obtaining the body condition of the dairy cows by identifying the body condition information of the verification section. According to the methodand system, dairy cow images are set to be dual information of identity verification and body condition identification, so that the acquisition difficulty of original information can be greatly lowered, parts with physical properties, such as an accelerometer, in direct contact with the dairy cows are cancelled, the manufacturing cost is reduced, and meanwhile the comfort degree of the dairy cowscan be improved.

title: Intelligent collar for analyzing beef cattle behaviors and monitoring vital signs and method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent collar for analyzing beef cattle behaviors and monitoring vital signs and a method thereof. The intelligent collar comprises an intelligent collar body worn on the neck of beef cattle, a wireless communication module and an equipment terminal. The intelligent collar body integrates a microprocessor control module, a temperature monitoring module, a behavior posture monitoring module, an identity recognition module, a Bluetooth positioning module and a power supply module, one end of the wireless communication module is the intelligent collar body, the other end of the wireless communication module is the equipment terminal, data transmission and communication are carried out between the two terminals through a Bluetooth gateway, and the equipment terminal is a PC and an APP. The intelligent collar and the method are used for monitoring and recording behavior postures, motion states, body surface temperatures and position information of the beef cattle, analyzing various data and comprehensively reflecting behavior activities and vital sign change conditions of the beef cattle. The management efficiency is improved, and clearness, accuracy andscientization of beef cattle breeding are ensured.

title: Intelligent system capable of displaying experimental rabbit breeding information in real time
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent system capable of displaying experimental rabbit breeding information in real time, and particularly relates to the technical field of livestock breeding. The intelligent system comprises an experimenter operation terminal, and the output end of the experimenter operation terminal is electrically connected with the input end of an experimental project login unit. According to the system, the circuit state, the system port connection state and the system operation environment state of the system can be monitored in real time in a multi-direction and multi-angle manner, real-time feedback of abnormal information can be achieved, so that timely processing work is conducted, meanwhile, real-time monitoring of the daily life state and the ordinary body temperature of an experimental rabbit can be obtained from multiple aspects, the abnormal information real-time feedback effect is achieved, accordingly, the disease early warning work is achieved, a remote user terminal can diagnose and monitor the running state of the system in real time, the running reliability and firmness of the system are improved, the extraordinary value of the intelligent system is embodied, and the diseases of the experimental rabbit can be quickly and effectively managed in time on a large scale.
applicants: WUHAN CITY WANQIAN JIAXING BIOTECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: HERD FEEDING SYSTEM WITH LOW-COST, EFFICIENT, AND PORTABLE FEED BINS FOR FEEDING INDIVIDUAL ANIMALS
abstract: A feeding system (100) for feeding individual animals of a herd feed, supplements, and combinations thereof. The feeding system includes one-to-many feed bin assemblies or feeding stations (130) such that the system is able to dispense a specified mass of feed to specific animals at user-defined intervals. In this way, each animal of a herd is provided with optimal, individualized amounts of feed or feed material. Multiple feed bin assemblies in a single pasture, for example, can automatically form a network of feeders so that regardless of the specific feed bin assembly or feeding station within the feeding system that an animal visits, the specified amount and type of feed or feed material is delivered. Each feed bin assembly or feeding station can also be equipped to download, archive/store, and/ or synthesize data into an individual animal record and/or to transmit data from additional onboard animal sensors such as activity and rumination sensors.

title: Construction system for remote monitoring means for measuring status of underground metal structure
abstract: Provided is a system for constructing a livestock house management system. According to the present invention, the livestock management house system comprises the inside (S) of a livestock house and a plurality of livestock house structures installed in the inside (S) of the livestock house to partition the same. Accordingly, the livestock house is operated as a multi-story building, environmental-friendly operation using an eco-friendly discharge system (purifying and discharging water by using only biological treatment without using coagulant) and an efficient feeding program operation are performed, and security of the livestock house is reinforced so that the security is reinforced. At the same time, a livestock house management system capo operating complex additional functions (e.g,, security, access control, selective operation of use of surrounding space, and a stable installation structure of a photographing means) can be provided.

title: A System for Early Forecasting of Infectious Disease in Poultry
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for measuring changes in vital signs of poultry and a method for predicting whether poultry is infected with pathogens by using the same. The present invention can be helpfully used to determine an overall health condition including the outbreak of various poultry diseases by measuring quantitative values of changes in biological vitality of poultry in real time. In particular, the present invention provides reliable real-time information about changes in biological vitality through comparison of body temperature and noise measurement values of poultry for each time period reflecting circadian changes of the poultry, rather than simple comparison of the body temperature and noise measurement values with simple reference values, and thus can be used for early diagnosis of highly infectious pathogens such as avian influenza virus and early isolation of confirmed cases, and ultimately the effective prevention of the spread of diseases.

title: SYSTEM FOR COLLECTING, MONITORING AND ANALYSING ANIMAL BEHAVIOUR
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for collecting environmental data, monitoring and behavioural analysis of grazing animals, in an environment with georeferencing using agrometeorological sensors, with the aim of spreading precision agriculture. The data generated are collected by a wireless network and stored in a database. The system is capable of analysing the data from the various sensors in order to generate information about cattle behaviours, and can also correlate them with characteristics and environmental data from the management area.

title: Livestock breeding environment monitoring system based on big data
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock breeding environment monitoring system based on big data. The livestock breeding environment monitoring system comprises a central control module, a signal transmission module, a safety anti-theft module, a daily management module, an environment monitoring module, a safety monitoring module and an environment acquisition module; the output end of the safety anti-theft module is unidirectionally and electrically connected with the input end of the central control module; and the output end of the daily management module is unidirectionally and electrically connected with the input end of the central control module. Through the central control module, the signal transmission module, the safety anti-theft module, the daily management module, the environment monitoring module, the safety monitoring module and the environment acquisition module, the livestock breeding environment monitoring system can achieve the function of high intelligent degree, andthe problem that an existing monitoring system for livestock breeding on the market does not have the function of high intelligent degree is solved. The problems that in the breeding work, human resource investment is large, cost consumption is large, the requirement for intelligent breeding is not met, and breeding work is not easy to carry out are solved.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR MANAGING LIVESTOCK THROUGH OBJECT RECOGNITION BASED ON DEEP LEARNING
abstract: The present invention relates to a method and a system for managing livestock by deep learning-based object recognition. The method includes the following steps of: collecting image data and 3D point cloud data on livestock; identifying the livestock as individual objects based on the 3D point cloud data; performing behavior pattern and state analysis for each of the individual objects using a first model for deep learning-based behavior pattern analysis; generating state information on the individual objects based on the analysis result; determining an intensive management livestock object from the individual objects based on the analysis result; and transmitting the state information on the intensive management livestock object to a user terminal. In the state information generation step, the state of the individual objects is determined as at least one of normal, disease, estrus, and parturition states based on the behavior pattern analysis result to generate the state information. In the intensive management livestock object extraction step, an object that corresponds to at least one of the disease, estrus, and parturition states is extracted as the intensive management livestock object.

title: System and method for analyzing object tracking and object behavior using deep learning algorithms
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart livestock management system using deep learning-based object tracking and behavior analysis and a method thereof. The smart livestock management system using deep learning-based object tracking and behavior analysis comprises: a brainwave detection module attached to the head of a pig object; a first photographing device for photographing a motion image of the pig object; a second photographing device that generates a thermal image of the pig object; a sound collecting device for collecting sound information; a monitoring server for predicting and determining whether the corresponding pig object has a disease and a type of the disease; and a manager terminal for receiving a disease outbreak notification message of the pig object from the monitoring server. Therefore, the smart livestock management system using deep learning-based object tracking and behavior analysis and the method thereof can predict whether a disease occurs in pigs.

title: Drools rule engine-based internet-of-things management and control system and method for group-breeding sow feeding station
abstract: The invention discloses a Drools rule engine-based internet-of-things management and control system and method for a group-breeding sow feeding station. The system comprises terminal monitoring equipment, a network communication layer and an application layer. The terminal monitoring equipment consists of an information acquisition and control module, realizes acquisition of data such as ear tags,weights and feed weights of the sows, and controls the discharging device and the automatic door; the network communication layer comprises a LoRa aggregation node and a GPRS module, and is used foraggregating the acquired data of each terminal node and uploading the acquired data to the cloud server; the application layer adopts a C/S architecture, an upper computer acquires sow identity and environment information in real time, an optimal decision amount is deduced by using a Rete matching algorithm of a Drools rule engine, and a result is sent to a lower computer. And the feeding rule base, the sow fact base and the related feeding information are stored in a MySQL database. Queuing feeding of the group breeding sows can be achieved, the optimal feeding amount is obtained through theexpert system, accurate discharging is achieved, the reasoning efficiency of the expert system is optimized through the Rete matching algorithm, and the reliability of the system is improved.

title: ANIMAL HANDLING DEVICE
abstract: Described herein is an animal handling device in the form of a cattle crush with automated headbail capture, back bar operation and positional sensing along with methods of use thereof. The crush and method offer automation for functions that in the art have been largely manual and inherently labour intensive, physical and even potentially dangerous for the operator and/or animal.

title: Elevator monitoring system, method and device for livestock and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses an elevator monitoring system for livestock. The elevator monitoring system comprises an image acquisition device arranged in an elevator car and used for acquiring image information in the elevator car and sending the image information to an elevator control system; a weighing device arranged at the bottom of the elevator car and used for acquiring weight information of the elevator car and sending the weight information to the elevator-based control system; an image processing device electrically connected with the elevator control system and used for acquiring the image information, processing the image information to obtain processed image information and feeding back the processed image information; the elevator control system electrically connected with an image recognition device, the weighing device and the image processing device and used for generating corresponding livestock monitoring information based on the processed image information and the weight information; and a cloud server electrically connected with the elevator control system and used for receiving and displaying the livestock monitoring system.

title: Barn Management System
abstract: The present invention provides a barn management system that not only identifies livestock in a barn using video equipment including a thermal imaging camera, but also acquires health information such as body temperature of each livestock, so as to manage the barn by utilizing the acquired health information. The barn management system includes a camera set and a control unit.

title: SURVEILLANCE USING WIRELESS CONTACT LENSES ON FOWL AND LIVESTOCK
abstract: A surveillance wireless contact lens powered by body fluids for animals and fowls is disclosed using Wi-Fi, Bluetooth®, wireless local area network (WLAN), satellite and cellular tower and radio communication network. The contact lens comprises a molten material, which is injected into a mold cavity through under pressure for making the lens. The contact lens has a central optic portion with a concavo-convex shape, wherein the central optic portion having a depression at the center. A peripheral bearing portion is extended from and about the central optic portion and having an outer margin, which is placed within the limbus of an eye of the animal and/or fowl and opposite the white outer layer of the eyeball. The contact lens further comprises a processor disposed on the peripheral bearing portion, configured to control the operation of the contact lens via an electrical circuit. The electrical circuit in communication with the processor is configured to connect to electronic components include a power source, a light sensor, a communication module, and a camera.

title: Dairy cow information detection device with recognition function
abstract: The invention discloses a dairy cow information detection device with a recognition function. The dairy cow information detection device comprises a box body, a drive motor, a dairy cow, an infrared detector, a processing box, a pressure sensor, a weighing scale, an electric telescoping rod, an oestrus detection ring, a temperature sensor and an information receiving box. The drive motor is fixedly installed at the top of the box body, the infrared detector is fixedly mounted on the outer side wall of the box body, a mounting frame is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the box body, adoor opening mechanism is rotatably connected to the inner side wall of the mounting frame, a right end opening groove is formed in the outer side wall of the box body, and the door opening mechanismis slidably connected with the inner side wall of the right end opening groove. Extra manual operation is not needed, operation is more accurate and efficient, and a large amount of manpower is saved; and the processing box analyzes detected data, and whether the dairy cow is oestrous, ill or reduced in weight or not is judged, so that the dairy cow is managed in the next step, the dairy cow canmate in time, the milk yield is increased, and profits are increased.

title: Dairy cow early limp recognition method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a dairy cow early limp recognition method and device. The dairy cow early limp recognition method comprises the following steps of acquiring three-dimensional acceleration signals of toes and hoofs of dairy cows; firstly establishing a limp motion scoring group template sample sequence, then obtaining a distance matrix, establishing accumulated cost matrixes, defining the last row of the accumulated cost matrix as a distance function, taking a local minimum value as a minimum regular path starting point, finally determining a segmentation starting point and a segmentation end point, and extracting gait features; extracting features from segmented strides, and obtaining recognition model input variables; firstly establishing a logistic regression model, then performing regularization processing, solving a loss function, then calculating a model regression coefficient, then dynamically adjusting the learning rate, training the logistic regression model, and finally solving an optimal model coefficient to establish a dairy cow early limp recognition model; and inputting the recognition model input variables into the model to carry out early limp recognition classification. The method has the characteristics of relatively high robustness, high automation degree, high recognition precision, rapid segmentation and the like.

title: Method and apparatus for tracking large animal neck movements and feed intake and rumination
abstract: The present invention is to distinguish what a cow actually eats and what it ruminates. A cow chews to eat feed or chews to eat protein from feed ruminated from a first stomach for the remaining time except sleeping time. Therefore, during continuous chewing activity and when neck swallowing occurs after chewing, the present invention distinguishes whether what to initially eat feed or what rumination generates.

title: Method and apparatus for tracking changes in estrus and rumination of cattle
abstract: The present invention relates to the method and algorithm for comparing and analyzing the amount of feed eaten by of a large animal during a day and a recommended amount. For large animals, change in body weight is closely related to the market price thereof. For example, in the case of horses, the horses perform a lot of exercise and the amount of feed should be adjusted according to the amount of exercise. If they consume more feed than the amount of exercise, they are prone to various diseases. On the other hand, in the case of cattle, unnecessary movements should be reduced and weight should be kept as heavy as possible. The reason is that cows are marketed corresponding to the weight. As such, accurate analysis of the daily intake of large animals is closely related to the income of large animal farmers. The present invention accurately analyzes time when large animals eat feed on the basis of short-range communication technology and motion sensors to deliver analysis information to a farmer, so that the farmer can operate a farm on a scientific basis, thereby maximizing profits.

title: Livestock health monitoring system and method based on 5G
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock health monitoring system and method based on 5G. The livestock health monitoring system based on 5G comprises an inspection robot and a background server connectedwith the inspection robot, wherein the background server obtains a target monitoring point set and sends a motion instruction to the inspection robot according to the target monitoring point set, thetarget monitoring point set comprises target monitoring points, the inspection robot moves to a target monitoring point under the indication of the motion instruction, obtains monitoring images of livestock, and sends the monitoring images to the background server, and the background server processes the monitoring images by adopting a neural network model to obtain target positions correspondingto the livestock, extracts image information corresponding to the target positions from the monitoring images, and generates a livestock monitoring result according to the image information. According to the invention, sick livestock can be found in time, and further diffusion of viruses is prevented, so that the death rate and the labor cost of the livestock can be reduced, and the breeding costcan be reduced.
applicants: WENS FOODSTUFF GROUP COMPANY; GUANGDONG NANMU MACHINERY AND EQUIPMENT COMPANY

title: SYSTEM AND APPARATUS FOR THE MONITORING OF LIVESTOCK AND THE LIKE
abstract: An electronic ear tag [1] for use in the monitoring or management of livestock has a mass of 32 grams or less. The tag has a polycarbonate housing [3] made with front and rear portions [9] and [11] which are ultrasonically welded together, and has a short neck [7] and a prong [15] for attachment to the ear of an animal. A PCB [40] in the housing includes a microprocessor, a GNSS module and a LoRa transceiver and antenna. A gateway [103] for communication with the ear tag [1] and with the telephone network is also disclosed, as is an animal monitoring and/ or management system which uses the ear tag [1] and the gateway [103].

title: Intelligent livestock breeding electronic monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent livestock breeding electronic monitoring system which comprises a fence, a feeding frame arranged on the fence, an electronic monitoring display arranged on thefeeding frame, recognition components symmetrically arranged on the feeding frame, discharging components symmetrically arranged on the feeding frame and adjusting components symmetrically arranged onthe feeding frame. The intelligent livestock breeding electronic monitoring system is characterized in that each recognition component comprises supporting frames symmetrically arranged on the feeding frame, limiting rotating rods arranged on the supporting frames, protective guards rotationally arranged on the limiting rotating rods, inlets formed in the protective guards, induction plates rotationally arranged on the inlets and recognition pieces arranged on the induction plates. According to the intelligent livestock breeding electronic monitoring system, through the combination of the recognition components and the adjusting components, the food intake of each pig is controlled, and the diet condition of each pig is tracked and recorded.

title: Drinking Apparatus for an Animal
abstract: Drinking apparatus for animals (e.g. a domestic pet such as a cat, dog, rabbit, or livestock such as sheep, cattle, pigs) comprises a capacitive touch sensor 104 under a water basin 102, arranged to detect when an animal touches the water, and/or a load cell measuring the weight of water in the dish or a reservoir and arranged to estimate water depletion based on weights detected before and after the proximity of an animal is detected, e.g. using the capacitive touch sensor. Detection of drinking events may trigger further responses, including activating an RFID antenna for animal identification and/or communicating captured drinking data to a remote location, e.g. monitoring water consumption to track refill status and/or identify abnormal drinking patterns associated with cat illnesses. The dish may promote visibility of the water using a shallow front lip 102a and/or a hydrophobic material, e.g. PTFE coating, to form a clearly-defined convex meniscus (200, fig. 2b).

title: MANAGEMENT METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR CONTROLLING FEEDING COW USING NECKLACE FRAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for managing the amount of feed supplied to a cow using a cow collar frame, which easily manage a feed intake situation of cattle from a remote location in real-time management is performed through a detection module capacity accurately determining the feed intake situation of cattle to secure reliability cattle feed management, and a system thereof. According to the present invention, a system manages the amount of feed for cattle in a livestock house equipped with a cow collar frame including a neck holder driven to a restraint position for restraining the neck of a cow and a release position for releasing restraint. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a collar driving device configured to receive a control signal from a control module to drive a neck holder to a restraining position or a release position; a detection module installed on one side of the cow collar frame and configured to detect a situation in which a cow consumes food; a control module receiving a detection signal from the detection module and generates a notification signal based on the received detection signal, and transmitting the notification system to a user terminal device; and a user terminal device having a management application configured to communicate with the control module to transmit a control signal to the control module.

title: Automatic monitoring, preventing and controlling device for livestock disease control
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of disease prevention and control devices, and discloses an automatic monitoring, preventing and controlling device for livestock disease control. The device comprises a walkway, a first infrared sensor, a first temperature detection device, a first channel, a second channel, a revolving door, a prevention and control breeding house and a control system. The interior of the prevention and control breeding house is divided into a plurality of independent breeding sections through partition plates, a livestock recognition device and a monitoring device are arranged in each breeding section, and an electric control door is arranged in each breeding section; and the control system is used for starting the first temperature detection device to startmeasurement according to a signal of the first infrared sensor, comparing measured temperature data with set temperature data, controlling the revolving door to rotate according to a comparison result, receiving data of the livestock recognition devices and the monitoring devices at the same time, and sending the data of the livestock recognition devices and the monitoring devices to a remote monitoring system and an intelligent mobile phone of a feeder through a wireless communication module, so that the automatic monitoring, preventing and controlling device for livestock disease control isautomatic in detection and isolation, and convenient to use.

title: Decontamination machine for parturient sows
abstract: A decontamination machine for parturient sows comprises an outer shell, a decontamination chamber and a water storage pool. The decontamination chamber is arranged on the upper portion of the water storage pool, the water storage pool is arranged on the lower portion of the outer shell, a spraying rod is arranged on the top face of the decontamination chamber, water outlet holes are formed in thepositions, making contact with cleaning brushes, of a vertical connecting pipe, and four right-angle corners of the decontamination chamber are each provided with a quadrangle imager; a decibel meteris arranged at the upper side of an outlet door, a stain scanner is arranged at the left side of an inlet door, a metal separation net is arranged between the decontamination chamber and the water storage pool, and the drainage end of the water pumping device is connected with the spraying rod, the vertical connecting pipe and a drainage hole device through hoses; and a computer control system isused for controlling normal operation of electrical elements in the decontamination machine. According to the decontamination machine, the labor intensity of feeders can be remarkably reduced, the safety and sanitation problem of predelivery of the sows near delivery is solved, and the safety of piglets is protected.
applicants: JINGGANGSHAN AOXIN HUAFU BREEDING COMPANY; TAIHE COUNTY AOMU BREEDING COMPANY; ZHANGPU COUNTY ZHAOMULAN BREEDING COMPANY; JI'AN AONONG MODERN AGRICULTURAL TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Sow management and Environmental control System
abstract: The present invention relates to a sow management and environmental control system. According to the present invention, the system for predicting and managing giving birth of sows and controlling the environment comprises: an environment control device installed in a breeding farm to control the environment of sows; and a terminal including an environmental sensor part sensing the sow's environment, one or more 3D sensors imaging a sow, a sow measurement part comprising one or more thermal imaging cameras for photographing sows, and a sow management/environment control application recognizing unusual behaviors of sows and predicting sow delivery by using the sow images and the thermal image extracted through the 3D sensors and the thermal imaging camera, and receiving environmental information sensed from the environment sensor part to control the environment control device.

title: Bio sensor capsule device with wireless charging function
abstract: The present invention is a biosensor capsule device which is inserted into the stomach of a cow to collect biological information of the cow and transmit the information to the outside through wireless communication and, more specifically, to a biosensor capsule device which includes a device for recharging a battery from the outside periodically in a wireless charging method to compensate for insufficient battery capacity. According to the present invention, the capsule device comprises: a 3D antenna to receive wireless power in all directions; a resonator and matcher for wireless power reception; a rectifier and voltage regulator converting the received wireless power into power suitable for the battery and load; a power management unit charging the received wireless power to a battery and distributing the received wireless power to the load; and a communication unit transmitting and receiving control signals for the wireless power transmission with a wireless power transmitter.

title: Live pig feeding system
abstract: The invention provides a live pig feeding system which comprises a pig farm, a first telescopic air cylinder, a weighing device, a second telescopic air cylinder, a rotating motor and a third telescopic air cylinder. The inner diameters of a plurality of via holes are sequentially decreased from left to right, the first telescopic air cylinder is connected with a vertical plate, and the upper endof the vertical plate extends into a limiting groove to block the via holes when the first telescopic air cylinder extends out; and when the first telescopic air cylinder contracts back, the verticalplate moves downwards to open the via holes, a sensor and a matching device are matched to recognize whether a pig is higher than a connecting line of the sensor and the matching device or not, the weighing device is arranged in a mounting base, the second telescopic air cylinder is connected with a supporting plate capable of clamping the pig, and the third telescopic air cylinder is connected with a manipulator. According to the live pig feeding system, when the size of the live pig is increased and the height of the live pig reaches the connecting line of the sensor and the matching device,after the sensor detects the condition, the first telescopic air cylinder controls the vertical plate to open the via holes in the left side to drive the live pig with the height reaching the connecting line of the sensor and the matching device into a breeding area at the left side, and finally the second telescopic air cylinder is started to jack up the live pig through the supporting plate.

title: LIVESTOCK MONITORING SYSTEM AND COMPONENTS THEREOF
abstract: Implantable devices, methods, and systems for using the implanted devices to monitor cattle are described herein.

title: SYSTEM FOR MONITORING CATTLE SHED AND MEHTHOD THEREOF
abstract: A cattle farm monitoring system and a method thereof according to an embodiment are disclosed. The cattle farm monitoring system includes: a measuring device for obtaining a thermal image of livestock located in a cattle farm area and location information which is a distance to the livestock; and a management terminal extracting body temperature information of the livestock from the obtained thermal image of the livestock, correcting the extracted body temperature information using the location information, and determining state information of the livestock based on the corrected body temperature information.

title: loT loT and AI-based Smart Hanwoo Barn Management Platform
abstract: The present invention relates to an IoT and artificial intelligence (AI)-based smart Hanwoo (a breed of Korean cattle) barn management platform. More specifically, the present invention relates to an IoT-based barn management system which is able to photograph the inside of the barn in real time by an intelligent smart camera, identify the individuals of the cattle and the environment inside the barn, the presence or absence of disorder, and onset of estrus and the optimal time for conception (Hanwoo and dairy cattle), monitor the symptoms of diseases in real time, and immediately deal with an abnormal situation when such a situation occurs. According to the present invention, the IoT and AI-based smart Hanwoo barn management platform comprises: an intelligent image monitoring system photographing unit generating image information of the livestock grown in the barn; a control system managing the inside of the barn; a data collection device for each barn district and individual recognition including the shape and behavioral characteristics of Hanwoo; and a smart barn integrated management system collecting and managing information in real time.

title: Sow obstetric table monitoring and early warning device, method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a sow obstetric table monitoring and early warning device, method and system. The device comprises a sow obstetric table, a monitoring device, a data transmission module, a central processing unit and an early warning device, the sow obstetric table comprises a sow fence and piglet movable fences, and the piglet movable fences are located on the two sides of the sow fence.The monitoring device comprises a video monitoring device and a voice recognition device, and the monitoring device is used for monitoring sow obstetric table conditions in real time; the data transmission module is used for transmitting data acquired by the monitoring device to a central processing unit in the data server; the central processing unit judges and recognizes the data and recognizesabnormal images or abnormal audios; and the early warning device is used for sending early warning information when the central processing unit recognizes the abnormal image or the abnormal audio to remind a worker to handle the abnormal image or the abnormal audio in time. According to the monitoring and early warning device, method and system, early warning can be conducted in real time and in time under the condition that the piglets are squeezed, a traditional obstetric table is effectively utilized, the transportability is high, and the cost is low.

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR ANALYZING FEEDING BEHAVIOR OF LIVESTOCK BASED ON IMAGE
abstract: The present invention relates to a device for analyzing a feeding behavior of livestock based on an image. The device comprises: a data transmission and reception module; a memory storing an image-based livestock feeding behavior analysis program; and a processor executing the program stored in the memory. The program is to detect each livestock entity by inputting an image collected through at least one camera assigned to each livestock room to a livestock entity detection model, track the state of movement of each livestock entity by accumulating and storing the center coordinates of each detected livestock entity, and generate feeding state information of the livestock entity by counting the entering and leaving behaviors of each livestock entity in a feeding area preset in the livestock room. The livestock entity detection model is a model trained using training data in which an outline arranged to be adjacent to the body area of each livestock entity and the behavior state of each livestock entity are labeled on an image taken in a bird's eye view direction of each livestock entity from the livestock room. The livestock entity detection model is to detect each livestock entity with respect to the input image and output the behavior state of the detected livestock entity. The program is to determine the entering behavior based on the degree to which the center coordinates of each livestock entity approach the coordinates of the preset feeding area, and determine the leaving behavior based on the degree to which the center coordinates of each livestock entity deviate from the coordinates of the preset feeding area.

title: Pregnancy detection method and device based on artificial intelligence, computer equipment and medium
abstract: The invention relates to a pregnancy detection method and device based on artificial intelligence, computer equipment and a storage medium. By adopting the pregnancy detection method, the livestock pregnancy detection time can be shortened, the pregnancy detection accuracy is improved, and the pregnancy detection efficiency is improved. The pregnancy detection method comprises the following steps:acquiring a to-be-detected video stream of a preset part of livestock, inputting the to-be-detected video stream into a pre-constructed pregnancy state classification model, so that the pregnancy state classification model outputs probability values corresponding to different pregnancy states based on the to-be-detected video stream, wherein the pregnancy state classification model adopts a neural network model based on a time sequence; and determining a pregnancy test result of the livestock according to the relative sizes of the probability values corresponding to the different pregnancy states.
applicants: SHANDONG NEWHOPE LIUHE GROUP COMPANY; NEW HOPE LIUHE COMPANY

title: Livestock breeding monitoring system
abstract: According to the livestock breeding monitoring system, an environment acquisition unit, an individual acquisition unit and a safety acquisition unit are connected with an automatic monitoring unit through a signal processing unit, and the automatic monitoring unit is connected with a bus control unit and used for controlling the bus control unit according to received acquisition information. Intelligent control is adopted, operation is convenient, power consumption is low, the livestock breeding environment, livestock individuals and the whole breeding area are monitored and adjusted, manual operation is reduced, the management efficiency is improved, the livestock management problem is fundamentally solved, behavior monitoring can be conducted on each livestock individual, then the breeding efficiency is improved, and the breeding income is increased.

title: Livestock breeding monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock breeding monitoring system, which comprises a wireless sensor network used for detecting physical sign parameters of livestock; the main controller is used for receiving data information containing livestock physical sign parameters and processing effective data; the GPRS unit is used for sending the processed livestock physical sign parameter data information to the Internet network; the monitoring center is used for receiving livestock physical sign parameter data information of the Internet network and realizing remote monitoring; and the power supply provides electric energy for the livestock breeding monitoring system. According to the invention, automatic acquisition, processing and transmission of breeding environment data are realized, the environment data can be transmitted to a monitoring center in a wireless communication mode, breeding personnel do not need to enter a breeding farm, and automatic monitoring of the livestock breeding environment is realized.

title: Intelligent management system for pasture livestock breeding
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent management system for pasture livestock breeding. The system comprises a main control module, and a pasture management module and a health monitoring module whichare in signal connection with the main control module, wherein the main control module is also in signal connection with an administrator terminal, and the health monitoring module comprises a temperature sensor, a pulse sensor and a GPS positioning module for completing the temperature and pulse information of livestock in the pasture, and themain control module is electrically connected with abattery for power supply. The pasture management module is arranged on the pasture, the health monitoring module is arranged on the body of the livestock in the pasture, the health monitoring module is in signal connection with the main control module, the pasture information or the livestock information in the pasture collected by the pasture management module and the health monitoring module canbe processed in a centralized mode through the main control module and then comprehensively processed through the administrator terminal, the pasture management efficiency can be improved, the management cost investment can be reduced, and the pasture management system is economical and practical.

title: Mobile application for livestock heat monitoring
abstract: Devices, systems, and methods for monitoring livestock can include a mobile platform arranged to present the user with an optimal breeding period based on mount activity of the livestock assets. Monitoring optimal breeding periods can increase likelihood of healthy breeding, including through real-time information.

title: Gas monitoring device
abstract: An animal emission monitoring device for positioning on cattle snouts, the animal comprising a snout member comprising a sensor unit 280 285 for detecting the quantity of methane emissions and a positioning means for positioning the device on the head of an animal such that the snout member locates the sensor unit over the nostril of the animal. The device may include a carbon dioxide sensor, a temperature sensor, inertia sensor to detect movement of the animal or a location tracker. The device may be battery powered and may have a solar cell. There may be a differential pressure sensor 300 and/or a flow rate sensor for monitoring the amount of methane being released by the animal. The sensor may monitoring continuously or discretely and may be able to transmit any data wirelessly, possibly in real time. The snout member may be Y shaped and there may be a methane sensor over each nostril. The device monitors the amount of methane, a greenhouse gas released by cattle or other bovine animals or goat or sheep.

title: Cow limp motion characteristic detection method and device based on thermal infrared
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a cow limp motion feature detection method and device based on thermal infrared. The method comprises the steps: collecting cow walking videos based on a thermal infrared camera; extracting a body image of the dairy cow in the walking process based on the dairy cow walking video; based on the body images in the walking process, determining the position coordinates of the key positions of the dairy cows in all the body images; and calculating the limp movement characteristics of the dairy cows according to the change of the position coordinates of the key positions of the dairy cows in each body image. According to the embodiment of the invention, the influence of illumination and environmental changes on cow limp motion feature detection can be effectively avoided, and the accuracy of cow limp motion feature acquisition is improved.

title: EVALUATION SYSTEM AND EVALUATION METHOD
abstract: This evaluation system for evaluating the state of rumen fermentation in a ruminant comprises an evaluation device having an estimation unit for estimating the state of rumen fermentation in a ruminant on the basis of milk production results representing the amount and components of milk produced by the ruminant. This evaluation system makes it possible to simply evaluate the state of rumen fermentation in a ruminant.
applicants: NATIONAL RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT AGENCY NATIONALAGRICULTURE AND FOOD RESEARCH ORGANIZATION

title: Pig house environment intelligent control system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of breeding, in particular to a pig house environment intelligent control system. The system comprises a pig house environment monitoring module used for monitoring temperature and humidity parameters and air quality parameters in a pig house, a pig house abnormal point monitoring module used for monitoring pig manure coverage, pig body abnormal pointsand trough abnormal points in the pig house, and a pig house environment regulation and control module used for regulating and controlling the working state of each environment regulation and controlterminal according to monitoring results of the temperature and humidity parameters and the air quality parameters in the pig house, and the pig manure coverage, the pig body abnormal points and the trough abnormal points in the pig house. According to the system, omnibearing monitoring and intelligent regulation and control of the environment in the pig house can be realized, so that the pig house is always in a comfortable and clean environment.
applicants: SHI CHENG; LIU GUANGYI; WANG ZHENDONG

title: Breeding method of dairy cow milk and meat dual-purpose variety
abstract: The invention discloses a breeding method of a dairy cow milk and meat dual-purpose variety. The method comprises the following steps that dairy cows are precisely monitored and managed by mounting aset of informationized Afimilk management software, and a set of precise feeding system is mounted and used; an intelligent pasture is built; nutrition CPM formula software is utilized, according to the milk yield of the dairy cows, the nutrition of the dairy cows is scientifically regulated and controlled in cooperation with forage grass resources of a local area, the nutrition requirements of the dairy cows are accurately calculated through the nutrition software (CPM), and then complete TMR daily ration is prepared through a TMR stirring machine; and the intelligent pasture is built by adopting an Afimilk management system. According to the breeding method, the Afimilk system (precise management software) is adopted, the use is simple and convenient, the performance is excellent, the pasture management can comprehensively control a milking platform, the Afimilk MPC system collects data, and important information can be provided for managers at the milking platform; and a computer informatization management system is introduced into medium and small cattle farms for the first time, and informatization, digitization and intelligentization modern dairy farm management is achieved.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA LVMENG AGRICULTURE AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT COMPANY

title: GAS MONITORING DEVICE
abstract: An animal emission monitoring device for positioning on cattle, the animal emission monitoring device comprising a snout member comprising a sensor unit for detecting the quantity of methane emissions and a positioning means for positioning the device on the head of an animal such that the snout member locates the sensor unit over the nostril of the animal.

title: Supervisory system for disease prevention of pigs
abstract: The invention provides a supervisory system for disease prevention of pigs. The supervisory system collects body surface temperature and motion information of the pigs in real time through a data collection system, transmits the body surface temperature and the motion information to a server module through a communication base station, performs intelligent analysis in the server module, judges temperature and behaviors, and sends results to a WEB service module or an APP of a mobile phone. Therefore, a set of biological clock model is established for each pig, a health state or a disease stateof the pigs is obtained in real time, and a forecasting system for automatic body temperature and activity detection is formed; when a certain pig is abnormal, warning information is actively sent tobreeding personnel, so that the labor cost is saved for a breeding farm; and meanwhile, vital signs of the pig can be monitored around the clock, so that real-time monitoring of the pig is achieved,the breeding risk of the farm is reduced, early discovery, early prevention and early treatment of diseases are achieved, the death rate is reduced, and economic losses are avoided.

title: Pig raising behavior analysis algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a pig raising behavior analysis algorithm. The pig raising behavior analysis algorithm can analyze, identify and store various behaviors of pigs, and is excellent in identification and analysis effect, so that the accuracy of pig behavior analysis work is ensured, the working efficiency and the working quality of the pig behavior analysis work are improved, and the workingeconomic benefit is improved. By means of a runway-shaped suspension rail, camera shooting collecting devices, a protection module and a positioning module, the camera shooting collecting devices arelocated at a higher position for the runway-shaped suspension rail, accidental collision is avoided, the camera shooting collecting devices can be protected in time when tracking analysis work of target pig behaviors is carried out, collision between the camera shooting collecting devices is prevented, the stability of observation and analysis of the target pigs can be improved, and the working quality of behavior analysis is guaranteed.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR TRACKING POSITION OF A LIVESTOCK ANIMAL
abstract: The disclosure relates to systems and methods for tracking position of a livestock animal in an area of interest over a period of time. The area of interest may be a barn, or a portion of a barn, for housing livestock animals such as dairy cows, sheep, goats etc. The animals carry a sensor device, which may be an ear tag, a leg sensor, a sensor carried around the neck of the animal or a sensor carried inside the body of the animal. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial position of the animal, obtaining angular velocity data related to the movement of the sensor device, and integrating the angular velocity data over time to represent a relative change in the direction of motion of the animal, obtaining acceleration data related to the movement of the sensor device, and integrating the acceleration data twice over time to represent a displacement of the animal, and determining the position of the animal after the period of time based on the displacement of the animal from the initial position.

title: Pneumatic grouping door device for cow breeding
abstract: The invention relates to a pneumatic grouping door device for cow breeding. The pneumatic grouping door device comprises an entrance door unit, a first guardrail, a second guardrail, a grouping door frame, a left grouping door unit, a right grouping door unit and an exit door frame, a left door leaf and a right door leaf in the entrance door unit are respectively arranged on two sides of the entrance door frame and are rotationally connected with the entrance door frame; and the first guardrail and the second guardrail are both arranged between the entrance door frame and the grouping door frame, information identification plates are arranged in the middles of the first guardrail and the second guardrail, and the left grouping door unit and the right grouping door unit are both arranged between the grouping door frame and the exit door frame. According to the pneumatic grouping door device, the information identification plates on the first guardrail and the second guardrail can identify basic information of dairy cows, and meanwhile, the dairy cows can be guided to different channels through the left grouping door unit and the right grouping door unit so as to be grouped to different areas, so that the grouping efficiency and accuracy are improved, and the pneumatic grouping door device has the advantages of simple structure, high practicability, convenience in operation and the like.
applicants: BEIJING KINGPENG GLOBAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: HOUSING FOR STOCK-RAISING SENSOR, AND STOCK-RAISING SENSOR
abstract: To provide a housing for a stock-raising sensor capable of constituting a stock-raising sensor easy to administer orally to livestock.SOLUTION: A housing for a stock-raising sensor contains a resin in which a coefficient of dynamic friction is 0.40 or less and a coefficient of static friction is 0.10 or less.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Intelligent ecological breeding system based on 5G communication technology
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent ecological breeding system based on a 5G communication technology. The intelligent ecological breeding system comprises a communication system, a pig house system and a monitoring system arranged in the pig house system; the pig house system comprises a breeding house and a ventilation structure arranged on the breeding house, an interior of the breeding house is divided into a plurality of compartments through pigsties, and a fermentation bed is laid in each compartment; and each fermentation bed comprises a bed frame, a plurality of padding layers laidin the bed frame and a turnover mechanism for controlling the bed frame to move, the bed frame comprises a bearing chassis and a padding enclosure frame, the padding enclosure frame is connected to four sides of the bearing chassis, and the padding enclosure frame is filled with the padding layers. Through a combination of a modern communication technology and a breeding technology, an intelligentecological breeding is achieved, a breeding cost is effectively reduced, meanwhile, epidemic situation early warning is mastered at the first time, and a breeding risk is reduced.

title: HOUSING FOR STOCK-RAISING SENSOR, AND STOCK-RAISING SENSOR
abstract: To provide a housing for a stock-raising sensor capable of constituting a miniaturizable stock-raising sensor excellent in corrosion resistance and easy to administer orally to livestock, and to provide a stock-raising sensor using the same.SOLUTION: A housing for a stock-raising sensor comprises a metallic housing in which a metal surface is coated with a thermoplastic resin.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: ARRANGEMENT, BOLUS, TAG AND METHOD FOR MONITORING THE PHYSIOLOGICAL STATE OF AN ANIMAL
abstract: An arrangement, an ingestible bolus, a communications interface tag, and a process to monitor the physiological parameters of an animal to determine its health status and provide information for the optimization of livestock management. The ingestible bolus is housed in the stomach of the ruminant and typically comprises multiple sensors such as a temperature sensor, motion sensors, and in particular a conductivity sensor that allows highly accurate measurements of the animal's physiological parameters (such as food intake, water, the absence of diseases, etc.). The tag communicates with the bolus and relays the signals to the wireless communications network to a gateway-type communications interface, which in turn transmits and receives data communications to and from 'the cloud.' Users communicate with the cloud from one or more remote terminals. The invention includes the above mentioned elements and a monitoring software resident in the remote terminals and in the cloud. The process of the invention comprises the testing and monitoring stages carried out by the arrangement.

title: Method and system for monitoring natural mating of barn-fed sheep based on non-contact induction
abstract: The invention discloses a barn-fed sheep natural mating monitoring method and system based on non-contact induction, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the subcutaneous implantation of an implantable RFID biochip with individual uniqueness at the tail root of each ewe, and wearing a data collector on the chest of a ram, the position of the data collector in the direction perpendicular to the ground is lower than the height of the implantable RFID biochips of all ewes; when the ram does not climb across the ewe, the data collector cannot scan any information; when the ram and the single ewe naturally mate and climb across the ewe, the information data collector scans and generates related information and records and adds one; the collected information is transmitted to a server through a remote communication module for statistical analysis; and the data subjected to statistical analysis is read through the data output end. The method can accurately identify the natural mating time and frequency of barn feeding male and ewes, predict the delivery time of the ewes, identify the ewes with reproductive diseases in the sheep flock, facilitate breeding management and reduce the breeding cost.

title: Intelligent feeding device for pigs
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent feeding device for pigs and belongs to the technical field of pig feeding devices. The intelligent feeding device for pigs comprises a storage box, a first mounting plate is fixedly arranged on one side of the storage box, a second mounting plate is arranged above the first mounting plate, two motors are arranged below the first mounting plate, spiral conveying rods are fixedly arranged at output ends of the two motors, and a partition plate is arranged in the storage box. Through an arrangement of the storage box and the partition plate, dry materials and wet materials can be conveniently added separately, through an arrangement of a water tank, a water pump and spray heads, an interior of a feeding trough can be flushed and cleaned, through an arrangement of a receiving hopper, a discharging plate and a bottom plate, the remaining feed can be discharged, and through an arrangement of a control box and a camera, live pigs in a pigsty can be monitored, and through an arrangement of the first mounting plate and the second mounting plate, device mounting can be facilitated.
applicants: SUZHOU WANYING AGRICULTURAL TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT COMPANY

title: Dynamic feedback breeding method and system for pigs
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic feedback breeding method and system for pigs. The breeding method comprises the following steps: the environment of a pig house is monitored and controlled in real time through an environmental control system; an inspection system conducts exploration to obtain pig activity conditions and pig house environment information in real time; a feeding system controls the diet condition of the pigs; after the environmental control system, the inspection system and the feeding system obtain the information, the information is uploaded to a background control system, and the background control system processes and analyzes the information and return an analysis result; when the inspection system obtains that the pig house environment information is abnormal, the information is sent to the environmental control system and is regulated and controlled by the environmental control system; and when the pigs are abnormal in the eating process, the feeding system sends alarm information to the inspection system, and the inspection system detects the pigs and feeds detection information back to the background control system. Pigs in a pig house can be well managed, a comfortable environment in the pig house can be created, and higher economic benefits can be created.
applicants: GUANGZHOU JIAEN TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; SOUTH CHINA AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY

title: Animal husbandry system
abstract: The present invention relates to an animal husbandry system, wherein a group of animals (2, 3, 4) can move about freely in a shed (1), a plurality of sensors (5) being provided, suitable for monitoring respective different regions of the shed (1), the sensors (5) being provided in such a way that, collectively, they are suitable for monitoring substantially the complete shed (1), an animal identification system being provided, suitable for identifying and locating individual animals (2, 3, 4) in the shed (1), processing means being provided, operatively connected to the sensors (5) and to the animal identification system, said processing means being programmed for determining for each individual animal (2, 3, 4) a urinating and/or defecating pattern orfrequency. In this way, a highly useful system is realized. The invention is based on the insight that, firstly, in order to be able to monitor the health status of animals, urinating and/or defecating patterns or frequencies are highly meaningful. Secondly, they render an efficient cleaning of the shed possible.

title: Pasture breeding risk prompting method and device and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a pasture breeding risk prompting method comprising the following steps: obtaining breeding cost in a historical first preset time period, wherein the breeding cost comprises feeding cost, labor cost and drug investment cost; determining predicted breeding cost in a second preset time period in the future according to the breeding cost in the historical first preset time period, wherein the first preset time period is the same as or different from the second preset time period; obtaining the average weight and the average meat increasing amplitude of livestock in a historical first preset time period; determining predicted weight in the second preset time period in the future according to the average weight and the average meat increasing amplitude; obtaining the entry weight and price information of the livestock; determining predicted livestock assets in the second preset time period in the future according to the approach weight, the predicted weight and the price information; determining a predicted breeding risk value according to the predicted breeding cost and the predicted livestock assets; and displaying prompt information corresponding to the breeding risk value. The accuracy of pasture breeding risk prediction is improved.

title: Sow estrus detection method and device
abstract: The invention relates to a sow oestrus detection method and device. The sow oestrus detection method comprises the steps that boar pheromones are released to sows; playing a boar courtship sound to the sows; interacting with the sows by using the mouths and noses of bionic boars; collecting image data of the sows; processing the image data by using a model based on a deep learning algorithm to obtain sow oestrus detection data; and the model based on the deep learning algorithm comprises a Mask R-CNN model, the sow oestrus detection data comprise appearance characteristic data during sow oestrus and interaction data with the mouths and noses of the bionic boars. Good bionic estrus checking and testing effects are achieved by releasing boar pheromones and playing boar courtship sound and matching with the mouths and the noses of the bionic boars, and rapid and intelligent estrus detection is achieved by collecting images and intelligently processing the images.

title: Animal oestrus monitoring device and method
abstract: The invention provides an animal oestrus monitoring device and method. The animal oestrus monitoring device comprises an oestrus testing module, an image data collection module, an infrared module anda data identification module; the oestrus testing module is used for releasing male animal pheromones, wherein the male animal pheromones are used for stimulating a female animal to be monitored to generate estrus performance; the image data collection module is used for collecting image information of the female animal to be monitored; the infrared module is used for acquiring body temperature information of the female animal to be monitored; and the data identification module is used for determining the identity and the estrus state of the female animal to be monitored according to the image information and the body temperature information. Non-contact and non-stress physiological information perception can be carried out on the animal, so that the oestrus state of the animal can be monitored, and the optimal mating and pregnancy opportunity can be mastered.

title: Wearable multi-parameter animal health index acquisition device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of veterinary electronics, and discloses a wearable multi-parameter animal health index acquisition device, which comprises a shell, a mobile phone APP, an acquisition system, a mounting base, a livestock face recognition camera, a breeding fence entrance camera and an rfid reader, and is characterized in that the upper surface of the mounting base is fixedly connected with a slideway, and one side of the slideway is movably connected with a sliding block. The sliding block is fixedly connected with the shell, grooves are formed in the lower surface of the sliding block and the lower surface of the shell, a module box, a wireless transmitter and a processor are fixedly connected into the grooves, the processor is connected with the wireless transmitter through a signal line, and the wireless transmitter is connected with a mobile phone APP through a signal line. According to the device, various acquired data can be used for comprehensively judging the body states of cattle and sheep, so that the disease types of cattle and sheep can be judged, various common diseases of cattle and sheep can be diagnosed and predicted, the cattle and sheep can be monitored in real time, the management is comprehensive in long-term use, the cost is reduced, and the practicability of the device is improved.
applicants: JIANGSU BROADCASTING NETWORK TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT COMPANY

title: Intelligent supervision and management system for living cows
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent supervision and management system for living cows. The intelligent supervision and management system comprises a data acquisition terminal, an alarm platform, an intelligent control platform and a monitoring and management platform. The intelligent supervision and management system has the beneficial effects that the system can keep at a gate, and detects and records possible or ongoing behaviors, such as cow departure, cow culling and cow entering, which may affect the loss or value reduction of guaranteed products; according to the intelligent supervision and management system, the number of the cows can be checked, object tracking and monitoring equipment is deployed in a certain channel or a certain cowshed, and an AI algorithm is used for counting and recording the number of the passed cows; according to the intelligent supervision and management system, the supervision process can be intelligently recorded, a certain logic data rule is formulated for judgment, early warning information is sent to a risk management platform after a certain preset standard is reached, and data are returned to a company system data storage server; and according to the system, through the alarm platform, supervisors can quickly know the risk, manual checking is facilitated, manual monitoring is facilitated, and confirmation of the ownership of the dairy cows and supervision of other movable properties are facilitated.

title: Respiratory metabolism cage for accurate feeding and automatic metabolism monitoring of goats
abstract: The invention discloses a respiratory metabolism cage for accurate feeding and automatic metabolism monitoring of goats. The respiratory metabolism cage comprises a closed metabolism cage body, wherein an inner cavity of the closed metabolism cage body is divided into a goat activity area and an excrement and urine separation and collection area by an excrement leakage plate; an air inlet conduit, a water inlet pipe, a feeding pipe, a trough and a gas detection sensor are arranged in the goat activity area, and a video acquisition and infrared device is arranged at the top of the goat activity area; an excrement blocking screen plate is arranged below the excrement leakage plate, an excrement pushing plate is arranged at one end of the excrement blocking screen plate, and an excrement collecting box is arranged at the other end of the excrement blocking screen plate; a urine guide plate is arranged below the excrement blocking screen plate, a urine guide opening is formed in the urine guide plate and communicates with a urine collecting basin arranged on the bottom surface of an inner cavity of the metabolism cage body through a guide pipe, and a heat conduction pipe is arranged on the lower bottom surface of the urine guide plate; an air outlet conduit is arranged in an area defined by the urine guide plate, the bottom surface of the inner cavity of the metabolism cage body and the inner wall of the metabolism cage body, a water level sensor and a liquid component sensor are arranged in the urine collecting basin, and a urination switch is arranged at the bottom of the urine collecting basin; and pressure sensors are arranged at four corners of the bottom surface of the trough, four corners of the lower bottom surface of the excrement leaking plate and four corners of the lower bottom surface of the excrement blocking screen plate.

title: Pig feeding system for Chinese herbal medicine treatment of African swine fever
abstract: The present invention discloses a pig feeding system for Chinese herbal medicine treatment of African swine fever. The pig feeding system comprises a plurality of feeding channels which can be arranged in parallel, each feeding channel can only allow one pig to enter, a front end of each feeding channel is provided with a feeding trough, the pig feeding system is also provided with a stirring tank, a medicine boiling tank and a smoke making furnace, and cameras are arranged at upper right parts of feeding openings.
