The pig feeding system is intelligent and more accurate to control, a treatmenteffect is better by uniformly stirring traditional Chinese medicine liquid and fluid pig food and facilitating absorption, water for food stirring and cleaning is pure water obtained after high-temperature sterilization, viruses can be effectively prevented from infecting cured pigs again through a water source, the pigs are fed in the independent feeding channels, cross infection is avoided, smoke generated by carbonizing traditional Chinese medicinal materials is used for smoking and roasting through the smoke making furnace, a pig house and air in the pig house can be sterilized and disinfected, meanwhile, and treated pigs can sleep peacefully so that blood sampling can be conducted to analyze a treatment effect. A feeding situation of the pigs is observed conveniently to judge the treatment effect conveniently.

title: Automatic feed supplying and cleaning system for breeding
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic feed supplying and cleaning system for breeding. The system comprises a server, a cloud database, a feed price recommendation module, a display module, a feed detection module, a feed cleaning module, a feed crushing module, a feed detection dispensing module, an operation module, a cub rescue module, a three-dimensional viewing module, a monitoring module, a sow feeding module and a life cycle module, wherein the server is connected to the cloud database, the feed price recommendation module, the display module, the feed detection module, the feed cleaning module, the feed crushing module, the feed detection and dispensing module, the operation module, the cub rescue module, the three-dimensional viewing module, the monitoring module, the sow feeding module and the life cycle module through cables and a network. and the feed detection module comprises a smell detection module, a chemical detection module and a humidity detection module. The automatic feed supplying and cleaning system for the breeding has the advantages that intelligent work is achieved, feed reasonably matches along with the growth cycle, and cubs are rescued.
applicants: WUHAN XINKE WISDOM AGRICULTURE AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Dairy cow body condition scoring method based on deep learning and point cloud convex hull features
abstract: The invention relates to a dairy cow body condition scoring method based on deep learning and point cloud convex hull features, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. The method includes the steps of obtaining a depth image of the back of a target dairy cow, carrying out rotation, and enabling the spinal direction of the dairy cow in the image to be parallel to the horizontal axis of the image; removing the front body part of the dairy cow in the image, obtaining a dairy cow rear body depth image, and converting the dairy cow rear body image into a point cloud to obtain a rear body point cloud; carrying out voxel rasterization, carrying out convex hull processing, determining a minimum convex polyhedron containing all voxel clouds, and calculating a feature distance; sequentially replacing a coordinate value of the center of gravity of each voxel of the voxel clouds with a voxel number and the feature distance to obtain a feature image of the rear body of the dairy cow; and obtaining a plurality of feature images processed in each step, performing pre-training by using a convolutional neural network model, and then performing body condition scoring by using the trained convolutional neural network model. Compared with an existing method, the dairy cow body condition scoring method based on the deep learning and point cloud convex hull features is simple in principle, high in reliability and high in application value.
applicants: HENAN UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title: Intelligent pig raising monitoring system
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent pig raising monitoring system, and relates to the technical field of breeding. The system comprises a data acquisition and monitoring system and a cloud platform, and the data acquisition and monitoring system comprises a data acquisition module, a communication module and a human-computer interface. The energy consumption data of the pig farm can be monitored in real time, and a data basis is provided for energy conservation and emission reduction of enterprises; environmental data of the pig farm can be monitored in real time, the good living environment of the pig farm is maintained, and the health condition of pigs is guaranteed. Information communication between upper-layer management and the pig farm site is realized, and standardized and unified enterprise production process data is formed.

title: Bluetooth lighting ear tag and motion early warning method using same
abstract: A Bluetooth lighting ear tag and a motion early warning method using the ear tag are provided. The structural design is simple and reasonable, the size and weight of a whole electronic chip can be reduced, the investment cost can be reduced, and the Bluetooth lighting ear tag comprises an ear tag body worn on an animal ear and the electronic chip packaged in the ear tag body. The electronic chip comprises an information acquisition module, a communication module and a power supply module; the power supply module is used for supplying power to the information acquisition module and the communication module, the information acquisition module comprises an acceleration sensor, the acceleration sensor is used for acquiring acceleration information of an animal, and the communication module comprises a Bluetooth chip; the acceleration sensor is connected with the Bluetooth chip through a sensor connecting circuit, the electronic chip further comprises an LED lamp, the LED lamp is connected with the Bluetooth chip, and the Bluetooth chip is in communication connection with a remote terminal.

title: Inspection helmet and inspection method for livestock and poultry farm
abstract: The invention discloses an inspection helmet and an inspection method for a livestock and poultry farm. The inspection helmet is wirelessly connected with a farm online management system on the cloudplatform; the inspection helmet comprises a helmet body, a controller, an AR display assembly, an infrared camera and a visible light camera. The AR display assembly is fixed to the edge of the bottomof the helmet body. The infrared camera and the visible light camera are arranged on the helmet body. The infrared camera can be used for electrically connecting the light camera and the AR display assembly with the controller. The infrared camera and the visible light camera are used for shooting livestock and poultry pictures in an area in front of a wearer to obtain livestock and poultry temperature and livestock and poultry images. The controller is used for processing the livestock and poultry temperature and the livestock and poultry image by adopting an AR technology to obtain an AR image. and the AR display assembly displays the AR image. According to the invention, convenient and safe inspection of the livestock and poultry farm is realized.

title: Intelligent pig raising system based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent breeding, and discloses an intelligent pig raising system based on the Internet of Things. The intelligent pig raising system comprises an environment information acquisition module, a dynamic control strategy module, a processing module, an execution module, a live pig information acquisition module and a storage module, wherein the processing module is used for calling body temperature information in the storage module and analyzing the body temperature information, a pig cold quantity result is obtained, and if the pig cold quantity result is larger than zero, relevant information in the storage module is called, the reason of a cold pig is analyzed, strategy adjustment information is generated and sent to the dynamic control strategy module, and the dynamic control strategy module updates a predicted control strategy after receiving the strategy adjustment information. According to the intelligent pig raising system based on the Internet of Things, room temperature after whether a pig catch a cold or not is judged is controlled in the first time, so that room temperature regulation and control are more accurate.

title: Livestock nursing system based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock nursing system based on Internet of Things. The livestock nursing system comprises a food supply module, a room temperature adjusting module, a cleaning module, a disease monitoring module, a disinfection and sterilization module, a display, an APP client and a server, the food supply module is used for providing livestock food and water, the room temperature adjusting module is used for controlling room temperature, the cleaning module is used for cleaning and hygiene, the disease monitoring module is used for monitoring the health condition of livestock and finding sick livestock in time, the disinfection and sterilization module is used for disinfection and sterilization, the display is used for displaying each state value of the nursing system, the server provides software and hardware services for all the modules running on the server, and the APP client can receive data of each module and can control each module. The livestock nursing system has the beneficial effects that on the basis of the technology of the Internet of Things, automatic grain feeding, automatic water feeding, automatic cleaning, disinfection and sterilization, temperature adjustment and livestock health condition monitoring can be achieved, and the survival rate and quality of livestock are improved.

title: Intelligent pig house monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent pig house monitoring system, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent breeding. An infrared temperature sensing camera transmits collected original pig house image data to a pig house monitoring platform through a control host; a manager marks live pig information and breeding environment information on an image; the pig house monitoring platform opens AI automatic model training; a matched breeding model is established; the breeding model verifies whether the breeding state of a pig house is abnormal according to the real-time image data and the real-time environment data; when the breeding state of the pig house is abnormal, the pig house monitoring platform gives an alarm prompt, informs the manager and makes a response instruction according to the abnormal type; and the control host regulates and controls the pig house environment or verifies the live pig condition according to the response instruction. The intelligent pig house monitoring system disclosed by the invention can perform real-time monitoring and timely make adaptive emergency response according to the types of abnormal emergencies occurring in the breeding process, the sensitivity of system monitoring is in a reasonable interval, and the response processing process is sensitive and reliable.

title: Ammonia gas management control system for pig farm
abstract: The invention discloses an ammonia gas management control system for a pig farm, relates to the technical field of ammonia gas management control, and solves the technical problem of low ammonia gas detection efficiency caused by incapability of performing region division on the farm and performing ammonia gas detection on each region in the prior art. Ammonia gas in the pig farm is detected through an ammonia gas detection unit, ammonia gas data of all areas in the pig farm are obtained, ammonia gas detection coefficients Xi of all the areas are obtained through a formula, and if the ammonia gas detection coefficients of the areas are larger than or equal to an ammonia gas detection coefficient threshold value, an ammonia gas abnormal signal is generated, the ammonia gas abnormal signal and the corresponding area are sent to a management control platform, and after the management control platform receives the ammonia gas abnormal signal, a health detection signal is generated and sent to a health detection unit; and the farm is divided into regions, and ammonia gas detection is carried out on each region, so that the ammonia gas detection efficiency is improved, and the working intensity of managers is also reduced.
applicants: FENGTAI COUNTY ZHENGXIANG AGRICULTURE TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT COMPANY

title: Cattle herd feeding management method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a cattle herd feeding management method and system, and the method comprises the steps: inputting a budget parameter, generating standard lactation curves of different birth times according to a wood model and a lactation curve model parameter level, and simulating and deducing the daily cattle herd structure change on the basis of a cattle herd and according to a cattle herd breeding logic model; generating milk yield per day of each cattle through the cattle herd breeding logic model and the lactation curve model; on the basis of the milk yield and the cattle herd structure and in combined with a feed model, calculating the demand quantity of various materials; and obtaining the income according to the milk yield in an income cost model, obtaining the cost according to the demand quantity of the materials, obtaining the average per unit yield according to the lactation curve of each cow, and finally matching financial accounting. According to the method and system, the problems of inaccurate production performance budget, inaccurate material purchase and low fund use efficiency and accuracy in dairy cow production are solved, and the black hole cost of pasture management is greatly reduced.
applicants: GANSU XIANGMU AGRICULTURAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Control system capable of regulating and controlling farm fan randomly
abstract: The invention discloses a control system capable of regulating and controlling a farm fan randomly. The system comprises a control module, a storage module, a cloud end, a display module, a sensor module, a sunlight irradiation module, a fan voltage detection module, a fan fault alarm module, a bacterium detection module, a protection module, a fan module, a livestock detection module, a ventilation plate module, a solar module and a time module. The control module is connected with the storage module, the cloud, the display module, the sensor module, the sunlight irradiation module, the fan voltage detection module, the fan fault alarm module, the bacterium detection module, the protection module, the fan module, the livestock detection module, the ventilation plate module, the solar module and the time module through cables and a network. The protection module comprises a touch detection module, a video recording module and a touch warning module. The control system capable of regulating and controlling the farm fan randomly has the advantages of saving energy and electricity, guaranteeing clean air of a breeding environment, protecting equipment and sterilizing through sunlight.

title: Boar estrus inducing fence pigsty with gilt monitoring
abstract: The invention discloses a boar estrus inducing fence pigsty with replacement gilt monitoring. The boar estrus inducing fence pigsty comprises boar fences, gilt fences, camera equipment used for capturing image signals, and a gilt recognition system; the center of a pigsty is provided with 5-8 pig fences, wherein at least four boar fences are arranged, and at least two gilt fences are arranged; a personnel passage is reserved on the other side of the long edge of the pigsty, and arranged on the two sides of a pigsty partition; the gilt recognition system judges estrus behaviors of gilts througha support vector machine and a three-axis accelerator to confirm estrus replacement gilts. According to the boar estrus inducing fence pigsty with gilt monitoring, guarding breeders can monitor a plurality of pigsties through the gilt recognition system at the same time, the number of guarding breeders can be effectively reduced in a unit area, meanwhile, the feeding amount of replacement gilts is increased, sufficient replacement gilt resources are provided for pig breeding, and the breeding efficiency of the pig breeding is improved.
applicants: CHONGQING LIUJIU ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Boar estrus inducing fence pigsty with gilt monitoring
abstract: The invention discloses a boar estrus inducing fence pigsty with replacement gilt monitoring. The boar estrus inducing fence pigsty comprises boar fences, gilt fences, camera equipment for collectingimages and a gilt recognition system, wherein two rows of boar estrus inducing fences in the center of a pigsty are sequentially arranged on one side of the long edge of the center of the pigsty in parallel, and the two rows of boar estrus inducing fences are spaced by 50 cm and arranged on the two sides of a pigsty partition, the gilt recognition system judges estrus behaviors of gilts through asupport vector machine and a three-axis accelerator to confirm estrus replacement gilts. According to the boar estrus inducing fence pigsty with gilt monitoring, guarding breeders can monitor a plurality of pigsties through the gilt recognition system at the same time, the number of guarding breeders can be effectively reduced in a unit area, meanwhile, the feeding amount of replacement gilts is increased, sufficient replacement gilt resources are provided for pig breeding, and the breeding efficiency of the pig breeding is improved.
applicants: CHONGQING LIUJIU ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Boar estrus-inducing fence pigsty with replacement gilt monitoring function
abstract: A boar estrus-inducing fence pigsty with a replacement sow monitoring function comprises boar fences, gilt fences and camera equipment used for collecting image signals, and 5-8 fences are arranged inthe center of the pig house, wherein at least four boar fences are arranged, and at least two gilt fences are arranged. The boar estrus-inducing fence pig house further comprises a gilt recognition system, and the gilt recognition system judges the estrus behaviors of gilts through a convolutional neural network and a three-axis accelerator to confirm replacement gilts in estrus. According to theboar estrus-inducing fence pigsty, a guarding breeder can monitor multiple pigsties through the gilt recognition system at the same time, the number of guarding breeders can be effectively reduced inunit area, meanwhile, the amount of the raised replacement gilts is increased, sufficient replacement gilt resources are provided for breeding boars, and the breeding efficiency of the breeding boarsis improved.
applicants: CHONGQING LIUJIU ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Full-life-cycle monitoring ear tag
abstract: The invention discloses a full-life-cycle monitoring ear tag. The ear tag comprises an upper shell, a lower shell and a main control panel, the upper shell is connected with the lower shell, the main control panel is installed between the upper shell and the lower shell, and the main control panel is provided with an indicator lamp, a temperature sensor, a Bluetooth communication chip, a motion control sensor, a magnetic induction sensor and a battery. The Bluetooth communication chip is connected with the indicator lamp, the temperature sensor, the motion control sensor, the magnetic induction sensor and the battery. According to the full-life-cycle monitoring ear tag manufactured through the technical scheme, sign information of monitored organisms can be collected through various sensors, the Bluetooth communication technology is adopted, data are transmitted to a cloud platform in real time through a gateway to be analyzed, and the management efficiency is effectively improved.

title: Rechargeable wireless body temperature detection device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of body temperature detection, in particular to a rechargeable wireless body temperature detection device. The device comprises a front-end shell, a rear-end shell, a thermometer, a plurality of metal elastic pieces and a balancing weight; the metal elastic pieces are connected between the first wedge block of the front-end shell and the second wedge block of the rear-end shell, the surface of the balancing weight is divided into a plurality of rhombic blocks through a first spiral groove and a second spiral groove in the outer circle face of the balancing weight, the outer surfaces of the rhombic blocks are fully covered with magnetic pieces, and the metal elastic pieces are installed on the first wedge block through a floating screw. The inner end of the floating screw is connected with a strip-shaped magnet. The floating screw moves up and down through different stresses of the metal elastic pieces, different magnetic poles of the strip-shaped magnet are matched with the magnetic pole of the magnetic piece, the balancing weight moves front and back to enable the strip-shaped magnet to move along the first spiral groove and the second spiral groove on the same side, and the rotating direction of the front-end shell is consistent when the balancing weight moves forwards or backwards. The change trend of the metal elastic pieces is consistent so as to adapt to different pressures of the ear canals of livestock.

title: Robot for farm inspection and farm inspection system
abstract: The invention discloses a robot for farm inspection, which comprises a communication module, a motion control module, an image acquisition module and an image analysis module, and the robot can work in a farm according to an inspection task issued by a platform through division of labor and cooperation of each model, so that on one hand, the purpose of remotely monitoring livestock can be achieved, the manual inspection task executed in the farm is replaced, the manual workload is reduced, the inspection cost is reduced, and on the other hand, the robot can analyze the physiological state of the livestock according to the image for reference by workers, the manual workload is further reduced, and the inspection efficiency is improved. In addition, the invention further provides a farm inspection system, and the technical effects of the farm inspection system correspond to the technical effects of the robot.

title: Livestock breeding dynamic supervision service device and equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock breeding, in particular to a livestock breeding dynamic supervision service device and equipment. The device comprises an electronic ear tag which carries the identity information of each livestock, a monitoring robot which is erected above breeding houses and used for collecting livestock dynamic video data in each breeding house, a dietary state monitoring module which is used for monitoring the dietary state of livestock in each breeding house based on sensor groups arranged in a feed trough and a drinking trough, and an intelligent terminal which is used for processing the livestock dynamic video data and identifying the abnormal state of each livestock in the current breeding house and the abnormal states in the feed trough and the drinking trough. The livestock breeding dynamic supervision service device and equipment are also used for realizing intelligent regulation and control of the environment in the farm and registration and analysis of livestock food intake. According to the invention, automatic identification of the abnormal state in the livestock breeding process can be realized, so that dangerous factors existing in the livestock breeding process can be discovered and eliminated in time, and a guarantee is provided for benefits of livestock breeding.

title: Feeding device for detecting health of dairy cow
abstract: The invention discloses a feeding device for detecting the health of a dairy cow. The feeding device comprises a machine body and is characterized in that a power space is arranged in the machine body, a power mechanism used for providing power for the device is arranged in the power space, a feeding space with an upward opening is formed in the upper side of the power space, and a pushing and scraping mechanism for clearing residual food of the dairy cow is arranged in the feeding space. According to the device, the residual food of the dairy cow can be effectively cleared and collected, meanwhile, the residual food is metered, the labor intensity of workers for clearing the residual food of the dairy cow is greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the workers can conveniently judge the health degree of the dairy cow; and meanwhile, secondary pollution of residual food to newly added food is prevented, and bacteria breeding of the residual food is avoided, so that the disease probability of the dairy cow is greatly reduced, the body health of the dairy cow is improved, and the milk yield of the dairy cow is increased.

title: Livestock water supply system that provides monitoring of water intake for each breeding individual
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock water supply system that provides a monitoring function of water intake per individual breeding. More specifically, the present invention relates to the livestock water supply system that provides the monitoring function of water intake per individual breeding enabling real-time monitoring of water intake amount per individual breeding, and having an effect of increasing the water intake amount of a livestock whose water intake is not smooth by adjusting a salinity of the water that has been water supplied. Therefore, the present invention is capable of having an effect of suppressing growth of bacteria.

title: Feeding detection system
abstract: The invention relates to a feeding detection system. According to the feeding detection system, the feed feeding amount is preliminarily determined according to the age and the body type of livestock and poultry, the feed feeding amount is adjusted in real time according to the daily exercise amount of the livestock and poultry before feeding each time is carried out, an intelligent real-time identification system determines relational data of nutrition demand quantity of the livestock and poultry at different age stages, a central control processor controls feed ingredients and controls feed feeding according to the nutritional ingredient requirements of the intelligent real-time identification system, a feedback system collects biological information of the livestock and poultry in real time and transmits the obtained information to the central control processor, and therefore the whole process is automatically controlled, it is guaranteed that the feeding amount of feed is sufficient, meanwhile, the feed can be saved, and the breeding cost is reduced.

title: Intelligent field livestock monitoring system
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent field livestock monitoring system. The intelligent field livestock monitoring system comprises intelligent terminal equipment and livestock monitoring equipment. The livestock monitoring equipment comprises a livestock necklace shell, a necklace movement power generation device is arranged in the livestock necklace shell, the necklace movement power generation device is connected with a farad capacitor, an NB-IOT module is further arranged in the livestock necklace shell, and the NB-IOT module is electrically connected with the farad capacitor. The system further comprises a cloud server, the NB-IOT module is in wireless connection with the cloud server, and the cloud server is in wireless connection with the intelligent terminal equipment. The NB-IOT module can send information such as the activity range, the motion state, the activity route, the position, the body temperature and the health state of the livestock to the intelligent terminal equipment through the cloud server, the condition of the livestock can be obtained without manual inspection, and the management effect of the livestock is greatly improved.

title: Quality Sensor, Computer-Implemented Method of Predicting Inhomogeneities in Milk Extracted from an Animal, Computer Program and Non-Volatile Data Carrier
abstract: A quality sensor (200) predicts a degree of inhomogeneities in milk extracted from an animal by receiving a set of input variables (DIN) reflecting at least one characteristic respectively of: the animal, the extracted milk, and at least process during which milk was extracted from the animal. In response to the set of input variables (DIN) , a trained artificial neural network (210) in the quality sensor (200) generates an estimate (DOUT) of the predicted degree of inhomogeneities in the milk. The trained artificial neural network (210) preferably has weights (w1, ..., wij) determined via a training process involving scoring of densities of milk clot deposits on filters through which extracted milk has been passed during milk extraction processes in relation to training data expressing the set of input variables. The scoring of the densities of milk clot deposits on the filters expresses output training data.

title: Method and system for estrus detection of a mammal
abstract: A method for estrus detection of a mammal is provided. Therewith activity data (Ai) is obtained (Sl). The activity data is indicative for a degree and/or type of activity as a function of time for an activity of the mammal, an indicated degree and/or type of activity being selected from at least two potential indications for a degree and/or type of activity. Based on the activity data, one or more activity switch counts (ASĳ) are determined (S2). The activity switch counts (ASĳ) are indicative for a number of switches in indicated type and/or degree of activity during an evaluation time interval of a predetermined duration. Respective relative activity switch scores (ZLij, ZSij) are computed (S3) for the activity switch counts. On the basis of the respective relative activity switch scores it is determined (S4) whether or not (E/-E) the mammal is in estrus.

title: Livestock anus temperature measuring device and method
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock anus temperature measuring device and method, and belongs to the technical field of agriculture. The invention provides a livestock anus temperature measuring device, which comprises a tail mounting assembly and an anus temperature measuring assembly, wherein the tail mounting assembly is reversibly fixed on the tail root of a livestock in a one-way manner; one end of the anus temperature measuring assembly is mounted on the tail mounting assembly, the other end of the anus temperature measuring assembly is used for being inserted into the anus of the livestock, and the anus temperature measuring assembly comprises a plurality of temperature measuring sections in the length direction of the anus temperature measuring assembly; when the livestock warps the tail, the anus temperature measuring assembly can be driven by the tail mounting assembly to slide towards the exterior of the anus of the livestock; and when the livestock puts back the tail, the anus temperature measuring assembly can be pushed to slide towards the interior of the anus of the livestock through the tail mounting assembly. The invention further provides a livestock anus temperature measuring method. According to the livestock anus temperature measuring device and method, the temperature sensor can be arranged in the anus of the livestock for a long time, so that the body temperature of the livestock is continuously monitored.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF AGRICULTURAL ECONOMICS AND INFORMATION, JIANGXI ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Cattle behavior automatic recognition and the monitoring system using the deep learning and method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and a method for automatically recognizing and monitoring animal behavior using deep learning, which can automatically recognize, detect, and analyze the behavior of livestock using animal behavior annotation to perform an alarm when a dangerous situation occurs, thereby automatically monitoring animal behavior in real time. The system includes: a livestock behavior annotation definition module for defining a livestock behavior annotation by performing hierarchical labeling of a type of livestock behavior; a livestock behavior automatic detection module for detecting a livestock behavior using deep learning based on a real-time input video; a livestock behavior data storage module; a first livestock behavior analysis module for requesting a dangerous situation generation alarm to a registered breeder terminal when a short-term behavior monitoring result is confirmed as a dangerous situation; a second livestock behavior analysis module for requesting a dangerous situation generation alarm to a registered breeder terminal when a long-term behavior monitoring result is confirmed as a dangerous situation; a livestock behavior alarm module for generating and transmitting a dangerous situation generation alarm message to the registered breeder terminal when the request for the transmission of the dangerous situation generation alarm is received; and a communication module.
applicants: INDUSTRIAL COOPERATION FOUNDATION JEONBUK NATIONAL UNIVERSITY; MOKPO NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIA COOPERATION GROUP

title: Automatic activity intensity monitoring, analyzing and managing system for miniature pig feeding
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic activity intensity monitoring, analyzing and managing system for miniature pig feeding. The automatic activity intensity monitoring, analyzing and managing system comprises a limb number marking unit, a pressure measuring unit, a data processing center, a walking stride input unit, a body weight analysis unit, a GPS positioning unit, a step number statistics unit, an activity intensity analysis unit, a pressure comparison unit, a behavior abnormity alarm unit, an activity shooting unit and an abnormity checking unit. Miniature pressure sensors are installed at the bottoms of the four limbs of each miniature pig to measure the pressure of the four limbs of the miniature pig on the ground when the miniature pig walks so as to confirm the weight of the miniature pig, the miniature pigs are divided into a light type and a heavy type according to the weight, the movement distances of different types of miniature pigs are confirmed through the GPS positioning unit, walking strides of different types of miniature pigs are called through big data, walking step numbers of the miniature pigs are counted by combining the movement distances and the walking strides to analyze the activity intensity, meanwhile, the walking states of the miniature pigs are monitored, the exercise amount of the miniature pigs can be adjusted according to the monitoring result to control the body weight, and the healthy miniature pigs which are good in state and used for feeding are obtained.
applicants: TIAN YUGUANG; GUANGZHOU SOUTHERN MEDICAL UNIVERSITY LABORATORY ANIMAL TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT CO., LTD.

title: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE AND INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD
abstract: The present invention pertains to an information processing device and an information processing method with which it is possible to effectively green deserts and regenerate ecosystems using livestock. The information processing device is provided with an evaluation unit for evaluating, on the basis of the behavior content of a herd of grazed domestic animals and/or the state of a passage area which the herd has passed though, the degree of contribution of the herd to the desert greening or ecosystem regeneration. The present technology can be applied to, for example, a system for greening deserts and regenerating ecosystems using livestock.

title: Livestock and poultry breeding inspection robot
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock and poultry breeding inspection robot which comprises a walking chassis; the walking chassis is provided with a storage battery; the walking chassis is provided with a disinfecting and killing mechanism, a telescopic support rod, a controller, a navigation mechanism and an acquisition mechanism; the acquisition mechanism comprises a fixed rod, an image acquisition camera, a temperature measurement infrared camera and a temperature and humidity sensor; the image acquisition camera and the temperature measurement infrared camera are both fixed on the fixed rod through a holder; the temperature and humidity sensor is fixed on the fixed rod; the fixed rod is fixed at the top of the telescopic support rod; the navigation mechanism comprises a GPS module and a magnetic navigation sensor; the GPS module and the magnetic navigation sensor are both fixed on the walking chassis; and the image acquisition camera, the temperature measurement infrared camera, the temperature and humidity sensor, a rotating mechanism, the GPS module and the magnetic navigation sensor are all connected with the controller. The livestock and poultry breeding inspection robot adopting the structure is wide in application range, has multiple navigation modes, and has disinfection and humidification functions.

title: HEALTH MONITORING SYSTEM AND DEVICE FOR LIVESTOCK
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to a monitoring device (100) for remotely monitoring health of a young livestock animal (10), the device (100) comprising: an elongated body (110) within predefined dimensional limits; and a set of electronic components housed within the elongated body (110), the electronic components comprising: a temperature sensor for measuring body temperature of the young livestock animal (10); a computer processor for processing the measured temperature into temperature data; and a wireless communications component for transmitting the temperature data to a remote computer device (210) for processing to monitor the health of the young livestock animal (10), wherein the predefined dimensional limits of the elongated body (110) enable the monitoring device (100) to be orally administrable into the young livestock animal (10) and to remain inside its stomach (12) without being excreted.

title: IP Swine disease forecasting system using infrared IP camera
abstract: Provided is a pig disease predicting system using an infrared IP camera. The pig disease predicting system comprises: an IP camera; a storing device; and a server. The IP camera consists of a thermal image sensor consisting of a thermopile array sensor. The storing device controls the IP camera to measure pig temperature for each space through the thermal image sensor of the IP camera, and collects pig body temperature data for each space. The server is connected to the storing device through a network to be operated, applies seasonal and climate variables, and correction variables related to food activity to the pig body temperature data, and determines pig disease infection for each pig object or pig colony by comparing the pig body temperature data to which the correction variables are applied with temperature data for each pig disease. The present invention can prevent spread of diseases in advance by confirming health states and disease infection of breeding pigs in real time.

title: Physiological and biochemical marker and evaluation method for heat resistance difference between different goat varieties
abstract: The invention discloses a physiological and biochemical marker and evaluation method for heat resistance difference between different goat varieties. The method comprises the following steps of S1, selecting three different varieties of goats for testing; S2, measuring the environment temperature and humidity of each sheep house; S3, measuring the physiological indexes of the goats; S4, determining biochemical indexes of goat blood; S5, carrying out statistical analysis on the tested data; and S6, comparing and analyzing the influence of the different blood biochemical indexes among the varieties on the group structure through test data. When PCA clustering analysis is carried out on different blood biochemical indexes of three varieties of goats, it is found that obvious population separation exists between the Leizhou goats and the Nubia goats, the difference between the Leizhou goats and the Nubia goats is between two parent populations, the population structure differentiated between the varieties is consistent with the genetic relationship constructed based on genome SNP markers, therefore, it proves that the biochemical molecular marker related to the heat stress has formed a stable hereditary basis in the variety.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL SCIENCE, GUANGDONG ACADEMY OFAGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Animal husbandry veterinary rearing cage with monitoring and alarming functions
abstract: The invention discloses an animal husbandry veterinary rearing cage with monitoring and alarming functions. The animal husbandry veterinary rearing cage comprises a rearing cage body, a feeding chamber and a toilet chamber are correspondingly formed in the two sides of the interior of the rearing cage body, and monitoring and protecting mechanisms are correspondingly arranged in the feeding chamber and the toilet chamber. A first clamp and a second clamp sleeve the outer wall of a supporting plate, a fifth lead screw is used for position fixing, a camera is placed between a first buckling plate and a second buckling plate, and the first buckling plate and the second buckling plate adjust the fixing space under the elastic effect of an elastic belt according to the size of the camera. A sixth screw rod is used for fixing the position of the camera, the camera shooting angle is adjusted by adjusting a gooseneck rod, an adjusting baffle is pulled upwards, so that sliding blocks on the two sides of the adjusting baffle slide in a first sliding groove through the elastic force of a reset spring, threaded holes in the corresponding positions are selected, and a third screw rod is used for fixing, so that a monitoring and adjusting mechanism is protected.

title: Livestock and poultry house breeding environment temperature prediction control system and regulation and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock and poultry house breeding environment temperature prediction control system and a regulation and control method thereof. The control system comprises a temperature and humidity sensor, a breeding environment temperature dynamic demand module, an environment controller and an environment regulation and control execution mechanism, wherein the environment controller is respectively connected with the breeding environment temperature dynamic demand module and the temperature and humidity sensor, and the environment regulation and control execution mechanism is connected with the environment controller and executes corresponding environment regulation and control according to a command of the environment controller. The regulation and control method controls the breeding environment temperature according to a dynamic setting model of the livestock and poultry breeding environment temperature, a livestock and poultry house breeding environment temperature prediction system based on a GM (1, 1) model and a gray prediction fuzzy system based on the GM (1, 1) model. The problems that the temperature in the livestock and poultry house is difficult to regulate and control in time, the regulation and control adaptability is poor and preventive measures cannot be taken are solved, and the limitation of feedback regulation and control of the livestock and poultry house based on a detection result is overcome.

title: An animal pregnancy monitoring system and its monitoring method
abstract: A livestock pregnancy monitoring system and a monitoring method thereof. The system comprises a first cultivation region, a second cultivation region, an RFID tag, a step counting sensor, a first heart rate sensor, a data monitoring center, a controller, an HCG sensor, a weight sensor and a wireless communication module. The step counting sensor and the first heart rate sensor are fixedly arranged at legs of livestock, and the step counting sensor and the first heart rate sensor acquire step number and heart rate information of the livestock and transmit the information to the data monitoring center through the RFID tag. The HCG sensor and a second heart rate sensor arranged in the second cultivation region acquire livestock urine and fetal heartbeat information respectively, and transmit the information to the data monitoring center through the controller and the wireless communication module to monitor whether the livestock is pregnant.

title: VIRTUAL AND DIGITAL RESEARCH MODEL AND RELATED METHODS FOR IMPROVING ANIMAL HEALTH AND PERFORMANCE OUTCOMES
abstract: A method and system for conducting virtual and digital research is provided. The method and systems seek to improve livestock health and outcomes.

title: Method of selecting target objects for livestock serum monitoring
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for selecting a target entity for livestock serum monitoring. The method is performed by a computer (for example, a server, a desktop, a laptop or the like) communicating with a livestock disease control system such as the Korea Animal Health Integrated System (KAHIS) possessing livestock monitoring information (for example, farm information, past test result information about livestock diseases, stockbreeding facility visit history information of livestock trucks and the like), and a livestock history management system such as a livestock entity history system (MTRACE) managing livestock entity history information by farm (for example, an entity history number, the date of birth and the like) to acquire monitoring information for livestock disease control, and, when a necessary parameter for livestock serum monitoring is inputted into the computer, a sample size for livestock serum monitoring is calculated based on the inputted parameter, and entities subject to serum sample collection are randomly selected from among livestock raised by a livestock farm in a designated zone based on the calculated sample size. In accordance with the present invention, the method is capable of solving existing inconveniences and difficulties with which the livestock monitoring information and the livestock history information need to be downloaded into a livestock disease manager computer every time a change is made in the same information, and then, recalculation using a spreadsheet program such as Excel needs to be performed; and conveniently and efficiently selecting entities subject to serum sample collection, necessary for livestock serum monitoring.

title: Livestock feed proximity and unmetabolised pharmaceutical monitoring system
abstract: Techniques for monitoring the individual feed and water intake and pharmaceutical use and unmetabolized residual alerting in the livestock industry. Livestock have sensors installed on or in their bodies to detect consumption of feed and water for each animal in an environment where multiple animals are present. Sensors communicate data regarding the duration and timing of individual animals feeding habits. Health and efficiency status data is recorded per animal and analyzed to determine whether to issue an alert indicating problems with individual animals. The system tracks the health and efficiency data for each animal, pen or farm and generates statistical information regarding the sensor data. The system communicates with user interface to display notifications and statistical data. In addition, the pharmaceutical monitoring system alerts when any unmetabolized residual pharmaceuticals are still in the animals when the animal is being readied for shipping to a packing plant.

title: Large-scale pig farm intelligent breeding system based on 5G technology and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a large-scale pig farm intelligent breeding system based on the 5G technology and a control method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of pig farm breeding. The large-scale pig farm intelligent breeding system comprises a pig house, a feeding mechanism, a trough, a 5G network, a control end and an RFID electronic tag. A first weighing sensor is arranged at the bottom of the trough, the pig house is provided with a feeding channel, a second weighing sensor is arranged at the bottom of the feeding channel, the RFID electronic tag is bound to the leg of a piglet, an RFID code reader reads identity information of the RFID electronic tag of the leg of the piglet, and the information is uploaded to the control end through the 5G network; and the weighing sensors correspondingly send feed weight data and weight data of the corresponding piglets to the control end through the 5G network, and the control end controls the working state of the feeding mechanism through the 5G network. Compared with the prior art, the Internet of Things technology, the 5G technology, an automatic control technology and pig breeding are combined for application, fine breeding is achieved, and the pig breeding efficiency and benefits are improved.
applicants: YANGZHOU SUSHENG ECOLOGICAL AGRICULTURE DEVELOPMENT CO., LTD.

title: Epidemic prevention method suitable for improving immunity of rural free-range live pigs
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of pig free-ranging, and discloses an epidemic prevention method suitable for improving immunity of rural free-range live pigs. The epidemic prevention method comprises the following steps that optimal temperature, humidity and air index thresholds for live pig breeding are presetted according to the current season and region; a live pig body temperature standard threshold value is determined; identity archives are established for the live pigs, and live pig information is recorded; a pig house and corresponding equipment are disinfected and sterilized before the live pigs enter the pig house, and the live pigs are moved into the pig house after live pig epidemic prevention vaccines are injected; a temperature sensor, a humidity sensor, an air detector and an infrared sensor are used for detecting the temperature, humidity and air quality in the pig house and the current body temperature of the live pigs in real time, and adjustment management is conducted based on a preset threshold value. Through pig house epidemic prevention management and mould adsorption combined with feed for improving immunity, the epidemic prevention management is carried out from a plurality of aspects such as live pig autologous and growth environment, and the epidemic prevention effect is effectively improved.

title: ANOMALY SENSING SYSTEM
abstract: Provided is an anomaly sensing system that senses an anomaly in an animal to be monitored. The anomaly sensing system comprises: an inference unit which inputs, into a time-series model, time-series data from a motion sensor attached to a predetermined part of the animal to be monitored, and infers the presence or absence of a ruminant behavior of the animal to be monitored, in each predetermined time range; and a determination unit which calculates a rumination rate indicating the rate of a ruminant behavior inferred by the inference unit and determines that an anomaly in the animal to be monitored has been sensed when the calculated rumination rate meets a predetermined condition.

title: SYSTEM FOR MONITORING LIVESTOCK
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for monitoring livestock and comprises: an ear tag case installed on an ear tag which is worn on the body of livestock and has information of corresponding livestock recorded thereon; a sensor unit installed to the ear tag case and detecting movement of corresponding livestock; an information collection part for collecting detection information detected by the sensor unit; and a state analysis part for analyzing state of the livestock on the basis of the detection information collected by the information collection part. The system for monitoring livestock according to the present invention is advantageous in that a state of corresponding livestock is analyzed on the basis of movement information provided from a sensor unit installed to an ear tag case to which an ear tag worn on livestock is mounted, and thus repulsion of livestock against the corresponding sensor unit can be reduced and data can be easily collected from the sensor unit.

title: Hog house sow oestrus identification system and application method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the field of livestock breeding equipment, and discloses a hog house sow oestrus identification system and an application method thereof. The hog house sow oestrus identification system comprises a plurality of sow single fences, a controller, fixing pipes and a plurality of ultrasonic sensors, and the fixing pipes are transversely arranged at the upper ends of the sow single fences; and the ultrasonic sensors are arranged in the length direction of the fixing pipes, each sow single fence corresponds to one pair of ultrasonic sensors, the ultrasonic sensors are used for obtaining distance information data between sows in the corresponding sow single fences and the ultrasonic sensors, and the ultrasonic sensors are electrically connected with the controller. The ultrasonic sensors are arranged in all single sow houses, so that the hog house sow oestrus identification system is high in accuracy, fast in time efficiency, simple to operate, small in labor amount of workers and low in cost during sow oestrus detection, and meets the requirements of large-scale hog house deployment.
applicants: HENAN MUYUAN INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Real-time monitoring system and method for state of dairy cows in lactation period
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring system and method for the state of dairy cows in the lactation period, relates to the field of animal husbandry, and aims to solve the problem of poor monitoring effectiveness caused by poor monitoring real-time performance of a monitoring method for the state of the dairy cows in the lactation period. According to the system and method, the state of nipples of the dairy cows is monitored in daily breeding of dairy cows, and the information of pressure applied by the dairy cows is detected through a plurality of pressure sensors, thereby calculating whether the dairy cows lie prone or not. Therefore, real-time monitoring of the state of the dairy cows in the lactation period is realized. The method is good in monitoring real-time performance and is an effective monitoring method.
applicants: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY BRANCH OF HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Pregnant cattle behavior real-time monitoring system and monitoring method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a pregnant cattle behavior real-time monitoring system and a monitoring method thereof, relates to the field of animal husbandry, in particular to a cattle type breeding technology, and aims to solve the problem of poor monitoring effectiveness caused by poor monitoring real-time performance of pregnant cattle. According to the system, behavior monitoring of the pregnant cattle is achieved through combination of various sensors, macroscopically, six-dimensional joint monitoring of the head, the hip, the back, the abdomen, the left side and the right side of the cattle is included, and the real-time performance of monitoring the pregnant cattle is high, so that the monitoring effectiveness is good.
applicants: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY BRANCH OF HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Electronic ear tag for animal husbandry
abstract: An electronic ear tag allows an individual to track a herd animal. Further, the electronic ear tag is an ultra-low power, and lightweight tag that runs only when needed. The electronic ear tag includes a substrate, a microcontroller, a rechargeable battery, a wireless communication module, a global positioning system (GPS) module, and a solar panel. The substrate is a circuit board used to support the electronic components of the present invention. The microcontroller is used to manage and control the electronic components of the electronic ear tag. The rechargeable battery is the main power source of the electronic ear tag. The wireless communication module allows the electronic ear tag to communicate with a central network. The GPS module allows the electronic ear tag to communicate with a GPS satellite. The solar panel converts solar energy into electrical energy used to charge the rechargeable battery.

title: Method of Implementing a Lightweight, Electronic Ear Tag for Location Tracking and Geo-Fencing Tasks
abstract: A method of implementing a lightweight, electronic ear tag allows for location tracking and geo-fencing tasks of a herd animal. A location-tracking device tracks spatial-positioning data of electronic ear tag. A communication node relays the spatial-positioning data to at least one remote server hosting an owner account that allows the owner to interact with the electronic ear tag. Accordingly, the spatial-positioning data is relayed from a low-power transceiver to a low-power gateway, if the electronic ear tag is in communication with the communication node. If the electronic ear tag is not in communication with the communication node, the spatial-positioning data is archived and store locally in the electronic ear tag. A high-power gateway provided at the communication node relays the spatial-positioning data to the remote server. Accordingly, the remote server generates a graphical representation of the spatial-positioning data, which is finally displayed on a personal computing device of the owner.

title: SHRINKAGE PRESSURE MEASURING APPARATUS FOR RUMINANT STOMACH AND MEASURING METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The present invention discloses a shrinkage pressure measuring apparatus for ruminant stomach and a measuring method thereof. The shrinkage pressure measuring apparatus includes: a capsule part that is located inside a bio-information capsule to be put into the ruminant stomach of a ruminant, and including a pressure sensor, a communication part, a power supply part and a control part; and a decompression part that forms the outside of the bio-information capsule, and is installed to surround the capsule part so that it is contracted by the contraction pressure of the ruminant stomach, or at least a part of which enters the inside of the capsule part by the contraction pressure of the ruminant stomach. It is possible to accurately measure the contraction pressure of the ruminant stomach of a ruminant animal.

title: LIVESTOCK HEALTH STATUS IMMUNE STANDARDIZATION SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock health status immune indicator system. The present invention includes: a database unit for storing data collected from a plurality of livestock farms; a candidate derivation unit for deriving a candidate index indicating the degree of immunological health from among variables related to livestock health status; a data analysis unit which analyzes a state value of the candidate index by using sample information stored in the database unit; a correlation analysis unit which analyzes a correlation between the state value of the candidate indicator and another existing indicator; a selection determining unit configured to determine whether to select a candidate index as a new index as a result of a correlation analysis; an index evaluation unit which evaluates the new index selected by the selection determining unit, but evaluates the degree of indicating the health status of the livestock; and a farm evaluation unit which estimates the health status including immunity of the livestock of an evaluation target farm using the sample information related to the new indicator collected from the evaluation target farm. According to the present invention, it is possible to quickly and easily determine the health status including an immunity level of the livestock.

title: Pig ingestion monitoring method and device
abstract: The invention provides a pig ingestion monitoring method and device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring video of the pig head in an ingestion trough to construct a data set; performing data enhancement and preprocessing on the data set, and dividing the data set into an ingestion state data set and a non-ingestion state data set; training the ingestion state data set and the non-ingestion state data set by adopting a convolutional neural network and a long-short-term memory network, and forming a pig feed intake estimation model; and inputting the real-time acquired video of the pig head in the ingestion trough into the pig feed intake estimation model to obtain a pig ingestion result. According to the method, the video information of pigs in the ingestion trough is processed, the state of the pigs in the ingestion trough is divided into the ingestion state and the non-ingestion state, so that the feed intake error caused by the fact that the non-ingestion state is attributed to the ingestion state can be avoided, the precision for estimating pig ingestion can be improved, and the actual production efficiency of pigs is improved.

title: Cattle management system using analysis of cow crying sound
abstract: The present invention relates to a cattle management system using analysis of a cattle lowing sound. According to the present invention, provided is the cattle management system using analysis of a cattle lowing sound, wherein the cattle management system comprises: a sound detection sensor that is mounted on a cow, measures sound data including a lowing sound observed from the cow, and transmits the sound data wirelessly with an identification code; and a management server that analyzes the sound data collected from the sound detection sensor to determine an estrus state or health state of the cow. According to the present invention, by observing the cow's lowing sound in real time and analyzing the same to determine the estrus state or health state of the cow, an administrator can monitor the cow remotely and a detection rate is increased.
applicants: BU MYEONG COMPANY; N INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY

title: Sow heat conduction monitoring device and method
abstract: The invention provides a sow heat conduction monitoring device and method. The sow heat conduction monitoring device comprises a measuring plate, a support and a controller, the measuring plate is placed on the bottom face of a limiting fence of a sow to be measured, and a geodesic temperature thermal resistor and a geodesic temperature distribution thermal resistor group are arranged in the measuring plate; the support is provided with an infrared thermal imager and a depth camera, and the infrared thermal imager and the depth camera face the measuring plate; and the controller is coupled with the thermal infrared imager, the depth camera, the geodesic temperature thermal resistor and the geodesic temperature distribution thermal resistor group. By means of the mode, the thermal infrared imager and the depth camera can collect the state of the sow to be measured, then the temperature value of the contact face of the sow and the ground surface can be obtained when the sow to be measured is in a lying state or a side-lying state, and the heat exchange amount of the sow in the lying state or the side-lying state can be calculated according to the temperature value, measured by the thermal infrared imager, of the contact surface of the sow and the ground surface and the temperature value measured by the geodesic thermal resistor.

title: Livestock activity detection system
abstract: The present invention relates to an activity detection system for livestock. More specifically, the activity detection system comprises: at least one photographing unit provided inside a breeding facility to photograph image information for livestock; a data collection unit mounted on a body part of the livestock and collecting activity information and body information of the livestock; a server unit receiving and storing the image information, activity information and body information of the livestock from the data collection unit; an analysis server unit receiving and analyzing the image information, activity information and body information of the livestock from the server unit; and a management unit receiving an estrus time or an appropriate breeding time of the livestock analyzed by the analysis server unit. Accordingly, customized breeding is provided.
applicants: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION, DAEGU UNIVERSITY

title: Method for dynamically measuring weight of swinery and analyzing growth trend of swinery
abstract: The invention discloses a method for dynamically measuring the weight of a swinery and analyzing the growth trend of the swinery, and relates to a method for dynamically feeding the swinery. The method includes: using a camera image wireless acquisition device to acquire a dynamic swinery image with identification ear tags on two nails, and transmitting the dynamic swinery image to a remote operation processing computer through the Internet; extracting a complete image of the pig with the complete ear tag in the image; using a deep learning RCNN to identify the whole pig and main appearance organs: a pig head and a pig ear; identifying an ear tag in the image through an intelligent algorithm to obtain an individual identification id; determining boundaries of the three identification targets by using an edge detection algorithm, subtracting the minimum ordinate from the maximum ordinate according to edge detection to perform the same processing on theabscissa to determine length and width feature sizes, and comparing the length and width feature sizes with the ear tag size to obtain a real size; according to the real size, reversely deducing the real weight by an empirical formula. The method is suitable for obtaining weight identification of pigs in group movement, giving a growth trend curve of each pig, digitally guiding fattening of a breeding factory, and improving benefits of the breeding factory.

title: Livestock monitoring method based on elevator and livestock monitoring device based on elevator
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock monitoring method based on an elevator and a livestock monitoring device based on the elevator. The monitoring method comprises the steps that a preset livestock recognition model is obtained; monitoring images of the elevator car are obtained, wherein the monitoring images comprise a plurality of monitoring images obtained from different visual angles; the monitoring images are recognized based on the preset livestock identification model to obtain a corresponding identification result; and corresponding livestock monitoring information is generated based on the identification result. According to the elevator control system, a traditional elevator is improved in a subdivided field, in the process that livestock is bred through a vertical breeding system, intelligent recognition is conducted on the growth condition of the livestock through the elevator, intelligent control is conducted on the elevator, and therefore the monitoring accuracy of livestock breeding is effectively improved, the intelligent degree of elevator control is improved, and the enterprise operation benefit is improved.

title: Animal eating action detection method and system, storage medium and device
abstract: The invention provides an animal eating action detection method and system, a storage medium and a device. The detection method comprises the following steps: receiving acceleration data acquired by an ear tag on an animal and acquisition time; carrying out animal behavior action recognition through an action recognition model according to the acceleration data so as to recognize eating actions of the animal; counting the number of eating actions of the animal in a preset eating time period according to the acquisition time; and judging the eating condition of the animal according to the number of the eating actions of the animal in the eating time period, and then judging the physical health condition of the animal according to the eating condition. According to the invention, the eating duration of the animal can be rapidly obtained by combining the data collected by the ear tag and the feeding information, so that the physical health condition of the animal can be judged according to the eating condition.

title: Sow cub number and weight evaluation and management system
abstract: The invention discloses a sow birth number and weight evaluation and management system, marking and weight information filing are carried out on each piglet through the set information filing module, the state and the active degree of the piglets are monitored in real time through the set real-time monitoring module, early warning is given out in time when there is a piglet without breast milk, foster processing is carried out; each piglet in the same batch and the whole piglet are analyzed through a comprehensive analysis module; the quality of the piglets is evaluated; and finally evaluation information is uploaded to a remote server through the module. According to the system, the number and weight of the piglets are automatically monitored and evaluated in real time, and abnormal conditions can be found in time for early warning, so that the overall survival rate of the piglets is improved.

title: 3D Livestock weighing device and method through 3D image processing
abstract: The present invention relates to a device and a method for measuring the weight of livestock through three-dimensional (3D) image processing, thereby enhancing measuring precision. In accordance with the present invention, the device for measuring the weight of livestock through 3D image processing comprises: a photographing unit for obtaining a 3D image of livestock; and a measuring module for processing the 3D image to measure the weight, wherein the measuring module includes: a pre-processing unit for extracting a central point and a central distance from the 3D image to remove a background and an outlier; a normalization unit for extracting and then removing a bottom plane from the pre-processed 3D image, grouping objects in accordance with density of points to extract a group of the livestock, and using a plane equation to correct a slope; a factor analysis unit for extracting a factor for one or more of length, height, circumference, an area, and a volume from the normalized 3D image; and a weight calculation unit using the extracted factor to calculate the weight.

title: Live pig identity information and growth state intelligent management system
abstract: According to the pig identity information and growth state intelligent management system provided by the invention, the identity information of the pig is managed by setting the information management module, the growth state of the pig is monitored in real time through the state monitoring module, and the environment management module and the feed management module are respectively connected with the alarm module; the pig house can be correspondingly adjusted in time according to the growth stage of live pigs, so that the growth of the live pigs is met, and the quality of the live pigs is improved. Therefore, the growth condition of each live pig is managed integrally, the management efficiency is improved, and the survival rate of the live pigs is improved.

title: Intelligent management and precise feeding system and method for farm
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent management and precise feeding system and method for a farm. The system comprises pig identity codes, a positioning fence, an instruction module, an input module, an identity recognition module, an environment acquisition module, a server, an automatic feeding device, an epidemic disease identification module, a reminding module, and a display module, wherein the output ends of the instruction module, the input module, the identity recognition module and the environment acquisition module are electrically connected with the input end of the server, and the output end of the server is electrically connected with the input ends of the automatic feeding device, the epidemic disease identification module, the reminding module and the display module. The system not only can realize different management of different production stages, such as feeding quantity management, pigsty transfer management, immunity management and the like of sows and growing pigs in different stages. Meanwhile, the system also realizes comprehensive management of pig farm data, such as feed consumption and sow mating rate, and obtains systematic data of the pig farm.
applicants: GUANGDONG GUANGKEN ANIMAL HUSBANDRY GROUP COMPANY; ENGINEERING RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF GUANGDONG GUANGKEN ANIMAL HUSBANDRY GROUP COMPANY

title: Intelligent and efficient pig raising method and system
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent and efficient pig raising method and system. The intelligent and efficient pig raising method comprises the steps that image information in each breeding fence is obtained, and a plurality of pieces of environment image information and live pig image information in the breeding fence are separated according to the image information; a live pig identifier is identified according to a live pig image, and a plurality of first images corresponding to the live pig are obtained according to the live pig identifier; according to the multiple first images, motion tracks of live pigs corresponding to each live pig identifier is obtained; a second image is obtained according to the first images, and the second image is input into a live pig weight prediction model to obtain live pig weight information; the weight information of the live pigs is recorded according to a preset time interval, and the weight variation of the live pigs is obtained within the time interval; and the growth condition of the live pig is judged according to the environment image information, the weight variation of the live pigs and the motion tracks. According to the intelligent and efficient pig raising method, the growth condition of the live pigs can be comprehensively analyzed by integrating environmental factors and a plurality of factors of the live pigs, and efficient and accurate management of the live pigs is realized.

title: Method for monitoring attack borne by beef calves
abstract: The invention discloses a method for monitoring attack borne by beef calves, relates to the field of beef cattle breeding, and aims to solve the problems that in the current beef cattle breeding process, a method for monitoring attack borne by beef calves is low in monitoring efficiency and wastes time and labor. According to the method, whether the calves are attacked or not is judged by taking the high muscle tension change of the calves as a measurement factor and assisting with the sound change condition of the calves in the same time period, and the method is suitable for beef cattle breeding farms.
applicants: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY BRANCH OF HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Intelligent monitoring and nursing system for sow after pregnancy
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent monitoring and nursing system for a sow after pregnancy. The intelligent monitoring and nursing system comprises a monitoring module, a feeding management module, a water supply management module, an environment management module, a weight monitoring module and an abdomen depth monitoring module which are connected with a control module; the monitoring module is used for monitoring body temperature of the sow and the behavior of the sow in a breeding fence; the feeding management module is used for performing feeding management on the sow; the water supply management module is used for performing water supply management on the sow; the environment management module is used for acquiring environment conditions according to environment images acquired by the monitoring module; the weight monitoring module is used for monitoring the weight of the sow; the abdomen depth monitoring module is used for acquiring a predicted number of fetuses according to a sow abdomen depth image acquired by the monitoring module; and the control module is used for adjusting feeding amount, feeding fodder and water supply amount of the sow according to the weight of the sow, the predicted number of the fetuses and the body temperature of the sow. According to the system, the pregnant sow can be carefully nursed, precise management of the pregnant sow is realized, and the survival rate of the fetuses is improved.

title: Wearable device for livestock positioning and stride frequency detection and detection method of wearable device
abstract: The invention discloses a wearable device for livestock positioning and stride frequency detection and a detection method of the wearable device, and relates to the technical field of livestock wearable equipment. The device comprises the livestock wearable equipment, a solar power supply device, a power supply control device and a system function device, wherein the power supply output end of the solar power supply device is connected with the power supply input end of the livestock wearable equipment, the data signal output end of the livestock wearable equipment is connected with the data signal input end of the power supply control device, and the data signal output end of the system function device is connected with the data signal input end of the livestock wearable equipment. A three-axis accelerometer is selected as the sensor and is mainly used for measuring stride frequency, and finally, the health state of livestock is researched through stride frequency data.
applicants: HEILONGJIANG XINNANYANG AGRICULTURAL DEVELOPMENT CO., LTD.

title: LIVESTOCK ESTRUS MONITORING DEVICE
abstract: Abstract The present application discloses a livestock estrus monitoring device in the technical field of livestock behavior detection apparatuses, which includes a first strap; two ends of the first strap are rotatably connected with a second strap and a third strap through rotary columns, the left part of the first strap is fixedly connected with a tightening box, and the upper part of an outer wall of the first strap is sequentially provided with a positioning module and a detection module from left to right. The present application can improve the detection efficiency, reduce the labor intensity, prevent the device from loosening and falling off, and improve the stability. Drawings

title: Pig house live pig body temperature intelligent monitoring robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a pig house live pig body temperature intelligent monitoring robot.
