The pig house live pig body temperature intelligent monitoring robot comprises a mobile base plate, an image acquisition module and a body temperature monitoring module are arranged, so that live pig body temperature distribution can be conveniently determined through an infrared camera, and key parts such as pig ear roots can be identified in combination with visible light camera photos. By means of a multiple regression function, regression is carried out on the temperature value obtained through the infrared image of the key part to obtain the equivalent rectum temperature, the equivalent rectum temperature of the live pig is obtained, non-contact monitoring of the rectum temperature of the live pig is achieved, and the fitted rectum temperature can be used for epidemic disease monitoring or health management of the live pig; and an autonomous moving module is arranged, a laser radar and an SLAM navigation technology are adopted in the autonomous moving module for automatic inspection, so that the image information acquisition point of each pigsty in the pig house can be determined conveniently, the system can be shared by the multiple pigsties conveniently, and the input cost is reduced.
applicants: ANHUI LING KUN INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Livestock health monitoring method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock health monitoring method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a health index threshold value, wherein the health index threshold value is determined according to historical temperature data and historical motion data of a plurality of healthy livestock in a livestock group; in the current time period, temperature data and motion data of the target livestock are collected for multiple times; determining a health index of the target livestock according to the temperature data and the motion data of the target livestock; and when the health index of the target livestock is lower than the health index threshold value of the livestock group, determining that the target livestock is in an unhealthy state. According to the embodiment of the invention, the health index of the livestock in the current time period is compared with the health index threshold value obtained according to the historical data, whether the livestock is healthy at present can be determined based on the historical data, and the health state of the livestock is monitored.
applicants: SHENZHEN ZHONGRONG DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Animal husbandry internet-of-things system
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a livestock Internet of Things system, which comprises an information acquisition module, an information collection base station and a server, and is characterized in that the information acquisition module is used for acquiring environment information and biological characteristic information of livestock, and sending the environment information and the biological characteristic information to the information collection base station; the information collection base station is used for receiving the environment information and the biological characteristic information and sending the environment information and the biological characteristic information to the server; and the server is used for receiving the environment information and the biological characteristic information sent by the information collection base station, analyzing the environment information and/or the biological characteristic information to obtain target information, and sending the target information to a user terminal. According to the embodiment of the invention, the environment information and the biological characteristic information are acquired through the information acquisition module, and the target information is obtained according to the biological characteristic information and/or the environment information, so that a user timely knows information of livestock according to the target information.
applicants: SHENZHEN ZHONGRONG DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: A distinguish method for weaning and estrus using vaginal biosensor in cattle
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for distinguishing weaning and estrus by using a bovine intravaginal implantable biosensor to weaned cows. According to the present invention, the conception rate can be efficiently increased by distinguishing weaning and estrus in weaned cows. The method includes a process of measuring temperature and activity in the cow's vagina using an intravaginal sensor.

title: Apparatus for farming animals such as pigs
abstract: An apparatus for farming animals, with a trough, a distributing system, an identifying system, a database and a control unit that allows, once an animal has been identified, the time passed ‘t’ since the time T0 corresponding to the last feed of said animal to be measured, a new value of the credit feed weight MC to be computed with the formulaMC⁡(t)=M⁢PΔ⁢T*(t-T0)+M⁢C0and a succession of feed portions to be distributed to the trough until the animal is sated or until a zero or negative credit feed weight MC is obtained.

title: Livestock activity range detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a livestock activity range detection method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring motion data of livestock in a first time period, if the motion data of the livestock in the first time period is null, acquiring motion data of the livestock in a second time period before the first time period, and then analyzing the motion data of the livestock in the second time period to obtain an analysis result, and finally determining whether the livestock is in a preset activity range according to an analysis result. In the embodiment of the invention, the motion condition of the livestock is analyzed by detecting the motion data of the livestock, so that whether the livestock illegally leaves the preset activity range or not is accurately detected.
applicants: SHENZHEN ZHONGRONG DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Ear tag state updating method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an ear tag state updating method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining state data collected by an ear tag, recognizing the data type of the state data, recognizing the numerical range of the state data, and then updating the state of the ear tag according to the data type and the numerical range. And updating the current state of the ear tag. The state of the ear tag can be updated, and the situation that a breeder cannot know the health state of the livestock in time due to the fact that the ear tag cannot normally collect the state data of the livestock because the breeder cannot find that the ear tag is in a non-wearing state in time is avoided.
applicants: SHENZHEN ZHONGRONG DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Livestock health monitoring method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock health monitoring method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: determining to-be-monitored target livestock; determining a heating temperature threshold value of the target livestock according to the historical temperature data of the target livestock in the plurality of historical health time periods; determining a total motion threshold value of the target livestock according to the historical motion data of the target livestock in the plurality of historical health time periods; acquiring the temperature of the target livestock and the total exercise amount in the current time period; when the temperature of the target livestock is larger than the heating temperature threshold value and/or the total exercise amount in the current time period is smaller than the total exercise amount threshold value, it is determined that the target livestock is in an unhealthy state. According to the embodiment of the invention, the current temperature is compared with the heating temperature threshold value of the livestock, and the total exercise amount of the current time period is compared with the total exercise amount threshold value of the livestock, so that whether the livestock is healthy at present can be judged, and the health state of the livestock is monitored in real time.
applicants: SHENZHEN ZHONGRONG DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Unmanned feeding system
abstract: The invention relates to an unmanned feeding system, and relates to the field of livestock breeding. The unmanned feeding system comprises a control terminal, a weighing module, a discharging module and an identity module, wherein the weighing module comprises weighing platforms arranged on one side of a trough in a one-to-one correspondence mode, and weight sensors installed below the weighing platforms; the weight sensors are in electric signal connection with the control terminal; the discharging module comprises a discharging trolley moving in the length direction of the trough; a rail is laid in the moving direction of the discharging trolley; and the discharging trolley is connected to the rail in a rolling mode. According to the unmanned feeding system provided by the invention, through the discharging trolley, accurate discharging can be achieved, so that the breeding effect is improved; and the bad health state of livestock can be found in time by comparing data such as the counted weighing data and the body temperature data, so that response can be made quickly, and the breeding effect is improved.
applicants: ZHENGZHOU KANGLI ELECTRICAL APPLIANCE TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Intelligent computing system used for animal husbandry and use method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent computing system used for animal husbandry and a use method thereof. The intelligent computing system comprises a camera, a feeding module and an intelligent computing module, the camera and an electronic tag are respectively connected with the intelligent computing module, the intelligent computing module is connected with the feeding module, the feeding module is connected with a detection module and a weighing module, and the weighing module is further connected with a timing device. According to the intelligent computing system used for animal husbandry and the use method thereof, through the arranged camera, photo recording can be carried out on the state of a pig, through an arranged reading device, identifying is conveniently carried out on the electronic tag, recording is carried out on the growth state of pigs, through an arranged limiting rod, data recording is conveniently carried out on the body type of the pig, through intelligent calculation module, pig growth curves can be fitted more conveniently, scientific feeding is carried out on the pigs, through the arranged feeding module and the intelligent computing module, feeding with different food amounts can be carried out on the pigs according to the growth conditions of the pigs, the manual feeding step is omitted, and manpower is saved.

title: Intelligent sow delivery monitoring and feeding management system
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent sow delivery monitoring and feeding management system which comprises a sow delivery monitoring system, wherein the sow delivery monitoring system can monitor and recognize the physiological indexes or activity conditions of sows to estimate the delivery time of the sows, and can remotely send delivery reminding or farrowing early warning to feeders after the delivery time of the sows can be recognized, the sow delivery monitoring system can continuously recognize the farrowing conditions of the sows and the health conditions of piglets in the sow delivery process; and the intelligent sow delivery monitoring and feeding management system further comprises a sow feeding management system and a pig house environment management system. According to the system, real-time monitoring and early warning before and after sow delivery can be achieved, meanwhile, automatic control over the feeding quality and the feeding environment of the sows and the piglets is achieved, and original work is more timely and efficient while manual checking is reduced; meanwhile, the contact opportunity of people and livestock is reduced, and germs are prevented from being brought into the pig house; and the efficient and automatic monitoring and management system can also greatly reduce the stress reaction times and stress reaction degree of the sows and the piglets, and is beneficial to increasing economic benefits.
applicants: QINGDAO DEBA BROTHER MACHINERY CO., LTD.

title: Pig population counting and sicked pig detection system based on deep learning video analysis technology
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for counting a pig population and detecting a sick pig based on a deep learning video analysis technology, which utilizes an information processor, which is installed in a form of an embedded board in a CCTV installed in a pig pen of a pig farm or in a moving passage for shipment or stocking of pigs and communicates with a management server, to analyze a video collected through the CCTV with a deep learning video analysis technology, identify a pig object, and track a position change of each pig object in the pig pen so as to provide a pig population in the pig pen obtained from an identification result of activities or abnormal behavior patterns, or a population of shipped or stocked pigs shipped through the moving passage, or sick pig detection information in the pig pen (e.g., a sick pig population, a pig identification number identified through a pig identification table, etc.) to the management server. If the pig population in the pig pen obtained from the pig farm or the population of pigs shipped or stocked is provided to the management server according to the present invention, management such as worker placement and feed supply in the pig farm can be efficiently performed, and specifically, if the sick pig detection information in the pig pen (e.g., the sick pig population, the pig identification number identified through the pig identification table, etc.) is provided to the management server, a sick pig is detected in advance to be quarantined, a disease is diagnosed in advance to prevent infectious diseases such as foot-and-mouth disease and African swine fever and respiratory diseases (e.g., cold), and disease treatment can be carried out quickly upon onset.

title: Portable livestock laser weight measuring device
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of weight measuring instruments, and particularly discloses a portable livestock laser weight measuring device. The portable livestock laser weight measuring device comprises a shell and a processing chip arranged in the shell, an LED display screen and a control panel are arranged on the front face of the shell, a battery bin and a tripod mounting hole are formed in the back face of the shell, a laser transmitter, an auxiliary point finding camera and a reflected light receiver are embedded in the top surface of the shell, and a data transmission interface is formed in the bottom surface of the shell; and algorithm program software is arranged in the processing chip. A software data simulation method is adopted, and dependence on the environment during yak weight measurement is overcome; meanwhile, different chest circumference value changes of yaks in different growth cycles are further overcome; weight measurement can be carried out on a large number of yaks in different growth cycles by using a small amount of manpower resources, parameters can be externally changed, and the measurement and calculation precision of the yaks in different growth states is further enhanced; and through a relatively mature weight measuring formula, the weight of the yaks is more accurate, and the portable livestock laser weight measuring device is more suitable for scientific breeding of the yaks.

title: COMPUTER-IMPLEMENTED METHOD, CONTROLLER, ARRANGEMENT AND MILKING SYSTEM FOR PREGNANCY DETECTION
abstract: A computer-implemented method (500), a controller (110), an arrangement (101) and a milking system (100) are disclosed. The computer-implemented method (500) comprises the steps of: receiving (501) a point in time of an insemination of an animal (105); obtaining (503) a measurement (M) of progesterone level in an analyte of the animal (105), which measurement (M) is made within 11 days from the point in time of the insemination; and determining (504) that the animal (105) is non-pregnant when the progesterone level of the obtained (503) measurement (M) is lower than a progesterone threshold limit (TL).

title: LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT INFORMATION SYSTEM
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock management information system (1) for transferring data of a multiplicity of labels (8-1,..., 8-5) to be worn by animals to be managed to a data processing unit (2). The labels are each provided with a label processor (81), a label memory (82) and a label transmitting device (83) which cooperate with the label processor, wherein the label is configured for storing in the label memory at least local data that specifically relate to that label. Two or more of the labels are provided as an assistance label having a collecting function and a reporting function. In performing the collecting function, the assistance label receives with a label receiving device a wireless information signal from another label and stores data contained therein as external data in the label memory. In performing the reporting function, the assistance label transmits the stored data to the data processing unit (2).

title: Dynamic grazing electronic fence system
abstract: The invention relates to a dynamic grazing electronic fence system, which comprises an intelligent terminal and a MESH fence monitoring device, and the MESH fence monitoring device comprises an outer fence, an inner positioning fence, livestock attached equipment and an NB-IOT relay station; the outer fence is arranged at the outer edge of a breeding area, the inner positioning fence is arranged at the center of the breeding area, the livestock attachment device is worn and attached to livestock in the breeding area, and the outer fence, the inner positioning fence and the livestock attachment device are used for determining the position of the livestock and forming position information of the livestock; and the NB-IOT relay station is used for receiving the position information of each livestock position and sending the position information to the intelligent terminal through the NB-IOT network. The virtual electronic fence is generated by using the outer fence and the inner positioning fence, the position of the livestock is monitored through the livestock attachment device, the formed position information is sent to the intelligent terminal, and then the position information is compared with the electronic fence area, so that herdsmen can know whether the livestock crosses the border or not, therefore, the effects of conveniently defining the grazing boundary and managing the livestock are achieved.

title: Breed duck performance testing device
abstract: The invention provides a breed duck performance testing device which comprises a rack, wherein a control box, a discharging device, a material weighing device, a gate device and a body weighing device are arranged on the rack, the control box and the discharging device are arranged on the upper portion of the rack, the control box is used for controlling the discharging device, the material weighing device, the gate device and the body weighing device. the discharging device is used for putting feed onto the material weighing device, the material weighing device, the gate device and the body weighing device are arranged on the lower portion of the rack side by side, and the gate device is arranged between the material weighing device and the body weighing device. The breed duck performance testing device can realize automatic testing of poultry, and has multiple functions.
applicants: GUANGDONG GUANGXING ANIMAL HUSBANDRY MACHINERY COMPANY; GUANGDONG INSTITUTE OF MODERN AGRICULTURAL EQUIPMENT

title: Pig weight estimation method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a pig weight estimation method and device, equipment and a storage medium. The estimation method comprises the following steps: acquiring back depth image data of a pig to be subjected to weight estimation; inputting the back depth image data into a preset pig weight estimation model to obtain the pig weight output by the pig weight estimation model, wherein the pig weight estimation model is obtained by training a back depth image sample of a pig and the weight of the pig corresponding to the back depth image sample of the pig. According to the technical scheme, the weight of the pig can be estimated according to the back depth image information of the pig, the speed is high, and the accuracy rate is high.

title: Intelligent livestock and poultry epidemic disease screening and early warning system
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent livestock and poultry epidemic disease screening and early warning system, and relates to the field of livestock and poultry epidemic disease monitoring systems. The intelligent livestock and poultry epidemic disease screening and early warning system comprises a user layer, a presentation layer, an application layer, a platform layer, a data layer, a physical resource layer, an infrastructure layer, a network layer and a sensing layer, wherein the user layer comprises users using the system, and specifically comprises an administrator, a supervisor and a checkpoint reporting person; the presentation layer comprises a PC end background and a mobile terminal device, and a user can check the system through the presentation layer; and the application layer can realize epidemic situation information reporting, monitoring data information management, inspection basic information management, equipment information management and early warning information management. The intelligent livestock and poultry epidemic disease screening and early warning system provided by the invention can perform real-time intelligent detection on livestock and poultry epidemic disease conditions at reported and detected points in a region, is efficient and accurate, performs statistical summarization on detection results, and can perform rapid early warning when epidemic diseases occur.

title: Computerized systems and methods for livestock management
abstract: Various examples are directed to livestock management systems and methods. A first user computing device may display a GUI comprising a first animal visual element. The first animal visual element may correspond to the first animal and indicate a first colostrum feeding of the first animal. When a user selects the first animal visual element, the user computing device may display a first colostrum input screen for receiving first colostrum data. The user computing device may also modify the first animal visual element to indicate the time status of the first testing action for the first animal.

title: Livestock behavior information collector, livestock behavior detection method, and livestock behavior detection system
abstract: The invention relates to the field of electronic communication, in particular to a livestock behavior information collector, a livestock behavior detection method, and a livestock behavior detection system. The livestock behavior information collector comprises a barometer, a motion amount collector, a first processing module, a first storage module, and a first wireless communication module. The barometer is used for acquiring a current environment air pressure value; the motion amount collector comprises a motion sensor, a processor, and a conversion circuit, wherein the motion sensor comprises a cavity, an infrared transmitting tube, and an infrared receiving tube; the first processing module is used for collecting a value of the barometer and a value of the motion amount collector and calculating the ground height and the motion amount of livestock; the first storage module is used for storing the detected value of the barometer, the data of the motion amount acquired and calculated by the motion amount, and the data processed by the first processing module; the first wireless communication module is used for sending out data stored in the first storage module. According to the invention, the problem that livestock behavior state data cannot be accurately counted in the prior art can be solved.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA WANG XUN INFORMATION ENGINEERING COMPANY

title: INTELLIGENT SMART FARM FOR LIVESTOCK HOUSE
abstract: Disclosed is an intelligent smart farm for a livestock barn. The intelligent smart farm for a livestock barn of the present invention comprises: a barn environment collection unit provided in a main body to detect the temperature, humidity, carbon dioxide concentration, ammonia, and illuminance of the livestock barn; a feed information collection unit provided in the main body to collect feed information supplied to livestock; an environment control unit provided in the main body to control the temperature and humidity in the main body and to ventilate the inside of the main body; a breeding management unit provided in the main body to determine whether a disease occurs by adjusting the amount of feed or analyzing the amount of exercise of the livestock; and an external environment collection unit provided in the main body to collect external environment information of the main body. Accordingly, environment and productivity of the livestock barn can be significantly improved.

title: Live pig health monitoring and marketing time evaluation method, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of live pig breeding, and provides a live pig health monitoring and marketing time evaluation method, terminal equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps as follows: calculating the current unit weight breeding income corresponding to a live pig when it is determined that the live pig is healthy according to millimeter wave radar monitoring information; drawing a unit weight breeding income change curve corresponding to the live pig; estimating a unit weight breeding income peak value corresponding to the live pig and corresponding first peak value time; and determining the first peak time as the optimal marketing time of the live pig. According to the live pig health monitoring and marketing time evaluation method, the terminal equipment and the readable storage medium provided by the embodiment of the invention, the peak value and the peak value time of the live pig unit weight breeding income are estimated in advance by observing the income change curve of the live pig unit weight in the farm and utilizing the data and the mathematical model, the problem that data support is lacked when the marketing time is determined in the current live pig breeding field is solved, and the breeding risk can be reduced.

title: Method for identifying sow oestrus and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sow breeding, in particular to a method for identifying sow oestrus and application thereof. The method for identifying sow oestrus comprises the following steps: collecting urine of the sow to be detected, determining the contents of estradiol and luteinizing hormone in the urine, respectively comparing the contents of estradiol and luteinizing hormone with an oestrus interval threshold value of estradiol and luteinizing hormone, and predicting whether or not the sow is in oestrus according to a comparison result. According to the method, stress-free and welfare oestrus identification is carried out on the weaned sows, manpower is saved, the production cost is reduced, and a technical guarantee of oestrus identification is provided for large-scale production of the sows.

title: Intelligent pig breeding method and system and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent live pig breeding method and system and a readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the growth sample data of live pigs in different regions, the live pig growth sample data of each region comprises emotion sample data, motion sample data, food proportion sample data, weight sample data and body fat distribution sample data of live pigs in different growth stages; respectively training the initial model by using the live pig growth sample data of each region to obtain a live pig growth model; collecting breeding growth data of the bred live pigs, and searching a target growth model in the live pig growth model according to a breeding place of the bred live pigs; and transmitting the breeding growth data to the target growth model for data analysis to obtain an analysis result, and monitoring the breeding state of the bred live pigs according to the analysis result. According to the method, the factors influencing the meat quality and taste of live pig breeding are monitored according to different stages and multiple dimensions, and it is ensured that the meat quality and taste of live pigs bred in all regions meet the requirements.

title: Replacement gilt feeding system and method and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a feeding system and method for replacement gilts and a readable storage medium. The system comprises a cloud server, a feeding subsystem, a temperature control subsystem and an estrus promotion subsystem, wherein the feeding subsystem, the temperature control subsystem and the estrus promotion subsystem are in communication connection with the cloud server; the feed supply subsystem comprises a feed supply groove, a feed supply conveying belt and a weight sensor, and the weight sensor transmits weight data of the replacement gilts to the cloud server so as to determine the feed ratio and the feed amount; the feed conveying belt transmits feed information to the cloud server so as to control the feed conveying belt to operate, and feed is conveyed to the feed trough; the temperature control subsystem transmits the detected temperature value, humidity value and air quality value of the hog house to the cloud server so as to control the temperature control subsystem; the cloud server also controls the aphrodisiac subsystem to start so as to promote aphrodisiac for the replacement gilts The actual growth factors of nutrition, weight data and oestrus are combined with the environmental factors of temperature, humidity and air quality, so that the replacement gilts are ensured to have growth and development which are most beneficial to fertility from all dimensions.

title: METHOD OF CONTROLLING AND MANAGING A PRODUCTION CYCLE OF A LIVESTOCK FARM
abstract: The present invention pertains to a computer-implemented method of systematically controlling and managing a production cycle of a livestock farm housing a population of animals, the method comprising (a) obtaining real-time data by means of one or more, preferably a plurality of, sensors and/or manual or machine-based measurement and evaluation devices, including a set of farm condition parameters, (b) establishing statistical correlations of animal status parameters and process parameters with the animal performance parameters; (c) calculating and automatically adjusting, depending on the farm condition parameters obtained in step (a) and on the statistical correlations identified in step (b), a set of data set points for farm operating parameters such that at least a selected one of the animal performance parameters is optimized; and (d) repeatedly conducting process steps (a) to (c) until finishing the production cycle.

title: Cattle and sheep positioning management system based on Lora communication
abstract: The invention discloses a cattle and sheep positioning management system based on Lora communication. A power supply is connected with one end of a magnetic control power switch; the other end of the magnetic control power switch is connected with a controller; and the controller is in control connection with a dynamic and static sensor, a GPS positioner, an LORA gateway, a temperature sensor, an LED indicating lamp and an anti-disassembly device. Lora communication is used based on a communication network which is long in transmission distance (can reach several kilometers), low in power consumption, capable of achieving multi-node connection and high in anti-interference performance. A linkwan protocol is utilized to be in connection with an Alibaba platform, and different devices are marked and distinguished through a triple so as to limit network access interference of other devices except a secondary system. High security and high stability of the whole network are realized. The positioning, collecting and monitoring functions of livestock such as cattle and sheep are achieved, grazing is planned, and loss alarm dynamic monitoring is achieved. Therefore, the complexity of animal husbandry management is greatly reduced, and the management efficiency is improved.

title: Pig supply and information monitoring system
abstract: The invention provides a pig supply and information monitoring system. The system comprises a supply plant, a plurality of circular supply bins are continuously and transversely arranged in the supply plant, a walking wheel is arranged on a moving frame, the walking wheel is connected with a vertical rod, the vertical rod is connected with a rotating motor, a sliding block capable of sliding on a transverse rod is installed on the transverse rod, and a telescopic air cylinder is connected with a mechanical arm capable of clamping pigs. The transverse rod is connected with a vertical supporting rod, a pig inlet channel is provided with a plurality of inlets communicated with the supply bins, a pig outlet channel is provided with a plurality of outlets communicated with the supply bins, and the inlets and the outlets are provided with first monitors and second monitors respectively. According to the pig supply and information monitoring system, led-in piglets and led-out adult pigs are monitored through the first monitors and the second monitors, the rotating motor and the sliding block are adjusted to enable the mechanical arm connected with the telescopic air cylinder to be located over the pigs needing to be led out, then the telescopic air cylinder is started to enable the mechanical arm to clamp the pigs. and then the slide block and the transverse rod are moved to adjust the position of the mechanical arm, so that the mechanical arm corresponds to the outlets.

title: Embedded equipment for step counting and positioning of animals in animal husbandry
abstract: The invention discloses embedded equipment for step counting and positioning of animals in the animal husbandry. The embedded equipment comprises a necklace, a positioning device and an adjusting device, wherein the lower end of the necklace is connected with the positioning device, the upper end of the necklace is connected with the adjusting device, the necklace is installed at the neck of an animal and is not easy to fall off, the positioning device comprises a shell, a guide groove which is through left and right is formed in the upper side of the shell, a strip-shaped box is slidably connected to the interior of the guide groove, a pulse sensor and a pressure sensor are installed in the strip-shaped box, a controller is arranged in the shell, and the controller is connected with the strip-shaped box through a wire. According to the embedded equipment, the position of the animal is determined by the positioning device, by means of actions of the animal, mechanical energy is converted into electric power, and the electric power is collected to supply electric power to the positioning device and the adjusting device; and meanwhile, through the arrangement of an elastic piece and a telescopic pipe in the necklace, the contact area under different pressures is changed, the comfort degree is increased, meanwhile, through the cooperation of a reel and a pressure sensor, the tightness degree is proper, and manual adjustment is avoided.
applicants: SHANGHAI QITU TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT CO., LTD.

title: INTELLIGENT SEPARATING APPARATUS FOR MILK ANIMALS
abstract: Abstract An intelligent separating apparatus for milk animals, comprising a storage area, wherein the storage area comprises a transfer channel and a retaining space; the retaining space is divided into an isolation area and a milking area; and the isolation area and the milking area are respectively communicated with the transfer channel; a detection component used for detecting health conditions of the milk animals; a blocking component arranged on the transfer channel, used for opening an entrance of the milking area and closing an entrance of the isolation area when healthy milk animals are detected by the detection component, and further used for closing the entrance of the milking area and opening the entrance of the isolation area when unhealthy milk animals are detected by the detection component. Drawings of Description Milk animals 3 -3 21 112b 112a
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL AND ANIMALHUSBANDRY SCIENCES

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR AUTOMATIC AND NONINVASIVE LIVESTOCK HEALTH ANALYSIS
abstract: The disclosure provides systems and methods for automatically and noninvasively analyzing livestock health, wherein to determine at least one of a body composition indicator or a pose indicator based on the data acquired from the camera; store the body composition indicator or pose indicator in a data record associated with the animal of interest; and provide the body composition indicator or pose indicator to a neural network trained to predict an animal outcome for animals of a similar species to the animal of interest.

title: Animal husbandry system
abstract: The present invention relates to an animal husbandry system, wherein a group of animals (2) can move about freely in an area (1), the system comprising at least one weighing unit 5 (9, 10, 11) located in the area (1), video monitoring and analyzing means (8) being provided suitable for establishing in conjunction with the at least one weighing unit (9, 10, 11) whether an animal (2) is positioned suitably on the weighing unit (9, 10, 11) for a correct weighing, storing means being provided for storing data relating to each individual animal (2), such as weight data, control means being provided, operatively connected to 10 each weighing unit (9, 10, 11), the video monitoring and analyzing means and the storing means, wherein the control means are arranged to store weight data from each weighing unit (9, 10, 11) in the storing means as soon as it is established that an animal (2) is positioned suitably on the weighing unit (9, 10, 11) for a correct weighing. In this way, a highly useful, robust and flexible system is realized. The use 15 of video monitoring and analyzing means (8) in conjunction with a weighing unit (9, 10, 11) enables an automatic and accurate weighing of animals (2) moving about in an area (1). Moreover, the feed and/or drink intake of the animals (2) can be monitored automatically and accurately.

title: Self-induced livestock information acquisition system and management method
abstract: The invention relates to a self-induced livestock information acquisition system and a management method. By combining related technologies of Internet of Things, using a sensor and a control chip and taking a feed trough, a water trough or an inducing agent as an inducing mode, information of the identity, step number, body temperature and weight of pasture livestock is acquired in real time, after information of pasture environment, geography, position and the like is combined, a result is uploaded to a server database, and according to a feeding mode algorithm embedded in automatic identification of different growth stages and different physiological stages of livestock, data can be downloaded from the UI client for viewing, and a data processing result is downloaded. A deep machine learning platform is established for testing a livestock body weight curve, a motion health curve and a feed matching algorithm and training related models, and livestock pattern recognition algorithm training and transplanting are achieved. In view of foreign management systems with high cost and different languages, the invention creates a new management method for the pasture in China, and the method is low in cost, high in flexibility and especially suitable for management of small and medium-sized pastures.
applicants: HARBIN UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title: AUTOMATED POULTRY OR LIVESTOCK WELFARE TRACKING
abstract: Various proxies can be used to qualitatively or quantitatively assess welfare of a poultry flock. For example, as shown and described herein, one or more of a video-based monitoring technique or audio-based monitoring technique can be used. Such monitoring can include a video-based (e.g., image based) technique where indicia of movement of individual members of the flock are automatically tracked. In addition, or instead, an audio-based technique can be used, such as for classification of vocalization. Various metrics can be stored or reported using such techniques and one or more alerts can be generated, such as indicative of flock welfare or a change in flock welfare. Techniques described herein can include identifying paths traversed by respective members of a flock (e.g., individual animals), and then extracting indications such as corresponding to a distribution of such paths. Such paths can be defined by corresponding movement trajectories associated with individual members.

title: Livestock breeding system based on big data monitoring
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock breeding system based on big data monitoring, which comprises a base, a working groove is formed in the upper end surface of the base, two door fence devices are arranged at the upper end surface of the base, the two door fence devices are arranged away from each other, the two door fence devices are connected through a plurality of transverse bars, the plurality of transverse bars are located on the two sides of the two door fence devices respectively, a plurality of symmetrically-arranged bottom columns are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the side, away from the door fence devices, of the working groove, the plurality of bottom columns are located on the two sides respectively, sliding grooves are formed in the upper end surfaces of the plurality of bottom columns respectively, hole columns are slidably connected into the plurality of sliding grooves respectively, and supporting springs are fixedly connected to the side walls, away from the door fence devices, of the plurality of hole columns respectively. A user can conveniently, quickly and accurately complete animal bathing and cleaning work by using big data, and great convenience is brought to the user.

title: DEVICE FOR CONTACTLESS THERMAL IMAGING VIDEO DIGITAL DIAGNOSTICS OF ANIMAL DISEASES
abstract: FIELD: agriculture.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of agriculture, in particular animal husbandry, namely for the identification and diagnosis of diseases of cows. The device for non-contact thermal imaging video digital diagnostics of animal diseases contains a thermal imaging device, a manipulator, a selection gate and a control unit. The contactless thermal imaging device is made in the form of a thermal imager and a base fixed on the platform of the rotary mechanism of the manipulator, with the possibility of rotation in the vertical plane by means of a controlled linear drive of the parallelogram mechanism, which retains the horizontal position of the platform attached to the parallelogram mechanism. The thermal imaging device is also made with the possibility of rotation in the horizontal plane by means of a controlled second linear actuator pivotally connected to the manipulator arm. At the same time, the thermal imager is moved to take thermal images of the sides of the udder or other parts of the cow’s body by controlling the operation of the manipulator by the control unit based on the results of video shooting of the thermal imager itself according to the feedback principle. Moreover, the selection gates are controlled by the controller according to the commands of the control unit formed by the results of video shooting with a thermal imager.EFFECT: invention makes it possible to increase the automation of obtaining thermal images, which significantly improves and accelerates the identification and diagnosis of signs of pathology of cows, as well as accelerates the treatment of animals and keeps them healthy.1 cl, 2 dwg
applicants: Federalnoe gosudarstvennoe biudzhetnoe nauchnoe uchrezhdenie «Federalnyi nauchnyi agroinzhenernyi tsentr VIM» (FGBNU FNATs VIM)

title: Piglet ICU isolated breeding container and nursing system
abstract: The invention relates to a piglet ICU isolated breeding container and a nursing system, and belongs to the technical field of piglet nursing systems. The piglet ICU isolated breeding container comprises a container type box body, and the box body is divided into a breeding area, a constant-temperature ventilation area, a constant-temperature water supply area, and a plurality of container bodies, wherein the breeding area comprises an excrement leakage plate lifted up from the bottom of the box body, and a fence area and a walkway area which are located on the excrement leakage plate; the constant-temperature ventilation area comprises a heat exchange fan and an exhaust fan which are respectively arranged at the front and rear ends of the box body; the constant-temperature water supply area comprises two parallel water supply pipelines, a pressurizing pipeline, a water feeder and a milk feeder; the plurality of container bodies are connected in a distributed mode and gathered to main control equipment, and mine heating machines, ceiling lamps, heat exchange fans, exhaust fans, water pumps and heating wires in the container bodies are all independently controlled; and the main control equipment is respectively connected with remote monitoring equipment and a multifunctional gateway through a cloud server, the remote monitoring equipment comprises mobile intelligent equipment, a PC (Personal Computer) and intelligent large-screen remote monitoring equipment, and the remote monitoring equipment checks temperature and humidity in houses, gives alarms in real time and manually adjusts the running state of the equipment.

title: Prevention and control method for African swine fever
abstract: The invention provides a prevention and control method for African swine fever. The prevention and control method for the African swine fever specifically comprises the following steps of (1) installing an intelligent body temperature monitor in a pig house, monitoring the body temperature of pigs in real time, and isolating the pigs with abnormal body temperature; and (2) carrying out African virus detection on the isolated pigs, specifically, carrying out purification treatment on the pigs if a detection result is positive, and carrying out isolation treatment on the pigs if the detection result is negative. In addition, the prevention and control method for the African swine fever further comprises the steps of regularly sampling a swinery, carrying out African swine fever virus detection and antibody level detection, and carrying out immunity enhancement according to the antibody level, so that the immune condition of the swinery can be known in time, the immune level of the swinery is improved, the morbidity of the swinery is reduced, and the disease resistance of pigs is enhanced; the accumulation of unbalanced fatty acids in the body is reduced, and the body health is improved, so that the purposes of reducing the feed cost and improving the breeding benefit are achieved.

title: METHOD FOR MONITORING THE FEEDING AND WATER CONSUMPTION OF AN ANIMAL
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for monitoring the feeding and water consumption of a bovine such as a cow. According to the invention, at least one sensor transported by the bovine is used to detect the presence of water and/or food in an area located in the muzzle of said animal and outside the body of said animal, in order to identify intake of food or water by said bovine.

title: Livestock thermochromic ear tag, preparation method and machine vision monitoring system thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock thermochromic ear tag which comprises an ear tag body and a tag neck, the ear tag body comprises a part in contact with livestock skin as a first part, and the rest part of the ear tag body is a second part; at least the first part contains 1-3wt% of thermochromic powder; at least the second part is transparent or semitransparent thermoplastic plastic and can display the color of the first part; the thermochromic powder is white/colored thermochromic powder which changes color at 38 DEG C, the color of the thermochromic powder gradually becomes darker or lighter along with the temperature rise of livestock in contact with the thermochromic powder, and when the temperature reaches 41 DEG C, the thermochromic powder becomes colored/white which is opposite to the original color. The invention further discloses a preparation method of the thermochromic ear tag and a machine vision monitoring system of the thermochromic ear tag.
applicants: SICHUAN INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF TIANJIN UNIVERSITY

title: Variable-structure intelligent obstetric table for sows
abstract: The invention discloses a variable-structure intelligent obstetric table for sows. The variable-structure intelligent obstetric table for sows is characterized in that a piglet incubator is placed outside the area of a sow movable fence, two groups of pulleys are welded at two ends of each of a left-side position-adjustable fence and a right-side position-adjustable fence, and each group of pulleys are placed in a sliding rail; when a sow is just transferred to the obstetric table, the left-side position-adjustable fence and the right-side position-adjustable fence are respectively fixed beside a left fence and a right fence of the obstetric table, the antenatal sow can freely move on the obstetric table, the activity time sequence change characteristics of the sow are extracted from the behavior video of the sow, whether the sow is close to delivery or not is judged, if yes, a left-side electric drive pusher pushes the left-side position-adjustable fence to be fixed to the position below a left-side cross beam, and a right-side electric drive pusher pushes the right-side position-adjustable fence to be fixed to the position below a right-side cross beam, so that the sow is limited, the activity space of the sow is reduced, and the probability that piglets in the lactation period are deadly pressed by the sow is reduced.

title: Livestock breeding electronic identity tracing device based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock breeding electronic identity tracing device based on Internet of Things. The device comprises a positioning device, a weighing area is arranged right below the positioning device, breeding areas are arranged on the left side and the front side of the weighing area, a buffer area is arranged on the right side of the weighing area, and automatic feeding machines are arranged on the sides, away from the weighing area, of the breeding areas and the buffer area. Cameras are installed at the tops of the breeding areas and the buffer area, gates are arranged on the left side and the right side of the weighing area, an information reader is installed on the side wall of the weighing area, an electronic door is arranged on the rear side of the breeding area on the front side, the breeding areas and the buffer area are communicated through the electronic door, and livestock movement is facilitated. According to the device, the growth condition of livestock is monitored in batches, diet is monitored, and epidemic prevention and treatment can be conveniently carried out in time. Meanwhile, by means of the circulating site, cleaning is convenient, the separated livestock are marked through a distribution label module, a house can inquire the source of the livestock through a two-dimensional code, and disorder is avoided.
applicants: SHANGHAI QITU TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT CO., LTD.

title: Pig state analysis system and method based on visual AI
abstract: The invention discloses a pig state analysis system and method based on visual AI. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a pig image in a video stream format obtained by performing image acquisition on a pigsty; respectively indexing the edge information and the behavior attitude information of each acquired pig image, and training a classifier model; analyzing a to-be-discriminated current frame of pig image by using the trained discrimination model, and discriminating edge information and behavior attitude information of the current frame of pig image; recording the edge information of the current frame of pig image, evaluating the similarity with the edge information of each pig in the previous frame, calculating the Euclidean distance between the edge information of each pig in the previous frame and the mass center of the edge information of each pig in the previous frame, carrying out weighted summation to obtain a matching score, completing matching of one pig at the maximum score, and circulating the process to complete matching of all pigs, and counting the matching pairs as the total number of pigs. According to the method, the total number of pigs can be remotely counted in real time, the posture state of the pigs is analyzed, instance individuals do not need to be recognized, and the better running speed and recognition accuracy are achieved.
applicants: CHONGQING UCCHIP INFOTECH COMPANY; CHONGQING ACADEMY OF ANIMAL SCIENCES

title: Pig video data acquisition and visual AI-based pig behavior evaluation method
abstract: The invention discloses a pig video data acquisition and visual AI-based pig behavior evaluation method. According to the pig video data acquisition method, a plurality of video acquisition devices are used for acquiring pig video data of a pig farm site, the video acquisition devices are installed in the same shooting direction, and working parameters configured by the video acquisition devices are consistent. The pig behavior evaluation method comprises the following steps: labeling pig video data to obtain a trained data set; dividing the data set into a training data set and a test data set according to a preset proportion; using a classifier model to learn the training data set, using the test data set to evaluate and correct the learned classifier model, and finally training a discrimination model for identifying pig behaviors; and identifying pig video data to be identified by using the discrimination model, and outputting identified pig behavior information. The acquired pig video data are normalized, unified processing is facilitated, and the evaluation method has high accuracy.
applicants: CHONGQING UCCHIP INFOTECH COMPANY; CHONGQING ACADEMY OF ANIMAL SCIENCES

title: Smart Stable having eco-friendly energy
abstract: A smart barn according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a photovoltaic module including a solar panel, and a livestock manure treatment device operated by electric energy generated through the photovoltaic module, and the livestock manure treatment device includes a manure collector to collect livestock manure, a manure treatment device for processing the manure collector into a specific state of livestock manure, and a manure discharger for discharging livestock manure treated in a specific state through the manure treatment device.

title: METHOD OF MANAGING DISEASE AND APPARATUSES OPERATING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a disease management method and apparatuses for executing the same. The livestock disease management method includes: a step of receiving biometric information on livestock from a biosensor capsule in the body thereof; a singularity detection step of detecting a singularity out of a reference value based on the biometric information; a health status monitoring step of increasing the disease probability of the livestock after the singularity detection; and a disease detection step of determining a health status abnormality of the livestock when the disease probability of the livestock is equal to or higher than a first threshold. According to the present invention, it is possible to quickly detect an individual suspected of having a reproductive disorder (ovarian cyst) and provide intensive care (veterinarian consultation and hormonal prescription) at a farm, and thus the productivity of the farm can be enhanced.

title: Dairy cow real-time rumination behavior identification method based on edge calculation
abstract: The invention discloses a dairy cow real-time rumination behavior identification method based on edge calculation, and belongs to the technical field of livestock and poultry healthy breeding. The method includes the following steps: S1, fixing a rumination detector on a halter of an individual dairy cow; after rumination behaviors of the dairy cow are detected, selecting a known rumination sample data set of the individual dairy cow, and then selecting continuous 24-hour three-axis acceleration data containing the rumination behaviors and other behaviors as a test data set; S2, performing data segmentation and framing processing on the ruminant data set and the test data set by taking 256 frames as a group to form short blocks to identify the ruminant behavior of the dairy cow; S3, performing feature extraction on a minimum processing unit formed by data segmentation; and S4, after the data set is preprocessed in the steps S1 to S3, identifying the rumination behavior of the dairy cow in real time by using a rumination behavior identification algorithm based on KNN improvement. According to the method, the data transmission pressure and the cloud computing amount are reduced, and higher real-time performance and efficiency are achieved.

title: Maternal and fetal heart rate monitor
abstract: Described herein are systems, devices, and methods for non-invasive pregnancy testing. The systems, devices, and methods can be used to provide pregnancy status information of a subject by detecting cardiovascular activity of a fetus in the subject. Subjects can include ruminants, ungulates, and humans.
applicants: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA; THE REGENTS OF THE UNVIERSITY OF CALIFORNIA

title: Intelligent livestock raising system and method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock breeding, and discloses an intelligent livestock raising system and method. The system comprises an intelligent weighing device, a fence, a grating intelligent door, a metering feeding device and a host. The intelligent livestock raising system has the following advantages and effects that the recorded data such as the livestock ingestion time, the ingestion amount, the empty weight of the livestock, the weight of the fed livestock and the feeding amount accurately correspond to each livestock, the data quality is high, the livestock feeding rule can be conveniently analyzed through big data, a more excellent feeding mode can be formulated, meanwhile, data collection consumes less manpower, and the efficiency is high. The livestock is promoted to enter the fence by means of the feeding instinct of the livestock, manpower is rarely relied on, the livestock is low in resistance mood and not prone to stress reaction, time and labor are saved, and efficiency is high. In addition, as the livestock is in a hungry state and enters the system provided by the invention, excretion dirt is not easily generated in the weighing and feeding processes, and the maintenance and clean-keeping cost of the system is low.

title: LIVESTOCK RESTRAINING DEVICES, SYTEMS FOR LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT, AND USES THEREOF
abstract: Tools for smart farming, including devices, management systems and methods of livestock management are provided.

title: An intelligent livestock feeding system and its feeding method
abstract: This invention discloses an intelligent livestock feeding system and its feeding method, which comprises of a feeding machine, a plurality of temperature and humidity sensor, a touch display screen and a wireless communication module, wherein the feeding machine is internally provided with a main control processor and a storage module. The described main control processor can formulate a feeding scheme according to the breeding environment information collected by various sensors and the movement condition of livestock, and it can also control the first electromagnetic valve and the second electromagnetic valve to feed materials to the food stirring device to form livestock food. When the food is insufficient, the feeding system can also send promptly information of insufficiency to the intelligent terminal of the user. The feeding system can actively monitor the breeding environment and livestock conditions, in order to judge and adjust the dynamics of the amount of feed required.

title: MATERIALS AND METHODS FOR LONG-TERM TRACKING OF GROUP-HOUSED LIVESTOCK
abstract: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method of tracking animals is provided. Such a method typically includes recognizing, by using at least one data processor, individual animals in images of a plurality of the animals; and tracking the animals using a probabilistic tracking-by-detection process. In another aspect, a system for recognizing animals is provided. Such a system typically includes an instance detection and part localization module; a visual marker classification module; a fixed-cardinality track interpolation module; and a maximum a posteriori estimation of animal identity module.

title: Intelligent pigsty for identifying individual pig weight
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent pigsty for identifying the individual pig weight, which comprises a weighing bottom plate. The top end of the weighing bottom plate is provided with a bearing plate, the bearing plate is internally provided with four high-precision weighing sensors, the four high-precision weighing sensors are uniformly distributed at four corners of the bearing plate, and the top end of the weighing bottom plate is provided with side plates. The number of the side plates is two, the two side plates are arranged on the two sides of the top end of the weighing bottom plate respectively, and the bottom ends of the side plates are fixedly connected with the weighing bottom plate. According to the pigsty, large-scale pigs can be rapidly weighed, the weighing qualification rate is high, the weighing efficiency is high, the identities of the pigs can be accurately recognized through weight data, the data are transmitted to a data processing terminal in a wireless transmission mode, the nutrition conditions of the pigs are evaluated according to the growth curves of the pigs, and if the real-time weight of the pigs is smaller than the due weight of the growth curve, early warning is carried out on the physical health condition of the pigs, so that a worker is reminded to check the health condition of the pigs or eliminate the pigs.
applicants: SOUTHWEST UNIVERSITY; CHONGQING ACADEMY OF ANIMAL SCIENCES

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MONITORING ESTRUS AND OVULATION
abstract: This invention relates to a method for monitoring estrus and ovulation, and for determining time for insemination of an animal, preferably a pig. The present invention furthermore relates to a system for monitoring estrus and ovulation, and for determining time for insemination of an animal, preferably a pig.

title: MANAGEMENT DEVICE, MANAGEMENT METHOD, AND MANAGEMENT PROGRAM
abstract: [Problem] To provide an imaging device and an imaging method with which an action can be identified with high accuracy even if a reference atmospheric pressure changes due to the position of livestock. [Solution] A management device comprises: an acquisition unit that acquires atmospheric pressure information, within a prescribed range, from an animal to be managed, such acquisition based on position information of the animal; an atmospheric pressure estimation unit that uses the atmospheric pressure information to estimate a reference atmospheric pressure at the position of the animal; and a posture estimation unit that estimates whether the animal is in a standing state or a laying-down state according to a difference between the reference atmospheric pressure and an atmospheric pressure based on an output signal of an atmospheric pressure sensor attached to the animal.

title: Monitoring and early warning method for physiological growth states of pigs
abstract: Aiming at the limitation of the prior art, the invention provides a monitoring and early warning method for physiological growth states of pigs. According to the invention, the body size, the weight, the body temperature and the behavior of a pig can be monitored through the depth image, the thermal infrared image and the RGB image of the pig, and meanwhile, early warning on the abnormal body temperature and the oestrus condition of the pig is also realized; and thus, the refinement and intelligentization levels of the pig breeding industry in the aspect of production management and control can be improved.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR DETERMINING PHASE TRANSITION IN YOUNG ANIMAL.
abstract: This document relates to a method for determining in a young animal a phase transition from a first development phase to a second development phase. The method comprises measuring, with a measuring instrument, one or more body or behavior parameters of the animal during a period of time and producing one or more measuring values for the or each measured body or behavior parameter. The one or more measuring values are received by a controller with which the phase transition is detected on the basis of the measuring values. The step of detecting the phase transition comprises processing the measuring values and, depending thereon, determining an extent of the animal's attention to solid food. Further, the document relates to the training of a self-learning data processing model, and to a livestock management system.

title: Chicken behavior and environment relation analysis method and system based on multi-color-difference model
abstract: The invention discloses a chicken behavior and environment relation analysis method and system based on a multi-color-difference model. The method comprises the following steps: calculating a temperature and humidity index and an ammonia concentration value of each time period; counting the number of times that the chicken body images appear at each position in the chicken house and generating a distribution heat map; selecting the proportion of the pixel points in the set frequency range to the total pixel points of the distribution heat map as the activeness information of the chicken in the time period; and analyzing the relationship between the temperature and humidity index and the activeness information and the relationship between the ammonia concentration value and the activeness information. According to the method, the yellow-feather chickens are separated from the collected images by using the multi-color-difference model, so that related personnel are helped to carry out future analysis; according to the method, the activity heat maps of the yellow-feather chickens in different time periods are generated through the processed images, and researchers can be helped to carry out behavior analysis on the yellow-feather chickens. The temperature and humidity index, the ammonia concentration value and the activity index of the yellow feather chickens are combined, and the obtained conclusion provides a theoretical basis for environment control personnel to adjust the environment in the poultry house.

title: Intelligent mobile artificial fish nest experiment platform for visco-demersal breeding fishes
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent mobile artificial fish nest experiment platform for visco-demersal breeding fishes. The platform comprises an artificial fish nest bed body and an intelligent mobile base, and is characterized in that the artificial fish nest bed body is of a structure shaped like a Chinese character 'tian', four sides of the artificial fish nest bed body are loaded with buoyancy cylinders, and the middle part is provided with an experiment observation camera. Four corners of the intelligent mobile base are respectively provided with a group of Mecanum wheels, and the intelligent mobile base is loaded with an omnidirectional mobile motor, a stable support motor, an intelligent console, a magnetic plate, an underwater camera system and a telescopic hinge. According to the platform, the defect that protection measures for the visco-demersal breeding fishes are lacked at present is overcome, a proper spawning site is provided for the visco-demersal fishes, the influence of underwater topographic changes caused by river and lake water level changes and dam flood discharge on the growth and development of the visco-demersal fish eggs is weakened, the protection effect of the artificial fish nest on the visco-demersal fish eggs is optimized, and more technical bases are provided for the protection of the spawning site of the visco-demersal fish.
applicants: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER COMPANY; CHINA INSTITUTE OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWERRESEARCH

title: Livestock weight estimation method, device and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock weight estimation method, a device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: collecting image data of to-be-estimated livestock in a target region, dividing the image data into a training set and a test set, and enabling the image data to comprise depth data and visible light data; performing data annotation on the image data in the training set to obtain to-be-processed data; inputting depth data and visible light data in the to-be-processed data into a deep learning neural network model for model training to obtain a livestock weight evaluation model; and inputting the test set into the livestock weight evaluation model to obtain weight data of the to-be-evaluated livestock. According to the embodiment of the invention, the depth data and the visible light data of the livestock are collected through computer vision to estimate the weight of the livestock, so that the workload and the weight estimation error can be effectively reduced, and the efficiency of livestock weight estimation can be effectively improved.

title: Pig house cleaning robot
abstract: The invention provides a pig house cleaning robot. The robot comprises a robot body, a walking mechanism, an executing mechanism, a navigation system and a control system, the walking mechanism comprises four omnidirectional wheels evenly distributed in the circumferential direction of the bottom face of the robot body, every two adjacent omnidirectional wheels are arranged in a splayed shape, and each omnidirectional wheel is powered by a driving assembly; the navigation system comprises a plurality of sensors fixedly arranged on the robot body, the sensors are in communication connection with the control system, and the walking mechanism and the executing mechanism are controlled to act through the control system. In order to enhance the applicability of an existing pig house cleaning robot to pig houses in an excrement leakage floor environment, improve the cleaning efficiency and increase the function of detecting the body temperature of pigs in the excrement removing working process, the pig house cleaning robot is provided. The pig house cleaning robot is convenient to use, thorough in cleaning, energy-saving and environment-friendly, a full-automatic pig house cleaning mode can be achieved, the working efficiency is improved to a great extent, and the environmental conditions of the pig house are improved.

title: Building type smart livestock-breeding farm
abstract: The present invention relates to a building-type smart livestock farm, and more specifically to a building-type smart livestock farm which can significantly improve a livestock breeding environment and solve environmental pollution problems caused by livestock farming. The building-type smart livestock farm according to the present invention comprises: a building structure (100) including a multi-layer structure; a plurality of indoor livestock housing unit (200) formed on each floor of the building structure (100) and having an odor removal means (220) therein; a quarantine management unit (300) managing and disinfecting livestock raised in the indoor livestock housing unit (200); and an excrement treatment unit (400) installed in the basement of the building structure (100) to treat excrement and odor excreted from the livestock raised. Accordingly, livestock farming can be performed more efficiently.

title: APPARATUS FOR LOCATIONAL CONTROL OF ANIMAL VOIDING AND METHOD THEREFOR
abstract: - 58 A wearable device for moving animals in a pastoral environment from their current location to a more desirable location to defecate or urinate (void). The device administers a stimulus to a bovine animal to move it away from less desirable locations such as waterways, to more desirable locations, such as areas of carbon-rich soil or areas where previous animals have not voided recently.

title: Monitoring system for growth monitoring individual livestock animals
abstract: A growth monitoring system, and method, for livestock animals comprises a barn environment that has a floor with bedding material, a 3D camera with a downward looking 5 field-of-view, in which an animal may be present during a visit, to obtain repeatedly a 3D image of said field-of-view, an image processorto extract a 3D point cloud representation. The image processor detects whether an animal is present in said point cloud representation, and if yes, selects the animal part point cloud of said point cloud representation, and determines a position dependent first height information, being a 10 height above the floor of said animal part point cloud, and determines a position of the front legs and/or the hind legs of the animal, and if no, determines a position dependent second height information, being a height above the floor of the bedding material. The image processor determines a height of the animal at the visit from the first height information, the second height information and the position of the front legs and/or of the 15 hind legs. This provides a reliable height measurementwithout manual labour, in a natural environment for the animals.

title: Pig cough identification method, device and equipment and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a pig cough identification method, which can improve the precision of cough identification by acquiring to-be-identified stiff data, extracting effective sound in the data and dividing the data into small sound segments for feature extraction, and can perceive the sound state of a pig by using a neural network model for classification and identification according to the extracted features, the cough classification results can be generated, and the convolutional neural network is called to realize the recognition of cough in pigs. Compared with a template matching method adopted in a traditional method, the pig cough identification method has the advantages that the cough identification precision can be greatly improved, meanwhile, the difficulty of data marking is also reduced, and the method can replace manual inspection through automatic processing of equipment, manpower is saved, contact between people and the pigs is reduced, transmission of infectious diseases is prevented, and health of the pigs is guaranteed. The invention further discloses a pig cough recognition device and equipment and a readable storage medium, which have corresponding technical effects.
applicants: HENAN MUYUAN INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Cattle tracking system
abstract: An animal tracking system comprising a first LoRa receiver configured as a gateway to receive transmissions on a first set of channels or a second set of channels and forward said transmissions to a first remote server, and a transmitting tag configured to be affixed to an animal. The transmitting tag includes a memory configured to store digital information, a passive RFID receiver configured to detect a close proximity to an RFID transmitter and store detection of the close proximity in comprising in the memory, a processor configured to determine an alarm status according to a frequency of detection of the close proximity, an internal energy source, and a LoRa transmitter configured to transmit signals for a distance greater than 100 meters via energy from the internal energy source.

title: Herd pig individual recognition system and method based on character spraying and image recognition
abstract: The invention discloses a herd pig individual recognition system and method based on spraying character and image recognition. The herd pig individual recognition system comprises a central processing system, a first spraying recognition control mechanism and second image acquisition equipment; The first spraying identification control mechanism is arranged on a closable entrance channel at the entrance of the pig growth house and comprises a first character spraying device and first image acquisition equipment; the second image acquisition equipment is arranged above the pig group activity area in the pig growth house; and the first image acquisition equipment, the first character spraying device and the second image acquisition equipment are respectively connected with the central processing system and are controlled by the central processing system to work. According to the method, herd pig group individual identification can be completed under the non-contact condition, the pig stress response caused by manual intervention can be reduced, and the risk that the pigs are infected with diseases can be reduced.

title: Portable long-term temperature measurement ear tag and temperature measurement method
abstract: The invention discloses a portable long-term temperature measurement ear tag and a temperature measurement method.
