The portable long-term temperature measurement ear tag comprises an ear tag body and a main control board, wherein the ear tag body comprises an ear tag upper shell and an ear tag lower shell, a groove hole is formed in the ear tag upper shell, an ear tag column is arranged on the front face of the ear tag lower shell, the ear tag column penetrates through the groove hole to enable the ear tag lower shell and the ear tag upper shell to be buckled with each other, the main control board comprises a temperature measurement module and a power supply module, the temperature measurement module comprises a first temperature sensor and is used for collecting the body temperature of an animal, and the power supply module supplies power to the temperature measurement module, and the invention further provides a temperature measurement method of the temperature measurement ear tag. The ear tag is tightly attached to one ear of an animal to stably obtain real-time temperature data, temperature correction is achieved through environmental factors, temperature measurement is accurate, real-time performance is high, and the method can be used for conducting stable early warning analysis and giving an alarm.

title: Cow nose ring and cow health monitoring device and method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of animal husbandry, and provides a cow nose ring and a cow health monitoring device and method thereof. The cow health monitoring device comprises a data collection device, a data transmission device, a microcontroller and a power module. The data collection device comprises an air pressure sensor, an environment sensor, a water pressure sensor and a nine-axis sensor. The microcontroller controls the data collection device to collect air pressure intensity, temperature, carbon dioxide concentration, water pressure intensity data and dairy cow movement information data, the dairy cow movement posture is observed, the dairy cow water drinking behavior and breathing state are analyzed, whether the dairy cow has the crippling behavior or not is judged, and the health state of the dairy cow is comprehensively analyzed. According to the cow health monitoring device, the data collection device, the data transmission device, the microcontroller and the power module are arranged on the single cow nose ring, so that the defects of incomplete monitoring data, inaccurate data and overhigh monitoring cost are overcome.

title: Livestock breeding acceptance system and method
abstract: The invention provides a livestock breeding acceptance system and method. The livestock breeding acceptance system comprises an acceptance selection subsystem, a breeding monitoring subsystem, a breeding interaction subsystem and a client. According to the livestock breeding acceptance system provided by the invention, the Internet of Things technology, the virtual computer technology, the network communication technology and the like are combined, the client can remotely and comprehensively know the infrastructure and environment conditions of a breeding site, and livestock satisfying a customer can be selected; the growth condition of the accepted livestock is monitored in real time, feeding and scratching massage can be conducted remotely, and interactivity and participation are improved.
applicants: ANHUI ZHONGHUI CHUANGLIAN NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Livestock heart rate measurement with bolus sensor
abstract: Various examples describe a livestock monitoring system and method. A sensor signal may comprise a rotational component describing a rotation of the sensor within an animal and a linear component describing a linear movement of the sensor within the animal. The rotational component may be used to identify an animal respiration signal. The animal respiration signal and the linear component may be used to generate a respiration-corrected linear component. An animal heart signal may be detected from the respiration-corrected linear component.

title: DETERMINATION OF METHANE EMITTED BY RUMINANTS
abstract: Eructations from ruminant animals is measured by use of an electronic bolus in the animals' reticulum, and a host processor which receives sensing data via a communication gateway. The bolus sensors provide physical 3D movement of the bolus in the animal's rumen, specifically ventral sac. By calibration according to general animal phenotypes, group quantitative data for volume of emissions can be determined for periods of time up to the full lifetime of an animal. The processor monitors, according to accelerometer signals, animal body activity to determine in real time periods in which it monitors with increased sensitivity contractions in an animal's rumen. It determines a monitoring period as a period when body activity is below a threshold and also rumination is taking place. It identifies low body activity primarily according to movement of the accelerometer; and identifies rumination according to a pattern of body activity and a condition that it follows immediately after feeding. It monitors rumination primary and secondary contractions during monitoring periods, and identifies a secondary contraction as representative of an eructation.

title: IoT SMART CATTLE SHED EQUIPMENT BASED ON IoT AND CATTLE SHED MONITORING SYSTEM INCLUDING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to smart cattle shed equipment based on IoT and a cattle shed monitoring system comprising the same which can conduct professional and efficient cattle shed management by remotely and automatically conducting persistent history management on a cattle shed entity and cattle shed environment management in real time, and address problems of labor force supply in rural areas. According to the present invention, provided is the smart cattle shed equipment comprising: a temperature sensor module which is installed in one or more places of a cattle shed to detect a temperature of the cattle shed and has a near field communication module; a humidity sensor module which is installed in one or more places of the cattle shed to detect humidity of the cattle shed and has a near field communication module; a vital sign sensor module which is fixed to an entity fed in the cattle shed, has a near field communication module, senses a vital sign of the entity and transmits the sensed vital sign data to a user server or a cattle shed monitoring server in a remote area; an air conditioning module which is installed in the cattle shed to provide air conditioning in the cattle shed; a water spraying device which is installed in the cattle shed to spray or inject water to at least one of inside or outside of the cattle shed; a lighting device which is installed in the cattle shed and configured to light the inside or outside of the cattle shed; and a user server which receives detection data from each module and has a control module configured to control each device.

title: History-based artificial intelligence abnormal behavior detection system
abstract: The present invention relates to a history-based artificial intelligence (AI) abnormal behavior detection system. The history-based AI abnormal behavior detection system of the present invention comprises: a data collection unit installed on the livestock to collect activity data of the livestock; a periodic activity data generation unit collecting the livestock activity data collected at regular intervals for a preset period and storing the same as periodic activity data in order to determine whether there are any abnormalities in the livestock among the livestock activity data collected by the data collection unit; a history data generation unit generating history data by updating livestock activity data collected by the data collection unit at regular intervals; and an abnormality determination unit determining whether the livestock is normal or abnormal according to the similarity between the periodic activity data collected by a periodic activity data setting unit and the history data updated at regular intervals by a history data setting unit. Accordingly, abnormal behaviors of the livestock can be efficiently detected regardless of the cow's age, species, nature, and rearing environment.

title: Milk feed supply vehicle, calf feeding control system and calf feeding method
abstract: The invention provides a milk feed supply vehicle, and belongs to the field of animal husbandry. The milk feed supply vehicle comprisess a vehicle body, a material storage tank, a material injection gun and an electric cabinet, wherein the material storage tank is installed on a cargo carrying platform of the vehicle body through a fixing support, the electric cabinet is installed at the rear end of a tank body of the material storage tank, a milk feeding opening is formed in the top of the tank body, a sealing cover is arranged on the milk feeding opening, a breather valve is arranged at the top of the tank body, a liquid outlet and a reflux inlet are formed in the bottom of the rear end of the tank body, a temperature sensor is installed at the bottom of the rear end of the tank body, the collecting end of the temperature sensor is located inside the tank body, the temperature sensor is electrically connected to the electric cabinet, the two side edges of an outer shell of the tank body are each provided with a material injection gun support used for hanging the material injection gun. The invention further provides a calf feeding control system and a calf feeding method.

title: Vegetable planting system based on biogas slurry purification
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of vegetable planting systems, and particularly discloses a vegetable planting system based on biogas slurry purification. The vegetable planting system comprises a breeding system, a planting and production system and a pollutant treatment system. Livestock breeding is managed through the breeding system, biogas slurry obtained after excrement and urine pollutants generated by livestock are treated through the pollutant treatment system is provided for the planting and production system to be used for vegetable planting and production, the planting and production system can purify the biogas slurry to form purified water to be recycled, and the whole planting and breeding combined system supports one another, so that the technical problem that excrement and urine pollutants generated in the current breeding industry are insufficiently treated or utilized is solved, and meanwhile, the technical problem that fertilizer of the planting and production system is excessively used is solved; and resources in the whole planting system are repeatedly recycled, treated and reused, and the whole production activity is intelligently managed, so that the economic benefits of agriculture and breeding industry are greatly improved.
applicants: ANHUI SHUIBULUO ENVIRONMENTAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Ecological and environment-friendly floor pig raising comprehensive system
abstract: The invention discloses an ecological and environment-friendly floor pig raising comprehensive system which comprises a base, a raising room is arranged at the top end of the base, the lower end of a hinge rod is connected with a pressing plate, and the bottom end of an excrement tank communicates with a waste liquid treatment tank through a pipeline. Through the arrangement of the excrement tank, a separation plate, a pressure sensor, a controller and the pressing plate, when excrement accumulated on the separation plate reaches a certain weight, the pressure sensor transmits a signal to the controller, the controller controls all the components, urine wastewater and the like doped in the excrement are extruded and separated, and the urine wastewater is discharged into the waste liquid treatment tank through a pipeline, so that dry-wet separation of the excrement is realized; and by arranging a push plate, after the dry-wet separation of the excrement, an electric telescopic rod is controlled by the controller to enable the push plate to be withdrawn forwards, so that dry excrement is taken out, electric control operation is adopted, manual operation of workers is not needed, on one hand, manpower and material resources are saved, and on the other hand, cleaning is more complete.
applicants: WUHU SHANLAN ECOLOGICAL AGRICULTURE TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Real-time cattle front face ID coding method
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time cattle front face ID coding method. The method comprises a data preprocessing stage and a cattle face recognition stage. According to the invention, non-intrusive ID confirmation can be carried out on the cattle by using an image recognition technology and any portable equipment; the identity of the cattle can be confirmed only by collecting the front face of the cattle with the highest exposure probability, and compared with similar methods, the method is higher in collection speed, higher in real-time performance and better in production landing capacity; the real-time image segmentation and illumination adaptive technology is adopted, so that the influence caused by background noise and uneven illumination is greatly reduced, and the system has better robustness in a non-standard environment.

title: Livestock disease control system and method
abstract: According to the present invention, a livestock disease control system comprises: a monitoring device that monitors a livestock farm; a terminal device that performs at least one of information input and query input/output; an artificial intelligence learning model that determines a state by using external information received from at least one of the monitoring device and the terminal device; and a database in which the external information and a determination result of the artificial intelligence learning model are stored.

title: Intelligent water drinking device for hog house
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent water drinking device for a hog house. The intelligent water drinking device comprises a water supply pipeline and water drinking bowls arranged on the water supply pipeline, wherein the water supply pipeline is connected with a computer control system and supplies water according to a preset program. The intelligent water drinking device is characterized in that 4-6 water drinking bowls are arranged side by side, the optimal water drinking heights of all the water drinking bowls are located at different positions on the same oblique line, and the optimal water drinking height refers to the most suitable water drinking height for pigs of different month ages (ages). The intelligent water drinking device for the pig house is good in universality, water drinking of all pigs in a single fattening house can be met by using one device, the intelligent water drinking device is suitable for water drinking of fattening pigs of any age, weight and body type and is not limited by the age, the weight and the body type of the pigs, the pigs can comfortably drink water in the whole fattening stage, and the situation of mouth pinning/mouth clamping in the drinking process of the pigs is avoided.

title: Live pig growth state acquisition method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a live pig growth state acquisition method and system. The live pig growth state acquisition method comprises the steps that the contact area S of live pigs and a detection plate is acquired, and the number M of the live pigs on the detection plate is acquired; a first total weight A1 of the live pigs on the detection plate is acquired, and a second total weight A2 of the live pigs on the detection plate is acquired after a certain time; the current weight Wt of the live pigs is obtained according to the first total weight A1, the second total weight A2 and the number M of the live pigs; and growth state factors of the live pigs are acquired according to the contact area S, the current weight Wt and the gender of the live pigs. According to the live pig growth state acquisition method, the weight of the live pigs and the growth state factors of the live pigs can be obtained, workers can adjust the captivity mode of the live pigs according to the current weight and the growth state factors, and the balance degree of live pig growth is improved; and in addition, the workers can adjust the feeding mode of the live pigs according to the current weight and growth state factors, the health degree of the live pigs is improved, and the meat quality of the live pigs is improved.

title: MONITORING SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MOUNTING BEHAVIOR IN LIVESTOCK BARN
abstract: A monitoring system for a mounting behavior in a livestock barn, according to an embodiment of the present invention, comprises: one or more first cameras installed at the entrance of the livestock barn to collect facial images including front, left, right, rear, and planar images of livestock; a plurality of mounting monitoring sensors installed on the inner wall of the livestock barn at a height corresponding to a monitoring height in order to detect in real time whether an obstacle exists at a preset monitoring height; a plurality of second cameras installed on the ceiling of the livestock barn to simultaneously capture images of the entire livestock barn and obtain images inside the livestock barn; and a control unit. When the livestock enter the livestock barn, the control unit stores the facial images of individual livestock collected from the first camera, determines that a mounting behavior has occurred when the obstacle is detected by one or more of the plurality of mounting monitoring sensors, transmits an operating signal to the plurality of second cameras so as to obtain the images of the inside of the livestock barn, and compares the images inside the livestock barn with the facial images to identify livestock participating in the mounting. Therefore, the present invention can improve a conception rate.

title: Ecological breeding method for improving disease resistance of live pigs
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of live pig breeding, and discloses an ecological breeding method for improving the disease resistance of live pigs, which comprises the following steps: establishing an ecological breeding farm for improving disease resistance of the live pigs according to a geographic position and a previous environmental state of the geographic position; from two aspects of pig farm health management and pig herd health management, establishing an intelligent acquisition system and an intelligent control system; according to the data acquired by the intelligent acquisition system, equipment in the farm is controlled, and changing the environment in the pig farm; and meanwhile, in the ecological breeding process for improving disease resistance of the live pigs, disinfecting the individual live pigs and the breeding farm for disease prevention and treatment. From two aspects of pig farm health management and pig herd health management, the intelligent acquisition system and then intelligent control system are established, so that live pig diseases are prevented in a mode of reducing drugs or additives, and the safety of meat quality is improved. The big data processing technology and the Internet of Things technology can be used for ecological breeding for improving disease resistance of the live pigs, and the breeding effect is improved.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR SMART LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT BASED ON INTERNET OF THINGS
abstract: Disclosed are an Internet of things (IoT)-based smart livestock management method and system. The smart livestock management system according to an embodiment may comprise a gate. The gate may include: a frame which forms a movement path of an animal; an external device which is disposed on the frame to irradiate electromagnetic waves toward the movement path, and receives identification information and biometric information of the animal from an implant device inserted into the body of the animal passing through the movement path; and a camera which obtains image data of the animal passing through the movement path.

title: Beef cattle health automatic monitoring system
abstract: The invention particularly relates to a beef cattle health automatic monitoring system. The beef cattle health automatic monitoring system comprises an acquisition channel and a processing module, the acquisition channel only allows a single cattle to enter, and the acquisition channel is provided with a camera for shooting cattle face photos or videos is arranged and provided with a pressure and temperature sensor for acquiring the body weight and body temperature of the cattle; and the processing module receives the cattle face photos or videos, identifies the single cattle, associates the data acquired by the sensor with the identified identity information of the cattle, analyzes and processes the weight and body temperature data of the cattle to obtain the health condition of the cattle, and outputs the health condition of the cattle. Only one cattle can enter the acquisition channel every time to acquire related data of the cattle, and it is ensured that data of all cattle in a cattle farm are independent; and besides, the face of each cattle in the cattle farm is shot to identify the identity of the cattle, ear tags do not need to be installed on ears, and many defects in the background technology are overcome.
applicants: ANHUI NONGDAO INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; ANHUI UNIVERSITY

title: IDENTIFYING POULTRY ASSOCIATED WITH EGGS OF A QUALITY
abstract: Example systems and methods receive camera data representative of images of a hen located in a cage. The hen can be identified based on identifiable biometric characteristics. When an egg is laid, the hen that laid the egg can be identified, based on an analysis that considers the one of the identifiable biometric characteristics of the hen, egg data, and a proximity in time between a pattern of movement indicative of a laying behavior by the hen, and the time the egg was detected being laid. An iterative process can be performed wherein the egg data and subsequently collected egg data can be used to determine a level of quality of eggs laid by the hen.

title: Free-range sheep flock integrated management system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of modern breeding, and particularly relates to a free-range sheep flock integrated management system, which comprises sheep terminals and a management terminal. Each sheep terminal is arranged on the body of a sheep. The management terminal comprises a human-computer interaction interface, an information transmission module and a built-in management system. The built-in management system comprises a body temperature abnormity judgment module, a sheep position management module and a sheep returning management module. The real-time data received by the body temperature abnormity judgment module comprises sheep body temperature and movement data. Compared with the prior art, the system has the following advantages that in the grazing process of the free-range sheep, the sheep flock can be remotely monitored and managed by arranging the sheep grazing terminals and the management terminal, the labor intensity of workers in a sheep farm is relieved, and the labor cost is saved; sheep disease information is obtained correctly, and workload increase caused by misjudgment is avoided; the outlier sheep are early warned in time to avoid loss; and precise management of the sheep flock is realized.

title: Intelligent aisle device for beef cattle body type parameter acquisition and motion health recognition
abstract: The invention particularly relates to an intelligent aisle device for beef cattle body type parameter acquisition and motion health recognition. A pedometer for recording the step number and identity information of a cattle is worn on the body of the cattle, a walking aisle allows a single cattle to pass through orderly, a weighing machine is arranged in the walking aisle and used for measuring the weight of the cattle, an infrared camera is used for shooting three-dimensional infrared images of the cattle, a card reader is used for reading information in the pedometer, photoelectric detection sensors are arranged at an entrance and an exit of the walking aisle respectively and used for judging the passing state of the cattle, and a processing module receives data output by the sensors and processes and analyzes the data. The walking aisle ensures that only one cattle passes through each time, and various sensors are arranged, so that the body type parameters and health data of the cattle can be comprehensively obtained, and data reference and decision basis are provided for formulating a scientific feeding plan for a farm; and meanwhile, the individual abnormality of the cattle can be diagnosed in real time by using a data analysis and mining technology, and important technical support is provided for avoiding loss and breeding risks in the farm.

title: Utilisation of loop mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) testing for the detection of mycobacterium paratuberculosis
abstract: This innovation patent embodies an innovation of the loop mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) chemical process to allow for its use in the detection of mycobacterium paratuberculosis (MAP) that ordinarily causes Johne's Disease in livestock and domesticated animals, specifically sheep, cattle, goats, alpacas, deer, horses, dogs and cats. This innovation patent embodies the gene sequence of MAP to be detected via the LAMP primer and means of detection and provides a means of replication of the method of manufacture within its claims and accompanying description.

title: Utilisation of loop mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) testing for the detection of Corynebacterium Pseudotuberculosis
abstract: This innovation patent embodies a diagnostic tool that provides for an innovation of the loop mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) chemical process to allow for its use in the detection of Corynebacterium Pseudotuberculosis that ordinarily causes caseous lymphadenitis; or 'cheesy gland' in livestock and domesticated animals, specifically sheep, cattle, goats, alpacas, deer, horses, camels, pigs and dogs. This innovation patent embodies the diagnostic tool to locate the gene sequence of Corynebacterium Pseudotuberculosis to be detected via the LAMP primer and provides a means of replication of the method of manufacture within its claims and accompanying description.

title: Utilisation of loop mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) testing for the detection of H5N8 Avian Influenza
abstract: This innovation patent embodies a diagnostic tool that provides for an innovation of the loop mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) chemical process to allow for its use in the detection of H5N8 Avian Influenza that ordinarily causes Avian Influenza; or 'Bird Flu' in livestock and domesticated animals, specifically chickens, turkeys, pheasants, partridges, quail, pigeons, ducks, geese, pigs and cats. This innovation patent embodies the diagnostic tool to locate the gene sequence of H5N8 Avian Influenza to be detected via the LAMP primer and provides a means of replication of the method of manufacture within its claims and accompanying description.

title: Ear tag type body temperature monitoring system for pig breeding
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent breeding, and discloses an ear tag type body temperature monitoring system for pig breeding. The ear tag type body temperature monitoring system comprises a main controller, an electronic display module and a body temperature monitoring module, the signal input end of the main controller is electrically connected with the body temperature monitoring module, the signal output end of the main controller is electrically connected with the electronic display module so as to display body temperature information collected by the body temperature monitoring module, and the body temperature monitoring module comprises a plurality of ear tag mechanisms installed on pig ears. According to the ear tag type body temperature monitoring system for pig breeding, an ear tag mechanism can monitor body temperature data of a corresponding individual pig and feed back the body temperature data to the main controller in time, the body temperature information of the bred pig is reflected more visually, management is convenient, the pig with abnormal body temperature is found in time, the ear tag mechanism is conveniently and rapidly fixed to the ear of the pig, a mounting structure is firm and not prone to loosening. A body temperature detection sensor is installed on a rotary sleeve through a flexible rod, the body temperature can be detected at a cochlea, and measured data are more accurate.

title: APPARATUS FOR RECOGNIZING CHARACTER ON STRAW OF ALIVESTOCK SPECIFICATION MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention relates to a sperm straw recognizing device of a livestock specification managing system capable of preventing wrong recording or errors and increasing efficiency of management of artificial insemination of livestock by accurately recognizing and recording information recorded in a sperm straw. The sperm straw recognizing device of a livestock specification managing system comprises: a fixing frame; a connecting frame; and a housing. The fixing frame is installed in a terminal having a camera, and forms a groove unit for exposing the camera depending on a position of the camera. The connecting frame is installed in the fixing frame. The housing is installed in the connecting frame, provides a photographing space at a view angle of the camera and within a focus range, forms an inserting hole for inserting the sperm straw to position the sperm straw in the space in a side surface, and allows the camera to photograph the sperm straw positioned in the space by opening an upper end toward the camera.

title: Smart farm management system based on behavior pattern and method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart livestock farm management system based on a behavior pattern, for improving and optimizing livestock facilities. A livestock facility management server of the smart livestock farm management system comprises: a data collection module which collects information on each object from an information collection device and provides the same; a feeding behavior-based analysis module which obtains information on rumination activity by time period and information on rest time based on feeding behavior for each object, determines and analyzes whether the information meets a standard range preset by herd ranking, and provides information on analysis results based on feeding behavior; a drinking behavior-based analysis module which, if the number of drinking times and a residence time in a drinking area for each object do not secure a preset sufficient drinking time, analyzes whether the cause is due to herd ranking and provides information on analysis results based on drinking behavior; and a livestock facility optimization module which determines whether to expand feeding facilities, rest areas, and drinking facilities and a scale of the expansion using the information on analysis results based on the feeding and drinking behavior and provides the same.

title: Pig house manure cleaning robot, manure cleaning method and live pig health diagnosis method
abstract: The invention provides a pig house manure cleaning robot, a manure cleaning method and a live pig health diagnosis method. The pig house manure cleaning robot comprises a navigation device, a movable chassis and a manure cleaning mechanism; the navigation device is used for being arranged in a pig house to obtain environment information in the pig house and planning a cleaning path of the pig house manure cleaning robot according to the environment information; the movable chassis is in communication connection with the navigation device; the manure cleaning mechanism is arranged on the side, facing the ground, of the movable chassis; the manure cleaning mechanism comprises a manure scraping device and a sweeping device, and the manure scraping device and the sweeping device are arranged in the advancing direction of the pig house manure cleaning robot. According to the invention, automatic cleaning of the manure in the pig house can be achieved, convenience and rapidness are achieved, the good manure cleaning effect is achieved, the pig house environment is improved, spread of comorbidity of people and pigs is reduced, the manure form can be detected and analyzed, and the evaluation basis is provided for the health conditions of the pigs.
applicants: INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH CENTER, BEIJING ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY SCIENCES

title: Livestock grouping system and method
abstract: The invention provides a livestock grouping system and method. The livestock grouping system comprises a main control unit, an anti-following unit, a measuring unit and a separating unit, wherein the anti-following unit, the measuring unit and the separating unit are arranged in sequence; the anti-following unit comprises a blocking channel, an isolation door arranged at an outlet of the blocking channel and an isolation door push rod motor; the measuring unit comprises a measuring channel and multiple types of sensors arranged in the measuring channel; the separating unit comprises a plurality of grouping channels, grouping doors arranged at the joints of the grouping channels and the measuring channel and grouping door push rod motors; and the main control unit controls any grouping door push rod motor to act according to the identity information and the physical sign information of a to-be-detected object, so that the to-be-detected object enters the grouping channel corresponding to any grouping door push rod motor. According to the livestock grouping system and method provided by the invention, grouping is carried out by adopting various physical sign information, a reasonable grouping standard can be flexibly formulated according to the needs of users, the growth and development uniformity of the population can be better regulated and controlled, and data support is provided for scientific management of a farm.
applicants: INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH CENTER, BEIJING ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY SCIENCES

title: Method for detecting crowd rank list based on behavior pattern
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for detecting herd order data based on behavioral patterns of livestock animals. The method for detecting herd order data comprises the steps of: (a) generating a herd order group for one round based on behavioral patterns of livestock animals at a target location; and (b) repeatedly performing step (a) for a preset period to respectively generate herd order groups for a plurality of rounds, and rearranging and extracting information about the plurality of generated herd order groups into herd order information for the entire herd. Therefore, herd order information can be detected according to behavioral patterns of livestock animals at a waiting area and a target location.

title: Artificial intelligence-based biometric signals and image analysis methods for monitoring livestock conditions
abstract: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence-based biosignal and image analysis method for monitoring the condition of livestock. The artificial intelligence-based biosignal and image analysis method comprises the steps of: installing a UWB sensor module, a visible light camera module, and an infrared thermal imaging camera module in a livestock barn; receiving biometric information about livestock; generating a matching image; detecting a livestock object; mapping the livestock object; and transmitting the biometric information about the livestock and livestock object mapping information to a management server and managing the detected livestock object. Therefore, a smart livestock management system can be realized.

title: Sow oestrus identification method, device and system
abstract: The invention discloses a sow oestrus identification method, device and system. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an ultrasonic emission signal and a corresponding ultrasonic reflection signal; according to the ultrasonic emission signal and the ultrasonic reflection signal, determining ultrasonic wave passing time; according to the ultrasonic wave passing time, determining sow posture information; and inputting the sow posture information corresponding to a target time period into a pre-trained estrus state model to obtain a sow estrus state. The posture of sows can be determined according to the turn-back time of the ultrasonic signals, the activity amount of the sows can be obtained according to the posture change of the sows at different time, and then whether the sows are in an estrus state or not is speculated through a model obtained through machine learning. The method can be used for automatically monitoring the estrus state of the sows in an all-weather mode, the labor cost is greatly reduced, biological safety prevention and control are facilitated, the detection efficiency and the detection accuracy are improved, the oestrus period of the sows is not easily missed, and the production efficiency of a pig farm is greatly improved.
applicants: HENAN MUYUAN INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Quantitative livestock feeding system and method based on single channel identification
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent breeding, in particular to a quantitative livestock feeding system and method based on single channel identification. The system comprises a plurality of single channels used for accommodating livestock for feeding, a feeding module, an RFID electronic tag module, a monitoring module, a server and a control module, wherein the RFID electronic tag module is used for recording information and feeding times of each livestock, and sending the information and the feeding times of the livestock to a controller, the controller controls the feeding module to feed according to the feeding times of the livestock, the monitoring module is used for forming a marking frame according to tags of the livestock in the RFID electronic tag module, monitoring the movement track of the livestock and generating an activity track image, the controller is further used for sending the activity track image generated by the monitoring module to the server, and the server generates a thermodynamic diagram according to the activity track image and generates abnormal information for livestock with a small activity range in the thermodynamic diagram to be pushed. The healthy state of the livestock is ensured through directional monitoring and quantitative feeding of the livestock.

title: Pig body state monitoring method based on animal behaviors
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of livestock breeding, and provides a pig body state monitoring method based on animal behaviors. The method comprises the following steps: installing a plurality of cameras; numbering pigs in a pig house; establishing a pig state evaluation model; positioning the position of each pig in the pig house according to printed identifiers; carrying out corresponding animal behavior data collection according to parameters of the pig state evaluation model within the sampling time; and according to the collected data and the pig state evaluation model, obtaining the body state index of each pig in the pig house through calculation. According to the method, various sensors do not need to be worn on the bodies of the pigs, discomfort of the pigs is avoided, the implementation cost is low, no harm is caused to the pigs, the body state of each pig in the pig house can be accurately evaluated, and a farmer can be early warned to check as soon as possible; and meanwhile, the farmer can reasonably adjust the parameters such as temperature, humidity, wind speed and gas concentration of the pig house, and environment parameters of the pigs are improved as much as possible.

title: Pig farm live pig state prediction system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of pig farm monitoring, and particularly relates to a pig farm live pig state prediction system. The pig farm live pig state prediction system comprises a live pig state prediction model establishment module for establishing a live pig state prediction model according to sample data of pig farm sample live pigs; and a live pig state prediction result output module is electrically connected with the live pig state prediction model establishment module so as to put current live pig data into the live pig state prediction model to obtain a live pig state prediction result. According to the pig farm live pig state prediction system, a visual normality index is provided for live pigs in a pig farm according to the pig farm live pig state prediction model, normality visualization of each live pig in the pig farm is achieved, subsequent workers judge the detected abnormal live pigs, the workload of breeding personnel is reduced, data support is provided, the management efficiency of the pig farm is improved, and intelligent, remote, precise and visual pig breeding is achieved.

title: Livestock breeding epidemic prevention detection equipment
abstract: The invention discloses livestock breeding epidemic prevention detection equipment which comprises a frame body. A storage mechanism is fixedly installed in the middle of the top of the frame body, fixing mechanisms are fixedly installed at the four corners of the top of the frame body, a guide rail is fixedly installed at the bottom of the frame body, a driving mechanism is slidably connected to the inner side of the guide rail, and an epidemic prevention detection mechanism is fixedly installed at the bottom of the driving mechanism. The upper ends of the two sides of the epidemic prevention detection mechanism communicate with the output end of the storage mechanism, a control device is fixedly installed on the right side of the lower end of the storage mechanism, and disinfection mechanisms are fixedly installed at the two ends of the front and back of the frame body. The livestock breeding epidemic prevention detection equipment can intelligently and automatically detect the body temperature of the livestock, has good sterilization capability, can realize real-time detection of the body temperature of the livestock, further effectively reduces the working intensity of epidemic prevention work, improves the epidemic prevention efficiency and quality, avoids large-scale transmission of livestock diseases, and is high in practicability, wide in application prospect, and worthy of popularization and use.
applicants: SHANDONG SUNWAY ANIMAL HUSBANDRY CO., LTD.

title: DISASTER PREDICTION AND PROACTIVE MITIGATION
abstract: According to one embodiment, a method, computer system, and computer program product for disaster prediction and mitigation is provided. The embodiment may include generating a knowledge corpus of a grazing pattern of a livestock group in a preconfigured area. The embodiment may also include generating a knowledge corpus of a growing pattern of flora for each of a plurality of sections in the preconfigured area. The embodiment may further include generating a prediction based on the knowledge corpuses. The embodiment may also include performing an action based on the prediction.

title: Automatic animal identity recognition method based on HDX chip glass label injection technology
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal husbandry, and particularly discloses an automatic animal identity recognition method based on an HDX chip glass label injection technology, which comprises the following steps: S1, injecting HDX chip glass labels to four limbs of a livestock towards the hoof; S2, installing a read-write board at the bottom of the door frame; S3, injecting the HDX chip glass label to the head, facing the tip of the mouth, of the livestock; S4, installing reader-writers at the bottoms of the material groove and the water groove; and S5, identifying the identity of the livestock through the read-write board and the reader-writer. Supplying can be carried out according to the age and body type of livestock, waste of forage and water is reduced, growth of the livestock is facilitated, the livestock recognition distance is long, the situation that the identity of the livestock cannot be effectively recognized is avoided, and in addition, the HDX chip glass tag is subjected to subcutaneous injection and is not prone to being lost.
applicants: ALXA LEAGUE ANIMAL HUSBANDRY INSTITUTE (ALXA LEAGUE CAMEL SCIENCE INSTITUTE)

title: Method for measuring productivity of long hair rabbits and application of method
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of livestock breeding, and particularly relates to a method for measuring and analyzing productivity of long hair rabbits. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, uniformly shearing hair of a to-be-measured long-hair rabbit group when the long-hair rabbit group is 18 weeks old, measuring the long-hair rabbit group when the long-hair rabbit group is raised to 29 weeks old in a single cage according to standard conditions, and recording the individual feed consumption of the long-hair rabbits in the measuring period; secondly, shearing a hair sample from the middle upper part of the body side of the long-hair rabbit by using an electric hair pusher, weighing the long-hair rabbit, the weight of the hair sample and the length of hair clusters, bagging and recording; thirdly, measuring the fluff fiber diameter of each fluff sample by using a fiber projection method; fourthly, substituting the measured values into a given estimation formula to calculate various indexes such as individual wool yield, wool material ratio and wool quality; and finally, constructing the productivity index of the long-hair rabbits according to the determination and analysis results, and sorting and selecting the breeding rabbits according to the productivity index. The method provided by the invention is efficient and rapid, and is suitable for large-group breeding of long-hair rabbits in terms of hair yield, hair quality and hair production efficiency.
applicants: SHANDONG AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY; MENGYIN YIDA RABBIT INDUSTRY CO., LTD.

title: LIVESTOCK HEALTH MONITORING SYSTEMS AND METHODS OF USE
abstract: Systems and methods of using an animal wellness notification system to determine the wellness of an animal, the systems and methods comprising: attaching an animal wellness notification system component to an animal, monitoring the temperature of the animal to determine if the animal's temperature remains outside a selected temperature range for a selected time duration, and providing notice if the animal's temperature remained outside the selected temperature range for the selected time duration.

title: Pig growth performance detection method and feed intake recording system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of pig breeding, and discloses a pig feed intake recording system which comprises a detection plate, a first fixing assembly, a second fixing assembly, a feeding assembly and an inlet, the detection plate is in a horizontally-placed rectangular plate shape, one side of the top face of the detection plate is a preliminary measurement area, a first weighing unit is installed on the preliminary measurement area, the other side of the top face of the detection plate is a fixing area, and a second weighing unit is mounted on the fixing area; the first fixing assembly is arranged on the periphery of the preliminary measurement area; the second fixing assembly is arranged on the periphery of the fixing area; the feeding assembly is arranged at one end of the detection plate in the length direction and is adjacent to the fixing area, and a third weighing unit is contained in the feeding assembly; the inlet is formed in the other end of the detection plate in the length direction. Stable pig weight data and stable feed intake data can be obtained through the feed intake recording system when pigs eat each time, and the growth of the pigs can be conveniently detected on the basis of the pig feed intake information.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY MEDICINE, ANHUI ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Water curtain fan cooling system based on pig group surface temperature and temperature adjusting method of water curtain fan cooling system
abstract: The invention discloses a water curtain fan cooling system based on pig group surface temperature and a temperature adjusting method of the water curtain fan cooling system. A pig group surface temperature T table is obtained in real time through an infrared thermal imaging device installed in a pig house. The temperature adjusting method comprises the steps that the output power P of a fan is calculated according to the real-time shell temperature T table of the pig group; according to a pig group surface temperature T list, whether the T table is larger than the T table is judged, otherwise, the fan is driven to stop working, if yes, when the T list is larger than the T table, the fan is driven to work according to the power P, then the relation between the pig group table temperature and the target temperature continues to be judged, and the fan power is increased till the T list is not larger than the T table; if the surface temperature of the pig group still cannot be reduced to the target temperature when the fan reaches the maximum power, the wet curtain is opened; and the fan and the water curtain are closed until the surface temperature of the pig group is reduced to the target temperature. In the working process, adjustment is conducted according to the T list, the fan and the wet curtain are simply and rapidly controlled to work only through one index, namely the pig group table temperature, obtained in real time, and therefore the fan and water curtain cooling system can be rapidly adjusted and controlled at the high temperature in summer, the pig group surface temperature in the pig house is relatively stable, meanwhile, fever and cold phenomena of the pig group caused by untimely and inaccurate cooling of the water curtain can be reduced, and the health of the pig group is maintained.

title: Early warning system for diseases through live pig behavior sign monitoring and construction method
abstract: The invention discloses an early warning system for diseases through live pig behavior sign monitoring and a construction method. The system part comprises a basic information management module, an audio and video monitoring module, an environment information monitoring module, an edge computing terminal module, an internet module and a cloud platform module. The construction scheme provided by the invention comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a large-scale pig breeding disease intelligent monitoring and early warning standard system; S2, constructing a live pig basic information and individual health database; S3, constructing a breeding environment and biological sign sensing system; S4, constructing an early warning model; S5, constructing an early warning cloud platform. The pig breeding epidemic disease intelligent monitoring and early warning cloud platform system is constructed through the five steps.

title: Pig growth performance detection method and weight gain recording system
abstract: The invention discloses a pig growth performance detection method and a weight gain recording system, relates to the technical field of animal husbandry, and provides the following scheme aiming at the problem that the growth speed of pigs cannot be effectively detected in the prior art: the pig growth performance detection method comprises the following steps: the weight gain recording system is arranged in a pig house, the weight gain recording system is used for recording weight changes in the growth process of pigs, the pigs in the pig house are classified, different types of pigs are fed in different areas, and corresponding electronic cards are installed for the pigs, so that workers can conveniently record data. The detection method is efficient and accurate, equipment used in the detection process is easy and convenient to use, various pigs can be detected and recorded at the same time, it is avoided that the pigs are driven out of a pigsty and back to the pigsty, the time needed for detection is short, and then the detection progress is effectively accelerated.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY MEDICINE, ANHUI ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PREDICTING OPTIMAL TRADING TIMING OF LIVESTOCK BASED ON ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
abstract: Disclosed are a system and method for predicting an optimal trading timing of a livestock based on artificial intelligence. The present invention includes: a sensing device installed in a feedlot to detect biometric information of livestock; and a server which receives the biometric information and derives an optimal trading timing for the livestock based on sensed data.

title: TMR Unmanned feeding system of TMR feeder
abstract: Provided are an unmanned feeding system of a TMR feeder which comprises an unmanned feeder and a main controller controlling loading, transfer, mixing, discharging a required amount of feeds and unmanned driving of the unmanned feeder. The unmanned feeder comprises: a feed loading member which accommodates feeds supplied from a feed loading place; a feed transfer member which is provided in a lower part of the feed loading member and transfers the loaded feed; a feed discharging member which is placed on a lower side of one end portion of the feed transfer member to discharge transferred feed, contains a feeding unit protruding outward, and changes a length of the feeding unit or an angle of feed discharging; and a driving unit which drives along a moving path from the feed loading place to an inside of a livestock barn without a person. The purpose of the present invention is to provide an unmanned feeding system of a TMR feeder which protects cows from external contamination and reduces labor costs to improve productivity.
applicants: OH, HEON SIK; GYEONGBUK RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF VEHICLE EMBEDDED TECHNOLOGY

title: Methods and apparatus to adaptively optimize feed blend and medicinal selection using machine learning to optimize animal milk production and health
abstract: Embodiments disclosed include systems, apparatus, and/or methods to receive a target health status of and/or quality of bioproduct produced by a managed livestock and indications of health status and quality of bioproduct. The systems, apparatus, and/or methods generate a set of input vectors based on the target health status or bioproduct quality, and the indications of bioproduct quality, and health status, and provide the set of input vectors to a machine learning model trained to generate an output indicating a feed selection. The feed selection can be included in a feed blend and administered to the managed livestock, such that, upon consumption, it increases a likelihood of collectively improving the health status of the managed livestock and the bioproduct quality of the managed livestock.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR EXTRACTING ABNORMAL BEHAVIOR PATTERNS OF LIVESTOCK BASED ON ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for extracting an abnormal behavior pattern of a livestock based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises: a data collection step of collecting livestock image; a livestock labeling step of performing livestock labeling; a data learning step of learning a livestock detection model and a movement tracking model; a behavior labeling step of setting label; a model generation step of learning artificial intelligence model; and an abnormal behavior detection step of detecting abnormal behavior pattern. Therefore, the present invention is capable of managing specifications optimized for the current status of individual livestock such as improving a livestock environment, setting a feeding and water supply amount, and the like.
applicants: ANIMAL INDUSTRY DATA KOREA CO., LTD.

title: Devices and methods for managing animals in an enclosure
abstract: The invention comprises systems and methods for controlling environmental conditions within and/or around an animal enclosure. The systems and methods preferably comprise a climate control system and infrared sensors in a poultry house having a first climate and housing poultry having one or more measurable parameters such a temperature. The infrared sensors detect infrared light information emitted by a head and/or vent of poultry in the house. The climate control system processes the information to calculate an internal temperature of poultry and activates one or more climate conditioning devices in the house to change the first climate to a second climate determined by the detected information and/or calculated internal temperatures of the poultry. The systems and methods may be deployed in houses comprising thousands of poultry and one or more climate zones. The systems and methods may make one or more climate changes based on one or more different parameters.

title: African swine fever virus monitoring and removing method suitable for large-scale pig farm
abstract: The invention discloses an African swine fever virus monitoring and removing method suitable for a large-scale pig farm. The method comprises the following steps: inspection sampling monitoring is performed on monitoring points inside and outside the farm through unmanned aerial vehicle inspection; isolated acquisition monitoring is carried out on the entrance of the farm through non-contact acquisition; and breeding group monitoring is carried out through breeding group remote temperature measurement, luring collection and detection and image collection and recognition. The intelligent control center is used for disinfecting and cleaning virus calibration points and automatically sealing and capturing virus targets according to monitoring results, so as to process and remove viruses.

title: SYSTEM FOR ZONED-BASED SOLAR HEATING AND VENTILATION OF POULTRY STRUCTURES
abstract: A system of solar thermal collectors and an HVAC controller draw heated air through a solar thermal absorbing needle-punched propylene geotextile with limited permeability to air flow, into the interior of poultry livestock house. In various embodiments, the poultry livestock house is divided into zones. Groups of collectors are joined with breather holes on opposite sides of the collectors and solid sides on the ends of each group. Groups of collectors serve each zone of the poultry livestock house. In an embodiment of the system the Environmental Optimization System (“EOS”) provides a system for the intelligent control and monitoring the broiler poultry livestock structure environment through the utilization of a variety of environmental and livestock behavior sensors, apparatus for controlling the thermal collection and existing interior heating/air conditioning/ventilation (“HVAC”) systems, and Internet or cloud based intelligent control and monitoring capabilities of the system. In various embodiments central sensor data aggregation is utilized to provide improved optimization control for livestock zones within individual structures based on data from multiple structures.

title: Real-time monitoring system based on livestock breeding
abstract: The invention relates to the field of livestock breeding monitoring systems, in particular to a real-time monitoring system based on livestock breeding. The system specifically comprises a data acquisition module, a tree-shaped virtual node management module, a data processing analysis and early warning module and a historical video format module. Physical equipment corresponding to multiple sensors is abstracted into a virtual equipment layer, unified equipment information description, equipment communication capability and equipment interface information are provided, meanwhile, a tree-shaped virtual node management module is established, through system hierarchical control, a breeding mechanism and a breeding site are better communicated, an incidence relation is established between the breeding equipment, and the breeding efficiency is improved. According to the method, the management mode is optimized, meanwhile, compression processing in a specific format can be carried out on monitoring data on the same day, feature recognition and counting are carried out on matched data according to corresponding rules, comparison with a preset threshold value range set by a cloud system is carried out, and early warning information is generated according to a threshold value and notified to corresponding management personnel.
applicants: WUHAN JIUHE SIFANG MANAGEMENT CONSULTING CO., LTD.

title: Livestock monitoring method and system based on big data, and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock monitoring method and system based on big data, and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining an environment factor in a preset range of a fence based on a preset sensor group, inputting the environment factor into a recognition neural network model, and obtaining an analog output value; identifying the distribution information of the livestock group in the current fence to obtain a target matching value; judging a drop point of the target matching value in the grade interval, and calling a preset distribution algorithm according to drop point information to output secondary distribution data information; and acquiring livestock group position information in the target area outside the fence based on a preset image, and outputting a fence returning path through big data analysis. According to the invention, multi-point monitoring can be carried out on the conditions of livestock inside and outside the fence, the fence returning path of the livestock outside the fence can be automatically generated outside the fence, the livestock distribution information in the fence can be automatically identified inside the fence, and secondary distribution calculation can be automatically carried out based on a preset algorithm, so that the number of the livestock in the fence can be reasonably distributed for orderly livestock raising.

title: Poultry health monitoring system and method
abstract: A poultry health monitoring system comprises a cloud module, a learning correction module and a monitoring module. Wherein the learning correction module is used for sensing a weight value of at least one carried poultry and a first poultry image so as to analyze the number of the poultry in the first poultry image and generate a poultry image feature and an image weight relational expression; the monitoring module is configured to generate a second poultry image including at least one poultry. The cloud module obtains the unit weight and the activity value of each poultry according to the second poultry image. The invention further comprises a poultry health monitoring method.

title: Infrared hanging rail inspection device for hog house
abstract: The invention discloses an infrared hanging rail inspection device for a hog house. The infrared hanging rail inspection device comprises a walking device, a control console and an intelligent pan-tilt, wherein the walking device comprises a sliding seat, a driving motor is arranged at the bottom of the sliding seat, a gear set is arranged on the right side of the sliding seat, the gear set is in driving connection with the driving motor, the gear set is connected with walking wheels, guide rails are arranged on the lower portions of the walking wheels, and the sliding seat is hung on the guide rails through the walking wheels; a connecting shaft is fixedly connected between the walking device and the control console, and a rotating shaft is connected between the control console and the intelligent pan-tilt; an infrared thermal imager is arranged at the bottom of the intelligent pan-tilt, a PLC is arranged in the control console, the infrared thermal imager and the driving motor are both electrically connected with the PLC, the PLC is used for controlling the driving motor to drive the walking wheels to walk on the guide rails, and the infrared thermal imager is used for collecting thermal image data of pigs. The infrared hanging rail inspection device for the hog house has the advantages of being high in measurement efficiency, safe, reliable, low in cost and high in automation degree.

title: Wireless electronic ear tag equipment for monitoring oestrus and morbidity of dairy cows
abstract: The invention discloses wireless electronic ear tag equipment for monitoring oestrus and morbidity of dairy cows. The wireless electronic ear tag equipment comprises a processor for comprehensively processing data, wherein the processor is connected with a power supply module, a memory and a temperature sensor used for receiving temperature data acquired by the temperature sensor, the processor is further connected with a ZigBee module used for wireless transmission of data, the processor is further connected with a gyroscope used for receiving angle change data sensed by the gyroscope, the processor is further connected with an acceleration sensor used for receiving acceleration data of the acceleration sensor, and the processor is further connected with a timer. The invention relates to the technical field of dairy cow breeding. The wireless electronic ear tag equipment solves the problems that the occurrence of oestrus and morbidity of the dairy cows is usually found by observation of workers, but the workers are not easy to find the occurrence of oestrus and morbidity of the dairy cows in a farm in the first time, and often miss the optimal treatment and hybridization time period.

title: Cattle momentum measurement system in the barn
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for measuring cattle exercise in a cattle shed, and specifically, to a system for determining the health status of cattle by measuring the exercise amount of cattle through an exercise measurement sensor installed on cattle legs. The exercise measurement sensor measures an amount that cattle moves during life by measuring the number of times the sensor shakes, collects data, and produces statistics. The exercise measurement sensor sends an alarm message to an administrator when there is a more significant change than a statistical amount.
applicants: INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF SUNCHON NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: Pig momentum measurement system in pig house
abstract: In the present invention, disclosed is a system that measures the momentum of pigs through a mat-type pressure sensor installed on the floor of a pig house to determine the health status of the pigs, as a system for measuring the momentum of pigs in a pig house. Statistics on the number of times a pig steps on a pressure sensor on the floor are collected, and when the number significantly decreases, it can be considered that there is a problem with the pig's health and quick action can be taken.
applicants: INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF SUNCHON NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: IDENTIFICATION AND TRACKING DEVICES
abstract: Provided herein are identification elements for subject(s) or article(s) or interest, such as livestock animals, including: an attachment fitting for securing the identification element to a subject or article of interest; and a unique identifier element affixed to, integrated with, or embedded in the attachment fitting; wherein at least a portion of the attachment fitting is formed of a heat-releasable material which is solid at normal environmental temperatures, and which dissolves, melts, disintegrates, degrades, and/or evaporates upon artificial heating above normal environmental temperatures, such that artificial heating results in removal or detachment of the identification element from the subject or article of interest. Related methods and uses for tracking and/or identification of subject(s) or article(s) are also provided herein.

title: Apparatus for monitoring ruminant stomach of cattle and method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a device and a method for analyzing activity of cattle by collecting movement data from a sensor inserted into the stomach of the cattle, and monitoring health of the cattle and disease management information by using activity information. According to the present invention, the device for monitoring the activity of the cattle by using the sensor inserted into the stomach of the cattle by oral administration comprises: a data sensing unit which receives sensing data including movement data of the stomach from the sensor; an activity analyzing unit which analyzes ingestion activity, stomach activity, and rest activity by using the received sensing data; and a monitoring unit which stores the analyzed activity information, provides information of health and diseases of cattle of which activity information is not analyzed, and monitors the same.

title: A Pig Body Temperature Monitoring System using transport cart
abstract: The present invention relates to a pig health monitoring system integrated with a transport cart, which can measure the temperature of pigs while a thermal imaging camera for measuring the temperature of a pig is moving, by arranging the thermal imaging camera on a movable cart which can move inside a barn, and can send in an alarm when a measured temperature value is detected to be higher than a set reference value, thereby allowing the outbreak of an infectious disease to be identified early and dealt with quickly.

In the case of pigs, high-ranking pigs frequently enter an automatic breeding device, and there are also frequent cases in which other pigs enter at the same time. Since it is difficult to allow only one pig to enter, there is a problem that feeding is not carried out for each pig when using the automatic breeding device. In order to solve the problem, an automatic pig feeding device having a two-way discharge device is provided which comprises: a frame; an entrance provided on one side of the frame; an automatic feeder provided on the other side of the frame; a passage provided in the center of the frame; a transparent cover provided on the outside of the frame at the entrance with respect to the center of the passage in forward and backward directions; a side rotating push door provided inside the transparent cover; and a side discharge door provided on a central front frame opposite the entrance to the passage. According to the configuration, by providing the automatic breeding device with a function to discharge pigs if a certain period of time does not elapse after feeding or if two or more pigs enter the entrance, pigs themselves can use the automatic feeding device at regular intervals.

title: LIVESTOCK PRODUCT CERTIFICATION MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND METHOD USING BLOCKCHAIN
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and method for managing a livestock product certification using a blockchain. More specifically, the present invention relates to the system and method for managing the livestock product certification using the blockchain that use a blockchain technology to store the information related to the livestock product during a process of growth and development, slaughtering, transporting, and distributing of the livestock, and enable a buyer to directly verify the certified livestock product and provide a highly reliable product. The system is configured with: a bio capsule; an external information input device; an authentication management server; and a blockchain server.

In the case of pigs, high-ranking pigs frequently enter an automatic breeding device, and there are also frequent cases in which other pigs enter at the same time. Since it is difficult to allow only one pig to enter, there is a problem that feeding is not carried out for each pig when using the automatic breeding device. In order to solve the problem, an automatic pig feeding device having a lower tilt-elevating discharge device is provided which comprises: a frame; an entrance provided on one side of the frame; an automatic feeder provided on the other side of the frame; a tilting floor provided at a center floor of the frame and allowing the floor to rise to the side; and a discharge side rising from bottom to top in a side discharge direction of the tilting floor. According to the configuration, by providing the automatic breeding device with a function to discharge pigs if a certain period of time does not elapse after feeding or if two or more pigs enter the entrance, pigs themselves can use the automatic feeding device at regular intervals.

title: Livestock health index monitoring management analysis system
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock health index monitoring management analysis system and relates to the field of animal husbandry. The system comprising an analysis host, monitoring sensors and an analysis system arranged in the analysis host. The analysis system comprises a central processing module, a data arrangement system, a sampling detection system, a cloud storage system, a judgment module, a deep learning module and a monitoring system, the monitoring sensors are in communication connection with the cloud storage system, and the monitoring sensors are installed on the four limbs of the livestock and carry out code division on the livestock. Through the deep learning module, deep learning can be carried out on previous livestock data in a pasture, association between the data is associated, a livestock health-season model is established for the relationship between seasons and data, and through the model, health models among spring, summer and autumn and a winter health model can be established respectively. Therefore, the health condition of the livestock in each season can be effectively judged.
applicants: XINJIANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL AND RECLAMATION SCIENCE

title: Self-power-generation livestock chewing detection device and detection method
abstract: The invention provides a self-power-generation livestock chewing detection device and a detection method, which belong to the technical field of equipment for animal husbandry. The self-power-generation livestock chewing detection device comprises a shell and a chain rope, piezoelectric patches, a processor and a power storage device are arranged in the shell, the piezoelectric patches are symmetrically arranged in two groups, and the free ends of the two groups of piezoelectric patches are diagonally arranged; the chain rope forms an annular shape suitable for being arranged on the peripheral contour of the mouth of the livestock in a sleeving mode outside the shell, a plurality of blocking pieces are arranged on the chain rope at intervals, and when the chain rope stretches out of or retracts back to the shell, the blocking pieces are in contact fit with the free ends of the piezoelectric patches in sequence; the free end of the piezoelectric patch is provided with a notch used for being matched with a blocking piece on the chain rope. According to the self-power-generation livestock chewing detection device, detection and power generation are carried out at the same time through jaw chewing movement of livestock, the device can achieve long-term monitoring in any environment, and the problem of a power supply environment does not need to be considered.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF AGRICULTURAL ECONOMICS AND INFORMATION, JIANGXI ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Behavior analysis system of livestock using acceleration sensor and behavior analysis method using same
abstract: Provided are a behavior analysis system of livestock using an acceleration sensor and a behavior analysis method using the same, which mount a biocapsule including an acceleration sensor on a rumen of livestock and transmit a sensor value sensed by a behavior of the corresponding livestock, analyze a sensor value transferred from each entity and analyze the behavior of the livestock by the server, and predict and judge a health state, or a timing of estrus or a delivery of the livestock through the analyzed behavior to efficiently manage the livestock.

title: Live pig body temperature detection device based on thermal imaging
abstract: The invention provides a live pig body temperature detection device based on thermal imaging. The live pig body temperature detection device based on thermal imaging comprises a live pig limiting fence, a sliding rail and a pan-tilt robot, the sliding rail is located above the live pig limiting fence, and the pan-tilt robot is installed on the sliding rail; and the pan-tilt robot comprises an electronic control unit, a detection sensor, a mechanical body, a power management unit, an actuator and a wireless communication unit. The live pig body temperature detection device based on thermal imaging has the advantages that the device capable of monitoring the body temperature and activity amount of live pigs in real time all day long can observe and discover abnormal phenomena before live pig diseases occur in advance, and therefore measures are taken in time to reduce breeding losses.

title: 3D SERVER AND METHOD FOR PROVIDING SOFTWARE INCLUDING 3D EDUCATION CONTENTS BASED ON VIRTUAL REALITY AUGMENTED REALITY MIXED REALITY FOR EDUCATING VACCINATION OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for providing a software including 3D educational content based on virtual reality, augmented reality, and mixed reality for educating vaccination of livestock, which comprises the steps of: receiving information on pen information and vaccination device information for vaccinating livestock managed by a pen from a livestock terminal corresponding to the pen; selecting a plurality of assets from a library database on the basis of the pen information and the vaccination device information, and generating at least one 3D educational content on the basis of the selected assets and vaccination educational scenario data for educating vaccination of the livestock; generating a software on the basis of the 3D educational content; and transmitting the software to the pen terminal. Therefore, a vaccination mistake is prevented.

title: Deep learning technology-based mad cow disease notification service
abstract: Disclosed is a device for providing a mad cow disease notification service based on deep learning technology, recognizing abnormal behavior of a cow using a camera at the top of the barn, and determining whether the cow has mad cow disease, thereby allowing for quick follow-up management.
applicants: INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF SUNCHON NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: Visual traceability intelligent breeding house system with automatic cleaning, sterilizing and killing functions
