abstract: The invention discloses a visual traceability intelligent breeding house system with automatic cleaning, sterilization and disinfection functions, a semi-cylindrical base ring wall and an inclined sewage discharge plate are arranged, an RFID module, a camera, a low-voltage mercury lamp and a center control DDC box are arranged on a house, and a plurality of modules are arranged in the center control DDC box. Through the arrangement of the low-pressure mercury lamp, the cleaning sliding block, the automatic flushing tank, the temperature and humidity sensor, the center control DDC box and other structures, the low-pressure mercury lamp controlled by the center control DDC box conducts ultraviolet irradiation sterilization and disinfection on the interior of the colony house at different time, and the colony house system has the good automatic sterilization and disinfection and self-cleaning effects; the RFID module automatically counts livestock in the breeding house, the camera above the breeding house monitors the interior of the breeding house all day long, the RFID card reading system is matched to completely record the breeding process of the livestock, and the automatic counting function and the visual source tracing function of the breeding house system are achieved.

title: ICT Information and Communication Technology Pig House Management System
abstract: An ICT hog barn management system discloses disease prediction data. An ICT hog barn management system includes the steps of: registering metadata information and searching and confirming all data created according to the registered data; inputting prediction information using the data; confirming disease information using the input prediction information; checking the location of a branch and a path of disease outbreak using an inputted location information system; and confirming disease cause prediction through ammonia and temperature/humidity IoT sensors. Therefore, a cause and path of disease can be confirmed using the collected metadata information.

title: Electric control system of boar estrus checking vehicle
abstract: The electronic control system comprises a fixing plate A and a system, a displayer is fixed to the upper portion of the right face of the fixing plate A, a power button is arranged below the displayer, and the power button is fixed to the fixing plate A. A charging port is formed in the center of the front face of the fixing plate A. A dustproof plug is arranged on the left side of the charging port and fixed to the fixing plate A through a hinge. The lower portions of the left side and the right side of the fixing plate A are each provided with a shell, and the bottom of the fixing plate A is provided with a fixing plate B. The system comprises a controller transmitting module, an MCU microcontroller, a brushless motor controller, a power input module, a parameter display module, a remote controller receiving module and a power module. The MCU microcontroller is respectively connected with the controller transmitting module, the brushless motor controller, the power supply input module, the parameter display module, the remote controller receiving module and the power module; the electric control system of the boar estrus checking vehicle has the advantages that power is provided through the brushless motor, the speed can be adjusted, power consumption is low, and later maintenance is easy.
applicants: GUANGZHOU INTEGRATED GRAZING, AGRICULTURE AND GRAZING SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY LIMITED COMPANY

title: Live pig farm environment monitoring equipment
abstract: The invention discloses live pig farm environment monitoring equipment which structurally comprises a photovoltaic panel, a processing box, a control box and a support. The photovoltaic panel is installed on the processing box, the processing box is movably connected with the photovoltaic panel, the control box is arranged on the processing box, the processing box is in clearance fit with the control box, the support is installed on the processing box, and the processing box is connected with the support. According to the live pig farm environment monitoring equipment, by means of a circulation frame, assembly blocks can be detached from adjusting blocks, insects mistakenly entering a monitoring structure are taken out, and the situation that too many dead insects are accumulated in the monitoring structure due to the fact that too many insects mistakenly enter, are trapped in the monitoring structure and are difficult to escape is prevented. A cylinder and a conical connecting block on an adjusting plate can be utilized to move the adjusting plate, through holes of the circulation frame are dredged, and the situation that in the long-time using process of the equipment, dust blocks are accumulated in the through holes of the circulation frame and block the through holes of the circulation frame, and consequently gas of the monitoring equipment does not circulate is avoided.

title: DETERMINATION DEVICE, DETERMINATION METHOD, AND DETERMINATION PROGRAM
abstract: The present invention carries out behavior determination of a ruminant animal from a captured image with high accuracy. This determination device is provided with: a skeleton inference unit that infers from a captured image a skeletal position of a ruminant animal to be processed; an extraction unit that extracts from the captured image a region of the ruminant animal to be processed; a clipping unit that clips a determination region for carrying out behavior determination of the ruminant animal to be processed, on the basis of the inferred skeletal position and the extracted region; and a determination unit that carries out behavior determination of the ruminant animal to be processed, on the basis of the clipped determination region.

title: Breeding system
abstract: The present invention relates to a breeding system, which includes: a breeding unit which forms a breeding space where livestock are raised; a breeding environment creation unit which creates different breeding environments for livestock raised separately in breeding spaces; a breeding information acquisition unit which acquires the breeding environment information of livestock raised in the breeding space; a first quality measurement unit which inspects products shipped from the breeding unit and acquires quality information; and a breeding information collection unit which links the livestock breeding environment information and the product quality information to derive the breeding environment information by quality of shipped products.

title: Self-adaptive precise ventilation system for livestock and poultry house
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive precise ventilation system for a livestock and poultry house, and relates to the technical field of fresh air and automatic control; the system comprises an air pipe, an adjusting assembly, a camera assembly, an air flow test piece and a controller; the air pipe and the air flow test piece are both arranged above the fence area, the camera assembly is installed on one side of the air flow test piece, and the adjusting assembly is connected with the air pipe through the connecting rope; the air pipe is provided with a plurality of air supply outlets, and each air supply outlet is provided with a valve. The camera assembly monitors the air flowing condition (including the air flowing speed and the air flowing direction) in the livestock and poultry house and in-fence area information (whether livestock animals exist in each in-fence area or not and posture information of the livestock animals when the livestock animals exist in the in-fence area) in real time. The camera assembly transmits the air flowing condition and the in-fence area information to the controller so as to determine the opening degree and the orientation of the air supply outlets, and accurate air supply is achieved.

title: GATING SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: A gating system for a livestock yard is disclosed. In an embodiment, the gating system comprises a gate, a receiver for receiving a gate control signal, and an actuator in signal communication with the receiver. The actuator may operate the gate to locate the gate in either a first position or a second position depending on the gate control signal. When located in the first position, the gate allows access to a first area of the yard and obstructs access to a second area of the yard and wherein when located in the second position, the gate allows access to the second area of the yard and obstructs access to a first area of the yard. applicants: R T GILBERT ENTERPRISES PTY LTD

title: DRINKING WATER STATE SPECIFICATION DEVICE, DRINKING WATER STATE SPECIFICATION PROGRAM AND STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: To provide a drinking water state specification device for suppressing erroneous detection of a drinking water action more than conventional practice.SOLUTION: In a monitoring system 100 relating to this disclosure, a terminal 20 in a stomach is indwelled in the stomach 10S of a plurality of cows 10, and information of temperature F in the stomach is transmitted to a monitoring terminal 50 by radio. In the disclosure, the monitoring terminal 50 specifies a drinking water state on the basis of a change in the temperature F in the stomach by using the change in the temperature F in the stomach when a cow 10 performs a driving water action to allow water to go into the stomach 10S. According to this configuration, it is possible to specify that a drinking water action is performed when the water actually goes into the stomach 10S. This can suppress the occurrence of a problem of making an erroneous determination that a drinking water action is performed even though the drinking water action actually is not performed in comparison with a conventional configuration for specifying the drinking water action due to movement of the cow 10.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: ventilation control apparatus and smart pigsty system having the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a ventilation control device (100) and a smart pig farming system (1000) comprising the same. According to the present invention, the ventilation control device (100) of the smart pig farming system (1000) for raising pigs comprises: a plurality of suction units (110) installed on an outer wall (220) of a livestock shed (200), where a plurality of accommodation spaces (A) in which the pigs are accommodated are formed bordering an internal partition wall (210); a plurality of actuator units (120) installed in correspondence with each of the plurality of suction units (110) to control at least one of the amount of external air intake and air flow through the plurality of suction units (110); and a control unit (130) for receiving a captured image captured by a camera unit (500) installed on an upper side of the accommodation spaces (A) and controlling the plurality of actuator units (120) based on the captured image. According to the present invention, productivity can be maximized by providing an optimal environment for the pigs accommodated in the livestock shed (200).
applicants: MYEONG SAN ENT CO., LTD.; METANOVA

title: Intelligent cow breeding system and method and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent cow breeding system and method and a readable storage medium, the system comprises a cloud server and an intelligent cow house comprising a plurality of cow pens, and each cow pen is used for breeding a cow with a unique number; the intelligent cowshed comprises an automatic feeding device and a control device connected with the cloud server and the automatic feeding device. Each cattle pen is provided with a first collecting device, a second collecting device and an adjusting device which are connected with the control device; the first acquisition device and the second acquisition device respectively transmit acquired breeding parameters and environmental parameters to the control device, and the control device binds the breeding parameters and the environmental parameters with unique numbers and then transmits the parameters to the cloud server; and the cloud server sends indication information to the control device based on the two and stored historical breeding parameters so as to control the automatic feeding device to start and/or adjust the operation of the device. According to the invention, intelligent milk cow breeding is realized from the automatic aspects of feed supply, milk quality supervision and multi-factor adjustment, and the yield and quality of milk are improved.
applicants: SHILIN CHUNCAOYUAN AGRICULTURAL PRODUCT PROFESSIONAL COOPERATIVE

title: ventilation control apparatus and smart pigsty system having the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a ventilation control device (100) and a smart pig farming system (1000) comprising the same. According to the present invention, the ventilation control device (100) of the smart pig farming system (1000) for raising pigs (P) comprises: a plurality of suction units (110) installed on an outer wall (220) of a livestock shed (200), where a plurality of accommodation spaces (A) in which the pigs (P) are accommodated are formed bordering an internal partition wall (210); a plurality of actuator units (120) installed in correspondence with each of the plurality of suction units (110) to control at least one of the amount of external air intake and air flow through the plurality of suction units (110); and a control unit (130) for controlling the plurality of actuator units (120) by grouping the plurality of suction units (110) into at least two suction groups (IG). According to the present invention, productivity can be maximized by providing an optimal environment for the pigs (P) accommodated in the livestock shed (200).
applicants: METANOVA; MYEONG SAN ENT CO., LTD.

title: EARLY PREDICTION METHOD OF REPRODUCTIVE EFFICIENCY IN RUMINANTS (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract: Early prediction method of reproductive efficiency in ruminants. The present invention refers to a method for early prediction of reproductive efficiency in ruminants, and more particularly, to an in vitro method based on the determination of the levels of a group of analytes that includes, among others, HDL-cholesterol (HDL), triglycerides (TGL) and oxocholanoic acid (OCO), and uses of said levels for these purposes. (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)

title: ELECTRONIC TAG
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an electronic tag for behavioural monitoring of animals, the electronic tag comprising a microprocessor and at least one sensor. The electronic tag is configured to obtain, via the at least one sensor, movement data of an animal to which the electronic tag is attached and to determine, based on the obtained movement data, a behaviour of the animal. The disclosure further encompasses a corresponding method as well as an ear tag.
applicants: South African National Parks; MAX-PLANCK-GESELLSCHAFT; Gepe Geimuplast GmbH

title: Livestock breeding management method, device and equipment based on RPA and AI and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a livestock breeding management method and device based on RPA and AI, equipment and a storage medium. The method applied to a server comprises the steps that original livestock information detected by at least one sensor is acquired; analyzing the original livestock information by using a computer vision algorithm and/or a machine learning algorithm to obtain livestock input information required by a livestock information management system; and sending the livestock input information to a robot process automation (RPA) robot, so that the RPA robot inputs the livestock input information into the livestock information management system. According to the invention, the AI technology can be utilized to automatically obtain the livestock input information, and the RPA technology can be utilized to automatically input the livestock input information into the livestock information management system, so that the employment of manpower to periodically detect and analyze the information of each livestock in the farm to obtain the livestock input information is not needed; and the livestock input information does not need to be manually input into the livestock information management system, so that the efficiency of acquiring and inputting the livestock input information is improved.
applicants: LIKEE SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (BEIJING) LIMITED COMPANY; BEIJING LAIALSO NETWORK SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY LIMITED COMPANY

title: Internet-of-things intelligent breeding method, system and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to an internet-of-things intelligent breeding method, system and device and a storage medium, and is applied to the field of intelligent breeding, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring measurement information sent by a target thermal imaging device in real time, wherein the measurement information comprises identification information and the sensible temperature value of a pig; if the somatosensory temperature value is greater than a preset standard somatosensory value, querying a pig house number and a temperature measuring device number corresponding to the identification information in a preset pig house information database according to the identification information; controlling the temperature measuring equipment corresponding to the temperature measuring equipment number to detect the environment temperature of the hog house to obtain a first hog house temperature value; if the first pig house temperature value is not larger than the preset standard somatosensory value, judgingthat the temperature of the pigs is abnormal; and sending alarm information related to the abnormal temperature of the pigs and a pig house number to an intelligent terminal of a farmer. The method has the technical effects that a breeder can know the fever condition of the pigs in time and treat the diseased pigs.

title: BLUETOOTH LOW ENERGY TRACKING TAGS FOR CATTLE TRACKING
abstract: Tracking tag and method for cattle tracking. The tracking tag includes, in some implementations, a near-field communication (NFC) module, a battery module, and a Bluetooth module. The NFC module is programmed with a unique identifier. The battery module is coupled to the NFC module. The battery module is configured to supply battery energy when active. The battery module is also configured to activate when the NFC module is first read after being programmed with the unique identifier. The Bluetooth module is coupled to the battery module. The Bluetooth module is configured to receive the battery energy from the battery module. The Bluetooth module is also configured to transmit the unique identifier using a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) transmission protocol.

title: Method and device for providing livestock remote breeding
abstract: According to an embodiment, a method for providing remote breeding of livestock comprises the steps of: determining the share ratio of livestock for a plurality of accounts; determining the scope of authority to remote breeding of the livestock for the plurality of accounts, based on the share ratio; obtaining breeding-related commands according to the scope of authority from the plurality of accounts; and requesting performance of breeding operations according to the breeding-related commands. The breeding-related commands include a feeding command. The feeding command controls a primary valve connected to a spare feeder to supply feed to the actual feeder of the livestock and the spare feeder connected through a secondary valve. Therefore, the method enables users to indirectly breed livestock so that the livestock can be bred in an environment suitable for the livestock.

title: Pig checking system and method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock breeding equipment, and discloses a pig checking system and a method thereof.The pig checking system comprises a pig transferring channel for pigs to walk and a fixing support arranged on the pig transferring channel, and a detection device used for detecting the pigs in the pig transferring channel is arranged above the fixing support and used for detecting the pigs in the pig transferring channel; the detection device is a millimeter wave radar; the tail end of the pig transferring channel is provided with a one-way door used for allowing pigs to pass through, the system further comprises a server platform used for receiving inventory data sent by the detection device, and the server platform is used for calculating and displaying the number of the pigs according to the inventory data; therefore, not only can the problems of high workload and low accuracy during manual pig checking be solved, but also the problems of high technical difficulty, complex structure and high price of a pattern recognition technology in the prior art are solved. The millimeter wave radar sensor can improve the precision and timeliness of pig number checking, and the cost is low.
applicants: HENAN PASTORAL INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY LIMITED COMPANY

title: Livestock Monitoring System
abstract: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a livestock farm monitoring system comprising a livestock farm in which a ventilation fan and an air conditioner are installed, and an air purification unit adjacent to the livestock farm, which purifies and discharges air supplied through the ventilation fan. The present invention provides a livestock farm monitoring system comprising: a complex sensor unit in which at least one temperature sensor measuring temperature in the livestock farm, at least one humidity sensor measuring humidity in the livestock farm, at least one CO_2 sensor measuring carbon dioxide in the livestock farm, and an ammonia sensor measuring ammonia concentration in the livestock farm are installed on one board; and a control device which controls the ventilation fan or air conditioner in accordance with sensor values input from the complex sensor unit, wherein the control device displays the values input from the complex sensor unit in real time, and determines and displays appropriateness by comparing the values collected in real time with appropriate growth environment information of organisms growing in the livestock farm. Accordingly, the growing environment can be improved according to environmental information in the livestock farm by monitoring signals input from sensors.

title: SCREENING MANAGEMENT METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR SHIPMENT AND SLAUGHTER OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: Provided are a livestock screening and management method and apparatus for shipment, mooring, and slaughter of livestock. The livestock screening and management method comprises the steps of: collecting first biometric information of livestock through a first sensor unit installed in a passage from a breeding farm to a shipping point; comparing the collected first biometric information of the livestock with preset standard biometric information to determine shipment of livestock having no abnormalities; obtaining information on means of transportation from the shipping point to a mooring; collecting second biometric information of the livestock through a second sensor unit installed in each passage of the mooring; comparing the collected second biometric information of the livestock with the preset standard biometric information to determine movement of the livestock having no abnormalities to a slaughterhouse; collecting third biometric information of the livestock through a third sensor unit installed in the slaughterhouse; and comparing the collected third biometric information of the livestock with the preset standard biometric information to determine whether to slaughter the livestock depending on whether there is an abnormality therein. Therefore, the livestock screening and management method can screen health livestock and allows the same to be processed as products with good quality.

title: Livestock fixing cage device
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock fixing cage device, and relates to the technical field of farming and animal husbandry breeding. The livestock fixing cage device comprises a main body cage body and a fixing mechanism; the main body cage body is used for integrally limiting livestock, the fixing mechanism is used for limiting and fixing the abdomen of the livestock, the fixing mechanism is hung on the top of the main body cage body, and the fixing mechanism comprises an arc-shaped air cushion which comprises a first air cushion and a second air cushion; and the first air cushion and the second air cushion are movably connected to form an annular fixing cushion. A vital sign detection device is arranged, livestock is comprehensively examined while hoof trimming is conducted, the height, the weight, the body temperature and the heart rate of the livestock can be displayed on a displayer in real time, a controller can record information, and the growth condition and the health condition of the livestock can be observed conveniently; and the fixing mechanism is arranged, the trunk of the livestock is wrapped and fixed through the arc-shaped air cushion, the livestock is flexibly fixed through the expanded arc-shaped air cushion, the device is friendly to the livestock body, and the whole device is easy to operate and high in practicability.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA AUTONOMOUS REGION ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL & ANIMAL HUSBANDRY SCIENCES

title: Automatic Control Growth Analysis System to Increase Productivity of Livestock Cost Experts
abstract: The present invention is to solve the problems in the livestock industry, which was previously dependent on the capabilities of experts. The present invention aims to establish an optimal growth environment learning algorithm system by securing valid information through big data analysis that integrates scattered information from the Livestock Product Quality Evaluation Institute and smart livestock farming companies and generating a specification management guideline database based on the same. In the above system, a complex environment manager comprises: a vision device and an acoustic sensor to measure growth without contact and without stress to monitor the amount of behavior and abnormal signs (disease detection). This is a system that sends livestock behavior, coughing sounds, body temperature changes, and the like to a livestock growth analysis system (300), analyzes the same and provides appropriate solutions to users. The system can lower the entry barrier to the livestock industry and is expected to improve productivity, quality, and reliability through future advancement through secured data.

title: 'LIVESTOCK MONITORING'
abstract: This disclosure relates to a system for livestock monitoring. Animal monitoring devices, mounted on animals, collect accelerometer data of parts of the animals. The devices classify the accelerometer data into one of multiple animal behaviours, to create behaviour classification data. Gateway devices receive the behaviour classification data from the animal monitoring devices, responsive to the one or more of the multiple animal monitoring devices being within a communication range of the gateway device. The gateway devices also obtain sensor data in relation to the animals that is measured independent from the animal behaviours. A rules engine, located remotely from the animals, determines compliance of the animal behaviours with predetermined rules, wherein the behaviours and sensor data are used as variable values in determining the compliance.
applicants: CSIRO (COMMONWEALTH SCIENTIFIC AND INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH ORGANISATION)

title: APPARATUS FOR MANAGING CONDITION FOR SOW
abstract: The present invention relates to a sow condition manager, and more specifically, to a sow condition manager which analyzes the sow's body temperature and feeding activity in real time to check the sow's health status, predict disease outbreaks, and take necessary measures. The sow condition manager according to the present invention comprises: an automatic feeder which includes a feed storage box for temporarily storing feed, and a feed supply unit coupled to the lower part of the feed storage box and discharging feed downward; a detection unit provided on one side of the automatic feeder to identify each sow and detect the body temperature and feeding activity of each identified sow; a control unit which controls the operation of the automatic feeder and determines whether the sow has a disease based on the results detected by the detection unit. The detection unit has a flat upper front surface, has a body with an inwardly inclined slope on its lower side, is equipped with a reader on the upper front flat part of the body to identify the sow by recognizing the tag attached to the sow's ear, is equipped with a thermal imaging camera disposed forward and downward on the slope of the body of the detection unit and acquires a thermal image of the sow to detect the sow's body temperature, and has a photo sensor which is placed vertically downward on the lower side of the body of the detection unit to detect sows which have moved to eat feed on the lower feeding station.

title: Necklace type wearable dairy cow rumination behavior monitoring device
abstract: The invention discloses a necklace type wearable dairy cow rumination behavior monitoring device, which comprises a necklace belt, and the necklace belt is connected in an end-to-end manner through a necklace belt lock catch; the necklace belt is provided with a detection main body, and the detection main body is provided with a single-chip microcomputer microprocessor, a GPRS module, a sound sensor, a real-time timer, a data memory, a power supply and a micro camera; a pressure sensor is arranged on the necklace belt; the single-chip microcomputer microprocessor, the GPRS module, the sound sensor, the real-time timer, the data memory, the miniature camera and the pressure sensor are electrically connected with the power supply. The sound sensor, the real-time timer, the miniature camera and the pressure sensor are all electrically connected with the data storage device, the data storage device is electrically connected with the single-chip microcomputer microprocessor, and the single-chip microcomputer microprocessor is electrically connected with the GPRS module.
applicants: SUBTROPICAL AGROECOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF

title: Automatic Control Growth Analysis System to Increase Productivity of Livestock Cost Experts
abstract: To solve conventional problems in the livestock industry relying on experts' capabilities, an automatic control growth analysis system secures valid information through big data analysis that integrates scattered information from the Korea Institute for Animal Products Quality Evaluation, smart livestock farming companies, and the like, creates a specification management guideline database based on the valid information, and constructs an optimal growth environment learning algorithm system. The automatic control growth analysis system comprise a complex environment management unit which includes a vision device and an acoustic sensor to measure growth without applying stress in a contactless manner and monitors behavior amounts and abnormal signs (disease detection). The automatic control growth analysis system transmits livestock behaviors, coughing sounds, body temperature changes, and the like to a livestock growth analysis system to analyze the same, and provides a user with an appropriate solution. This system can lower the barrier to entry to the livestock industry and be advanced through secured data, thereby being expected to improve productivity, quality, and reliability in the future.

title: Device for monitoring feed intake of dairy cow in real time
abstract: The invention discloses a necklace device for real-time monitoring of feed intake of dairy cows, which comprises a double-layer elastic waterproof necklace belt, and the double-layer elastic waterproof necklace belt is in end-to-end connection through a buckle; the double-layer elastic waterproof necklace belt is provided with a pressure sensor, a sound sensor, a signal processor for comprehensively processing sound frequency and pressure, a solar cell panel, a single-chip microcomputer and a dairy cow real-time information inquiry channel two-dimensional code. The pressure sensor, the sound sensor, the signal processor for comprehensively processing sound frequency and pressure and the single-chip microcomputer are all electrically connected with the solar cell panel. The pressure sensor and the sound sensor are electrically connected with the signal processor for comprehensively processing sound frequency and pressure, and the signal processor for comprehensively processing sound frequency and pressure is electrically connected with the single chip microcomputer.
applicants: SUBTROPICAL AGROECOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF

title: Necklace type wearable dairy cow respiratory rate real-time monitoring device
abstract: The invention discloses a necklace type wearable dairy cow respiratory rate monitoring device which comprises an elastic necklace. A micro infrared thermal imaging sensor, a sound sensor, a photoelectric pulse sensor, a power supply, a single chip microcomputer, a data memory and Bluetooth transmission equipment are arranged on the elastic necklace; the micro infrared thermal imaging sensor, the sound sensor, the photoelectric pulse sensor, the single chip microcomputer, the data memory and the Bluetooth transmission equipment are all electrically connected with the power supply; the micro infrared thermal imaging sensor, the sound sensor, the photoelectric pulse sensor and the Bluetooth transmission equipment are electrically connected with the data memory; the data memory is electrically connected with the single-chip microcomputer.
applicants: SUBTROPICAL AGROECOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF

title: Automatic metering trough for feeding dairy cows
abstract: An automatic metering trough for dairy cow feeding belongs to livestock breeding equipment. A groove type track, a telescopic driving cylinder, a dairy cow identity recognizer, a photoelectric emitter and a photoelectric receiver are installed on a fixedly-arranged flail, a gate is assembled in the groove type track, the telescopic driving cylinder is hinged to the gate, and an upper support is installed in front of the flail through a lower support and a gravity sensor in a supporting mode. A feeding trough is installed on an upper support through a rotating shaft, a rotary driving cylinder installed on the upper support is fixedly connected with the rotating shaft through a rotary component, and a positioning shaft installed on the feeding trough is matched with a rubber pad assembled on the upper support in a contact mode or a contact-separating mode. The automatic controller is respectively communicated with the cow identity recognizer, the photoelectric emitter, the photoelectric receiver, the telescopic driving cylinder, the rotary driving cylinder, the gravity sensor and the computer through wires; the trough can accurately monitor the ingestion starting and ending time, the ingestion amount each time, the daily ingestion total frequency, the total ingestion time and the total ingestion amount of individual dairy cows, and is high in automation degree and reliable to use.
applicants: HEILONGJIANG AGRICULTURAL MACHINERY ENGINEERING SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title: SEAL MEMBER FOR LIVESTOCK SENSOR AND LIVESTOCK SENSOR
abstract: Provided is a seal member for a livestock sensor, the seal member being excellent in durability against organic acids and low acid permeability. This disclosure relates to a seal member for a livestock sensor, the seal member comprising resin or rubber free from chlorine atoms.

title: LIVESTOCK MONITORING AND MANAGEMENT
abstract: The present invention provides farm management systems comprising: an animal asset monitoring systems, wherein the animal asset monitoring systems determines animal health; and a pasture energy content determining system; wherein the farm management systems correlate animal health and pasture energy content to inform a pasture grazing protocol maximise animal product production.

title: CATTLE TRACEABILITY SYSTEM BY CONSEQUENCE
abstract: The present invention relates to a technology platform for consolidating information collected from livestock farms using proprietary applications or enabling automatic reception of information from management systems throughout the animals' lifetimes. This information is stored using blockchain technology to guarantee inviolability. The system ranks the traceability of each animal and allocates a traceability level stamp to said animal.

title: Livestock Smart Farm System to Improve Livestock Growth
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock smart farm system for improving livestock growth, which collects and manages information related to livestock growth through IoT technology in breeding facilities such as livestock barns or pig farms, wherein the system purifies polluted air, maintains a pleasant livestock environment, and improves safety and productivity from various diseases.

title: Animal health monitoring system
abstract: The invention provides an animal health monitoring system. A pig ear tag is arranged on an ear of a pig; a temperature probe is arranged in the pig ear tag and is used for transmitting detected pig body temperature information to the host; the environment temperature sensor is used for detecting environment temperature and transmitting the environment temperature to the host; the host is used for transmitting the received pig body temperature information and the environment temperature to the server; the server is used for analyzing the received pig body temperature information to obtain a corresponding pigsty ID, a corresponding pig ID and a corresponding pig body temperature, and correcting and comparing the pig body temperature by using the environment temperature and a preset correction coefficient; and when the comparison result meets a preset alarm condition, giving an alarm. The system can improve the accuracy of pig body temperature monitoring.
applicants: SHENZHEN AAOYIN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD

title: CATTLE MANAGEMENT METHOD IN STABLE
abstract: An antibacterial LED lamp, a thermal camera, a CCTV camera, a radar sensor, an ammonia sensor, etc. are mounted in a cattle shed. Cattle entity management, entity growth management, regular cattle shed sterilization, entity hygiene management, entity disease management, cattle entry and intrusion management, cattle health management, cattle rut management, and cattle shed hygiene can be easily and conveniently carried out based on images, videos, and detection values detected by the sensors and the cameras. Specifically, thermal temperature videos and image videos are mapped to manage cattle in the cattle shed, and heartbeats/respiration can be linked to individual recognition cameras to check the health state of the cattle through the surface temperatures, heartbeats, and respiration records of entities by a microwave radar sensor to prevent infectious diseases and easily impregnate Korean cattle through mounting images, temperature, heartbeats, and respiration in the rut state of Korean cattle.

title: ICT ICT CONVERGENCE CHICKEN GROWTH SMART FARM SYSTEM
abstract: A technology disclosed in the present specification relates to an ICT convergence chicken growth smart farm system. The ICT convergence chicken growth smart farm system may comprise: a transmission unit for receiving state information and breeding information of chickens measured for each setting area, and when it is determined that the chickens are abnormal, transmitting abnormal alarm information to a manager's terminal in a setting area in which abnormal chickens are located; and an information analysis unit for determining whether the chicken is abnormal for each setting area based on the state information and the breeding information, and comparing the number of chickens laying eggs set for each setting area with the number of laid eggs measured for each setting area to determine whether the chicken is abnormal for each setting area. Therefore, by checking whether the chicken and egg are abnormal for each setting area and controlling the environment for each setting area, it is possible to easily manage the chicken and the egg separated for each setting area.

title: Intelligent medicine box monitoring system for dog parasite expelling
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent medicine box monitoring system for dog parasite expelling, which comprises an intelligent medicine box and a management system, and is characterized in that the intelligent medicine box and the management system are in wireless communication; the intelligent medicine box is used for storing anthelmintic and dog excrement; the management system is used for monitoring the feeding condition of the anthelmintic through the opening and closing state of the intelligent medicine box, storing dog excrement detection data and judging whether echinococcosis eggs exist or not. The intelligent medicine box can automatically remind and supervise the dog owner to take medicine for feeding according to the feeding time interval of the vermifuge, and can remind and supervise the dog owner to sample dog excrement at a certain time interval after the dog owner feeds the vermifuge; then, whether the dogs suffer from the clathecium eggs or not can be detected through component analysis of excrement sampling; whether the dog owner feeds the medicine on time or not can be checked; meanwhile, detection data can provide a decision basis for accurate prevention and control of echinococcosis.
applicants: SUZHOU XIANGSHI INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; AGRICHINA HUAWEI BIOPHARMACEUTICAL (HUBEI) COMPANY

title: Outdoor sheep release cattle and sheep positioning and health monitoring system and device based on lora communication
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of cattle and sheep positioning, and discloses an outdoor sheep release cattle and sheep positioning and health monitoring system based on lora communication, and the system comprises the steps: 1, planning the number of LORA hosts according to an actual area, placing the LORA hosts on a pasture/meadow according to a rule, determining the maximum activity range of cattle and sheep, and carrying out the positioning of the LORA hosts; and drawing the control range of the electronic fence on the terminal equipment. According to the invention, the RFID module of the ear tag communicates with the LORA hosts which are arranged in a rectangular shape in a pasture/meadow, the signals sent by the ear tag can be received by at least three LORA hosts, the cloud platform accurately measures the positions of cattle and sheep through the timestamp and a three-point positioning algorithm, and the health condition of the cattle and sheep can be reminded to a user through the terminal equipment, so that the user experience is improved. The system greatly prolongs the service time of the positioner, the service time can reach 48 months at most, the ear tag does not need to be charged, the positioning precision is high, and the stress response of cattle and sheep is relatively less.
applicants: SHENZHEN AAOYIN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD

title: WATER INTAKE MONITORING SYSTEM AND METHOD OF INDIVIDUAL COW
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and method for monitoring the amount of drinking water for each dairy cow. The present invention relates to a system for monitoring the amount of water consumed by dairy cows raised in livestock barns. The system includes: a milk collection device which milks and stores milk from cows; a measuring device which generates data to estimate the amount of drinking water in the dairy cows; and a control server which calculates the amount of water consumed by dairy cows based on estimation data of the amount of drinking water.

title: METHOD AND CONTROL DEVICE FOR DETERMINING FLOOR CONDITION IN A DWELLING AREA
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to the field of farming and more specifically it relates to a method and a control device for determining floor condition in a dwelling area. According to a first aspect, the disclosure relates to a computer implemented method for determining floor condition in a dwelling area for a herd of animals. The method comprises obtaining S1, from a walking monitoring system arranged in the dwelling area, walking data indicative of walking characteristics of one or more individual animals located in the dwelling area, and determining S3 the floor condition based on walking characteristics indicated by the obtained walking data. The method enables a farmer to determine the floor condition, whereby the farmer can intervene immediately if floor quality is unacceptable. Consequently, accidents and animal injury may be avoided.

title: Reusable ear tag
abstract: A monitoring device includes a male portion including a housing with a top on a first ear side, a first needle and a shorter second needle for piercing the ear, electronic components including a battery, processor and temperature sensor, a thermally conductive ring on the first ear side coupled to the temperature sensor, a female portion including a housing with a bottom surface on a second ear side, a first and second openings in the housing, a first chamber for physically selectively retaining and releasing the first needle, and a second chamber for inhibiting rotation of the male portion relative to the female portion, when the first needle is physically retained by the first chamber.

title: Apparatus and method for monitoring inactive livestock
abstract: Disclosed is a monitoring method for visualizing a location of inactive livestock within a livestock farm. The monitoring method comprises the steps of: extracting, by an image analysis device, livestock objects from video images acquired for each frame, and then calculating center coordinates representing a location of inactive livestock within a livestock barn based on coordinates of an extracted livestock objects; displaying, by a display device, an object icon representing the inactive livestock in a display area mapped to calculated center coordinates among a plurality of display areas defined on a display screen; and emitting light by lighting units selected from among a plurality of lighting units installed in a livestock structure based on the calculated center coordinates. Accordingly, livestock management can be managed efficiently.

title: Training method and device for growth performance measurement model and measurement method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a training method and device for a growth performance measurement model and a measurement method and device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a livestock pedigree table and a first individual feature of a livestock individual, and building a first adjacent matrix according to the livestock pedigree table; splicing the first adjacent matrix and the first individual features to obtain a first spliced feature, so as to combine the individual features of the livestock individuals with a genetic relationship, thereby combining the influence of the current own conditions and genetic factors of the livestock individuals on the growth performance; and finally, on the basis of taking the first splicing feature as model input, performing iterative training on a preset graph neural network model, and stopping iteration until the graph neural network model reaches a preset convergence condition to obtain a growth performance determination model, thereby realizing the determination of the livestock growth performance by using the neural network model. The problem that the determination result is inaccurate due to dependence on manpower is solved, meanwhile, the livestock does not need to be driven, and the stress reaction of the livestock is avoided.
applicants: SHANDONG NEWHOPE LIUHE GROUP COMPANY; SICHUAN NEW HOPE ANIMAL NUTRITION TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.; NEW HOPE LIUHE COMPANY

title: Image processing
abstract: Forming an object image data set comprises: receiving 54 plural image data sets from plural cameras installed in a livestock habitation; spatially relating 56 a first image data set and a second image data set from the plural sets to account for overlap between the image data sets; and forming 58 an object image data set from the image data contained in the spatially related image data sets, the object image data set comprising at least part of the image data common to the two data sets. The object image data set comprises the coterminous area of the first and second image data sets and at least part of each of the first and second image data sets outside of the overlapping area. The second image data represents a scene in the livestock habitation. The plural image data sets each represent a view of a different part of the livestock habitation. The cameras may be installed at elevated locations in the livestock habitation in an array such that each of the cameras views the habitation from above.

title: Sow estrus checking method, device and system
abstract: The invention provides a sow estrus checking method, device and system. The sow estrus checking method comprises the following steps: collecting continuous multi-frame face images of a to-be-tested sow; under the condition that it is determined that the posture of the mouth and nose of the to-be-detected sow is stable according to the continuous multiple frames of face images, estrus inducing pheromone is sprayed to the mouth and nose of the to-be-detected sow; and displaying the holographic image of the boar, and continuously pressing the back of the to-be-tested sow by using a back pressing plate to obtain a feedback pressure curve for determining the estrus state of the to-be-tested sow. According to the method, the holographic image of the boar is fused with the estrus inducing pheromone, the back pressure feedback pressure of the to-be-detected sow is collected, the feedback pressure curve is constructed, the estrus state of the sow is judged, the sow is stimulated to be in estrus from multiple aspects such as vision, smell and touch, the real boar is not used, the number of estrus checking personnel for controlling the boar is reduced to a great extent, and the working efficiency is improved. In addition, direct contact between boars and sows and indirect contact between the sows in all the fences are avoided, the virus spreading possibility is reduced, and the detection precision and the detection efficiency are effectively improved.
applicants: INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH CENTER OF BEIJING ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY SCIENCES

title: Livestock and poultry health sign big data Internet of Things detection system
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock and poultry health sign big data Internet of Things detection system which is characterized in that the detection system comprises a parameter acquisition and control platform and a livestock and poultry body temperature big data intelligent prediction subsystem, and accurate detection and prediction of the measured livestock and poultry body temperature are achieved; the system effectively solves the problems that an existing livestock and poultry sign parameter detection system does not accurately detect and predict livestock and poultry sign parameters according to the influence on the livestock and poultry sign parameters due to the fact that the livestock and poultry environment area is large, and the livestock and poultry environment parameters and complex changes such as nonlinearity and large lag of livestock and poultry sign parameter changes are complex; the livestock and poultry health and the livestock and poultry management are greatly influenced.

title: Pig feeding method, device and system for measuring fat thickness based on terahertz
abstract: The invention provides a pig feeding method, device and system for measuring the thickness of fat based on terahertz, and the method comprises the steps: determining a target point for detecting the thickness of back fat according to a back image of a pig; obtaining terahertz time-domain waveform information of the target point, and calculating the theoretical backfat thickness of the pig according to the terahertz time-domain waveform information; inputting the theoretical backfat thickness into a thickness correction model, and obtaining an actual backfat thickness output by the thickness correction model; and adjusting a feeding curve according to the actual backfat thickness so as to feed the pigs. According to the method, the actual backfat thickness of the pig is rapidly obtained through the obtained terahertz time domain waveform information of the pig and by means of the pre-trained thickness correction model, the body conditions of the pig in different limiting fences in the pig house in different growth stages can be accurately, conveniently, rapidly and efficiently detected in a non-contact mode, and the detection accuracy is improved. Data support is provided for precise feeding of pigs, feed can be effectively saved, the fat measuring labor intensity is reduced, and the production benefits of pig farms are maximized.
applicants: INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH CENTER OF BEIJING ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY SCIENCES

title: Use of Aversive Stimulus Collars to Deter Physical Confrontations Between Livestock
abstract: An aversive stimulus collar is configured for fitment around the necks of livestock to counter aggressive tendencies between animals. Each animal can be fitted with a collar that monitors for proximity of other similarly configured collars worn by other animals. When a collar worn by one animal senses that another collar worn by another animal is within a certain distance, the collar can deliver an aversive stimulus to the animal, such as an electric shock. As the distance between collared animals continues to decrease, the level, intensity, and/or frequency of the aversive stimulus can be increased so that the animal learns an association between proximity to other collared animals and the aversive stimulus.

title: Livestock management system
abstract: A livestock management system for detecting, tracking, and responding to livestock location and physical parameters, and for determining livestock behavior and physical conditions correlated thereto. The system generally includes a plurality of tags and sensors attached to and implanted in a plurality of livestock, one or more local sensors, a management platform, and a remote computer system. Each tag receives, processes and maintains data regarding the location, activity and physical parameters of a livestock to which it is attached and locally determines the behavior and physical conditions of the livestock. The tags communicate with other nearby tags and sensors locally via dynamic mesh networks and with the management platform and remote computer system via longer range wireless networks. The management platform processes the tag data and produces herd-related data. The remote computer uses the tag data to generate and update livestock behavior and condition models for download to the tags.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR BROILER DATA PROCESSING
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a poultry data processing method performed by a computing device comprises the following steps of: inputting an image containing one or more poultry to a poultry detection model to obtain poultry size information for at least some of the one or more poultry; and inputting the poultry size information to at least one weight prediction model determined to minimize a prediction error among a plurality of weight prediction models so as to obtain at least one of poultry weight prediction information and shipment time prediction information for the one or more poultry.

title: PIG REARING ASSISTANCE APPARATUS, PIG REARING ASSISTANCE METHOD, AND PIG REARING ASSISTANCE PROGRAM
abstract: This pig rearing assistance apparatus is provided with: an acquisition unit that acquires image data of an image captured by a camera directed to a plurality of pens in each of which a group of pigs are being raised; a detection unit that detects a specific posture of the pigs on the basis of the image of the image data; and a count unit that counts the number of times of the specific posture detected for each of the plurality of pens during a preset observation time. This pig rearing assistance apparatus can notify rearing staff of which pen includes a pig having a poor health condition among the plurality of pens in each of which the group of pigs are being raised at an appropriate timing without excessive cost and labor.

title: Replacement gilt management pig house
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock breeding management, and provides a replacement gilt management pig house in order to solve the problem of low breeding efficiency in existing pig house management; the replacement gilt management pig house comprises pigsties arranged in the center of the pig house, where the pigsties comprise boar pigsties and sow pigsties, and wherein the boar pigsties and the sow pigsties are arranged alternately; the pig house also includes: the recognition system that comprises a three-axis accelerator which is located on the front leg portion of the replacement gilt, collects displacement exercise amount information of the oestrus replacement gilt in advance, and is used for collecting the exercise amount information of the replacement gilt and judging whether the replacement gilt has an oestrus behavior or not; the camera module that is located above the pig house and used for collecting a pig house image when the replacement gilt has an oestrus behavior; the recognition module that is used for recognizing whether the replacement gilts are oestrus or not according to the pig house images; and the communication module that is used for sending a signal to a terminal when the replacement gilt is identified to be oestrus.
applicants: CHONGQING LIUJIU ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Barn Ventilation System Using Behavioral Patterns of Livestock
abstract: One embodiment of the present invention can provide a barn ventilation system using behavioral patterns of livestock which comprises: a complex sensor unit that collects environmental information within the livestock shed; a camera unit that measures movement information of livestock within the livestock barn; and a server which collects and analyzes air quality information measured by the complex sensor unit and livestock movement information measured by the camera unit, and operates the ventilator or air conditioner installed in the livestock barn in accordance with the analyzed livestock movement information and air quality information results.

title: AN ANIMAL TRACKING SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention relates to an animal tracking system (10) comprising at least one temperature sensor (140) associated with a heat transfer element (110) which has a heat transfer area (111) provided in a manner contacting the ear of the livestock, in order to provide tracking of health information and behavior analyses of livestock by the breeder by means of an electronic ear tag (100) fixed to the ear regions of livestock.

title: High-efficiency breeding hybridization method and device
abstract: The invention provides a hybridization method and device for efficient breeding, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the image collection of stocking animals, analyzing the collected images, judging whether each animal is in an oestrus state or not, and recognizing the head orientation change of each oestrus animal in the image if there is an oestrus animal; according to the method, address information of each identification device and the head orientation of the corresponding animal are obtained through the identification device worn on each animal, and then the head orientation change condition of each animal is obtained; for each oestrus animal, comparing the head orientation change condition of the oestrus animal with the obtained head orientation change condition of each animal, and if the head orientation change conditions of the oestrus animal and the head orientation change conditions of each animal are the same, sending an indication signal to a corresponding identification device; and the corresponding identification device performs indication display after receiving the indication signal, so that a feeder can quickly find the oestrus animal and pull the oestrus animal to breed. According to the invention, the estrus animal searching efficiency and accuracy can be improved.
applicants: CHONGQING ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY PROMOTION MASTER STATION

title: Tire replacement structure based on different diameters and livestock mobile weight measuring system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a tire replacement structure based on different diameters and a livestock moving weight measuring system and method.The tire replacement structure comprises a mounting wheel shaft, obstacle crossing wheel bodies, eccentric bearing seats and bearings, and the mounting wheel shaft is rotationally assembled on a limiting frame; the obstacle crossing wheel body is assembled on the mounting wheel shaft in a transmission manner; the eccentric bearing seat is fixedly connected to the limiting frame, and the eccentric bearing seat is provided with an eccentric hole; a bearing is assembled in the eccentric hole, and the mounting wheel shaft is assembled and connected with the bearing. The technical problems that in the prior art, when tires with different diameters are replaced for a rail robot, part of the structure of the robot needs to be changed, the working procedure is complex, the tires cannot be rapidly and stably replaced, the weighing operation efficiency is not high, and the normal operation period is affected are solved.
applicants: BEIJING XIAOLONG HIDDEN TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Sow estrus checking method and estrus checking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a sow estrus checking method and a sow estrus checking robot, the method applies the sow estrus checking robot, the sow estrus checking robot comprises an image collector and a body temperature measurer, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting a sow image through the image collector, importing the collected sow image into a pre-trained convolutional neural network to carry out convolution operation, identifying an oestrus feature part image of the sow; enabling a body temperature measurer to locate the position of the oestrus characteristic part image, and collecting the temperature information of the oestrus characteristic part of the sow through the body temperature measurer; predicting and identifying the oestrus key state of the sow according to the oestrus feature part image of the sow by utilizing regression analysis to obtain the oestrus key state information of the sow; and performing normalized data processing on the characteristic part temperature information and the oestrus key state information of the sow, and importing the information into a classifier for classification and identification so as to identify the oestrus state of the sow. The method can automatically check the estrus of the sow and judge whether the sow is in an estrus state or not.
applicants: XIAMEN INTELLIGENT PUPIL SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY LIMITED COMPANY

title: Intelligent tethered dairy cow feed intake monitoring device for test
abstract: The invention relates to a tethered intelligent dairy cow feed intake monitoring device for a test. The tethered intelligent dairy cow feed intake monitoring device comprises at least one suspension unit, at least one first fixing unit, at least one connecting unit, a material loading unit, a plurality of turning plate units, a detection unit and a control unit, wherein the first end of the suspension unit is used for being suspended on a tether bar; the first fixing unit is arranged at the first end of the hanging unit; the first end of the connecting unit is detachably connected with the second end of the first fixing unit; the material loading unit is mounted at the second end of the connecting unit; the plurality of turning plate units are rotationally arranged on the side wall of the loading unit; the detection unit is arranged in the material loading unit; the control unit is arranged in the material carrying unit and connected with the detection unit and the intelligent terminal. The tethered intelligent dairy cow feed intake monitoring device for the test can accurately measure the feed intake of the dairy cow, can be folded and detached so as to be convenient to carry, and solves the problems that the head of the dairy cow needs to be sleeved with an existing detection device, and the feed intake of the dairy cow cannot be accurately and directly obtained.

title: Live pig body temperature measuring system
abstract: The invention discloses a live pig body temperature measuring system, relates to the technical field of live pig detection, and aims to solve the problem that the existing live pig body temperature measuring efficiency is low, the live pig body temperature measuring system comprises a measuring channel, a mounting plate is fixed to the inner wall of one end of the measuring channel, and a far infrared thermometer is mounted on the mounting plate; the measuring channel is provided with a limiting assembly used for limiting the position of a live pig, and the measuring channel is further provided with a driving assembly used for driving the live pig to move. The body temperature of the live pig can be rapidly and effectively measured, the live pig with the measured body temperature can be limited, the live pig with the measured body temperature can be fixed, then the temperature measurement accuracy is effectively improved, the measurement efficiency is high, and the working performance is high.
applicants: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES IN

title: Intelligent feeding method, device and system based on visual animal body size
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of breeding, and particularly relates to an intelligent feeding method, device and system based on a visual animal body size, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining the image information and body size information of an animal; judging the type of the animal according to the image information of the animal; judging the body condition information of the animal according to the animal category and the body size information; and generating a feeding strategy according to the body condition information, so that the feeding robot performs intelligent feeding according to the feeding strategy. According to the invention, the camera is adopted to detect the body size of the animal, the real-time performance is high, manpower is not needed, the intelligent degree is high, after the body size information of the animal is identified, the blanking rate and the blanking amount can be adjusted in time in combination with the read ear tag information, and the adjustment of the body condition can be efficiently completed.

title: Milk cow heat stress behavior monitoring method and monitoring device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a dairy cow heat stress behavior monitoring method and device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining dairy cow monitoring information and environment monitoring information, which are non-contact monitoring information; determining cow behavior information based on the cow monitoring information; obtaining a preset heat stress early warning model; and processing the environment monitoring information and the cow behavior information based on the preset heat stress early warning model to generate a corresponding heat stress behavior monitoring result. By adopting the non-contact monitoring method, the behaviors of the dairy cow under various environmental factors can be effectively and accurately monitored, and the heat stress behaviors of the dairy cow can be effectively and intelligently pre-warned or managed in combination with the heat stress pre-warning model for the dairy cow, so that the labor cost is reduced, and the monitoring effectiveness and the monitoring accuracy are improved.

title: Novel method for automatically measuring sheep body size
abstract: The invention discloses a novel method for automatic sheep body size measurement. The method comprises the following steps that S1, an ultrahigh frequency electronic ear tag is installed on each sheep ear; s2, enabling the flock of sheep to enter a measuring channel in sequence; s3, sensing the electronic ear tag through the ultrahigh frequency card reader at the entrance of the measuring system; s4, opening an entrance electrically operated gate of the measurement system; s5, the single sheep enters the measuring system, and the entrance electric door is closed; s6, the measuring system measures the body weight and the body size; s7, the measuring system distributes corresponding access doors according to the weight (body condition scores) of the sheep, and the corresponding access doors are opened; and S8, the single sheep enters the exit channel, the channel door is closed, and then the single sheep enters the corresponding sheepfold. According to the method, the problem that the grouping process is very inconvenient and not standard because the sheep flock can only be grouped by visually measuring the body size of the sheep flock by workers and then are selected one by one is solved.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY; INNER MONGOLIA HUAWEN TECHNOLOGY INFORMATION COMPANY

title: Precise feeding method and feeding system
abstract: The invention discloses a precise feeding method and system, and relates to the technical field of livestock breeding, a feeding control method is applied to an intelligent feeding cloud management system, and the intelligent feeding cloud management system is connected with a control terminal; comprising the following steps: acquiring two-dimensional code information of a pig ear tag and two-dimensional code information of a feeder; correspondingly associating the two-dimensional code information of the pig ear tag with the two-dimensional code information of the feeder; the intelligent feeding cloud management system sends a feeding instruction to the feeder through transfer equipment according to the two-dimensional code information of the pig ear tag associated with the feeder; and the feeder receives the feeding instruction and then carries out feeding. According to the invention, the two-dimensional code information of the pig ear tag and the two-dimensional code information of the feeder are correspondingly associated, and then different feeding instructions are sent to the feeder through the intelligent feeding cloud management system according to the pig information associated with each feeder, so that each feeder carries out feeding according to the different feeding instructions. Therefore, accurate feeding of different types of pigs is realized.

title: Animal husbandry system
abstract: The present invention relates to an animal husbandry system, wherein a group of animals (2) can move about freely in an area (1), the system comprising - monitoring and analyzing means (8) configured for repeatedly generating images and gathering data therefrom regarding at least one mobile being (2) and/or object (9) in the area (1), 10 - illumination means provided with a number of illumination elements, each arranged for illuminating at least a subarea of the area (1), and - control means connected to the monitoring and analyzing means (8) and to the illumination means, wherein the monitoring and analyzing means (8) are configured for determining an image 15 quality value for each generated image and for detecting an insufficient image quality due to an unsuitable illumination intensity in at least one of the subareas, wherein the control means are configured for adjusting said unsuitable illumination intensity in said subarea to a suitable illumination intensity, so that the image quality becomes sufficient. A simple, yet efficient and automated enhancement of the images generated in the 20 system can be achieved by locally adjusting the illumination intensity, if required. The quality of the data gathered in the system is thus improved.

title: Movable beef cattle hoof trimming and performance detection device and method
abstract: The invention discloses a movable beef cattle hoof trimming and performance detecting device and method.The movable beef cattle hoof trimming and performance detecting device comprises an enclosure frame and a cattle belly lifting appliance, the front side of the enclosure frame is provided with a front door, the rear side of the enclosure frame is provided with a rear door, the left side and the right side of the enclosure frame are closed, and the movable beef cattle hoof trimming and performance detecting device further comprises a front leg fixator and a rear leg fixator; the front leg positioning device comprises a first driving device, a front leg positioning rod, a first winch, a first inhaul cable and a rotating piece, and the rotating piece is connected with the first driving device and the front leg positioning rod. The first driving device drives the front leg positioning rod to rotate through the rotating piece; the upper end of the first inhaul cable is connected with the first winch, and the lower end extends downwards; the rear leg fixer is mounted at the lower end of the rear door and comprises a rear leg positioning rod, a second winch and a second inhaul cable, the rear leg positioning rod is provided with two raised n-shaped wave crests, the upper end of the second inhaul cable is connected with the second winch, and the lower end of the second inhaul cable extends downwards. The hoof trimming machine has the advantages of compact structure, efficient hoof trimming, safety and the like.
applicants: LIVESTOCK AND POULTRY VARIETY IMPROVEMENT STATION IN GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION; PROFESSIONAL COOPERATION FOR DEVELOPMENT OF GUANYANG TENGFLYING CATTLE INDUSTRY

title: Livestock shed management system and Livestock shed management method using livestock bio-information
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock bio-injection biometric information unit, which comprises: a biometric information unit for checking biometric information on each livestock entity; a control unit for receiving a signal of each biometric information unit to check the biometric information on a corresponding entity; an error detection unit for checking the reliability of an abnormal signal by comparing the biometric information on the corresponding biometric information unit with biometric information on other capsules when the abnormal signal is received from the biometric information on the control unit; and a communication unit for transmitting a signal of the control unit to a terminal preset to check the biometric information on the corresponding entity in real time. According to the present invention, livestock biometric information is checked in real time, and management efficiency can be improved by improving the reliability of an abnormal reaction to allow a rapid response when the abnormal reaction occurs.

title: Feedlot ear-tag systems and methods
abstract: Systems and methods for tracking certain activities of a plurality of animals in a feedlot involve a plurality of RF asset tags attached to the plurality of animals and a plurality of RF detector stations that are operable to read unique identifier codes associated with each of the plurality of RF asset tags. Members of the plurality of RF detector stations are positioned, at least for some, proximate to at least one water trough and at least one feed trough, and are operable to transmit data concerning the RF asset tags detected over a communication link to an asset management subsystem. Duplicate signals may be reduced, signal filtered and smoothed, and energy conserved with certain approaches taken with the RF detector stations. Other systems and devices are presented.

title: Sow's Estrus detection apparatus and method
abstract: A device for detecting an optimum time of insemination of sows and a method thereof are disclosed. The device for detecting the optimum time of insemination comprises: a sensor unit that sets a sensing area around a through hole of a certain size formed in the wall that blocks a boar area and a sow area and detects the behavior patterns of the sow entering the sensing area; and a unit for detecting the optimum time of insemination that identifies an estrus or fertilization period based on the behavioral patterns.

title: Livestock sign monitoring device and system
abstract: The invention provides a livestock physical sign monitoring device and system, and relates to the technical field of livestock physical sign detection. The livestock physical sign monitoring device is installed at the bottom of a hoof of a livestock and comprises a hoof walking extrusion part and a processing chip connected with the hoof walking extrusion part. In the walking process of the livestock, the hoof walking extrusion component generates pressure change; the processing chip is used for determining the weight value of the livestock according to the pressure change. According to the livestock physical sign monitoring device and system provided by the embodiment of the invention, the body weight of the livestock can be measured in the walking process of the livestock and does not need to be measured on a horizontal plane, so that the efficiency and accuracy of livestock body weight measurement are improved, and the technical effect of monitoring the physical signs of the livestock is achieved.
applicants: AGRICULTURAL ECONOMY AND INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES IN JIANGXI

title: Detection system of cow's delivery and hard labor
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for detecting calving and dystocia in cows using an acceleration sensor, and more specifically, to a system for detecting calving and dystocia in cows using an acceleration sensor that accurately and quickly detects the calving time of a cow and informing the breeder to maximize the survival rate of cows and calves.
