The system comprises: a motion detection device (10) attached to the upper part of the cow's hock (knee of back legs) to detect acceleration generated by the cow's hock movement in three axes; a data collection device (20) operating as a gateway that periodically receives the three-axis acceleration behavior data detected from the motion detection device (10) and transmits the received acceleration behavior data to a management server (30); a management server (30) analyzing acceleration behavior data received from the data collection device (20) and determining whether the cow is calving based on the analyzed data; and a user terminal (40) on which an app accessible to the management server (30) is installed. The management server (30) is configured to notify the user terminal (40) of the state of the cow based on acceleration behavior data received from the data collection device (20).

title: Intelligent pig raising growth health dynamic monitoring management method based on big data
abstract: The invention relates to the field of pig raising growth health monitoring, in particular to an intelligent pig raising growth health dynamic monitoring management method based on big data. Comprising the following steps: step 1, forming a live pig health condition database; constructing a related index threshold value; and processing the data in the live pig health condition database, and judging and analyzing whether the data meet related index thresholds or not. According to the intelligent pig raising growth health dynamic monitoring management method based on big data provided by the invention, the image data of the live pig activity area, the live pig living environment data, the live pig feeding data and the live pig physiological parameter data are acquired in real time, and the health condition of the live pig can be known through analysis; according to the method, the characteristic protocols of related index thresholds are matched, so that feeders can conveniently find the growth conditions of the live pigs in time, time and labor are saved, rationalization and intelligentization of live pig breeding are greatly improved, meanwhile, the live pigs can keep healthy growth before slaughtering, and economic losses of breeding are reduced.
applicants: CHONGQING ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY PROMOTION MASTER STATION

title: Intelligent pregnant sow feeding management system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sow breeding, in particular to an intelligent pregnant sow feeding management system. Comprising a mobile terminal, a central control management system, a sow feeding management system and an environment management system, the sow feeding management system comprises a feed management module, a feeding management module and a pig house management module, and the environment management system comprises a temperature sensor, a humidity sensor, a temperature control module and a humidity control module. According to the system, the mobile terminal, the central control management system, the sow feeding management system and the environment management system are connected into a whole, a worker can record and query the inspection time, the weight, body condition, fetal number and pregnancy stage information of the pregnant sows at the mobile terminal, intelligent feeding of the pregnant sows can be conveniently achieved, and compared with traditional handwriting recording, the system has the advantages that the efficiency is high; more and more detailed information can be inquired and recorded, so that recording paper is saved, convenience is brought to management of sow feeding by managers, and the working efficiency of workers is improved.
applicants: CHONGQING ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY PROMOTION MASTER STATION

title: CONTROL ARRANGEMENT AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING OPERATION OF MOBILE AGRICULTURAL DEVICES
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to farming and in particular to a control arrangement for controlling operation of mobile agricultural devices in a livestock area. According to a first aspect, the disclosure relates to a control arrangement (100) configured to obtain from the real-time location system (50), positions of individual animals (10) and of individual mobile agricultural devices (20) located in the livestock area and to automatically control operation of one or more of the mobile agricultural devices (20), based on the obtained positions of the one or more individual mobile agricultural devices (20) and of the individual animals (10). Thereby, mobile agricultural devices can be operated optimally and safely with regard to the positions of the animals (and staff). The disclosure also relates to a corresponding method and to a computer program for performing the method.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR TRACKING ANIMALS
abstract: A method for tracking animals, more particularly cattle, comprises the following steps: - capturing a digital image of a plurality of animals to obtain digital image data, - identifying individual animals from the image data, - tracking the progress of the animals identified to obtain first movement data, - analysing the first movement data to create a progress profile for each animal, - tracking the movement of individual body parts of the animals and/or detecting and tracking the body position of the animals from the image data to obtain second movement data, - analysing the second movement data to determine the motion sequence and/or the activity of the animals to create a behaviour profile for each animal.

title: Bio Capsule and Method for Measuring and Reducing Methane Gas in the Rumen of Livestock
abstract: The present invention relates to a biocapsule for measuring and reducing methane gas in the rumen of livestock and a method for measuring and reducing methane gas using the same, and more specifically, to a biocapsule for measuring and reducing methane gas in the rumen of livestock and a method for measuring and reducing methane gas using the same, which can significantly reduce emissions by detecting and measuring the amount of methane gas generated in the rumen of the livestock, which are ruminants, and reducing the same.

title: Method for identifying dangerous target in electric power monitoring system
abstract: The invention discloses a method for identifying a dangerous target in a power monitoring system, the method adopts a monitoring identification system, the monitoring identification system comprises a monitoring module, an analysis module and a processing module, the monitoring module is electrically connected with the analysis module, the analysis module is electrically connected with the processing module, and the processing module is electrically connected with the analysis module. The monitoring module is used for monitoring the breeding environment in a breeding farm, the analysis module is used for analyzing the state of chickens, the processing module is used for performing operation processing after diseased chickens are found, and the feeding module is used for feeding the bred chickens with food. The monitoring module comprises a camera shooting module, a positioning module, a capturing module, a recognition module, an evaluation module, a feeding module and a measurement module, the camera shooting module is electrically connected with the positioning module, the camera shooting module is electrically connected with the capturing module, and the recognition module is electrically connected with the evaluation module. The method has the characteristic that sick chickens in a farm can be timely found and identified.

title: Rapid sheep body fat detection structure based on sheepfold guardrail structure design
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sheep body fat detection, in particular to a rapid sheep body fat detection structure designed based on a sheepfold guardrail structure. The device comprises a measuring device and a clamping device which is arranged in the measuring device and used for clamping limbs of sheep, and the measuring device comprises a limiting frame and a sliding control device which is arranged on one side of the limiting frame and moves up and down. The rear clamping frame and the front clamping frame are fixed to the bottom plate, a channel for sheep to pass through is formed between the rear clamping frame and the front clamping frame, when the sheep needs body fat detection, the sheep is driven to the limiting frame to be detected, and the trouble that workers capture the sheep is avoided; and when the other leg clamping device moves, the leg clamping device moves upwards to clamp the rear legs of the sheep through transmission of the linkage device, so that the measuring electrodes on the two leg clamping devices are connected with the front legs and the rear legs of the sheep respectively, and the accuracy of body fat detection data of the sheep is improved.

title: Pig farm epidemic disease early warning system and method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of livestock breeding management, and discloses a pig farm epidemic disease early warning system, which comprises an electronic temperature measurement ear tag, front-end equipment, middle receiving equipment, a front-end acquisition PC (Personal Computer) terminal, a data management cloud platform, a data early warning analysis module, an early warning information distribution module and an early warning information receiving terminal, the electronic temperature measurement ear tag is connected with the front-end equipment through a 2.4 G wireless network, and the front-end equipment is connected with the intermediate receiving equipment through a wireless network and a wired network; wireless network ear temperature monitoring equipment is adopted to collect ear temperature of a pig individual in real time, and the body temperature monitoring of the pig has the characteristics of 24-hour uninterrupted, all-weather and full-coverage; the system background can solve the real body temperature of the pig in real time, and analysis of body temperature abnormity, body temperature change abnormity and the like of the pig individual is realized through big data analysis, comparative analysis and the like, and matching with body temperature abnormity and change abnormity values of different epidemic diseases is realized.
applicants: HUNAN XUYU SMART SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY LIMITED COMPANY

title: Intelligent monitoring system for cattle raising
abstract: A cattle raising intelligent monitoring system disclosed by the present invention comprises a big data platform, a command center, an intelligent early warning module, a growth system and an automatic control system, the command center comprises a terminal module, and the intelligent early warning module comprises an environment monitoring system. The growth system component comprises a drinking water feeding system and an intelligent feeding system, and the automatic control system component comprises a sewage treatment module, a waste treatment module, a waste and waste treatment module and a disinfection module. The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring system for cattle raising, and relates to the technical field of intelligent cattle raising monitoring systems, through arrangement of an intelligent early warning module and an intelligent exhaust module, components and emission of environmental odor can be monitored in real time, peculiar smell can be eliminated in time, the growth condition of cattle can be detected in real time through a growth system, and the cattle can be automatically fed. Diet plans of each cattle are made differentially, manual operation is reduced, and the requirement for automatic cattle raising is met.
applicants: SHENZHEN CORE LISTENING SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY LIMITED COMPANY

title: Live pig ingestion and drinking behavior detection method and device based on instance segmentation
abstract: The invention discloses a live pig ingestion and drinking behavior detection method and device based on instance segmentation. The device comprises a wall; a lifting device is arranged on one side of the wall, if a data analysis box analyzes that the live pigs want to drink water by analyzing the motion tracks of the live pigs, a second motor is started and drives a driving belt wheel fixedly connected with the driving end, and the driving belt wheel is in transmission connection with a driven belt wheel through a transmission belt; the driving belt pulley can drive a driven belt pulley to start to rotate, then the driven belt pulley drives a second screw rod fixedly connected with one end to start to rotate, and the second screw rod drives a lifting carrier plate in threaded connection with the outer side to start to lift, so that a water conveying branch pipe descends to a proper position for the live pigs to drink water; the water conveying branch pipes are arranged in the pigpen and prevented from being damaged when multiple live pigs move in the pigpen, after the live pigs drink water, the water conveying branch pipes can rise, the height of the water conveying branch pipes is larger than the highest height which the live pigs can reach, and therefore the effect of protecting the water conveying branch pipes can be achieved.
applicants: XIAMEN RURAL CORE DIGITAL SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY LIMITED COMPANY

title: SWINE REARING ASSISTANCE APPARATUS, SWINE REARING ASSISTANCE METHOD, AND SWINE REARING ASSISTANCE PROGRAM
abstract: This swine rearing assistance apparatus is provided with: an acquisition unit that acquires image data of an image captured by a camera unit disposed so as to be directed towards a pen in which female swine are being raised in a group; a detection unit that detects a mounting behavior of the female swine on the basis of the image of the image data; and a count unit that counts the number of times the mounting behavior has been detected during a preset observation time. With such a swine rearing assistance apparatus, it is possible to notify, in a timely fashion without requiring excessive cost or labor, rearing staff of whether or not any of the female swine being reared in the pen are showing signs of heat.
applicants: NATIONAL AGRICULTURE AND FOOD RESEARCH ORGANIZATION; NH FOODS

title: Intelligent drinking table for livestock
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of breeding equipment, and provides an intelligent drinking table for livestock. The drinking trough is arranged at one end of the limiting fence and used for containing drinking water; the temperature control device is arranged at the bottom of the water trough and used for controlling the temperature of the water trough; the weighing device is arranged at the bottom of the temperature control device and is used for weighing water in the water trough; the identity recognizer is used for recognizing livestock identity information; and the controller is electrically connected with the temperature control device, the weighing device and the identity recognizer. According to the intelligent water drinking platform for the livestock, a water drinking place is provided for the livestock through the limiting fences, and the temperature control device controls the temperature of water in the water drinking trough; when the livestock drinks water, the weight of the water drinking trough before and after the cattle drinks water is respectively weighed by the weighing device, so that the water drinking amount of the livestock is obtained; meanwhile, the identity recognizer can recognize the identity information of the livestock, so that the water intake of a certain livestock is recorded; the normal water intake of the livestock is further monitored.
applicants: AGRICULTURAL INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Automatic pasture feed feeding system based on block chain technology
abstract: The invention discloses a pasture feed automatic feeding system based on a block chain technology, and relates to the technical field of livestock breeding, the pasture feed automatic feeding system comprises a camera, a central processing unit and a feeding box, the output end of the camera is electrically connected with the central processing unit, and the output end of the central processing unit is electrically connected with a type identification module; and the input end of the type identification module is electrically connected with a recording module. After feed enters the feeding box, the time recording module starts timing, the storage time of the feed in the feeding box is calculated, and in addition, the time recording module can judge the storable time of the feed according to the internal temperature, measured by the temperature statistics module, of the feeding box; and if the storage time of the feed in the feeding box is too long and exceeds the storable shelf life, the discharge module works to discharge the expired feed from the feeding box, so that the influence on growth and development caused by the use of the expired feed by animals can be avoided, and the safety of animal breeding can be improved.

title: DISEASE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR CALVES
abstract: The present invention relates to a disease management system and method for calves. More specifically, calf biometric information is obtained by injecting the information into the rumen of a newborn calf. By analyzing this, diseases which occur in the early stages can be quickly detected and informed to managers, thereby significantly lowering the mortality rate of calves. The disease management system and method for calves can quickly predict and analyze diseases which commonly occur in calves to determine their health or abnormal condition, so as to manage calves individually.

title: Livestock and poultry farm inspection method and livestock and poultry farm robot
abstract: The invention provides a livestock and poultry farm inspection method and a livestock and poultry farm robot. The livestock and poultry farm inspection method comprises the following steps: simultaneously acquiring a visible light image and an infrared thermal imaging image containing an inspection target at a current inspection point position through a dual-light camera; carrying out image fusion on the collected visible light image and the infrared thermal imaging image to obtain a fused image on the current inspection point position; judging whether the current inspection target is a livestock target or not according to the visible light image information features in the fused image, and judging whether the temperature of the current inspection target is lower than a set temperature threshold or not according to the heat source information features in the fused image; and if the current inspection target is the livestock and poultry target and the temperature of the current inspection target is lower than a set temperature threshold value, judging the current inspection target as a suspected dead livestock and poultry target, and recording corresponding position information. According to the method, the fused image of the heat source feature information and the visible light information is obtained through image fusion, the survival state of the livestock is judged by removing non-livestock targets and setting the temperature threshold value, and the judgment accuracy is high.
applicants: YITAI RORE PHOTOELECTRIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY LIMITED COMPANY

title: Method and system for judging comfort level of livestock and poultry house
abstract: The invention provides a livestock and poultry house comfort level judgment method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an acoustic characteristic parameter measurement index based on the audio data of a target livestock and poultry house; performing data processing and analysis on the acoustic characteristic parameter measurement index to obtain an acoustic characteristic parameter statistical index; performing principal component analysis on the acoustic characteristic parameter measurement index and the acoustic characteristic parameter statistical index, and determining a livestock and poultry house comfort level judgment score equation; and based on the livestock and poultry house comfort level judgment score equation, obtaining a livestock and poultry house comfort level judgment result. By collecting the target livestock and poultry sound data of the livestock and poultry house, extracting the acoustic features from the target livestock and poultry sound data and comprehensively analyzing to obtain the judgment result of the comfort degree of the livestock and poultry house, the method has the characteristics of convenience in test, no need of contact with livestock and poultry and low cost.
applicants: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH CENTER OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY ACADEMY OF SCIENCES IN

title: Intelligent ecological breeding system based on 5G communication technology
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent ecological breeding system based on the 5G communication technology, and the early warning system comprises a breeding hidden danger evaluation module, a plague occurrence risk control module, a treatment scheme implementation module, a patient feature risk reminding module and a central decision module. The plague occurrence risk control module is used for monitoring sick livestock in different breeding areas in real time and judging whether serious disasters such as plague are caused or not, and the treatment scheme implementation module is used for determining the position where the livestock is located through an unmanned aerial vehicle and conducting isolated treatment. The patient feature risk reminding module is used for sending early warning information in time when the patient livestock exceeds the highest early warning value, information in the patient feature risk reminding module is sent to the central decision module in time, and the central decision module is connected with the breeding hidden danger evaluation module.

title: Method for cow behavior detection and electronic necklace
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic necklace for cow behavior detection, and particularly relates to the field of cow breeding, the electronic necklace comprises an adjusting belt and a locking buckle, the adjusting belt is connected with the locking buckle, a main control circuit module is bound on the adjusting belt, a microprocessor, a vibration sensor and a power supply are arranged in the main control circuit module, and the microprocessor is connected with the locking buckle. And the microprocessor and the vibration sensor are electrically connected with the power supply, so that the individual identity, daily behavior and disease of the cattle can be continuously identified and monitored for a long time in a large-scale farm. Motion data is transmitted to a cloud platform server through a wireless transmission technology, and the data is processed and classified by using a deep learning algorithm, so that the lying, standing, walking and chasing behaviors of the dairy cow are identified. According to the design, the individual related information of the cattle can be accurately obtained, manual intervention is greatly reduced, the intelligent informatization level of the pasture is improved, and the economic benefits of pasture breeding production are increased.

title: Electronic necklace for oestrus detection of small-tailed han sheep
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic necklace for oestrus detection of small-tailed han sheep, and relates to the technical field of livestock breeding, the electronic necklace comprises a necklace belt and a main body, a temperature sensor, an acceleration sensor, a battery and a microprocessor are mounted in the main body, two ends of the necklace belt are mutually buckled through a buckle structure, and a buckle structure shaped like a Chinese character'ri 'is arranged at one end of the necklace belt. The necklace is more convenient to wear due to the inserting buckle structure, the necklace belt body is made of the nylon braid, one side of the necklace belt is of the buckle structure shaped like the Chinese character'ri ', and the size of the necklace can be rapidly adjusted. According to the behavior characteristics of restlessness, frequent walking, fence observation and the like of maternal small-tailed han sheep, oestrus detection is performed by utilizing a sensor, digital signal processing and artificial intelligence technologies, and meanwhile, the problem of relatively low oestrus detection efficiency in a large-scale small-tailed han sheep farm is solved; therefore, precise management in the small-tailed han sheep breeding process is achieved, and the labor cost is reduced.

title: CHARACTERIZATION OF PASTURE FOR IMPROVED AND SUSTAINABLE GRAZING AND FEEDING MANAGEMENT OF LIVESTOCK
abstract: A method comprising: digitally processing a plurality of aerial images of a terrain, each aerial image of the plurality showing a portion of the terrain; digitally partitioning the portion of the terrain into a plurality of paddocks; digitally processing animal data, the animal data at least comprising: geolocation data of at least one animal of a herd obtained at least during grazing of the at least one animal somewhere on the portion of the terrain, identification of an animal type of each animal of the herd at least during grazing of the at least one animal, and a number of animals in the herd at least during grazing of the at least one animal; and digitally estimating, based on both the digital processing of the aerial images and the animal data, quantity and, optionally, quality of the pasture in each paddock of the plurality of paddocks.

title: Special raising house for epidemic prevention of animal husbandry and veterinary medicine and monitoring system thereof
abstract: The invention provides a breeding house special for epidemic prevention of animal husbandry and veterinary. The raising house special for epidemic prevention of the animal husbandry and veterinary medicine comprises a raising box, an observation opening and a sewage draining grid are arranged on the raising box, and a limiting sliding groove is formed in the raising box; the exhaust assembly is installed on one side of the feeding box, and the observation opening is formed in the other side of the feeding box. According to the raising house special for animal husbandry and veterinary epidemic prevention, the turning cover plate is limited by the connecting plate and the limiting sliding shaft after being closed, the turning cover plate can be kept in a stable closed state, the phenomenon that the turning cover plate is opened due to shaking of livestock in the raising box is reduced, and the stability of livestock isolation is enhanced; through the movable plate, the interior of the feeding box can be cleaned and maintained conveniently, meanwhile, a rotatable mounting structure facilitates overall movement and adjustment of the connecting plate, and stable and reliable support is provided for normal opening of the overturning cover plate.

title: Dairy cow mastitis automatic detection method and system, storage medium and equipment
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic detection method and system for cow mastitis, a storage medium and equipment, and the method comprises the steps: collecting depth images and infrared thermal images of two sides of a cow, and collecting the individual identity recognition information of the cow; on the depth image and the infrared thermal image obtained for each cow, identifying the eye areas on the two sides and the front and back milk areas of the cow; whether the dairy cow suffers from mastitis or not is judged and detected according to the temperature characteristics of the eye area and the milk area of the dairy cow. The cow milking detection system has the advantages of being convenient and rapid in detection, non-contact and free of stress on cows, can replace part of manual detection links, and effectively reduces milking labor cost. The method can be widely applied to the field of agricultural livestock automation.

title: Sow delivery intelligent monitoring system based on cloud-side cooperation
abstract: The invention discloses a sow delivery intelligent monitoring system based on cloud-side cooperation. The system comprises a data acquisition module; a data preprocessing module; the sow delivery monitoring module is used for monitoring sow postures and piglet targets on the basis of a lightweight target detection model; the model optimization and deployment module is used for quantifying the trained model to achieve the purposes of reducing the calculation amount and reducing the power consumption of equipment, and deploying the accelerated model to Jetson Nano embedded equipment; and the data storage and visualization module is used for calculating the sow posture conversion frequency and the number of piglets at the edge end, transmitting text information into a cloud server for storage, and performing visual management on the sow delivery behaviors in the perinatal period and the lactation period in a PC end/mobile terminal form. A low-cost system which is easy to install and convenient to operate is formed, the system can serve most breeding personnel, and the management efficiency is improved.

title: Live pig breeding epidemic disease monitoring equipment
abstract: The invention discloses pig breeding epidemic disease monitoring equipment which comprises a supporting frame and a monitoring plate, a first motor and a lead screw are arranged in the supporting frame, the output end of the first motor is connected with one end of the lead screw, meanwhile, a sliding block is connected to the lead screw, a liquid storage box is arranged at the top of the sliding block, and a monitoring box is connected to the bottom of the sliding block; and a second motor and a rotating shaft are arranged in the monitoring box. The pig breeding epidemic disease monitoring equipment is provided with a second motor, the second motor can drive a gear to rotate, and the rotating gear drives a monitoring plate to move, so that an infrared body temperature detector at the bottom of the monitoring plate can move to detect the temperatures of different pigs, and meanwhile, a buzzer and a warning lamp are arranged, so that the temperature of the different pigs is monitored. When the infrared body temperature detector detects that the body temperature of the live pig is abnormal, detected information is transmitted to the controller, and the controller gives an early warning to a breeder through the buzzer and the warning lamp, so that the intelligent level of the device is conveniently improved, and the device meets the requirement for breeding epidemic disease monitoring in the current society.

title: Ad hoc network ear tag and livestock checking method and system
abstract: The invention relates to an ad hoc network ear tag which comprises an ear tag seat, an ear tag neck and an ear tag head, the ear tag seat is perpendicular to the ear tag neck, and the ear tag head is connected with the ear tag neck; a circular through hole is formed in the center of the circular fixing seat, so that the ear tag head is inserted into the circular through hole, and the Ad-Hoc network ear tag is fixed to the ear of the livestock; a built-in ad hoc network module is used for establishing network connection with a gateway and sending broadcast signals to the gateway every preset time based on the network connection, so that the gateway can receive the broadcast signals and upload the broadcast signals to a cloud platform; workers can check the number of livestock through the cloud platform, and the working efficiency of the workers is improved.
applicants: BEIJING ZHONGJIANG COLD SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY LIMITED COMPANY

title: Farm animal supervision system and farm animal positioning method
abstract: One or more embodiments of the invention provide a farm animal supervision system and a farm animal positioning method. The livestock farm animal supervision system comprises wearable equipment and a gateway which are located on a terminal side, and a cloud platform located on a cloud side, the wearable equipment can be worn on livestock farm animals, the wearable equipment is used for collecting animal data, and the wearable equipment uploads the animal data to the cloud platform through the gateway. And the cloud platform monitors and/or judges the state of the animal based on the uploaded data. Therefore, the state of the animal can be accurately monitored.

title: INTELLIGENT PIGLET PROTECTION DEVICE
abstract: An intelligent piglet protection device (100), comprising a sound recognition device (10) and a driving device (20). The sound recognition device (10) is used for monitoring a sound in a piggery (200), and sending a driving signal according to a monitored target audio. The driving device (20) is communicatively connected to the sound recognition device (10) and receives the driving signal, and is movably mounted on the piggery (200); after receiving the driving signal, the driving device (20) is in a driving state, and drives a sow, and after the driving device (20) drives the sow away, the driving device (20) is switched to an initial state. The intelligent piglet protection device (100) can drive sows in time when piglets are pressed by the sows, and provide time for the escape of the piglets.

title: Animal marking and management system
abstract: The invention provides an animal marking and management system which comprises a marking module and a management module, the marking module comprises an ear tag and a marking clamp, the management module comprises a detection device and a server, the ear tag is provided with a plurality of anti-counterfeiting marks and is internally provided with a radio frequency chip for storing animal information, and the radio frequency chip is provided with a radio frequency chip for storing the animal information. The marking clamp automatically reads animal information of the radio frequency chip and automatically uploads the animal information to the server while achieving marking, the detection device can grasp the directions of animals and ear tags in real time through the ear tag reader, and finally a user monitors the animal information and the ear tag information through the server. And an omnibearing closed-loop traceable marking and animal management system is realized.
applicants: SHANGHAI GREENNESS INFORMATION SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY STOCK LIMITED COMPANY

title: Livestock breeding intelligent monitoring method based on edge calculation
abstract: The invention provides a livestock breeding intelligent monitoring method based on edge calculation, and the method comprises the steps: collecting and analyzing images of an area where a breeding shed is located and an area where an outdoor pasture is located, and obtaining first animal activity state information and shed equipment operation state information of the area where the breeding shed is located; according to the first animal activity state information and the second animal activity state information of the area where the outdoor pasture is located, the working state of the shed equipment is adjusted, whether the animal escape situation exists in the outdoor pasture or not is judged, and when it is determined that the animal escape situation exists, an alarm notification instruction is sent through the edge computing platform terminal. According to the system, the shed and the outdoor pasture are independently monitored in a camera shooting mode, feed supply and ventilation in the breeding process are automatically adjusted, animals can be effectively prevented from escaping, and therefore the management efficiency of livestock breeding is improved, and normal growth of the animals is guaranteed.

title: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD AND PROGRAM
abstract: To enable the individual identification of an animal related to a picked-up image on the basis of the picked-up image of the animal in a specific area.SOLUTION: An animal appearance determination device 100 includes an image data analysis part 112 for acquiring a picked-up image including a cow raised in a cow stall, and acquiring the position of the cow in the cow stall calculated on the basis of the image of the cow in the picked-up image, as first position information, a position data analysis part 114 for acquiring identification information from a sensor device 200 attached to the cow and second position information showing the position of the cow in the cow stall, and an individual identification part 115 for associating the first position information with the identification information related to the first second information for recording in the case of determining that difference between the first position information and the second position information is equal to or less than a prescribed threshold.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: DATA COLLECTION DEVICE, PROGRAM, AND DATA COLLECTION METHOD
abstract: To provide a data collection device capable of efficiently collecting data useful for specifying an activity state of an animal, a program, and a data collection method.SOLUTION: A data collection device 1 includes: a data acquisition unit 11 that acquires positional information continuously indicating an activity amount of a cow C; a specifying unit 13 that analyzes the positional information for a predetermined period and specifies a tendency related to a time change of the activity amount; and a data acquisition amount adjustment unit 14 that adjusts an acquisition amount of the positional information on the basis of the specified tendency related to the time change of the activity amount. The data acquisition unit 11 acquires positional information according to an acquisition amount adjusted by the data acquisition amount adjustment unit 14.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Pig raising metabolism cage for batch raising
abstract: The invention provides a pig raising metabolism cage for batch feeding. The problem that an existing metabolism cage is inconvenient to use in batch experiments is solved. When the device is used, the space above the bottom plate is uniformly divided into a plurality of feeding stations through the transverse rods and the vertical plates which are arranged above the bottom plate, a plurality of experimental objects can be respectively placed in the feeding stations in a directional manner, and batch feeding can be conveniently realized; the movable plate is arranged on the bottom plate, excrement generated by the experiment object is collected through the excrement collecting disc arranged below the bottom plate, use is convenient, when the weight of the experiment object needs to be measured, the feeding station is moved to the movable plate by moving the positions of the transverse plate and the vertical plate, and then weighing can be conducted through the electronic scale located below the movable plate; and the detection is relatively convenient.
applicants: JINHUA AGRICULTURAL SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE (ZHEJIANG AGRICULTURAL MACHINERY RESEARCH INSTITUTE)

title: Farm feed monitoring method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a livestock farm feed monitoring method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the field of livestock breeding, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining feed trough image information corresponding to a feed trough, carrying out the target tracking of animals in a fence when it is detected that the feed exists in the feed trough, judging whether the animals start to eat or not, and if yes, carrying out the target tracking; if the animals start to eat, determining the eating starting time and the eating stopping time of the animals starting to eat, determining the eating duration of the animals starting to eat based on the eating starting time and the eating stopping time, and outputting the eating duration of the animals starting to eat. The animal feeding device has the effect that a worker can conveniently know the feeding time of animals.

title: Precise and efficient breeding internet-of-things system and method for pig farm
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of breeding, and discloses a precise and efficient breeding Internet of Things system of a pig farm, which comprises a server and an environment monitoring unit in communication connection with the server, the server is also in communication connection with external feed management software, the system is characterized in that the pig farm is divided into a plurality of pig houses, a trough is arranged in each pig house, and the trough is communicated with the environment monitoring unit. A weighing machine is arranged on one side of the trough, a camera right facing the weighing machine is arranged above the trough, and a bioelectricity detection unit is arranged on more than three pigs in each pigsty of the pigsty; the weighing machine, the camera and the bioelectricity detection unit are respectively in communication connection with the server. According to the system, the body fat, the body weight and the body length of the pig can be measured, a breeding relevance table can be obtained by associating the body fat, the body weight and the body length of the pig with environment data and feed data, and a reliable reference basis is provided for follow-up dynamic adjustment of the environment and feed. Meanwhile, the invention further discloses a breeding method based on the system.
applicants: SHAOGUAN ZHENGBANG ANIMAL HUSBANDRY DEVELOPMENT COMPANY; ANIMAL SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE, GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: Sow optimal mating time detection device and detection method
abstract: The invention provides a device for detecting the optimal mating time of sows. The device comprises an elastic clamping device, a heatable leather lining, a tightening device, an equipment shell, a motion sensor and a temperature measuring unit, wherein the elastic clamping device and the heatable leather lining are used for simulating the boar to climb and lean against; the tightening device is used for controlling the elastic clamping device to tighten; the equipment shell is used for mounting and protecting other parts; the result indicating unit is used for indicating the optimal mating time of the sows, the wireless communication module is used for wireless communication, and the main controller is used for achieving the functions of control, calculation, judgment and the like. The invention further discloses a method for detecting the optimal breeding time of the sow, the method is carried out by means of the detection device, the optimal breeding time of the sow can be accurately detected at the earliest, the labor cost of oestrus detection is reduced, the detection efficiency is improved, and it is guaranteed that multiple times of breeding is completed within the optimal breeding duration of the sow; and the sow feed is convenient to use and high in practicability.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA HUIYUN TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Prediction method and device for maintaining net energy demand amount and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention provides a prediction method and device for maintaining net energy demand amount and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring heart rate data of a target live pig; on the basis of the heart rate data and a pre-trained net energy demand prediction model, obtaining the net energy maintenance demand amount of the target live pig; wherein the net energy demand prediction model is a neural network model obtained based on productivity parameter training. According to the method, the processing thought of prediction based on the heart rate data of the live pigs is effectively introduced in the prediction process of the net energy maintenance demand amount of the live pigs, the overall prediction process is simplified and optimized, the net energy maintenance demand amount of the live pigs can be conveniently and rapidly predicted in real time, and the replicability and applicability of the prediction method are improved.

title: Dairy cow oestrus prediction device based on body temperature and exercise amount data
abstract: The invention discloses a dairy cow oestrus prediction device based on body temperature and exercise amount data. The device is used for solving the problems that the oestrus detection rate is not high due to the fact that traditional dairy cow oestrus prediction depends on experiences of observers, and recessive oestrus dairy cows are difficult to identify when oestrus is predicted by adopting an accelerometer step counting method. The method comprises the steps that firstly, an accelerometer and a temperature measurement module achieve parameter collection to generate a data set, a worker conducts oestrus identification through a rectum inspection method to obtain a label value, then data preprocessing is conducted on original data through a sliding window, and feature vectors are extracted; and inputting the feature vector into a supervised learning model to predict whether the oestrus occurs or not, wherein the prediction model comprises but is not limited to K nearest neighbor, a support vector machine, a decision tree, a random forest and a learning vector quantization LVQ model.

title: Animal husbandry system
abstract: The present invention relates to an animal husbandry system with monitoring and analyzing means configured for repeatedly generating images and gathering animal data therefrom. A plurality of cameras is suitable for monitoring the area from above. Image processing means are suitable for matching animals in the field of view of multiple cameras by detecting animal silhouettes in images of different cameras; defining an animal bounding box around each animal silhouette, applying to each animal bounding box either a first projection onto an image stitching plane if the animal is standing, or a second projection if the animal is lying down, stitching the projected bounding boxes in the stitching plane and identifying identical animals in the stitched image. The reliability of the matching process is increased by taking into account whether the animal in question is standing or lying down. The quality of the data gathered in the system is improved.

title: Livestock weight identification method and device, storage medium and terminal equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a livestock weight identification method and device, a storage medium and terminal equipment, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a first image which comprises a to-be-measured target and a reference object bound with the to-be-measured target; based on the position coordinates of the reference object in the first image, determining the scaling ratio of the to-be-measured target relative to the preset size; adjusting the size of the first image according to the scaling to obtain a second image; and inputting the second image into a body weight recognition model for body weight recognition operation to obtain body weight data of the to-be-measured target in the second image. According to the embodiment of the invention, the scaling of the reference object is calculated, the first image is scaled according to the obtained scaling, the second image with the unified standard scale is obtained, and then the pre-trained body weight recognition model is used for body weight parameter recognition of the second image, so that workers can be prevented from frequently and directly contacting with livestock, and the working efficiency is improved. The body weight parameter acquisition process is simple and high in precision.
applicants: SHENZHEN ZHONGRONG DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Livestock state monitoring method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock state monitoring method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and the method comprises the steps: detecting whether first historical data is recorded in a first historical time interval in a time sequence list of target livestock, and the time sequence list is used for recording physical sign data transmitted by a detection device carried by the target livestock; if yes, processing the first historical data according to a preset state recognition model to obtain a state detection result of the target livestock; and when the state detection result indicates that the target livestock is in the out-of-fence state, outputting prompt information of out-of-fence of the target livestock. By processing the first historical data recorded in the first historical time interval, the state detection result of the target livestock is obtained, and when the state detection result indicates that the target livestock is in the off-fence state, the prompt information can be output in time to remind a user, so that the safety of the target livestock is guaranteed.
applicants: SHENZHEN ZHONGRONG DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Livestock survival and death state judgment method and device, storage medium and terminal equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a livestock survival and death state judgment method and device, a storage medium and terminal equipment. The method comprises the steps that multiple pieces of text data of a to-be-detected target in a preset time period are acquired; state discrimination operation is carried out on the multiple pieces of target data through a pre-trained state discrimination model, and the survival and death state of the to-be-detected target is obtained; and judging whether to send out reminding information or not according to the survival state. According to the embodiment of the invention, the timeliness and accuracy of livestock survival and death state supervision can be improved while the labor cost is reduced.
applicants: SHENZHEN ZHONGRONG DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Cattle state detection method, device and system
abstract: The invention provides a breeding cattle state detection method, device and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the individual state information of a cattle based on multi-source data; obtaining individual behavior information based on the individual state information; and inputting the sample set into a state detection model to obtain state detection results of all cattle. According to the cattle state detection method, device and system provided by the invention, the individual behavior information is generated on the basis of collection and quantification of multi-source data, the core features of the individual behavior information are extracted, the extracted individual behavior information of various cattle is taken as the sample set, and the state detection model performs state detection on cattle individual activities. Various habitual data of the cattle are fused for comprehensive analysis, the accuracy of cattle anomaly detection can be improved, and misjudgment caused by monitoring of single habitual data is avoided.
applicants: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH CENTER, BEIJING ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY SCIENCES

title: AI Livestock shed management system through AI analysis
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock management system through AI analysis, which comprises: a bio-information unit for checking bio-information on each livestock subject; an image unit for photographing an image of a livestock shed; and a control unit for receiving signals from the image unit and each bio-information unit to detect a specific behavior through AI analysis. According to the present invention, when bio-information on a livestock subject is checked in real time, and a preset specific behavior is detected, a corresponding image is stored, and an actual specific behavior acted by a corresponding subject can be checked through a terminal connected through a short-range communication or long-range communication by an alarm, such that reliability and management efficiency can be improved.

title: Ear tag state detection method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an ear tag state detection method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining different types of state data, collected in different time intervals, of an ear tag, recognizing the numerical range corresponding to the different types of state data collected in different time intervals, and obtaining the state data of the ear tag; and determining the current state of the ear tag according to the numerical range corresponding to the different types of state data collected in different time intervals. According to the scheme, the ear tag state can be accurately detected, and the situation that a breeder mistakenly judges the health condition of livestock due to inaccurate ear tag state detection is reduced.
applicants: SHENZHEN ZHONGRONG DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Livestock state monitoring method and device, terminal and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock state monitoring method and device, a terminal and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-dimensional monitoring data for a target livestock in a preset collection time period before a current moment, and the collection time of each piece of multi-dimensional monitoring data, the multi-dimensional monitoring data comprising monitoring data under at least two livestock monitoring dimensions; determining monitoring time sequence data based on the acquisition time of each piece of multi-dimensional monitoring data, wherein the multi-dimensional monitoring data in the monitoring time sequence data are arranged according to the sequence of the acquisition time; the livestock death probability is predicted based on the livestock monitoring time sequence data through the trained livestock death judgment model, the death probability of the target livestock is obtained, and the livestock death judgment model is obtained through training according to the monitoring time sequence data sample of the livestock sample; and when the death probability of the target livestock is greater than a preset death probability threshold, determining that the target livestock is in a death state. The scheme can quickly judge whether the livestock is dead or not, and is low in cost and harmless to the livestock.
applicants: SHENZHEN ZHONGRONG DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Livestock health state detection method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock health status method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring time sequence state data of to-be-detected livestock and time sequence environment state data of an environment where the to-be-detected livestock is located; fusing the time sequence state data and the time sequence environment state data to obtain fused data; performing feature coding on the fused data to obtain a current coding feature; and determining the health state of the to-be-detected livestock according to the current coding feature. The detection accuracy of the health state of the livestock can be improved.
applicants: SHENZHEN ZHONGRONG DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Intelligent detection method and system for mycoplasma synoviae infection
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent detection method and system for mycoplasma synoviae infection. The intelligent detection method and system are used for reducing harm of mycoplasma synoviae infection to the poultry industry. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a chicken circle video, wherein the chicken circle video is a video shot by a camera in a chicken circle range; determining a motion trail of at least one chicken according to the chicken circle video and determining a motion trail distance corresponding to the motion trail; determining a target track distance lower than a first preset distance in the motion track distance, and determining a target chicken corresponding to the target track distance; determining the unit advancing distance of the target chicken according to the chicken circle video; and if it is determined that the unit advancing distance is smaller than a second preset distance, generating a mycoplasma synoviae infection early warning notification of the target chicken, and sending the mycoplasma synoviae infection early warning notification to a control room.
applicants: GUANGXI HONGTING INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Cattle heat stress monitoring system and monitoring method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a cattle heat stress monitoring system, monitoring method and monitoring equipment, and belongs to the technical field of cattle breeding. A body temperature sensing unit arranged on a cattle body is used for collecting cattle body temperature information, a pulse sensing unit is used for collecting cattle pulse information, and a respiration sensing unit is used for collecting cattle respiration frequency information; the positioning sensing unit is used for collecting cattle position information and then comparing the information collected on a cattle body with the information, collected by the environment quantity sensing unit, of the cattle house environment, real-time online continuous monitoring is achieved, and the cattle stress response condition is comprehensively evaluated through the cattle house environment and cattle physiological state data. Monitoring personnel can correspondingly adjust cattle house environment control or timely heatstroke treatment strategies for cattle according to monitoring results, real-time monitoring and early warning of cattle stress response are guaranteed, and the problem that in the prior art, after cattle have heat stress, an alarm cannot be given out in time, and huge economic damage is brought to breeding enterprises is solved.
applicants: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION INSTITUTE OF ANIMAL HUSBANDRY

title: Cow whole-cycle health detection system based on visual identification
abstract: The invention provides a dairy cow whole-period health detection system based on visual identification, and the system comprises an electronic chip which is provided with a dairy cow ID and is fixed on a dairy cow body; the on-line acquisition device is used for acquiring a to-be-detected dairy cow image and identifying a dairy cow ID on line, and transmitting the acquired to-be-detected dairy cow image and the dairy cow ID to the main control module; the main control module is provided with an image recognition algorithm and a health judgment algorithm, the image recognition algorithm obtains the measured growth cycle and weight of the dairy cow according to the received image of the dairy cow to be measured, and the health judgment algorithm calls the corresponding complete-cycle growth information of the dairy cow in the storage module according to the ID of the dairy cow to judge the health state of the dairy cow. The whole-cycle growth information of the dairy cows is updated; and the storage module is used for storing the complete-cycle growth information of the dairy cows corresponding to all the dairy cow IDs and the complete-cycle growth standard information of the dairy cows. According to the method, manual work can be replaced by a visual identification method, and the growth health condition of the dairy cow can be rapidly and accurately judged.

title: Milk-producing animal teat treatment device and treatment method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a milk-producing animal teat processing device and a processing method thereof.The milk-producing animal teat processing device comprises an automatic opening and closing cage body, a mechanical arm is arranged on one side of the cage body, the end, stretching into the cage body, of the mechanical arm is connected with and drives a processing mechanism, and the mechanical arm is further connected with an image recognition module used for monitoring individual animal teats; remote wireless card reading is adopted, ear tag information of the individual animal is read and updated, the spatial position of the individual animal entering the cage body is monitored and recorded through the camera modules arranged at the two ends of the cage body, and adjustment of the mechanical arm is guided through the spatial position of the individual animal. The image recognition module accurately recognizes the spatial position of the animal teat for marking, meanwhile, the mechanical arm adjusts the processing mechanism according to the spatial position, recognized by the image recognition module, of the animal teat, the processing mechanism conducts cleaning, milk sucking and medicated bath on the animal teat, and the animal teat is automatically processed, recorded and recognized. And milk-producing animals can be managed more conveniently.
applicants: NANJING LIRUN INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Electronic monitoring device for sheep shed and monitoring method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an electronic monitoring device for a sheep shed and a monitoring method thereof, relates to the technical field of electronic monitoring for sheep sheds, and aims to solve the problems that due to the fact that an existing electronic monitoring device for a sheep shed cannot dispel mosquitoes, too many mosquitoes exist in the sheep shed, the health of sheep flocks is affected, the mosquitoes can shield the monitoring view angle, and the monitoring effect is reduced. Comprising a rotary table, a structural connecting rod is arranged at one end of the rotary table, a monitoring fixing frame is arranged at one end of the structural connecting rod, an electronic monitor is arranged below the monitoring fixing frame, a rotary adjusting motor is arranged at the upper end of the rotary table, and a fixing base and a solar panel are arranged at the upper end of the rotary adjusting motor. And the mosquito repelling device is arranged above the structural connecting rod, a mosquito repelling liquid connector is arranged at the lower end of the structural connecting rod, a mosquito repelling liquid tank is arranged below the mosquito repelling liquid connector, and mosquito repelling liquid atomizing openings are formed in the front end and the rear end of the structural connecting rod.
applicants: ANHUI LONGZHAN ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY

title: Livestock body temperature monitoring method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a livestock body temperature monitoring method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining a thermal image of a to-be-monitored livestock; target detection is carried out on the thermal image, a part area of a to-be-monitored part of the to-be-monitored livestock in the thermal image is obtained, and the to-be-monitored part comprises an ear part and/or a head part; and monitoring the body temperature of the to-be-monitored livestock based on the temperature data of the part area in the thermal image. According to the livestock body temperature monitoring method and device, the electronic equipment and the storage medium provided by the embodiment of the invention, compared with a mode of adopting a mercury thermometer in the prior art, the health of livestock and workers is better facilitated, meanwhile, the labor cost is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved; compared with an infrared temperature measuring gun, the temperature measuring gun has the advantages that the randomness of manually selecting temperature measuring points is overcome, the temperature data of the ears or the head closest to the temperature of the rectum is monitored, and the body temperature monitoring is more comprehensive and accurate.
applicants: HENAN IFLYTEK INTELLIGENT SYSTEM CO., LTD.

title: Sow oestrus management method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sow management. In order to solve the problem that in the prior art, a body surface temperature measurement mode is adopted to identify whether sows are in oestrus or not, so that the accuracy of an identification result is low, the sow oestrus management method comprises the following steps that S1, the body surface temperature and the night exercise amount are monitored, and the basic body temperature and the basic night exercise amount are obtained according to the body surface temperature and the night exercise amount; s2, starting from the predicted estrus day, according to the monitored body surface temperature and the night exercise amount, the periodic average body temperature and the periodic night exercise amount are obtained; s3, judging whether the body temperature continuously rises and a decline inflection point appears or not, and whether the amount of exercise at night rises or not; and S4, when it is judged that the body surface temperature continuously rises, a declining inflection point appears, and meanwhile, the night exercise amount rises, whether the current period is in a predicted estrus period or not is judged, if yes, estrus early warning is sent, and if not, manual intervention early warning is sent.
applicants: CHONGQING 69 ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; CHONGQING ACADEMY OF ANIMAL SCIENCES

title: Sow oestrus intelligent management system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sow management. In order to solve the problem that an existing intelligent oestrus monitoring system is not high in accuracy of a judgment result, the invention provides an intelligent management system for sow oestrus. The system comprises a monitoring module used for monitoring the body surface temperature and the night exercise amount of a target sow; the storage module is used for storing data and pre-storing basic data of a target sow; the control module is used for controlling the monitoring module to monitor from the day of weaning; the processing module is used for obtaining the body surface temperature and the night exercise amount and processing the body surface temperature and the night exercise amount to obtain the basic body temperature, the basic night exercise amount, the periodic average body temperature and the periodic night exercise amount; the judgment module is used for judging whether the body surface temperature continuously rises and a declining inflection point appears or not and whether the night exercise amount rises or not; when it is judged that the body surface temperature has a decreasing inflection point and the amount of exercise at night rises, whether the current period is within the predicted estrus or not is judged; and the early warning module is used for sending an oestrus early warning or a manual intervention early warning.
applicants: CHONGQING 69 ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; CHONGQING ACADEMY OF ANIMAL SCIENCES

title: Liquid feeding system for individualized breeding
abstract: The present invention relates to a liquid feeding system for individual customized growth and development that adjusts nutrients and mixing ratios at a farm site according to a characteristic of each pig pen, individual, and breeding environment, enables feed to be mixed, and provides optimal feeding amount through monitoring of an environment variable and an individual variable. The liquid feeding system comprises: a feeding management part; an information management part; an information processing part; and a feeding control part.

title: Big data-based feeding recommendation and provision system
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for recommending and providing feeding based on big data that adjusts nutrients and mixing ratios at a farm site according to a characteristic of each pig pen, individual, and breeding environment, enables feed to be mixed and provided, and derives and provides an optimal feeding condition by collecting and analyzing detailed feed and nutrition conditions for each pig pen. The system comprises: a feeding management part; an information management part; an information processing part; and a feeding control part.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR MONITORING AND MEASURING THE BEHAVIOUR OF A PLURALITY OF ANIMALS
abstract: Monitoring of animals in a herd has various challenges. A method and a system for monitoring and measuring the behavior of a plurality of animals in a herd chamber is provided. The disclosure provides a method to develop a model to identify the animal interactions between a given set of herds of two or more animals. The system uses image, RFID sensors, animal phenotyping information such as species, breed, age and reproduction cycle information to generate an animal profile. This profile is used to quantify the interaction into an aggression score to the animals in the given herd. The aggression score over a given duration can help herd manager to put the animals with similar aggression score together. This will also help analyze the temporal aspects of the aggression score for a given animal and take preventive measures.

title: Ewe house environment regulation and control system based on ewe estrus behavior recognition
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of efficient breeding of ewes, in particular to an ewe house environment regulation and control system by combining ewe estrus behavior recognition results with sensor data. The system comprises a behavior recognition system, an environment regulation and control system and a network monitoring system. The behavior recognition system comprises a database module and a model selection module. The database module is mainly used for storing related data required by training of a convolutional neural network model and ewe oestrus behavior recognition results; the model selection module comprises a convolutional neural network model used for ewe oestrus behavior recognition. The environment regulation and control system mainly takes instruction regulation and control of the behavior recognition system as a main part and takes detection regulation and control of sensors around the ewe house as an auxiliary part. The environment regulation and control system comprises a temperature and humidity control module, an air circulation control module, an illumination control module, a sensor module and a data acquisition module. By adopting the method, the environment quality of the ewe house can be improved, estrus behavior information of the ewes can be mastered, and a method for improving the fertility of the ewes is provided.

title: Livestock weighing apparatus and method
abstract: A livestock weight measuring device and a method thereof are disclosed. According to the present invention, the livestock weight measuring device comprises: a frame part including a frame forming a certain width; a drinking fountain or feeder to attract livestock into the interior of the frame part; a tracking part which identifies and tracks the movement of livestock from camera footage; and a weight measurement part which measures the weight of livestock entering the frame part.

title: Body temperature detection equipment for parallel milking parlour
abstract: The body temperature detection equipment is structurally provided with a side column door, a base, a working machine and an infrared sensor, a movable cavity provides a movable area for rolling of magnetic balls, when the magnetic balls roll, a shaft wheel is pushed to slide, a swinging and folding block is driven to swing and fold, and the magnetic field force between the two magnetic balls can detect the body temperature of the milking parlour. The flapping blocks oppositely arranged are made to reversely flap, gas in the cavity grooves can be disturbed conveniently, the magnetic balls are made to roll in a reciprocating mode through elastic cooperation of the elastic blocks, then the flapping blocks are made to continuously perform flapping operation and accelerate to drive gas to flow, the gas on the outer side of the plate frame can be brought into the cavity grooves through the through opening structure of the plate frame, then gas exchange is generated, and the gas flow speed is increased. Therefore, a good heat dissipation effect can be achieved around the sensing head, the phenomena that the outer end face of the sensing head is atomized and foreign matter is attached to the sensing head due to heating are avoided, and the detection work of the sensing head is prevented from being affected.

title: CAMERA DEVICE FOR MONITORING AND RECOGNISING ANIMALS OR PORTIONS THEREOF, AND ASSOCIATED LIFESTOCK SHED
abstract: Camera device for observing and recognising a livestock animal in a shed environment, comprising a housing with an outer surface and with a light transmitting opening, an optics for forming an image of the environment, a light-sensitive sensor provided in the housing for recording the formed image, an image processing device for processing the recorded image and recognising a portion of a shed animal therein, and a control unit. A first portion of said outer surface is lighter in colour on a side of the opening at least directly around said opening than a second portion of said outer surface which is located away from said opening and which is at least half the size of the first portion. Because of the lighter colour directly around the one or more openings for the camera, there is much less soiling by flies in comparison with known cameras with black surroundings for these one or more openings. This is important for mostly autonomously operating cameras for animal recognition.

title: Intelligent breeding system for animal husbandry
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent breeding system for animal husbandry. The intelligent breeding system mainly solves the problem that the intelligent level of existing animal husbandry breeding is low. The intelligent breeding system comprises an environment monitoring system for monitoring the environment of a breeding farm, a growth parameter monitoring system for monitoring the body health of animals bred in the breeding farm, and an adjusting system for intelligent adjustment. The adjustment system comprises a fed animal quality grade subtraction clustering classifier, a plurality of GRNN neural network environment parameter optimization models, an HRFNN recurrent neural network growth parameter prediction fusion model, a plurality of ANFIS neural network quality grade prediction models, an environment parameter inverse solution model and an environment adjustment device. According to the method, the output of the ANFIS neural network prediction model is used as the prediction value of the quality of the finished products of the bred animals according to the differentiation characteristics of the quality of the individual finished products of the bred animals in the breeding farm, and the optimal parameters of the breeding environment are obtained by using the environment parameter inverse solution model, so that the scientific and intelligent regulation of the environment in the breeding farm is realized.
applicants: SICHUAN HUANENG BAOXINGHE WATER POWER COMPANY

title: Feeding device capable of monitoring rising, lying and drinking times of pigs
abstract: The feeder comprises a main box body, a stirring box and a camera, one end of the main box body is fixedly connected with the stirring box, one end of the top of the stirring box is provided with the camera, one end of the main box body is fixedly connected with the camera through a wire, and a feeding mechanism is arranged at the top, close to one end of the main box body, of the top of the stirring box; the high-precision camera is carried on the feeding device, the water drinking frequency and the rising and lying frequency of pigs are monitored in real time, monitored data information is fed back to a background, big data are analyzed, the health state of the pigs is judged, abnormity is fed back to a farm manager for management, and the pig feeding device is high in practicability and high in practicability. A scraping plate and a water spraying structure are arranged on the inner wall of the feeding mechanism, cleaning of the feeding hopper is facilitated, a scraping structure is arranged in a discharging opening, scraping of the discharging opening is facilitated, and adhesion, feed mildewing and influence on pig health are prevented.

title: Method and device for judging heat resistance of chicken
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for judging the heat resistance of chickens. The heat resistance of the chickens can be accurately judged under the non-lethal condition. And detecting blood biochemical index levels of the chicken before and after heat stress by carrying out light heat stress treatment on the chicken, and substituting the blood biochemical index levels into the heat resistance judgment model to judge the heat resistance of the chicken.

title: Experimental animal behavior monitoring system and method
abstract: The invention discloses an experimental animal behavior monitoring system and method, and relates to the technical field of feeding, in particular to an experimental animal behavior monitoring system and method.A concentrator and an intelligent ear tag of the experimental animal behavior monitoring system and method adopt a star networking mode, and a one-master multi-slave mode is adopted for broadcasting instruction issuing and time-sharing data reporting processes; the data interaction time is shortened to the greatest extent, the bit error rate of data interaction is reduced, and meanwhile, real-time network access of a new ear tag and real-time network exit of an eliminated ear tag can be met. The concentrator is mainly used for collecting ear tag data in a broadcast area, completing data interaction, reporting the ear tag data to the upper computer and completing data interaction with the upper computer.
applicants: ZHONGKE EQUIPMENT (GUANGZHOU) BIOLOGICAL SAFETY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Overlook fish body length monitoring method and device used in farm
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of breeding monitoring, and provides a method and a device for monitoring the length of an overlook fish body in a farm, and the device comprises a vision measurement module, a network cable, a network switch and a PC (Personal Computer). When the fish body length is measured, the problems that the space of a breeding site is limited, the number of laying scenes is large, the body is bent when the fish body swims, cost is controlled and the like are fully considered, and the measurement system is designed in a network interconnection and embedded calculation mode. Meanwhile, in the binocular vision system composed of the two cameras, image segmentation and center line extraction analysis are carried out only for the left camera, and consumption of computing resources is greatly reduced.
