The fish body center curve is obtained in a fitting + reconstruction mode, the fish body length is calculated in a segmented statistics mode, implementation is easy, and operation is stable. The system not only has the wiring advantage of network transmission, but also has the capability of acquiring the fish body length in a free state in a non-contact and real-time manner, and can greatly improve the fish growth sensing capability of a breeding factory.

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR ANALYZING PATTERN OF HERD BEHAVIOR OF ANIMAL BASED ON IMAGE
abstract: An apparatus for analyzing patterns of group behaviors of swarm individuals based on an image comprises: a data transmission/reception module; a memory storing an image-based program for analyzing group patterns of swarm individuals; and a processor executing the program stored in the memory, wherein the program performs image preprocessing to detect edge images of swarm individuals, based on input images captured through at least one camera allocated to a space where the swarm individuals are accommodated, inputs edge images into a swarm pattern analysis model to detect pattern information on the swarm individuals, and determines whether the swarm individuals are normal, based on the pattern information. The swarm pattern analysis model is a model trained by using learning data including edge images of each swarm individual to output pattern information on the swarm individuals based on the inputted images.

title: Piglet milk eating behavior detection system based on YOLOv5 and C3D
abstract: The invention discloses a piglet milk eating behavior detection system based on YOLOv5 and C3D, the piglet milk eating behavior detection system comprises a lactation room, a camera, a video storage unit, a server and the like, on one hand, the camera continuously stores video data to the video storage unit, and on the other hand, the camera is directly connected with the server; the server analyzes the monitoring data; the working steps of the detection system are that the posture of the sow is detected through the YOLOv5 detection network, when the sow is detected to be in a side-lying posture, a lactation interesting domain is extracted, the number of piglets is detected, the interesting domain is input into the C3D recognition network to recognize the lactation movement of the piglets, and a comprehensive recognition result is output to the database. Compared with a sensor technology, the technology avoids contact with the sow and reduces stress reaction; compared with other methods for identifying the lactation behavior of the sow by using a computer vision technology, the method disclosed by the invention more pays attention to the lactation movement of the piglet. Tedious steps brought by analysis of sow lactation characteristics are reduced, and the method has the advantages of being direct in analysis and high in efficiency.

title: Data processing method and system for animal ear tag, terminal and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a data processing method and system for an animal ear tag, a terminal and a storage medium, and belongs to the field of animal monitoring, and the method comprises the steps: recording a target animal number and entering a temperature measurement mode after obtaining an identity recognition result carrying the target animal number; within the duration of the temperature measurement mode, if a temperature measurement instruction is received, obtaining a test temperature and storing the test temperature; based on all the test temperatures stored within the duration of the temperature measurement mode, obtaining and recording the current body temperature corresponding to the target animal number; and judging whether the health condition of the animal corresponding to the target animal number is abnormal or not based on the current body temperature and the historical body temperature corresponding to the target animal number. The method and the device have the effect of monitoring the animals at relatively low cost.
applicants: WUXI FUHUA IOT TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Off-line ear tag data transmission method, system and terminal
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet of Things information systems, in particular to an off-line ear tag data transmission method and system and a terminal, and aims to solve the problem of low collection efficiency of data in animal ear tags in the prior art. Comprising the following steps: broadcasting a transmission detection signal according to a preset broadcasting period, the transmission detection signal being used for detecting an information receiving device in a communication range, so that the information receiving device returns a transmission response signal; when a returned transmission response signal is received, analyzing the transmission response signal to obtain link information of the information receiving device; establishing a communication link with the information receiving device based on the link information; and sending the animal monitoring information to the information receiving device through the communication link. The animal ear tag information acquisition method and device have the effect of improving the animal ear tag information acquisition efficiency.
applicants: WUXI FUHUA IOT TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Livestock feeding device and system
abstract: The invention provides a livestock feeding device and system. The device comprises a feeder and a feeding channel; the feeder comprises a trough 110, a food storage device 120 and an inductor 130; a preset outlet of the feeding channel is opposite to the first side of the trough 110; a livestock can pass through the feeding channel; the sensor 130 is used for collecting a face image of a target livestock in a feeding channel and identifying the face image to obtain identity information of the target livestock; obtaining feeding information of the target livestock according to the identity information of the target livestock; the sensor 130 is further used for determining the target putting amount corresponding to the target livestock according to the feeding information of the target livestock and controlling the food storage device 120 to put food with the weight equal to the target putting amount into the food trough 110, and precise automatic feeding is achieved.
applicants: BEIJING UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title: Sow estrus state automatic detection system based on interaction characteristics
abstract: The invention discloses a sow oestrus state automatic detection system based on interaction characteristics. The established sow interaction behavior detection model is used for recognizing interaction behaviors of the non-pregnant sows and the bionic boars in real time, and the function of automatically detecting the oestrus states of the sows in the limiting fences is achieved. The system is composed of a crawler-type driving module, a bionic boar estrus testing module, a data acquisition and processing module, a wireless data transmission module, a cloud server and a data display module. According to the system, the sow oestrus state detection system is adopted for automatic oestrus detection, rapid detection of oestrus sows can be achieved, participation of workers and boars is not needed, and the epidemic disease spreading risk caused by the fact that the boars participate in oestrus induction and manual oestrus detection can be reduced.

title: Double-layer barrier frame type cow house for mixed feeding of female cattle and calves
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of livestock breeding, and provides a double-layer fence frame type cow house for mixed feeding of female cattle and calves, the double-layer fence frame type cow house comprises a cow house main frame, fences, feeding units, supporting beams and aisles, and two rows of middle-layer plates, a batching station, a spliced display screen and a camera device are arranged in the cow house main frame; the middle-layer plate is provided with a plurality of pairs of lifting ports in one-to-one correspondence with the feeding units, lifting baskets are arranged in the lifting ports, supplementary feeding grooves are formed in the lifting baskets, a lifting control mechanism is arranged at the top of each lifting basket and comprises a lifting rope pulley block, an unwinding wheel, an unwinding motor and a remote control device, and a feed supply pipeline is arranged above the middle-layer plate. The feed supply pipeline comprises a supply main pipe, supply branch pipes in one-to-one correspondence with the lifting baskets, a telescopic pipe and an input pipe connected with the batching station, and a horizontal driving device is arranged on one side of the supply main pipe. The device is reasonable in design, simple in structure, convenient for supplementary feeding, favorable for improving the feeding efficiency, high in space utilization rate and suitable for large-scale popularization.

title: Dairy cow informatization intelligent breeding method and system
abstract: The invention provides a dairy cow informatization intelligent breeding method and system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent breeding, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the image collection of dairy cow activity states through an image collection device, and building a dairy cow image library comprising codes and activity state images; constructing a dairy cow evaluation system model by using the dairy cow breeding experience database; sequentially inputting the dairy cow information into the dairy cow evaluation system model to obtain dairy cow evaluation results; data clustering is carried out based on a dairy cow evaluation result, state classification is carried out on dairy cows according to a data clustering analysis result, dairy cow classification clusters are established, breeding feature marking is carried out on the clusters, and marks are bound with dairy cow codes; and identifying the dairy cow breeding feature mark by using the dairy cow coding information, and determining the breeding information to carry out informatization breeding supervision on dairy cows. The technical problem that lacking of an intelligent cow breeding method affects the breeding level and the milk yield is solved. The technical effects that targeted feeding is conducted through informatization guidance, the breeding efficiency is improved, and the milk yield is ensured are achieved.
applicants: LIANYUNGANG ANIMAL HUSBANDRY & VETERINARY MEDICINE; LIANYUNGANG DONGWANG COW CULTURING COMPANY

title: Livestock necklace
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal husbandry wearing equipment, and particularly discloses an animal husbandry necklace. The animal husbandry necklace comprises a rotary function box, a necklace main body, a control circuit board, a switch, a shearing alarm unit and a wire. A mounting cavity is formed in the rotary function box, and a fixing pile is arranged in the mounting cavity; the necklace main body is fixedly connected to the fixed pile and penetrates out of the rotary function box; the control circuit board is arranged in the mounting cavity; the switch is arranged in the rotary function box and is electrically connected with the control circuit board; the shearing alarm unit is electrically connected with the control circuit board; the wire is embedded in the necklace body and extends in the circumferential direction of the necklace body, and the control circuit board, the switch and the wire are arranged on the same closed loop. The animal husbandry necklace has a shearing alarm function, and the risk that animal husbandry is stolen can be reduced.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR LIVESTOCK MONITORING AND MANAGEMENT
abstract: A system and method for monitoring livestock is disclosed. In the illustrative embodiment, calibration patterns are placed on the ground in the field of view of a camera. The calibration patterns are used to generate homographies usable to determine a 3D position of a 2D position on the ground in images captured by the camera. If a gravity direction is also determined, then the 3D position of objects can be determined if a point on the ground along the gravity shadow of the object can also be identified. The identified positions of objects may be used to determine if livestock is lame.

title: Cloud platform for pig breeding
abstract: The invention discloses a cloud platform for pig breeding, and the cloud platform comprises a cloud architecture layer module which is used for providing basic resources for cloud computing for the cloud platform of a pig farm, and the basic resources comprise a data storage space, a computing resource and a network resource; the support layer module is used for providing a database function and a basic resource allocation function for the cloud platform; the application layer module is used for providing an application function for the cloud platform, and the application function at least comprises an AI framework; the experience layer module is used for generating an internal function unit and an external application program associated with the internal function unit for the cloud platform according to the AI framework by obtaining a user demand; according to the cloud platform provided by the invention, the requirements of vast people for food safety can be met to the greatest extent, and the safety problem of live pig products is ensured from the source, so that lawbreakers are effectively prevented from seeking for violence with unhealthy live pigs through illegal channels, and the sanitation and health of the live pig products are ensured to the greatest extent.

title: Animal husbandry livestock body temperature monitoring method and system based on computer vision
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of computer vision, in particular to an animal husbandry livestock body temperature monitoring method and system based on computer vision, and the method comprises the steps: respectively obtaining a visible light image and a thermal imaging image; according to the visible light image, constructing a livestock three-dimensional model, and performing image cutting on the livestock three-dimensional model to obtain a livestock head model; according to the livestock head model, obtaining a model face image containing livestock eyes; obtaining texture information of the model face image to obtain a model texture image; fusing the model face image and the model texture image to obtain a face feature image; processing the facial feature image by using a neural network to obtain a Gaussian distribution diagram of intraocular angular points of the livestock, and further obtaining coordinates of the intraocular angular points; and according to the intraocular angular point coordinates and the thermal imaging face image, determining that the temperature of the intraocular angular point is the body temperature of the livestock. The livestock body temperature detection efficiency can be improved.

title: Breeding pig health detection method based on time convolution
abstract: The invention discloses a boar health detection method based on time convolution, and the method comprises the specific steps: 1, numbering boars, collecting the body temperature information of the boars through a temperature measurement device, and uploading the data to an MYSQL database; step 2, preprocessing the data in the MYSQL database; step 3, performing feature extraction on the preprocessed data; step 4, constructing a detection model, respectively measuring body temperature data of the breeding pigs infected with diseases and healthy breeding pigs on the spot as a known disease training set for training, and obtaining a trained breeding pig health accurate detection model; and 5, judging whether the body temperature of the boar is abnormal or not by utilizing the mathematical characteristics extracted in the step 3, if the body temperature is abnormal, importing abnormal data into the boar health accurate detection model, and performing secondary judgment on the abnormal data by utilizing the boar health accurate detection model. A preliminary judgment mechanism is introduced, so that the time cost can be reduced under the condition that the accuracy is not lost.
applicants: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF POSTS AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title: Two-channel small animal fear common-estrus behavior detection system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal behavioristics, and particularly relates to a double-channel small animal fear common-estrus behavior detection system. The system comprises a behavioristics implementation device, a wireless physiological signal telemetering device, an optical genetic nerve control device and a video monitoring device, the behavioristics implementation device is of a square box body structure and is used for placing small observation animals and small demonstration animals; the wireless physiological signal telemetering device is used for collecting a physiological signal when the small observation animal is subjected to an observable fear acquisition test; the optical genetic nerve control device is connected with a target region for observing brain tissues of the small animal and is used for carrying out specific regulation and control on neurons in the target brain region of the small animal; and the video monitoring device is arranged right above the behavioristics implementation device. According to the method, a series of fear responses such as stiffness time, corner area staying time, total movement distance and interaction area exploration times of the small animals can be analyzed at the same time.
applicants: INSTITUTE OF MILITARY MEDICINE, ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCES OF PLA

title: Sow oestrus detection method based on deep learning and infrared thermal imaging
abstract: The invention discloses a sow oestrus detection method based on deep learning and infrared thermal imaging, and the method comprises the following steps: shooting a hip image of a sow through an infrared thermal imager, training a sow hip and vulva detection model, and accurately and rapidly obtaining the vulva skin temperature of the sow; the continuous vulva skin temperature of an oestrus sow and a non-oestrus sow is regularly obtained through a sow hip and vulva detection model, the continuous vulva skin temperature serves as a training sample to classify a time sequence model based on LSTM, and a sow oestrus early warning model is obtained; when oestrus detection needs to be conducted on the sow, sow hip images shot regularly every day are input into the sow hip and vulva detection model to obtain the daily vulva skin temperature of the sow, then the continuous vulva skin temperature of the sow is input into the sow oestrus early warning model, and whether the sow is oestrus or not is judged. According to the invention, automation of sow oestrus detection can be realized, the labor intensity of farmers is reduced, and the accuracy and efficiency of sow oestrus detection are improved.

title: Anti-disassembly intelligent grazing ear tag capable of measuring temperature and positioning
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent raising ear tag capable of measuring temperature, positioning and preventing disassembly, and relates to the technical field of livestock breeding, the intelligent raising ear tag capable of measuring temperature, positioning and preventing disassembly comprises an ear tag shell, a shell cover is arranged on the ear tag shell, a puncture rod is fixedly connected to the side, away from the ear tag shell, of the shell cover, and the puncture rod is fixedly sleeved with a limiting block; a fixing ring is movably connected to the puncture rod, a fixing mechanism is arranged on the puncture rod, and a miniature solar panel is inlaid in the ear tag shell. According to the anti-disassembly intelligent grazing ear tag capable of measuring the temperature and positioning, a GPS positioner is arranged, so that a feeder can find the position of livestock at the first time, the phenomenon that the fed livestock is lost is avoided, and the anti-disassembly intelligent grazing ear tag capable of measuring the temperature and positioning is convenient to use. And meanwhile, when the livestock has bad phenomena, the livestock can be quickly found through the GPS positioner, so that the treatment speed is ensured, the economic loss caused by death of the livestock is reduced, the livestock can be treated at the first time, and the healthy growth of the livestock is ensured.

title: Feeder with state monitoring function for pregnant pigs
abstract: The invention discloses a pregnant pig feeder with a state monitoring function, and particularly relates to the technical field of livestock feeding, the pregnant pig feeder comprises a first chassis, the right side surface of the first chassis is fixedly connected with two mounting seats, and the right side surfaces of the two mounting seats are fixedly connected with the left side surface of the same second chassis; the upper surfaces of the two mounting bases are fixedly connected with the lower surfaces of four first reinforcing plates correspondingly, the opposite faces of the two corresponding first reinforcing plates are fixedly connected with the faces, away from each other, of the two first side plates correspondingly, and the upper surfaces and the lower surfaces of the four first side plates are fixedly connected with second side plates correspondingly. By arranging the control panel, the processing barrel, the feeding barrel, the sensor and the heat treatment barrel, the feeder can judge the health condition of the sow according to two aspects of food residues and the body surface temperature of the sow, so that the pregnant sow is protected, and the survival rate and the farrowing rate of the sow during pregnancy are guaranteed.

title: Method for controlling amount of fodder for sows based on artificial intelligence and apparatus therefor
abstract: A feed supply amount control and device for sow are disclosed. The feed supply control device determines the appearance data of the sow through a sensor, determines weight management information including the sow's body rating based on the appearance data, and controls the amount of feed supplied according to the weight management information.

title: METHOD AND CONTROL DEVICE FOR SURVEYING EATING BEHAVIOUR OF ANIMALS
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to feeding animals (10) and in particular to a method for surveying eating behaviour of animals (10) in a livestock area (30). The disclosure also relates a control device (100), and to a computer program for performing the method. According to a first aspect, the disclosure relates to a method for surveying eating behaviour of animals (10) in a livestock area (30). The method comprises monitoring over a time period subsequent to distributing feed at a feed table (31) in the livestock area (30), animal data acquired using tags carried by the animals (10) and indicative of activities of the animals (10) and/or positions of the animals (10) in relation to the feed table (31). The method further comprises performing an action upon the monitored animal data failing to meet one or more eating criteria defining normal eating behaviour of the animals (10) with respect to activities of the animals (10) and/or positions of the animals (10) in relation to the feed table (31). The disclosure also relates a control device (100), and to a computer program for performing the method.

title: METHOD AND CONTROL DEVICE FOR CONTROLLING A FEED ROBOT AT A FEED TABLE
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to feeding animals (10) and in particular to a method for operating a feed robot (1) at a feed table (3) in a livestock area (30). According to a first aspect, the disclosure relates to a method for operating a feed robot (1) at a feed table (3) in a livestock area (30). The method comprises monitoring over a time period subsequent to distributing feed at the feed table (3), animal data acquired using tags carried by animals (10) in the livestock area (30) and indicative of respective positions of the animals (10) in the livestock area (30) in relation to a feed table (3). The method further comprises determining, based on the animal data indicative of respective positions of the animals (10) in relation to the feed table (3), eating statuses of a plurality of individual animals (10) in the livestock area (30) and controlling operation of the autonomous feed robot (1) based on the determined eating statuses of the plurality of individual animals (10). The disclosure also relates a control device (100), and to a computer program for performing the method.

title: Hog house environment management method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a pig house environment management method and system, and relates to the technical field of pig breeding, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining RFID data of pigs in a pig house and daily food intake data of the pigs; detecting real-time environment data of the pig house; generating a basic adjustment scheme based on the real-time environment data; generating a special adjustment scheme in combination with the RFID data and the daily food intake data; and adjusting the Internet of Things equipment in the pig house according to the basic adjustment scheme and the special adjustment scheme. The hog house environment management system has the effect of not consuming more manpower when managing the hog house environment.

title: SYSTEM FOR DETERMINING A WALKED DISTANCE OF AN ANIMAL WITHIN A BARN
abstract: System (100) for determining a respective walked distance of animals (101, 102, 103) in a barn (200) during a predetermined time period. The system (100) comprises a Real-Time Location System (110, 120a, 120b, 120c, 130), a database (140) storing historical trajectories (430) of the animals (101, 102, 103) and a processing controller (150). The processing controller (150) is configured to determine the walked distance of the animal (101) by es-tablishing a walked trajectory (450) based on obtained data entities (301), and store the trajectory (450) in the database (140) associated with the animal (101); or detecting a gap (420) of missing or incomplete data entities (301) among the obtained data entities (301); 1and establish the trajectory (450) by inserting replacement distance data in the gap (420), based on historical trajectories (430) extracted from the database (140) and store the es-tablished trajectory (450) in the database (140).

title: Apparatus and method for monitoring inactive livestock
abstract: Disclosed is a monitoring method for visualizing a location of an inactive livestock in a livestock pen. This method includes extracting, by a video analysis device, livestock objects from a video image acquired for each frame and subsequently calculating center coordinates indicating a location of the inactive livestock based on coordinates of the extracted livestock objects, displaying, by a display device, an object icon representing the inactive livestock in a display region mapped to the calculated center coordinate among a plurality of display regions defined on a display screen, and emitting light by light emitting units selected based on the calculated center coordinate, among a plurality of lighting units installed in a livestock structure.

title: SYSTEM FOR DETERMINING A TIME DISTRIBUTION OF AN ANIMAL INTO ZONES OF A BARN
abstract: System (100) for determining distribution of time that a respective animal (101, 102, 103) has spent in different zones (210, 220, 230) of a barn (200) during a predetermined time period. The system (100) comprises a Real-Time Location System (110, 120a, 120b, 120c, 130), a database (140) comprising position coordinates of the respective zones (210, 220, 230) and a processing controller (150). The processing controller (150) is configured to determine distribution of time by associating each obtained data entity (301) with a respec-tive zone (210, 220, 230) based on the position coordinates of the respective information entity (301) and the position coordinates of the zones (210, 220, 230); counting the number of data entities (301) in each respective zone (210, 220, 230); and calculating an amount of time the animal (101) has spent in the zone (210, 220, 230) by multiplying the number of data entities (301) of each respective zone (210, 220, 230) with the regular time interval.

title: Integrated culture management method for intelligent culture of calves
abstract: The invention discloses a calf intelligent breeding integrated breeding management method which comprises high-quality calf formula milk powder and a unique feeding method, a good material basis is laid for calf feeding, and the method is a healthy starting point of calf breeding. The system further comprises a calf full-automatic feeding system and a calf intelligent weighing system, and detection and evaluation of standardized feeding and regular feeding management effects are achieved. Compared with milk feeding, the formula milk powder feeding is more economical, better growth performance can be brought to the calves, and due to the application of a new formula, a new feeding mode and new equipment in the breeding method, the overall basic level of a pasture is improved, and the pasture win the starting point of competition in the future. The method is a brand-new mode in the aspect of calf breeding management means, is an innovation compared with a traditional domestic calf breeding mode, and can make meaningful attempts for domestic replacement cattle breeding.

title: Integrated intelligent monitoring device for growth and development of dairy cow
abstract: The invention discloses an integrated cow growth and development intelligent monitoring device, which comprises a body weight detection scale, a linkage lifting mechanism, a telescopic pedal, a body shape measuring mechanism and a body height measuring mechanism, and is characterized in that the body weight detection scale comprises a supporting frame, a pressure sensor, a lifting cross beam and walking wheels, and strip-shaped storage grooves are formed in two side edges of the supporting frame; a body type measuring mechanism is arranged in the strip-shaped storage groove in a turnover manner; supporting legs are respectively arranged at the bottoms of the weight detection scale and the telescopic pedal; the front and rear ends of the linkage lifting mechanism are respectively connected with the telescopic pedal, the left and right ends are respectively connected with the lifting cross beam, a driving motor is connected with the body type measuring mechanism, and the first laser distance measuring sensor, the second laser sensor and the third laser sensor form a dairy cow body type dynamic detection channel after being overturned and unfolded. The device can realize multiple measurement functions and is convenient to operate, the growth and development conditions of the dairy cow can be intuitively mastered through the LED display screen according to body measurement data, and the device is suitable for large-scale fine management pasture.

title: A MONITORING DEVICE FOR AN ANIMAL
abstract: A monitoring device for an animal comprising a body with an aperture for receiving a first part of an ear tag that extends through an ear of the animal. The body comprises a surface area for contacting the ear of the animal. The monitoring device further comprises a processor, a battery and a network. The monitoring device is configured such that, in use, when the first part of an ear tag extends through the ear of the animal and the aperture of the monitoring device, and the second part of the ear tag is fixated to the first part, the monitoring device is positioned between the ear tag and the ear of the animal so that the surface area of the body of the monitoring device is in contact with the ear of the animal to obtain the information indicative of at least the temperature of the animal.

title: Intelligent animal husbandry monitoring equipment based on image processing
abstract: The invention relates to the field of livestock breeding monitoring equipment, in particular to animal husbandry intelligent monitoring equipment based on image processing. Comprising a breeding shed, an annular square pipe is fixedly installed on the inner top face of the breeding shed through a plurality of first supports and located above all breeding grooves, a connecting water supply device communicated with the interior of the square pipe is arranged on one side of the breeding shed, and a plurality of water outlet valve structures distributed in the length direction of the square pipe are arranged at the bottom of the square pipe; the periphery of the square tube is sleeved with a C-shaped frame with an upward opening, the frame is further provided with a movable pushing structure which drives the frame to move along the square tube and can push the frame to move downwards, and a water spraying camera shooting structure which is perpendicular to the square tube and can be adjusted in the water outlet state is arranged below the frame; the device is compact in structure and novel in conception, traditional fixed position monitoring is broken through, the camera device can dynamically shoot and monitor the lower portion of the breeding shed in real time, and the interior of the breeding tank can be dynamically monitored in an all-around mode.

title: WEARABLE INTERNET OF THINGS DEVICE AND CONVERGENCE TYPE LIVESTOCK MONITORING SYSTEM USING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable Internet of things (IoT) device and a convergence-type livestock monitoring system using the same. The lightweight wearable IoT device attachable to the ears of livestock provides a convergence-type monitoring function that extracts two types of measurement values, such as livestock movement sensing values and body temperature sensing values, through a single device function, and enables identification of livestock entities, and can process both a long-distance communication function that can transmit sensing data to a remote server system (cloud server or the like) by using only a single MCU chip within a single device and applying a dual-band wireless communication method (both long-distance and short-distance), and a short-distance BLE communication function for a smartphone that is essential for instant entity identification management on livestock entities in onsite barns and state management on the attached wearable IoT device. Furthermore, a low-power current consumption control method that is essential for matching the lifetime of the livestock and the lifespan of the devices to the maximum after the same is attached to the ears of the livestock, is presented, thereby providing the lightweight wearable IoT device attachable to the ears of the livestock (cows, pigs, and the like). The wearable IoT device comprises: a sensor unit detecting movement information and body temperature information on livestock; and a chip unit controlling the operation of the sensor unit and a communication unit.
applicants: INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF SUNCHON NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: Female tag for pig identity marking, ear tag assembly and processing method
abstract: The invention discloses a mother tag for pig identity marking, an ear tag assembly and a processing method.The mother tag for pig identity marking comprises a first injection molding part, a second injection molding part and a wet inlay tag, an insertion hole is formed in the middle of the first injection molding part, and a supporting protrusion embedded in the insertion hole is arranged in the middle of the second injection molding part; according to the female tag for pig identity marking, the ear tag assembly and the processing method, the sealed annular cavity is formed by the annular inner protrusion and the annular outer protrusion which are connected with the second injection molding part, and the wet inlaid tag is arranged in the annular cavity and can be effectively protected; therefore, the long-term effectiveness and stability of the female label for pig identity marking are improved, and meanwhile, the connection strength of the first injection molding part and the second injection molding part can be effectively enhanced through a buckling structure of the annular outer protrusion and the connecting protrusion.

title: Precise feeding device for monitoring heartbeat and breathing of pigs
abstract: The invention discloses an accurate feeding device for monitoring heartbeat and breathing of pigs, which is characterized in that a pedal and a feeding trough are respectively arranged at two ends of the top of an I-shaped steel base, a gravity sensing mechanism is positioned between the pedal and the inner wall of the I-shaped steel base, and a feeding mechanism is positioned above one end of the feeding trough; the gravity sensing mechanism comprises a mounting box and a magnet, the top of the mounting box is movably connected with an I-shaped rod, the magnet is magnetically connected with the I-shaped rod, and the timer switch is in contact with a bottom transverse plate of the I-shaped rod; the feeding mechanism comprises a storage barrel; a storage bin with a conveying roller is arranged at the bottom of the feed barrel, materials fall into a conveying groove through rotation of the conveying roller, the feeding amount can be controlled by calculating the number of rotation times in unit time and the material receiving amount of the conveying groove, a scraping block is arranged on one side of the storage bin, when the feed is wet, the feed is prone to being adhered to the inner wall of the conveying groove, and therefore the feeding amount can be controlled. And the scraping block descends, the surface of the scraping block scrapes the inner wall of the conveying groove, the discharging rate is increased, and the purpose of precise feeding is achieved.

title: Livestock management system using artificial intelligence analysis based on convergence data
abstract: According to the present invention, a livestock management system using artificial intelligence analysis based on convergence data comprises: a non-contact individual data collection unit that collects individual-specific data on livestock from group data on the livestock measured by a non-contact monitoring device; a contact individual data collection unit that collects individual-specific data on livestock measured by a contact sensor; a non-contact individual state analysis unit that analyzes the individual-specific data collected by the non-contact individual data collection unit to determine the state of the individual; a contact individual state analysis unit that analyzes the individual-specific data collected by the contact individual data collection unit to determine the state of the individual; an individual convergence data generation unit that generates individual-specific convergence data by using the individual data and analysis results for the individual; a convergence data-based individual state classification unit that receives the individual-specific convergence data and classifies the state of the individual into multiple states; an individual state analysis unit that receives classification results for the state of the individual and generates final determination information for individual-specific management; and a determination result notification and monitoring unit that receives the final determination information for each individual and transmits the final determination information to a manager so that the health condition of the individual is monitored. Therefore, errors in the measurement and determination of the remote livestock monitoring and management system can be minimized.
applicants: INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF SUNCHON NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: Animal behavior measurement system using acceleration sensors
abstract: The present invention relates to an animal behavior measurement system using an acceleration sensor, and specifically, to an animal behavior measurement system using an acceleration sensor, which is capable of maximizing the survival rate of young goats or the like by accurately and quickly detecting the estrus or delivery period of livestock such as goats, cows, and horses and informing animal keepers of the estrus or delivery period of the same. The animal behavior measurement system using an acceleration sensor comprises: a motion detection device (10) which is attached to an upper part of the hock (knee of on the hind leg) a mother goat and detects acceleration generated by movement of the mother goat's hock in three axes; a data collection device (20) which operates as a gateway that periodically receives three-axis acceleration behavior data detected from the motion detection device (10) and transmits the received acceleration behavior data to a management server (30); the management server (30) which analyzes the acceleration behavior data received from the data collection device (20) and determines whether the mother goat is in estrus and gives birth based on the analyzed data; and a user terminal (40) in which an application that can connect to the management server (30) is installed, wherein the management server (30) is configured to inform the user terminal (40) of the status of the mother goat based on the acceleration behavior data received from the data collection device (20).
applicants: KYUNGPOOK NATIONAL UNIVERSITY; GYEONGSANG NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: Body size measuring device and method for mutton sheep
abstract: The invention relates to a body size measuring device for mutton sheep. The body size measuring device comprises a detection fence unit and a video acquisition unit, the invention further relates to a body size measuring method for the mutton sheep, the detection fence unit is used for delineating a detection area, after the sheep enters the detection area, ear tags of the sheep are read through the code reading plate, meanwhile, overlooking and side-looking videos of the sheep are collected through the video collection unit, images in the videos are obtained through an existing video processing module, and the images are stored in the detection area. And obtaining the body size data of the sheep through the estimation model. The body size measuring device for the mutton sheep is scientific and reasonable in design, has the advantages of saving manpower and labor, being convenient to operate, high in measuring precision, high in measuring efficiency and easy to implement, and has relatively high innovativeness.

title: POULTRY HEALTH BENCHMARKING SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: A method includes training, by at least one processor, an artificial intelligence model using a library of data associated with poultry, receiving, by the at least one processor, realtime information associated with a plurality of poultry from at least one imaging device at a particular location, determining, by the at least one processor, at least one benchmark based on the realtime information associated with the plurality of poultry from the at least one imaging device and using the artificial intelligence model, and generating and sending, by the at least one processor, an alert in realtime to a client computing device based on the realtime information associated with the plurality of poultry.

title: Radio frequency identification (RFID) system for cattle identification and automatic column separation and column separation method
abstract: The invention discloses an RFID system for cattle identification and automatic column separation and a column separation method. The RFID system comprises an RFID reader-writer, a controller, a transportation mechanism, a cattle entering channel, a plurality of steering mechanisms and a plurality of independent cattle columns. By means of the RFID reader-writer, the conveying mechanism and the steering mechanism, automatic column separation of cows is achieved, manual classification and driving are not needed, the efficiency is high, the labor intensity of feeders is reduced, in the column separation process, the cows are always in the temporary storage column with the periphery closed, and the risk that the cows are stored in the temporary storage column when being out of control is avoided; meanwhile, steering of the cattle is achieved through the steering mechanism, it is guaranteed that the cattle enter the temporary storage fence in the state that the heads of the cattle face the temporary storage fence and enter the cattle pen in the state that the heads of the cattle face the cattle pen, in this way, the situation that the cattle are manually guided, steered or backed back to enter the cattle pen can be avoided, and it is guaranteed that only the cattle walk simply in the cattle pen dividing process; and the rejection of the cattle can be reduced to the greatest extent.
applicants: SICHUAN NANSHUI AGRICULTURE AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Spraying system for adjusting pasture environment
abstract: The invention discloses a spraying system for pasture environment regulation, and particularly relates to the field of pasture environment regulation spraying.The spraying system is characterized in that S1, a mobile phone terminal and a remote terminal are used for signal transmission with a control module, the control module is operated, the control module is in signal connection with a background terminal, and water consumption, temperature, humidity, THI value and ammonia concentration changes in a pasture are obtained; s2, acquiring real-time monitoring pictures monitored in the pasture through a control end, so as to judge that electronic equipment in the pasture is compatible, expanded and controlled to keep normal operation, and S3, acquiring temperature change in the pasture by using a temperature control terminal module, and then controlling each nozzle point. When the time interval is reached or exceeded, the spray head is used for secondary water spraying when the cattle only replace the spray head, so that the water spraying effect of the spraying system on the cattle heads in the pasture is effectively reduced, the required water source amount is reduced, and meanwhile, the more accurate pasture environment adjusting and using effect of the system is improved.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA LIANMU TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT CO., LTD.; SHANGHAI ZHENRAN INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Live pig abnormal symptom diagnosis system based on body temperature monitoring
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of body temperature detection, in particular to a live pig abnormal symptom diagnosis system based on body temperature monitoring. The live pig abnormal symptom diagnosis system based on body temperature monitoring comprises an acquisition device, the acquisition device is connected with a database module, the database module is connected with a matrix construction module, the matrix construction module is connected with a monitoring model training module, the monitoring model training module is connected with a data inspection module, and the data inspection module is connected with a result output module. The live pig abnormal symptom diagnosis system based on body temperature monitoring can achieve live pig abnormal symptom real-time detection.

title: Systematic method for identifying pregnancy of cows
abstract: The invention discloses a systematic method for identifying cow pregnancy. The systematic method comprises daily identification, appearance identification and vagina identification. The daily identification comprises behavior identification and appetite identification; the appearance identification comprises breast identification, bull eye identification and oral cavity identification; according to the system and method for identifying cow pregnancy disclosed by the invention, the identification factors comprise various aspects of the cow, the coverage range of the identification factors is wide, and more accurate judgment on whether the cow is pregnant or not is facilitated; the detection cost is greatly saved, the required labor is greatly reduced, and the labor cost is reduced; the operability is high, and wide popularization and application are facilitated.
applicants: LIVESTOCK RESEARCH INSTITUTE, XINJIANG ACADEMY OF ANIMAL SCIENCE

title: Method for treating bovine viral diarrhea
abstract: The invention discloses a method for treating bovine viral diarrhea, and belongs to the technical field of breeding, and the treatment method comprises the following specific steps: (1) collecting breeding information of a breeding farm, and carrying out classified storage; (2) collecting and analyzing information of each bred cattle in real time; (3) performing isolation treatment on the diseased cattle; (4) collecting the treatment condition of the diseased cattle and feeding back; (5) updating and recovering the data in the server; the intelligent inspection trolley is adopted to collect and analyze the information of each bred cattle, the workload of breeding personnel is reduced, meanwhile, the illness condition of the bred cattle can be efficiently and accurately detected, the situation that the diseased cattle cannot be isolated and treated in time to cause virus transmission is avoided, the property loss of the breeding personnel is reduced, redundant cache data existing in the server can be automatically cleaned, and the service life of the breeding personnel is prolonged. The operation efficiency of the server is improved, operation of breeding personnel is facilitated, and the use experience is improved.

title: Mutton sheep fixing device
abstract: The invention discloses a mutton sheep fixing device, and belongs to the technical field of animal husbandry production equipment.The mutton sheep fixing device comprises a platform scale, a second shell and a first shell, a first motor is installed on the inner bottom wall of the first shell, the output end of the first motor is connected with a third rod body, and the exterior of the third rod body is connected with a driving gear; a driving gear is arranged in the first shell, a driven gear is connected to the driving gear in a meshed mode, a multi-section type two-way lead screw is connected to the exterior of the driven gear, and the end, away from the driven gear, of the multi-section type two-way lead screw is connected to the interior of the first shell through a bearing. A second motor drives a first rod body to rotate, finally, a first plate body is driven to rotate to be horizontal with the ground, an electric push rod is started, the output end of the electric push rod is attached to the bottom of the first rod body, the first rod body is stabilized, and the mutton sheep placed on the upper portion of the first rod body is prevented from inclining due to uneven weight.

title: Monitoring and early warning device for serious diseases of livestock, poultry and aquatic products and use method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the field of livestock and poultry aquaculture management, in particular to a livestock and poultry aquaculture major disease monitoring and early warning device which comprises a monitoring anchor rod arranged in a culture area in a surrounding mode, a camera installed at the top end of the monitoring anchor rod, an environment monitoring sensor set installed in the monitoring anchor rod in an embedded mode and a spray head set installed on the outer wall of the monitoring anchor rod. An arc-shaped plate used for installing the environment monitoring sensor set is arranged on the front side in the monitoring anchor rod in a sliding mode, an open hole matched with the environment monitoring sensor set is formed in the front side wall of the monitoring anchor rod, an agent storage box in butt joint with the spray head set is arranged on the right side in the monitoring anchor rod, and the camera is used for collecting images of the surrounding environment of the breeding area. And the acquired surrounding environment image is fed back to the control terminal in real time, and the control terminal evaluates the surrounding environment based on a preset image processing program. According to the invention, on-line continuous automatic monitoring and analysis of major diseases of livestock, poultry and aquatic products can be realized, and abnormal conditions in the livestock and aquatic product culture process can be found in time.
applicants: GANSU AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY; GANSU FISHERY TECHNOLOGY PROMOTION GENERAL STATION

title: Pig industry supply and marketing management system based on big data
abstract: The invention provides a live pig industry supply and marketing management system based on big data, and the system comprises a data collection module which is used for obtaining the identity data information and daily weight data information of each fattening pig in a breeding fence; the cloud server is used for acquiring the data information fed back by the data acquisition module, processing the data information and distributing the processed necessary data information to the user terminal; a user terminal; generating a single-fence fattening pig weight growth curve graph, and prompting corresponding farmers and purchasers when monitoring that the weight data of all the fattening pigs are within a standard marketing weight interval; according to the method, purchase and sale guidance can be provided for the purchaser and the seller in a relatively fair and objective manner, the marketing opportunity, the pricing right and the profit are prevented from inclining to a single party, the familiar and unfamiliar purchaser and the seller are facilitated to comply with a better pig purchase and sale scheme, and the problems of information isolated island and information asymmetry of a live pig industry chain can be really solved.

title: Prediction and prevention system of the spread path of livestock disease and Their method
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and a method for predicting spread path of livestock disease and preventing a spread. The system comprises: a livestock management device that collects environment information and vehicle information within at least one livestock house and manages temperature, lighting, air quality, or vehicle entry/exit within the livestock house; an integrated control server that generates a disease spread prediction model using the environment information, vehicle information, and external data, predicts the disease spread pattern and the disease spread probability value of each livestock farm through the disease spread prediction model, and generates result data, and controls the livestock farm management device through livestock farm management data generated according to the result data; and a virtual space generation part that generates simulation data by conducting a simulation of the spread of disease in a virtual space, thereby enabling to monitor a situation within the livestock farm in real-time, provide comprehensive information to each livestock farm in the event of a disease outbreak, and generate response messages at each level according to the disease spread probability value.

title: Livestock and poultry pig farm inspection method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent breeding inspection, and particularly discloses a livestock and poultry pig farm inspection method and system based on artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the steps: receiving image information obtained by a monitoring end, and marking a breeding unit according to the image information and the installation position of the monitoring end; counting the marked breeding units, and determining sampling points; and when the motion end moves to a sampling point, inquiring and playing audio information in a preset audio library, obtaining feedback audio of the animal, and judging whether to collect a close-range image based on the feedback audio. The animal image is obtained through a traditional monitoring camera, the animal image is intelligently recognized, then the inspection instruction of the moving end is determined, and in the inspection process of the moving end, the moving end interacts with the animal through audio information and determines whether to obtain the close-shot image according to the feedback audio of the animal; and an intelligent identification process is added on the basis of an original monitoring architecture, so that the working pressure of workers is greatly reduced.
applicants: SUZHOU SHUZHI FUNONG INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Pig grouping feeding management device and system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of animal breeding, and relates to a pig grouping feeding management device and system.The pig grouping feeding management device comprises an individual recognition module, an image obtaining module, a calculation control module and a column dividing module, and the individual recognition module is used for conducting individual recognition on pigs; the image acquisition module is used for acquiring back depth image data according to the individual recognition result; the calculation control module is used for inputting the back depth image data into a deep learning model and classifying the pigs; and the column dividing module is used for conveying the corresponding pigs to the corresponding ingestion areas according to the classification result. The system is used for solving the problems that in the prior art, a wagon balance is damaged and pig individuals are not accurately managed and monitored, a new management system is provided for pig group feeding, the animal welfare can be effectively improved, the individual behavior state and weight change of the pigs can be monitored every day, and accurate management of the pigs is facilitated.

title: Ruminant carbon emission gas detection method, device and system
abstract: The invention provides a ruminant carbon emission gas detection method, device and system, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent detection.The ruminant carbon emission gas detection method comprises the steps that ear tag information, collected by an identity information recognition module, of a ruminant within a monitoring range is continuously received; deciding the operation state of the bait supply system based on the ear tag information; and under the condition of determining that the bait supply system is in the continuous action state, determining the emission rate of carbon emission gas in the emission gas according to the collected emission gas when the ruminant is in the ready-to-eat state. According to the ruminant carbon emission gas detection method, the ruminant carbon emission gas detection device and the ruminant carbon emission gas detection system provided by the invention, whether the ruminant exists in the detection area and the feeding information of the ruminant are judged by detecting the ear tag information of the ruminant, so that the operation state of the bait supply system is controlled; the emission rate of the carbon emission gas matched with the identity of the ruminant animal is obtained, and the quantity of the carbon emission gas of the ruminant animal can be detected with few people.
applicants: INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECHNOLOGY CENTER, BEIJING ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY SCIENCES

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR ASSESSING LIVESTOCK WELFARE BASED ON THE ANALYSIS OF ANIMALS VOCALIZATION AUDIO SIGNALS
abstract: The present invention relates to a novel method for assessing livestock welfare, especially poultry birds, based on the analysis of animals' vocalization audio signals. With a set of five acoustic features (the Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients MFCC3, MFCC4 and MFCC6, the number of livestock animal vocalizations per unit of time, and the pitch feature), the method of the invention provides with real-time or short time forecast of one or more livestock animal productive indicators. This allows them to monitor and control animal welfare in a non-invasive and continuous way at any given time, taking better and faster corrective actions to guarantee animal well-being and high-quality products while maximizing productivity and profit. In addition, the method of the invention allows farmers to guarantee the welfare state of the livestock animal/s sold to a customer both prior (main location) and during transportation (secondary location).

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR IMPROVING LIVESTOCK HEALTH AND PERFORMANCE
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method of improving health, performance, or a combination thereof for one or more livestock animals is provided. The present systems and methods predict an appropriate intervention for improving animal health, performance, or a combination thereof based on biomarker data.

title: Centralized heating automatic temperature adjusting system for livestock breeding industry
abstract: The invention discloses a central heating automatic temperature regulation system for livestock breeding industry, which comprises a control terminal, and the output end of the control terminal is connected with the input end of a big data network module. And the output end of the big data network module is connected with the input ends of the first wireless watchband type temperature sensor, the second wireless watchband type temperature sensor and the third wireless watchband type temperature sensor. Through the first wireless watchband type temperature sensor, the second wireless watchband type temperature sensor and the third wireless watchband type temperature sensor, a plurality of wireless watchband type temperature sensors can be bound to the legs of the animal husbandry, so that the temperature of a plurality of animal husbandry individuals is monitored, and the automatic temperature regulation temperature in a breeding shed is judged; compared with an integral temperature measurement and temperature regulation mode, individual monitoring temperature regulation data is more accurate.
applicants: BAODING ANIMAL HUSBANDRY WORKSTATION (BAODING FEED INDUSTRY OFFICE, BAODING GRASSLAND SUPERVISION AND MANAGEMENT STATION)

title: Intelligent livestock nameplate with information collection function
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent animal husbandry nameplate with an information collection function, and relates to the technical field of animal husbandry, the animal husbandry nameplate comprises a nameplate body and a positioning mechanism arranged on the nameplate body and used for fixing the nameplate body on an ear of an animal, and the right end of the nameplate body is provided with a functional block; the functional block comprises a step counting unit used for recording the number of walking steps of the livestock every day, a physiological statistics unit used for counting vaccines taken in the livestock growth process, a positioning unit used for positioning the position of the livestock and a wireless unit used for interacting with a terminal, and the wireless unit can be a radio frequency card. According to the livestock information collection device, various information of livestock can be collected, disassembly and assembly of a nameplate are facilitated, dust removal operation is performed according to livestock habits, in addition, mosquito repellent liquid can be quantitatively scattered according to the livestock habits, and harm of mosquitoes to the livestock is reduced.

title: Detecting estrus in animals for insemination
abstract: A method for detecting estrus in sows where insemination is carried out when a determination has been made. In a first method images of a rear profile of each sow are analyzed to make a determination from features relating to a shape, size, and/or color of the vulva whether the sow is in estrus. The analysis can use a program where a large number of images showing the vulva area of a plurality of sows known to be in estrus and known not to be in estrus have been previously analyzed to generate data on the previous images to create a program which generates a signal using the data to make the determination. In a second method a boar is confined and brought into close contact with the sows where images and/or sounds of each sow are analyzed to make a determination whether the sow is in estrus.

title: Smart Stable having eco-friendly energy
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a smart livestock shed comprises: a solar power generation module including a solar panel; and a livestock excrement treatment device operated by electric energy generated through the solar power generation module. the livestock excrement treatment device comprises: an excrement collector collecting excrement of livestock; an excrement treatment device for treating the excrement of the livestock in a specific state by the excrement collector; and an excrement discharger discharging the excrement of the livestock treated in the specific state through the excrement treatment device.

title: Monitoring device and livestock breeding intelligent management system
abstract: The invention is suitable for the field of livestock breeding, and discloses a monitoring device and a livestock breeding intelligent management system.The livestock breeding intelligent management system comprises the monitoring device and a control center, and the monitoring device comprises a visual collection assembly, a transverse movement assembly and a longitudinal movement assembly; the longitudinal moving assembly comprises a first longitudinal moving mechanism and a second longitudinal moving mechanism which are arranged in parallel, the two ends of the transverse moving assembly are connected with the first longitudinal moving mechanism and the second longitudinal moving mechanism respectively, and the visual collecting assembly is arranged on the transverse moving assembly. The first longitudinal moving mechanism and the second longitudinal moving mechanism jointly act on the transverse moving assembly, and the transverse moving assembly and the longitudinal moving assembly are arranged to drive the visual collecting assembly to transversely move and longitudinally move, so that the position of the visual collecting assembly relative to livestock can be adjusted according to the actual position of the livestock; the livestock image information can be remotely acquired, and high-resolution livestock image information can be acquired at a short distance.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR A DISTRIBUTED LEDGER TRACKING ANIMALS
abstract: System, method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage media for allowing creating a record of an animal on a distributed ledger such as a blockchain. The animals have tags which, when read using a livestock tag reader, allow the owners of the animals to update the animal records with information about the animal, such as health and/or location data. The updated record can then be cryptographically signed and transmitted to a network server which verifies that the cryptographic signature corresponds to an owner's cryptographic signature for the animal.

title: Intelligent sow feeding system
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent sow feeding system and belongs to the technical field of pig feeding. The problems that the existing sow feeding amount control accuracy is poor, and the accuracy of manually collecting the body temperature and the body weight of the sow is low are solved. An inlet section structure and an outlet section structure are both channel type structures defined by fences, and the fences of the two channel type structures are connected at an obtuse angle; an automatic control door is arranged at an inlet of the inlet section structure, and a one-way door is arranged at an outlet of the outlet section structure. The feed trough and the automatic feed adding mechanism are arranged at the joint of the two sections of channel type structures; an electronic ear tag is attached to the ear of each pig; the wireless ear tag collector identifies the label of the electronic ear tag located in a collection area through the wireless radio frequency technology, the upper computer judges whether the food intake of the pig corresponding to the received label of the electronic ear tag reaches the maximum feeding amount of the pig on the day or not in real time, and if the feeding amount of the pig on the day does not reach the maximum feeding amount of the pig on the day, the wireless ear tag collector is started. If yes, an opening control signal is sent to the door entering driving mechanism. The feed is suitable for feeding sows.

title: Live pig health monitoring method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a live pig health monitoring method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and is applied to the field of live pig breeding, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the image information of a target live pig shot by a first camera unit, the image information comprising the live pig shape and the identity label of the live pig; estimating the weight of the target live pig according to the shape of the live pig to obtain the estimated weight of the target live pig, and determining an abnormal identity label with the estimated weight outside a preset standard weight range; comparing the live pig shape corresponding to the abnormal identity with an abnormal posture preset in a posture database; if the abnormal posture consistent with the shape of the live pig exists in the posture database, judging that the live pig corresponding to the abnormal identity label is in a sick state; and sending the abnormal identity identifier to an intelligent terminal of the farmer. The pig house has the technical effects that a breeder can know the sick condition of the live pigs in time and treat the sick live pigs in time, so that the survival rate of the live pigs in the pig house is improved.

title: Power generation system based on dynamic livestock breeding
abstract: A power generation system based on livestock dynamic breeding comprises a channel system used for enabling livestock to move from a first preset position to a second preset position; the rotating wheel system is used for loading livestock and enabling the rotating wheel system to rotate; the transfer waiting system is used for gathering the livestock arriving at the second preset position and conveying the livestock to the rotating wheel system; the power generation equipment is used for being connected to the rotating wheel system and generating electric energy; the ascending channel system comprises a channel device used for supporting the walking of the livestock and constraining the movement range of the livestock; the at least one driving device is used for driving the livestock; and the at least one monitoring device is used for detecting the position and the motion state of the livestock and controlling the driving device.

title: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention relates to an animal husbandry system, wherein a group of animals (2) can move about freely in an area (1), the system comprising monitoring and analyzing means (11) suitable for determining and tracking the identity and the position of each individual animal (2), wherein lameness detection means operatively connected to the monitoring and analyzing means (11) are provided, suitable for the early detection of lameness in an animal (2), the lameness detection means being arranged to take into account at least one of the following parameters measured with the aid of the monitoring and analyzing means (11): - lying down time of the animal (2) in a certain time interval; - distance covered by the animal (2) in a certain time interval; - speed of movement of the animal (2) in a certain time interval (top speed and/or average speed and/or speed stability); - time spent by the animal (2) in zones of the area having a particular animal density characteristic. The use of monitoring and analyzing means (11) enables an automatic and accurate early lameness detection in animals (2) moving about freely in an area (1). The early detection of lameness in animals (2) can prevent serious health complications for the animals (2) in question.

title: Intelligent animal husbandry and veterinary examination device
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent animal husbandry and veterinary examination device which comprises an examination ring for placing livestock and a plurality of wide-angle cameras mounted in the examination ring, a springboard for allowing the livestock to stand is arranged on the inlet side of the examination ring, and a piston disc is axially mounted in a buffer tube in a movable sealing and sliding manner. The side, away from the closed end, of the piston disc is fixedly connected with a piston rod, the piston rod is connected with the end of a steel cable, the steel cable winds around the pulleys and then is wound around the reel, the sliding column is axially installed in the buffer pipe in a sliding mode, and a hydraulic rod is axially installed at the end, away from the closed end, of the buffer pipe. The free end of the hydraulic rod directly faces the piston disc and keeps a certain distance from the piston disc; the end of the sliding column is connected with a valve plate which is vertically arranged in a sliding mode through a steel wire wound on a plurality of idler wheels, a strip hole is formed in one end of the valve plate, and the end, where the strip hole is located, of the valve plate is connected to the inner top wall of the closed end through a reset spring. The livestock detection efficiency is high, and liquid medicine can be sprayed to livestock in a targeted mode.

title: Intelligent pig house monitoring system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent breeding, in particular to an intelligent pig house monitoring system. Comprising a processing end and an intelligent terminal, and the processing end comprises an acquisition unit, an identification unit, a comparison unit, a processing unit, a breeding database, an artificial intelligence system and a data synchronization unit. The intelligent hog house monitoring system provided by the invention can perform real-time monitoring and timely take corresponding emergency management measures according to the types of abnormal emergencies occurring in the breeding process based on the breeding database and the artificial intelligence system, the sensitivity of system monitoring is in a reasonable interval, the response processing process is sensitive and reliable, and the system is convenient to use. The system improves the emergency management capability of sudden abnormal conditions, can reduce the supervision dependence on manpower, reduces the labor difficulty, and also overcomes the difficulty from experience-based cultivation to digital cultivation. Based on the comparison unit, a two-time judgment mode is adopted, so that data acquisition errors can be greatly reduced, and emergency response can be timely, accurately and effectively carried out.

title: Intelligent monitoring and analyzing system for breeding sheep breeding based on visual monitoring
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring and analyzing system for breeding sheep breeding based on visual monitoring. Comprising a breeding area monitoring equipment setting module, a stud ram physique monitoring terminal wearing module, a breeding period division module, a breeding database, a breeding process stud ram growth monitoring and analysis module, an end-of-breeding stud ram mating conformity monitoring and analysis module, a stud ram comprehensive breeding quality evaluation module and a background display terminal. When the breeding quality of the breeding rams is supervised, the breeding rams of the current breeding batch are subjected to breeding period division, so that the breeding quality of each breeding ram is monitored in each breeding period and after the breeding is finished, and the breeding quality analysis is performed based on the monitoring result of the breeding process and the monitoring result of the breeding completion; the comprehensive coverage breeding quality monitoring of the whole breeding process of the rams is realized, historical development tracing is facilitated, and hidden dangers of monitoring results are avoided to a certain extent.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA SAINUO BREEDING SHEEP TECHNOLOGY COMPANY; XILINGOL VOCATIONAL COLLEGE

title: Apparatus for monitoring the biological condition of pregnant breeding cattle
abstract: The present invention relates to a pregnant breeding cattle vital state monitoring device comprising: a learning data collection part for generating a plurality of learning data by selecting and using at least two among an insertion-type device, an attachment-type device, and an imaging device as a learning data collection device; a prediction model learning part for pre-learning a prediction model through the plurality of learning data; a device cooperation criterion setting part for collecting and analyzing sensing data acquired through the learning data collection device to derive and store a device cooperation criterion; a device cooperation performing part for pre-processing the sensing data of the monitoring device according to the device cooperation criterion when at least one among the learning data collection devices is selected as a monitoring device; and a vital state prediction part for predicting and outputting a vital state corresponding to the pre-processed sensing data through the prediction model, wherein the prediction model has at least one among activity amount, temperature, pressure, pulse, activity content, location information, and first-wave point as an input condition and at least one among an estrus index, a delivery index, and a health index as an output condition.

title: A METHOD OF MANAGING THE AMOUNT OF FEED FOR LIVESTOCK
abstract: The disclosure relates to a method for managing the amount of feed for livestock. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for managing the amount of feed for livestock, which is executed on a computer system based on an artificial intelligence model, includes: a step of collecting data about individual livestock and cattle shed environment, wherein the data includes data received from at least one livestock attachment sensor; a step of generating an individual livestock model for inferring a production amount of milk and a feed intake amount of the livestock by using the collected data; a step of analyzing individual livestock data by using the generated individual livestock model; and a step of determining an optimal feed amount of the individual livestock. The purpose of the present invention is to provide the optimal feed amount to achieve maximum productivity and reduce carbon emission.

title: Livestock adoption monitoring system and method based on block chain and Internet of Things
