abstract: The invention provides a livestock acceptance monitoring system and method based on a block chain and Internet of Things, and the system comprises an Internet of Things monitoring module which collects the growth information and acceptance data of accepted livestock, and transmits the growth information and acceptance data to a data collection and transmission module; the data acquisition and transmission module is used for receiving the data sent by the Internet of Things monitoring module and sending the data to the data storage module; the data storage module is used for receiving the data sent by the data acquisition and transmission module, carrying out storage and uplink processing, and returning a storage certificate to the data acquisition and transmission module; the livestock internet-of-things module is used for receiving the accreditation data and the evidence storage voucher sent by the data acquisition and transmission module; and the livestock acceptance supervision module receives the evidence storage voucher sent by the data evidence storage platform and the acceptance data and the evidence storage voucher sent by the livestock Internet of Things module, and performs monitoring based on the received evidence storage voucher sent by the data evidence storage platform and the received evidence storage voucher sent by the livestock Internet of Things module.

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR INVENTORY MANAGEMENT OF LIVESTOCK BASED ON IMAGE
abstract: According to one embodiment of the present invention, an image-based livestock inventory management device includes: a data transmission/reception module; a memory storing an image-based livestock inventory management program; and a processor executing the program stored in the memory, wherein the program inputs images collected from at least one camera that captures images in which an entrance/exit of each livestock room is set as one ROI area into a livestock object detection model to detect each livestock object, accumulates and stores coordinates of each detected livestock object to track the movement status of each livestock object, counts the entry and exit actions of each livestock object at the entrance/exit of each livestock room for each ROI area to generate entry/exit status information of each livestock room, and provides inventory information including an initial value of the number of livestock objects accommodated in each livestock room and the real-time number of livestock objects for each livestock room based on the entry/exit status information.

title: Monitoring system for beef cattle breeding
abstract: The invention discloses a monitoring system for beef cattle breeding. The monitoring system comprises a feeding trough, a trough body cleaning assembly and a feeding monitoring assembly. The trough body cleaning assembly is located in the feeding trough, and the feeding monitoring assembly is connected to the top of the feeding trough; the feeding monitoring assembly comprises a connecting part, a camera, a signal transmitter, an industrial personal computer and a signal receiver; and the signal transmitter is connected to a beef cattle ear. The feeding trough is provided with the feeding monitoring assembly, the feeding time and the feeding state of beef cattle can be monitored according to the feeding state of the beef cattle, the health state of the beef cattle is judged, the initial feeding time is recorded through a signal transmitter and a signal receiver in the feeding monitoring assembly, and meanwhile the feeding state is recorded through a camera; the industrial personal computer is used for collecting monitoring information, if the feeding time is short or the appetite is inappetence, the health problem of the beef cattle can be judged, so that timely inspection and treatment are facilitated, the health state of the beef cattle can be automatically monitored, and the automation of cattle raising is improved.

title: VIRTUAL LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT
abstract: A system for virtual management of livestock includes a server computer, a primary collar, and a plurality of secondary collars. The server computer receives virtual boundary data, as a user input, which establishes a virtual boundary. The primary collar is worn by and associated with a primary livestock animal and communicates with the server computer via a remote wireless gateway. The plurality of secondary collars communicate wirelessly with one another and with the primary collar via an ad hoc wireless mesh network. Each of the secondary collars is worn by and associated with an individual secondary livestock animal of a plurality of secondary livestock animals. The primary collar receives the virtual boundary data from the server computer, transmits it to the plurality of secondary collars via the wireless mesh network, and provides directional stimulation to the primary livestock animal to encourage it to refrain from crossing the virtual boundary.

title: Pig farm body temperature monitoring equipment based on Internet of Things
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of body temperature monitoring, and discloses pig farm body temperature monitoring equipment based on Internet of Things, which comprises a base, a plurality of uniformly distributed chutes are formed in the top of the base, one end of each chute faces the center of the top of the base, and the other end of each chute faces the edge of the top of the base. The top of the sliding piece is detachably connected with a splicing piece, one end of the splicing piece is inserted into the splicing piece located on one side of the splicing piece, the pig house is formed by the closed space defined by the splicing pieces, and during automatic feeding, the first rotating piece pulls the traction line to enable the second rotating piece to relieve fixation of the splicing pieces, so that the splicing pieces are not prone to falling off; the sliding part is arranged on the fixed part, so that the sliding part is close to the fixed part along with the sliding part, the closed space is reduced, and the temperature of the live pigs close to the sliding part can be accurately measured and recorded through an automatic temperature measuring recorder when the live pigs are fed.
applicants: GUIZHOU HUANGNIU INDUSTRY GROUP TECHNOLOGY SERVICE CO., LTD.; GUIZHOU UNIVERSITY

title: High-precision automatic weight estimation method applied to pig farm
abstract: The invention discloses a high-precision automatic weight estimation method applied to a pig farm, and the method specifically comprises the following steps: dividing a breeding fence into two space regions, and arranging at least one communication channel in the two space regions; an intelligent weight estimation module is erected right above the communication channel; carrying out size calibration on the acquired pig image, and carrying out weight estimation according to the calibrated size; performing mean value operation on the multiple estimated weights of each pig to obtain a final estimated weight; analyzing the weight gain condition of the pig according to the weight estimation result, and associating the weight gain condition with the feed feeding amount; a feeding area and a water drinking area of a fence of a pig farm are separated, and a communication channel is arranged, so that pigs can pass through the position below an intelligent weighing unit in a standing state, pig images can be rapidly obtained, size calibration and weight estimation can be conveniently carried out, and the intelligent weight estimation module is extremely rapid and convenient to use; and the device is not polluted and is more convenient to maintain.
applicants: HEFEI JIANGXIN ATSUSHI INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS OF LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT
abstract: A system and method of livestock management comprising a device disposed in a livestock animal. The device comprises a network interface, a housing defining a cavity, a weighted element, a power supply, a data processing unit, a temperature sensor and an accelerometer. The temperature sensor acquires temperature data of the livestock animal. The accelerometer acquires movement data of the livestock animal. The cavity includes a data processing system having at least one processor and memory. The data processing system is coupled with the power source and communicatively coupled with the temperature sensor and the accelerometer. The data processing system transmits, via the network interface, temperature data and movement data. The cavity includes an activation receiver to receive activation signal to activate the data processing system. A livestock management server receives and analyzes the data, along with any data from any additional data sources, and provides output to a user interface.

title: Automatic livestock system for milking cows
abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an automatic cowshed system for raising milking cows, which comprises a milking exercise area in which milking cows can move freely, a smart gate that identifies information about the milking cow is formed on one side of the exercise area, and a milking parlor installed on one side of the exercise area so as to be connected to the smart gate. An automatic cowshed system for raising milking cows includes a cowshed; a smart gate; a milking parlor; an automatic manure treatment device; a feed tank; a water tank; a manure storage area; and an entry door.

title: Temperature measurement method based on living body breeding
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of animal breeding, and discloses a living body breeding-based temperature measurement method, which comprises the following steps: S1, ear tag disinfection: putting an ear tag into medical alcohol to be soaked for a period of time for disinfection treatment; s2, installing a temperature measuring device; s3, ear tag installation; s4, the bred pigs are marked with ear tags; s5, adjusting the temperature measuring device; s6, checking the temperature in real time; the temperature measuring device is installed on the ear tag, the temperature sensor in the temperature measuring device is attached to the ear of the pig to sense the body temperature of the bred pig, and the data acquisition device transmits a temperature signal to the temperature management platform and displays the temperature signal, so that the body temperature of the bred pig can be monitored in real time, the measurement is simple and convenient, and the efficiency is high; the threaded sleeve is rotated to be screwed out from the outer portion of the threaded rod, the temperature sensor is driven to push the pig ear towards one side, the pig ear is clamped between the temperature sensor and the ear label, the temperature sensor can be attached to the pig ear all the time, and therefore the most accurate body temperature value of the bred pig can be obtained.
applicants: XIAMEN TANGPU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: AI Livestock shed target management system through the AI analysis
abstract: Accordingly, the purpose of the present invention is to provide a livestock target management system through AI analysis that can improve reliability and management efficiency. A livestock target management system using AI analysis includes: a biometric information unit for checking the biometric information of each livestock object; an imaging unit for taking images of a livestock pen; and a control unit for receiving signals from the imaging unit and each biometric information unit and detecting specific behavior through AI analysis.

title: Monitoring and early warning equipment based on Internet of Things technology
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of livestock breeding, relates to a data analysis technology, is used for solving the problem that the existing monitoring and early warning equipment based on the Internet of Things technology cannot match the suitable environment of livestock and poultry in combination with the growth state, disease state and environmental influence factors of the livestock and poultry, and particularly relates to monitoring and early warning equipment based on the Internet of Things technology. Comprising an animal husbandry monitoring platform, and the animal husbandry monitoring platform is in communication connection with a growth detection module, an environment matching module, a disease analysis module, an exception handling module and a storage module; the growth detection module is used for carrying out growth detection on livestock and poultry in a livestock breeding factory and judging whether the growth state of the livestock and poultry meets requirements or not; according to the method, the matching range is obtained through data analysis in combination with the forward coefficient and the disease coefficient in an environment stage segmentation mode, the matching range is the optimal environment coefficient range of the livestock breeding factory in the current stage, and then the growth state of livestock is improved through the environment.

title: Animal husbandry system
abstract: The present invention relates to an animal husbandry system, wherein a group of animals (2) can move about freely in an area (1), the system comprising identification means suitable for determining the identity of each individual animal (2), tracking means suitable for tracking the position of each individual animal (2), and attention means suitable for identifying an attention animal having a predetermined condition, wherein the system is suitable for automatically determining a subgroup of animals (2) that have been in a predetermined relationship with the attention animal. The determination of such a subgroup is highly useful. For example, it can be established whether the animals (2) in the subgroup also have the predetermined condition of the attention animal. This is helpful in order to be able to contain the spreading of the predetermined condition, if this is desired. Thus, a user-friendly, animal-friendly and safe animal husbandry system is realized.

title: METHOD FOR A DIRECTED ANIMAL TRAFFIC, AND MILKING INSTALLATION
abstract: The invention relates to a method for controlling the flow of traffic of animals (1), said method being carried out at least partially automatedly, and to a milking installation which has the method features. On the basis of the animal density in at least one specifiable detection region (2.1, 2.2), a directing unit (4) can be automatically adjusted according to the method, said directing unit allowing, facilitating, or preventing the passage of the animals through a corridor (8). According to advantageous embodiments, the operation of a cow pusher and a carousel milking station is also controlled on the basis of the detected data.

The object of the present invention is to improve a method of measuring the weight gain, body temperature change, and body mass index of pigs raised in a pigpen. The present invention relates to a pigpen having an air inlet and an air outlet formed on a side surface of a wall and having a fan, equipped with a pig growth measurement device, wherein a central lighting fixture is installed on the ceiling, a body temperature measurement unit for measuring the body temperature of a pig with infrared rays is provided below the lighting, and the floor of the pigsty is provided in a double layer so that the excrement and urine excreted by the pig can be discharged downward. Also, an exhaust port is provided on the floor of the pigpen so that cleaning is possible, and a weight scale for measuring the weight of a pig passing by is provided in the center of the floor of the pigpen. A feed supply unit and a water supply unit are provided separately on the left and right sides of the weight scale, respectively. The present invention enables the growth information of a pig to be confirmed by measuring the body temperature.

The present invention aims to provide a method for scientifically raising pigs, which have been raised by relying on human senses. A pigsty with an air inlet and an air outlet formed on the side of a wall and equipped with a fan is characterized by having a lighting fixture in the center of the ceiling, a body temperature measuring unit for measuring the body temperature of pigs, an exhaust port for cleaning on the floor of the pigsty, a scale for measuring the weight of pigs passing by on the center of the floor of the pigsty, a feed supply unit and a water supply unit provided in a separate manner, and a body mass measuring device for measuring body mass. The present invention has the effect of comprehensively evaluating changes in body mass index according to the amount of feed supplied, changes in body mass index according to the type of feed, feed efficiency, etc.

title: Livestock house monitoring apparatus using body temperature and image tracking
abstract: An objective of the present invention is to provide a livestock monitoring device using body temperature and image tracking. The livestock monitoring device is equipped with: a plurality of livestock terminals mounted on the ears of each of a plurality of livestocks within a barn and are equipped with wireless communication modules and body temperature measurement sensors to provide together the measured body temperature information of the livestock with the identification information of the livestock; at least one camera that photographs the livestock within the barn and provides real-time image information; and a monitoring server that receives identification information and body temperature information from a livestock terminal, selects livestock with the highest and lowest body temperatures and stores the identification information, identifies livestock selected from a camera image and tracks in real-time, and analyzes behavioral data using a deep learning-based AI algorithm to determine whether there are any abnormalities and provides the information to an administrator terminal. According to the present invention, management costs and labor costs can be reduced since abnormalities can be automatically monitored, thereby having an advantage of allowing for efficient management.

title: POULTRY BREEDING FARM MANAGEMENT DEVICE
abstract: A management device for managing a poultry breeding facility comprises: a body unit; a sensor unit connected to the body unit to collect environmental information of the poultry breeding facility; an image photographing unit connected to the body unit to collect image information of the poultry breeding facility; a movement inducing unit connected to the body unit to induce movement of poultry inside the poultry breeding facility; a power providing unit connected to the body unit to provide power so that the management device can move along a predetermined trajectory; a trajectory providing unit coupled to one side of the power providing unit to provide a trajectory so that the management device can move along a predetermined path; a litter discharge unit connected to the body unit to discharge litter into the poultry breeding facility; and a control unit controlling the sensor unit, the image photographing unit, the movement inducing unit, the power providing unit, and the litter discharge unit.

title: Lamb nursing device
abstract: The technical problem to be solved by the invention is to provide the lamb nursing device which is convenient to record food intake and weight change of each lamb, digitizes the food intake and weight change, keeps constant temperature of lactation liquid, can adjust the height of the lactation device according to the growth condition of the lambs, and effectively improves the nursing effect. The lamb nursing device comprises a breeding house body, at least one lamb feed supplementing groove and a lamb lactation device are arranged in the breeding house body, a constant-temperature heating device used for heating lactation liquid and a control assembly are arranged in the breeding house body, and data information is collected through an ear tag recognizer and a flow sensor; the controller arranges identity information and feed intake information of the lambs and stores the information through the data storage device, the weighing device is used for body weight collection, data analysis is conducted in cooperation with the feed intake, the relation between the feed intake and the growth condition of each lamb can be effectively mastered, and the lamb feeding device is suitable for being applied and popularized in the technical field of breeding.
applicants: SICHUAN ANIMAL HUSBANDRY SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title: Livestock drinking water weighing system
abstract: The invention discloses a livestock drinking water weighing system, and relates to the technical field of livestock breeding equipment. Comprising a main frame, a protection device, a water storage device, an identification device, a weighing device and a control device, the main frame is provided with a weighing channel for single livestock to walk, the protection device is provided with a protection cavity, and the water storage device is arranged in the protection cavity; the identification device begins to identify individual information of the livestock when the head of the livestock begins or completely extends into the protection cavity, continuously identifies until the head of the livestock begins or completely retreats from the protection cavity, and continuously sends the individual information; the weighing device continuously weighs the livestock in the weighing channel and continuously sends weight information; and the control device receives and records individual information and weight information when the head of the livestock starts or completely extends into the protection cavity and individual information and weight information when the head of the livestock starts or completely retreats from the protection cavity. The livestock drinking water weighing system provided by the invention is convenient for weighing livestock and recording the drinking water condition, and is convenient for judging the growth condition of the livestock.
applicants: INNER MONGOLIA HUIYANG BIOTECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.; INNER MONGOLIA UNIVERSITY; BEIJING HUAMU TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.; URAD ZHONGQI MINYANG ANIMAL HUSBANDRY COMPANY; INNER MONGOLIA AUTONOMOUS REGION ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL & ANIMAL HUSBANDRY SCIENCES; INNER MONGOLIA HAOKUAI TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: APPARATUS FOR MEASURING THE EXERCISE VITALITY OF HERD-BREEDING LIVESTOCK AND METHOD THEREOF
abstract: According to the present invention, physiological exercise vitality of livestock can be evaluated, accumulated and observed as data to identify and respond to stress conditions or signs of disease of livestock at an early stage, and can be used as effective decision-making data for breeding management to increase productivity and increase profits of farmers. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a livestock herd vitality measurement device comprises: an image acquisition unit acquiring a livestock breeding space image photographed in real time; and an activity amount measurement unit identifying a livestock entity to measure an activity amount. The activity amount measurement unit comprises: an entity identification unit extracting an individual image frame from the real-time image photographing the livestock breeding space and identifying livestock to be measured within the image frame; a measurement unit comparing an image of the image frame with an image at a specific past time point to measure a moving distance or a moving speed of the livestock entity identified by the entity identification unit; and a calculation unit calculating an activity index of a livestock herd by using the moving distance or the moving speed measured by the measurement unit to measure vitality.

title: System and Method for Monitoring the pigpen stable using thermal imaging camera and error calibration algorism
abstract: The present invention proposes an error correction algorithm to solve the problem of measurement error of a thermal imaging camera while utilizing an existing commercially available thermal imaging camera as it is, and thereby proposes a method for properly utilizing a thermal imaging camera in a livestock farm by correcting the measurement error accordingly. The pig hen monitoring system applying a thermal imaging camera and an error correction algorithm includes: an image acquisition unit that acquires a photographed image from a thermal imaging camera installed in a pig hen; a temperature detection unit that detects the surface temperature of livestock in a pig hen and derives surface temperature data; a correction criterion generation unit that generates an error correction algorithm for the surface temperature data of livestock and generates a correction criterion; a correction unit that corrects the surface temperature data of livestock detected by the temperature detection unit according to the correction criterion; an abnormality determination unit that determines whether an abnormality condition occurs in livestock by determining whether the surface temperature of the livestock corrected by the correction unit falls within a preset standard temperature range; and an abnormality notification unit that notifies the occurrence of an abnormality condition to a user terminal.
applicants: INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF SUNCHON NATIONAL UNIVERSITY

title: METHOD AND ARRANGEMENT FOR GROWTH MONITORING OF FARM ANIMALS BY MEANS OF IMAGE ANALYSIS
abstract: A method for surveillance and analysis of animals (111) is provided, the method comprising the steps of detecting an identification marker of an animal (111), associating said detected identification marker with an animal ID, detecting a growth indicator of the animal (111), associating the detected growth indicator with said animal ID, comparing the growth indicator with a predetermined growth target, and, if the growth indicator meets the growth target, generating an alert.

title: Livestock manure automatic processing device and system
abstract: The present invention provides an automatic livestock manure treatment device and a smart livestock management system using the same, wherein the device includes: a livestock house divided into a mobile livestock space where livestock are raised and moved, and a reserve livestock space where the moved livestock temporarily stay; a mobile livestock house configured in the mobile livestock space and coupled to enable movement from both sides of the livestock house toward the center, to move livestock staying in the mobile livestock space; a manure discharge means for collecting manure of livestock existing on the floor of the mobile livestock space and discharging the collected manure; a manure treatment unit which stores the discharged manure and agitates and dries the stored manure; and a solar power generation system which generates power to drive the automatic livestock manure treatment device.

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING THE FEED AMOUNT BASED ON THE LIVESTOCK'S INTENTION TO EAT FEED
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus for controlling a feed supply amount based on a feed intake intention of livestock and a method thereof. the apparatus for controlling a feed supply amount based on a feed intake intention of livestock according to the present invention comprises: a feed intake intention quantification unit for grasping a feed intake intention of livestock by using image information obtained by photographing a predetermined area in a livestock farm and quantifying the feed intake intention as a feed intake intention value; and a feed intake intention-based feed supply amount control unit for generating a command for controlling a feed supply amount in consideration of the feed intake intention value.

title: SYSTEMS AND COMPUTERIZED METHODS FOR LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT
abstract: A method includes receiving, by a client application executing on a mobile computing device, livestock information, the livestock information including one or more of information about a livestock facility or information about items of livestock at the livestock facility. The method also includes capturing, by the client application, images of the items of livestock at the livestock facility. Further, the method includes determining an identification of one of the items of livestock based at least partially on an analysis of one or more of the images that were captured. The method includes transmitting, by the client application, the livestock information, the images to an insurance server system, and the identification.

title: MONITORING LIVESTOCK IN BARNS
abstract: The present invention relates to a system and a method intended for automatic monitoring of a sow herd, and in particular of sows in insemination and gestation stables, where sows exhibiting health and welfare issues are identified and located, so that the farmer can quickly begin treatment.

title: NFT Development method of livestock-based NFT blockchain system in production and distribution model of urban livestock industry
abstract: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a livestock-based NFT blockchain system to maximize production and distribution profits by allowing urban residents to participate in livestock management, to reduce carbon emissions in livestock farms, to maximize the happiness of people and animals, and to expand convenience in the production and distribution model of urban livestock industry. In the production and distribution model of urban livestock industry, the livestock-based NFT blockchain system guarantees the uniqueness of livestock individual characteristics and group total quantity system and number of members in the livestock-based blockchain NFT issuance, voluntarily issues mobile gift certificates with distribution period and meat and price information inserted, conducts direct transactions, consignment breeding methods, and class member auctions to win the ownership of designated livestock for a period, distributes the profits based on the operating expenses payment standard of livestock on the total quantity shipment date or expected shipment date by individual and group as 1/N, produces a high-quality meat reservation production program and a breeding game operation system, and establishes a global protein source food security strategy by improving the productivity of safe high-quality meat and expanding the quality of innovative NFT distribution networks by analyzing big data collected through a user terminal (10).
applicants: KIM, YOUN SIL; CHOI, KYUNG SIK; KIM, TAEG SEOG; KIM, TAEG GU; KIM, CHUNG HUI; KIM, CHEOL HO

title: Porcine diarrhea data monitoring system and method based on wireless network
abstract: The invention discloses a pig diarrhea data monitoring system and method based on a wireless network, relates to the field of animal husbandry, and aims to solve the problems that in the pig breeding process, pig diarrhea data monitoring is time-consuming, labor-consuming and poor in real-time performance, and the method comprises the steps that pig vomit is monitored through a head camera; the pressure sensor monitors a pressure value when the pig moves; the weighing sensor monitors the weight of the pig; the tail camera monitors the excrement condition of the pig; the monitored vomit of the pig, the pressure value of the pig during movement, the weight of the pig, the excrement image of the pig, the intake water amount and the intake food amount of the pig are uploaded to a control room through a wireless communication device, and the control room carries out summarizing comparison and listing with data values of the state of the healthy pig. The method completely gets rid of the constraint that pig diarrhea data only depends on manual observation of breeding personnel, and monitoring of the pig diarrhea data saves time and labor and is high in real-time performance.
applicants: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND VETERINARY BRANCH OF HEILONGJIANG ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES

title: LED SMART POULTRY FARM MANAGEMENT SYSTEM USING FUNCTIONAL LED AND SENSOR NETWORK
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart poultry farm management system using functional LEDs and a sensor network. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the smart poultry farm management system using functional LEDs and a sensor network comprises: an LED light module for irradiating light in at least two wavelength bands having different functions; a vision recognition module for identifying broilers inside a poultry farm and generating individual management information derived from the movements of each broiler; an environment information collection module for sensing environmental information inside and outside the poultry farm; an environment management module including a plurality of devices for adjusting environmental conditions inside and outside the poultry farm; and a control module configured to control the operation of the LED light module and the environment management module using the individual management information and the environmental information. This configuration enables dynamic control of the LED light module and the environmental management devices according to the status of broilers and environmental information sensed via the sensor network, thereby maintaining optimal breeding conditions inside the poultry farm.

title: SMART TAG SYSTEM FOR LIVESTOCK
abstract: In one or more arrangements, a tag system for monitoring of livestock is presented. The system includes at least one tag and a control system communicatively connected to the tag. In one or more arrangements, the tag includes a housing and a connector configured to operably connect with the housing to facilitate attachment of the tag to an animal. The tag also includes a set of sensors. In one or more arrangements, the set of sensors includes a first temperature sensor configured to monitor a temperature of the animal (animal reference temperature), a second temperature sensor configured to monitor an ambient temperature (ambient reference temperature) of the environment where the animal is located, a gyroscopic sensor, and/or an accelerometer sensor. In one or more arrangements, the tag includes an electronic circuit positioned within the housing and configured to communicate data from the set of sensors to the control system.

title: Remote Cattle Detection and Trapping System
abstract: A remote cattle securing and trapping system that allows a virtual rancher to detect cattle entering or exiting a pen at a remote location using an image recognition subsystem that includes capturing images using a camera, that determines which motion activates an electronics communication subsystem to send images via a virtual platform to a virtual rancher, and the virtual platform can be utilized to activate a relay controlled latch system that opens or closes a cattle gate at the remote location.

title: METHOD AND PRODUCT FOR SICK ANIMAL IDENTIFICATION
abstract: The invention relates to a method and product destined for the rapid identification of sick animals in groups of large- population production animals or companion animals, without the assistance of a veterinarian for polygastric production animals, pets or monogastric production animals. The product comes in the form of a suppository and/or capsule. This suppository and/or capsule has a film casing (1) on which a specific number is printed or engraved and contains numbered balls (2) which have the same number printed or engraved as the film. This number corresponds exclusively to a specific animal. When the sick animal vomits or has diarrhea, it will expel the numbered balls for being thus identified among the herd.

title: Food intake detection device and feeding device
abstract: The invention relates to a food intake detection device and a feeding device, and relates to the technical field of breeding tools, and the food intake detection device is arranged above a trough; the food intake detection device comprises a mounting assembly, an induction circuit board and a test piece, the installation assembly is used for being fixed to a support or a wall. The induction circuit board is connected with the mounting assembly; one end of the test piece is connected with the installation assembly and electrically connected with the induction circuit board, and the other end extends into the trough. When livestock and poultry are fed in the feeding trough, the livestock and poultry touch the test piece, and the induction circuit board receives a signal that the test piece is touched, so that the test piece can test the feeding frequency of the livestock and poultry. The amount of food in the feeding trough can be judged through the test piece, so that an operator can add food according to the food intake of each feeding trough conveniently, waste of the food is avoided, and meanwhile the food intake requirement of livestock and poultry can be met.

title: Body Type Evaluation Device
abstract: The present invention provides a livestock body type measuring device capable of grasping a relationship between a body type and weight. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the livestock body type measuring device comprises: a frame forming a movement path of livestock in a first direction and including an upper frame and a side frame; a weight measuring unit disposed in a lower portion and disposed along the first direction; a plurality of cameras connected to the frame and disposed to photograph livestock on the weight measuring unit; and a control unit connected to the weight measuring unit and the camera. The camera includes an upper camera connected to the upper frame and a side camera connected to the side frame.

title: Livestock barn system for improving growth environment by acquiring biological information
abstract: The present invention relates to a livestock shed system for improving a growth environment by acquiring bio-information, which collects and manages information related to the growth of livestock in a breeding facility such as a livestock shed or a pigpen, and purifies pollutants including odor components and various pathogens to maintain a pleasant livestock environment and promote disease prevention and growth.

title: KPN APPARATUS FOR EXTRACTING GENETIC ABILITY VALUE USING KPN AND METHOD THEREROF
abstract: The present invention discloses an apparatus for extracting a genetic capacity value using Korean beef KPN. The apparatus comprises: a slaughter value extraction unit for extracting slaughter values for each slaughter age for KPN of cattle from a Korean beef DB; a representative value derivation unit for deriving a representative value of the slaughter values for each slaughter age for KPN from the slaughter values extracted by the slaughter value extraction unit; a deviation calculation unit for calculating a deviation from the representative value of the slaughter values for each slaughter age for KPN using the representative value derived by the representative value derivation unit; and an expected improvement rate derivation unit for obtaining an expected improvement rate of the slaughter values for each slaughter age for KPN using the deviation from the representative value calculated by the deviation calculation unit.

title: KPN APPARATUS FOR EXTRACTING ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS USING KPN AND METHOD THEREROF
abstract: The embodiments disclosed in the present specification have, as a technical objective, in providing a device and method capable of obtaining a slaughter value environment index by slaughter month for a Korean beef KPN of a specific farm so as to provide a basis for reference when purchasing Korean beef. The method comprises: a step of extracting slaughter values by slaughter month for a KPN of a target farm searched from a Korean beef DB; a step of deriving a representative value from the extracted slaughter values; a step of calculating a deviation of the slaughter values of the representative value using the representative value; a step of obtaining an absolute deviation of the slaughter value using an absolute value of the deviation; a step of searching the KPN and slaughter month of the target farm and an absolute deviation of a median of the slaughter value by KPN month that matches the KPN and slaughter month, from the median absolute deviation DB; and a step of obtaining the slaughter value environment factor by using the absolute deviation of the slaughter value by slaughter month for the KPN of the farm subject to the search and the absolute deviation of the median of the slaughter value by month of the searched KPN. According to the embodiment disclosed in the present specification, the present invention has an effect of being able to serve as a reference for determining how much the environment of a farm affects the raising of cattle when purchasing Korean beef by obtaining the slaughter value environment factor by slaughter month age for the KPN of the specific farm.

title: HEALTH STATE ASCERTAINING DEVICE, HEALTH STATE ASCERTAINING METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: Provided are a health state ascertaining device, etc., which enable certification that an animal such as livestock has lived healthily in mind and body throughout life, and which contribute to conferring food safety security and peace of mind to consumers. Specifically, provided is a health state ascertaining device including: a behavior data acquisition unit for acquiring behavior data which indicates the behavior of an animal and is acquired by monitoring or sensing the animal; a behavior data storage unit for storing the behavior data; and a health state inference unit for inferring the health state of the animal by using the behavior data.

title: System and method for testing poultry reactivity
abstract: A system for testing poultry reactivity comprises a camera, a processor, a beam generator and a beam direction control unit. The camera is used for receiving a plurality of first images of a poultry house, and the first images include at least one of the poultry area and the background area; the processor is used for calculating a first activity according to the first images, and determining whether the first activity is lower than a target activity threshold. The beam generator is used for emitting a beam. The beam direction control unit is used for moving the beam. If the first activity is lower than the target activity threshold, the beam is emitted through the beam generator and the beam is moved through the beam direction control unit to disturb the plurality of poultry in the poultry house.

title: Method for monitoring optimal pairing time of giant panda breeding male animal training
abstract: The invention provides a method for monitoring optimal mating time of giant panda breeding male animal training, and relates to the technical field of natural mating of captive animals. The method comprises the following steps: S1, in a conventional breeding period, placing an oestrus female panda with a breeding history and natural mating experience in a mating room, arranging an independent animal house on each of two sides of the mating room, and placing two adult male individuals in the animal houses respectively, male panda oestrus is induced; s2, collecting urine samples of the female pandas in the mating room. According to the method, the female panda reproductive hormone level and behavior change are utilized to reasonably arrange the male animal estrus test pairing time, and cage closing is performed from the female panda estradiol peak to the progesterone descending gap and when the female panda has a to-be-mated posture, so that the natural mating success rate is increased, the injury caused by asynchronous oestrus of male and female individuals can be effectively reduced, and the survival rate of the female panda is increased. The utilization rate of the breeding male animals is further improved.
applicants: QINLING GIANT PANDA RESEARCH CENTER (SHAANXI PROVINCE RARE WILDNESS ANIMAL RESCUE BASE)

title: Feed supply device for barn
abstract: A feed supply device for a barn according to the present invention may comprise: a running unit having running wheels; a feed storage unit located above the running unit to contain feed and having an outlet formed at the bottom for discharging feed; a feed supply unit located at the bottom of the feed storage unit to supply the feed discharged through the outlet to feeding troughs for livestock positioned on one side or both sides of the running unit; a detection unit located on one side or both sides of the running unit or the feed storage unit to check the remaining amount of feed in the feeding trough; and a control unit controlling the feed supply unit according to the remaining amount of feed in the feeding trough checked by the detection unit to adjust the supply of feed to the feeding trough and the amount of feed supplied.

title: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD, INFORMATION PROCESSING PROGRAM
abstract: The present invention provides a technology for easily implementing livestock breeding management in consideration of animal welfare. The present invention captures images of livestock animals, acquires identifiers of the livestock animals, and saves, in a storage unit, the acquired identifiers and the captured images in association with each other. In addition, the present invention compares the images, captured at different times, of the livestock animal that is identified by the same identifier, and notifies a switch of the livestock animal that is identified by the same identifier, when a change of the livestock animal, which cannot occur in a prescribed period, is found as a comparison result.

title: Systems and methods for determining feed intake of cattle
abstract: A system for determining feed intake of a cow, the system including: at least one sensor configured to be positioned on a collar and/or ear-tag of a cow, wherein the sensor is configured to collect data associated with head movements of the cow, a processor in communication with a memory module, the memory module having stored thereon program code, the program code executable by the processor to: receive signals from the at least one sensor, preprocess the received signals by classifying different time blocks of the received signal into classes of behaviors of the cow, extract a plurality of features based, at least in part, on the classified time blocks, and calculate the feed intake of the cow based on the one or more extracted features.

title: Systems and methods for determining feed intake of cattle
abstract: A system for determining feed intake of a cow, the system including: at least one sensor configured to be positioned on a collar and/or ear-tag of a cow, wherein the sensor is configured to collect data associated with head movements of the cow, a processor in communication with a memory module, the memory module having stored thereon program code, the program code executable by the processor to: receive signals from the at least one sensor, preprocess the received signals by classifying different time blocks of the received signal into classes of behaviors of the cow, extract a plurality of features based, at least in part, on the classified time blocks, and calculate the feed intake of the cow based on the one or more extracted features.

title: INTRARUMINAL DEVICE AND METHOD
abstract: The invention relates to devices and methods for reducing and monitoring methane emissions from ruminant and pseudo-ruminant animals. In particular the invention relates to an intraruminal device comprising a light source with an illumination wavelength of about 420nm to about 470nm. The light source may inactivate co-factor 420 which is essential for methane production in ruminant animals thereby reducing emitted methane. The device may also incorporate sensors including sensors configured to detect the fluorescence emission of excited F420.

title: PROBE APPARATUS FOR MEASURING AT LEAST ONE STATE VARIABLE OF THE ORGANISM OF A LIVESTOCK ANIMAL
abstract: The invention relates to a probe apparatus (1) for measuring at least one state variable of the organism of a livestock animal (2) and for identifying the livestock animal (2), wherein the probe apparatus (1) can be arranged in the gastro-intestinal tract (3) of the livestock animal (2) and comprises at least the following components arranged in or on a housing (4): - at least one sensor element (51, 52) for measuring at least one physical parameter in the gastro-intestinal tract (3) of the livestock animal (2); - at least one internal communication device (8) for wirelessly receiving and transmitting information; and - at least one internal processor unit (5), which is designed to evaluate the signals detected by the sensor element (51, 52) and is connected to the at least one sensor element (51, 52) for this purpose, and is connected to the internal communication device (8) for transferring the data derived from said signals and for actuation, wherein the internal processor unit (5) comprises a data store (6) on which at least one configuration file (7) can be stored.

title: FREE-RANGE LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SERVER DEVICE, SYSTEM, METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: This free-range livestock management server device: acquires information pertaining to individuals or locations; identifies individuals on the basis of the acquired information; identifies locations on the basis of the acquired information; ascertains states of the individuals or locations on the basis of the acquired information; monitors for an abnormal state of the individuals or locations on the basis of the acquired information; organizes, for each individual or location that has been identified, information pertaining to the identified individuals or locations, ascertained states, and monitored abnormal state, and thereby associates such information with each individual or location that has been identified; stores the organized and associated information; determines, out of the stored information, the urgency of information pertaining to the abnormal state of the individuals or locations, such determination being on the basis of a preset criterion; and generates notice information on the basis of information determined to be urgent and transmit same to a predetermined terminal.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR DETECTING LAMENESS IN CATTLE
abstract: The present disclosure relates to detection of lameness in bovine subjects, especially dairy cattle, in a shed environment based on vision technology, in particular 3D imaging. A first embodiment relates to a method for detecting lameness in bovine subjects, the method comprising the steps of acquiring at least one 3D image of the back of a bovine subject, extracting data representing the spine of the bovine subject, determining at least one curvature of at least one preselected part of the spine, and detecting lameness and/or determining a degree of lameness of the bovine subject by correlating said curvature(s) with at least one reference value, such as at least one predefined threshold value.

title: SYSTEMS, DEVICES, AND METHODS FOR RUMINANT ACIDOSIS DETECTION
abstract: Embodiments include example systems, devices, and methods for solvent analysis and biological sample analysis, and for analyzing biological samples for solvents associated with health status related to ruminant acidosis, and for on-farm identification of acidosis in ruminants. In certain aspects, acidosis is detected via measurement of solvents and other volatile chemicals present in the ruminants. Embodiments include methods and systems of diagnosing a state of health of an animal by receiving a sample of a bodily fluid or gas from an oral or nasal cavity of the animal, measuring a quantity of at least one of an identified solvent or an identified gas in the sample, and determining a state of health associated with the animal based on the quantity of the identified solvent.

title: Electronic body caliper for sows
abstract: A first plate with a first downwardly extending member and a second plate with a second downwardly extending member. The second plate moves with respect to the first plate to define a change in a relative angle between the first downwardly extending member and the second downwardly extending member. A position sensor is coupled between the first plate and the second plate to measure a relative change in angle between the first plate and the second plate.

title: REUSABLE EAR TAG
abstract: A biometric monitoring device for an animal ear includes a male portion on a first side of the ear including a base having an upper surface towards the first side including openings and a protrusion having an upper portion for penetrating from the first side a second side of the ear, and a female portion for the second side of the ear including a housing having a bottom surface towards the second side of the ear including an internal opening configured to receive the upper portion of the protrusion, a retention portion configured to releasably retain the upper portion of the protrusion, a plurality of electronic components including a battery, a processor, and a temperature sensor, and a thermally conductive ring disposed upon on the bottom surface configured to be disposed against the second side, and wherein the thermally conductive ring is thermally coupled to the temperature sensor.

title: DIGITAL MONITORING OF PATHOGEN LOAD IN LIVESTOCK
abstract: The present invention relates to a computer-implemented method for monitoring pathogen load in livestock, using a risk matrix for evaluating the risk of a pathogen load in livestock to cause a disease, a computer program product comprising code portions adapted for performing the method according to the present invention, and a system for monitoring pathogen load in livestock.

title: Livestock evaluation system and method of use
abstract: A livestock evaluation system for identifying the soundness of the livestock, comprising, a livestock evaluation application, a user profile, an interface, and a server. The interface provides a secure connection between the user and the server, and the user profile requiring specific livestock evaluation uploads the photos of livestock on the server. The livestock evaluation application uses an algorithm to identify structural components of livestock and the points are identified marking the major joints and skeletal features of livestock. The livestock can be cattle, horse, sheep, deer, and any other similar animal.

title: IOT-BASED CATTLE HEALTH AND HEAT MONITORING SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention introduces an IoT-based cattle health and heat monitoring system (100) that enables continuous monitoring of cattle health parameters through a collar unit (10) attached to or worn by each cattle. The collar unit (10) is designed to capture multiple parameters from the wearer using a variety of sensors. The collar unit (10) then transmits the measured values to a server (20) for further processing via a communication network. The server (20) generates alerts to a user's computing device (40) based on predictions made by AI module (30) therein. The alerts are produced when abnormal conditions are detected, utilizing statistical analysis performed by the AI module (30) on the server side. These alerts assist the user in providing appropriate remedies, as early detection of issues contributes to the well-being of the cattle.

title: REMOVABLE TREATMENT MANAGEMENT APPARATUS AND TREATMENT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract: A treatment management apparatus for managing treatment administered to livestock is provided. The treatment management apparatus may comprise a wireless communication interface configured to receive, from a user system, treatment data representing an animal to be treated and a treatment to be administered; an animal detector configured to detect placement of the treatment management apparatus against a surface of the animal; and an actuation monitor configured to detect actuation of a treatment initiation component to initiate administration of the treatment of the animal; wherein the wireless communication interface is further configured to send, to the user system, administration data regarding the administration of the treatment, wherein the administration data represents one or more events associated with the animal detector and the actuation monitor.

title: SERVER FOR DETECTING LIVESTOCK ANOMALY AND METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The present invention relates to a server for detecting abnormal signs of livestock, comprising: a communication module; and a processor connected to the communication module, wherein the processor receives image data from an image acquisition device through the communication module, extracts the amount of livestock activity from the image data, calculates the average amount of livestock activity based on the extracted amount of livestock activity, and can detect abnormal signs of livestock based on the average amount of livestock activity.

title: Cow nipple positioning and tracking control system
abstract: The invention discloses a dairy cow nipple positioning and tracking control system, which belongs to the technical field of positioning and tracking and comprises an upper computer, a mechanical arm, a controller, a driving mechanism and a camera. According to the invention, images are collected through the camera, image information is transmitted to the upper computer, accurate positioning and tracking of a dairy cow nipple target are realized based on an SURF algorithm and a KCF algorithm, after position data of the dairy cow nipple target are obtained, the upper computer sends a control instruction to the controller, and the controller changes the coordinates of the position data, so that the dairy cow nipple target can be accurately positioned and tracked. Further, the driving mechanism is controlled to drive the mechanical arm to move, and follow-up milking work is facilitated; the X-axis lead screw module, the Y-axis lead screw module and the Z-axis lead screw module are adopted in the driving mechanism and used for achieving three-dimensional movement of the mechanical arm, and accurate grabbing is facilitated.

title: LABEL FOR USE IN A POSITIONING SYSTEM, POSITIONING SYSTEM, LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: The invention relates to a label for a positioning system, provided with a transmission and reception unit comprising coil antennas. Each of the coil antennas is located in the label such that a longitudinal axis through the coil antenna extends, in use, parallel to a surface of the earth. A first and a second coil antenna thereof are mutually differently oriented. For transmitting a positioning signal, the transmission and reception unit comprises an energization circuit for generating a first magnetic alternating field with the first coil antenna and a second magnetic alternating field with the second coil antenna. Further, the transmission and reception unit is provided with a readout circuit which is configured for determining a voltage potential of an alternating voltage in both the first coil antenna and the second coil antenna, for receiving an incoming positioning signal.

title: Livestock health monitoring system and method of use
abstract: An animal wellness notification system includes an attachment body configured to securely engage with an ear of the animal; an elongated temperature probe secured to the attachment body and configured to extend within the ear of the animal; a housing secured to the attachment body; a power module electrically connect to and configured to provide power to (or recharge) at least one other element of the animal wellness notification system; a computer disposed within the housing and operably associated with the temperature probe; and a notification device in data communication with the computer, the notification device being configured to provide notice if a temperature of the animal goes beyond a determined.

title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR THE AUTOMATED IDENTIFICATION OF A PIG THAT IS READY FOR ONWARD TRANSFER
abstract: A device for the automated identification of a pig that is ready for onward transfer includes a detection unit for the determination of a weight statement of at least one pig, a database with pig-related data, wherein the pig-related data includes statements concerning at least one determined, or determinable, pig, and an evaluation unit configured to generate an onward transfer indicator. The evaluation unit is configured for data exchange with the detection unit and with the database, such that the evaluation unit generates the onward transfer indicator as a function of the determined weight value and as a function of the pig-related data, so as automatically to identify the pig with the onward transfer indicator as being ready for onward transfer.

title: METHOD AND CONTROL SYSTEM FOR CONTROLLING AN AGRICULTURAL INSTALLATION FOR SMALL LIVESTOCK FARMING AND/OR MEDIUM LIVESTOCK FARMING
abstract: A method for controlling an agricultural installation for small and medium livestock farming includes the steps of: acquiring at least one sensor signal of a sensor device of the agricultural installation configured for measuring a process or state variable in the agricultural installation; acquiring a plurality of further sensor signals from locally in the agricultural installation or from sensor devices distributed locally in another agricultural installation, wherein the distributed sensor devices are configured to measure process or state variables; storing the acquired sensor signals as cloud data in a cloud computing device; evaluating the sensor signal with an evaluation module, wherein the evaluation module is part of a control device of the agricultural installation and/or of a cloud computing device and wherein the evaluation takes at least a portion of the stored cloud data into consideration in order to verify the sensor signal in relation to the stored cloud data.

title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR INVENTORY MANAGEMENT OF LIVESTOCK BASED ON IMAGE
abstract: An image-based livestock inventory management device includes a data transmission and reception module, a memory storing an image-based livestock inventory management program, and a processor configured to execute the image-based livestock inventory management program stored in the memory, wherein the image-based livestock inventory management program detects each livestock individual by inputting, to a livestock individual detection model, an image collected by at least one camera that captures a doorway of each livestock room which is set as one region of interest (ROI), tracks a movement state of each livestock individual by accumulating and storing center coordinates of detected each livestock individual, generates entry and exit state information of each livestock room by counting an entry action and an exit action of each livestock individual at the doorway of each livestock room for the ROI, and provides inventory information.

title: ANIMAL HUSBANDRY SYSTEM
abstract: The present invention relates to an animal husbandry system, wherein a group of animals (2) can move about freely in an area (1), the system comprising identification means configured for determining the identity of each individual animal, tracking means configured for tracking the position of each individual animal, and attention means configured for identifying an attention animal having a predetermined condition, wherein the system is configured for automatically determining a subgroup of animals that have been in a predetermined relationship with the attention animal. The determination of such a subgroup is highly useful. For example, it can be established whether the animals in the subgroup also have the predetermined condition of the attention animal. This is helpful in order to be able to contain the spreading of the predetermined condition, if this is desired.

title: LIVESTOCK ANIMAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
abstract: A livestock animal management system comprises a livestock shed with a livestock space for livestock animals, a feed fence provided in the livestock shed with a plurality of feed fence positions, where the livestock animals are able to eat animal feed through the feed fence, a livestock animal locating system for determining and monitoring positions of the livestock animals in the livestock shed, and a control device which is connected to the livestock animal locating system for receiving and processing said positions. The control device is configured for generating an animal alarm if the position of a livestock animal remains within a distance threshold of one of the feed fence positions for at least a time threshold. In this way, it is possible to generate an alarm for a trapped animal in a reliable manner. Due to the distance threshold, there is, on the one hand, a connection with the feed fence, in which animals could become trapped. On the other hand, said distance threshold prevents the situation the situation where no alarm is raised for trapped animals which are still moving.

title: Computer method and apparatus for tagless tracking of livestock
abstract: A computer method provides tagless tracking of livestock. Individual livestock are identified using biometric identification. Biometric identities are associated with digital identities. The method reconciles image analysis and tracking errors iteratively.
applicants: Synetic, Inc.; The Main Branch, Inc.

title: ICT ICT-based pig farming management system
abstract: The present invention relates to a pig barn management system based on information and communications technology (ICT) that is configured to: receive temperature detection data within a pig barn from a temperature detection part; receive humidity detection data within the pig barn from a humidity detection part while controlling a pig barn temperature adjustment part to maintain the set temperature based on the temperature detection data within the pig barn; receive thermal image data, ammonia detection data, and methane detection data from a thermal image acquisition part, an ammonia detection part, and a methane detection part while controlling a pig barn ventilation adjustment part to maintain a set humidity based on the humidity detection data within the pig barn; obtain pig disease data by analyzing with AI based on the received thermal image data, ammonia detection data, and methane detection data; and provide the obtained disease data to an administrator terminal.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MONITORING AT LEAST ONE ANIMAL IN A DAIRY FARM COMPRISING A PLURALITY OF ZONES
abstract: The disclosure relates to systems and methods for monitoring at least one animal (100), such as at least one cow, in a dairy farm (1) comprising a plurality of zones. Animal location data (P) comprising in which zone (Z) of the plurality of zones the at least one animal (100) was located at certain moments in time is determined by animal localising means (200). Furthermore, at least one respective response (R) from the at least one animal (100), indicative of a level of physical and/or psychological stress and/or discomfort of the at least one animal (100) at certain moments in time, is registered by at least one animal sensor arrangement (300). At least one respective response (R) from the at least one animal (100) is associated with the corresponding animal location data (P) by a control unit (20) to determine in which zone (Z) said at least one animal (100) was located at the certain moment in time on which said at least one respective response (R) was registered. A zone-specific stress level (Sz) for a zone (Z) is determined by the control unit (20) based on at least one respective response (R) and an action is triggered by the control unit (20) if the zone-specific stress level (Sz) fulfils a stress level criterion (Sc).

title: LIVE-STOCK TRACKERS FOR WELLNESS ASSESSMENT IN AN INTERNET OF THINGS NETWORK
abstract: In one aspect, a system of a live-stock carbon footprint assessment in an internet of things network tracking comprising: a plurality of asset trackers, wherein each asset tracker tracks one or more IoT assets and obtains a set of IoT data; one or more communications hubs; a base station; one or more communication networks; wherein each asset tracker is configured to be in communication with a base station and one or more of the communications hubs; a server computing device configured to be in communication with the one or more networks, wherein the server computing device is further configured to implement the following logic: periodically received sensor data from an attached live-stock carbon footprint tracker that is attached to a live-stock entity; and use the sensor data to calculate a livestock carbon footprint.
applicants: PANCHALAN, PRASAD; VIDAL, ALBERTO; Rao, Manu

title: Dairy Cattle Breeding Status Indicator Technology
abstract: A bovine estrus detection device includes a generally rectangular base having sides and ends, the base having a predetermined length and a predetermined width, and the width being less than the length, the base having a first side and a second side. The first side of the base has a central region having a first color and end regions having a second color. The second color is different from the first color. An adhesive is disposed on the second side of the base for coupling the base to a female cow or heifer. A removable coating is disposed over the first side of the base. The removable coating is exposed for contact by male or female cows mounting the female cow or heifer to which the device is attached. The coating is adapted to being removed by mounting male or female cows, whereby the first and second colors become visible. Exposure of the first color in the central region is an accurate predictor of activation and estrus.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR AUTONOMOUSLY NAVIGATING AN ANIMAL ENVIRONMENT AND PERFORMING TASKS
abstract: A navigation device provides for autonomous interactions with animals and navigation of the animal environment, such as a poultry barn. The navigation device includes one or more cameras for detecting animals. The navigation device also includes one or more cameras for object detection purposes. The navigation device also includes a camera or a LiDAR for mapping the position and orientation (pose) of the navigation device within the environment. By the object detection and the pose information, the navigation device autonomously travels within the environment. The navigation device also includes a spinner assembly for deterring animals from the path of the navigation device.

title: Solar-Powered GNSS SIM Chip Device for Tracking and Monitoring Animals and Assets
abstract: A solar-powered Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) Subscriber Identity Module (SIM) chip device for tracking and monitoring animals and assets is disclosed that allows an individual to track an animal or object. The device is designed as an ultra-low power and lightweight tag that runs only when needed. To do so, the device includes an electronic ear tag, a cellular communication module, a camera module, an electronic stethoscope, a radio-frequency identification (RFID) scannable chip, and a two-way audio communication system. The electronic ear tag corresponds to the main structure of the device that supports the operation of the electrical and electronic components. The cellular communication module enables the device to connect to a cellular network through which the necessary data is being transmitted. The camera module, the electronic stethoscope, the RFID scannable chip, and the two-way audio communication system facilitate the remote monitoring of the target animal wearing the device.

title: AI-BASED LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND LIVESTOCK MANAGEMENT METHOD THEREOF
abstract: Disclosed is an Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based livestock management system and a livestock management method therefor. According to the inventive concept, it is possible to determine whether the animal has abnormal symptoms by learning the standard livestock stall management data and analyzing the body temperature information and behavior information of livestock from livestock image data obtained in real time from livestock such as cattle, thus giving the manager confidence.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR DETECTING LIVESTOCK RESPIRATORY COMPROMISE
abstract: Video cameras capture video images of livestock and transmit the images to a computer. The computer identifies individual livestock based on biometric markings. The computer performs pixel enhancement to amplify breathing motion and calculates a respiration rate. A sudden increase in respiration rate indicates respiratory compromise, such as pneumonia or BRO.

title: Livestock Monitoring System and Methods of Use
abstract: Livestock movement monitoring system and method of use are disclosed herein. An example method includes receiving output from each of a plurality of sensors that are associated with livestock in a confined area, tracking a position and movement of the livestock from the output, determining at least one deviation from an expected parameter using the position and movement, and transmitting an alert to a recipient when the at least one deviation has been determined.

title: MONITORING DEVICE FOR AN ANIMAL
abstract: A monitoring device for an animal comprising a body with an aperture for receiving a first part of an ear tag that extends through an ear of the animal. The body comprises a surface area for contacting the ear of the animal. The monitoring device further comprises a processor, a battery and a network. The monitoring device is configured such that, in use, when the first part of an ear tag extends through the ear of the animal and the aperture of the monitoring device, and the second part of the ear tag is fixated to the first part, the monitoring device is positioned between the ear tag and the ear of the animal so that the surface area of the body of the monitoring device is in contact with the ear of the animal to obtain the information indicative of at least the temperature of the animal.
